Then, his subordinates and his friends would see his corpse appearing in the Beast Tide, like any other beast.
At that thought, Kong Dao watched the beasts surrounding him attempting another lunge. He smiled a tragic smile, howled, and was about to trigger a self-explosion.
It was then that... suddenly, he heard gasps of shock. He heard human breathing and explosions. He hadn’t the time to see clearly what was happening when spell after spell erupted around him in a blinding glare. Dharmic Artifacts shot into the pit he was at and exploded.
The beasts, who had the pit surrounded and had been trying to charge inside, screamed amidst the series of explosions. They were torn into pieces, their flesh bloodied. Kong Dao, who escaped death narrowly, saw Wang Baole, Dharmic Armament in hand, charging towards him and appearing before him. Wang Baole grabbed at him. Behind Wang Baole were hordes of cultivators with varying degrees of injuries.
“You...” Kong Dao was dazed. He struggled instinctively. Before he could finish what he wanted to say, Wang Baole shut him up with a glare.
“Kong Dao, did you knock yourself too hard in the head?” Furious, Wang Baole swept his large hands and snaked around Kong Dao’s instinctively struggling arms. He grabbed Kong Dao’s robes and flung Kong Dao towards the military cultivators behind him.
“Quickly, retreat!” Wang Baole was wrought with anxiety. He had a bad feeling. He could feel that a presence inside the catacombs was slowly stirring awake with his arrival.

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - Points Added and Points Deducted!
chapters.content:
Chapter 378: Points Added and Points Deducted!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Just as Wang Baole and the group were about to make their escape, a howl that seemed to come from the depths of the catacombs rang out suddenly. It erupted without any warning from the deep end of the catacombs.
It thundered and deafened, shaking everyone to their core. Blood spilled from everyone’s lips, and Wang Baole shuddered violently as the three Dark Fires inside his body wavered and became unstable. They almost extinguished.
As he lowered his head, he thought he could vaguely see a warped, translucent giant hand reaching out from the depths of the catacombs. It seemed to stretch endlessly towards where Wang Baole was, reaching out for him!
“Dark Child...” The voice howled. Its howl thundered and rang in the catacombs and drained all color from Wang Baole’s terrified face. He shouted back angrily.
“To hell with your shouting!” Wang Baole’s skull was about to explode with the terrible howling. He and the rest around him charged madly towards the catacombs’ entrance, but they were too late. The giant hand was too swift. It had been a distance away a moment ago, but in the next moment, it was but a hundred yards away from Wang Baole!
Everywhere it passed, it left catacomb walls frozen in ice. There would be waves of crackling as the giant hand approached, then after, ice everywhere.
It approached him and was about to catch up...
Wang Baole started heaving and was about to silently chant the scripture to fight back. It was then that they heard a snort over their heads. It erupted suddenly and without warning. Three silhouettes leaped across the crowd of people like lightning bolts, appearing behind their backs and before the giant hand that was about to grab them!
They were the Martian Colony Governor, the giant tree, and a red-haired elderly man dressed in military uniform. The three of them were all at the perfected Core Formation realm. Their cultivation erupted, and they joined forces as they clashed against the giant hand.
A thunderous boom erupted. It was deafening. The giant tree and the elder grunted under their breaths and retreated hastily. Only the Governor stood firm, raising her right hand. An enormous war hammer was instantly summoned and appeared in her hand. As soon as it appeared, its presence shook the heavens and earth. A force that paled only in comparison against the Divine Armament erupted. It was... a ninth-grade Dharmic Armament!
One hit from it seemed to shatter heaven and earth. The giant hand shuddered violently and split apart instantly. Only the howling remained, echoing in the catacombs. It seemed to be filled with hate and resentment, and it contained fury and madness.
“Go!” The Governor’s face was stern. After that single blow, she didn’t speak again and fell back hastily. She flung her sleeves and, together with the giant tree and the elder from the military, guarded Wang Baole and the tens of thousands of cultivators as they fled with increasing speed.
Their journey back was smooth and without obstacle. They immediately reached the entrance and charged out. When they reappeared in the open again, the Governor quickly formed a series of hand seals. The seal over the Divine Armament Catacombs erupted and once again sealed the catacombs shut.
Wang Baole’s heart was still racing after they escaped outside. He couldn’t help but stare at the Governor and her accompanying duo. He knew that the Governor had immediately teleported over after receiving his notice. If she hadn’t done so, the rescue mission would have been a complete disaster.
Supported by his fellow cultivators, Kong Dao swallowed a pill that prevented him from passing out despite his serious injuries. He knew that he had made a misstep this time and had narrowly avoided death. He also knew that if Wang Baole hadn’t come for him, it was likely... that he would have died in the catacombs.
He felt a complicated array of emotions regarding this. He didn’t know what to say to Wang Baole when he looked at him. He chose silence instead.
“Wang Baole, you’ve gone too far!” The Governor sealed the catacombs and turned on Wang Baole. There was fury in her eyes, and she had an extremely stern and disapproving expression on her face.
Wang Baole grimaced. He was about to speak when Kong Dao clenched his teeth and said softly.
“Governor, this entire incident is a result of my recklessness. It has nothing to do with Wang Baole...”
“Silence! So, you do know that you’ve been rash? What did I tell you before you came?” Without giving the Governor a chance to speak, the red-haired elder in military uniform flew into an instant rage. As the primary priest of the Martian military, he had a close friendship with Duan Muque. The reason Kong Dao was here on Mars was that he and Duan Muque had found him in the Sea of Beasts when he had been only a baby.
Kong Dao was clearly very important to the elder. That was why when he heard that Kong Dao had fallen into danger, he had immediately left his seclusion and joined the rescue party. Whilst he raged at Kong Dao, the elder still spared the occasional glance at Wang Baole. The expression he showed Wang Baole was different from what he was showing Kong Dao. It was colored with approval as well as gratitude.
The elder knew that if Wang Baole had waited for them to arrive before taking any action, Kong Dao... would have been dead by then.
Wang Baole blinked under the elder’s gaze. The Governor glared at Wang Baole again, then scolded Jin Duoming and Lin Tianhao. Finally, she said...
“This will never happen again!”
Wang Baole finally released a sigh of relief when he heard that. He realized that there was nothing he feared in the entire universe, except the Martian Colony Governor. He didn’t understand why...
He stepped forward hastily and was thinking about how best to suck up to the Governor when she snorted.
“You can stop that now. Put away that pitiful look on your face. Since I’m here, I’m going to check out how far the construction of the new city zone has progressed. If there’s anything not in order, you’re going to be punished!”
“Don’t worry, Governor. I won’t dare to make guarantees for anything else, but this definitely is in order. Your humble subordinate has been forgoing sleep and food for the past six months...” Wang Baole thumped his chest and immediately started rattling off. A glare from the Governor stopped him mid-track in his exaggerations. She didn’t say anything else, only walked ahead and started her inspection.
It was a detailed inspection but hardly slow-moving. The Governor’s cultivation often allowed her to identify any flaws or oversight with a mere glance. Within an hour, the Governor had found a few problem areas and instructed Wang Baole to resolve them quickly. She ended the inspection and left.
During the entire process, she hadn’t spared Li Yi a single glance, nor had she spoken a single word to the latter. She had seemed to have completely disregarded her presence. Li Yi, who had been expecting praise, had been stunned.
The red-haired elder had done the same. He had been stern towards Kong Dao, but towards Wang Baole, Lin Tianhao, and Jin Duoming, he had shown apparent approval. He had smiled and displayed friendliness towards the trio. He similarly ignored Li Yi. Before he left, he had given her a deep, meaningful look and snorted.
Li Yi had grown nervous. She hadn’t been able to control herself from sneaking a glance at the giant tree, but he remained silent. Then, just before they left, he sighed. He looked at Li Yi with an unfathomable look in his eyes, filled with thoughts he found difficult to express. There had been slight regret and a certain sense of speechlessness.
When he first arrived and noticed that Wang Baole and the others had entered the catacombs while Li Yi alone had remained outside, he had immediately known... that Li Yi had made a grievous mistake!
It would have been fine if there had been no basis for comparison, but that hadn’t been the case. Everyone knew that the relationship between Wang Baole and Kong Dao was strained. However, despite the tensions between them, Wang Baole hadn’t hesitated to put his life at risk in order to mount an immediate rescue.
Even though his actions might have revealed an impulsive nature, they were all young men and women. Some passion and impulse was essential. His actions might not have been appropriate, but he had gained points for his character in people’s hearts!
Li Yi, on the other hand, regardless of the reasons she might have had, chose not to follow them. She seemed to have made the right decision from the grand scheme of things; however, in reality, while what she had done wasn’t exactly wrong, she had lost points in the hearts of the people. In fact, she hadn’t simply lost a few points...
In the political landscape of the Federation, one’s character was key. Others’ impression of them were equally important. Often, it was important to accumulate points for one’s character.
This was especially so because of the special status Kong Dao held...
Li Yi started trembling under the giant tree’s gaze. She had grown pale gradually. Then, she had come to her senses and snuck a glance at Kong Dao. She then saw the look that Kong Dao had been giving Wang Baole. It was one filled with complicated emotions.
Even Jin Duoming had shaken his head inwardly. He had wondered if Li Yi had directed all the nutrients towards nourishing her body and had left her brains malnourished and inadequate.
Everything seemed to revert to normal after the Governor and the other two cultivators left. However, Li Yi could clearly feel herself being ostracized... Kong Dao hadn’t said anything, but the military cultivators under his supervision treated Li Yi more coldly compared to how they treated Wang Baole.
Lin Tianhao had been like this from the start. Though, Jin Duoming’s attitude towards her seemed to have grown less fervent...
Wang Baole, you must have done this intentionally!
A sullen Li Yi returned to her residence. She gnashed her teeth as her eyes shone bright with hate and resentment. She swore that she would kick Wang Baole out and take his place!
While Li Yi swore vehemently under her breath, Wang Baole had just returned to his residence. He released a sigh of relief as a strange light glimmered in his eyes. He recalled what had happened in the catacombs earlier. The absorption by his devouring seed had enhanced his cultivation tremendously during that short period of time.
He couldn’t control himself. He started thinking. Then, he realized that while most of his mosquitoes had been destroyed after they had rescued Kong Dao, two remained... they were alive and were inside the catacombs right now!
Wang Baole relied on the two mosquitoes’ vision and saw the chill inside the catacombs rapidly dissipating. After everything returned to normal, he maneuvered the two mosquitoes, with slight difficulty, and got them to rapidly fly deeper into the catacombs. Slowly, they reached the end of the catacombs... where the wall was!

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - The Bigger the Territory, the More Powerful Baole Was
chapters.content:
Chapter 379: The Bigger the Territory, the More Powerful Baole Was
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Inside the Divine Armament Catacombs, silence reigned.
It was as if the Governor’s ninth-grade Dharmic Armament had destroyed everything with a single blow. Within a short period of time, there would be no beasts in the catacombs.
Even the meatballs previously hanging on the walls had all been destroyed and disintegrated into dust. Wang Baole’s mosquitoes flew ahead, their journey undisturbed. They easily reached the end of the catacombs.
Wang Baole had reached the limits of his control by then. He could vaguely see the wall. His eyes widened, and his breathing stopped. Incredulity colored his face.
It wasn’t that he hadn’t seen the wall before. It was true he had never seen it with his own eyes, but he had seen images and videos of the wall through the mosquitoes’ eyes and via the reports that Kong Dao submitted on a regular basis.
He remembered the wall as a thick wall of ice that exuded a frightening chill. It was like a hardy fossil resistant to erosion, one that required the constant wearing down by the array formation all hours of the day and night in order to chip away slowly at it.
The rate of erosion was indiscernible to the eye across a brief period of time, and changes were only apparent after decades.
Now, however... the wall appeared before Wang Baole’s eyes. It was clearly more eroded than what he had seen a week ago in Kong Dao’s reports. The erosion seemed like the result of months of wearing down.
This shocked Wang Baole. A strange light glimmered in his eyes, and his breathing quickened. He couldn’t pinpoint the cause that sped up the rate of the wall’s erosion.
Is it because of the appearance of the giant hand? Or maybe the blow from the Governor’s ninth-grade Dharmic Armament? Or perhaps... it’s because of the Dark Qi that I absorbed at an increased rate using my devouring seed?
Wang Baole was unclear of the exact cause. However, he could sense that this was an opportunity.
Even though he couldn’t say for sure what sort of opportunities the quickened erosion opened up for him, he had studiously read the high officials’ autobiographies and through that honed a keen instinct. His instincts were telling him that... he could try exploring further on this matter.
With that thought in mind, Wang Baole immediately summoned Kong Dao. Kong Dao hadn’t yet fully recovered from his injuries, but he had healed well and was in fine condition currently. If it had been in the past, he might not have given great consideration to Wang Baole’s summons and got a deputy to respond in his stead. Now, however, he fell into momentary silence and made a personal visit.
He heard Wang Baole’s inquiries regarding the wall. Kong Dao didn’t attempt to conceal what he knew. He shared everything he knew about the wall, including the video recordings he had taken during his observations of the wall yesterday, with Wang Baole.
Wang Baole watched the video, and his eyes shone. Yesterday’s wall and today’s wall were completely different creatures. This allowed Wang Baole to narrow his scope of investigation. However, it was difficult to replicate the appearance of the giant hand or the blow from the Governor’s ninth-grade Dharmic Armament as and when Wang Baole wanted so that he might test and verify his hypothesis.
Based on Wang Baole’s analysis, though, the giant hand’s appearance shouldn’t be the key to solving the mystery at hand. It also seemed improbable that the blow from the ninth-grade Dharmic Armament had been the cause of the wall’s rapid erosion. If that had been the case, the various political forces in the Federation wouldn’t have chosen to set up an array formation here. They could simply take turns unleashing the power of their ninth-grade Dharmic Armaments at the wall.
The reading materials from the Governor said before... only a Divine Armament could forcibly break through the wall!
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. His heart started racing. The only thing that remained before him that required his verification and testing was... whether his devouring seed had an influence on the wall!
The idea burned like a scorching fire inside his heart, fierce and bright. He had no idea why he had to test this theory. His instincts simply told him that if he could indeed verify that the devouring seed indeed was the cause, this would present an unprecedented opportunity for him!
Wang Baole shoved the burning heat inside his heart down and sent Kong Dao off. Then, he raced towards the sealed Divine Armament Catacombs. The area was controlled by the military. However, Wang Baole’s rescue efforts had won the respect of all military cultivators. He was also the mayor. No one would try to stop him, and some even volunteered to escort him in.
Wang Baole didn’t want others to witness his attempts. He turned them down politely. Then, with a racing heart, he sent his mosquitoes out first to scout out the area before entering the catacombs alone.
He didn’t venture too deep into the catacombs and stopped at an appropriate section. He checked that there were no dangers around, then, controlled his excitement as he used the Dark Art as a foundation while activating his devouring seed. Instantly, a rush of chilly aura erupted from within the depths of the catacombs and surged towards him. Wang Baole transformed into a vast whirlpool that drew the chill inwards. At the same time, he allowed part of his attention to settle on the mosquitoes that had ventured near the wall at the end of the catacombs, pushing them to investigate the area swiftly.
Wang Baole shuddered at what he saw. He could see, clearly, the wall eroding at a rapid rate as his devouring seed churned.
It was the devouring seed all along!
Wang Baole perked up. He stopped the churning of his devouring seed before turning and leaving hastily. He soon exited the catacombs and sealed it shut. Wang Baole returned to his residence. He wasn’t in the mood for meditation. Instead, he started pacing in his residence.
This is an opportunity...
Let me think, how should I play this so that I can fully utilize this opportunity to my maximum benefit...
How should I do this...
Wang Baole’s Spirit Qi stirred as countless thoughts flashed across his head. He seemed to have exhausted himself with the intense thinking, so he pulled out some snacks and started eating while continuing his brainstorming.
Firstly, the Federation will definitely treat something that can increase the rate the wall is eroding with the utmost importance... Even though my individual powers are limited, and I’m not inclined to reveal the existence of my devouring seed, the mystic technique I taught the students in the Dao Mountain Mist Academy should be able to achieve a similar effect...
However, it has to be built on the foundation of the Dark Art... this can be easily done. I just have to convert the mystic art into an array formation and turn myself into the core of the array formation!
This way, the array formation will be able to amplify the powers of the devouring seed and absorb the Dark Qi inside the catacombs at a furious rate, increasing the speed the wall is eroding!
Wang Baole paused in his pacing and slapped his thigh loudly before raising his head. His eyes shone with excitement and anticipation. He could hardly contain his emotions. He had combined everything he had learned from the high officials’ autobiographies and came up with... a solution that was out of this world!
If I’m able to achieve that, I’ll be able to gain complete control. The array formation... will need more resources and greater space. That’s why... we need to expand the existing city zone extensively based on the existing infrastructure already in place...
We’ll then be able to set up the Devouring Seed Array Formation on the foundations of the Qi Fostering Spirit Array Formation!
If the Federation approves my proposal, I’ll have the final say on how much we will need to expand the city zone in order to accommodate the array formation. I can expand the city zone multiple times and turn it into a... new Martian city!
That’s right, that’s how this is going to work. That’s the opportunity I instinctively sensed. If the array formation is successfully set up, this will present an opportunity for me to transform a city zone... into an actual city!
Wang Baole’s head started buzzing noisily. There was no doubt that his idea was an extremely bold venture, but if he succeeded... the new city zone would become a fully formed city. His Noble would naturally be elevated despite there being no chances of it happening previously. He would no longer be a Primary Rank Four Noble but rise to become a Primary Rank Three Noble!
After all, the Federation wouldn’t allow a mere city zone to possess the structure and scale of an actual city, that would create chaos in the existing administrative system and structure. Once something like that happened, the city zone would be reclassified as a city!
Wang Baole was the key to building the city. He would have been the one who submitted the proposal. He would become irreplaceable, to a certain extent. What was equally important was also... the urgency the Federation would have in wearing down the wall inside the Divine Armament Catacombs as soon as possible. As long as his theory was valid and could be implemented successfully, there was a great chance of him being made a Primary Rank Three Noble without much quibbling!
What this means is that the more territory I have, the more powerful I will become! Wang Baole was overcome with excitement. He realized he was simply too clever. He actually came up with such a brilliant and crazy idea. He grabbed a bottle of Ice Spirit Water excitedly and took a huge gulp. The fire inside him burned brighter.
I won’t share this with anyone at the moment. As for converting the simplified devouring seed mystic technique into an array formation...
Wang Baole considered his options while his heart raced. Finally, the image of Zhao Yameng and the Ethereal Dao College surfaced in his mind.
I’ll ask Zhao Yameng for help. At the same time, I’ll get the Sect Lord to provide some assistance as well!
At that thought, Wang Baole turned on his voice transmission ring hastily and called Zhao Yameng.
Zhao Yameng was stationed on Earth in the Federation Capital. Currently, she was sitting inside her office. A beautiful and dignified young woman, she had earned the adoration of countless male cultivators since she assumed office. However, her presence inspired shame and guilt in the opposite sex when they stood before her.
Before her stood a rather good-looking young man, he had adoration in his eyes and spoke softly.
“Minister Zhao, our department is holding a party tonight. Will you...”
Zhao Yameng lifted her head before he could finish saying what he wanted to say. She gave him a deep, meaningful look. The young man started to sweat profusely under her gaze. He grew nervous and awkward, started stuttering, and couldn’t finish his words. He left silently.
Zhao Yameng lowered her head after he left and resumed reading her documents. It was then that her voice transmission ring rang. Wang Baole’s loud voice rang out from the voice transmission ring.
“Yameng, did you miss me? Let’s have a hug that stretches from Earth to Mars, across the vast expanse of space.”

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - Death Comes to Those Seeking It
chapters.content:
Chapter 380: Death Comes to Those Seeking It
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Zhao Yameng’s expression was that of exasperation as she listened to Wang Baole’s shameless greeting. She had long since discovered that when others disrupted her in her daily routines, she needed only to lift her head and give them a long, deep look before they would lower their heads nervously. This tactic of hers had allowed her to drive away the many irrelevant people around her.
But Wang Baole was simply too thick-skinned. He seemed naturally immune to her tactics; they were useless before him. He had also saved her life. Most importantly, Zhao Yameng did feel more warmly towards Wang Baole than towards other people.
Zhao Yameng smiled when she heard Wang Baole’s unpredictable words. Fortunately, no one saw her smile. If anyone in her department saw that smile, they would undoubtedly be dazzled and dazed by it. The Zhao Yameng of their memories was distant and dignified. She was composed and unfazed. Such an authentic smile that came from the heart was a rare display.
“Have you gotten yourself into some other trouble on Mars? Is that why you’ve come looking for me?” Zhao Yameng smiled and said casually.
“How is that possible? I’m the leader of the Adonis Association, beloved by all. Flowers blossom when I walk past them. Everyone’s fallen in love with me since I arrived on Mars.” Wang Baole coughed and thudded his chest.
“Is that so.” Zhao Yameng picked up a file and continued reading it.
Wang Baole could hear the disbelief in Zhao Yameng’s voice. He grew slightly unhappy and decided to list the various examples that proved his point...
“You don’t believe me? Let me tell you a secret. You heard of the Governor of the Martian Colony? I realized that she’s been looking at me in a funny manner...” Wang Baole whispered, pleased. He couldn’t see Zhao Yameng, who had placed her documents down and had a strange expression on her face.
“My charm is just too great. I can feel that the Governor really admires me. She might be considering making me her son-in-law, but it would be hard for her to succeed. I’m just too popular. Do you know? So many young women on Mars are fighting to give me their transmission contact details. Girls these days are all perverts! I’m only the most good looking person on Mars. It has caused me so much trouble. If only I wasn’t so good looking.” Wang Baole got extremely excited. He didn’t have anyone around him to talk to about such matters after all. That was why he couldn’t control himself as he started bragging.
As he rattled on and on, he suddenly realized the silence on the other end of the voice transmission. He froze.
“Yameng?”
Zhao Yameng raised an eyebrow and looked at the voice transmission ring. Wang Baole couldn’t tell if she was smiling or not as she narrowed her eyes. It was rare to see such expressions flickering across her face.
“Ah, how amazing you must be!” After a moment, Zhao Yameng spoke softly and was about to end the transmission. Wang Baole seemed to sense the change in her emotional state. He laughed awkwardly then went straight to business. He told Zhao Yameng about his views and about modifying his mystic technique into an array formation.
Zhao Yameng, who had graduated from the Array Runes Pavilion of the Ethereal Dao College, had extraordinary talents in the area of array formations. She started thinking after hearing what Wang Baole had said. She discussed with Wang Baole the finer details of his idea, and Wang Baole sent her the simplified version of the Qi Devouring Art.
They spoke for a while more. Wang Baole also told Zhao Yameng that he would be informing the Sect Lord of this matter and that he would study the array formation together with Zhao Yameng.
Their transmission ended. Zhao Yameng set her voice transmission ring down. She did not know why, but the voice of Wang Baole bragging appeared in her head.
She thought for a bit before turning on her voice transmission ring. She found a contact number and tried calling. After chatting for a while, she finally went away, pleased, to study the simplified Qi Devouring Art that Wang Baole had given her.
At the same time, Wang Baole had contacted the Sect Lord immediately. He didn’t conceal his ambitions. The Sect Lord was surprised when he heard Wang Baole’s ideas. He took a few breaths, and his eyes shone.
“Baole, are you sure this array formation will speed up the erosion of the wall?”
“Sect Lord, I swear on the lives of my four vice mayors!”
The Sect Lord grew silent when he heard that. He realized he shouldn’t have tried to confirm whether the plan was feasible. He smiled wryly.
“That’s alright, as long as you’re sure. I will contact Zhao Yameng regarding the modification of the array formation and follow her lead. We will work together and help you keep this a secret!”
The conversation ended. Wang Baole was brimming with energy and excitement. He felt as if the doors had just opened to a brand new world. He had everything going smoothly. He only needed the array formation now. Once the array formation was deemed a success, he would become a Primary Rank Three Noble!
He walked out happily and did a round of inspection, catching sight of the donkey. Since he was in high spirits, he did the rare thing and didn’t send a kick in the donkey’s direction. He even patted the donkey on its head, his eyes shining with tender care for it.
The donkey, which had been prepared to be kicked, shuddered at the sight. Its eyes shone with shock and terror. It seemed to sense that Wang Baole was behaving abnormally at that moment, which made it nervous. It thought that some disaster was about to happen. It shuddered and didn’t recover from his shock and alarm even after Wang Baole left. It thought for a while and finally crept away, deciding that it would avoid appearing in front of Wang Baole during this period of time.
Wang Baole ended his inspection and began his seclusion. The night passed. On the second day, bright-eyed and bushy-tailed, Wang Baole was about to continue his inspection when suddenly, he received a voice transmission from the Martian Colony Governor.
The Governor started by asking about Wang Baole’s work, which took Wang Baole by surprise. She had just left yesterday and completed her own inspection. Why was she sending him a voice transmission and inquiring about the new city zone?
Regardless, Wang Baole patiently and respectfully reported everything again. Before he was done, the Governor caught an oversight Wang Baole had missed. She flew into a rage immediately and gave him a scolding over the voice transmission. He was reprimanded for half an hour before she hung up.
Wang Baole was dazed by the verbal lashing he had just gotten... only recovering after a long while. He stared in shock at his voice transmission ring. He found it incomprehensible. The Governor, who was busy all the time and could only afford half an hour to meet him then, had called and reprimanded him for half an hour. Why had she done that...
She specifically called so that she could scold me... could it be that someone has been talking bad about me behind my back? Has someone been passing along reports to the Governor secretly?
Wang Baole gasped as violence flashed across his eyes.
It must be Li Yi!
Wang Baole thought Li Yi simply too despicable. She actually tried to stab him in the back. He was extremely displeased. It was then that Lin Tianhao came looking for him to report on the progress of their work. He had a stern expression on his face. As soon as Lin Tianhao saw Wang Baole, he spoke immediately, and his words made Wang Baole’s eyes turn cold.
“Mayor, Li Yi has been unilaterally modifying the design of the city infrastructure. On the surface, it seems that she’s building the Eternal Fortress, but she’s actually secretly building the city model that she built during the trial!”
“Hmm?” Wang Baole raised his eyebrows. His eyes flashed. Lin Tianhao quickly shared the findings of his report with Wang Baole.
Li Yi had been very careful with what she was doing. However, she couldn’t keep everything under wraps indefinitely. Her occasional carelessness was caught by Lin Tianhao, who had been watching her closely. He had then started to investigate further. The results of his findings had shocked even him.
Li Yi had used her authority and modified the design of quite of few areas in the new city zone. The external appearance of the city seemed to be based on the Eternal Fortress’s design; however, the core of the design and its inner infrastructure had been tweaked to replicate the Global Dharma City.
She had been very careful, though. Many of her modifications had been difficult to spot. Lin Tianhao had watched her for a very long time before he had been able to retrace what she had been doing and got his hands on evidence of her tampering.
Wang Baole grew serious as he listened to the report. He had given Li Yi greater authority so that he could catch her making a mistake. He hadn’t expected her to be so bold. She hadn’t just made a simple mistake. What she had done would affect the smooth running of the array formation. The disaster that would befall them was unimaginable should any instability occur.
This was especially so with the imminent mass migration. If something went wrong with the array formation after the residents had settled in, the consequences would be disastrous!
The thought made Wang Baole furious. He immediately summoned Jin Duoming, Kong Dao, as well as Li Yi. She was to see him immediately.
Kong Dao and Jin Duoming arrived first. They sat in his office, staring at Wang Baole’s somber face with slight surprise. They noticed Lin Tianhao and the lack of expression on his face as well. Kong Dao and Jin Duoming looked at each other but didn’t ask any questions. Soon, an annoyed Li Yi walked in. Before she could sit down, Wang Baole slammed his desk loudly.
“Li Yi, did you get your head kicked by a donkey? Or maybe some dog pissed on your guts, making it swell to such an extent! That’s some guts you have!” His palm slammed loud against his desk. Wang Baole’s furious roar descended like a storm, erupting in the room suddenly.
“Wang Baole, what do you mean by this!” Li Yi lifted her head, her eyes shining with icy hostility. She had a temper as well. She was emboldened by the support the four Dao Colleges were giving her and hence faced Wang Baole’s anger head-on.
“What do I mean by this?” Wang Baole pulled out Lin Tianhao’s jade slip containing the findings of his report and threw it at Li Yi.
“I made you responsible for building the new city zone. Instead of doing that, you went behind my back and secretly built the city model you had designed for the trial. Li Yi, are you trying to start a revolt? Or are you trying to sabotage the Martian project and go against the Federation’s mandate?”

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - Trouble!
chapters.content:
Chapter 381: Trouble!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Facing Wang Baole’s wrath, Li Yi narrowed her eyes and caught the jade slip that Wang Baole had tossed to her. Holding it in her hands, she took a look and turned solemn. She knew that what she had done would eventually be discovered, but didn’t think that it would happen so quickly. In reality, to delay its discovery, she had already taken precautions.
Her plan to carry out her goals while appearing to abide by what she was assigned needed more time to be completely carried out. Once everything was settled, the time would be ripe for her to show her cards and battle it out with Wang Baole.
However, her acts had been discovered earlier than she had planned. That made her frustrated and angry, and as she grew even more solemn, Li Yi put the jade slip down and spoke calmly.
“This should be the act of those lower-ranked workers who made the decision themselves. I will handle this matter and turn the situation around.”
Lin Tianhao narrowed his eyes but remained silent. Kong Dao furrowed his brows, while Jin Duoming looked at Li Yi intently. They all knew that she was trying to shift the blame to someone else.
Wang Baole looked coldly at Li Yi with unfriendliness in his eyes. He was about to erupt in anger, thinking about whether he should use this opportunity to beat Li Yi up when suddenly, he sensed three figures outside his office who were locking his Qi in.
The three figures who were locking his Qi didn’t bother to hide their Core Formation cultivation. They had come from the four Dao Colleges and were the Dao guardians of Li Yi. To put it more accurately, they were the ones who would guarantee the interests of the four Dao Colleges in the new city zone.
The three of them had each come from the White Deer Dao College, White Deer Branch College, and Holy River Dao College. Ethereal Dao College didn’t arrange for their elites to come over, apparently, as that was part of their plans to stop Wang Baole.
After all, the new city zone wasn’t to be belittled. It was in a critical location, so regardless of whether it was Li Yi or Jin Duoming, they had people guarding them by their sides. Only Lin Tianhao and Kong Dao didn’t have such guardians, as even though Lin Tianhao had a strong backing, he represented himself and not the Senate.
Kong Dao, on the other hand, was from the Mars military, which could be considered a local faction. With the convenience of being sent through teleportation, it naturally eliminated the need for guardians.
With his Qi locked in by the three Core Formation cultivators, a chilly look flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes. Even though he had the means to forcefully teach Li Yi a lesson despite being locked in, he thought about it and buried the vicious thoughts deep in his mind. He didn’t choose to act immediately, instead, speaking with a cold voice that reverberated.
“The issue of moving the people is most crucial now. There is also a need to draw divisions for the new city zone. Since everyone is here today, we shall divide the new city zone into four smaller zones, with each of you overseeing its construction. The eastern and southern zones shall be under Mayor Lin Tianhao and Mayor Jin Duoming’s charge, the northern zone under Mayor Kong Dao, while Mayor Li Yi will be in charge of the remaining western zone. On top of that, Li Yi, you owe me an explanation for this matter!”
As Wang Baole spoke, Li Yi furrowed her brows slightly. Originally, having sensed that Wang Baole’s Qi had been locked in, she felt superior as she had the support of the four Dao Colleges, which gave her a firm standing. However, she felt uncomfortable listening to what Wang Baole said.
Wang Baole didn’t talk about relinquishing the power he had given her, but instead divided that power into four, such that she was only in charge of a portion of it.
However, Wang Baole had caught her wrongdoings. As such, even though she was unhappy, and despite having the support of the four Dao Colleges, she didn’t have an excuse to reject the arrangement. In her silence, she sighed.
“I will definitely give you an explanation with regards to this matter. If there is nothing else, I will return to carry out my investigations, and will take my leave now!” As she spoke, Li Yi turned around like a proud peacock displaying her beautiful back and left the office.
Instantly, silence filled the office. Seeing what had happened, Jin Duoming seemed to be in deep thought. He felt that Wang Baole wasn’t someone who could hide things in his heart. However, now that he was able to handle matters like these with dignity and lightness, he instinctively felt that there was something amiss, and had a premonition that a big scheme was forming in Wang Baole’s mind!
This is part of the plan to completely annihilate Li Yi.
Jin Duoming sighed. He had no intention to caution Li Yi about it, as if he were to do such things, it would equate to him burning the bridge with Wang Baole. Therefore, after thinking about it, he looked at Kong Dao and realized that Kong Dao had lowered his head, apparently disinterested in this matter. He then laughed, standing up with cupped fists as he left.
After he left, Kong Dao lifted his head, seemingly wanting to speak, but he stopped himself. He then left, and very soon, there was only Wang Baole and Lin Tianhao remaining in the office.
Lin Tianhao felt indignant, as to him, the way Wang Baole handled the matter this time around was too lenient. He then spoke with dissatisfaction in his voice.
“Mayor, you’re letting her off just like that?”
Wang Baole flashed a profound look and hit the table several times, before speaking suddenly.
“Tianhao, transcribe all the conversations today, as well as the details of the entire matter into a jade slip, and send it to the Governor. Since Mayor Li Yi announced that she would correct it, we shouldn’t dwell too much on it.”
Without a choice, Lin Tianhao nodded his head and was about to stand up and leave when suddenly, Wang Baole spoke again.
“In addition, use this as an excuse to delay the time to move the people. At the same time, there is no need to keep an eye on Li Yi’s western zone any longer. Instead, it is more important to return the areas in the other zones which Li Yi secretly messed up to normal!”
The meaning behind Wang Baole’s words was clear. As Lin Tianhao listened, his breathing quickened. He sensed something sinister in Wang Baole’s words and immediately abided to the commands before taking his leave.
When everyone had left, Wang Baole, who was sitting on the chair, shut his eyes, appearing to be deep in thought. As the skies darkened and began to shroud the office in darkness, Wang Baole blended within. Only his mumbles could be heard vaguely.
“Li Yi, it would be no big matter if you had stayed honest. However, if you still continue to court death, I will give you what you want!”
Just as Wang Baole had predicted, even though Li Yi sent instructions to carry out investigations after she had left, it was all surface work. She appeared to be making repairs and adjustment, but she didn’t do anything to the core position, instead, increasing the speed of construction.
However, as her authority had been reduced, such that she was only in control of the western zone instead of the entire city zone, the most she could do was to transform the western zone into her own Global Dharma City.
She held onto the belief that she would eventually be able to prove that she, Li Yi, was the candidate most suitable to become mayor. Wang Baole, the pig, was merely trying to get into the good books of the public in order to trick them.
However, she also knew that whatever she was doing shouldn’t be discovered again, at least before the Global Dharma City was completed. Therefore, she was even more vigilant and even replaced everyone she was in charge of to people from her own White Deer Dao College.
At the same time, she put in place protective measures that made it extremely challenging for outsiders to investigate the situation. That was a different case for the other three zones. With Lin Tianhao in charge, Jin Duoming and Kong Dao cooperated with each other, rectifying everything that Li Yi had secretly changed and rebuilding the area according to Wang Baole’s blueprint.
Time flew by just like that, and half a month passed. The Martian Colony Governor seemed to have received the jade slip, but for some unknown reason, she didn’t ask about it. Instead, the Martian Colony Governor delayed the moving of the people due to some procedural issues.
In addition, a new round of tests for the new city zone’s ability to resist the Beast Tide took place several times within this half month. With each Beast Tide, the new city zone’s array formation was activated in all zones, suppressing the Beast Tide each time. As for the western zone that Li Yi was in charge of, no issues surfaced.
That made Li Yi even more confident. That was especially so when there was one instance where the force of the Beast Tide rose significantly, and an illusory circular glow appeared in the western zone that Li Yi was in charge of. As the glow was reflected, it strengthened the array formation in the Divine Armament Catacombs, resulting in severe casualties to the Beast Tide.
That test significantly boosted Li Yi’s confidence. She already had some evidence that her Global Dharma City was more suitable and more powerful than Wang Baole’s Eternal Fortress!
It’s time to take over!
Observing the situation, Li Yi grew impatient. She summarized the advantages of her Global Dharma City, as well as its performance in resisting the Beast Tide, and planned to contact White Deer Dao College to issue a challenge to Wang Baole so that the Martian City would reassess the suitability of each of their cities. A sudden change occurred suddenly that very night, one that she wasn’t prepared for!
A new catacombs entrance, one that appeared to be branching off the Divine Armament Catacombs, appeared in Li Yi’s western zone!

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - Arrest Her!
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Arrest Her!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Li Yi couldn’t have foreseen the appearance of the catacombs. When the new entrance exploded into existence, she was deep in meditation. The thunderous sound of explosion rose to the skies, and the earth quaked. There had been a public square in the center of the western zone, but it had since collapsed and sunken in, forming a gigantic crater!
A chilly, eerie air surged from the crater, spreading an icy chill in the surrounding area. The waves of chilly air were accompanied by countless hordes of beasts!
This wasn’t the first time a new catacombs connected to the Divine Armament Catacombs appeared. The Blood Cave where Lin Tianhao had met with danger had been a similar situation. Based on the Governor’s analysis and assessment, she had guessed that such incidents would occur and had carried out the necessary preventive measures. The new city zone was one such measure to prevent and manage such incidents when they happened.
Wang Baole wasn’t fully aware of the details surrounding the occurrence of the new catacombs. However, he could sense something had gone wrong through the new city zone’s array formation. If the array formation had been constructed based on his plans and didn’t have any loopholes or gaps, and if the entire city had been running correctly with all the cogs turning smoothly, it would have been difficult for a new catacombs to appear. Even if it did appear, it wouldn’t be inside the city but somewhere else.
However, it was clear that the Global Dharma City that Li Yi believed to be perfect didn’t fuse and mesh fully with the Qi Fostering Spirit Array Formation, resulting in problems. It might have been difficult to discover such incongruencies normally, as they were very well hidden; however, in such key moments, they would be exposed fully.
The new catacombs would never have been able to appear in the other three zones. The loopholes present in the western zone presented an opportunity for it to appear. Its explosion seemed to shake the heavens and earth. At that moment, the cheap tricks that Li Yi had been playing in secret were all exposed and laid out in the open for all to see.
The deafening explosions alarmed everyone in the new city zone. Li Yi’s face was pale. The first thing that came to her mind wasn’t how to fight off and push back the beast hordes, but the disadvantage she would suffer once this incident got out and people heard about it!
Defense and resistance came as an afterthought. She raced out hastily and immediately gathered the people from the four Dao Colleges to fight off the beast hordes. They were mainly from the White Deer Dao College and its branch college. There were some from the Holy River Dao College, while those from the Ethereal Dao College were few. The Ethereal Dao College cultivators had wanted to be here since Wang Baole was stationed in the new city zone; however, the White Deer Dao College, in its attempts to prevent Wang Baole’s influence from growing too vast, had put a stop to that.
Li Yi tried frantically to hold back the Beast Tide. The sudden event had sent the entire city zone quaking. The other zones were faring well compared to the western zone though, which was seeing great casualties.
Fortunately, the Beast Tide had only just erupted. It would be fine if they could seal the catacombs. If efforts to do so were delayed though, the beasts could spread into other zones and result in calamity.
As soon as Wang Baole found out about this, his face turned dark, and a murderous aura erupted from his person. He dashed out and barked out an order instantly.
“Lock down the entire western zone. Unleash the full power of the array formation. Cultivators at Foundation Establishment realm and above, follow me into the western zone. We’re going to seal the new catacombs!”
The city zone’s array formation was instantly activated upon Wang Baole’s order, and numerous cultivators lined up in their formations and awaited their orders. The western zone was locked down. It seemed that Wang Baole was prepared to abandon the western zone.
A similarly somber-faced Kong Dao and Jin Duoming followed Wang Baole and charged into the western zone. Lin Tianhao had been instructed to stand guard outside, and Wang Baole’s concern for the rest meant they weren’t brought along either.
At least ten thousand cultivators soon followed Wang Baole’s lead and charged into the western zone. Amongst them were six to seven Core Formation realm cultivators. They dashed forward swiftly and approached the new catacombs in the western zone. Li Yi and her people were engaged in a fierce battle with the beasts. Her people were all injured and forced to fall back.
There were still more beasts surging outwards endlessly.
Wang Baole was about to spew fire at the sight of such chaos and danger. He had expected something like this to happen. However, Li Yi had simply grown too bold. She continued to do what she wished secretly, despite him clamping down on her. Her reckless actions had been the cause of the current predicament.
He didn’t hesitate. As soon as he and his people arrived at the scene of battle, Wang Baole immediately headed for Li Yi, who was being protected by a circle of her people. A tinge of resentment and hate colored Li Yi’s pale face when she saw his arrival.
Li Yi couldn’t tell where her resentment came from. However, it was obvious that the emotion had only reared its ugly head when she saw Wang Baole. Wang Baole ignored her poisonous stare and said immediately, “The four Dao Colleges, listen to my orders. Fall back a hundred thousand feet. Lock down the perimeters and slow the Beast Tide. Seniors who are at the Core Formation realm, follow me to the heart of the new catacombs and stand guard while I seal it!”
“Li Yi, you are to transfer the control of the new city zone that you have been secretly modifying to me immediately!” Wang Baole said immediately, his tone leaving no room for negotiation.
The shocked and alarmed cultivators from the White Deer Dao College hesitated and looked at Li Yi. Li Yi, on the other hand, only saw how Wang Baole had seized authority over her people upon his arrival and was now trying to seize her authority from her. If he were allowed to have his way, he would take control of all power and authority she had. She instinctively resisted the idea. She still couldn’t accept the reality of things and still believed that her city infrastructure hadn’t yet been perfected. Once it was completed, something like this would never happen!
“Wang Baole, what are you trying to do? This is the western zone that I’m in charge of. I, Li Yi, will be responsible for it. Leave us!” Li Yi’s voice was shrill. She resisted vehemently. She knew clearly that things would turn out all right if she managed to control and handle the current situation. However, if Wang Baole were the one to resolve the situation, her future in the New Mars Region would be precarious.
“You will handle it? You big-bosomed, no-brain piece of trash. How are you going to handle it? By trading the lives from the four Dao Colleges?” The anger that Wang Baole had been keeping under control erupted. He didn’t hesitate as he stepped forward and appeared next to Li Yi. He raised his right hand and sent it sweeping, his late-stage Foundation Establishment realm cultivation erupting. Li Yi wasn’t his match, especially with her mind wrought with emotions and unstable. She was immediately sent flying with a single slap from Wang Baole.
She fell back with a loud thunderous boom and blood spilled from her lips. The Core Formation realm cultivators from the White Deer Dao College around her could have stopped that from happening, but they had witnessed what Li Yi had done, as well as Wang Baole’s attempts to save the current situation. They had to consider the consequences if they tried to stop Wang Baole. They had to think about how their responses would affect the grand scheme of things.
After all... their concern was the White Deer Dao College’s interests. What Li Yi had done and the consequences of her actions were clearly going to adversely implicate the White Deer Dao College.
That was why they hesitated. The result was Li Yi being driven back by Wang Baole. Li Yi didn’t have a chance to scream her rage before Wang Baole’s voice, cold and dispassionate, rang out.
“Arrest Li Yi!” Wang Baole’s eyes fell on the cultivators from the four Dao Colleges around Li Yi when he said that. He specifically stared at the people from the White Deer Dao College.
Li Yi had no time to wipe the blood from her lips. Her hair had fallen loose, and madness and savagery colored her eyes. She shrieked.
“Wang Baole, you dare lay your hand on me!? Elder Zhou, Elder Wu, help me take Wang Baole down. I, Li Yi, will take full responsibility for everything that happens today!”
“Bullshit! I, Wang Baole, am of the four Dao Colleges as well. The White Deer Dao College also has my respect. Li Yi, you’ve made a huge mess of things here. Do you expect us four Dao Colleges to go down together with you!”
The White Deer Dao College cultivators fell silent. The comparison between Wang Baole and Li Yi was simply too stark. One was composed and the other raving mad. Furthermore, Wang Baole was right. Li Yi had clearly made a mistake. This incident would definitely create an uproar in the Federation. Li Yi was destined... to be held responsible.
If the White Deer Dao College insisted on siding with Li Yi, they wouldn’t be able to escape scrutiny and criticism. They only had one choice before them. They understood very well... that Li Yi was finished. Wang Baole had become the only representative of the four Dao Colleges who held authority in the new city zone.
Even if the White Deer Dao College was unwilling to do so, they had no choice... but to support Wang Baole if they still wanted to have a presence in the new city zone.
Wang Baole was aware of all this. As soon as he finished speaking and stared coldly at the group, one of the two Core Formation realm cultivators from the White Deer Dao College said immediately.
“Arrest Li Yi!”
Alarm rose on Li Yi’s face. Cultivators from the White Deer Dao College immediately stepped forward and brought the limp and pale Li Yi away. Everyone from the four Dao Colleges immediately bowed at Wang Baole.
It was a clear indication of the change in their attitude. Wang Baole had no time for relief though. He instantly issued an order and brought everyone with him to fight the Beast Tide. He swiftly manipulated the array formation in the new city zone and enveloped the entire area in array formations. He was going to seal the new catacombs!

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - Forever on the No-Hire List!
chapters.content:
Chapter 383: Forever on the No-Hire List!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
It was no simple feat to seal the new catacombs. Fortunately, the scale of the current Beast Tide was small. It had simply taken them by complete surprise. However, with the battle capabilities the new city zone possessed, it wasn’t impossible to fight the beasts off.
Wang Baole chose the simplest, most straightforward, and most brutal solution. He arrested Li Yi, took control of Li Yi’s Global Dharma City, and locked down the entire city zone with the authority he had seized from her. Then, he ordered everyone to evacuate the area.
Wang Baole locked down the area around the new catacombs and had the beasts trapped within the area. Then, an icy glint flashed in his eyes. Without any hesitation, he ordered the cannons to fire!
Excluding this area, the rest of the new city zone had been built according to the design of Wang Baole’s Eternal Fortress and was augmented by the Qi Fostering Spirit Array Formation. The power of the array formation roared to the skies. Numerous Baole Cannons and Fire God Cannons appeared instantly. They aimed at the western zone, targeted the new catacombs, and fired simultaneously.
The combined artillery forces from the other three zones threatened to wipe everything out. Cannon fire rained down on the Beast Tide. Shots thundered in the air. The array formation transformed into endless strands that criss-crossed and sliced through beasts, mutilating flesh and spilling blood. Howls of agony pierced the heavens.
A good half of the entire western zone was destroyed in the attack, buildings collapsing and disintegrating into dust. But Wang Baole didn’t care.
He knew the key thing was to get the situation under control quickly. There were no workers in the area; only buildings remained. It was true that significant resources had gone into constructing the area, but since Li Yi had committed a wrongdoing, she and the White Deer Dao College would have to pay for the resultant destruction!
Explosions boomed as multiple cannon shots were fired repeatedly. The earth shuddered. Jin Duoming and Kong Dao stood beside Wang Baole, shocked. Their eyes fell on Wang Baole at the same time. Gone was the constant smile on Wang Baole’s face; it had been replaced by a cold, emotionless look, and his eyes glittered with a cold light.
This guy is vicious!
Kong Dao and Jin Duoming came to the same, deep understanding of Wang Baole’s true character. They might have had similar assessments in the past, but Wang Baole’s typical behavior was the complete opposite of vicious. It made it easy for others to forget what they knew about his true character.
At that moment, however, he had instantly chosen to abandon half of the western zone. It was true that the workers in the western zone had long since evacuated, but such a decision wasn’t something everyone could have made so decisively.
After another round of cannon shots, when the Beast Tide was finally being pushed back by cannon fire, Wang Baole took a deep breath and immediately led a large army of cultivators charging into the western zone, where the beasts had been trapped and sealed in. They left death and destruction in their wake, exterminating whatever beast remnants they came across before they finally reached the location of the new catacombs.
Wang Baole stared at the eerie catacombs. A chilly air exuded from inside. He immediately formed a series of hand seals and used his authority to access the new array formation and seal the new catacombs.
Strands from the array formation appeared, dashing in from all directions and weaving themselves rapidly over the catacombs. It was then that a roar, brimming with resentment and anger, rumbled from inside. Seven to eight beasts exuding a Core Formation realm cultivation surged forward and tried to stop the seal from settling.
“Everyone!” Wang Baole’s eyes narrowed, and he roared immediately. As his voice resounded in the air, the Core Formation realm cultivators from the various political forces dashed out from behind him and clashed with the beasts inside the catacombs.
The sounds of battle rose to the heavens. The glow and dazzle from spells lit the skies, visible from afar. As they fought against the beasts, Wang Baole continued to set up the array formation and seal the catacombs without interruption.
Kong Dao and Jin Duoming clearly understood the importance of what was happening. This concerned the security of the new city zone. If they failed to repair this loophole in their security, Li Yi wouldn’t be the only one held responsible, both of them would be implicated as well.
Besides, they had chosen unanimously to keep the matter under wraps. They hadn’t reported it to the Governor. Lin Tianhao had also carried out preventive measures to stop any news from leaking out.
Of course, with so many people as eye-witnesses, it was inevitable that the Governor would find out about this matter. However, if they could resolve it before the administration started questioning them about accountability, the only person who would be held responsible would be Li Yi.
Everyone shared the same understanding. They also knew that time was key. That was why everyone from every political force was unleashing their full power at the moment and fighting against hordes of beasts with everything they had. They were all fighting to give Wang Baole the time to seal the catacombs.
Just as everyone joined forces and was able to push the Beast Tide back, establishing a stalemate in the battle, a fearsome, thunderous roar louder than the previous suddenly erupted from inside the catacombs.
The thunderous boom was accompanied by the sounds of crackling, like the sounds of ice rapidly spreading through the catacombs. It was as if a giant hand was reaching outwards from the depths of the new catacombs. Where it passed, the surrounding walls turned to ice.
The beasts fighting to get out were all affected by the chill and immediately turned to ice. The giant hand surged forward, exuding a terrifying and overpowering aura. The surrounding cultivators, including those at the Core Formation realm, were all alarmed.
They were caught in a tight spot. Wang Baole’s seal wasn’t yet completed. Wang Baole’s breathing quickened. He knew that if they couldn’t hold back the beasts, they would have no choice but to notify the Governor.
He was unwilling to do that unless he had absolutely no other choice. An icy glint flashed in his eyes. He uttered the first few words of the scripture in his heart!
“Enlightened...”
Those words echoed inside Wang Baole’s heart. A familiar presence suddenly erupted in the distant heavens. This was different from what had happened in the past. Wang Baole could sense clearly... eyes from the distant regions of the universe opening and gazing over suddenly.
My god... did I wake it?
Wang Baole shuddered. He had no time to think though, as the awesome presence traveled through the universe and descended. The giant hand that had been stretching out madly and without fear suddenly shuddered violently. It seemed to be terrified and dared not move forward. Instead, it shrank back hastily, like a mouse that had just seen a cat!
Everyone was shocked at the sight. They released a breath of relief, and an indescribable feeling arose in their hearts. They had felt the unbelievable presence as well. They looked at Wang Baole with a strange and curious look in their eyes.
However, they were at a critical stage in their attempt to seal the new catacombs. No one had time to think further. They made use of the sudden oppressive presence and intensified their resistance against the Beast Tide. Wang Baole seized the opening as well and completed the sealing!
The strands of the array formation finally transformed into a complete web over the new catacombs. The beasts were trapped inside, and while they kept attacking the seat, they couldn’t nudge it.
Wang Baole let loose a breath of relief. He quickly organized the cultivators to exterminate the beasts that had escaped. He also issued an order to Lin Tianhao to get the cultivators from the other three zones to comb through the western zone, starting from the perimeter and moving inwards in their search. They were to ensure that not a single beast remained.
From the start of the incident, beginning with the zone-wide hunt to the final verification that no beasts remained in the western zone, the entire incident spanned four hours. It was after the four hours had passed that the furious reprimand from the Governor finally arrived.
The Governor had clearly been informed that the danger had been resolved. She was therefore focused on finding out the cause of this incident. Wang Baole didn’t speak a single word. Instead, he looked at Kong Dao and Jin Duoming.
Kong Dao had witnessed Wang Baole driving back the Beast Tide and resolving the situation. He was silent for a while before the scene of his earlier rescue by Wang Baole surfaced in his mind. His feelings and views towards Wang Baole were complicated, but he had to admit that he did have a certain degree of admiration towards Wang Baole.
He inhaled a deep breath and reported everything from his own perspective and stance: how Li Yi had unilaterally modified the city plans, how that had sparked off the Beast Tide, and how everything had been resolved. He shared everything he knew in detail.
Jin Duoming shook his head and smiled wryly. He didn’t make any statements regarding the matter, but that in itself spoke volumes about what truly happened. Lin Tianhao, who had been standing at one side, handed over the evidence he had gathered to the Governor. He also handed over a jade slip that contained the contents of their initial meeting, which Wang Baole had instructed that he recorded. The facts were laid out clearly before the Governor.
The Governor remained silent for a moment. Then, she issued an immediate order to strip Li Yi of her vice mayorship. She was to be transferred out of Mars, and would never again resume office on Mars!

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - Everything Prepared!
chapters.content:
Chapter 384: Everything Prepared!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Being stripped of one’s office was already a serious punishment. To be blacklisted by the Martian administration from future positions on the planet was a more serious punishment. It showed the Governor’s firm stance and attitude towards the matter.
It was clear that she was displaying her displeasure. This was also a stern warning to the four Dao Colleges as well as the other political forces. If they wanted to stay on Mars, they would have to play by her rules!
They were to quit playing dirty tricks and carrying out underhanded activities. In fact, in her opinion, Li Yi had it coming!
She was of the view that Wang Baole needed more monitoring. However, he was still the mayor she had appointed and recognized. To have vice mayors representing the other political forces entering the picture and creating all sorts of trouble was something that displeased her tremendously.
Especially... when Wang Baole, the kid, was so brave and responsible. He had gone ahead and led a rescue fearlessly when Kong Dao had gotten into danger. Li Yi, on the other hand, had been a coward afraid of death, who had continued fixating on wrestling power from Wang Baole during such critical times. That had made the Governor see her in a worse light.
The four Dao Colleges had remained silent in the face of Li Yi’s punishment. The White Deer Dao College had been resigned. They were frustrated, but everything had been decided. Despite them wishing to resolve the matter more amicably, the Federation had approved the Governor’s orders instantly. The swiftness of their response spoke volumes about the Federation’s attitude towards this matter.
The White Deer Dao College had only one option before them. It was... to support Wang Baole. Else, the White Deer Dao College would be kicked out of the contest for power, and the Ethereal Dao College would naturally rise in power, becoming the primary authority speaking for the four Dao Colleges in the New Mars Region.
After sighing in resignation, those of the White Deer Dao College discussed amongst themselves and eventually contacted the Ethereal Dao College. They carried out a series of communications and negotiations, finally reaching a consensus to support Wang Baole fully!
Their support was immediately seen in the attitudes of those in the new city zone who belonged to the four Dao Colleges. They complied to Wang Baole’s every order. At the same time, the Ethereal Dao College, which had been prevented from sending more of their people to the new city zone, was finally able to send a great number of their disciples over to support Wang Baole.
Wang Baole didn’t hesitate to designate the Ethereal Dao College disciples as the heads of various departments in the new city zone’s administration. A round of eliminations and replacements was carried out rapidly.
This applied to both Jin Duoming and Kong Dao as well. They split the various positions which had been vacated after Li Yi’s departure. Lin Tianhao was tempted to do the same. However, after some discussion with his father, Lin You, he decided not to arrange for more of his people to come over to the new city zone. He was to isolate himself and instead fully bind his fate with Wang Baole, as his follower.
No one cared about Li Yi at this point. Even though Wang Baole sometimes still missed her alluring figure, he spent more time lamenting over how brainless Li Yi had been.
The other person who often thought of Li Yi was Jin Duoming. He knew that this was his best chance to get Li Yi to yield to him. He was confident that he would be saving her in her dire moment. He only needed to provide some help to get her to surrender to him. However, he only smiled lightly at the thought.
It’s time to switch targets. Li Yi no longer has anything that appeals to me. I think... Li Xiu’s sister, Li Wan’er, should prove to be quite a challenge. Even though she almost castrated me in the past, but the more extreme her attitude is, the more motivated I become!
After most of the positions in the new city zone were filled, the White Deer Dao College contributed resources independently to repair the western zone. This was to smoothen the tensions between Wang Baole and the Martian administration. A gigantic glowing shield appeared over the newly constructed western zone, sealing the new catacombs. It would be activated from time to time to wear down the power of the catacombs.
Time passed steadily. A month later, a hundred million people moved to the city zone. Numerous large cruisers arrived, and the new arrivals settled down in the new city zone. They joined the various departments and started both their work and lives in the New Mars Region.
The Trilunaris Corporation expended tremendous effort in the entire endeavor. They set up branches for most of their major businesses in the new city zone, resolving the issue of reemployment for most of the new residents. The other political forces also started doing their part, and the new city zone started to slowly take off.
The increase in the population led to the growing strengthening of the new city zone’s array formation. It became more powerful. The control it had over the catacombs, and the rate of erosion of the wall, started to stabilize, resulting in a stable cycle.
The New Mars Region had finally been established. It had both the structure and scale befitting a city zone. Wang Baole could finally feel the authority and power he was to have as a mayor.
In the new city zone, his one decision could decide the fate of countless people. Countless discerning people would read and study every one of his gazes carefully.
This made Wang Baole overjoyed, and he basked in happiness. Most of his subordinates knew his love for snacks, and soon, the retail industry for snacks expanded and prospered in the new city zone... The reception towards the donkey also changed because of Wang Baole’s status.
Regardless of where it went and what it ate, no one tried to stop it. In fact, they were worried that it might not eat its fill...
No one knew who had started the trend, but increasingly, more people started rearing donkeys. Almost all of those pet donkeys were female donkeys... the donkey was increasingly seen as a valuable asset. It enjoyed an elevated status, and many in the Federation were interested in the donkey.
It was clear that they wouldn’t be able to get their hands on the donkey, though. As a result, they began to come up with other ideas. That resulted in the prevalence of female donkeys. The donkey was overjoyed. However, it was still very devoted and loyal. Kong Dao protected his own White Phoenix religiously, though, and seldom allowed it to leave the house. The donkey found this unfortunate.
Heaven rewarded the donkey that waited, though. It could always find opportunities... as a result, as long as one saw a raging Kong Dao in pursuit of the donkey with his men, they immediately knew that the donkey had once again done the unspeakable to Kong Dao’s White Phoenix.
Wang Baole could only express his exasperation. Despite giving the donkey a good thrashing numerous times, and regardless of how badly he had beaten the donkey up, it would recover the next day and continue its brazen ways. Wang Baole finally decided to ignore it altogether and focus on his cultivation. His communications with the Sect Lord of the Ethereal Dao College and Zhao Yameng regarding the array formation grew more frequent.
Three months passed. The new city zone began to grow prosperous. It was then that, due to Zhao Yameng’s hard work and the support of the Ethereal Dao College’s Array Runes Pavilion, finally... she was able to successfully convert the simplified Qi Devouring Art into an array formation!
The name had been thought of by Zhao Yameng. It was called Trees Hath Branches.
Wang Baole didn’t think it sounded nice at all. He thought that even if Zhao Yameng started chasing after him on a flying sword, they would still be leagues apart when it came to naming things. He decided to change the name to the Great Baole Array Formation.
“How’s that? The name that I came up with is quite good, right? Yameng, it’s not that I want to brag, but you’re really not that good at coming up with names,” Wang Baole said, pleased with himself.
Zhao Yameng was silent on the other end of the voice transmission ring. Then, she hung up.
Is she embarrassed? Angry?
Wang Baole blinked. He realized he shouldn’t have spoken that way when she had helped him. He thought about how to go about bragging about himself in a tactful manner the next time they spoke.
Wang Baole made up his mind. Then, he tried to control his excitement. As soon as he got ahold of the array formation, he immediately set up a mini-version of the Great Baole Array Formation in secret to verify its effectiveness.
He found people to set up the array formation in his residence. After sending them away, when he was finally alone, Wang Baole immediately sat down and crossed his legs. He activated the array formation. As his cultivation started churning and the array formation started its activation, an undeniable suction force started spreading towards the earth. It had a clear effect on the Dark Qi inside the Divine Armament Catacombs. Wang Baole was instantly overjoyed.
With this array formation, my Primary Rank Three Noble is within grasp!
Wang Baole laughed out loud. He got to his feet hastily. He started pacing in his residence, the gears in his head spinning furiously.
This is a good thing for everyone in the new city zone... that’s why I should rope them all in. With everyone working together, we can turn the new city zone into a city!
At that thought, Wang Baole made up his mind. He immediately called for Lin Tianhao, Kong Dao, as well as Jin Duoming.
The three appeared in Wang Baole’s office after receiving his notice. Before they could speak, they saw Wang Baole’s stern look and the excitement that he couldn’t conceal in his eyes. He spoke hurriedly.
“Brothers, I have an extremely rare and fortuitous opportunity that I’m going to give you all. It can bring you a promotion to the next level of Noble. Do you want to take it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - Unity is Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 385: Unity is Strength
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Wang Baole’s spirits were high. He was extremely excited. He spoke with great excitement, holding back his impulse to share everything with them. He waited for his three vice mayors to question him.
However... Kong Dao glanced at Wang Baole, sat down on a chair beside him, and grunted. Even though the tensions between himself and Wang Baole had lessened during this period, and even though he had a refreshed perception of Wang Baole, every time he remembered how his White Phoenix was constantly bullied by Wang Baole’s donkey, he couldn’t control his desire to fly into a rage.
The donkey was extremely fast, though. He had been able to catch up with it in the past, but now that it had grown even faster, he could only simmer in frustration. That wasn’t all. What drove him mad was how his White Phoenix had gradually grown from its original resistant self to its current subservient attitude...
As a result, Kong Dao experienced mixed feelings every time he saw Wang Baole.
Jin Duoming, on the other, always seemed like he didn’t care for anything in other people’s eyes. He yawned and sat down as well and started massaging his own waist. He nodded at Wang Baole as a form of greeting, then grabbed Lin Tianhao into a hug, his face expressive while whispering.
“Tianhao, the picture book you gave me a while ago. Where did you get it from? Is it accurate?”
Lin Tianhao originally had a serious expression on his face. He had been thinking about how to react when he had heard what Wang Baole said. Now, he was being hugged by Jin Duoming, and he grew embarrassed instantly when he heard what Jin Duoming said.
Wang Baole’s head immediately started throbbing. A donkey must have kicked him in the head. There was no other reason for why he had chosen these few as his vice mayors. It must not have been for their resources. He was, after all, a righteous man of principles.
He decided to give the three guys another chance.
“Brothers, I just said that I have an extremely amazing opportunity that is out of this world, that will benefit all of us. Don’t you want to know what it is?” Wang Baole’s expression remained serious, and his eyes shone threateningly as he spoke.
The hint of threat immediately got Lin Tianhao to struggle out of Jin Duoming’s arms. He spoke hurriedly, with a mad joy in his expression.
“Mayor, what sort of opportunity? Is it really that amazing?”
Jin Duoming resigned to his fate, following up with a question with superficial interest. Kong Dao seemed like he couldn’t be bothered to say anything. He glanced over to indicate how uninterested he was, as if saying that this was all he was going to give Wang Baole if the latter forced him to ask...
Wang Baole saw that the three were still kind of playing along and decided to forgive them. He coughed and took out a bottle of Ice Spirit Water. As he drank, he whispered.
“I have a way to turn our new city zone into a new city...” Wang Baole said. He continued to explain his plans, sharing what he had discovered earlier, how he had gotten someone to invent an array formation and how he had tested the array formation to be a success, with Kong Dao and the rest.
