As there were aspects of the story that concerned his secrets, he did some necessary concealment and covered up certain truths. Regardless, as he continued to speak, the eyes of the other three young men widened.
Jin Duoming’s head had been filled with the picture book that Lin Tianhao had given him a while ago, but now, the picture had vanished from his mind. His breathing quickened slightly. Even though he generally displayed a carefree and lackadaisical attitude before other people, what Wang Baole had just said was a rare opportunity for anyone.
Even he was moved. Countless thoughts flooded his head instantly.
Jin Duoming wasn’t the only one. Beside him, Kong Dao’s initially stern face had transformed as he listened. He gasped, his eyes widened and brightened. Wang Baole’s words were like a bolt of lightning that had struck him speechless. In his mind, he saw a ladder leading upwards. If he could simply take a step, he would be able to ascend and almost reach the heavens!
Lin Tianhao’s eyes almost popped out. He stared at Wang Baole like the latter was the devil. His head buzzed. He couldn’t imagine how Wang Baole had managed to create such an astonishing opportunity for all of them!
Pleased with their reactions, Wang Baole finished speaking, waited for a while to give them enough time to digest all that he had said, then continued.
“That’s why, as long as we succeed, all of us will at least raise a level in rank. In fact, all our comrades in the entire city zone will enjoy the same promotion!
“Even if we fail, there’s nothing to it. We’ll simply be back where we started. There’s no loss in that. That’s why... don’t you think we should fight for this chance?”
As soon as Wang Baole finished speaking, Jin Duoming straightened his back and had a serious look on his face. It was a rare look for him. There was a bright light in his eyes. He immediately said.
“Baole, could you let us take a look at this array formation that you speak of?”
Wang Baole had expected that they would say that, so he didn’t hesitate. He brought them to where he had set up the array formation and allowed them to inspect it. He personally activated the array formation to show that it was effective.
Kong Dao even proposed to make a visit to the Divine Armament Catacombs and get someone to set up a small scale of the array formation so that they could perform another round of tests. When the results came back, both Jin Duoming and Kong Dao grew excited. Lin Tianhao’s breath quickened as it never had before.
Their eyes shone brightly. They hadn’t yet recovered from their shock; however, they immediately understood very clearly that should they succeed in this endeavor, Wang Baole would immediately advance from a Primary Rank Four Noble to a Primary Rank Three Noble!
Similarly, they would advance in status and rank alongside Wang Baole, and rise from their Secondary Rank Four Noble to a Secondary Rank Three Noble!
In the entire Federation, they wouldn’t be the only ones who would go crazy for such an opportunity; countless others would feel the same. That wasn’t what made this an extremely rare opportunity. After all, this matter required both the Federation’s and the Martian administration’s approval.
Even if other people wanted to elevate their city zones to become cities, they would be met with the Federation’s lack of approval. However... in this New Mars Region, the possibility of something like that happening was extremely high!
Wang Baole’s proposal would save a great deal of time. Even though it would exhaust a great deal more resources, the greatest challenge the Federation and the Martian administration faced now wasn’t a shortage of resources but a shortage of time!
The earlier they could excavate the Divine Armament, the earlier they would possess this immense power. This would benefit the Martian administration greatly as well. After all, as long as the Divine Armament remained unstable, more unforeseen disasters would occur. The faster the excavation progressed, the greater the resources and human labor they would save in tackling said disasters.
The three young men stared at one another. They were overcome with excitement, as they knew very well... the chances of success were very high!
They couldn’t help but extend their respect towards Wang Baole. Amidst their excitement, they also realized something. Wang Baole’s strength and the array formation as proof alone wouldn’t suffice.
“I’ll contact the military immediately and ask for their full support!” Kong Dao took a deep breath and declared instantly. His enthusiasm towards this endeavor surpassed everything else. In fact, after saying that, he clenched his teeth.
“I’ll contact my godfather shortly!”
“That’s what a good brother should do. Let’s all work together and use everything we’ve got to fight for our future!” Wang Baole was overjoyed. He patted Kong Dao on the shoulder, his eyes bright with encouragement.
After a moment of silence, Jin Duoming spoke in a low voice as well.
“We have to use all our connections for this matter... I’ll discuss with the master of my family in a while. Tianhao, you too. You should speak to your father. We’ll need support from the senators!
“As for the other political forces... I’ll think of something!”
“Baole’s right about this. We should make a bid for this!” Jin Duoming’s eyes shone with a strange light. A Secondary Rank Three Noble was an extremely high rank for anyone his age.
After all, Wang Baole had fought with his life in the trial and had only gotten himself a Primary Rank Four Noble.
Amidst their excitement, they continued to talk for a while longer. They decided to inform the respective political forces supporting them and make their arguments. Wang Baole would tidy up the information and submit a formal request to the Martian administration!
Wang Baole accepted the responsibility readily. He knew that he had to be the one to make the first move.
The four went about their own preparations. The various political forces supporting them were all stunned by Wang Baole’s bold idea. Seven days later, a request for city status came from the new city zone and was delivered to the Martian administration. Heated discussions that even the Federation deemed to be of epic proportions erupted instantly!
The New Mars Region formally requested to expand and become a new city. It would be... the second city on Mars!

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - Primary Rank Three!
chapters.content:
Chapter 386: Primary Rank Three!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
To the entire Federation, this was an extremely serious matter. Back in the day, the Martian Colony Governor reached Secondary Rank One though her achievements in the Martian City, which also placed her in the candidacy for the next Federation President.
Right now, the newly appointed Wang Baole, who was Primary Rank Four, was also building a stronghold. As a result, he garnered a lot of attention and drew so much discussion that it was indescribable.
In an instant, all the media outlets were covering the matter. The fact that they knew about the matter proved that it was an outcome that had resulted from a push by the Federation, Mars, and the various factions!
In reality, once the matter surfaced, it was hyped up by others and was discussed by everyone on Earth. The people on Mars were also very interested in the matter.
With the attention of the entire Federation, Wang Baole’s reasons for suggesting that a stronghold be built soon spread. There were two main points, the first being that a new catacomb had appeared in the New Mars Region, which proved that the Martian Colony Governor’s previous judgment that the Divine Armament wouldn’t give the Federation more time was correct.
If they didn’t act to stop it immediately, the appearance of more catacombs would result in disaster, putting Mars in immense danger. At the same time, it was merely a new city zone, and even though it was possible to dissolve the barrier in ten years, it would obviously still be too late!
Therefore, it was necessary to build a bigger stronghold to suppress the catacombs, and to gain complete control over the rate at which the Divine Armament Catacombs erupted.
The second reason was the Great Baole Array Formation that Wang Baole had suggested. This array formation was created by Zhao Yameng and the Ethereal Dao College according to Wang Baole’s ideas and cultivation techniques, which were eventually tried and tested. Once it was laid out in the scale of the stronghold, it would only take a maximum of three years to completely dissolve the barrier!
This way, the speed of dissolving would be so fast that it would slow the appearance of new catacombs even more significantly. Mars would be able to gain control of the situation within two to three years!
Each of these reasons for building a bigger stronghold could be tested, as they were backed by credible information, and could, therefore, be pushed forward. Naturally, this resulted in Mars and the Federation regarding it highly.
Without a doubt, the outcome that Wang Baole had promoted was extremely tempting to the Federation and Mars. Completely dissolving the barrier in three years meant that it was three times faster than what was possible before.
It may seem like it was only three times, but to the Federation and Mars, the time saved could be used to do other things. At the same time, a large amount of resources could be saved.
Despite that, if no one were to support the idea, or if there were many detractors, then the Federation would still evaluate the pros and cons—perhaps even using other methods to replace the proposal. After all, the new stronghold wasn’t a new city zone, and once built, it meant that a large number of Nobles would need to be assigned, and that was something that the Federation didn’t want to do.
However, Wang Baole was logical and had ample information that made his reason for building the city strong. He even gained the spotlight through this. Most importantly, perhaps due to concerns about safety, or because the views put forth by Wang Baole were aligned with the basis of her judgment, or for some other reason... the Martian Colony Governor, who seldom interfered with the internal affairs of the Federation, firmly chose to support the proposal!
She supported Wang Baole in building the array formation and transforming the city zone into a city!
The Martian Colony Governor’s attitude influenced the Federation significantly. More importantly, the four Dao Colleges also made their stance clear at this time to support the transformation of the new city zone into a new city. At the same time, they pledged their willingness to provide resources to construct the second Mars City for the Federation and all mankind!
The Senate followed after the four Dao Colleges. This time, the Seventeen Senator Coalition of the Senate announced their support for the building of the second city on Mars in unison. That way, the two factions that could equally influence the Federation had stepped forward, which made it even more likely that the new city could be approved for construction.
However, not all factions expressed their support. Soon, the Galactic Dusk Sect and Plume Manifestation Connate Sect, followed by the Five Generation Sky Clan, activated their resources to prevent the matter from going through. Their factions were powerful, and with the lack of their support, there were delays to the building of the city.
Despite that, they were all sly old foxes. The motives of the three factions were known between each other. Therefore, at that moment, the three factions immediately activated their resources, and even the military made a statement as well. Eventually, it appeared as if the three opponents found out about the background of the matter. They appeared to be acting for the greater good of society and switched their stance to support the proposal. In reality, however, countless exchanges were taking place beneath the surface...
Regardless, the Federation President eventually sent the order to deploy an assessment team to carry on-site assessments of the New Mars Region to make the final decision!
This time around, the assessment was merely a formality. After all, the various factions were incredibly intelligent, and they had long had a clear understanding of Wang Baole’s suggestion and the actual situation. Therefore, after the assessment, which, together with everything else, lasted a month’s time, the Federation finally announced the news to everyone.
They allowed the New Mars Region to be transformed into the second Martian City!
The scale would be ten times its original scale!
That made it the second Martian City, without a doubt!
As the news spread, everyone in the Federation was delighted. After all, the matter was groundbreaking, and at the same time, Wang Baole had made an even deeper impression on people’s minds.
The approval for the new city also meant that the status of everyone within the new city zone would be raised. This outcome made Kong Dao and the rest of the trio, who were sitting in Wang Baole’s office with him, whom was waiting to hear the result anxiously, when the Federation announced the news hear deafening screams of happiness from outside immediately.
“Success!” Wang Baole slapped his thigh hard and laughed agitatedly. Jin Duoming, Kong Dao, and Lin Tianhao, who were beside him, were also extremely exhilarated. A glow flashed across their eyes, and their breathing quickened as they all began to laugh happily.
What’s more, most of the unhappiness and grudges between them were resolved as a result of the hard work they have put in to reach their common goal. In their exhilaration, Jin Duoming clapped his hands, and immediately, female cultivators began entering from outside. They brought along wine and food in celebration.
Instantly, the area where the Mayor’s Office used to be was filled with activity, as well as people!
At the same time, the news about Wang Baole and company’s Noble titles was quickly conveyed. Just as he had judged, Wang Baole was immediately promoted to Primary Rank Three, from Primary Rank Four.
The advancement in his Noble title saved him at least ten years, and that was on top of the fact that he had to become a Core Formation realm cultivator first if he were to go the conventional path. A person who became a Primary Rank Three without reaching the Core Formation realm hadn’t been seen in the Federation for the past twenty years.
It could be said that Wang Baole was the only person in the entire Foundation Establishment realm who managed to become Primary Rank Three while still being at the Foundation Establishment realm! A Noble like that allowed Wang Baole to be on the same level as Lin You, to a certain extent!
After all, it was impossible to take another step forward right now. That was because the procedure to become Secondary Rank Two was governed by strict standards. One must be a Core Formation realm cultivator, and at the same time, not all Core Formation realm cultivators were Secondary Rank Two Nobles. The Federation wasn’t an absolute world of cultivation, and after thousands of years of regulations and laws, there were obvious classes. Therefore, it wasn’t surprising to be a Core Formation realm cultivator holding another Noble rank.
Furthermore, even if one was a Secondary Rank Two Noble, their duties also differed in terms of rank. Regardless of that, they still held power, authority, and dignity!
It could even be said that in the eyes of many, Wang Baole was already a high official. Though, in reality, his Noble title was still a leap away from that of the high officials within the Federation. Despite that, the journey of his advancement could be considered a miracle!
Even Lin You got a shock when he first heard from Lin Tianhao about Wang Baole’s plan to build the city. He could imagine how big a leap Wang Baole would advance this time.
However, that came with a cost as well. Lin You thought about it deeply, and also sent a voice transmission to Wang Baole to remind him that such a fast advancement would result in the jealousy of others. Now, in the Federation, there were already many who were suggesting to rein Wang Baole in. This meant creating challenges in the future advancement process of his Noble, and it was even possible that he wouldn’t be advanced in ten years.
In reality, there were many factions who had the same intention. However, Wang Baole didn’t care about all that, as he felt that they were all nonsense. It didn’t matter to him as long as nobody provoked him.
This time, the Federation was extremely generous, apparently as a result of the efforts of the various factions. At the same time, the returns that Wang Baole promised prompted the Federation to be generous for once, not only advancing Wang Baole to become Primary Rank Three, which held a lot of power, but also giving similar rewards to Lin Tianhao, Kong Dao, and Jin Duoming!
That was also the case for their subordinates, and everyone in the entire new city zone advanced!
There were also plans made by the Federation and Mars for the new city. The new city would be divided into six zones, with Lin Tianhao, Jin Duoming, and Kong Dao being the Mayors. This way, three other candidates for the Mayor position were needed.
At the same time, and perhaps most importantly, a Deputy City Lord was still lacking in the second Martian City!!
It was also at this time that a piece of news that shocked many was spreading among the powerful nobles...

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - Remaining Vigilant Even in Safe Times
chapters.content:
Chapter 387: Remaining Vigilant Even in Safe Times
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The information was unclear and seemed to be about the union between the Five Generation Sky Clan and the Senate. However, once the news spread, the Five Generation Sky Clan and the Senate immediately stepped forward to deny it. They did so in identical manners, by saying that they respected each other and anticipated their future collaboration, but that now wasn’t the right time for them to form a union.
Words like these could fool outsiders, but to the cultivators within the Five Generation Sky Clan system, such news wouldn’t spread without reason. It was very likely that the Five Generation Sky Clan and the Senate were really discussing with each other regarding their collaboration. It was also very possible that they purposely leaked the news to test the waters and to see how others would react.
As the new Martian City Lord of Primary Rank Three, Wang Baole was considered a high official within the Federation. He heard the news too, and in his bewilderment, had sought Lin Tianhao for clarification about it. However, Lin Tianhao didn’t know more about the matter than Wang Baole, and it seemed that Lin You hadn’t mentioned it to him either.
After thinking about it, Wang Baole no longer bothered himself with the matter. After all, the business between the Five Generation Sky Clan and the Senate didn’t have much to do with him. Therefore, he placed all his attention on the development of the new city.
Equipped with the previous experience of building the new city zone, Wang Baole felt confident about constructing the new city. After discussing it with Lin Tianhao, Kong Dao, and Jin Duoming, the four of them split up the work and began the planning process for the new city. Their focus was still on the array formations, but this time, it involved not just the Qi Fostering Spirit Array Formation, but also the Great Baole Array Formation.
However, the most they could do was plan. After all, they were no longer constructing a city zone but an entire city. Therefore, the amount of manpower and resources that they needed was so hefty that it was unimaginable. Even though both Mars and the Federation had approved the application to build the city, it was near impossible to expect them to pay for the resources.
Therefore, a big problem that was presented to Wang Baole was about the resources. However, he was used to tackling the problems as they came, especially those regarding resources. He felt that to solve such problems, not much skill was involved.
“Each mayor will be responsible for their own zone!” That was the slogan that Wang Baole announced, which was also the first command that he had given as a Primary Rank Three City Lord. He had learned from the method he had adopted when he built the new city zone previously, and at the same time, he was mimicking the pressure that the Governor had put on him. Therefore, Wang Baole felt that he should put what he learned into practice, especially after gaining the authority to do so.
“There are three rules. Number one, there are no resources. Number two, after half a year, an inspection of the construction process will be made, and it should be able to house a population of at least a billion. Number three, whoever fails will have to leave!” Wang Baole enthusiastically laid out the three rules, which immediately resulted in some resistance.
However, at this juncture, Kong Dao, Jin Duoming, and Lin Tianhao all stepped forward at the same time and expressed their support for Wang Baole, agreeing to the rules and taking the initiative to be role models.
This made the other factions who were unhappy feel extremely helpless. They knew very well that the trio had gained a huge advantage, and the factions backing them would naturally be thankful and willing to put in the effort to firm up their positions. Therefore, they would also willingly supply resources to them.
While the other factions felt helpless, they gave up on their intentions to pull a cheap shot. They gritted their teeth and began to work.
The second Martian city, which was also known as the Divine Armament New City, was already extremely important when it was a city zone. Now that it had become a city, not only did it provide crucial assistance to the Divine Armament, it also meant that if one could control the area—regardless of which part it was—would stand to obtain great gains in the future.
On the other hand, if they were to give up and allow other factions to take over, they would be under the beck and call of others. At the same time, everyone had seen that Wang Baole’s array formation could really speed up the rate at which the barrier dissolved. In reality, three years could be considered an overestimation. It was possible that the barrier could be eliminated within one or two years, and that the elites of the Federation could enter the cave and obtain the Divine Armament!
Therefore, every faction wanted a place as mayor of the new city, and they each began planning and preparing for it.
All the major figures of the Federation had placed their attention on Divine Armament New City. At the same time, Wang Baole was also thinking about the future of this city of his. What was most important to him right now was to construct the Great Baole Array Formation.
Other than that, he also needed to ensure that his position in the city would not be shaken. This way, it would be impossible for him to be replaced. There would be an added effect on the construction of the array formation as a result. At the same time, Wang Baole was also thinking about candidates for the position of the three other mayors.
He thought that it would be best if the candidates didn’t see him as an enemy, and were equipped with resources as well. However, when he pondered about it and sent the Martian Colony Governor a voice transmission to convey his thoughts humbly, the Martian Colony Governor replied him calmly.
“There is no need for you to think about these matters. The remaining three mayors of Divine Armament New City will be appointed by the Federation. You don’t have the power to decide, and that will be the case for the candidate for the Deputy City Lord as well.”
When he heard those words, Wang Baole was angry and disappointed. However, he also understood that he had already gained a huge advantage by having successfully pushed for the transformation of the city zone into a city. Therefore, it was impossible for the Federation to consider his opinions regarding the selection of the mayors.
He sighed.
Who would the three mayors be...? The Deputy City Lord as well...
Wang Baole’s head throbbed. He didn’t fear that the people appointed would be too powerful but simply felt that there were too few people of his alliance around him.
Lin Tianhao could be considered as one, but combining Kong Dao and Jin Duoming... they can’t be considered as one of my people...
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He knew that after the new city was constructed, it would be on such a large scale that it would require an immense amount of people in the system. Each faction would inevitably arrange for their own manpower, and that was exactly the scenario that Wang Baole was most afraid of.
I should never become a figurehead!
Wang Baole took a deep breath, remaining extremely vigilant even though he was now safe. Thoughts circulated in his head, and he decided to send Zhuo Yifan a voice transmission to seek his assistance.
However, Zhuo Yifan, who remained in Ethereal Dao College, had a duty to fulfill, and wouldn’t be able to come at short notice. After expressing his disappointment, he reminded him about the issues of safety, before putting away the voice transmission ring and sending a voice transmission to Zhao Yameng.
“I can’t go to Mars... Furthermore, I will be transferred from my current department and be deployed for duty in the President’s Office. Baole, I can’t help you this time. However, if you meet any problems on Mars, you can still tell me, and I will help you if I can.” Zhao Yameng first said that it wasn’t convenient for her to help, and then extended her assistance somewhat half-heartedly. However, Wang Baole, who was extremely disappointed, didn’t think much about it. He sighed, and discussed some details of the array formation with her casually, before putting down the voice transmission ring. He took a deep breath and raised his head.
It seems like the only thing I can do is use my trump card!
A glow flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes. He opened the voice transmission ring and flipped to Liu Daobin’s number, before sending a voice transmission to him.
“Liu Daobin, come help me at Divine Armament New City!”
Liu Daobin, who received the voice transmission, was leading his Armament Soldiers to inspect the administrative work in the Dharmic Armament Pavilion. The moment he saw Wang Baole’s voice transmission, he immediately picked it up agitatedly.
“City Lord, I...”
“Are you coming or not?” Wang Baole asked again.
“I’m coming!” Liu Daobin took a deep breath and answered loudly. He stopped leading his Armament Soldiers for the inspections, and instead sped to the peak of the Dharmic Armament Pavilion to report his work progress. He was extremely excited, as he felt that the chance he had been waiting painfully for had finally arrived!
At the same time, Wang Baole also sent a voice transmission to the Ethereal Dao College Sect Lord. They communicated, and after hearing about the difficulties Wang Baole faced, the Sect Lord laughed. He had long predicted that such a problem would surface. In reality, if Wang Baole didn’t send him a voice transmission, he had planned to discuss the matter with Wang Baole one of these days. Now, without hesitation, he agreed.
“Baole, you are the most outstanding student of Ethereal Dao College. I have always had great expectations of you. Don’t you worry about this matter. Ethereal Dao College is your home, and we will support you fully. It’s just manpower, right? I’ll make arrangements to send a large number of students to you immediately so that they can become your eyes in each of the departments of Divine Armament New City!”
The Sect Lord gave his complete support, and that calmed Wang Baole down, lifting his mood. Therefore, while he was waiting for the arrival of the cultivators from the Ethereal Dao College, he also wondered about who the Deputy City Lord could be.
He knew very well that the Deputy City Lord wasn’t a mayor. With his Noble title, he could order the mayors around, but he needed to tone down when handling the Deputy City Lord.
It’s best if it’s someone I know. That way, it would be easier to work.
As Wang Baole thought about the candidate for the Deputy City Lord, days went by. The plans for the entire city were completed, and people from the Ethereal Dao College arrived in tens of large cruisers in the skies above the Divine Armament Zone!
Liu Daobin, who had rushed from Earth, was extremely agitated in the cruiser. As he neared the Divine Armament New City, he felt that the road to success was paved right beneath his feet!
Follow the City Lord and serve him well. That way, I will never lose out!
Liu Daobin patted his storage bag with gusto. It was filled to the brim with snacks...
In terms of currying favor, if I, Liu Daobin, claim to be second, no one in the Ethereal Dao College would dare claim first place!
Liu Daobin raised his head with extreme pride.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - Li Wan’er Gets Engaged!
chapters.content:
Chapter 388: Li Wan’er Gets Engaged!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Soon, the ten cruisers landed in the simple aerial port of Divine Armament New City. Wang Baole was the host, and his guests were his Junior Sisters and Brothers, as well as Senior Brothers and Sisters. Therefore, it was only natural that he welcomed them personally.
Looks of passion and adoration immediately appeared in the eyes of the disciples when they noticed Wang Baole as they stepped off the Ethereal Dao College’s cruiser. They all went forward to greet him.
“Greetings, Senior Brother!”
“Greetings, Senior!”
“Greetings, City Lord!” Wang Baole was identified differently by different people. The group greeted him, and even though their voices were of varying loudness, they were collectively deafening and spread in all directions.
Wang Baole was also agitated. He felt that he had made such great interpersonal relationships with others in the Dao College that so many people adored him. That was especially so as most of them were his Junior Sisters. That made Wang Baole even more confident in his appearance and figure.
Just as he was about to move forward and hug his junior sisters, Liu Daobin jumped towards him, his eyes full of tears. Even before he reached Wang Baole, his agitated cries drowned out the voices of the other people as it overwhelmed the entire area.
“I’ve missed you, Senior Brother Baole, I’ve missed you so much!” Liu Daobin was shaking as he went forward and hugged Wang Baole’s thighs tightly. He was so agitated that he was trembling, which touched Wang Baole. Even the other people around Wang Baole were moved.
Jin Duoming threw a few glances at Liu Daobin, and Kong Dao nodded his head silently. Lin Tianhao was the only one who looked bewildered. On one hand, he was familiar with Liu Daobin, and on the other, he somehow had a feeling that Liu Daobin’s appearance would threaten his position.
“Daobin!” Looking at Liu Daobin hugging him agitatedly, Wang Baole was moved. He also felt guilty for only having eyes for his junior sisters, but not this junior brother of his.
As he reprimanded himself, Wang Baole helped Liu Daobin up and patted his shoulders in a pleased manner. He then swept his gaze towards the surroundings, as if looking for someone. Liu Daobin wiped his tears off and noticing Wang Baole’s reaction; he immediately spoke softly.
“Senior Brother, Zhou Xiaoya is... still in seclusion. As for Du Min, she has gone to the Moon, as the Foundation Establishment realm has opened yet again.”
Still in seclusion!
Wang Baole took a deep breath. He suddenly had the thought that helping Zhou Xiaoya gain admission into the Alchemy Pavilion then was a mistake. The Alchemy pavilion was inhumane, accepting students and putting them in seclusion every single day. That was just savage, and the mere thought of it made one shudder!
Wang Baole was immediately angered. He thought that if he had the chance to return to Earth, he would personally go down to the Alchemy Pavilion to find out what was going on. After making that decision, Wang Baole chatted briefly with the disciples from the Ethereal Dao College. He ended the conversation by encouraging the disciples before arranging for their residences. What awaited them would be the allocation of their numerous positions in the city.
With that, Wang Baole brought Liu Daobin to his office. The moment they entered, Liu Daobin immediately began to boil water like a pro, personally brewing a cup of tea for Wang Baole. After that, he sat beside Wang Baole, lowering his head while taking out a small notebook, ready to listen.
This scene aroused a sense of familiarity in Wang Baole. He suddenly thought about his life when he was in the Dao College. As a wave of emotions rushed through him, he asked about Du Min’s journey to the Moon, before taking a sip of tea. As he set the tea down, he assigned Liu Daobin the role of the supervisor of his office.
Liu Daobin, who had been bestowed with the responsibility, patted his chest forcefully.
“Rest assured, City Lord. My father used to hold a similar position, and I have seen him work from a young age. I am very familiar with the workings of this place, and I dare to guarantee that there will be no problems arising at all!”
Wang Baole grew even more satisfied upon hearing his words. He further relayed some instructions, and Liu Daobin jotted everything down as he listened, seeming afraid that he would miss out on even a word. His attitude made one feel comfortable, and that was especially so when he left a storage bag in front of Wang Baole before he left.
Wang Baole frowned and was about to reject him when Liu Daobin hurriedly opened the storage bag, pouring out some of the snacks. Wang Baole took a look and picked up the bag, rummaging through it. He realized that it was filled to the brim with snacks, as well as dozens of boxes of Ice Spirit Water from the Ethereal Dao College that were of a different flavor than what was commonly available. That made him feel even more delighted.
Seeing that Wang Baole was pleased, Liu Daobin was satisfied. He then left after cleaning up the office.
Liu Daobin’s not bad, as usual.
Wang Baole sat where he was, munching on the snacks and drinking the Ice Spirit Water. He was filled with emotions and felt that right now, everything had been prepared for the new city. The only thing lacking was the commencement of the construction process, which could only happen after the three new mayors arrived.
As Wang Baole waited, time flew by, and soon seven days passed. In those seven days, the Federation didn’t manage to come to a conclusion in regards to the candidates for the three mayors, and from that, it could be seen how intense the competition was.
However, in the process of each faction fighting for the mayor candidacy, yet another piece of news regarding the Five Generation Sky Clan and the Senate began to spread throughout the Federation, causing a huge commotion.
This second piece of news was even more detailed than the last. The previous news merely mentioned the collaboration of the two parties, but now, there was no mention of the collaboration. The only thing that was brought up was... the marriage alliance between the Head Senator and the Chen Family of the Five Generation Sky Clan!
The moment the news spread, it immediately sent shock waves amongst people who were following it. Wang Baole also got a huge shock, and couldn’t help but make some guesses. He then sought out Lin Tianhao, inquiring with him about it.
Lin Tianhao seemed to know more this time around. After all, when Wang Baole asked him about the matter previously, he was unable to answer, and that made him feel that he wasn’t playing an important role like he did previously. That was especially so when a sense of crisis arose in him when he saw Liu Daobin. Therefore, after hearing about the news regarding the marriage alliance, he immediately sent a voice transmission to his father, making it clear that he wanted to know the details.
Lin You didn’t have much of a choice and told Lin Tianhao part of the whole story. Therefore, when Wang Baole summoned him to ask about the matter, Lin Tianhao took a deep breath and began speaking.
“City Lord, I have just come to know about the matter as well. What’s known now is that... Li Wan’er and the eldest son of the Chen Family, Chen Mu, will be tied by marriage. The two of them will get engaged soon, and will complete their marriage a year later!”
“Since we’re at it... I have met this Chen Mu as well. He is a little older than we are and has long been on the job. In the Federation, he is a Secondary Rank Four in the Authority Department. When I was a young boy, my father would compare me with him, and want me to learn from him...” Lin Tianhao was somewhat emotional. He was mid-sentence when Wang Baole suddenly slammed the table.
“All this is ridiculous. What era are we in that there are still arranged marriages and marriage alliances?” Wang Baole had some bad intuition previously, and now that he heard Lin Tianhao’s words, the scene of himself and Li Wan’er in the cave surfaced in his mind. All sorts of emotions emerged, and vaguely, he felt as if his woman had been snatched away by someone.
Lin Tianhao got a fright and felt confused. He silently wondered if the City Lord was acquainted with Chen Mu, and hurriedly spoke.
“Yes, you’re right, City Lord. It’s now the Spirit Inception Era, and yet there are still marriage alliances! Chen Mu is a decent chap, but it’s a pity that of all people, he married that abused old witch, Li Wan’er!” Lin Tianhao sighed and was about to continue when Wang Baole lifted his head and stared at him.
That stare made Lin Tianhao shocked. He had a bad feeling that he had misinterpreted the situation. The person that Wang Baole felt indignant for wasn’t Chen Mu, but Li Wan’er...
This guess made him widen his eyes.
“That Chen Mu... what on earth was he thinking about? Isn’t he afraid that Li Wan’er will castrate him?” After Wang Baole stared at Lin Tianhao, Wang Baole grumbled, extremely unsatisfied towards the marriage.
Wang Baole’s words confirmed Lin Tianhao’s guess. He felt bewildered and thought silently in his head that the City Lord indeed had a different and unique taste in women. However, he didn’t dare to ask further and instead told Wang Baole everything his father had revealed.
“This time, it would be a deep-rooted alliance that would be formed between the Senate and the Five Generation Sky Clan through the marriage alliance. Even though there was some unhappiness between the two parties, politics is all about compromise... At the same time, I have heard that the Chen Family, in asking for Li Wan’er’s hand in marriage, has given a dowry that the senator found irresistible to reject!”
When he finished what he had to say, Lin Tianhao didn’t stay and left hurriedly. As he left, he thought about how different he was from Wang Baole. Right now, Wang Baole had lost all mood for eating the snacks. He was depressed and was filled with indescribable emotions. He felt that Chen Mu had made him a cuckold.
D*rn it. How dare you snatch my woman. I’ll torture you to death!
A look of viciousness flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - The Deputy City Lord is Appointed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 389: The Deputy City Lord is Appointed!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The baneful vibe was so strong that Wang Baole couldn’t control himself and wanted to release it. After circling the office, he took out his voice transmission ring and sent a voice transmission to Li Wan’er. The moment the voice transmission went through, even before Wang Baole could speak, Li Wan’er’s cold voice reverberated by his ears.
“What’s the matter?”
That cold voice stopped Wang Baole in his tracks, but he still couldn’t help but ask.
“I heard that you’re getting engaged with that b*stard from the Chen Family?”
Li Wan’er was silent. After a brief moment, she spoke calmly.
“What has that got to do with you? Additionally, my fiancee is not a b*stard. Please be more respectful in your words, City Lord Wang!”
Her words completely froze Wang Baole in his steps; the anger in his heart slowly calming down. He was silent for a long while, before laughing.
“Congratulations.” After that, Wang Baole hung up the voice transmission. He took a deep breath and pushed open the window, looking at the sky outside for a long while before turning around to meditate with his legs crossed. He calmed himself down while cultivating.
However, what he didn’t know was that right now, in the Colony Disciplinary Order Office, Li Wan’er was standing beside the windows and looking in the direction of Wang Baole’s Divine Armament New City. She carried a complex look, and after a very long period of time, an extremely soft sigh that only she could hear reverberated in her heart.
As for Wang Baole, he managed to slowly calm his thoughts after using a lot of will. He no longer thought about Li Wan’er’s matter, as he felt that he didn’t have the right to interfere in the matter, and didn’t want to bother himself with it any longer. Even though he had exposed his body and was disadvantaged, he felt that the b*stard from Chen Family would lose out even more.
Even though he consoled himself with such thoughts, jealousy still crept in his heart. Wang Baole sighed and took a deep breath, and as he calmed down his thoughts, he slowly immersed himself in the process of cultivation.
His cultivation was already at the late-stage Foundation Establishment realm. Even though the construction of the new city during this period of time had kept him busy, he still managed to delegate the tasks such that he had a lot of time to cultivate. Most importantly, the cultivation of the Dark Art took place at an extremely fast speed under the aura of the Divine Armament Catacombs. At the same time, it also significantly raised his Lightning Dao: First Volume.
This way, Wang Baole’s cultivation improved by the day. For others in late-stage Foundation Establishment realm, increasing their cultivation depended not just on fate, but also the availability of time for cultivation. As for cultivation, it would take a few years at least. After all, the process of perfecting Foundation Establishment realm from late-stage Foundation Establishment realm was one of accumulation. They were all aimed towards stepping into the Core Formation realm after breakthrough, and the more they accumulated, the higher the likelihood of succeeding.
Therefore, the entire process was taken with all seriousness. At the same time, there was no shortcut. However, for Wang Baole, who had the boost from the Dark Art, his speed of cultivation could be increased significantly. Even though he hadn’t reached perfection, he was clearly already halfway through.
Despite that, Wang Baole also knew very well that cultivation couldn’t be completed within a day. It required a process of accumulation over days and months. Therefore, after cultivating in seclusion for several days, and completely calming down, he ended the cultivation process. When he opened his eyes, the sky had already darkened, and through the window, he could see the lights outside. After spreading the array formation, he could even hear the bustling activity of the New Mars Region coming from afar in the night.
Even though the city hadn’t been constructed, that piece of land was already housing a trillion people. The nightlife made the city a bustling place.
Looking at all the lights and feeling the activity of Divine Armament New City, Wang Baole breathed calmly. Even though he didn’t continue cultivating, he had already begun thinking about how to go about refining the artifacts.
I am already sufficiently familiar with the refinement of fifth-grade Numinous Treasures...
Wang Baole mumbled to himself. The construction of the Eternal Fortress could be said to have utilized fifth-grade Numinous Treasures as its foundation. Therefore, Wang Baole had already reached a certain standard in his skills of refining the fifth-grade Numinous Treasures, such that most of them were perfect.
What’s next is the sixth-grade Numinous Treasure... From this, I can soon attempt to construct my very own seventh-grade Dharmic Armament!
With that thought, Wang Baole’s breathing quickened. That was the lifelong dream of any Dharmic Armament cultivator.
Wang Baole had already experienced the power of the Dharmic Armament. At the same time, he knew very clearly that his Dharmic Armament saber wasn’t entirely suitable for him. If he wanted something that was perfectly compatible with him, he had to make it himself.
However, in the Federation, not all cultivators had such an opportunity. For most of the cultivators, receiving a Dharmic Armament was already like winning the lottery. If they really wanted to personalize one for themselves, they could only do it in their dreams.
However, for Wang Baole, it wasn’t a dream. He could accomplish the goal in real life. This managed to push out the unpleasant thoughts that had previously occupied his mind. A look of anticipation and agitation flashed across his eyes, and at the same time, he understood that he should carry out everything step by step. He could be excited about it, but he shouldn’t rush into it, as being anxious wouldn’t help at all.
Next, I’ll try to refine the sixth-grade Numinous Treasure. In addition, I need to upgrade all my Dharmic Artifacts to the level of a fifth-grade Numinous Treasure! Most important of them is my Intrinsic Dharmic Artifact, the scabbard!
Wang Baole had calmed down. Determined, he immediately went to work. Previously, he had to be prudent in his use of resources as the expenditure was hefty every time he cultivated. That was especially so for the refinement materials required for the fifth-grade Numinous Treasure. They were extremely rare, and therefore extremely expensive.
However, now that he was a City Lord of Primary Rank Three, he had a large amount of resources in his hands. As the City Lord, he had many means to obtain sufficient refinement materials without affecting the process of the city’s construction. Furthermore, there was no need to be secretive about it and break the law. In the eyes of the Federation in the Spirit Inception Era, this was a reasonable matter, as long as he didn’t go overboard.
Therefore, with sufficient resources at his disposal, Wang Baole began to refine and upgrade his Numinous Treasures furiously. The upgrading of the other Numinous Treasures was relatively simple, but it was challenging for his Intrinsic Dharmic Artifact, which not only required sufficient Armament Sand but also numerous tries.
However, Wang Baole was in no rush. As he waited for the confirmation of candidates for the Deputy City Lord and the mayors, he continued refining his Dharmic Artifacts while cultivating the Dark Art simultaneously. Everything progressed in a stable manner, but what made Wang Baole most regretful was that, from start to end, he had no chance to display the godly mystic art of the Dark Art—the Dark Corpse Face Art!
There were simply too many people around. In addition, the Dark Corpse Face Art was a part of the Dark Art, and if other people sensed it, it would be difficult for Wang Baole to explain himself. Therefore, he could only imagine and play it out in his mind while regret filled his heart.
I wonder when I can find someone to display my Dark Corpse Face Art to!
Wang Baole was emotional while cultivating, and just like that, half a month passed.
At this time, after a month of competition between the various factions, there were some changes made once again to the candidates chosen to become Divine Armament New City’s three mayors. There was still no confirmation of the mayor candidacy, and instead, the candidate for Deputy City Lord was set.
When Wang Baole received the notice from the Martian Colony Governor about the confirmation of the Deputy City Lord—and that the person would arrive within the next few days—his thoughts that had taken a lot of effort to stabilize suddenly grew chaotic again. He looked at the voice transmission ring and listen to the Governor read out the name.
Why is it her?
Wang Baole frowned. However, after thinking about it deeply, he set aside his personal feelings. It seemed reasonable that this person was appointed as Deputy City Lord.
After all, this person had worked on Mars for many years and was Secondary Rank Three for a long time running. Regardless of whether it was her cultivation or background, she was considered an elite. It was appropriate for her to become Deputy City Lord.
The candidate for Deputy City Lord was... Li Wan’er!!
At the same time, she didn’t come as Secondary Rank Three, but was instead promoted to Primary Rank Three, the same rank as Wang Baole, as she became Deputy City Lord.
Many things could be interpreted from the promotion of her Noble rank. Wang Baole had some understanding of it but still felt that it was a complex matter. He was powerless in changing the fact that Li Wan’er was engaged to the eldest son of the Chen family, and had thought that he would no longer have the chance to meet her. He had never imagined that both of them would work together in the future.
That made Wang Baole sigh. He had a headache for several days, and soon, Li Wan’er arrived...
As the cruiser landed and Li Wan’er’s tall and slender figure appeared before others, Wang Baole was completely filled with regret and jealousy.
However, compared to him, even if the others were attracted to Li Wan’er’s impressive looks, they also felt a chill as they knew that she was a thorny rose and was known for being ruthless. Therefore, they all lowered their heads and greeted her. Even Kong Dao and Lin Tianhao followed suit. Jin Duoming had originally planned to challenge himself and woo her, but after hearing about the engagement, and the trauma of being almost castrated, he put on a rare look of seriousness.
As the people greeted her, Li Wan’er stepped forward amongst the crowd with a cold expression towards Wang Baole. When she saw him, she expressionlessly greeted him.
“Greetings, City Lord. I am under the order of the Governor. Other than overseeing the construction of the city, I am also responsible for inspecting the Colony Disciplinary Order of Divine Armament New City. I seek the City Lord’s cooperation in working together in the future!”

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - Loggerheads Would Always Meet
chapters.content:
Chapter 390: Loggerheads Would Always Meet
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Li Wan’er’s cold and distant attitude and formal tone immediately made everyone who came to welcome her confused, as they looked at Wang Baole and Li Wan’er.
That was especially so as many people had known that Li Wan’er didn’t come as someone who was Secondary Rank Three, but was promoted to Primary Rank Three before taking on the role of Deputy City Lord. That made her the same rank as Wang Baole. Therefore, in reality, even though they had different statuses, Li Wan’er was the only one who could argue and defy Wang Baole in the entire city.
A person like her had just arrived but was already distant and impersonal in tone. At the same time, she was in charge of a scary department like the Colony Disciplinary Order, which was a signal to everyone!
Instantly, silence filled the surroundings. Kong Dao frowned slightly. He hadn’t cared much previously about Li Wan’er’s arrival, but now that he saw how imposing she was, he seemed to have seen through something and was now narrowing his eyes. He wasn’t foolish, after all.
Kong Dao didn’t care about anyone else. However, since Wang Baole had helped him and gave him an advancement, he was on the side of Wang Baole. Instinctively, he was filled with dislike and resistance towards Li Wan’er, who had just arrived.
That was even more so for Lin Tianhao. Even though his father and Li Wan’er’s father were both from the Senate, he felt that it revolved around people of the previous generation, which had nothing to do with himself. Therefore, he also raised his eyebrows, but when he thought about the guess he had made regarding the relationship between Wang Baole and Li Wan’er, he blinked and felt that this matter was complex and impossible to understand fully.
Jin Duoming was also bewildered right now. In his mind, even though Li Wan’er was hot-tempered, she wasn’t a rash person. Logically, it was impossible for her to say such things the moment she arrived.
Is she putting up a show?
Jin Duoming was suspicious. This intuition was very obvious, and Wang Baole felt that way even more. The complex emotions in his heart were now mostly gone, and with a chilly and stern look, he glanced at Li Wan’er and nodded slightly. Without saying a word, he turned and left.
It would have been clearer if Wang Baole had said something, but he left without saying anything. That, coupled with the fact that he had a great influence over Divine Armament New City, made that seem like an expression of his attitude. Lin Tianhao and Kong Dao also turned to leave with him. Jin Duoming hesitated, only turning to leave after looking at Li Wan’er and nodding slightly.
The people of other ranks who noticed the silent fight going on between the elites didn’t dare to go near either. After greeting her, they all began to dissipate. Soon, there were just a handful of people remaining of those who had come to welcome Li Wan’er.
Li Wan’er stood there, furrowing her brows slightly. Before she came, she had done some research on Divine Armament New City and had known about Wang Baole’s status. However, after arriving, she was still frightened by the authority that Wang Baole held, and the words that her father said to her before she came kept surfacing in her mind.
“Wang Baole is an extraordinary person. After transforming the city zone into a city, his position in Divine Armament New City is one that cannot be easily shaken. The matter between the both of you must be made clear, and ties must be cut!”
With that thought, Li Wan’er sighed in her heart. In reality, she had been unwilling to come. On one hand, she was of superior rank to Wang Baole previously, but now that Wang Baole became her superior in name, she had a hard time getting used to it.
On the other hand, there was an incident between them that she couldn’t tell anyone. In addition, she was engaged. Even though she was vehemently against the engagement, she could only give in eventually. She could only bear with the unhappiness in her heart, and that made her feel even more complex emotions as she faced Wang Baole.
Before long, Li Wan’er buried the complex emotions deep in her heart and took a deep breath. She led the servants into Divine Armament New City. As there was only one zone now, her office was in the same building as Wang Baole, which wasn’t far away.
Having just been appointed, she managed to push aside all her thoughts as she began to oversee matters regarding the city. At the same time, she deployed manpower in the various departments. She didn’t act lightly and didn’t appear to be challenging Wang Baole’s authority, instead, taking the initiative to cooperate. Through this, the planning of the new city advanced further towards completion.
Even Wang Baole had to admit that Li Wan’er was extremely capable in handling various matters, and was even better at the job than himself. As she began work, she managed to increase the speed and order of the city’s construction.
This made Kong Dao and company more impressed with Li Wan’er. They no longer felt a strong resistance towards her. In addition, as work began, the contact between Li Wan’er and Wang Baole inevitably increased. After all, the planning for the city depended on the Great Baole Array Formation as a foundation, and this made Wang Baole’s suggestions extremely crucial in the planning process.
Right now, the two of them were in Wang Baole’s office, discussing the plans for the construction of the sixth zone in the city.
“City Lord, according to your array formation, there needs to be alterations made to the plan for the sixth zone. With that change, not only could we increase the power of the array formation, we could also reduce the costs of construction.” Li Wan’er looked serious as she passed a jade slip to Wang Baole.
Wang Baole received the jade slip in a similar, formal manner. After reading it, he was impressed. The plan laid out in the jade slip, after being edited by Li Wan’er, was indeed much better than before. At the same time, Wang Baole was encouraged by how orderly the city had become after Li Wan’er arrived, even if it was just for a few days.
“We shall use this plan then.” Wang Baole didn’t reveal his thoughts. He simply nodded after putting the jade slip down.
Li Wan’er didn’t say anything and turned to leave. Seeing her push open the door, about to step out, Wang Baole sat there, raising his head to look at Li Wan’er’s beautiful back, before speaking suddenly.
“Li Wan’er, no matter how hard you try to display the distance and chill between us, I am your superior!
“At the same time, since you’re here as Deputy City Lord, you must remember that if the city performs well, it would benefit you, and it would benefit me... I respect you, and I also hope that you would respect me. Regarding matters of the city, we can always discuss and solve problems, as whatever I say isn’t the be-all and end-all!”
“I’m not sure if you have any motives being in Divine Armament New City. However, this place has all the attention of the Federation on it. If something were to happen, I’m not a magnanimous person, and would report the matter honestly!” Wang Baole spoke with a low voice. This was the first time he said something like that to Li Wan’er.
As he spoke, Li Wan’er stopped in her tracks. With her back facing Wang Baole, she seemed to be deep in thought. At that moment, silence filled the office.
“Got it!” After a brief period, Li Wan’er spoke. Her tone was still unyielding, but the chill in her voice was somewhat reduced. She didn’t turn around as she left.
Li Wan’er, who had now stepped out of Wang Baole’s office, was on her way back to her residence. A complex look of regret filled her eyes. She knew that what Wang Baole said was correct. The stability of the city trumped everything else.
She also admitted that she felt differently towards Wang Baole. However, she knew very clearly that her role in the city wasn’t to destroy anything, but to go according to the marriage alliance between the Senate and the Five Generation Sky Clan to pave the way to success for her fiancée!
Others didn’t know who the three future mayors would be, but she knew that the eldest son of the Chen Family, Chen Mu, would be one of them. She even knew that this way of paving the road to success for her future husband would lead to disagreements with Wang Baole that she didn’t desire, but she had no choice.
Therefore, all she could think of was to cut away all ties with Wang Baole, treating him merely as a co-worker!
Wang Baole didn’t know the details of Li Wan’er’s thoughts, but could more or less guess it. In reality, when Li Wan’er arrived, he had already analyzed the situation and felt that the possibility of her fiancee Chen Mu eventually coming to the city was high.
This was indeed the case, just as Wang Baole had guessed. After several days, the candidacy of the three remaining mayors of Divine Armament New City was finally set, after the month-long delay the competition between the various factions.
When the notice was passed from the Martian Colony Governor to Wang Baole, he looked at the profiles of the three new mayors under his lead!
The first one was indeed... Chen Mu, the eldest son of the Chen Family!
The second person was someone from Galactic Dusk Sect that had failed in his attempt to rob Wang Baole on the moon and was instead stripped by Wang Baole. The elite bound by black bandages!
The third person was a woman that Wang Baole wasn’t familiar with. However, from her portfolio, it seemed that she had come from the Plume Manifestation Connate Sect!
The various factions within the Federation were all assembled in Divine Armament New City. It could be said that, to a certain extent, the city was a mini-version of the entire Federation!

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - Autonomous Zone!
chapters.content:
Chapter 391: Autonomous Zone!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Chen Mu, Wen Huai, and Fang Jing from Plume Manifestation Connate Sect...
Looking at the file sent by the Martian Colony Governor, Wang Baole raised his eyebrows slightly. He finally knew that the person who had wanted to rob him but was instead robbed was named Wen Huai.
Wang Baole’s deepest impression about this Wen Huai was that... he was rather poor.
It would have been fine if he was just poor, but he still had to act cool and cover himself with black bandages. His figure isn’t as great as mine, and he didn’t grow as well during puberty like I did...
Wang Baole patted his stomach. As he became more knowledgeable, he began to have sentiments of a person who was bored that no one could defeat him because he was too superior.
However, that sentiment all but vanished when he focused his attention on Chen Mu’s profile again. Chen Mu was from the Five Generation Sky Clan, and within this clan, the Chen family’s status was far superior to that of the Zhuo family. Even though both family clans were nuclear family clans, the Chen family clan occupied almost thirty percent of the Five Generation Sky Clan!
Chen Mu, as the eldest son in this generation of the Chen family, may not be the heir to succeed the position of Clan Leader, but the possibility of him eventually taking on the position remained high.
The profile that the Martian Colony Governor has given me is... interesting.
Wang Baole held onto the jade slip containing the profile and narrowed his eyes. In reality, anonymous comments from someone, who may or may not be the Martian Colony Governor, were given for every single person listed in the file. There was only a single comment for Chen Mu.
Ambitious but not sufficiently talented!
The comments for Wen Huai were even more vicious, which mentioned that he was malicious and stubborn!
The comment for Fang Jing from the Plume Manifestation Connate Sect was the only one that was slightly better. It merely said that she was hot-tempered.
Wang Baole didn’t know for sure if the three comments were true, but he thought that they were very likely made by the Martian Colony Governor. Therefore, Wang Baole couldn’t help but wonder what the Martian Colony Governor would say of him if she were to assess him.
Without having to think too hard, I know what she’ll say. Handsome, intelligent, the suavest person in the entire Federation. I’m sick of hearing words like these.
Wang Baole shook his head. He wasn’t affected by the three comments. He was clear that he should only take other people’s comments as a reference, as he would lose out if he formed the habit of viewing others around him as fools.
However, this Chen Mu is definitely a simpleton!
Wang Baole sneered. However, he knew that even though the trio had been appointed as mayors instead of working their way there, this should be the outcome of the discussion between the Federation, Mars, as well as the various factions.
At the same time, in the file, it was also stated that the trio wouldn’t come by themselves. They would bring with them a large amount of resources, similar to the case of Lin Tianhao, Kong Dao, and Jin Duoming, who also provided resources for the construction of the new city.
The tactic used by the Federation and Mars is always about trying to gain something without risking anything of their own. They use it all the time... Don’t they have other tricks up their sleeves?
Wang Baole shook his head. Even though the one that would sponsor the most resources was Chen Mu, the displeasure Wang Baole felt towards Chen Mu was still strong. He was a thorn in his eyes.
However, he also understood that in terms of importance, scale, and future prospects, the new city far exceeded that of the new city zone. He was also wielding authority that he never had before. As he enjoyed all of these benefits, it was inevitable that he would clash with the Federation and the various factions.
In reality, these clashes could be considered a battle to a certain extent. However, they were competing not based on divine abilities, but tactic and circumstance.
My cultivation level is still too low. If I were a Nascent Soul now, these ridiculous people would have long been eliminated by me with a single slap. Their family clan and factions wouldn’t dare say a word either!
Wang Baole slapped his forehead as he sighed. He gritted his teeth and continued to meditate in seclusion to cultivate.
In the entire life of, I, Wang Baole, everything I’ve owned has been the result of my own efforts. I can’t even remember the amount of sweat and blood that I’ve spared! They will never know that even when I’m snacking, I’m thinking about my journey of cultivation!
A look of determination appeared in Wang Baole’s eyes. He knew very well that even though Little Missy had helped him significantly, that even without Little Missy, his achievements wouldn’t pale in comparison to what he had now—based on his talent and that gorgeous face of his.
After all, in his consciousness, people who looked good would naturally be kindly treated by the entire world, and their luck was typically good.
Little Missy’s appearance proves this point too. I know that she took the initiative to come to me because she appreciated my talent. She wanted to assist me in accomplishing great success.
With that thought, Wang Baole’s head swelled. He took a deep breath, feeling as if his confidence was through the roof. With that strong sense of confidence, a glow flashed across his eyes as the cultivation within his body began to activate furiously. It was as if his Spirit Qi was also being boosted with his confidence.
Therefore, leveraging on this confidence, Wang Baole began meditating and cultivating. As his Lightning Dao was activated, and as the Dark Art gradually cycled, Wang Baole could feel that his cultivation level was slowly rising.
That increment satisfied him, making him feel as if his talent was beyond describable. If that wasn’t the case, he wouldn’t have already reached late-stage Foundation Establishment realm while others in the same batch as him were still in the mid-stage Foundation Establishment realm at most...
I cannot be arrogant!
A glow flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes as he hurriedly reminded himself. With that self-reminder, he couldn’t help but grow even more satisfied with himself.
Just like that, days passed. When Wang Baole finished a few cycles of his cultivation, he realized that the three appointed mayors had still not arrived. He didn’t need to monitor the construction of the city either. At the same time, the donkey seemed to have gone missing during this period, its whereabouts unknown.
Based on Wang Baole’s sense, he felt that the donkey seemed to be very healthy, and therefore, didn’t care much about it. Instead, he used the time to continually upgrade his Dharmic Artifacts.
He had many Dharmic Artifacts, which made the upgrading process extremely long. It was also in this process of refinement that Wang Baole grew more familiar and gained a deeper understanding of his Dharmic Artifacts.
In his free time, he also began to play out the Dark Corpse Face Art in his head. In this manner, days passed, and soon, half a month had gone by.
By this time, Chen Mu and the other two had still not arrived. That made Wang Baole frown, and he thought about calling Lin Tianhao to ask about it after he emerged from seclusion.
Listening to Wang Baole’s tone, which indicated his displeasure, Lin Tianhao laughed bitterly and hesitated for a moment before deciding to tell the truth.
“City Lord, according to the information I have received from Martian City, Chen Mu and the other two people have long arrived on Mars. However, after their arrival, they remained in the Martian City, paying visits to the Governor, Deputy Governor, as well as the people in charge of the different departments... I heard that they are still not done with their visits even now...” Lin Tianhao looked at Wang Baole and spoke softly.
Hearing those words, Wang Baole slowly narrowed his eyes. He was extremely annoyed, thinking that the three fellas were trying to send an obvious and clear message for purposely not visiting him after visiting so many others.
However, they aren’t foolish people. Why are they making it so obvious...
This was something that Wang Baole couldn’t understand. After Lin Tianhao left, he was still pondering this question.
However, without having to think for too long, Wang Baole immediately got the answer he was looking for on the second day as the voice transmission notice from the Martian Colony Governor arrived.
“City Lord Wang, Chen Mu, Wen Huai, and Fang Jing will report for duty at Divine Armament New City in the next few days. It has already been approved by the Federation that the three zones that they will be stationed at will be overseen by the Federation directly, and be approved as an autonomous zone!”
“Huh?” After receiving the voice transmission, a cold glow flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes. He looked increasingly solemn and serious as he lowered his head to look at the voice transmission ring.
“Governor, the Federation has gone overboard with the handling of this matter, don’t you think? This is my city, and they are still going autonomous in my territory?”
“Even though it’s autonomous, it is, after all, still under your charge.” The Governor was unhappy about this matter, but it was a decision made by the Federation, and she didn’t want to participate in the battle between the factions.
Wang Baole’s breathing quickened slightly. He knew very well that he would just be a figurehead. He wanted to fight for his rights, but the Martian Colony Governor sighed once again, emphasizing that these were the orders of the Federation.
However, she eventually told Wang Baole that she would definitely not let matters rest if the three of them acted out of order!
Once they break the rules, everything will be too late. After all, they aren’t Li Yi...
Wang Baole thought about this but didn’t verbalize it. After calming down and accepting the news, a look of ruthlessness appeared on his face as the Martian Colony Governor hung up the voice transmission.
Those three rascals. You’re so capable, huh? I’ve silently agreed for you to have a piece of the pie, and you’re still not satisfied? Now you want autonomy too?
Sure, just you wait!
A cold look flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - Dont Be Too Serious!
chapters.content:
Chapter 392: Don’t Be Too Serious!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
To Wang Baole, the feeling was like he built a large house for himself, but three other people just came and occupied it with him, taking up one room each.
It wouldn’t have been an issue if it was similar to the act of living in his house, but what they were trying to do was erase his name as the owner of the room from the deed, and then replace it with their own name.
This is robbery! D*rn it, how dare you snatch my things away?
When Wang Baole thought of the word ‘robbery’, he was reminded of Li Wan’er and Chen Mu’s engagement. With the thought that Li Wan’er would soon become Chen Mu’s Dao partner, the anger he had towards it, which had once appeared but waned, reappeared again.
At the same time, in the skies between the Martian Colony City and Divine Armament New City, tens of specially built large cruisers were traveling at an astonishing speed.
The cruisers carried the first batch of manpower and resources, which were in staggering quantities. In the cockpit of the first cruiser, three people sat there, sipping on wine and conversing with each other. One of them was dressed in formal attire and had fair skin. At the same time, he had a profound look in his eyes. Besides looking extremely handsome, he gave off an extraordinary vibe.
“Junior Brother Wen and Junior Sister Fang, as long as we go according to our agreement and carry out our duties in Divine Armament New City, there would be no issues.” The youth held the wine cup and took a sip of the wine. He smiled, appearing extremely intelligent and persuasive, and that made the two people sitting opposite him nod their heads slightly.
Of the two, one was Wen Huai, who was now wearing a long robe of traditional design. From his wide sleeves, it could be seen that a large number of black bandages were covering his arm, and that was the same case for his neck and half of his face. This unique style made him look extremely vicious.
The other person was a woman named Fang Jing. There were obvious signs that she was from the Plume Manifestation Connate Sect. Even though the name ‘Plume Manifestation Connate Sect’ sounded elegant, in reality, all their disciples strove for physical strength, regardless of whether they were male or female. All of them had exaggeratedly large muscles, and Fang Jing was no exception.
She was born with beautiful looks. However, no matter how beautiful she was, when paired with a muscular physique, anyone who saw her would gasp.
Right now, Fang Jing was like a metal tower, sitting there, giving off a strong suppressive force that made even Wen Huai fearful. However, it had no effect on the youth in formal attire.
That youth was Chen Mu, the Chen Family’s eldest son. Right now, the three of them were on the way to Divine Armament New City. According to the scheduled time, they would arrive in an hour.
“Senior Brother Chen, don’t belittle Wang Baole. I had some interactions with him previously... not only is he a vicious person, but he is also extremely shameless and sly. It’s as if there are no limits to the things he can do or how he can act. Disgusting!” After a period of silence, Wen Huai spoke softly, revealing all his thoughts about Wang Baole.
“Li Yi and I are best friends. According to her, Wang Baole is scum with all the body fat he carries. At the same time, he is extremely lecherous. If he dares to have any perverted thoughts towards me this time, I will let him know that not everyone will be bullied by him!” Fang Jing snorted. She was filled with hatred towards Wang Baole, especially when she already had a bad impression of him through what she heard from Li Yi’s stories.
A look of bewilderment flashed across Wen Huai’s eyes, but he didn’t say much. Chen Mu, on the other hand, remained elegant throughout the process. One couldn’t guess what he was really thinking, and right now, he was nodding his head while smiling.
“Wang Baole is indeed a scum of the Federation. It is necessary to eliminate him as soon as possible, but Junior Brother Wen is right. The fact that he could make it until now means that he has some capabilities. His tactics may be vicious, but we should never let our guard down. However, the fact that the three factions of ours have already reached a consensus, allowing us to regard each other as brothers and sisters, shows just where the issue lies.
“Therefore, as long as the three of us don’t fall out with each other and remain united, Wang Baole will eventually be our stepping stone.”
As Wen Huai and Fang Jing listened, they seemed to have thought of something. They smiled, holding up their wine glasses and toasting Chen Mu.
Chen Mu laughed heartily. He looked calm on the surface, but he was secretly delighted. This time, not only did his family clan manage to arrange for the position of mayor for him, but they also achieved the right to be autonomous. At the same time, in this new city, he already had people standing on the same side as him. His fiancé Li Wan’er was already the Deputy City Lord.
In reality, Chen Mu was dissatisfied towards this fiancé of his. To him, although there were many women superior to him, enough that he felt shameful, there were also innumerable women who would willingly strip naked and leap at him with a snap of his fingers.
After all, he was different from Jin Duoming. Jin Duoming liked to collect, while Chen Mu preferred brief enjoyment. Therefore, he was somewhat against his fiancé.
When he arrived, his family clan had told him that according to the agreement with the Head Senator, Li Wan’er’s role was to pave the way for his success in Divine Armament New City.
Therefore, on the basis of having a path to success, he unwillingly agreed to the marriage arrangement. However, these were all thoughts that he kept in his heart, thoughts that he didn’t dare reveal in front of the senator.
Fine then. I have met this Li Wan’er previously. She looks quite beautiful, and her figure is hot. Even though I don’t know how she will look naked, she should be relatively good in bed.
With that thought, Chen Mu was suddenly excited. However, Li Wan’er had long made it clear that before their marriage, there would be no physical contact. Despite that, Chen Mu was confident that, as a woman, what she said wasn’t what she meant.
Having thought of Li Wan’er, hatred and dislike towards Wang Baole arose uncontrollably in Chen Mu’s heart. It was even transformed into a form that would make him choose to kill if he had the choice...
He belittled Wang Baole, because, according to his judgment, Wang Baole was merely lucky. That luck of his was baseless and inconsistent.
To Chen Mu, the persistence of wanting to expand the city zone into a city when Wang Baole was already holding a stable position as mayor was a stupid move, despite it allowing him to be promoted. Wang Baole was rash, but Chen Mu still had to thank him for his stupidity. If not, his family clan wouldn’t have the opportunity to interfere in the New Mars Region again when everything seemed to have already been set in stone.
There was another reason. He had heard about the incident between Wang Baole and his fiancé, Li Wan’er, through the private conversations of the Zhuo family. That shocked him extremely badly. He tried going to the Zhuo family several times to demand the video footage, curious about finding out exactly what was going on.
However, the Zhuo Family didn’t dare to hand it to him. All they said was that it had already been destroyed.
However, Chen Mu didn’t want to let the matter rest. Therefore, he found Zhuo Yixian, but Zhuo Yixian was already frozen in fear with regret and didn’t dare involve himself further. However, the strong hatred he had towards Wang Baole overruled everything, and with a pitiful look, he patted Chen Mu’s shoulder and told him...
“Brother, don’t be too serious about this matter. Just treat it as if nothing happened. If not, if you were to really see the footage, you might... Forget it, that’s all I’ll say. You’ll understand what I mean.”
It wouldn’t have mattered much if he didn’t say such things. However, hearing those words, Chen Mu grew even more bitter. However, he could only hide it deep in his heart, without revealing a hint of it in his interactions with Wen Huai and Fang Jing along the journey. In truth, his heart was filled with hatred towards Wang Baole. Just like that, the cruiser they were in traveled at high speed for another hour, before eventually reaching Divine Armament New City.
Obviously, Wang Baole didn’t receive them, and Li Wan’er went in his place instead. After the trio arrived in Divine Armament New City, they paid a visit to Kong Dao and Jin Duoming.
