Amidst the loud boom, it seemed as though a hurricane was being produced around Zhou Chudao. The hurricane swept in all directions, producing crazy winds in the surroundings. Looking from a distance, as the winds howled, the hurricane seemed to have transformed into a vortex with Zhou Chudao as the center.
As the vortex turned, the aura from Zhou Chudao grew increasingly stronger. In the blink of an eye, it had already spread in all directions. Numerous cultivators standing near him appeared in shock and retreated quickly. It was then that the voice of Zhou Chudao, who was in the center of the hurricane on the mountain peak, reverberated.
“Junior Brothers, please do not come within ten thousand feet of this area. If you wish to watch the battle, do it from a distance!”
At the same time, Zhao Yameng and Kong Dao had arrived in the air. As they neared, they could already hear Wang Baole’s chilly and stern voice reverberating.
“Yameng, lay the array formation. Kong Dao, guard the area. The battle between Fellow Daoist Zhou Chudao and I should not be interrupted by busybodies!”
Zhao Yameng nodded and immediately took out the compass to lay array formations around the mountain peak. There was only one use for the array formations, and that was to block anyone from going near. There may have been people who were hiding within the array formation, and Wang Baole seemed to acknowledge that, but he didn’t say anything. Therefore, Zhao Yameng only took a glance and didn’t bother with it anymore.
Soon, the array formations were completely put in place, and Kong Dao guarded the surroundings vigilantly. Wang Baole didn’t attack immediately and instead waited until the aura from Zhou Chudao had grown increasingly stronger, causing the vortex to be transformed into a typhoon that could tear the space apart. That was when Wang Baole suddenly spoke.
“Fellow Daoist Zhou, there is no time to lose. Let’s... begin!” Wang Baole looked at Zhou Chudao, and when their eyes met, their gazes seemed to have been transformed into extremely sharp swords that showed their intent to battle!
In the next instant, Zhou Chudao moved, descending the mountain peak while bringing the winds that were sweeping in all directions with him. He was like a Heavenly Venerate as he neared Wang Baole, his aura so strong that it could be felt even before he neared Wang Baole. His strong aura resulted in loud bangs being produced, and carried a force that seemed to be able to wither and decimate everything in his path the moment it was released!
“Wang Baole, you aren’t my opponent!” Zhou Chudao’s voice was like Heavenly Thunder. When it was heard, it was as if an invisible hand or a crashing wave was being brought along, pressuring Wang Baole!
The scene shook Zhao Yameng and Kong Dao. The spectators in hiding also quickened their breathing. Even the Dao Palace cultivators on the public square outside, who had focused all their attention on the individual battles involving Wang Baole and Dugu Lin, were gripped with shock when they noticed the aura given off by Zhou Chudao.
While everyone was immersed in shock, Wang Baole laughed and stepped out. He was someone who had come to battle, not someone who had come to be challenged, and there was no way he could lose out in terms of aura. Therefore, when his foot landed, an extremely strong desire to battle was similarly emanated from Wang Baole!
As the desire to battle was unleashed, Wang Baole had already clenched his right fist. The force from his physical body, the Lightning Core, as well as the Dark Core, were all released and combined together. That, integrated with Wang Baole’s desire for battle, resonating his will and cultivation at that very moment!
What that resonance meant was that, in this state, Wang Baole could exhibit a force that was beyond his capabilities depending on the degree of resonance!
If Zhou Chudao’s aura were described as crashing waves, then right now, Wang Baole would be like an indestructible reef that remained undamaged in the face of the turbulent waves!
It was perhaps still inappropriate to describe Wang Baole as the reef. That was because right now, as Wang Baole unleashed his aura and his foot landed, his right fist punched the powerful Zhou Chudao who was fast approaching in mid-air!
Supernova!
Ten percent boost from the resonance!
Everything happened in an instant. In the blink of an eye, the duo made contact with each other. It was a battle between their auras and a clash of their consciousness. Loud booms reverberated in all directions, and at that moment, the waves produced from the impact exploded between the duo, creating a force that swept in all directions. Noticing it, Wang Baole laughed.
“Zhou Chudao, I can defeat you with five punches. That was the first punch, and now... the second punch!” As Wang Baole spoke, the desire to fight in his eyes grew even more frightening. That was especially so as his desire to fight was complemented by his long flowing hair and the viciousness in his eyes. It made someone feel that he was indescribably overbearing and that his aura was extremely overwhelming. That was especially so as he dared to battle Zhou Chudao as if he were an equal, without bowing down to him!
The moment Wang Baole’s voice was heard, he moved, charging forward at high speed. He was like a shooting star as he dashed towards Zhou Chudao with an extremely strong aura. He grew faster and faster, as if he could pass through the emptiness and set off a series of sonic booms. When he neared in an instant, he punched, and the impact caused the heavens and winds to transform!
Thirty percent boost from the resonance!
“How interesting that you’re announcing your battle plans! If you manage to fulfill it, it means that you can showcase how formidable you are, with me as an example. Then, let’s see whether you can really make use of me to show how capable you are, or... if you will fail!”
A glow flashed across Zhou Chudao’s eyes. At that moment, there was no look of disdain in his eyes at all. Instead, as his aura emanated from his body, an indescribable sense of sharpness could be felt. That was also what made Dugu Lin value him.
As he spoke, Zhou Chudao raised his right hand before sealing it and pointing his finger. Instantly, a purple ball of fire was produced from his finger, transforming immediately from a flame to a sea of fire that enveloped him. As Wang Baole’s punch landed, the sea of fire enveloping Zhou Chudao was turned into the skull of a giant fire beast!
The fire beast was like a kirin mentioned in the ancient myths of the Federation. It charged towards Wang Baole at high speed, and amidst the loud boom, it made contact with Wang Baole’s second punch.
Loud bangs could be heard in all directions. Wang Baole trembled, and the Blood Qi in his body churned. At the same time, the kirin skull formed from the sea of fire broke apart, revealing Zhou Chudao, who now had the same desire to fight in his eyes. He had his hands sealed, and his internal Blood Qi was similarly churning!
“Void Awl!” A glow flashed across Zhou Chudao’s eyes as he waved his hands. Instantly, nine cracks appeared in Wang Baole’s surroundings, transforming into nine purple-colored awls that piercingly charged towards Wang Baole!
Each of those nine awls released a combat force that was similar to a cultivator who was in late-stage Core Formation realm. The collective force of the nine awls was so powerful that it was capable of suppressing any late-stage Core Formation realm cultivator, and even someone who had perfected the Core Formation realm would be taken aback!
After unleashing the Void Awl, Zhou Chudao didn’t stop. Instead, he neared Wang Baole instantly, and with a glow of fire being given off his finger, he pointed at Wang Baole’s forehead!
Wang Baole felt its force but didn’t retreat. He didn’t even unleash Thearch Armor, as like Zhou Chudao had said, not only did he need to eliminate Zhou Chudao, he also needed to use this battle to hone himself!
As he waved his right hand, Wang Baole took out a ribbon from his storage bracelet, wrapping it around him to block the nine awls. Wang Baole’s thunderous voice could be heard as he gripped his right fist and moved his body forward!
“Fellow Daoist Zhou, this is... the third punch!”

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - Whetstone
chapters.content:
Chapter 568: Whetstone
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Seventy percent boost from the resonance!
The moment Wang Baole spoke, the two neared each other. As the fist and the finger landed, and as their cultivation was instantly unleashed, a combined force that was so powerful that it seemed to be able to destroy everything was released from both of them!
Amidst the boom, blood flowed out from the corner of Zhou Chudao’s mouth as he retreated. Similarly, blood flowed out of the corner of Wang Baole’s mouth. However, the glow from Wang Baole’s eyes was even brighter right now. He stepped forward while laughing heartily as he attacked Zhou Chudao once again!
A loud boom was produced when the duo made contact, and Zhou Chudao retreated from the impact. Wang Baole seemed unrestrained and aloof. As a contender and a challenger, his aura grew even stronger as he unleashed his cultivation once again and neared Zhou Chudao in an instant.
“Now, this is the fourth punch!” Wang Baole’s voice was like Heavenly Thunder. At this moment, complemented by his aura, he seemed unbeatable. Zhou Chudao’s breathing uncontrollably quickened, and he had a strong gut feeling that if Wang Baole were allowed to continually boost his aura without restraint, his fifth and last punch would be incredibly astonishing and earth-shaking!
This cannot continue!
The fighting spirit in Zhou Chudao’s eyes didn’t diminish, and instead burned even more strongly. As Wang Baole neared him at high speed, he retreated while raising his right hand and sealing it. Instantly, moonlight emerged from his chest. It was extremely brilliant, and as Zhou Chudao sealed his hands, the moonlight was turned into an image of the moon in front of him!
Even though the moon was bright, it didn’t carry a sense of pureness. Instead, it seemed extremely bizarre, and evil murmurs that could make people and spirits tremble with fear could be heard from it.
It made one feel that those murmurs were extremely evil curses!
“Cursed Moon!” Zhou Chudao bellowed as he pointed with his sealed right hand at Wang Baole. The moment his finger landed, Wang Baole was shocked, and a strong sense of crisis exploded in his heart. He didn’t have time to think too much, and he turned his body at a weird angle while it was still moving at high speed.
However, as a personal disciple of the Vast Expanse Dao Palace who was valued by Dugu Lin, Zhou Chudao’s ferocity had far exceeded that of ordinary Core Formation realm cultivators. Even the Nascent Soul realm cultivators would likely not stand a chance against him.
As Zhou Chudao’s voice reverberated, and as his finger landed, it was evident that it was still too late for Wang Baole to dodge the impact. Instantly, moonlight appeared around Wang Baole’s body. With crisis looming, an undetectable flash appeared across Wang Baole’s eyes, and overlapping figures of his body also seemed to have appeared. However, everything had happened too quickly. As the moonlight gathered at high speed, the image of the moon, which was just in front of Zhou Chudao the previous moment, enveloped Wang Baole. At that moment, Wang Baole seemed to have transformed into the moon!
The moment the moon enveloped Wang Baole, feelings of weakness, sleepiness, and fatigue overwhelmed him. Wang Baole’s breathing quickened, and his body trembled. His eyelids grew so heavy that he almost couldn’t keep them open, and he was about to fall into a slumber. The fatigue from his body spread from within him like the tides, and the feeling of weakness he felt seemed to have turned him from a cultivator to a commoner!
His mood and emotions were also all being affected. Despair, sadness, thoughts of suicide, as well as all the different negative emotions, were being strongly experienced by him at that moment!
Even his cultivation seemed to be affected. Put more accurately, it wasn’t his cultivation, but his ability to control it, that was affected. He was previously able to control his cultivation perfectly, but due to all the negative effects that he was experiencing, his power of control was weakened by fifty percent!
That was one of Zhou Chudao’s trump cards, the Cursed Moon!
If it were someone else and not Wang Baole, Zhou Chudao would have neared immediately and killed his opponent without wasting too much of his cultivation or his Dharmic treasures. However, his opponent was Wang Baole. Even though he didn’t understand him deeply, having gone through this short battle, Zhou Chudao had already elevated Wang Baole’s position, placing him as an equal opponent like Dugu Lin was!
In the face of such a strong opponent, Zhou Chudao couldn’t afford to be careless. Therefore, a chilly flash appeared in Zhou Chudao’s eyes. Even though Wang Baole was affected by the Cursed Moon, Zhou Chudao didn’t go near him. Instead, he retrieved a wooden figurine from his storage bag!
The wooden figurine was black in color. The moment it was taken out, a chilly aura was released from it. It was the figure of a ferocious hound which carried an evil glow in its eyes. When the wooden figurine was taken out, the ferocious hound bit its own tongue, and a mouthful of blood was spat from the figurine. Instantly, a large amount of Black Qi was produced from the wooden figurine.
A ferocious roar that shook the heavens and earth also reverberated. The wooden figurine seemed to have come to life, transforming into a hundred-foot-tall, black-colored ferocious hound!
The ferocious hound’s teeth were extremely sharp, and its eyes carried a look of madness and greed. As it roared, it charged towards Wang Baole, wanting to swallow him!
It was like... a hound swallowing the moon during a lunar eclipse!
“This is the end. It’s a pity that you didn’t manage to show how formidable you are in the end!” Zhou Chudao narrowed his eyes and spoke slowly. The ferocious hound had already neared Wang Baole with its mouth opened wide in an exaggerated manner. It was about to swallow both Wang Baole and the image of the moon surrounding him!
The onlookers around them, as well as the cultivators outside the trial grounds, were all deeply shaken. That was especially so for the Federation Seedlings, who were all extremely anxious!
That was when... something unexpected occurred!
A voice that carried a sense of regret was heard from Wang Baole, who was enveloped by the moon.
“It’s indeed a pity that you didn’t come near...”
When that voice emerged, a hand that was formed from lightning was extended from the Cursed Moon. It was so fast that it landed on the ferocious hound’s teeth in an instant!
As it landed, thunder was instantly produced. Explosive waves spread in all directions, and as the noise reverberated, an extremely powerful force emerged from within the Cursed Moon. Not only did it devastate the Cursed Moon, but it also landed on the ferocious hound. In the blink of an eye, the Cursed Moon was destroyed, and the ferocious hound retreated while screaming painfully. Zhou Chudao was gripped with shock, and at that moment, Wang Baole emerged from the devastated Cursed Moon. His speed had increased significantly from before. He neared Zhou Chudao at the speed of lightning and punched forward!
That was the fourth punch!
One hundred percent boost from the resonance!
The punch clearly harnessed an even stronger force from the resonance. It was like the crashing waves during a hurricane, with each subsequent wave being stronger than the previous. To a certain extent, the lethality of that punch was twice that of Wang Baole’s own combat power!
That was because the effect of the resonance allowed Wang Baole’s cultivation and spirit energy to break through their respective limits. As his fist landed, even Zhou Chudao couldn’t avoid it and could only try to resist it with all his might. As the loud boom reverberated, Zhou Chudao spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, and the protective Dharmic treasures covering him were destroyed. His chest caved in while blood spurted endlessly from it. As he retreated, a look of indignation could be seen in his eyes!
“Lightning Avatar!”
“You’re right!” Wang Baole created a lightning avatar during the crucial juncture previously. Both the Cursed Moon and the ferocious hound had targeted Wang Baole’s avatar, and as his avatar self-exploded, which resolved the crisis, Wang Baole’s true self emerged and landed the fourth punch.
If Zhou Chudao hadn’t been vigilant and chose to go near Wang Baole, this battle would perhaps have already ended!
Right now, as the duo conversed, Wang Baole turned and charged towards Zhou Chudao. He was so ferocious and formidable that if one were to look at everything from afar, Zhou Chudao seemed to be on the brink of being completely suppressed!
“Next up, the last punch!” Wang Baole’s desire for battle was extremely strong at this moment. He was about to go near when, at that moment, Zhou Chudao screamed. His retreating body suddenly stopped moving, and his eyes grew bloodshot. A sense of resonance suddenly emerged from Zhou Chudao’s body!
“You will not be able to unleash your last punch!” As Zhou Chudao spoke, he raised his hands and sealed them. Green veins bulged from his forehead, and his cultivation vibrated heavily!
“Nine Generations...”
“False Killing!”
When Zhou Chudao spoke, illusory figures appeared from Zhou Chudao’s body. Each of the illusory figures was an image of him. Together with his true body, it looked as if the reincarnations from nine generations had appeared together. When he sealed his hands, so did the illusory figures. Frightening auras that could freeze the spectators in fear emerged from Zhou Chudao’s body at that moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - Domineering!
chapters.content:
Chapter 569: Domineering!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The reincarnation of the Nine Generations clearly shared the same origins as the mystic technique of the Federation’s Five Generation Sky Clan!
The difference lay in that the Five Generation Sky Clan could only call upon reincarnations from five generations, while Zhou Chudao could call upon reincarnations from nine generations. Right now, as the illusory images appeared behind him as he sealed his hands, nine awls appeared between him and Wang Baole!
At the same time, those illusory figures also sealed their hands, causing the number of awls existing between the duo to grow instantly from nine to eighty-one!
The moment the eighty-one awls appeared, they caused such a strong wave of impact that it shook the entire area, causing the night sky map over the region to warp. Turbulent winds were also triggered, and even the mountain peak beneath them was vibrating vigorously. Large amounts of rock fragments were tumbling down as if the mountain was about to collapse.
The ground seemed to be unable to withstand the impact as well. Cracks were seen in the ground, and, coupled with the turbulence of the mountain, it seemed as if the entire area was crumbling!
At this moment, Zhou Chudao’s eyes were bloodshot. He roared and raised his hands, and the illusory figures behind him followed suit. They seemed to be moving the eighty-one awls, pressing on them and directing them towards Wang Baole!
“Imprison him!” Zhou Chudao exclaimed loudly. The illusory figures behind him all carried a frightening expression on their faces at the same time. They opened their mouths and screamed in unison, resulting in the formation of a sonic wave that exploded instantly. An astonishing aura was also emanated from the eighty-one awls as they criss-crossed in mid-air, forming a giant cage that charged towards Wang Baole while carrying a suppressing force!
The killing intent carried by the eighty-one awls, as well as the imposing threat they had on Wang Baole, were combined together, such that he wasn’t able to throw out his fifth punch!
It wasn’t that he was unable to release the fifth punch. Instead, the shock that he felt from the imposing manner of the awls made him lose confidence in the ability of his punch to lead him to victory!
In addition, as the cage formed by the eighty-one awls neared Wang Baole, an indescribable suppressive force that seemed impossible to fight against exploded like a tsunami. It contained an extremely high pressure as if it could decimate him!
With crisis looming, a chilly glow flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes. He didn’t wish to dodge, nor did he wish to activate Thearch Armor so soon. He narrowed his eyes and raised his right hand, and three one-use eighth-grade Dharmic Armaments flew out from his storage bracelet, surrounding him!
The three Dharmic treasures, which were each in the form of a clock, looked identical. Once they were taken out, they began to grow larger in size, each bigger than the other as if they were building on top of each other. They enveloped Wang Baole. Looking at it from a distance, the three Dharmic treasures seemed to have formed a protective covering so sturdy that they appeared like the mountainous rocks that even a tsunami couldn’t destroy. Suppressive forces emanated from the Dharmic treasures as they took on the impact of the eighty-one awls head on!
It all took place in an instant. In the blink of an eye, the eighty-one awls neared and made contact with Wang Baole’s one-use eighth-grade Dharmic Armaments!
“You can block it!” Zhou Chudao bellowed as he stepped forward. However, just as he said that and his foot landed on the ground, Wang Baole’s voice reverberated.
“It is not part of my Dao to use blocking as a strategy!” The desire for combat could be seen in the eyes of Wang Baole, who was within the protection of the clocks. As he spoke, he pushed his hands towards both sides of the protection and roared with a deep voice.
“Explode!”
The moment his voice was heard, the clock on the outermost layer vibrated and exploded in an instant. A powerful force churned and spread in all directions, forming an invisible hand that charged towards the incoming tsunami-like awl!
That wasn’t the end!
The fighting spirit in Wang Baole’s eyes grew even stronger. His voice was heard again, and this time, he ordered for two explosions. The second, as well as the last clock exploded almost at the same instant, creating an impact that added on to the previous one that was produced. That caused the invisible hand to swell, and it slapped the awls hard!
It was as if it wanted to open up a pathway within the cage formed by the awls!
In this battle with Zhou Chudao, the spells, as well as the thought and flexibility that both sides adopted in their battle techniques, were on the level of someone who was at the peak of the Core Formation realm. To a certain extent, the battle between them could be used as a case study. If their opponents weren’t each other and were instead any of the bystanders, that opponent would have long been defeated, unless they were as savage of either of them.
However, that was still a hypothetical scenario. Wang Baole had a strong desire for combat, and that was the case for Zhou Chudao as well. He seemed to have predicted Wang Baole’s tactics, as he sealed his hands and pointed just as the three clocks self-exploded and the invisible hand was carrying out the slap!
Instantly, the awls gathered together, transforming the cage formed by the eighty-one awls into an awl shield!
The shield took on the impact from the self-explosion of the three clocks head-on. When contact was made, a force that was several times more powerful instantly reverberated. Zhou Chudao’s breathing became disorderly, and his hair was disheveled. Blood spewed out of his mouth as he let out a battle cry!
“Wang Baole, you’ve taken the bait... Nine Generations... Anti-Shock!” As Zhou Chudao’s voice was heard, an astonishing anti-shock force was released from the awl shield. That large force, which resulted from the destruction of half the number of awls, combined with the explosive force of the three clocks, and it landed directly to propel Wang Baole away!
That was an extremely unexpected turn of events. Wang Baole’s body trembled, and blood spewed from his mouth. His body, which was in mid-air, suddenly tumbled backwards, and even though he clenched his right fist, he seemed to have lost the strength to flail it. As blood spurted out of his mouth continuously, a sense of fragility and weakness could be seen from Wang Baole.
At the same time, an indescribably powerful impact formed visible waves that spread in all directions. Wherever the waves passed, the mountains crumbled and the ground cracked. Even the array formation set up by Zhao Yameng was destroyed at that instant. It was as if a strong gust of wind had blown off all the fallen leaves!
Zhao Yameng and Kong Dao were extremely taken aback. In their anxiety, their bodies were also forced to retreat by the impact, without their control. The cultivators who were previously hiding in the area had blood spurting out of their mouths as they escaped to distance themselves from the area. Those people were the participants hidden on the map who had lost their keys. As they escaped with fear, there were three of them who looked frightened on the surface but carried a look of greed deep in their eyes.
If it were some other time, they might not have harbored such malicious thoughts. However, right now, Wang Baole was visibly and severely injured. The three keyless participants didn’t think too much as they leaped into the air, activating their cultivation. One of them was in the late-stage Core Formation realm, while the other two were at the peak of the mid-stage Core Formation realm. They dashed right towards Wang Baole, who was now retreating with blood in his mouth!
They wanted to kill Wang Baole and snatch his keys!
Zhou Chudao frowned slightly, but as a glow flashed across his eyes, he gave up the thought of going after the three keyless participants. If such an elite from the Federation died in his hands, it would be disadvantageous for him in the future.
Of course, if the trio hadn’t made the ambush, Zhou Chudao would still have attacked Wang Baole one last time. He wouldn’t have killed him, but he would definitely have taken away his keys.
However, just as Zhou Chudao gave up his intention to pursue, and as the three greedy Dao Palace disciples were about to launch their attacks, a chilly voice that carried a sense of regret was heard from Wang Baole, who seemed to have been severely injured and lost all ability for combat.
“D*rn it, the three of you really deserve to die!”
The moment those words were heard, the sense of weakness that was emanating from Wang Baole vanished instantly. Right now, the resonance of the fifth punch spread on Wang Baole’s clenched fist. That stunned Zhou Chudao, and his heart was gripped with shock!
It was only now that he realized that Wang Baole didn’t suffer from injuries as severe as he had thought. Rather, it could also be said that Wang Baole’s physique was peculiar and could recover extremely quickly. Regardless, if not for the idiotic trio, had Zhou Chudao neared Wang Baole, he would have come face to face with Wang Baole’s fifth punch, which he had secretly been preparing until now!
Without a doubt, that would be the case!
Therefore, right now, Wang Baole’s anger and regret could be clearly felt. The waves of resonance on his fist dissipated, and just as the three Dao Palace disciples retreated in shock, Wang Baole, with a chill in his eyes, pointed his right finger at each of the trio’s foreheads!
Flame Snatch!
A scream that sounded so painful that it didn’t seem human was heard from the trio. Their bodies could be seen withering visibly, while their energy and life seemed to have been stripped at that instant. They were turned into dried corpses that landed heavily on the ground. That was when Wang Baole turned around with a solemn expression on his face to look at the surprised Zhou Chudao.
“Even though I didn’t physically unleash the fifth punch, in my mind, I have already successfully executed it and have already defeated you!”
“Therefore... The teleportation is about to begin, and this battle... should end now!” As Wang Baole spoke, Zhou Chudao suddenly felt a strong sense of crisis. He reacted quickly, sealing his hands and controlling the awl shield to move towards Wang Baole. However, Wang Baole suddenly raised his right hand!
A blood-colored meridian emerged beneath the skin on Wang Baole’s right hand and spread throughout his body!
It was extremely sinister and overbearing!
It was... the Flame Snatch Thearch Armor!

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - Observing From Above!
chapters.content:
Chapter 570: Observing From Above!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The battle between Wang Baole and Zhou Chudao sent shock waves in all directions. All the spectators were gripped with surprise and shock, especially as they watched Zhou Chudao demonstrate his ability to anticipate Wang Baole’s moves, and as they watched Wang Baole using a series of lures as he attacked.
That was especially so for the last moment where the three ambushers suffered a pitiful death. Regardless of whether it was the way or the speed of their miserable deaths, it implied that Wang Baole’s abilities were at a level similar to the peak of the Core Formation realm, and was sufficiently powerful to suppress others on the same level as him!
What was most important was that Wang Baole was still a mid-stage Core Formation realm cultivator!
What happened scared everyone, preventing them from going near. No one had any intention to attack sneakily, and all the Dao Palace disciples who were watching the battle couldn’t help but sweep their gazes at the Federation Seedlings in the public square.
After this battle, no one would dare to say that there were no elites in the Federation anymore!
That made all the Federation Seedlings in the public square extremely emotional. After all, since their arrival on the ancient greenish-bronze sword and the Vast Expanse Dao Palace, they had lived like second-class citizens.
The Dao Palace disciples’ disdain towards them, as well as the scornful and cold attitude that they had experienced throughout the past year, resulted in pent-up frustration in their hearts. They were cautious in whatever they did, and some of them had even wavered and thought about getting into the good books of the Dao Palace disciples.
However, at the current moment, all those thoughts had vanished, replaced by a sense of pride and agitation. Through Wang Baole’s hard work, all the Federation Seedlings had proven their worth!
Even though it seemed like Wang Baole was the only elite, at the very least, they were no longer nobodies in the Dao Palace and were able to have a presence!
Many people understood that principle. Therefore, the Dao Palace disciples, who were experiencing a myriad of emotions, were much less scornful towards the Federation Seedlings. That was seen in both their gazes and attitudes. They had become more solemn, and that was especially so when they watched Wang Baole on the screen. From their eyes, a look of respect and awe towards Wang Baole could be seen.
However, in their hearts, they were still somewhat unable to accept the fact that Wang Baole and the Federation were more powerful than they had thought. Thankfully, before the first teleportation, Wang Baole wasn’t the only one who had performed spectacularly, as there was also Dugu Lin who fought well!
The battle between Dugu Lin and Xu Ming was similarly earth-shaking, sending shock waves in all directions. That filled all the Dao Palace disciples in the public square with excitement. As the duo were both Dao Palace disciples as well, the exhilaration that the Dao Palace disciples felt was multiplied, and could somewhat alleviate the emotional discomfort that they felt due to Wang Baole!
Dugu Lin was indeed formidable. Even though Xu Ming was also a personal disciple and could beat many other Core Formation realm cultivators, he still lacked compared to Dugu Lin!
Right now, the battle between Du Guilin and Xu Ming was held on a plain. Numerous cracks had appeared on the ground, and Xu Ming’s screams had become the theme song of the area. His body was blown into the air before crashing onto the ground again and again, and this would be repeated every time he picked himself up from the ground!
Dugu Lin, who was standing expressionlessly in mid-air and hadn’t spoken much since the beginning, was like an inescapable fate for Xu Ming. No matter how hard Xu Ming tried—regardless of whether he had self-exploded his Dharmic treasures, unleashed his trump cards, or even boosted his attacks with mystic techniques—it had all been useless!
All those efforts were simply negated by a single punch from Du Guilin, and that was the case from start to finish!
It was, without a doubt, a complete suppression of Xu Ming. From the beginning until the present, Xu Ming had bled profusely, and his hair was a mess. The hopelessness and indignation in his heart had been transformed into a form of torture that drove him crazy.
“Dugu Lin! Your opponent... is me!” After being thrown towards the ground from mid-air yet again, Xu Ming vomited a clot of blood. When he struggled to stand up, blood flowed from his forehead into his eye, turning his world blood-colored. He looked even more frightening, but his voice didn’t carry a sense of madness, only bitterness and struggles.
That was because... from the second punch onwards, the quiet Dugu Lin no longer focused his attention on Xu Ming. Instead, he had raised his head, focusing on the night sky map, and specifically on the location where the battle between Wang Baole and Zhou Chudao was taking place.
Even though Dugu Lin couldn’t see the actual battle, a look of desire and anticipation had appeared in his eyes. As such, to him, Xu Ming was merely...
A nobody!
Dugu Lin’s disregard towards him was what made Xu Ming feel most bitter. He was also a personal disciple, and before this, he was filled with confidence about himself. However, it was only after this battle that he realized that compared to Dugu Lin, he was nothing.
That sense of powerlessness made Xu Ming bitter, but he was still indignant. Therefore, as he quickened his breathing, a burning desire for battle was rekindled in his eyes. He was about to attack once again, as he wanted to battle despite the possibility of failure!
However, at that moment, Dugu Lin suddenly spoke.
“You are... too weak.”
“You will definitely die under my next punch, and I am too lazy to kill you. So... hand your keys over.” Dugu Lin retracted his gaze from the night sky map and lowered his head to look as Xu Ming, speaking calmly. There was no change to his facial expression, it was still cold and distant.
However, as that gaze and those words landed in Xu Ming’s eyes and ears, he suddenly trembled. His intuition told him that what Dugu Lin said was true!
If he continued to attack, then the moment he flew into the air beside Du Guilin would be the moment he would truly be defeated...
Should he battle or not?
Amidst the silence, Xu Ming felt increasingly bitter and hopeless. The desire to battle in his eyes slowly dissipated. He realized that if he dashed out and survived, he would definitely be transformed, but ultimately, he didn’t want to die.
As he laughed bitterly, Xu Ming tossed out over twenty keys. As that happened, he seemed to have lost all energy and couldn’t support his body any longer, and he landed on the ground. He was looking towards the sky, not at Dugu Lin but at the other battleground in the night sky map.
“Is that Wang Baole...?” Xu Ming murmured. Dugu Lin retracted his gaze. This time, he wasn’t looking at the night sky map but in the south-eastern direction where Wang Baole and Zhou Chudao were battling.
In the south-eastern direction, as Xu Ming was defeated and lost all his desire to fight, the battle between Wang Baole and Zhou Chudao had also reached its final moments. Zhou Chudao was shocked, but he had been able to swiftly control the awl shield. He also saw that blood-colored meridians had appeared on Wang Baole’s raised right hand.
As the meridians spread, and as more blood-colored meridians appeared on other parts of Wang Baole’s body, a large human-shaped outline appeared around Wang Baole’s body in the blink of an eye!
The aura was extremely strong and sinister, and it was also presented in an overbearing manner. As Wang Baole’s aura was unleashed and complemented with the resonance from his body, he seemed to have become a divine being!
“This is the end!” As he spoke calmly, Wang Baole’s emotions were clearly affected. His cold and distant voice carried a hint of ruthlessness. He moved his body, and between steps, he unleashed a punch!
That punch had exceeded the limits of the Core Formation realm. It was directed towards the air. Immediately, cracks appeared, and a force that could create chaos in the sky, as well as winds, erupted from it!
Looking from a distance, Wang Baole’s body seemed like a blood-colored hurricane. As lightning and thunder interlaced, it seemed as if demons were dancing, sweeping across the skies towards Zhou Chudao!
That was the real fifth punch!
Two hundred percent boost from the resonance!
The first stage of the Flame Snatch Thearch Armor was unleashed at three times the force!
As the loud boom reverberated, the blood-colored hurricane landed directly on the awl shield, which as controlled by the screaming Zhou Chudao. When contact was made, the awl shield shook violently and began to crack apart loudly. In the blink of an eye, under the force of the blood-colored hurricane, the awl shield was completely devastated!
Without stopping, the blood-colored hurricane continued to send shock waves in all directions, and it arrived in front of Zhou Chudao almost immediately. At this critical juncture, blood spewed from Zhou Chudao’s mouth as he took out several protective Dharmic treasures, putting in his utmost effort to resist the force.
However, those Dharmic treasures were extremely weak in the face of the blood-colored hurricane. They were blown apart and turned to ash as the blood-colored hurricane swept through the clouds. Seeing that the hurricane was nearing him, Zhou Chudao was turned into a maniac as he flailed his arms in a final attempt at resistance. He controlled all of his illusory figures to pass through his body in an attempt to block the force!
However, it was all futile!
As the loud boom was heard, his illusory figures made contact with the blood-colored hurricane and were instantly devastated. It was then that the blood-colored hurricane stopped advancing, arriving an inch from Zhou Chudao, who had lost all hope.
The hurricane dissipated and was transformed into Wang Baole’s Thearch Armor fist!
As Zhou Chudao’s hair was blown, he looked at the powerful fist in front of him, which carried a sense of madness. He felt bitterness in his heart as Wang Baole’s cold and distant voice arrived by his ears.
“You have lost.”
Zhou Chudao shut his eyes, and as the bitterness in his heart grew, he suddenly sighed. When he opened his eyes, he looked extremely indignant. He put on the aura of an old peasant before tossing his keys to the side. He stood up and began staggering into the distance while sighing.
“I shouldn’t have let the elderly ladies leave... Why did I find trouble...”
Without looking at the keys that Zhou Chudao had tossed out, Wang Baole stood there. He seemed to have felt something as he raised his head to look towards the north-west direction. That was... where Dugu Lin was on the night sky map!
As Wang Baole looked in that direction, Dugu Lin was also looking in his direction. As the distance between them was great, they couldn’t physically see each other. However, that didn’t affect their desire to battle each other and didn’t influence their decision to look in each other’s direction!
All this was seen by the disciples in the public square. In their eyes, the scene of Wang Baole and Dugu Lin looking in each other’s direction on different screens cast such a strong impression that it seemed to have been transformed into a deep memory that couldn’t dissipate.
The entire public square was silent until someone let out a soft murmur.
“Elites indeed!”

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - No One Asks About It!
chapters.content:
Chapter 571: No One Asks About It!
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
They were on the trial grounds. As Wang Baole and Dugu Lin looked at each other, there were also people around them who had lost. However, compared to Zhou Chudao’s carefree back view as he left, Xu Ming, who was lying in the basin, was feeling a sense of bitterness and was laughing at himself for not daring to take on another battle.
Right now, it was also time for the teleportation to begin!
The loud boom arrived from all directions in the trial grounds, initially soft but quickly becoming as deafening as thunder. It was as if a humongous giant was screaming at the trial grounds.
The map in the night sky warped for the first time. The ground trembled, and the mountains shook!
The booms grew increasingly louder as if the heavens and earth were about to flip. The force of teleportation appeared from nothingness, and it was unleashed fully in the trial grounds in the short time of a few breaths!
That was the first teleportation, and it would take away a key from everyone. Those who didn’t hold any keys would be eliminated!
At that moment, the originally calm trial grounds were thrown into chaos. Numerous keyless participants who had lost their keys suddenly rose up, charging forward with all their effort towards those who possessed keys near them!
Even though some of them succeeded, most of them failed. As the glow from the teleportation shimmered between the heavens and earth, keys disappeared one after another, and the elimination took place.
It was as if there was a hurricane that only those who possessed keys could stand firmly against. Those without keys would be wiped of all the meaning they ever held in the trial grounds by the hurricane.
It was the case for both Xu Ming and Zhou Chudao. Wang Baole witnessed one of his keys being taken away in this wave of teleportation. Zhou Chudao, with his back facing Wang Baole a distance away, grew gradually blurry as if he was walking into nothingness. The moment before he completely disappeared, Zhou Chudao raised his right hand with his back facing Wang Baole, as if bidding him farewell.
He only managed to wave thrice before he disappeared entirely without a trace.
The teleportation came and went quickly. The entire process only took the time of a few breaths. When the heavens and earth returned to a state of calm, the teleportation ended. The warped map in the night sky became clear once again, but the number of keys on it had significantly decreased!
Looking at the map in the night sky, Wang Baole took a deep breath, and Zhao Yameng’s voice arrived by his ears.
“Every time the teleportation happens, it will wipe everything out, eliminating those keyless participants. At the same time, new keyless participants will appear. In addition, this is the only time every day where the tracks of the keyless participants would be exposed!”
“This is because, at every single location on the map where there is a key, there is bound to be a new keyless participant who appears there!” As Zhao Yameng spoke, she raised and waved her right hand. Instantly, the compass in her hand shone with a gentle glow, gathering before her and forming a map!
“I have indicated all the locations where a key was taken away previously. These positions right here are the locations of the keyless participants. According to this, we can estimate the coordinates of the keyless participant!” Zhao Yameng said while pointing her left hand at the compass. Immediately, numerous locations glowed on the map formed by light ray.
These glowing spots were the coordinates of the keyless participants present on the trial grounds, according to Zhao Yameng’s estimations. Right now, there were three such spots around them!
“How should we handle this?” Zhao Yameng looked towards Wang Baole, apparently asking what they should do with the keyless participants located at the three points near them.
“We don’t have to care about them... Hmm?” As Wang Baole spoke, he seemed to have noticed something. After taking a look at one of the spots, he raised and waved his right hand. Immediately, the tri-colored flying sword emerged, charging towards the other two positions.
As the tri-colored flying sword flew through the nothingness, cultivators leaped up from the two locations. The two cultivators escaped hurriedly without even turning around. However, their speed was no match for the flying sword. After a brief moment, painful screams emerged as the two of them tumbled to the ground one after another.
Wang Baole didn’t kill them, instead simply making them lose the ability to run far for the coming day, restricting them to this region.
The tri-colored flying sword returned after that. Wang Baole walked towards the location where the third glowing spot was at. When he neared, something wriggled within it, and a person emerged. The person didn’t run away. Instead, he sat there, laughing bitterly and incredulously while looking adrift at Wang Baole.
“Baole... You...”
Looking at the familiar face that was similar in size to him, a smile appeared on Wang Baole’s face.
“Senior Brother Yun Piaozi...”
That person was indeed Yun Piaozi. He had seen the battle between Wang Baole and Zhou Chudao. He was immensely shocked even now, as he couldn’t reconcile the image of Wang Baole in his mind with that before his eyes.
Wang Baole’s was so powerful that it completely exceeded his expectations. This made him feel somewhat distant towards Wang Baole.
“I have cleared all the keyless participants around here. Be careful after you leave this region.” Wang Baole had managed to understand what Yun Piaozi was thinking about, and also sensed the unfamiliarity that was revealed instinctively by him. Therefore, he only spoke after a moment of silence, and then he looked at Zhao Yameng.
Zhao Yameng understood Wang Baole’s intention. She took out a key and placed it before Yun Piaozi.
“Yun Piaozi, see you back at the sect. Bye.” Wang Baole cupped his fists at Yun Piaozi and then left with Zhao Yameng and Kong Dao, a smile on his face. As they left, Kong Dao looked curiously towards Yun Piaozi before turning back.
He naturally understood that Wang Baole didn’t have plans to deal with the two keyless participants initially and that he only did so because of Yun Piaozi.
It could be said that Wang Baole did so in order to give Yun Piaozi a key to ensure his safety. This made Kong Dao curious. After all, they were Federation disciples, and it was difficult for them to form a deep relationship with the Dao Palace disciples despite having shared some common experiences.
In reality, that was the truth. Even though Yun Piaozi was close to Wang Baole, it was mostly due to Wang Baole’s generosity, as well as the Spirit Boat gains. It was a one-sided relationship, and fundamentally, this relationship between them couldn’t weather major storms.
This made Yun Piaozi fall silent as he looked at the key before him. After a brief moment, he raised his head and looked at Wang Baole and company’s back view. He stood up silently and exclaimed loudly, “Baole!”
Wang Baole stopped his tracks in mid-air and turned to look at Yun Piaozi.
“Dugu Lin fought with Xu Ming previously. You... take care.”
Hearing that, Wang Baole thought about it briefly before waving his hand with a smile on his face, then, he turned to leave. When he disappeared before Yun Piaozi, Yun Piaozi lowered his head to look at the key, a tinge of respect appearing in his eyes.
His respect resulted not from the act of Wang Baole giving him a key. Instead, it was because he dealt with the two keyless participants for him specifically.
At the same time, he suddenly realized that the difference between him and Wang Baole wasn’t only their combat capabilities, but most importantly, their mindsets!
He doesn’t even care about the keys or the rules here. To him and the other personal disciples, these aren’t important. They didn’t need to follow the rules because they have their own rules!
That is... To eliminate all competitors other than themselves. It is enough that they are the ones remaining. Yun Piaozi looked at the key and managed to think through everything. When he raised his head, he sighed a long sigh of relief while laughing bitterly.
This bitter laugh was quickly replaced by a carefree attitude. He looked up, and instead of picking up the key, he turned and walked in another direction. He knew that it was meaningless to continue persevering in the trial grounds. What he needed was to find a place to meditate and leave when the second teleportation happened.
This isn’t a trial for ordinary people like us anymore. Yun Piaozi shook his head and walked further and further away. The key remained on the ground, shining brightly, but no one cared about it anymore.
In the air a distance away, Zhao Yameng was the first to realize what had happened amongst the trio. She looked at the night sky map, where the key stood unmoving. Even though she didn’t witness everything first hand, she had managed to guess what had happened. After thinking about it, she smiled and looked at Wang Baole.
“Baole, that friend of yours isn’t simple. He knows the appropriate time to part.”

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - Baole, Do You Understand?
chapters.content:
Chapter 572: Baole, Do You Understand?
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
As Wang Baole and company left the trial grounds where they battled Zhou Chudao previously, breathing sounds emerged from the momentarily silent Dao Palace public square. Even though discussions could be heard, most of the disciples remained silent.
If it were said that the battle they witnessed between Wang Baole and Zhou Chudao had begun on fair terms, then the armor formed by blood-colored meridians that appeared outside Wang Baole’s body towards the end was the factor that caused the entire situation to be turned around!
To a certain extent, it couldn’t be considered a one-dimensional combat force. The result was something that everyone was unable and unwilling to believe.
All the Federation Seedlings were silent, and torrents of emotions crashed in their hearts. They felt that Wang Baole’s powers were unreal.
Feng Qiuran was deeply surprised, and she felt a myriad of emotions in her heart. She stared at Wang Baole through the footage, thinking about how powerful Thearch Armor was on the one hand, and deeply shocked by Wang Baole’s rising on the other!
Before this, she didn’t have high hopes for Wang Baole and company. She even thought that unless a miracle happened, it was impossible for the trio to emerge in the top three with their own abilities.
However, right now, Feng Qiuran had to admit that she made the wrong judgment. She had also belittled her ally, the Federation!
They have sent such an elite to the Vast Expanse Dao Palace. I am nothing compared to the Federation’s generosity!
Feng Qiuran was focused. She thought to herself that if there were a talent like Wang Baole under her lead, she would definitely not send him out. After all, if anything untoward happened, the losses would be too great to handle.
To her, it wasn’t easy that the Federation could do that!
Mie Liezi also thought similarly. Right now, Mie Liezi was looking at Wang Baole through the footage silently. Daoist You Ran reacted the same way, but what was different was that in the depths of his eyes, a chilly glow and an intention to kill was hidden!
At the same time, as the first teleportation ended, there were only slightly over a hundred people remaining on the trial grounds. This was due to the intensity of the first day, which had resulted in a large number of keys being collected.
Most of those that remained were scattered all over the place. They were cautious and vigilant towards the possibility of being attacked by the keyless participants. Indeed, according to Zhao Yameng’s judgment, as the first day was so intense, the second day was comparatively calmer.
Even though fights and clashes still occurred occasionally, everyone knew that there were four people on the trial grounds that shouldn’t be provoked. Other than the three remaining personal disciples, the last one was the personal disciple from the Federation, Wang Baole!
‘Federation Personal Disciple’ was the respectful term that people on the trial grounds gave to Wang Baole. To them, only the words ‘Personal Disciple’ were a good fit for Wang Baole’s identity.
Therefore, the locations where Wang Baole and the other three people were at were forbidden grounds for the other disciples. They didn’t dare go near those areas and would flee if they even saw them from a distance away.
After flying in the air for a period of time and noticing the scattered keys on the night sky map swiftly running away, Wang Baole called for Zhao Yameng and Kong Dao to take a rest on one of the mountain peaks.
To the others, the keys were of increasing importance. However, to Wang Baole, it didn’t matter, and no one dared to snatch it from him either. He knew very clearly that right now, he only had three opponents remaining!
One was Dugu Lin, one was Lu Yun, while the other was Zhou Chudao’s Dao partner, Huang Yunshan!
Wang Baole didn’t belittle any of the three. That was especially so for Dugu Lin, who had risen to become Wang Baole’s greatest competitor!
“If nothing peculiar happens, the top three would definitely be chosen from the four of you.” As Wang Baole was looking at the night sky map, Zhao Yameng commented softly while sitting beside him.
“Then, Baole, do you want to stably enter the top three, or do you want to try going on the Lonely Path?” A glow flashed across Zhao Yameng’s eyes as she looked at Wang Baole.
Kong Dao responded similarly as well and was even tempted to try it out. That was because once Wang Baole chose the latter option, he would have great advantages...
Wang Baole thought about it and suddenly laughed.
“I still want to go on the Lonely Path to eliminate everyone, so that there is no number two or number three, but only a number one! Then, when the trial ends, each one of us shall take a Hyacinthus Tree leaf!”
“Let’s do it!” Kong Dao spoke excitedly. Zhao Yameng rubbed her forehead, appearing as if she had long guessed that Wang Baole would take that option. She relaxed, and as she heard Wang Baole’s words, she no longer continued to think about the details of the rules here.
“Since this is the case, then I’ll no longer do the analysis. You do it yourself. However, let me remind you that your next opponent might appear even before the second teleportation happens. If I didn’t guess incorrectly, it should be Huang Yunshan, Zhou Chudao’s Dao partner!”
“Coming for revenge?” Kong Dao raised his eyebrows.
“Coming to give us a key! Kong Dao, I’ve realized that your intelligence seems to have been lowered recently.” Zhao Yameng spoke calmly.
Kong Dao twisted his mouth and didn’t speak. He thought silently in his heart that whoever followed these two weirdos had to bow down to them. One was undefeatable in terms of combat power, the other undefeatable in terms of wit. What could he do other than say something? If it were someone else, they would have long lost their sense of existence.
Seeing how awkward Kong Dao looked, Wang Baole cleared his throat, and almost instinctively thought to take out his snacks. However, on the one hand, there were only a few pieces left, and on the other hand, he felt that it didn’t match the situation. Therefore, he resisted doing so. Instead, he raised his chin and maintained the proud attitude that he had been putting on in the trial grounds.
True to Zhao Yameng’s judgment, after the trio rested for half a day, a star worth over thirty keys could be seen nearing them quickly on the night sky map.
This caught the attention of everyone inside and outside the trial grounds. Naturally, Wang Baole and trio also noticed it, but they simply sat waiting, without moving.
An hour later, as the star appeared before the trio with astonishing speed, the alluring Huang Yunshan arrived like a ball of fire.
She was extremely fast. The previous moment, she was still a distance away, but in the blink of an eye, she was just a thousand feet from the trio. As she landed on the mountain peak, she didn’t look at Wang Baole, instead, throwing a glance at Zhao Yameng first.
Zhao Yameng looked back at her with a smile. Huang Yunshan smiled as well, before turning to look at Wang Baole, sizing him up. At the same time, Wang Baole was also looking at that woman.
When their eyes met, Huang Yunshan suddenly laughed.
“Even my man fell in your hands. It seems like I am no match for you either. Since that is the case, I’ll give you the keys. Since you’ve won over my man, you should continue battling and become number one!” With that, Huang Yunshan raised and waved her right hand, and tens of keys landed before Wang Baole.
Then, she looked at Wang Baole once again and smiled before turning to leave.
From her arrival to her departure, that was the only thing that she said. Kong Dao was deep in thought, looking at Zhao Yameng and back at Wang Baole, who seemed to also be thinking about something, before speaking suddenly.
“Baole, she must have fallen for you... Otherwise, why would she travel so far to give you those keys...”
Wang Baole blinked and was about to speak, but Zhao Yameng snorted upon hearing those words.
“Kong Dao, your intelligence has indeed been lowered.”
“What do you mean by that, Zhao Yameng!” Kong Dao was delighted but purposely acted as if he were angry. In reality, he had deliberately said those words to agitate Zhao Yameng.
“I don’t mean much. However, if my man failed, I would hope that the person who beat him would become the mightiest person in this trial. This way, my man would have failed under the hands of the top elite and not under the hands of other failures. This would minimize the damage to my reputation, and he wouldn’t be as disheartened. He would have a chance to rise up again and defeat him with his own hands!” Zhao Yameng spoke calmly. Kong Dao didn’t know how to argue back and simply mumbled.
“You’re a lunatic as well...”
“That’s because you don’t understand!” Zhao Yameng laughed. She looked at Wang Baole with a glow in her eyes and asked, “Baole, do you understand?”
Being looked at by Zhao Yameng in that way made Wang Baole’s heart rate quicken. As Zhao Yameng sat down, he couldn’t help but sweep his gaze at her...

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - Clearing the Area!
chapters.content:
Chapter 573: Clearing the Area!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Wang Baole was about to speak, but right then, on the night sky map, the star that represented Dugu Lin suddenly moved!
He was fast, much faster than when he charged towards Xu Ming. He was headed towards the last personal disciple of Feng Qiuran, Lu Yun!
The distance between the two of them wasn’t great. Since he moved with such a high speed, even the outsiders were surprised as they watched. The people that Dugu Lin passed on the way were also shocked, as they heard the sound of thunder arrive by their ears while noticing Dugu Lin’s figure charging ahead!
“Dugu Lin is battling once again!”
Wang Baole raised his head to look at the night sky, and Zhao Yameng and Kong Dao also turned their attention towards it. On the night sky map, they saw that the galaxy that represented Lu Yun, which had been moving slowly initially, suddenly stopped. It appeared that it had reached a decision after pondering over it briefly, and then it changed its direction and charged towards where Dugu Lin was coming from!
He wasn’t trying to escape or avoid battle, he was moving to take Dugu Lin head-on!
This could only be sensed by the disciples in the trial grounds through the night sky map, as they couldn’t see the details. However, the Dao Palace cultivators outside who could see everything going on were gripped with surprise.
They witnessed Dugu Lin charging forward, and they saw Lu Yun changing direction and charging towards Dugu Lin, an intention to fight in his eyes. They also noticed the decreasing distance between the both of them!
They were like two meteors swiftly approaching each other, about to collide!
“Huang Yunshan giving away her keys just now must have agitated Dugu Lin, forcing him to act sooner than he had planned!”
“Lu Yun actually took the initiative to battle!”
“The way things are now is simply good luck on Wang Baole’s part. He only needs to continue waiting, and he will enter the top two!”
As commotion arose amongst the disciples outside, Mie Liezi looked more comforted, though he was still solemn. However, a look of anticipation appeared in his eyes. Despite Wang Baole’s rising causing changes in how this trial was playing out, he still believed that his disciple, Dugu Lin, would emerge as number one!
Compared to Mie Liezi, Feng Qiuran was now sighing. Xu Ming was teleported back previously but didn’t stop by the public square. The moment he returned, he immediately left, as if ashamed with himself.
Right now, only her personal disciple Lu Yun remained on the trial grounds. With Huang Yunshan’s decision to give up, the results of the trial were clear, and there was little possibility of a change happening.
If everything happened accordingly, the top three would be Dugu Lin, Wang Baole, and Lu Yun!
However, the fact that Dugu Lin suddenly charged out with his intention to kill unleashed showed clearly that his goal wasn’t to be in the top three. Instead, he only wanted there to be a number one, with no other positions in the trial!
Dugu Lin!
Feng Qiuran’s facial expression was awful as she threw a glance at Daoist You Ran. However, she realized that Daoist You Ran still had his eyes shut, and he merely sighed without making any moves even when his personal disciple had been defeated.
In the silence, Feng Qiuran felt a myriad of emotions. She had high hopes of the two of them, but Xu Ming had already been eliminated. Lu Yun was impressive, but compared to Dugu Lin, whose ferocity was unleashed, Xu Ming still fell behind. Feng Qiuran had also realized that Dugu Lin wasn’t going at full force and was reserving some of his powers.
It was without a doubt that Lu Yun would fail.
However, Wang Baole, whom she didn’t look upon favorably initially, had suddenly risen up. The last Thearch Armor punch that he threw at Zhou Chudao to defeat him made Feng Qiuran feel that perhaps the trial was made specifically for Dugu Lin and Wang Baole. If Dugu Lin won, he would lead the Dao Palace disciples in the days to come, rising up completely with Mie Liezi.
Similarly, if Wang Baole won, his status and identity in the Dao Palace would be transformed. Even the others from the Federation could raise their heads, and few if not none of the Dao Palace disciples would dare to provoke them. This was because the Federation wouldn’t only have a personal disciple, but they would have the personal disciple that was the strongest below the Nascent Soul realm, suppressing even the Dao Palace disciples!
As everyone felt a torrent of emotions, Dugu Lin and Lu Yun were charging forward at increasing speed. Half an hour later, they neared each other in the central region of the trial grounds, and the battle between the two began as a loud boom was produced!
Different from the time he battled Xu Ming, and perhaps because Lu Yun came to battle on his own accord, Dugu Lin’s attacks were even more decisive. As he sealed his hands, his ferocity intensified, and nine black dragons appeared behind him, charging towards Lu Yun while screaming.
Not many on the trial grounds could see what was happening. Only the disciples near the battle location could see what was going on from a distance. Other than that, only the Dao Palace disciples outside could see what was going on clearly.
However, the clearer they could see, the more shocked they were. In reality, personal disciple Lu Yun had already surpassed his peers and was someone who could eliminate those in the Core Formation realm. However, in front of Dugu Lin, he was completely suppressed!
From start to finish, Dugu Lin only attacked with his fists while the nine black dragons circled around Lu Yun. Like the battle against Xu Ming, he didn’t use other spells and only threw punches. That was enough to make Lu Yun scream painfully, but he still charged out despite being pelted by the punches and thrown to the ground.
The Dao Palace disciples fell silent while watching it. They didn’t notice that a distance away, the heavily injured Xu Ming had returned, supported by his servant. Looking at the duo in battle, Xu Ming was silent, as if he could see himself in their position.
When Lu Yun’s body was about to crumble to a state similar to that of Xu Ming’s, Dugu Lin said the same thing he did to Xu Ming while flying in mid-air. Lu Yun laughed bitterly and didn’t avoid the battle. Instead, with a hint of madness, he charged out!
Looking at Lu Yun, Xu Ming trembled. Lu Yun did something that he didn’t dare do for fear of death!
Xu Ming was silent, and he closed his eyes with bitterness in his heart.
The battle between Lu Yun and Dugu Lin had ended. Perhaps due to admiration for Lu Yun, Dugu Lin didn’t unleash the final punch on Lu Yun. Instead, he slapped Lu Yun out of the sky, knocking him unconscious and no longer attacking.
As the battle ended, the public square was filled with momentary silence. Sounds of delight emerged from Mie Liezi’s clan. Compared to them, both Feng Qiuran and Daoist You Ran’s clans were silent, their hearts filled with shock and a torrent of emotions that couldn’t rest like the raging sea.
Without a doubt, Dugu Lin was more powerful than anyone could imagine. He didn’t use a second skill against both Xu Ming and Lu Yun from beginning to end. He could simply defeat them with punches and the nine circling dragons.
Everyone could see that Dugu Lin didn’t unleash his full force, but no one could guess how much power he actually used for the two battles.
“Thirty percent at most!” Xu Ming mumbled before turning to leave.
As everyone was filled with shock, the disciples within the trial grounds all fell silent. Even Wang Baole and company, who were resting on the mountain peak, looked solemn.
“This Dugu Lin is powerful, very powerful!” Kong Dao took a deep breath as he spoke.
“Baole, are you confident?” Zhao Yameng looked towards Wang Baole, a look of concern in her eyes.
Wang Baole remained silent for a while before his gaze deepened with a strong intention to battle burning in his eyes. His lips slowly curled into a smile as he spoke slowly.
“We’ll find out after the battle.” With that, Wang Baole shut his eyes and meditated with his legs crossed. He wanted to remain at the peak of perfection. Even if Dugu Lin didn’t come for him, he would look for him himself.
The battle between the two wasn’t only the end of this trial, it was also the most brilliant highlight!
Dugu Lin didn’t want there to be anything other than number one, and that was the case for Wang Baole as well!
Time passed, and it was no less than five hours to the second teleportation. Commotion arose in the trial grounds once again!
The one who caused the commotion was still Dugu Lin. After defeating Lu Yun, he had managed to accumulate over a hundred keys. However, he didn’t stop and instead began to clear the scene!
The goal of that was to fight against Feng Qiuran’s disciples!
Soon, Feng Qiuran’s remaining disciples who were struggling to survive in the trial grounds could only bitterly hand out their keys. They became keyless participants, and looking at it on the night sky map, Dugu Lin gained an increasing number of keys, while the keys that were scattered around dwindled.
This was definitely noticed by the cultivators outside. Even though they were shocked, they also understood that it was the survival of the fittest!

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - Two Peaks of One Mountain!
chapters.content:
Chapter 574: Two Peaks of One Mountain!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Watching Dugu Lin wiping out others from the night sky map, Wang Baole thought about it and laughed suddenly.
“It’s good that you’re wiping out the rest!” The outcome of this battle had already turned into the inevitable battle between him and Dugu Lin. Dugu Lin’s act of wiping out the others was clearly to ensure that the battle would not be interrupted. Wang Baole felt that it was a good move made by Dugu Lin, and he stood up on the mountain peak.
“Let’s begin to wipe out the rest as well, targeting those from his clan!” With that, Wang Baole stepped into the air and flew out. Zhao Yameng and Kong Dao followed behind, and the trio charged forward towards all the locations on the map that marked the position of the keys.
Therefore, the map was gradually cleared with both Wang Baole and Dugu Lin heading in two different directions!
This was a bitter experience for the disciples of Feng Qiuran and Mie Liezi. Previously, Wang Baole was someone insignificant in their minds. However, with this trial, Wang Baole had risen up like a star, and he had even managed to defeat Zhou Chudao to become one of the two elites in the trial ground.
The struggling cultivators under Mie Liezi were all aghast at his arrival. Even though they were indignant, they also knew that it was impossible for them to succeed in this trial, given their capabilities. Initially, they also held onto the hope of reaching the top three by chance.
Of course, if someone, either Wang Baole or Dugu Lin were to fail, they felt that second place was possible. However, they had already realized that neither Wang Baole nor Dugu Lin was giving others a chance!
Therefore, this so-called ‘wipe out’ was simply an assembly of keys. It wasn’t possible that anyone would foolishly try to fight back, regardless of whether it was people from Feng Qiuran or Mie Liezi’s clan. Right now, those who had keys weren’t stupid either. Most of the time, after being caught up to by either Wang Baole or Dugu Lin, they would hand over their keys without a fight.
However, amongst the two clans, there were still a few who weren’t smart. Towards people like them, Dugu Lin and Wang Baole acted similarly. They didn’t kill them but simply broke their legs to cripple them.
Looking at it from the night sky map, one could see that the stars that represented the two of them were extremely distinct, sweeping across each other’s region. Three hours later, through beating up or taking away the keys, the disciples from Mie Liezi and Feng Qiuran’s clan gradually lost all the keys they had.
It was the same for Daoist You Ran’s clan as well. Even though they were a neutral party, as the scene was cleared, they also knew that it was meaningless to persevere. In this trial, everyone could be considered a beginner, and the value of their existence lay simply in helping those two elite stars rise to the top!
Therefore, when they met Wang Baole and Dugu Lin, the disciples of Daoist You Ran didn’t bother to resist, and instead courteously handed out their keys. As this went on, before long, it was a mere one hour until the second teleportation. There were no longer anymore scattered keys on the night sky map.
There were only two stars made from numerous keys assembled together, and the numerous keyless participants who would be eliminated in this round of teleportation.
Right now, all these people raised their heads to look at the night sky map as they waited in silence.
As they waited, Wang Baole looked away from the night sky, and he looked at Zhao Yameng and Kong Dao.
Without hesitation, Zhao Yameng took out all the keys she had. Kong Dao took a deep breath as he similarly passed all his keys to Wang Baole.
“Baole, you must win!” Kong Dao spoke in a deep voice.
A smile appeared on Zhao Yameng’s face, and a look of anticipation appeared in her eyes. Looking at both of them, Wang Baole smiled as he kept all the keys, before speaking calmly.
“Let’s see each other outside in a while!” With that, Wang Baole turned around and stepped into mid-air. With his full speed unleashed, he turned into a shooting star as he charged towards the north, where Dugu Lin was!
At the same time, Dugu Lin, who was meditating on some rocks, suddenly opened his eyes, which carried an extremely strong desire to battle as he mumbled.
“You, who defeated Zhou Chudao... I wonder if you have the ability to force me to unleash the second divine power!” With that, Dugu Lin smiled and stood up. He was like a giant as he stepped forward, flying into the air with the speed of lightning, charging towards the approaching Wang Baole!
The two of them, one from the north and one from the south, were traveling extremely fast such that the distance between them was shortened instantly. This intense move by both of them made everyone on the trial grounds who had lost their keys extremely taken aback. To them, even if they were destined to fail, the fact that they could witness the battle between the elites of the Dao Palace made their failure worthwhile.
That was especially so as the battle to become the first was between a Dao Palace local and a Federation cultivator!
From the aspect of emotional ties, they naturally hoped that Dugu Lin would emerge victorious. However, everyone also recognized Wang Baole’s rising. It could be said that in the hearts of these people, it was difficult to say who would eventually win!
However, the majority still hoped that Dugu Lin would win!
Amidst those emotions, and as Wang Baole and Dugu Lin neared each other, the other cultivators on the trial grounds also advanced at high speed. Their goal was to reach the region between the two of them. With their speed, estimating the region where they would make contact wasn’t a difficult task.
At the same time, as Wang Baole and Dugu Lin’s battle was about to begin on the trial grounds, and as the others assembled, the public square outside was teeming with sounds of discussion and commotion. Everyone focused their attention as they looked towards the sky, where the eye-catching figures of Wang Baole and Dugu Lin were on the big screen!
The two of them were nearing each other at such high speed that thunder was produced continuously. A tear was formed in the empty space as a result of their speed, such that it appeared as if the sky behind the both of them was being torn open!
Their force also grew increasingly stronger as they charged ahead!
“The both of them are gearing up!”
“Dugu Lin only used a single spell for both his previous two battles. That shows how formidable he is. As for Wang Baole, the blood-colored armor that he used to defeat Zhou Chudao is astonishing as well!”
“If Wang Baole’s blood-colored armor can be sustained for a long period of time, then the outcome of this trial will be uncertain. However, if he is unable to sustain it, then Dugu Lin will definitely win!”
As all the disciples on the public square were engaged in heated discussions, the Federation Seedlings were also extremely nervous. They were agitated and worried, and with the myriad of emotions that they were feeling, everything turned into anxiety.
Even the Nascent Soul realm cultivators from the Dao Palace looked solemn. It was clear that whether it was Wang Baole or Dugu Lin, both of them had showcased, to a certain extent, a combat power that was similar to that of a Nascent Soul realm cultivator!
Naturally, their experience was on a level that those Core Formation realm disciples couldn’t compare to. Therefore, after witnessing the duo engage in their individual battles, they had reached a conclusion in their hearts.
“Wang Baole will lose.”
“He will lose because he is still in the mid-stage Core Formation realm, while Dugu Lin has already reached the perfected Core Formation realm!”
“In the face of an enemy that isn’t on par with you, combat power is important. However, if both sides are equally powerful, then how long they each can last becomes crucial!” As the Nascent Soul realm cultivators made their own judgments, Feng Qiuran also took a deep breath as she looked at Mie Liezi.
“Mie Liezi, it’s time to end the battle now that we have reached this stage.”
“Even if we go according to the rules, we still need to wait until after the teleportation to make a decision. There is still an hour left. Elder Qiuran, you’re too anxious.” Mie Liezi spoke calmly as he rejected her proposition.
Feng Qiuran narrowed her eyes and was about to say something when Daoist You Ran suddenly spoke.
“Elder Qiuran, it’s just an hour. I am also curious to know who would emerge victorious between the two of them! Furthermore, halting the battle now wouldn’t only not be accepted by the both of them, but it is also something that the surrounding disciples would be against.”
Feng Qiuran looked at the disciples around her and noticed the anticipation and passion in their eyes. She also looked at Wang Baole and Dugu Lin from the screen in the sky and saw their strong desire to battle. As such, she fell silent.
As Feng Qiuran fell silent, the spectators focused their attention on the trial grounds. Five minutes later, on the night sky map of the trial grounds, the two stars nearing each other from the north and south finally met each other!
Perhaps due to a coincidence, or perhaps it was on purpose, the location where they met was a double-peaked mountain!
A mountain with two peaks stood stably on the ground, towering as it pointed towards the skies!
Right now, a loud boom was produced as Wang Baole appeared on the right peak, while Dugu Lin arrived on the left peak. As he stood on the peak, he looked like a god at Wang Baole, who was a thousand feet away from him with bright eyes!
“Wang Baole!”
Wang Baole looked at him as well, and their gaze met in mid-air. Vaguely, a loud boom produced from around both of them and reverberated in all directions.
“Dugu Lin!”

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - The Ultimate Battle!
chapters.content:
Chapter 575: The Ultimate Battle!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
As the duo shouted, they fully unleashed their forces. A blood sea containing nine large carps that were swimming vigorously in it appeared behind Dugu Lin. Every time they leaped out of the water surface, waves of the blood sea rose and crashed.
This illusion also brought with it a genuine smell of blood that spread in all directions. This resulted in the peak beneath Dugu Lin’s feet being stained blood red!
Wang Baole was impressive as well. Large amounts of lightning appeared and spread in all directions, forming a Lightning Domain that covered a large area. The heaven and earth were discolored as the lightning and thunder arrived in waves, covering the entire mountain peak from his body!
Looking at it from a distance, the mountain peaks beneath the feet of the two of them were a Blood Peak and a Lightning Peak respectively. They were equally matched and shook the heavens and earth!
This scene gripped all the spectators who were watching the events unfold. At the same time, in the area surrounding the twin peaks, numerous trial-takers had arrived. They didn’t dare to go near, watching from thousands of feet away. It was as if the physical bodies of a cultivator were different from that of ordinary people.
