As such, as their gaze was focused with their cultivation, they could see everything on the battlegrounds clearly.
However, it was also this that caused them to be deeply shaken, feeling extremely pressured. Their breathing grew chaotic as Wang Baole and Dugu Lin unleashed their forces, and as the Blood Peak and Lightning Peak stood!
“The battle is about to begin!”
“This is a battle between the peaks, the battle of the top person below the Nascent Soul realm in the Dao Palace!”
“Whoever emerges victorious will be the undeniable top person below the Nascent Soul realm!”
Numerous disciples, both inside and outside the trial grounds, were focusing their attention on what was happening. That was especially so for the disciples who had bet on Dugu Lin’s victory, and they were extremely nervous.
That was the case for the Federation disciples as well. With everyone’s attention on the twin peaks, Wang Baole suddenly laughed. His laughter grew louder, and in the end, he raised his right hand and waved it hard!
He wasn’t making an attack. Instead, he was throwing all the keys he had into the valley between them. Those keys shimmered brightly, and as they landed in the valley, they were like twinkling stars!
That scene surprised all the spectators instantly. They had never thought that Wang Baole would throw out the keys, but after thinking about it, they realized that it was a logical move!
The rules of this trial had already been changed. In other words, be it Wang Baole or Dugu Lin, they could simply disregard the rules, as they each had their own rules!
That was... Only one person shall remain!
However, even so, not everyone could throw out the keys without concern like Wang Baole. Such a simple action caused a powerful force to accumulate on Wang Baole. That was an act of no return, an act of leaving no way out!
The surrounding spectators all held their breaths, and this was especially so for the disciples outside. At this moment, even though Wang Baole was a Federation cultivator, he had already gained the respect of many people everywhere!
“Such boldness... I have belittled Wang Baole in the past!”
“If I have a chance, I want to be friends with Wang Baole, regardless of whether he wins or loses!”
As the perceptions towards Wang Baole changed in the minds of numerous cultivators, Dugu Lin also felt respect towards what Wang Baole had done!
Dugu Lin also laughed heartily and raised his right hand, waving it. He threw all the keys that he had obtained into the valley as if they were trash, and he didn’t did not even bother looking at them as he did so. A single key was left behind, and as he pointed at it with his right hand, the remaining key flew out and landed on the rocks between the two peaks as it shone brightly!
The winner would take the key!
As the key was thrown out, the force from Dugu Lin’s body also intensified, shaking the sky. The disciples around them who had lost their keys were completely shocked by what Wang Baole and Dugu Lin had just done, and they held their breaths. Regardless of whether they admitted it, they felt that they were insignificant compared to the both of them.
“The both of them are the true elites!” someone mumbled, and this comment gained the agreement of others around them.
They could feel the mightiness of the both of them and could understand the purpose of why they did what they did.
This battle would end with the next round of teleportation. Before the teleportation began, the winner and loser must be determined. If not, everyone, including the both of them, would be eliminated, and everyone would fail!
No one dared to pick up the keys from the valley between them either, as it was meaningless. Rules may be rules, but with the sect watching everything, if someone really made use of the opportunity to reach the top three, that person would have a hard life in the future!
After all, all the cultivators in this trial met each other often in the Vast Expanse Dao Palace. Not many would take the risk, and that was especially so for those who remained, as they were all smart.
Therefore, even though some of them were filled with regret, they controlled their greed and tidied up their thoughts!
The winner of this trial was to be determined between Wang Baole and Dugu Lin. The winner between them would be the only one eligible to pick up the shimmering key laying on the rock, and as that person held the key and watched as the others were being teleported away by the teleportation array formation, he would become number one in the trial!
“Wang Baole, don’t disappoint me!” The moment he threw out the keys, Dugu Lin bellowed as the desire for combat was unleashed in his eyes. He stepped into the air instantly as he charged towards Wang Baole. He raised his hand and grabbed, and instantly, the nine carps in the blood sea behind him all screeched and leaped out of the water surface!
In mid-air, in the blood sea, the nine carps were transformed into nine black dragons that coiled around Dugu Lin’s right arm, boosting his punch with the force of nine dragons!
Similar to when he was battling Xu Ming and Lu Yun, he charged towards Wang Baole!
Until now, in the Vast Expanse Dao Palace, he had never met someone who could force him to unleash the second spell. All his opponents fell and lost against his nine dragon punch.
He had once thought that Zhou Chudao was the only one that could make him unleash the second spell. However, right now, this anticipation had turned towards Wang Baole. To a certain extent, Dugu Lin no longer cared about the Hyacinthus Tree leaf, he only cared about having a hearty battle and using the victory from this battle to accumulate his power!
With that thought, the desire to battle, and the determination to win, Dugu Lin’s force was unleashed as the blood sea behind him churned. He leaped into mid-air and punched at Wang Baole!
That punch made the heavens and earth vibrate, and it even produced a black hole. It produced a force that shook the firmament. The nine dragons screeched, and a force of unity was contained within everything!
Like an indestructible pike, it pierced straight forward!
“As you wish!” Wang Baole’s desire to fight was evident in his eyes. All the lightning in his Lightning Domain danced and was unleashed. His voice carried a level of power that was unlike before. It was decisive, and as it reverberated, Wang Baole stepped out!
Using his right hand for support, the force from his hip accumulated in his right hand the moment he neared. His cultivation was completely unleashed. His Lightning Core, Dark Core, and Heart Core all activated, forming a collective force that integrated with his consciousness, causing his power to intensify as he similarly punched his fist!
Supernova!
The resonance boosted him two-fold!
With that punch, the heavens and earth were shaken, the wind was disrupted, and the clouds and sky were being torn apart. A black hole-like existence was being forced apart, making him appear like a steady, indestructible pike. His fist was the sharp tip that pierced forcefully towards Dugu Lin!
The distance between the two of them on the peaks was a mere thousand feet. As they charged out, it looked like two extremely sharp pikes that were never before seen had made contact with each other!
The heavens and earth shook, and tremors filled the surroundings!
This was the contact between the Blood Sea and the Lightning Domain!
This was the collision between the Blood Peak and the Lightning Mountain!
This was... The ultimate battle to become the first amongst the Dao Palace disciples!

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - Light Rays Intersect!
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: Light Rays Intersect!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Astonishment and amazement like never before!
That was the thought that revolved around the minds of the trial-takers who were standing around the twin peaks. Their emotions were being heavily influenced by the two pikes that Wang Baole and Dugu Lin had transmogrified. Astonishment, and nothing else, filled their thoughts right now!
The next moment, a deafening noise sounded, reverberating in mid-air as Wang Baole and Dugu Lin collided, and as the Nine Dragon Punch and Supernova made contact!
The nine dragons were torn apart, and the supernova was devastated. As a result of the both of them completely unleashing their power and cultivation, a black hole-like existence appeared, overlapping and exploding in the opposite direction. An indescribably powerful impact spread swiftly between the two of them!
The waves that were produced as the spread happened also harnessed an astonishing force. If other Core Formation realm cultivators were to go between the two of them, they would definitely be killed by the waves themselves!
To Wang Baole, who was equipped with the Heart Core, the waves may be frightening, but it wasn’t sufficient to kill him. That was the case for Dugu Lin as well. He didn’t have a Heart Core, but his combat body could provide him with a physical protective covering. Amidst the loud boom, the two of them didn’t even move a single step back, unlike what the others had expected!
That was because at that moment, whoever moved back would lose the lead. Being in the lead was important, perhaps the most crucial in a battle between two equally matched individuals!
It could be said that from the beginning, the duo’s individual attacks were already extremely intense, and they weren’t giving each other any leeway!
Amidst the loud boom, Dugu Lin laughed heartily, with excitement evident in his laughter. His intention to battle far exceeded when he battled Xu Ming and Lu Yun. He turned around and bellowed.
“Wang Baole, you’re qualified!” With that, Dugu Lin sealed his right hand, and with his body against the impact, he charged towards Wang Baole. At that moment, as the Blood Sea behind him churned, a giant Kun Peng emerged from under the sea!
The appearance of the creature instantly made everyone who was around, as well as those outside, shocked beyond words. The fact that a Core Formation realm cultivator could create such a powerful scene was incredulous to many. In the minds of most cultivators, only the Nascent Soul realm cultivators could achieve this feat!
However, this phenomenon appeared through Dugu Lin. In addition, it was extremely powerful. When the Kun Peng appeared, it was already extremely physically imposing as it was tens of thousands of feet wide. As it screeched, it didn’t charge towards Wang Baole. Instead, it turned and raised its tail, sweeping it towards Wang Baole!
Looking at everything that was happening, it seemed as if a large fan was creating a churning wind that could destroy everything in its path. It tore apart the space, causing the Blood Sea to tumble. It appeared like ink was being spilled to stain everything red!
It moved extremely fast, at a speed that exceeded even that of Dugu Lin himself. Instantly, it appeared before Wang Baole, who was similarly going against the impact!
A strong sense of crisis arose in Wang Baole’s mind. It didn’t come from in front of him, but from behind him instead!
Behind him, as the tail of the Kun Peng swept with immense force towards him and blocked the path ahead of him, Dugu Lin appeared!
He somehow appeared behind Wang Baole, and his appearance was extremely bizarre. He seemed to be bloated and covered with large amounts of black hair all over his body. In the blink of an eye, he was transformed into a maniacal ape that was hundreds of feet tall!
The ape’s eyes were reddened, carrying a maniacal level of desire to battle. It was extremely excited, and as it waved its large arms, its two fists were like giant pails, pounding down on Wang Baole as it laughed!
The Kun Peng was in front of him, while the giant ape was behind him. This was an extremely treacherous situation and didn’t give Wang Baole any time to react. If it were someone else, they would be completely flustered. Dugu Lin was simply too experienced, and every move he made was fatal!
However, Wang Baole had been through life-and-death crises numerous times before. Right now, even in the face of danger, he was calm. He suppressed the urge in his mind to unleash Thearch Armor. It wasn’t that it shouldn’t be unleashed, but if he were to use it as a form of resistance now, it would definitely not feel as good as using an unexpected move!
Therefore, a glow flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes as he sealed his hands without hesitation. Instantly, a ribbon appeared, winding around its surroundings while the tri-colored flying sword also appeared, shining brightly as it pierced straight ahead at the Kun Peng. As for Wang Baole, he turned around with a punch to welcome the giant ape that Dugu Lin had transformed into!
Everything, from the beginning of the crisis to tackling the attacks head-on, happened in an extremely short amount of time. Immediately, a loud boom reverberated. The ribbon that was akin to an eighth-grade Dharmic Armament had a unique protective characteristic. At the same time, the tri-colored flying sword that was like a ninth-grade Dharmic Armament was extremely powerful. Using the two Dharmic Armaments together boosted their individual powers, such that the Kun Peng’s tail that was fast approaching was staggering.
The punch that Wang Baole threw after turning around was also without hesitation. With all his cultivation being activated, he collided with the giant ape with the collective force of his body.
A loud boom was produced. Wang Baole’s Blood Qi churned throughout his body. He knew that in this battle, he was at a slight disadvantage. As such, a glow flashed across his eyes, and he was about to leverage on the force to retreat and emerge from the situation before entering it again to attack. However, Dugu Lin didn’t give him the chance to do so, as he laughed heartily.
“It seems like the pressure I’ve given you is still insufficient for you to unleash your trump card. Fine, I’ll add on to the pressure!” As he spoke, Dugu Lin opened his mouth and spat out three beads!
The three beads were green in color, with a blurry figure sealed within them. It looked extremely bizarre, and a vibe that made Wang Baole’s heart tremble emanated from the beads. He didn’t even have time to fully recognize what they were when Dugu Lin suddenly shouted.
“Shatter!”
Instantly, sounds of explosions were produced as the three beads broke apart, and three identical Dugu Lins emerged. Every single one of them carried an imposing aura, and when they appeared, they charged towards Wang Baole from five different directions together with the Kun Peng, unleashing a formidable force!
The sense of crisis far exceeded what he experienced previously. It was clear through this battle that Dugu Lin was extremely powerful. Even though Wang Baole was mentally prepared for it, he was still deeply shaken. It could be said that if Zhou Chudao had replaced Wang Baole, he would definitely be defeated under Dugu Lin’s continuous attacks!
A worthy opponent!
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He realized that if the three beads weren’t broken apart, they could be reused multiple times. However, their force wouldn’t be as powerful as right now, after they had been torn apart. This made him grow vigilant of Dugu Lin’s decisiveness, as he recognized that the person before him only cared about winning and not about the items he possessed!
With that thought, a look of ferociousness appeared in Wang Baole’s eyes. He no longer fret over making a loss. As he sealed his hands, he pointed towards the ribbon and bellowed.
“Explode!”
Instantly, the ribbon exploded. It wasn’t an eighth-grade Dharmic Armament that had a one-time-use quality. Instead, it was a treasure from an extraterrestrial civilization. Right now, as it exploded, it immediately formed a hurricane with Wang Baole as the center as it swept its surroundings. The tri-colored flying sword also produced a sharp sound as it charged towards Dugu Lin’s three avatars.
That wasn’t the end. Wang Baole quickly took out five one-time-use eighth-grade Dharmic Armaments and exploded them. The hurricane that resulted instantly rose towards the sky with an even more powerful force that swept the surroundings!
As the hurricane swept violently with such an imposing force, the giant ape that Dugu Lin had transformed into trembled. Even he was surprised at Wang Baole’s decisiveness. He could sense the aura from the ribbon, and it wouldn’t be a huge matter if only one of his Dharmic Armaments had exploded. Instead, right now, Wang Baole exploded five such treasures, and this decisiveness filled Dugu Lin with surprise for the very first time. He didn’t dare to go head-to-head with the force that resulted from the explosion of the five Dharmic Armaments, and he could only retreat.
His three avatars also retreated as the explosion happened and the tri-colored flying sword zeroed in on them. A weakness was exposed in Dugu Lin’s attacks. The most obvious weakness was the gap formed by Dugu Lin and his avatars as they retreated. However, Wang Baole didn’t choose to attack that area. Instead, as the hurricane swept, he stepped back and landed on the Kun Peng’s tail. Blood spewed out of his mouth as he passed the Kun Peng, as well as the gap left as Dugu Lin and his avatars retreated!
Unexpectedly, he tossed a coin into the gap!
That made Dugu Lin narrow his eyes, and a look of excitement could be evidently seen. As he waved his hands, an almost invisible thread emerged from the gap that resulted when he and his avatars retreated. It coiled around the copper coin instantly, and the copper coin couldn’t break free no matter how hard it struggled!
“Wang Baole, you’ve piqued my interest!” As Dugu Lin laughed, he turned and charged towards Wang Baole!

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - Soul, Come Over!
chapters.content:
Chapter 577: Soul, Come Over!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“What you just said can lead to a misunderstanding, you know.” As Dugu Lin charged towards him, Wang Baole suddenly laughed. His lips, with fresh blood flowing from them, made his smile seem indescribably evil. He raised his right hand and pointed towards the copper coin that was being restrained by the thread!
As he pointed with his finger, the ordinary-looking copper coin suddenly vibrated. Countless runes were produced from it, becoming a fountain of runes. Under this impact, the thread that coiled around it broke apart and charged towards Dugu Lin as the runes were increasingly unleashed!
An aura that belonged to a Nascent Soul realm cultivator immediately emerged from deep within the copper coin’s runes, forming a suppressive force as it landed on Dugu Lin!
From a distance, there were countless runes, and they were so dense that it formed a large copper coin in mid-air by itself. This scene made everyone surprised, and the spectators outside were shocked. That was especially so for Mie Liezi, whose eyes widened significantly.
“A Runic Soldier!”
As everyone was immersed in astonishment, a glow flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes as he bellowed!
“Mountain spirits, thunder gods. Slay these ghouls, bring these spirits to their knees. Destroy these demons and exorcise all evil. Protect the eternal and divine!”
The moment he said those words, astonishing flashes of lightning were produced from within the large copper coin formed by the runes. As the lightning crashed down and landed on Dugu Lin, Dugu Lin was shocked. He waved his hand and punched, breaking numerous lightning bolts while more of them continued to rain down. The large rune-formed copper coin also began to descend, trapping and pressing Dugu Lin under it!
That wasn’t the end. Wang Baole sealed his hands and pointed at the copper coin as he bellowed again.
“With lightning at the front and the Eight Trigrams at the back, seal!”
As soon as he said that, markings of the Eight Trigrams appeared on the rune copper coin. A loud sound was produced as it landed around Dugu Lin. Right now, the speed of suppressing him increased, and with innumerable lightning bolts raining down, it seemed like Dugu Lin was about to be completely suppressed!
However, right at that time, a peculiar flash appeared in Dugu Lin’s eyes. After looking deeply into Wang Baole’s eyes, he raised his hand, and a flower could be seen in it!
That was a five-colored flower with petals of five different colors!
When the flower appeared, an aura akin to a peak ninth-grade Dharmic Armament was unleashed from it. When Wang Baole sensed it, he was gripped with surprise as Dugu Lin’s voice reverberated.
“You made me reveal this treasure. Wang Baole, if you don’t have any other forms of attack in this battle, then this is the end!” With that, without even taking a look at the Eight Trigrams around him, the copper coin above his head, or the flashes of lightning surrounding him, Dugu Lin raised his hand and tore off the blue petal of the five-colored flower. When he released his hand, the blue petal danced in the wind.
As it danced in the wind, everything around it seemed to have frozen. Quietly, large quantities of blue-colored bubbles appeared on the Eight Trigrams. The large rune-formed copper coin in the sky also rose and was covered by thousands of blue-colored bubbles.
That was the same case for the surrounding lightning as well. Visibly, they turned into bubbles. When everything around Dugu Lin had been transformed into bubbles, he cleared his throat, and that was when all the bubbles burst at the same time. When everything was destroyed, a copper coin that looked as if it had been corroded landed on the ground.
Wang Baole retracted his gaze, staring at the flower in Dugu Lin’s hands, which now had four petals remaining. Of them, he paid special attention to the black-colored petal. Even though he felt a strong sense of crisis from the flower, he still suppressed the urge to unleash Thearch Armor. He turned and was about to go near when a chilly glow flashed across Dugu Lin’s eyes. He tore off the second petal, which was blood-red in color.
“Blood Draw!” Dugu Lin spoke softly. When he released the petal, Wang Baole was taken aback, and his heart trembled. He had a peculiar feeling that the petal had insidiously formed a strong connection with him.
This connection couldn’t be controlled and seemed to have been formed automatically after the petal was torn off. When Dugu Lin opened his mouth, the petal transmogrified into a bloody hand that grabbed towards Wang Baole. Immediately, Wang Baole’s body trembled, and his face turned pale. Blood Fog emerged from all his pores!
Blood Fog also emerged from all his orifices. He clearly felt that the blood in his body couldn’t be controlled and was being drawn out by a bizarre force that couldn’t be described!
That bizarre force of a Dharmic treasure was never experienced by Wang Baole previously. Now, his breathing was visibly quickened, but Dugu Lin, with his rich combat experience, wasted no time. As soon as the second petal was torn off, he immediately tore off the third petal!
The third petal was white in color!
“Bone Cracking!”
When the petal landed, a white glow was produced as it transmogrified into a small white-colored skeleton that sneered at Wang Baole. Wang Baole snorted in his heart. As the blood in his body was being drawn out in large volumes, the bones in his body were being attacked by an unknown force. Cracks appeared as if his bones were about to break apart!
If it were someone else, they would have definitely died from these attacks. However, Wang Baole had a Heart Core and was physically strong. The green lotus in his body shook quickly, releasing life energy that swiftly recovered the blood and the breaking bones in Wang Baole’s body!
Even so, only an equilibrium was achieved. If Dugu Lin didn’t have any further moves, it would be enough. However, if he were to continue to attack, he might be thrown into a state of disequilibrium, which would cause his body to crumble instantly as all his blood would be lost and all his bones would turn to powder!
However, despite all that was happening, Wang Baole didn’t unleash Thearch Armor. Instead, he screamed and charged towards Dugu Lin. That made Dugu Lin feel bored.
“Do you really think that you will be able to walk in front of me with my Heaven Representing Flower in hand?” He shook his head and tore off the fourth petal, which was the black-colored petal!
“Soul, come over!”
When he said that, the black-colored petal instantly dissolved. As a black fog spread, a black ball of fire was produced, which gave out a chill. From within, a palm-sized lone boat appeared. There was a small black-robed man with a lantern oar in his arms. As he appeared, he raised his right hand and pointed at Wang Baole, but that was when the black-robed man trembled!
When the black boat and the tiny black man appeared, Wang Baole raised his head, and a bright glow flashed across his eyes. That was the moment he was waiting for!
Without hesitation, the Dark Core in Wang Baole’s body was instantly unleashed. A Dark Fire emerged from his body. The black boat and tiny man formed from the black-colored petal turned around instantly, screaming at Dugu Lin who was frozen with surprise. The tiny man waved the lantern oar in his hands and pointed at Dugu Lin!
As he pointed, Dugu Lin’s body trembled vigorously and his mind buzzed noisily. In his shock, he wanted to retreat, but it was too late. Wang Baole roared loudly and charged out, his body like a shooting star that seemed capable of destroying the universe. When he emerged, he raised his right hand and formed a fist. Immediately, the blood-colored meridians transmogrified and coiled around him. An overbearing and sinister aura was produced, and the Flame Snatch Thearch Armor appeared!
When the Flame Snatch Thearch Armor appeared, the force from Wang Baole’s body was fully unleashed, and its scale exceeded that of previous times significantly. It was doubly boosted by the collective force, and that was a triple boost for the Flame Snatch Thearch Armor!
When they overlapped, the resulting force was extremely imposing, carrying with it an irreversible and destructive power as it approached Dugu Lin!
Everywhere it passed was torn apart, and the heavens and earth shook violently!
Dugu Lin was gripped with indescribable shock. He wanted to resist, but right now, his spirit was trembling and on the verge of being drawn out. He slowed down as Wang Baole’s lightning avatar appeared, snatching away the flower that only had one petal left, while the actual Wang Baole let out a punch through the Flame Snatch Thearch Armor. The disciples who were surrounding them and watching the battle, as well as the Dao Palace cultivators outside, were all shocked!
He was so fast and so powerful that it seemed like he had harnessed the Heaven and Earth powers. Dugu Lin vomited blood, and his body retreated. Wang Baole chased after him like lightning and punched him again!
This punch made a dent in Dugu Lin’s chest, revealing his bones. It was a powerful impact as his body was thrown towards the other mountain peak. When he landed, the mountain peak caved in, and Wang Baole continued chasing after him with his powerful force!

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - Opening the Seal!
chapters.content:
Chapter 578: Opening the Seal!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The tide had turned!
At this moment, both the surrounding spectators and the Dao Palace cultivators outside were watching with their mouths agape. The battle between Wang Baole and Dugu Lin was full of twists and turns. Initially, it was clear that Dugu Lin was in the lead, and was pressuring Wang Baole strongly.
However, to the outer world cultivators, they knew about Wang Baole’s blood-colored meridian armor which he used to suppress Zhou Chudao. As they watched, they realized that Wang Baole didn’t unleash it even in the face of crisis. Some of them even thought that perhaps there were disadvantages to that move of Wang Baole’s, which was why he didn’t unleash it. As Dugu Lin unleashed the five-colored petals that caused Wang Baole’s blood and bones to be destroyed, Wang Baole was about to be defeated!
However, all the changes that happened after that shocked everyone. For some unknown reason, the black-colored petal switched alliances!
This betrayal was also the factor that turned the situation around. Wang Baole grabbed hold of the opportunity, unleashing all of his power and beginning to destroy everything. The blood-colored armor that wasn’t seen previously instantly appeared. In his attack, he snatched away the flower with only one petal remaining from Dugu Lin, inflicting severe injuries on him with two shocking punches!
The punches made fresh blood spew out of Dugu Lin’s mouth, and caused his chest to cave in. His body slammed against the mountains. At that moment, as Wang Baole emerged, he was like a spear, and he was about to attack Dugu Lin once again!
Everything that happened caused everyone’s breathing to quicken as they watched on. However, even before they could gasp, Wang Baole’s pupils constricted. He felt an astonishing force emanating continuously from Dugu Lin, who had crashed into the mountain before him.
However, Wang Baole didn’t stop. A chilly glow flashed across his eyes as he picked up speed and neared Dugu Lin. He punched ahead, landing his fist on Dugu Lin’s caved chest.
However, at that moment, Dugu Lin suddenly opened his eyes. His eyes had turned a pale gold color, and the glow from them wasn’t only extremely imposing, but it also carried a sense of excitement!
“The first seal, open!”
The moment he spoke, an imposing force was unleashed from Dugu Lin’s body. Dugu Lin laughed heartily, raising his right hand, where an identical golden glow spread from. He punched the fast approaching Wang Baole!
A loud boom reverberated instantly. Wang Baole snorted and retreated thousands of feet as his body shook. As a brilliant blood-colored glow emerged from the Flame Snatch Thearch Armor, he charged out once again towards Dugu Lin, who had leaped up from the mountains, and attacked him again!
At that moment, the duo were attacking each other with punches through the air. They fell from the sky, crashing into the mountain peaks and then leaping up at the same time to continue fighting under the night sky map. In the short span of an hour, the ground was broken, the mountains had crumbled, and only the twin peak mountain stood steadily, as it was deliberately avoided by both of them.
In those five minutes, both Wang Baole and Dugu Lin had forgotten how many punches they had thrown out. They had battled to the best of their abilities and were both breathing rapidly. However, the desire for combat continued burning crazily in their eyes.
It wouldn’t be extinguished if no winner emerged!
“Again!” Amidst the loud boom, Wang Baole laughed again and licked away the blood on the corner of his mouth. He neared Dugu Lin once again, who then frowned. Even though he had enjoyed the battle so far, he was also being surprised again and again.
In reality, having unlocked the first seal, his combat capabilities were significantly boosted. However, after the continuous attacks for the past five minutes, he began to feel that his body couldn’t keep up with the changes that were happening in the battle!
To put it more accurately, his speed of recovery couldn’t be compared to Wang Baole’s!
As such, after the duo continually attacked each other, Wang Baole could continue making his attacks as he recovered quickly. However, for Dugu Lin, even though he was able to withstand everything at first, if this were to continue, he would eventually be completely exhausted!
I shouldn’t compete against his physical body!
Dugu Lin narrowed his eyes and raised his right hand to attack at full force. When his fist touched Wang Baole’s, he leveraged on the force and retreated. As Wang Baole picked up speed and approached him, he suddenly stopped. A peculiar glow flashed across his eyes as he sealed his hands and bellowed.
“Vermilion!”
With that word, a purple-colored sea of fire immediately emerged from his body. The purple-colored flames were scorching, and the moment they appeared, the surrounding space was warped by the flames. The ground melted, the mountainous rocks were turned into lava, and everything else was shrouded in an environment of extremely high temperature!
As the space warped, the outline of a vermilion bird appeared from it. It was initially colorless and without a physical body, as if it was formed by the waves produced by the warping. Everything was transparent!
However, the flame was colored, causing the vermilion bird that was produced from the warped nothingness to turn a purple color. It was a thousand feet wide, and it enveloped Dugu Lin within it before it chirped at Wang Baole and dashed towards him!
From a distance, it was impossible to see Dugu Lin anymore. One could only see the purple-colored vermillion bird, its wings opened as it charged towards Thearch Armor together with the churning sea of fire!
The cultivators outside were all shocked, and the Nascent Soul realm cultivators looked extremely solemn. They knew very clearly that right now, the combat power unleashed by Dugu Lin was on the level of a Nascent Soul realm cultivator!
Even if it were them, they would have to put in their utmost effort to resist such a force. Some of them even predicted that Wang Baole would definitely be defeated!
However, with everyone focusing their attention on what was happening as the vermillion bird neared, an undetectable glow flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes. He knew that there was no way he could avoid it. Therefore, he screamed loudly, clenching his right hand into a fist as he punched!
That punch was a culmination of two times the collective power and three times the force of the Flame Snatch Thearch Armor. When it was released, Wang Baole’s Flame Snatch Thearch Armor seemed to have shrunk by seventy percent!
It was several hundred feet tall previously and was now only sixty feet tall. The power of Thearch Armor was all accumulated in the punch and released!
Looking at everything that was happening, in front of the vermillion bird, as Wang Baole attacked with his punch, a gigantic illusory fist a hundred feet wide landed on the vermillion bird. When contact was made, Wang Baole vomited fresh blood, and the Thearch Armor in his body also produced cracking sounds as his body was thrown back.
The vermillion bird was extremely beaten. Even though it wasn’t devastated, a huge cave had appeared in its chest, and it looked solemnly at Dugu Lin.
This is the end!
Dugu Lin took a deep breath. To him, Wang Baole was the strongest opponent he had ever met in his life. In the face of such an opponent, he chose not to allow any further attacks to be made by him. As he spoke, he turned and charged towards Wang Baole with the severely injured vermillion bird!
However, the moment he neared, a glow flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes, and he chanted in his mind!
“Enlightened, prisoner of the Dao of heaven, all sentient beings must endure immeasurable calamities...”
It was the Dao Scripture!
He may be heavily injured, but in reality, that was the form of retaliation he had thought of during the crossfire just now. As he chanted the Dao Scripture in his mind, a frightening and indescribable force emerged from the depths of the Universe, about to be awakened. Instantly, it arrived in the Solar System, on the ancient greenish-bronze sword, in Vast Expanse Dao Palace, and in... the Infinite Spells Array Formation!
Boom!
The Dao Palace cultivators outside felt their minds buzz noisily with activity. They were all surprised, and the higher their level of cultivation, the more significantly they could feel it. That was especially so for Mie Liezi and Feng Qiuran, who were now aghast as they stood up and exclaimed.
“What is this aura!”
All of them, who were immersed in shock, didn’t notice that Daoist You Ran beside them had blood spewing out of his mouth. Even with his perseverance, he didn’t manage to withstand the impact and opened his mouth slightly. Even though his mouth wasn’t fully opened, the shape of his mouth had turned into a square!
The blood disappeared instantly when he reacted to what was happening!
Dugu Lin, who was on the trial grounds, also shook vigorously as his mind buzzed with activity. His cultivation was being messed up, and the vermillion bird could no longer sustain the fight with its injuries as it broke apart. When that happened, and as Dugu Lin shook violently, a chilly glow appeared in Wang Baole’s eyes. He charged forward like a ferocious light ray towards Dugu Lin!

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - The Limit
chapters.content:
Chapter 579: The Limit
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
During the battle, the duo exchanged attacks. On several occasions, Wang Baole was in the lead, and on the other, Dugu Lin was leading. Until now, with this suppressive force that appeared suddenly, Wang Baole leaped into the air and charged towards Dugu Lin, unleashing his force once again!
He was so fast that it was as if he was passing through the emptiness. When he emerged, he unleashed his Dark Core, and instantly, a Dark Fire emerged from his body, forming a sea of fire outside his body!
This sea of fire was black in color. It didn’t give off a high temperature but a chill that seemed to be able to seal everything. Crackling sounds were produced continuously, as if the ground, the firmament, and the space between the two of them were instantly frozen!
Immediately, Dugu Lin’s trembling mind and his messy cultivation were thrown into further chaos by the Dark Fire. Fresh blood spewed from his mouth once again, and controlling his body, he retreated and widened the distance between him and Wang Baole. However, Wang Baole continued to pick up speed and didn’t stop in his tracks. As the Dark Fire was unleashed, he raised his right hand, and a look of ferocity flashed across his eyes as he chanted two words in his heart!
Soul Guidance!
Dark Art Soul Guidance!
Instantly, a huge blurry hand extended from Wang Baole’s chest, as if struggling from hell. When it appeared, the surrounding Dark Fire was instantly drawn to it. It seemed as if strong winds were blowing, not to extinguish the Dark Fire but to boost it!
The next moment, the Dark Fire burned with greater intensity, spreading in all directions. As the Soul Guiding Hand emerged, the Dark Fire was being drawn in, forming a gigantic hand that was thousands of feet wide!
Even though the gigantic hand was somewhat blurry, it carried an aura that made Dugu Lin tremble in shock. Wang Baole’s attacks were unanticipated and extremely vicious. From afar, the combination of the Dark Fire and Soul Guidance, which formed the gigantic hand, was now carrying an imposing force from Wang Baole’s body, grabbing towards Dugu Lin as it neared him!
At this crucial juncture, Dugu Lin didn’t have time to consider too much. The strong sense of life-and-death crisis caused the pale golden glow in his eyes to be replaced by a blood-red color. When the Soul Guiding Hand approached, Dugu Lin exclaimed loudly!
“The second seal is to be opened for the time of ten breaths!”
When Dugu Lin said those words, a force that seemed to have accumulated in his body for a long time was instantly unleashed. It was a ferocious force, ten times more powerful than what he had unleashed previously. As he rose up, Dugu Lin seemed to have been transformed into the sea, his force turning into a vortex that then created a hurricane and tornado that swept in all directions!
Loud booms reverberated between the heavens and earth. The hurricane grew bigger, spreading a distance of a thousand feet and was extremely imposing!
Wang Baole’s Soul Guiding Hand vibrated, and it couldn’t continue grabbing as it began to be destroyed. A strong sense of crisis arose in Wang Baole’s mind. He didn’t hesitate and retreated immediately.
As he retreated, Wang Baole could finally see that in the middle of the thousand-foot-wide hurricane, while the figure that rose into the sky was still Dugu Lin, something was different!
His hair was flying in the wind, and it was no longer a pale gold color in his eyes. Instead, it was a rich gold color that was spreading throughout his body, making his entire body shimmer with a golden glow. A suppressive force that was growing increasingly stronger by the moment was spreading, and he was like a combat god!
However, that wasn’t what shocked Wang Baole. What really made him gasp in shock was that Dugu Lin, who was glowing with a golden glow, caused the extremely powerful force that was ten times what he had unleashed previously, as well as the thousand-foot-wide hurricane, to disappear the moment he raised his right hand!
It was completely retracted and vanished entirely. It was as if he were standing in mid-air but didn’t give off an aura. In Wang Baole’s Spiritual Sense, there was no trace of it ever existing!
This instantly made Wang Baole hold his breath. A sense of crisis that was several times what he had experienced before exploded in him. Vaguely, it felt like all the cells in his body were trembling, telling him to avoid the person before him!
Similarly, the surrounding spectators, including the Dao Palace cultivators outside, were also shocked. However, even before their shock could be translated into sound, Dugu Lin moved!
Unlike previously, he didn’t open his mouth to speak. Instead, he stepped out in silence, and as Wang Baole was gripped with shock and wanted to avoid him, Dugu Lin appeared before Wang Baole!
Very simply, a punch landed on him!
Visually, this punch seemed like nothing compared to the Nine Dragon Punch. However, it felt ten times more dangerous to Wang Baole. He was unable to avoid it. It was as if he had been frozen, and as if this punch was fated to land on him!
This was because Dugu Lin, who had unlocked the second seal, had a combat power that completely suppressed Wang Baole’s physical body, focus, cultivation, and force!
Wang Baole only managed to raise the right hand of the Flame Snatch Thearch Armor to resist the attack. Both the collective force and the boost from Thearch Armor were unleashed at this moment. However, in the next instance, when Dugu Lin’s fist landed, Wang Baole trembled vigorously. It was as if a cruiser traveling at high speed had collided with him. Amidst the loud boom, the right hand of Thearch Armor was destroyed!
Fresh blood spewed out of his mouth, and Wang Baole leveraged on the force to retreat. However, even before he could take more steps back, the silent Dugu Lin neared him and landed the second punch!
This time, it landed on Wang Baole’s Thearch Armor’s chest. Crackling sounds reverberated in all directions as Wang Baole’s Thearch Armor was destroyed and broken into pieces. Dugu Lin’s third punch landed on Wang Baole’s chest that was exposed by the broken Thearch Armor without hesitation!
It was so powerful that Wang Baole could only see his vision darken. As he vomited blood, his body seemed to have lost all form of control and was forced to retreat by the punch. He was like a kite that had been detached from its string as he landed on the twin peaks, specifically, the peak that represented him!
Amidst the loud boom, the mountain began to crack apart and crumble. Numerous broken rocks were formed, and Wang Baole, who was laying there, was in a semiconscious state as blood continued to flow out continuously from his mouth. Dugu Lin’s attack didn’t end there!
Dugu Lin approached and punched him once again!
This punch was not targeted at Wang Baole but on the ground beside him. The rocks were turned into ash, and the ground shook, resulting in a ricochet whose force landed on Wang Baole’s body. It caused his body to jump up from the ground, towards the night sky!
After that, Dugu Lin leaped up and caught up with Wang Baole. His body appeared above Wang Baole. He was expressionless as he lowered his head and looked at Wang Baole with a chill in his eyes, before landing the fifth punch on him!
That punch was even more powerful, especially when complemented with his astonishing speed. It formed a suppressive force that harnessed the Heaven and Earth powers, and when it landed, Wang Baole’s Thearch Armor was entirely destroyed. With an even greater speed, his body landed on the ground, forming a large basin-shaped depression in the ground!
Fresh blood no longer spewed out just from Wang Baole’s mouth but from everywhere on his body. He was almost unconscious. Dugu Lin, who had unlocked the second seal, was so powerful that it was beyond imagination. Even a Nascent Soul realm cultivator would be extremely frightened and shocked by it.
However, Wang Baole didn’t give up. The green lotus turned maniacal as it endlessly repaired his body. Wang Baole opened his eyes while gasping, looking at Dugu Lin, who was in mid-air.
“Wang Baole!” Dugu Lin lowered his head and didn’t show a trace of emotion in his eyes as he looked calmly at Wang Baole, who was struggling to stand up on the ground.
“Next is my sixth punch, which is also the peak of my force. I advise you to concede defeat, as if you choose to persevere, you would die without a doubt. However, it is also possible that between the state of life and death, you would unleash your full potential!”
“I have witnessed a similar scenario previously, and it all depends on your fate!” With that, Dugu Lin raised his right hand and grabbed. Instantly, a scream emerged from behind him. A giant ape first transmogrified, followed by a nine-headed black dragon, then the vermillion bird and the Kun Peng. The figures of the four beasts took up the entire sky, enveloping Dugu Lin before interweaving with each other and transforming into a large illusory fist. They each screamed and intertwined with each other!
Looking at everything from a distance, the fist was like the firmament, extremely imposing, as if harnessing the Heavenly Tribulation and charging towards Wang Baole!
The ten breaths ended!

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - Slimmed Down!
chapters.content:
Chapter 580: Slimmed Down!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Even though the ten breaths had ended, the punch was still unleashed with a powerful force that seemed like it represented the powers of heaven. Right now, as it arrived, it suppressed everything. It caused the ground to shake as cracks appeared, and that was the case for the surrounding mountains as well. That was especially so for the spectating cultivators who were all shocked as they retreated. Zhao Yameng and Kong Dao, who were watching everything, were both extremely anxious.
However, there was no way they could help, and neither could they participate. In reality, the battle between Wang Baole and Dugu Lin, having reached the current stage, was no longer on the level of Core Formation realm cultivators. It was closer to that of the Nascent Soul realm, just that they could probably demonstrate more types of spells.
“He still lost...?” Outside the training grounds, everyone who was watching the battle was shocked. Wang Baole lay amongst the broken rocks, looking at the giant fist arriving from the skies above him, his lips curled into a bitter smile. However, in the depths of his eyes, a desire to fight was hidden!
I still have one move that I haven’t used!
Wang Baole’s breathing quickened. Until now, Little Missy didn’t say anything throughout the battle. However, Wang Baole knew clearly that Little Missy wasn’t hibernating. She was watching his battle!
Naturally, the move that Wang Baole had never used wasn’t Little Missy, it was his intrinsic scabbard!
It was the first true treasure that Wang Baole had refined. In the words of Little Missy, it was an intrinsic treasure that could slay anything. Under the nurturing environment in Wang Baole’s body, other than releasing mosquitoes, it didn’t seem to have other uses.
Wang Baole had never considered using it before, but now... A chilly glow flashed across his eyes. The moment the Four Beast Punch neared him from the skies, the green lotus in Wang Baole’s body shook violently, injecting him with life and allowing him to recover from his severe injuries quickly. Even though he was suppressed by Dugu Lin, which made his recovery slow and incomplete, it was sufficient to give Wang Baole enough energy to unleash his never-before-used move!
Instantly, Wang Baole’s heart burned with the desire for combat, which was extremely strong. He shouted, and green veins bulged on his forehead. His left hand slammed on the broken rocks and broke them with a bang. He leveraged on the force and leaped into the air. Instead of retreating, he charged forward towards the approaching Four Beast Punch!
That scene immediately gripped all the spectators around him and outside with shock. They watched on, dumbfounded, as Wang Baole charged towards the Four Beast Punch as if courting death!
As Wang Baole caught the attention of everyone, both outside and on the trial grounds, the Four Beast Punch was a mere hundred feet from him when he raised his head and grabbed his chest!
With that, a brilliant glow emerged instantly from Wang Baole’s chest, revealing an end of the scabbard. In the blink of an eye, as Wang Baole screamed painfully, a complete scabbard was pulled out from within his body!
The scabbard was an antique and had never been seen in civilization. Now that it emerged, the firmament was transformed, and the winds and clouds churned. Even the trial grounds trembled. It was clearly just a sixth-grade Dharmic treasure and not a Dharmic Armament, but when it appeared, it seemed to be able to influence the entire ancient greenish-bronze sword. This culminated in an indescribable force that concentrated in the trial grounds, from Wang Baole’s scabbard!
Very vaguely, Wang Baole had a strong feeling that there was an invisible sword in the scabbard that he couldn’t see. Even though he wanted to pull it out, something seemed to be lacking!
It was just short of something!
Wang Baole didn’t have time to feel regret and didn’t have time to ponder over it. Right now, without hesitation, he gave up the thought of pulling out the sword. Instead, he used the scabbard as a sword, slaying the incoming Four Beast Punch!
Instantly, the brilliance was like an eternity that soon vanished at that moment. Initially, there was still light under the night sky, but right now, all the light had disappeared. It was as if the act of flailing the sword caused all light to be sucked away, leaving behind the scabbard that had made contact with the Four Beast Punch under the sky!
Loud booms that sounded like the angry roars of the world filled the training grounds, while a maniacal force spread in all directions like a wave. As it spread, Wang Baole trembled, spewing large volumes of blood from his mouth. His body landed on the ground due to the suppressive force of the Four Beast Punch, but he still held the scabbard in his hands tightly, a frightening look on his face as he continued to resist!
That extremely powerful Four Beast Punch didn’t become devastated with the slaying of the scabbard, but it vibrated strongly, and it could no longer suppress Wang Baole!
It was blocked by the scabbard!
The scabbard seemed to magnify Wang Baole’s power, allowing him to withstand the force of the Four Beast Punch. Right now, looking from a distance, the entire scene was a frightening image. The large and powerful Four Beast Punch was only one man’s length away from the ground. Under that gigantic fist was Wang Baole, who was gripping onto the scabbard and preventing the fist from landing on him!
He was like an extremely hardy stone that was blocking the wheels of fate. As he suppressed it, the wheel couldn’t successfully destroy everything!
It was already Wang Baole’s limit, having achieved all of that. His hand that held onto the scabbard was trembling, and the green lotus in his body was shaking. Life energy was released on a scale that was never seen before as it tried to restore Wang Baole’s body. As a result, it couldn’t relax one bit, as if he did so, he would be completely crushed. His only choice was to persevere.
However, very soon, his body couldn’t withstand it any longer. As cracks appeared on his skin and on his bones, the force from the fist caused Wang Baole to be unable to catch his breath. His body was continuously torn apart and continuously repaired, but it was difficult for him to last long.
Even his Lightning Core began to crack at this moment. This was the case for his Dark Core as well. The cracks grew larger. If it were to continue, his two cores would be destroyed, his cultivation would be wiped out, and his Core Formation realm would crumble!
His consciousness grew increasingly blurry at this moment. He seemed to have heard some voices, some familiar, some foreign, but all anxiously screaming for him to give up and concede defeat!
How can I concede defeat? My Dao doesn’t allow me to concede defeat. My ambitions don’t allow me to concede defeat... I, Wang Baole, would never concede defeat, ever!
As Wang Baole screamed in his heart, the cracks in his Dark Core and Lightning Core grew wider. His body showed signs of breaking down. The repair of his body by the green lotus couldn’t keep up.
However, just as his body was about to break apart, as his will continued to burn, and as he was suppressed to the maximum, the devouring seed in his body was suddenly unleashed with a loud boom!
It didn’t absorb the force from outside. Instead, in this life-and-death crisis, the devouring seed swallowed the green lotus, as well as the Dark Core and Lightning Core. They didn’t vanish and were instead integrated with the devouring seed for the second time!
The first integration happened when the green lotus was first planted on the devouring seed, and equilibrium was reached. Right now, at this life-and-death juncture, the devouring seed was unleashed. After taking everything in, it still felt insufficient, which was why it began absorbing Wang Baole’s body. His originally rotund body could be visibly seen slimming down swiftly. In the blink of an eye, the Wang Baole that appeared before others...
It was no longer a rotund body, but one that had entirely slimmed down. He had a long body, well-defined eyebrows, and sharp eyes. Coupled with the well-chiseled face and loose clothing, Wang Baole appeared extremely handsome right now. Perhaps it was due to the significant contrast with how he looked previously, but everyone who saw him was surprised by the transformation in his physique. The Wang Baole right now was extremely eye-catching!
Even Zhuo Yifan, who was considered handsome in the Federation, conceded defeat to Wang Baole’s handsomeness. That was because Wang Baole had something he didn’t have—defiance, an overbearing attitude, and a power that could destroy everything!
All this made the current Wang Baole look handsome, yet a little sinister. His charisma was instantly boosted, and even Li Yi, the Federation Seedling outside, was bewildered.
At this moment, as the devouring seed was in the process of backlash, the process of reverse nourishment also began!
Wang Baole’s cultivation was instantly activated, his force growing stronger from an initially weak state. It reached the peak of the mid-stage Core Formation realm and entered into the late-stage Core Formation realm. He broke through with a bang!
That wasn’t the end. After entering the late-stage Core Formation realm, the devouring seed continued to nourish him, and his cultivation was boosted again. In a short period of time, his cultivation reached the peak late-stage and was just a small step away from perfection!
This scene shocked Dugu Lin, as well as everyone inside and outside the trial grounds!
“Breakthrough in the midst of battle!”
As the people exclaimed and gasped in shock, Wang Baole’s cultivation was activated, and all his injuries were healed instantly. He regained the power that he had lost, and his power was now several times that of what it was previously. Waves of astonishing forces were released from his body, and it was as if it were capable of destroying the heavens. The hand that was gripping the scabbard no longer trembled and was instead extremely steady. Amid Dugu Lin’s disbelief, Wang Baole raised his head, looking past the Four Beast Punch before him and directly at Dugu Lin within it!
“I do not concede defeat!” Wang Baole spoke softly, a frightening desire for combat clearly evident in his eyes!

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - Drawing the Sword!
chapters.content:
Chapter 581: Drawing the Sword!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Wang Baole, at the mid-stage Core Formation realm, was someone who could unleash Dugu Lin’s first level seal and battle it at an equal level. However, he wasn’t someone who could make Dugu Lin unleash his second level seal.
However, right now, everything had changed. As the devouring seed devoured and counter-nourished, Wang Baole achieved a breakthrough in his cultivation, reaching the late-stage Core Formation realm. He was only a small step away from entering the perfected Core Formation realm!
That form of breakthrough was also a leap in terms of physical qualities. Right now, not only did it allow Wang Baole’s injuries to fully recover, but it also caused all the cultivation in his body to send shock waves in all directions.
The Lightning Core and Dark Core could no longer be seen in his body, as everything, including the green lotus, was inside the devouring seed. Wang Baole could feel their presence and that they were undergoing a form of transformation that even he couldn’t describe accurately. However, he knew that the transformation wouldn’t be disadvantageous for him!
Instead, he would stand to gain greatly when the transformation had been completed!
However, these issues weren’t the ones that Wang Baole had to focus on right now. As he raised his head and the glow of battle flashed across his eyes, his Lightning Avatar appeared once again, layering on top of his body and causing his combat capabilities to be further boosted!
What followed was the Flame Snatch Thearch Armor that Dugu Lin had crushed previously. It reappeared in the next instant, and blood-colored meridians appeared, spreading in all directions and causing Wang Baole’s aura to explode with three times the force!
His will resonated with his cultivation technique, augmenting him by two times!
In the end, with all the boosts, an aura that seemed capable of destroying the heavens and earth was formed. That force eventually culminated in his right fist, forming a punch that landed directly on Dugu Lin’s Four Beast Punch!
“Break!”
The heavens and earth tumbled, and the winds churned, shaking the entire area. Amidst the shock of the surrounding cultivators and those on the outside, that seemingly unbreakable Four Beast Punch instantly showed signs of breaking down. The first to be devastated were the four beasts inside. The giant ape, the vermillion bird, the nine dragons, and the Kun Peng roared pitifully. They couldn’t withstand the impact any longer as they were torn apart by the violent winds. It was then that Dugu Lin, who was pale with shock, was revealed, and he scrambled to retreat with blood spewing out of his mouth.
He looked surprised and was filled with indignation in his heart. The combination of shock and indignation didn’t evoke a sense of weakness, but a desire to battle. Even though he wasn’t able to open his second level seal for too long without it causing irreversible damage to him, at this moment, Dugu Lin still chose to lift the seal!
“The second seal is to be opened for the time of ten additional breaths!”
Just as Dugu Lin sealed his hands and spoke, the aura from his body erupted once again, forming a hurricane that was swiftly controlled. Like previously, it demonstrated a powerful force as it exploded from Dugu Lin’s body. As a chilly glow flashed across his eyes, he turned and charged towards Wang Baole!
That punishing aura that seemed to replace that of the firmament was produced again, causing the sky to be transformed into a large vortex. Dugu Lin, who was charging towards Wang Baole at high speed, was at the center of it!
Seeing that Dugu Lin was about to attack again, the spectators outside the trial grounds watched solemnly with their eyes widened. Wang Baole appeared as calm as he had ever been as he looked at the approaching Dugu Lin, murmuring softly.
“I really want to know if right now, I can withdraw... the sword that I feel is hidden in the scabbard!” Wang Baole smiled, and without looking at the fast-approaching Dugu Lin, he held the scabbard in his left hand. After taking a deep breath, he shut his eyes and gripped his right hand on top of the scabbard. He seemed to have gripped onto thin air, but if there were indeed a sword, the area that he grabbed would be the sword handle!
The moment Wang Baole’s hand gripped onto that area, everything seemed to have vanished in Wang Baole’s world. There was no more Dugu Lin, no more trial grounds, no more Vast Expanse Dao Palace, and no more green lotus. There was only the invisible sword that he vaguely felt was hidden in the scabbard!
Sword, rise!
In the mind of Wang Baole, who had his eyes shut, a sword had appeared. He imagined himself withdrawing it, and all those thoughts were transformed into a sense of touch in his right hand. He twisted his right hand out, and at that moment, change happened!
The entire trial grounds shook. Even the Vast Expanse Dao Palace outside was shaking vigorously. Mie Liezi, Feng Qiuran, and Daoist You Ran all stood up. They were completely filled with shock, and right now, even the ancient greenish-bronze sword shook slightly!
An invisible force seemed to be pulling on the vast ancient greenish-bronze sword, pulling it out of the sun!
Regrettably, that force was too weak and was unable to accomplish that feat. It could only move it slightly, but even so, even though Wang Baole still couldn’t pull out the invisible sword in the scabbard, he maintained his posture and the effect that he produced still caused the scabbard to shake violently, unleashing an extremely powerful force!
The force couldn’t be seen or felt, but the moment it emerged, it formed a formidable sword intent that could shock everyone. The sword intent was directed towards the approaching Dugu Lin!
Even though the second level seal had been opened, Dugu Lin, who was extremely powerful, still trembled. A strong sense of impending life-and-death crisis that he hadn’t felt for a long time instantly flooded his mind. Amidst his shock, Dugu Lin had a strong premonition that if he continued to advance, he would die without a doubt!
In his fear, Dugu Lin retreated. However, it was still too late. As Wang Baole opened his eyes, a sword projection flashed across his pupils!
An invisible sword projection charged towards Dugu Lin, its ferocity extreme. Dugu Lin, with bitterness in his heart, didn’t hesitate and unleashed his third level seal, which he had originally not wished to unleash!
As the seal was lifted, Dugu Lin’s hair grew. The golden glow in his eyes was replaced by a black glow. It was as if he had been transformed into a black hole that was releasing a frightening aura. He sealed his hands and put in all his effort to block the incoming sword projection!
Images of god beasts transmogrified behind him. They all roared and maniacally charged towards the incoming sword projection!
He opened the first level seal without much thought. As for the second level seal, the most he could open it for was the time of ten breaths. Furthermore, opening it caused severe damage to his body. On the other hand, the third seal... could only be opened when his cultivation technique was pushed to the limits. Even though his previous efforts wouldn’t be made futile if the third seal was opened before that, it could break the force that he had been accumulating and prevent him from continuing. He could only choose to breakthrough in advance while in seclusion!
Dugu Lin never wanted to open his third level seal initially. His goal was to surpass the Nascent Soul realm and enter the Soul Conduit realm. However, right now, with his life on the line, he was forced to open the third seal with bitterness in his heart!
Even though the third level seal was opened, it could only allow him to survive in the face of the sword projection!
Instantly, the sword projection neared. Like an autumn wind that blew off the leaves of a tree, the sword projection destroyed all the illusory images of the god beasts and landed heavily on Dugu Lin’s body with an extremely strong force. Blood spewed out of Dugu Lin, and his body tumbled and fell backwards, pushing him back to the second level seal. The black color in his eyes returned to a gold color. Even then, it didn’t end as blood spewed from his body again. The second level seal was devastated, and his eyes were transformed into a pale gold color!
That wasn’t the end. At that moment, the first level seal was broken apart as well. The aura from his body weakened, and his body landed heavily and loudly on the Blood Peak that represented him, crumbling it. He was thrown to the brink of death before a mouthful of fresh blood spewed from his mouth. That was when the sword projection dissipated!
There was silence all around. Both outside and within the trial grounds, everyone stood dumbfounded. Wang Baole sighed softly in his heart. He was still unable to withdraw the sword in the end. No one but him knew that the sword projection that was seen previously was the only one that the scabbard had accumulated so far!
If he wanted to unleash it again, he would need to accumulate it for a period of time.
As he sighed, Wang Baole raised his head and stepped out. When he appeared, he stood in front of Dugu Lin, lowering his head but not speaking.
Dugu Lin laughed pitifully as he struggled to raise his right hand. He grabbed in the direction of a key and mountainous rocks a distance away, and the key flew instantly to Wang Baole.
“You win!”

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - The Top Person!
chapters.content:
Chapter 582: The Top Person!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After grabbing hold of the key, Wang Baole didn’t speak a word. Instead, he stood on the rock beside Dugu Lin and raised his head to look at the night sky, where ripple-like waves were spreading in all directions. That caused the night sky map to be blurred and slightly warped. That wasn’t the first time something similar had happened in the night sky. It had happened once twelve hours ago, and that was... a sign that the teleportation was about to occur.
“This is the end.” Wang Baole spoke softly while retracting his gaze from the night sky and lowering his head to calmly look at Dugu Lin, who was lying there. Wang Baole shook his head as he looked at his opponent, who had blood flowing out of his body and who was struggling to even stand up. Wang Baole shook his head, and based simply on his life experiences and not the teachings of the high officials’ autobiographies, he naturally extended his hand to Dugu Lin.
Dugu Lin, who had lost all his strength and was still struggling to stand up, was momentarily surprised when he saw Wang Baole extending his right hand towards him. He was silent for a while before laughing suddenly. Without even wiping off the blood from the corner of his mouth, he grabbed onto Wang Baole’s right hand. Even though his body was still trembling, when he grabbed hold of Wang Baole’s hand, Wang Baole pulled, and Dugu Lin managed to sit up.
The pulling seemed to have affected Dugu Lin’s injuries slightly, and he twisted his mouth. He looked at Wang Baole while panting, his eyes carrying a mix of complexity, emotion, and relatability.
“Are there others in your Federation who are as capable as you?” Dugu Lin couldn’t help but ask.
“In terms of looks, if I, Wang Baole, claim to be number two, no one would dare to claim that they are number one! However, if it was in terms of combat capabilities, there are many who could defeat me.” Wang Baole raised his head and spoke calmly. If those words were said by someone else, they would have felt embarrassed. However, as Wang Baole had hypnotized himself countless times, he truly believed what he said about his own appearance. That was especially so as, right now, he had really lost weight!
Dugu Lin hadn’t interacted with Wang Baole previously, and now that he heard those words, he was visibly thrown into a blur. With a weird expression on his face, a loud boom was heard, reverberating within the trial grounds. As the power of teleportation grew stronger, and as everyone was still in a state of surprise after having watched the process and ending of the battle, the teleportation... began!
That was the second teleportation that had happened in the trial grounds. Everyone who didn’t possess a key would be eliminated, and right now, Wang Baole was the only one there who had a key.
Seeing that the teleportation had begun, and as he felt the force of teleportation and rejection from the trial grounds, Dugu Lin took a deep breath. He dazedly looked at Wang Baole, who had obviously slimmed down, before nodding his head at him.
“The definition of beauty in your Federation... Hah, I understand now. There should have been deep hatred between us.” Dugu Lin spoke softly before shaking his head. He wasn’t someone who didn’t dare to concede defeat. Even though there was a huge price to pay for this battle, whatever had happened had happened. Soon, a desire to battle burned in his eyes again, and he looked at Wang Baole and spoke.
“Wang Baole, this has been an exhilarating battle. I will go into seclusion after returning. You must work hard too, as I will battle you again once I emerge from seclusion!” As Dugu Lin spoke, the intention to battle grew stronger in his eyes. His body began to turn blurry as the teleportation array formation was activated, but the adamant desire for battle was something that the teleportation array formation couldn’t remove.
“I’ll await our next battle!” Wang Baole spoke calmly, and Dugu Lin laughed. His body turned into a blur completely and disappeared. At the same time, the surrounding on-lookers were also being turned into a blur. However, before they were teleported away, they bowed at Wang Baole with cupped fists, without prior agreement with each other.
Their eyes carried a complex look of respect and awe. That was because they understood deeply that, from now on, no one would dare be scornful of the name ‘Wang Baole’. Even though there were some who were unwilling to concede, they still had to be courteous to him, at least on the surface. After all, the survival of the fittest was how the Dao Palace worked!
People continually disappeared, including Zhao Yameng and Kong Dao, who vanished with happiness and excitement in their eyes, until Wang Baole became the only person left on the trial grounds!
There was nothing else remaining between the heavens and earth within the trial grounds. That quietness calmed Wang Baole instantly. He raised his head to look at the night sky, recalling everything that had happened since entering the trial grounds. Gradually, a peculiar glow appeared in his eyes, and he asked silently in his heart.
“Little Missy, is it possible that once I become more powerful, my intrinsic scabbard could hold the ancient greenish-bronze sword within it?”
Little Missy, who didn’t react ever since Wang Baole entered the trial grounds, was silent for a brief moment before she spoke softly into Wang Baole’s mind.
“Yes!”
Wang Baole smiled. Without hesitation, he stepped forward. As he was the only person remaining in the trial grounds, the trial had ended with the other people being teleportation away. The teleportation array formation didn’t dissipate like the day before and was instead waiting for Wang Baole to step into it.
As he stepped forward, he seemed to have crossed into thin air from the mountains. His body turned blurry, starting from his legs. When his limbs and body had vanished completely, the trial that everyone in the Dao Palace had placed great emphasis on was concluded!
Wang Baole saw nothing but a blur. When the teleportation ended, and as everything before his eyes regained clarity, he saw the unique appearance of the Dao Palace’s skies, the Sea of Fire in the distance, the great hall at the peak of the mountain, and the gazes that everyone had laid on him as he stood in the public square!
Of those people, there was Zhou Chudao, Dugu Lin, and others whom he had defeated, as well as Zhao Yameng, Kong Dao, and the other Federation Seedlings. However, regardless of whether Wang Baole knew them or not, at that moment, their eyes were all on him. That was the case for those Nascent Soul realm cultivators, as well as Mie Liezi and company.
There was silence in the public square.
Even though Wang Baole was from the Federation, he had managed to demonstrate a combat power that deeply shocked most Dao Palace disciples, many of whom were elites themselves. However, there were still a few of them who felt jealous of Wang Baole, though they didn’t show it on their faces. After all, right now, Wang Baole was different from before!
It wasn’t an exaggeration to call him the top person after defeating Zhou Chudao and Dugu Lin!
Even those Nascent Soul realm cultivators looked at Wang Baole with a profound look in their eyes. Without a doubt, the wave that had been produced from the battle between Wang Baole and Dugu Lin had surpassed that of the Core Formation realm and had reached the standards of the Nascent Soul realm!
They respected such an elite. Even Mie Liezi, who was looking extremely solemn, carried a look of appreciation towards Wang Baole when he looked at him. However, he still felt regret and pity that such a talent didn’t belong to his lineage.
As for Daoist You Ran, he had his eyes closed while smiling. No one knew what he was thinking about in his mind.
Amidst everyone’s silence, Wang Baole took a slow, deep breath before bowing deeply with cupped fists at Feng Qiuran and company who were in the higher seats!
His greeting made Feng Qiuran feel a torrent of emotions. She stood up immediately, and Mie Liezi also rose slowly while sighing, followed by Daoist You Ran. With the three of them standing up, the Nascent Soul realm cultivators also followed suit, and that was the same for all the other disciples who were around!
“Ring the bell!” Feng Qiuran spoke without waiting for Mie Liezi. If it were some other scenario, Mie Liezi would definitely be displeased. However, right now, the fact that he didn’t say anything meant that he silently approved of Feng Qiuran’s action.
“Congratulations to my disciple, Wang Baole, for placing first in the trial for the Hyacinthus Tree leaves. You will be given three Hyacinthus Tree leaves and can distribute them according to your own preferences!” Feng Qiuran smiled warmly as the ringing of the bell reverberated throughout the entire Dao Palace.
The sound of the bell was loud and spread in all directions. That caused ripples in Wang Baole’s heart, who had become the center of attention of the masses. He looked at Zhao Yameng and company and smiled, before greeting Feng Qiuran and company with cupped fists again!
“Thank you, Elders!”
As Wang Baole spoke, cheers erupted from the Federation Seedlings. The cheers reverberated, and the other Dao Palace disciples recovered from the silence as well. They experienced different emotions as they began to talk, and some of them even took the initiative to begin a conversation with the Federation Seedlings. Amidst the buzzing activity on the public square, Xie Haiyang, who was within the crowd, also began to reap his gains from the bets that he had made with excitement.
Someone also brought up the three bowls that Xie Haiyang had turned over back then. Xie Haiyang laughed and flipped the first bowl over. There was a jade slip under the bowl, and the words ‘Wang Baole’ were written on it!
Then, the second and third bowl were also turned over. Similarly, the words ‘Wang Baole’ were also written on them!

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - It’s Different!
chapters.content:
Chapter 583: It’s Different!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Amidst Xie Haiyang’s delight, amidst the complex emotions and awe that the people on the public square felt towards Xie Haiyang, amidst the reverberation of the bell ring, and with Feng Qiuran announcing the results, the trial had finally concluded.
What followed would be the trip to the Worship Palace Pavilion. However, the Worship Palace Pavilion was located in the body region of the sword and was extremely far from their current location. Even though there was an array formation in the Vast Expanse Dao Palace that could teleport them there directly, it required a lot of preparation in order to open it each time. They still needed to wait for a period of time before the array formation was ready for the teleportation process.
Regardless of that, Wang Baole, who now held the Hyacinthus Tree leaves, had a different status and identity in the Vast Expanse Dao Palace after the trial!
However, Wang Baole didn’t stay long on the main island of the Dao Palace. Instead, he left after Feng Qiuran announced the results. Even to Wang Baole, the trial was extremely dangerous. Had he not been able to unleash his potential at the last moment, it would be impossible for him to defeat Dugu Lin.
Furthermore, as he had just achieved a breakthrough in his cultivation, he needed to stabilize it. Feng Qiuran understood that clearly, and therefore, before Wang Baole left, she generously passed Wang Baole a bottle of pills that could consolidate his cultivation.
The pills were expensive and were suitable for both cultivation and healing injuries. Wang Baole expressed his gratitude for the pills before leaving with Zhuo Yifan, Zhao Yameng, and Kong Dao. Many other agitated Federation Seedlings also followed them.
After exchanging greetings with the other people outside the Dao Palace doors, Wang Baole turned and stepped into the air, leaving the main island of the Dao Palace and charging towards his Green Fire Island. The Federation Seedlings sent him off.
Zhao Yameng and company also dispersed to return to their own cave abode after Wang Baole left. Even with their departure, the trial didn’t become an event of the past so quickly. It continued to spread between the Dao Palace disciples and became the topic of conversation amongst them.
Wang Baole didn’t care about those matters. Right now, he unleashed his full speed and returned to Green Fire Island, stepping directly into the cave abode to enter seclusion. He meditated with his legs crossed to cultivate, and also checked on his devouring seed in detail.
The green lotus is gone, and so is the Lightning Core and the Dark Core...
Wang Baole was troubled as he recalled the final transformation of the devouring seed at the last moments of the trial. Even though he vaguely felt that the transformation benefited him, he couldn’t help but scratch his head when he thought about it. After pondering for a moment, he tapped into his Spiritual Sense to find out what exactly was going on inside the devouring seed.
As his Spiritual Sense spread and entered the interior of the devouring seed, he soon saw a pitch-black emptiness before his eyes. He didn’t know how big it was, but it was extremely quiet and vast. There was only a green lotus shaking in that emptiness...
Looking at the green lotus, as well as the Dark Core and Lightning Core on it, Wang Baole heaved a sigh of relief. However, he couldn’t figure out how to take them out.
