Wang Baole didn’t hesitate. He activated the Eye of the Eternal Star and teleported himself away, appearing above the spirit boat just as it was about to disappear. Upon his reappearance, he immediately sensed an incredible heat around him and the burning hand reaching out for him!
There was nowhere for him to hide and nothing that he could do to evade the attack. His cultivation had been suppressed completely, and he had lost all ability to defend himself. As death approached, Wang Baole steeled himself and decided to make a final gamble. He bet that the paper human cutout in his storage ring would come to his aid!
At that very critical moment, the paper human cutout in his storage ring suddenly let loose a burst of creepy laughter.
It was a laughter that only Wang Baole could hear inside his head. As it echoed inside Wang Baole’s mind, someone else struck. It wasn’t the paper human cutout inside his storage ring, but... the paper human cutout on the spirit boat that was fading away steadily. The ferryman lifted its head suddenly and jerked the paper oar in its right hand up slightly.
A huge white wave appeared out of nowhere and fell over Wang Baole instantly. It formed a protective barrier before him as it collided with the burning hand.
A thunderous boom rumbled in the cosmos, and the burning hand disintegrated. Fury and incredulity rose within Daoist Lin Hai as he watched the white wave that the paper human cutout had summoned sweep Wang Baole away and take him safely onto the boat.
“Impossible!”
“Long Nanzi!”
“What’s going on?”
“You!”
The first exclamation came from Daoist Lin Hai. The shock he was currently experiencing was indescribable. Never in his wildest dreams would he have imagined that the Fallen Star Envoy would lend its aid. This was something that was completely out of this world. He had never heard of something like that happening before.
The second exclamation came from the patriarch of the Divine Sovereign Justice Sect. He was completely dumbfounded by Wang Baole’s boldness and insanity.
The third wave of exclamation came from the other chosen ones on the boat. Not all of them had exclaimed in shock, only the dozen newer arrivals had voiced their surprise. What was unfolding before them had stunned them. At the same time, they were also aware of the strange expressions of the other passengers on the boat. Those looks appeared tinged with exasperation and resentment. What was completely absent was shock.
The fourth exclamation came from another passenger who was currently on the boat as well. It was Xing Ling. The excitement that he had experienced earlier died as he watched Wang Baole step onto the boat and, without any hesitation, charge at him. The Emperor Armor materialized instantly, and the glare of the Divine Armament blinded him as the blade slashed mercilessly at him!

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - was given a spot!
chapters.content:
Chapter 918: was given a spot!
From the moment Wang Baole appeared, and the star Almighty Daoist Linhai stepped in to stop him, to the moment when the paper figurine on the boat waved the paper oars, to the moment when Wang Baole stepped onto the boat along with the white waves that were stirred up.., he charged straight towards the prodigy of the purple gold civilization, Xing Ling. Everything happened in an instant!
All the changes happened so quickly that it caught people off guard. It was as if they had practiced it countless times. Lightning flashed and thunder rumbled. Amidst the exclamations of the other prodigies on the boat, as well as the roars of the Patriarch of Linhai outside the boat.., wang Baole was like a bolt of lightning. The emperor’s armor materialized, and the divine armament drew a bright arc across the starry sky as it neared... The purple gold prodigy!
If it had been any other perfected Spirit Immortal, they wouldn’t have been able to react in such a sudden turn of events, much less counterattack or Dodge, they would have been caught off guard and killed instantly by Wang Baole’s slash!
However, Xing Ling was the only candidate for the Dao child of the purple gold civilization. The purple gold civilization was nothing in the eyes of the powerful factions, but it was still the overlord of the 19th region, it possessed a wealth of resources that far surpassed the divine eye or the federation. It had conquered other civilizations frequently. With its astonishing resources and battle experience, even though the situation was dangerous and swift.., xing Ling still displayed his extraordinary abilities.
After a moment of shock, he didn’t Dodge. Instead, he instinctively ignited his cultivation!
It wasn’t just his cultivation that was ignited. There was also the fire of life that erupted at that instant, as if it had been overdrawn. As he stood up, he turned into a ball of flames that surged into the sky. With a low roar.., the fire formed a gigantic crimson tiger that pounced towards Wang Baole!
Wang Baole’s pupils constricted. This was the first time he had fought against a prodigy from a major faction, and he immediately felt that it was difficult to deal with. There was no doubt that the prodigies from major factions were clearly much stronger than other cultivators in battle, it wasn’t just in terms of combat strength. There was also a difference in their battle awareness.
However... Wang Baole’s original plan wasn’t to destroy his opponent in both body and soul. Now that his opponent was in such a state, Wang Baole couldn’t guarantee the final outcome. He couldn’t guarantee that he would spare his opponent’s life.
His reaction may be quick, but he doesn’t know what’s good for him. He’s caught himself in a trap! As this thought flashed through Wang Baole’s mind, the two figures on the ship collided with each other.
A loud boom reverberated in the air, spreading in all directions. If one looked from afar, one could clearly see that Wang Baole’s divine armament had landed on the Crimson Tiger’s head and cut it in half, the Crimson Tiger, which had been cut in half, had no energy left to continue. It exploded on its own at that moment, forming a force of impact. It didn’t push Wang baole backward, but... pushed behind the Crimson Tiger, xing Ling, who was in the midst of the flames, retreated abruptly. It was clear that she was trying to widen the distance between them, trying to break away from her previous passivity.
...
A battle with similar cultivation and similar combat strength was in fact a battle for the initiative. Once the opponent grasped the initiative and rhythm, they would lose the initiative, and this passivity would quickly turn into a loss, in fact, they would be defeated in an instant.
Therefore, when the prodigy of the purple gold civilization, Xing Ling, made his move, the other prodigies around him immediately retreated rapidly. At the same time, they couldn’t help but reveal a strange look in their eyes, it was obvious that Xing Ling’s reaction and his decisiveness in burning his cultivation and life at the critical moment had gained some of their approval.
Wang Baole was equally experienced in combat. He had known from a long time ago the importance of taking the initiative. Now that he saw that his opponent was about to retreat, how could he agree? He didn’t want to delay the battle for too long. Even though he was on the boat now.., the paper figurine had helped him arrive, but he didn’t have a spot!
Outside, the Linhai patriarch was filled with rage, causing the surrounding starry skies to distort. He had to obtain the mark as soon as possible. Otherwise... Once he was expelled from the boat, what awaited him would be death!
That was indeed the case. After Wang Baole appeared, he immediately boarded the ship and attacked his chosen one. His attack was too ferocious, and the change was too sudden. The Rage in Patriarch Linhai’s heart was enough to burn the entire God’s eye civilization, as his face was damaged, his cultivation erupted crazily. When he saw his chosen one burning his cultivation, his killing intent and anger towards Wang Baole reached its peak.
“You Little Bastard, you’re courting death!”He growled, the Linhai Patriarch went mad. A gigantic phantom image of a star appeared behind him. The gigantic fireball emitted an indescribable heat and pressure as it charged towards the ghost ship, intending to board it forcefully.
However, the ghost ship was not something that he could touch as a star. If the ship from the fallen star was truly that fragile, then the secret of the fallen star would have long been in the hands of the Weiyang clan. It would no longer be a legendary land, it would become the personal property of the Wei Yang clan.
Therefore, it was destined that all of the actions of the Linhai clan patriarch would be in vain. That was exactly the case. Even though the Linhai clan patriarch had gathered the power of his own star, the ghost ship before him seemed to be transparent, it was as if it didn’t exist in the same space as him. No matter how he attacked, all his divine abilities would only penetrate through it, making it difficult for him to harm it at all!
Seeing this, even though Wang Baole chose to ignore it, the sense of urgency in his heart was still strong. Therefore, while the Purple Gold Civilization’s prodigy, Xing Ling, was filled with killing intent, and as if the rage in his heart was rising rapidly, he used the scarlet tiger to retreat, a cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes. He raised his right hand and took out the megaphone that he had remodeled from his storage bag!
After the modification, the megaphone had surpassed the ninth-grade. It hadn’t reached the level of a divine weapon yet, but it had reached the level where it could adapt to the spirit immortal realm. Wang Baole was especially anxious at the moment, so he didn’t hesitate to damage it, the moment he took it out, he placed it right in front of him and roared with all his might!
Roar!
The roar was like a sudden clap of thunder. After being absorbed by the megaphone, it was channeled with all its might and amplified. It erupted with a frequency that was several times higher than normal, a violent sonic boom and shocking ripples that could be seen with the naked eye were formed.
Cracking sounds could be heard coming from within the megaphone. It was clear that it could not hold on any longer and was operating at an overload rate.
The speed of the ripples was too fast. In the next instant, they covered Xing Ling, who was trying to retreat. The sound was difficult to describe, and it was enough to make anyone who heard it go deaf for a short period of time. It would then affect their minds and cause them to feel dizzy, the minds of all the chosen in the area began to buzz. Their expressions were blank for a moment, then filled with shock and shock.
If they were already in such a state, then there was no need to even mention Xing Ling, who was injured and burning his cultivation base. The instant he was covered by the ripples, he felt as if he had been struck by a powerful force. His body trembled, and he let out a bloodcurdling scream, his Ears lost their hearing instantly, and his vision blurred. An uncontrollable dizziness made him lose his ability to fight.
He wanted to resist, but how could Wang Baole give him the chance? The moment his opponent lost his ability to fight, Wang Baole approached him at lightning speed.
When the Linhai patriarch saw this, his eyes were about to pop out of their sockets, and he let out a low growl.
“You Little Bastard, how dare you snatch the token and hurt someone? I swear that I will destroy all living beings in your god-eye civilization!”
“Are you threatening me?”Wang Baole snorted coldly. He didn’t slow down at all. He reached out with his right hand and grabbed the card in Xing Ling’s hand!
As for Xing Ling, Wang Baole naturally wouldn’t kill him directly. Instead, he raised his right hand and formed a seal. He slapped Xing Ling’s forehead and threw him into his storage bag. Then, he looked outside the ship, his eyes bloodshot, the killing intent seemed to have reached its peak. It was the Linhai Patriarch!
“When I return, when all is well, it will be time to release the chosen one of your race!”
With that, he ignored the unsightly and indescribable Linhai patriarch. Instead, he raised the card high up in the air and shouted at the paper figurine who was rowing the boat. Everyone was flabbergasted.
“Thank you, senior. Now, I have a spot!”
The paper figurine looked at Wang Baole and nodded. It began to paddle the paper oars in its hands. Immediately, the boat jolted and set sail again, slowly sailing into the distance!
All the elites on the boat had complicated looks in their eyes. They looked at Wang Baole, who stood there as if he was suppressing them with his radiance, and fell silent.
In this battle, not only did Wang Baole obtain a spot, he also obtained... their recognition of his strength!

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - If You’re hungry, you must eat! (animated announcement included)
chapters.content:
Chapter 919: If You’re hungry, you must eat! (animated announcement included)
“Little Bastard! ! !”As he watched the ghost ship gradually disappear into the distance, Daoist Linhai couldn’t help but admit that he had made a mistake this time, even though he was filled with indescribable anger and frustration.
He had underestimated long Nanzi. He didn’t rush into the Divine Eye Star and kill him as soon as he arrived. However, he felt depressed because of the Xie family, he really could not rush into the star so decisively.
In the end, he had never expected that the other party would be so bold. Most importantly... the paper figurine of the Ghost ship had chosen to help the other party!
This matter had exceeded his judgment and imagination. According to his knowledge, this had never happened before!
As for the threat and counter-threat, they left him in a dilemma. If the other party had killed the chosen of his own civilization, then it would have been fine, but they could have done it together. However, the other party wasn’t stupid. They didn’t kill him, but captured him alive, he didn’t dare to make a decision so easily. He could only squint his eyes and suppress his killing intent, trying to figure out how to deal with the situation.
As his expression grew uglier and uglier, and his anger seemed to erupt uncontrollably, cold sweat trickled down his forehead as he watched everything unfold, his face was pale as he stared at the gradually disappearing ship. Wang baole, who was standing there, felt waves of emotions surge in his heart. He had to admit that he... had underestimated long Nanzi’s courage after all, it was at that moment that he thought of long Nanzi’s past battle achievements!
Perhaps it was because Wang Baole hadn’t revealed his viciousness and viciousness after stepping into the spirit immortal realm that he had neglected the other party’s past!
When he was in the spirit realm, he had suffered a loss at the hands of the new Dao sect’s Ink Dragon Army. He had killed the general’s disciple, escaped, and returned to cripple the INK Dragon Army. That had earned him the nickname of a madman!
“Madman!”
A madman was someone who didn’t care about his own life and death. He only wanted to be straightforward. Even if he had to suffer a thousand losses, he would still destroy eight hundred of them!
...
A madman was someone who dared snatch food from the jaws of a tiger in front of a mighty figure from a star. Yet... He had succeeded!
As he watched Wang Baole leave on the ship, his mind replayed his battle record and madness. He suddenly felt a strong sense of regret. He regretted that he... shouldn’t have provoked long nanzi!
As he felt regret and the Dao Master of Linhai struggled, the shadow of the spirit cruiser became increasingly blurry. It disappeared completely from their eyes. It sped through the starry sky at an indescribable speed, as if it was traveling through the void.
Standing on the boat and looking outside, Wang Baole watched as the starry sky seemed to have turned into a river. It continued to streak past his eyes. This scene made Wang Baole very clear that the speed of the boat had reached a shocking level, at the same time, he heaved a sigh of relief.
After all, the paper figurine that was rowing the boat had also nodded. Now that the boat was moving, it didn’t chase him off the boat. This meant that his plan had been a perfect success. Obtaining the card meant that he had a ticket, he had the right to head to the fallen star.
With that thought, Wang Baole relaxed completely. He withdrew his gaze from the starry sky and looked at the nearly fifty prodigies around him.
There were men and women among them. They sat at a distance away from each other. It was obvious that they all had their own identities and didn’t want to get close to others. Other than the few who had quarreled with Wang Baole, who had looked at him with a dark expression.., the others had different expressions on their faces.
Some were surprised, some were curious, and some weren’t interested in him at all.
“Hi, we meet again.”Wang Baole felt that it was necessary for him to build a good relationship with everyone. He blinked and greeted everyone.
However, most of them ignored him. Occasionally, they would snort coldly. It was clear that even though his abilities were recognized, the way he boarded the ship seemed to have violated some taboos, which made everyone displeased.
Ingrate. No matter what, I helped them row the ship back then. Wang Baole snorted inwardly, thinking to himself, if you ignore me, I will ignore you.
With that thought in mind, Wang Baole couldn’t be bothered to repair his relationship. He could tell that these people were very proud. However, he also admitted that the prodigies on the boat did have the right to be proud.
None of them were inferior to the prodigies of the purple gold civilization. There were even a few who were stronger than him. Even though they were all at the Perfected Spirit Immortal Realm, the difference in their foundations and talents meant that there was a huge gap between them at this level, there was also a huge gap between them.
There was one person in particular that caught Wang Baole’s attention. It was a woman. She wore a mask on her face, so he couldn’t see her face clearly. He could only see that the face carved on the mask was an extremely beautiful and cold face.
Wang Baole had just taken a few glances when the woman seemed to notice something. She looked at Wang Baole as well. There wasn’t a hint of emotion in her eyes. Her gaze, which was as if she was looking at a dead person, didn’t seem to have much effect on Wang Baole. His expression remained the same, instead, he smiled at her.
A glint flashed in the Woman’s eyes, and she ignored Wang Baole.
Wang Baole raised an eyebrow. He thought to himself, with his status as the most handsome man in the federation and his appearance, he smiled at her. She actually ignored him, and he snorted in his heart.
Most people who wear a beauty mask are probably too ugly
After muttering to himself, Wang Baole found an empty space and sat there, thinking about the gains and losses of this trip and how he would use his relationship with the paper figurine in his storage ring after arriving at the meteorite land, he would be able to obtain good fortune through this opportunity.
“I’ll be promoted to a planet!”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes, his eyes filled with anticipation.
Time passed slowly. The spirit cruiser continued to move forward without a pause, as if Wang Baole was the last person to board the ship. As he meditated for the past few days, he could no longer sit still.
It was simply too quiet. No one spoke, not even moving. Everyone sat there silently meditating, waiting for the journey to end.
The first few days were fine, but after more than ten days, Wang Baole felt that it was too boring to continue like this. Under the scrutiny of others, he stood up and walked to the head of the boat.
“Senior, you’ve worked hard. Let Me Help You Row. Do you still remember? I love rowing the most!”
The moment Wang Baole spoke, he immediately attracted the attention of even more people. Those elites who had seen him row before had ugly expressions on their faces. Those who had not seen him before were astonished.
As they watched, Wang Baole stood there and waited for a long while. When he saw that the paper figurine was ignoring him, Wang Baole sighed. Although it was a little awkward for everyone to look at him like that, his skin was thick, it was even more exaggerated than his combat strength. He coughed, cupped his fists, and bowed deeply at the paper figurine.
“Thank you for your understanding, senior. I know that Junior is going to seek opportunities next, so I don’t want to tire myself out. Thank you again, Senior!”As he said that, Wang Baole turned around and returned to the place where he had been meditating previously. Amidst the strange expressions of the others.., he sat upright and upright.
He didn’t pay attention to the gazes of the people around him. Wang baole, who was sitting there, fell silent for a moment before he couldn’t help but look around again.
Is this the number of people in the fallen star land this time? He had secretly observed everyone. He had made a mental comparison over the past few days. Other than the woman in the mask, the others were also far ahead of their peers, however, he felt that it would not be difficult for him to defeat them.
At the same time, not only had he observed all the chosen on the boat, he had also paid attention to the decoration and structure of the boat several times. The thing that caught his attention the most... was the altar placed at the rear of the boat!
This altar seemed to be made of wood, and there was nothing special about it. There was an incense that seemed to burn forever on it, and there was also a plate of red fruits. There were seven of them.
Wang baole, who had nothing to do at the moment, felt that since he could no longer continue rowing, his attention was involuntarily drawn to the fruits.
These fruits should be edible... they seem to taste pretty good. Wang Baole looked at the fruits, blinked, and instinctively rubbed his stomach.
——
He was filled with excitement as he told everyone the good news. With one thought, eternal animation had produced a pilot trailer. As a long series, it was expected that the first season of the summer vacation would be released this year, penguin Pictures, Tencent Video, and TV & US film production have been polished for a long time. It is also the first animation to be released in Ergen. Fellow Daoists, go and take a look!
There are two ways to watch the trailer: 1. My Weibo. 2. My wechat public account.
Both search for “Ergen”

chapters.title: Chapter 920 - I Make a wish
chapters.content:
Chapter 920:, I Make a wish
Wang Baole didn’t think that he was greedy. It was because the red fruit was very tempting and looked delicious. That was why he couldn’t help but want to eat it.
That must be the case. Otherwise, as an origin dharmic body, I don’t even have real internal organs. Why would I want to eat? Wang baole rubbed his belly and looked at the red fruits, he found them even more repulsive.
Wang Baole felt that he had to eat these repulsive foods. That would be the greatest punishment for them. With that thought, he was instantly energized. However, Wang Baole also understood, it was obvious that many of the fruits had been placed there. Furthermore, no one else had taken them after so many days. That was enough to explain the problem.
It was almost certain that the fruits could not be obtained by the prodigies on the boat. Either there was a restriction or the paper figurine that was rowing the boat did not allow it.
If there is a restriction, it’s fine. At most, I won’t punish them. But if the paper figurine doesn’t allow it... Wang Baole blinked. He felt that he had some relationship with the paper figurine that was rowing the boat, the paper figurine in his storage ring must be related to the other party, and it was highly likely that they knew each other.
This gave Wang baole confidence. He thought that it was fine if he didn’t let him help with the rowing and let him eat the fruit. Thinking of this, Wang Baole immediately stood up from his meditation. He stood up, he quickly attracted the attention of the surrounding elites.
Wang Baole was undoubtedly an extremely unique individual among them. It was one thing for him to come up to row the boat previously, but now, with the help of the fallen star emissary, he had once again boarded the boat and snatched the spot in front of everyone. All of this.., all of this meant that the other party was special. Therefore, even those who did not seem to care about his every move were actually paying attention to him.
This was especially true for Li Linzi, Wang Yishan, and the others, who had previously had conflicts with him. Although they appeared to be disdainful, they were secretly wary of Wang Baole. Now that Wang Baole had stood up again, they all looked over.
As they watched, they saw Wang Baole stand up and head straight for... the altar at the stern. Almost instantly, the spectators understood what Wang Baole was thinking.
“Is he going to eat the fruit?”
...
After understanding this, the elites didn’t immediately express their emotions. Instead, they watched. After all, Wang Baole’s previous performance was extraordinary, furthermore, it was obvious that the attitude of the fallen star emissary towards him was different from that of the others. Therefore, even though they felt that the possibility of them wanting to eat the fruit was almost zero, they couldn’t immediately make a judgment.
Wang Baole ignored the stares of these people. At that moment, his body flashed and he quickly approached the stern of the ship. As he neared, he was about to step onto the altar. However, just as he neared the altar.., suddenly, the paper paddle in the rowing paper man’s hand was raised. There was no need to cast any spells. A ripple spread out, and Wang Baole, who was approaching the altar, trembled.
He felt a powerful force erupt from the altar, sweeping towards him like a landslide. He didn’t have time to dodge, and he was instantly enveloped. It was as if he had been pushed hard, he lost his balance and fell back. His cultivation was even unstable at that moment, causing Wang Baole to feel as if the world was spinning around him.
Seeing this, many of the onlookers around him sneered. They felt even more gratified. They had long been jealous of the meteorite emissary’s attitude towards Wang Baole. Now, seeing that he was the same as them.., they all felt happy.
There must be something wrong with Xie Dalu’s head. These fruits have always been there. If we could move them as we please, we would have taken them away long ago
It seems like he’s just a fool. The offerings on the meteorite ship have been recorded in various ancient records. Up until now, only one person has managed to obtain one. That person is the third prince of the Weiyang clan. With his outstanding talent, he received one as a gift
Although everyone’s thoughts remained in their minds, even if Li Linzi and the others did not say anything, the disdain and ridicule on their faces became more obvious.
This was especially so for Li Linzi. He seemed to feel that if he did not say anything, he would miss this opportunity to ridicule them. Therefore, under his disdainful expression, he laughed coldly.
“I didn’t think that there would really be a fool. Don’t you know that from ancient times until now, only one person has ever obtained the spirit soul fruit on the Starfall ship? Don’t tell me you think you’re the second person?”
Wang Yishan and the others burst into laughter.
Listening to their laughter and seeing the expressions of the others around him, Wang Baole, who was slowly calming down his cultivation, felt a little disgusted. At the same time, he was also a little angry. He glared and thought to himself, I really don’t believe it.., he snorted and sat there with his right hand in his storage bag. He took out the wishing bottle.
At that moment, he did not care about the side effects of the wishing bottle. Even if there was still lightning, the spirit ship would still be able to resist. With that thought in mind, he made a silent wish in his heart.
I want that fruit
The bottle did not respond.
I want to enter the altar
The bottle still did not respond. Wang baole sighed in his heart. He felt increasingly disappointed with the wishing bottle. He thought for a moment and attempted to recite it again.
“I wish that the paper figurine on the boat won’t Stop Me!”
As the words rang out in his heart, Wang Baole’s body trembled violently. He could feel the heat that appeared on the wishing bottle in that instant. He couldn’t help but feel nervous and excited. His breathing quickened slightly. He had only been indignant.., he had only attempted to make a wish, but he hadn’t expected to succeed after three attempts.
He sat there and looked at the paper figurine that was still rowing. Wang baole blinked, thought for a moment, and gritted his teeth. He put away the wishing bottle, and under the gazes of everyone around him, he stood up once again.
“Are you still going to try? Xie Dalu, I admire your courage. You can do it!”Li Linzi glanced at Wang Baole and mocked.
“Li Linzi, watch carefully for daddy!”Wang Baole was not a person who would be at a disadvantage. Hearing Li Linzi’s repeated mockery, he looked over coldly, and a cold glint flashed in his eyes.
This cold glint made Li Linzi squint his eyes. His companions beside him also had a glint in their eyes, and there was a hint of hostility. It was obvious that if Wang Baole really attacked them here, they would not sit idly by.
Wang Baole glared coldly at Li Linzi and the others. He snorted coldly and walked towards the altar. This time, his speed was the same as before. He approached in an instant and was about to step onto the altar. He had been here the last time, he had been chased away by the paper figurine.
Seeing this, Li Linzi and the others sneered. The other prodigies also looked at him calmly. Their expressions were more or less filled with disdain. It was clear that everyone believed that it was impossible to eat the offering fruit, it was already impossible.
However, just as everyone’s expressions appeared on their faces, Wang Baole leaped and landed beside the altar!
The paper figurine did not stop him again. It continued to row the boat, as if it did not notice Wang Baole’s actions.
This made everyone’s eyes widen. As their minds buzzed, even the masked woman opened her eyes. She could not hide the shock in her eyes.
The shock that filled everyone’s hearts was like a raging storm, causing everyone to freeze in shock. They watched helplessly as Wang baole reached the altar and picked up a fruit from it! He placed it to his mouth and took a bite... and ate half of it!
Wang Baole was elated. He felt that his wish bottle was still very useful. His dream came true, and the paper figurine didn’t stop him. After he ate the fruit, its fragrance filled his mouth and instantly turned into jade nectar, it spread throughout his entire body, and what followed was a pleasant and refreshing feeling. Wang Baole quickly ate a few more mouthfuls and swallowed the fruit he had picked up, along with its skin and core. He even burped, only then did he look at the prodigies whose eyeballs were about to fall out of their sockets.
“The taste isn’t... Eh?”

chapters.title: Chapter 921 - spirit spirit spirit fruit!
chapters.content:
Chapter 921: spirit spirit spirit fruit!
Before Wang Baole could finish his sentence, his eyes widened like everyone else’s. He couldn’t even stand properly, and he had no choice but to hold onto the altar at the side. His breathing was unsteady, and his vision was blurry, his brain was especially dizzy.
Is it poisonous
Wang Baole wailed in his heart. His body quivered, and suddenly, all the dizziness and blurriness of his vision gathered on his soul. At that moment, his soul.., there was a loud boom that no one else could hear.
Amidst the loud boom, his soul expanded. It seemed to have been stimulated, as if it had been injected with a great tonic. In the blink of an eye, it seemed to have been catalyzed and exploded.
The soul was below the planet. It was formless and existed in the physical body. It couldn’t be identified because it was everywhere. To a certain extent, the physical body was merely the carrier of the soul.
But now... as the fruit melted and absorbed, and as the soul exploded, Wang Baole suddenly had a strange feeling. It was as if... He had sensed the soul, and at the same time, his clone.., it was as if... he was unable to support the soul!
That was because at that moment, his soul had indeed been greatly nourished. It was on the verge of breaking through in the blink of an eye. It had grown so much larger that it had exceeded the limits of what his body could support.
This feeling was as if the clothes he had been wearing had shrunk by a size. Wang Baole wasn’t used to the tense feeling. It took him a long while before he managed to stabilize himself. He no longer held onto the altar, instead, he tried to raise his right hand..
However, when the command for this action was given... Even though he raised his right hand instantly, Wang Baole could sense that his body’s reaction was a little slow. However, he quickly understood that it wasn’t because his body was slow, it was because his soul had become stronger, and his reaction speed had become faster.
This fruit... is a good thing! After realizing this, Wang Baole was ecstatic. In reality, he knew very well that the success rate of advancing to a planet seemed to have nothing to do with the soul, that was because there weren’t many things in the world that could allow one’s soul to explode at the level of a spirit immortal. In reality, the soul and the cultivation to break through to a planet were closely related.
...
It could be said that this fruit had increased his success rate of breaking through by more than half. As for the other uses, Wang Baole wasn’t an alchemist, and he didn’t know the details of this fruit, so he didn’t know yet.
But it didn’t matter. Someone had told him!
The person who had told him was the masked woman!
This fruit is called the spirit spirit fruit, and it only grows in the fallen stars. There aren’t many in the outside world, but among the endless wonder fruit, this fruit is known as the number one supplementary item for a spirit immortal to break through to a planet
“Although its function is only to raise the soul of cultivators and push them to their limits, it has another hidden function. That is... the chances of fusing with immortal planets and even special planets will be higher!”
The masked woman spoke slowly. When she spoke, Wang Baole’s body trembled. Without any hesitation, he immediately picked up another fruit. As for the others, they were clearly aware of this, however, they were still in shock.
The reason for their shock was not what the masked woman had said. It was because they had recovered from their shock. Their dazed state had turned into an uproar and disbelief.
“How is this possible!”
“He actually managed to get his hands on it... Before this, only the third prince of the Weiyang clan had succeeded. This fruit... damn it, why didn’t the fallen star emissary stop it?”
The commotion caused the entire ship to turn noisy from its previous silence. More than half of the prodigies in the area stood up immediately. The madness and jealousy in their eyes when they looked at Wang Baole were extremely intense.
When they saw Wang Baole pick up the second spirit spirit spirit fruit and eat it in front of them, they couldn’t help but go crazy.
“What a waste of heavenly treasures. Xie Dalu, stop. You Can’t eat this fruit directly...”
“For cultivators, one spirit spirit fruit is enough. It’s useless if you eat too many!”The surrounding elites spoke quickly. Wang Baole also realized that the second fruit he had eaten had almost no effect. Even so.., however, the taste of the fruit wasn’t bad. Therefore, Wang Baole coughed and picked up the third fruit in front of everyone. This time, he ate it a little slower.
This scene caused everyone else to go crazy, especially Li Linzi. His eyes were red. He had never expected that the other party would actually be able to eat the fruit, however, he still felt that something was amiss.
Could it be... could it be that I won’t be stopped by the fallen star emissary the second time? The thought surfaced in his mind. Even though he felt that it was ridiculous, the desire in his heart made him grit his teeth, he dashed toward the altar where Wang Baole was.
There were three to five other people who also rushed over. Their thoughts were similar to Li Linzi’s. They were extremely fast, and they approached in an instant. Just as they were about to enter the altar, the paper figurine that was rowing the boat suddenly raised its right hand and waved, immediately, the powerful force that had stopped Wang Baole from approaching appeared once again. It stopped everyone and pushed at them fiercely.
With a loud boom, Li Linzi and the others trembled violently and retreated rapidly. One of them had been pushed too hard, and blood oozed out from the corner of his mouth. When the others saw the retreating figures, they sucked in a breath, they had recovered a little from their earlier frenzied state.
“Eh, I didn’t expect there to be such a fool. Li Linzi, don’t you know that since ancient times, only two people have ever obtained the spirit spirit fruit on the Starfall ship? Do You Think You’re the third?”Wang Baole finished the third fruit, he took the fourth fruit and returned Li Linzi’s previous words with disdain.
“You!”Li Linzi’s expression was ugly, but he seemed to be stubborn. He felt that if he tried a second time, there was a chance of success. His body swayed, and he charged toward the altar once again.
“Are you still going to try? Li Linzi, I admire your courage. You can do it!”Wang Baole said with a smile, he picked up the fifth fruit again. This time, he didn’t eat it. Instead, he tossed it around in his hands, looking as if he deserved a beating. He looked at Li Lin Zi, who was charging towards him. The moment he got close, he was stopped by the paper figurine with a wave of his hand, and he was once again sent tumbling.
This time, there seemed to be a sense of punishment. The force of the push was even stronger, causing Li Lin Zi to spit out a large mouthful of blood as he retreated. He staggered a few steps back, and his face turned pale. However, when he looked at Wang Baole.., both his expression and eyes were filled with intense anger and grievance!
He was indeed aggrieved, but he had no choice. He had to admit that people were really different from each other... the others could tell that this was clearly the Starfall Emissary’s favoritism. Therefore, when Wang Baole boarded the boat for the first time.., the scene of him rowing the boat until his cultivation broke through appeared in their minds once again.
“What right does he have?”
“This is too much!”
“He helped him break through his cultivation and even helped him board the boat. He didn’t even care about his rights to kill and plunder people. Now, he’s only allowed to eat the spirit spirit spirit fruit, and he’s eating it as he pleases... could it be that this Xie continent is the child of the falling stars?”
The intense imbalance made everyone feel extremely helpless. They watched helplessly as Wang Baole ate the fifth fruit in his hand, then picked up the sixth, as if he wanted to finish all the fruits, they forced themselves to calm down. As they racked their brains, the masked woman, who had told them about the fruit’s uses, suddenly spoke.
“Fellow Daoist Xie, I’m willing to pay three million red crystals to buy a fruit. Is that okay?”
“How much?”Wang Baole was just about to bite down when he heard that. His eyes widened, and he opened his mouth instantly. He didn’t continue biting down. Instead, he stared straight at the masked woman.
“Three million red crystals. This is the Xie family’s red crystal card. As a member of the Xie family, you naturally know it. There’s exactly three million in it!”As she spoke, the masked woman raised her right hand and took out a red jade token. She threw it at Wang Baole, in an instant.
Wang baole inhaled when he heard that. He raised his hand and pulled the jade token over. Although he did not recognize it, he had seen someone take out something similar in the Xie family market. It was just that the amount was not that large.
His heart raced. He looked at the fruit with the teeth marks in his hand, then at the remaining one on the altar. Suddenly, he felt endless regret.
Heavens, how many red crystals did I eat before? Fifteen million? I, I... I should have sold it earlier

chapters.title: Chapter 922 - , the Lightning Tribulation, continued!
chapters.content:
Chapter 922:, the Lightning Tribulation, continued!
Just as Wang Baole was deep in thought, remorseful over the loss of the fifteen million red crystals, the eyes of the other elites on the ship flashed. Immediately, other people began to speak.
“Thank you, fellow Daoist. I am also willing to use three million red crystals to buy a spirit soul fruit!”
“Fellow Daoist from the continent, I will offer three million five hundred thousand. This fruit is indeed only useful for the first fruit. It is practically useless for the rest. Furthermore, you have eaten quite a lot. Sell it to me!”
“Four million. Thank you, fellow Daoist. The price I’m offering is already sky-high. Even though I don’t have enough Red Crystals on me, I can use my Dharmic artifact as collateral!”
Wang Baole was filled with even more regret as the others spoke one after another. He sighed and slowly narrowed his eyes. Someone had offered four million, but Wang Baole felt that the masked woman had remained as cold as ever, however, she didn’t participate in the taunts and didn’t hide her words. This made him feel good about her. He also understood that on the ship, or perhaps in the fallen star that he was about to head to, he was still a little weak.
Four million and three million are a huge fortune to me. There’s no need to be so greedy... at the thought of this, a strange light appeared in Wang Baole’s eyes. He raised his right hand and waved it, immediately, he rolled up the only remaining spirit spirit spirit spirit fruit on the altar and threw it at the masked woman. In order to avoid any misunderstandings, he spoke at the same time.
“There’s a first come, first served basis for doing things. I’m from the Xie family, so I have to abide by the principles!”
The moment Wang Baole rolled up the spirit spirit fruit and said those words, the masked woman’s body turned blurry. Before anyone could fight over it, she had already appeared outside the altar, she raised her right hand and grabbed the spirit spirit spirit fruit that Wang Baole had taken out.
With the fruit in her hand, the masked woman raised her head and looked deeply at Wang Baole. The coldness in her eyes softened considerably. She nodded slightly and returned to the spot where she was meditating, ignoring the greedy gazes of everyone around her. She swallowed the fruit in one gulp.
“Everyone, I’ve bitten the spirit spirit fruit in my hand and damaged its skin a little... if you don’t mind, Let’s auction off the final fruit. The highest bidder will get it!”Wang Baole coughed, after attracting everyone’s attention, he raised the spirit spirit spirit fruit with his teeth mark in his hand and spoke with anticipation.
...
He looked at the spirit spirit spirit fruit in his hand. Even though there were obvious teeth marks on it, the surrounding prodigies’eyes were burning with passion. After a short period of silence, the sound of an opening bid was heard.
The price soared. It went from three million to five million. Wang Baole was shocked as well. The sudden arrival of wealth had caught him off guard.
However, that didn’t mean that the prodigies were stupid and rich. To them, the fact that they were the prodigies of their respective families and powers, and that they were qualified for the meteorite meant that they had high hopes, to them, wealth was something they could afford as long as it wasn’t an exaggeration.
In their minds, the opportunities and treasures that could be purchased were worth it as long as they were useful to them. The spirit spirit fruit could not only increase the chances of their planet, they could also obtain the possibility of merging with the immortal planet or even a special planet. That way, they would not be left behind.
Just like that, after a round of competition, the spirit spirit spirit fruit with Wang Baole’s teeth mark was finally bought by Li Linzi... the price he offered was so high that it was almost an exaggeration.
“Nine million!”Li Linzi roared. His eyes were red. He was afraid that Wang Baole would not sell it to him, so he simply offered a sky-high price.
When the others heard the price, they couldn’t help but gasp. They hesitated and remained silent.
Seeing this, Wang Baole’s eyes lit up. Li Linzi was overthinking things. If he had offered a normal price, it wouldn’t have been a big deal. Wang Baole was completely moved by the price.
These people are F * cking rich! Wang Baole suddenly felt energized. He realized that during this trip to the fallen star, he might not have been lucky enough to obtain a good planet to fuse with. Instead... he might have been able to make a fortune here!
With that thought in mind, Wang Baole saw that the others had stopped talking. He was about to nod, but thinking that he was someone with status, he cleared his throat and pretended to look down on wealth like dirt, he waved his hand lightly.
“Since you haven’t continued, I’ll sell you.”
Li Linzi was nervous and excited, but he still felt aggrieved. However, he had no choice but to suppress it. He quickly handed over three red crystal cards and completed the transaction with Wang Baole.
After receiving the spirit spirit spirit fruit, he ignored the teeth marks on it and swallowed it in one gulp. He then sat down cross-legged and began meditating. Previously, there had been people who said that Wang Baole had wasted heavenly treasures, but that was mostly due to jealousy. If it had been anyone else.., they probably wouldn’t have swallowed the spirit spirit fruit. Instead, they would have swallowed it directly. After all, only by eating it would they truly be counted as his own.
He had easily earned 12 million red crystals. With such a large amount of wealth that he had never, even in his dreams, thought he would never have, Wang Baole felt a little dizzy. After a long while, he recovered, his eyes were filled with a fanatical glow.
I want to go to the Xie family market and buy twenty nine Heavens Lightning spirits
I want to buy twenty catties of Water Cloud Heavenly River
“I also want to buy the heaven and earth spirit boat that is worth millions!”
As he thought about it, while he was excited, he suddenly felt that the ten million didn’t seem like a lot. Therefore, he quickly scanned the surroundings of the altar and realized that there was nothing to sell, he scanned his surroundings again.
“It’s gone...”after confirming that there was indeed nothing on the boat that he could sell, Wang Baole sighed with some regret. He was just about to leave the altar when.., wang Baole suddenly saw a familiar bright glow appear in the distant starry sky that was like an oil painting under the speed of the ghost ship.
This is... Wang Baole’s eyes widened in that instant, and the bright glow instantly reached a blinding level. It charged straight for the ghost ship.
It was so fast that the moment everyone else noticed it, the light had already closed in on them. It turned into a giant bolt of lightning that was thirty feet thick and headed straight for the Ghost Ship!
A loud boom rang out. The ship was unharmed, but everyone on board was shocked. Even the masked woman opened her eyes and was on high alert. Everyone else was the same.
“An enemy attack?”
“Why is there lightning all of a sudden?”
“The size of this bolt of lightning is already comparable to the heavenly tribulation!”
While everyone was shocked, they didn’t notice that even though Wang Baole was similarly shocked, his eyes flashed with guilt.
Others didn’t know why the Lightning had arrived, but Wang Baole already knew the answer. It was a side effect of the wishing bottle, and it was clearly more terrifying than before. It was especially so when he thought about how the spirit cruiser was traveling at an astonishing speed, however, it was still caught up by the Lightning. From this, one could see how astonishing the speed of the Lightning was.
The magnitude of the Lightning also made Wang Baole nervous. Based on his experience, lightning like this would appear countless times in the future.
I believe that this spirit cruiser can withstand it! Wang Baole quickly comforted himself. He was even more worried about being discovered, so he immediately put on the same expression as the others. However, just as he was consoling himself, in the next moment.., a second bolt of lightning struck, followed by a third, a fourth, and a fifth..
Within a short period of time, the number of bright lights that appeared in the surrounding starry skies had increased to dozens. It didn’t end there. In the next instant, it increased to hundreds and headed towards the spirit cruiser.
All the prodigies on the ship were shocked. Only the paper figurine rowing the boat remained calm and composed. It allowed the hundreds of bolts of lightning to strike. Amidst the loud noise, the spirit cruiser wasn’t affected too much, it only trembled slightly.
Wang baole heaved a sigh of relief. He was even more pleased with himself. He thought to himself that his father was smart. With this invincible spirit boat, no matter how powerful the side effects of this tiny wishing bottle were.., he would be helpless in front of him.
He didn’t know if this thought had angered the lightning bolts, but in the next moment, the surrounding starry skies lit up. If he could stand at a vantage point and look down, he would be able to see the surroundings of the speeding spirit boat.., the starry sky rumbled and formed a lightning sea that was the size of a civilization!
Countless bolts of lightning turned crimson in color. They were like violent red pythons that were charging towards the ghost ship from all directions. They were like mountains and seas that were about to topple over!
All the prodigies on the ship, including Wang Baole, had a drastic change in expression. Even the paper figurine that was rowing the ship, whose face had always been expressionless, twitched. The hand that was holding the paper paddle couldn’t help but pause.

chapters.title: Chapter 923 - , the mysterious and peerless prodigy!
chapters.content:
Chapter 923:, the mysterious and peerless prodigy!
It can’t be... I just made a wish... Wang Baole wailed in his heart. He could already tell that the lightning this time, whether it was a single bolt, or the overall range and power.., it had far surpassed the lightning pools he had encountered previously.
There was no way to compare the two. It was like the difference between a pond and an ocean. Every bolt of lightning that appeared this time shocked Wang Baole to the core, and he felt a strong sense of danger.
Will the paper figurine know that it’s me and throw me out... Wang Baole appeared as shocked as the others, but the anxiety and grief in his heart were greater than the others combined.
In reality, he knew very well that the bolts of lightning were coming for him. As long as the paper figurine threw him out, there would be no more lightning strikes on the ship.
It was especially so when he saw that the starry sky around him had turned completely red. Countless bolts of lightning struck from all directions like the wrath of the heavens. No matter how sturdy the ship was.., it began to tremble violently under the shocking sea of lightning.
It was as if it would disintegrate in the next instant. Wang baole grew even more nervous. The others on the ship might not be as strong as he was, but they were all extremely nervous. There was also a deep sense of confusion, they couldn’t help but let out a low growl.
“Could it be that a mighty figure from the star domain is making a move?”
“That’s impossible. Even a mighty figure from the star domain wouldn’t make a move against us. After all, any one of our family clans and factions is powerful enough. If we add them together... would a mighty figure from the star domain dare make a move?”
“Could it be that this is a necessary process to go to the fallen star lands? But it’s not recorded in the family clan’s ancient records.”
Everyone’s minds spun in shock, and they had no choice but to make preparations. Once the ship collapsed, how could they escape? The paper figurine’s expression turned grim, and it waved its right hand, causing a layer of gentle light to appear, the light instantly enveloped the ship, and it faced the lightning that was spreading out in all directions.
...
Rumbling sounds filled the air, and a shocking explosion rang out, causing everyone to feel as if their ears were going to explode. The ghost ship trembled as never before, but in the end, it was able to withstand the lightning.
However, there was no time for everyone to relax. In the next moment... The Sea of lightning around them seemed to explode with rage. It actually gathered all the lightning within its range, and with an even more exaggerated and shocking aura than before, it attacked once again.
Seeing that, the paper figurine let out a low growl. White Light radiated from its body, and it paddled the paper paddle at a speed that it had never seen before. The moment before the lightning gathered around it.., the speed of the Ghost ship was astonishing. It sped off into the distance. It was so fast that Wang Baole and the others on the ship felt extremely uncomfortable.
Blood trickled down the corners of some people’s mouths. They had to hold on tightly to the objects around them. Otherwise, they would be flung away. At this extreme speed, the ghost ship finally avoided the Lightning Sea. It was like a black hole that had been created, it dived straight into the Lightning Sea. The next moment, it appeared in the starry sky far away from the Lightning Sea, as if it was jumping.
However, the crisis wasn’t over... before Wang Baole could heave a sigh of relief, lightning appeared once again in the originally calm starry sky. The Lightning Sea chased after it as well. From Afar, the Lightning Sea was extremely fast, the bolts of lightning that spread out continuously landed on the spirit cruiser. As the spirit cruiser continued to shake, the rumbling in the surroundings became even more shocking.
“This isn’t over!”Wang Baole wanted to cry, but he had no tears. The rest of them were pale as well. They watched the paper figurine paddle crazily and watched the bolts of lightning continue to fall. Thankfully, the spirit cruiser was indeed extraordinary, the paper figurine seemed to have used all its strength. It was unable to shake off the sea of lightning even though it had teleported over and over again. However, it wasn’t trapped in the middle of the sea of lightning like before.
However... the vast sea of lightning seemed to lock onto the ghost ship as it chased after it. Even though more than a month had passed, the Sea of lightning was still persistent... looking from afar.., anyone who could see the ghost ship in front and the Sea of lightning in the back would feel waves of shock in their hearts.
They would even have the misconception that the sea of lightning was a part of the Spirit Cruiser’s divine ability. The bolts of lightning that kept striking the spirit cruiser were like chains, causing the sea of lightning behind it to spread open like a peacock’s tail, it also highlighted how extraordinary the spirit cruiser was.
However, this was not what Wang Baole wanted, nor was it what the dozens of prodigies on the ship wanted. During this period of time, no one spoke. Everyone’s face was pale. Even the masked woman.., there was fear in her eyes. She couldn’t sit still and meditate.
Similarly, this wasn’t what the paper figurine wanted either.
Wang Baole didn’t know if he was imagining things. He could faintly see sweat on the paper figurine’s forehead. This made his heart tremble even more. He swore to himself that he would never use the wishing bottle recklessly again.
This isn’t a wishing bottle. This is a divine suicide artifact! Wang Baole was filled with grief and indignation. Time passed once again. Another half a month passed.
The Lightning Sea... continued its relentless pursuit. At that moment, the spirit cruiser slowed down and entered... a different space!
Wang Baole didn’t notice how it entered. It was as if it was teleporting, as if it was shuttling, and as if the surrounding space was changing on its own in an instant.
It was a white space. More accurately speaking, the color of this space was the color of white paper. That was because... looking around, the endless area around them was really like white paper, especially in this white space, there were stars of all sizes, and when you looked at them... They were all white paper!
Meanwhile, the ghost ship slowly came to a stop in front of a huge white paper planet!
“White Paper Starry Sky, White Paper Planet! This is the gate to the fallen star lands! !”Someone on the ship immediately cried out in excitement. The reason why they were so excited was mostly because they felt that the lightning might not appear once they arrived.
In reality, though the Lightning Sea didn’t appear at the beginning, it only took about ten breaths of time before the Crimson Lightning Sea descended in the white starry sky, it spread rapidly towards Wang Baole’s ghost ship from afar.
It’s over! Wang Baole’s eyes widened. The others around him couldn’t help but wail. Perhaps the white starry sky where the door to the land of the fallen stars was located was indeed something strange, causing the Crimson Lightning Sea to chase after them, however, it stopped behind their spirit cruiser. It looked terrifying, but it didn’t drown the spirit cruiser. Instead, streaks of scarlet lightning struck the spirit cruiser continuously.
This process lasted for half a month. During this half a month, Wang Baole and the others were extremely nervous. Even the paper figurine stood there vigilantly.
Half a month later, in the distant white starry sky, a second ghost ship suddenly appeared!
It was followed by a third, a fourth, and a ninth ghost ship. Wang baole finally understood that there wasn’t one meteor ship, but nine!
He couldn’t help but look at the other eight ships. He wanted to see if there were any powerful elites among the elites on board that couldn’t be defeated. It wasn’t just Wang Baole, it was the same for everyone else on the ship, in reality... the elites on the other eight spirit cruisers were the same. However, they all looked at the ship that Wang Baole and the others were on almost at the same time!
The ship that Wang Baole and the others were on was simply too shocking. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that it was the center of attention. Many people were stunned. That was because in the white starry sky, the Crimson Sea of lightning.., it was even more eye-catching than the torches in the dark!
They didn’t know that the sea of lightning had been chasing the ghost ship the entire way. When they looked over, due to the floating sea of lightning and the Suppressive Force it exuded, they instinctively thought that the ghost ship was... Incredible!
Could it be that there is a peerless prodigy on this ship who is using this method to intimidate us? Many people narrowed their eyes, their eyes filled with wariness. At the same time, this thought arose in their minds!

chapters.title: Chapter 924 - - the sorrow of the raging flames!
chapters.content:
Chapter 924: — the sorrow of the raging flames!
It wasn’t their fault for making a wrong guess. Anyone else would have made the same judgment when they saw the red lightning that filled the sky after seeing a meteorite ship.
Most importantly, the red lightning didn’t seem to be aggressive. It was just a majestic presence that accentuated the spirit cruiser. As a result, the other prodigies on the other eight meteorite ships.., they began to scrutinize the people on Wang Baole’s ship.
Wang Baole and the others weren’t stupid either. They quickly realized what was going on. They felt that something was amiss, but none of them tried to resolve the misunderstanding. Instead, they remained silent, causing the misunderstanding to worsen.
As for Wang Baole, his gaze swept across the other eight ships. He felt a sense of solemnity in his heart. He took a rough look at the number of people on the eight spirit cruisers. There were about four hundred people. If he included himself.., there were about four hundred and fifty to sixty people who had entered the fallen star this time.
The weakest among them... were much stronger than the perfected Spirit Immortal realm cultivators in the outside world. He felt that they were as difficult to deal with as he had been when he hadn’t reached the perfected Spirit Immortal realm, there were also some who seemed to be on par with him. There were even a few who Wang Baole couldn’t see through.
Even though that’s how it feels, when it comes to actual combat, it’s not just one’s cultivation that determines the outcome. It’s also the Dharmic treasures and battle awareness... Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and pondered. Some of the gazes from the other eight ships.., they swept past Wang Baole as well, but he could vaguely sense that the focus of most people’s attention was on the masked woman.
As everyone sized each other up, the nine spirit boats gradually came to a halt outside the giant paper planet. Suddenly... The giant paper planet emitted an even more intense white light, it enveloped the entire area, and at the same time, a loud boom rose into the sky.
As the sound erupted, the giant paper planet began to tremble visibly. Slowly, it seemed to stretch out. From its spherical form... it stretched out into the shape of a human!
To be precise, it was a huge paper man. It looked exactly the same as the paper man in the boat, as if all the paper men were no different in appearance.
Its entire body was originally curled up, so it looked like a planet. However, as it stretched out, when its body was completely revealed, the entire starry sky trembled, and an indescribable pressure.., it was as if mountains and seas had been toppled from his body. Like a storm, it spread out in all directions, enveloping the entire area. At the same time, it was as if there were more than a thousand stars within his body, converging together to form a mighty pressure.
...
Just a single glance caused everyone’s hearts to tremble, and their eyes to sting. It was as if a single thought from the other party could blind all of their eyes. This feeling turned into a pressure that almost suffocated everyone!
It was partly due to the terrifying level of his cultivation, and partly due to the size of his body. Before him, the elites who had come for the training were not even ants. Only the nine spirit cruisers seemed to be on top of him, that was why they could barely be called ants!
“A mighty figure from the Galaxy!”That was Wang Baole’s judgment when he saw the gigantic paper figurine, it was the same judgment that surfaced in his mind the moment he felt the pressure. He had only felt this kind of feeling from two people. One was the blazing flame ancestor, and the other was his senior brother, Chen Qingzi.
However, even though the feelings were similar, there were also differences in strength. It was obvious that the paper figurine was not as vast as the blazing flame ancestor. Compared to his senior brother, the difference in sharpness was even greater.
Wang Baole wasn’t the only one to come to such a conclusion. The prodigies who were able to come here had backgrounds that could be considered wealthy in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain. They had seen a lot of things, so they immediately made their own guesses.
The prodigies were shocked. They retracted their gazes and lowered their heads to greet Wang Baole. Suddenly, the giant paper figurine opened its eyes abruptly, revealing a cold glow. At the same time, a voice rang out in the starry skies.
“Welcome to the meteorite gate!”
The moment the words left its mouth and reverberated in everyone’s minds, the white starry sky seemed to be affected as well. Large amounts of ripples appeared, spreading out in all directions, causing the entire white starry sky.., it seemed to have turned into a rippling sea surface!
A huge wave of white waves appeared in the distance. It kept rolling and rising, and in the next instant, it reached the end of everyone’s sight. Everyone, including Wang Baole, could not help but raise their heads, they could not hide the shock on their faces.
Even the masked woman and the other prodigies that Wang Baole had been paying attention to were stunned for a moment. It was true... that the huge wave that had been stirred up was slowly revealing its true appearance as the ripples disappeared!
It was not a huge wave at all. It was like a piece of flat paper that had been folded in half and turned into a wave!
Or perhaps it wasn’t appropriate to use the word “Folded”to describe it, because if you stood at the highest point and looked down, you would see... that in the black starry sky, the white region... was actually a huge piece of white paper!
It didn’t matter if it was a paper figurine or a meteor ship, or the 400 chosen inside of it, all of them were on the white paper, which was being folded in half!
All of this takes a bit of time to describe, but actually happened in the blink of an eye. In the next moment, the huge piece of paper was folded in half, covering the nine Starfall ships, the people inside, and the paper figurine, at the same time, the area of the white starry sky was reduced by half.
It wasn’t over yet. As the sound of the paper being folded echoed out, it was actually folded in half again. After that, it was folded again and again, and the area of the paper began to shrink, as it became thinner and thinner, its thickness also increased without limit.
As it folded in half, the white paper that eventually appeared in the galaxy suddenly turned into a white needle. It stabbed into the void, pierced through it, and disappeared!
Almost at the instant it disappeared, dozens of auras immediately descended from the depths of the galaxy in the area where the white paper had once been. They did not turn into concrete figures, but wills descended instead.., after sensing the area, they stared at the spot where the white needle had disappeared.
“It’s still the same method...”
“Even if I look at it again, I still won’t be able to figure it out. I can’t find the true location of the fallen star land!”
“I can be sure that although this seems to be related to the dark art, there’s actually no connection between the two...”
“The fallen star land is a crack that connects the Weiyang Dao domain to the outer domain...”
“There’s also that crimson bolt of lightning. It’s a bit strange... it actually went in with them?”
Each of these wills was a patriarch-like existence in their own clans and factions. They had gathered here not to protect their own children, but to see the door to the fallen star open once more, they had tried to study it from the inside.
However, it was clear that they had still failed this time.
At the same time, in the depths of the starry sky, in a starry sky filled with flames, was a gigantic planet. It looked like a majestic pill furnace, and was surrounded by hundreds of stars that provided it with high temperatures, an old man sat cross-legged at the top of the Pill Furnace Planet.
This old man was none other than Patriarch Flame. His eyes, which were originally closed, suddenly opened. He lowered his head and flipped his right hand, causing a voice transmission jade slip to appear in his palm. He lowered his head to look at it, then looked into the depths of the starry sky, a smile slowly appeared on his lips.
“The little kid from the Xie family is asking for help? He’s asking for my help to plead for him? Isn’t he looking for the wrong person... However, I have a feeling that before Chen Qingzi kills the Moon splitting divine emperor, his little junior brother will become my disciple.”
“Chen Qingzi, Oh Chen Qingzi, this is fate. HMPH, I might not be able to defeat you, but if my premonition comes true, when you see me, how should you address me? Also, the little kid from the Xie family is asking for help. Haha, interesting, interesting. I wonder what the kid’s expression will be like when he finds out that the person he needs help from is that Kid Baole...” The Blazing Flame Patriarch couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
His laughter echoed throughout the entire raging flame star field, echoing in the minds of the countless living beings in the area. Eighteen illusory figures appeared around him, rapidly condensing into eighteen cultivators of different races, they knelt down and kowtowed to the blazing flame patriarch.
“We pay our respects to Master!”
“May I know why master is so happy?”All of these cultivators had extraordinary cultivation bases, and when they saw how happy their master was, they couldn’t help but ask with a smile.
Patriarch Raging Flame, who was sitting on the pill furnace, once again laughed happily.
“There’s a very high chance that you’ll have an additional junior brother.”As he spoke, no one noticed the grief in the depths of Patriarch Raging Flame’s eyes as he looked at his disciples.
“Your real junior brother...”

chapters.title: Chapter 925 - the land of the fallen stars!
chapters.content:
Chapter 925: the land of the fallen stars!
The land of the fallen stars was the legendary region within the Weiyang Dao Domain. It was also one of the most mysterious places!
If one wanted to enter this place, one had to satisfy three conditions. The first was the moment it was opened. The second was that one’s cultivation base could not exceed that of a planet. As for the third, one had to possess the qualifications to be a sealing mark!
These three conditions could not be missing. As a result, the greed of too many people had been stopped. It was not as if there had not been a star or even a star domain’s mighty figure interested in this place over the years. However, those who tried to force their way in had all failed without exception.
In fact, even the Weiyang clan had suffered heavy losses when they tried to barge in under the leadership of a divine emperor. In the end, the divine emperor had returned and publicly apologized. This matter shocked the entire DAO domain, and it also caused the various factions and clans.., they had no choice but to give up on their greed and spying on the fallen star lands.
Fortunately, the fallen star lands did not completely exclude the outside world. They had used various methods to send out five hundred quotas. Although only four hundred of these quotas remained after the passage of time, the attitude of the fallen star had already shown that.., as long as they followed their rules, they would welcome the outside world.
That was why the meteorite base’s trip, which took place once every few hundred years, had taken place.
At that moment, as the white paper disappeared after being folded in half, the four hundred plus prodigies on the nine meteorite boats were all dazzled. Wang Baole was no exception. However, they quickly regained their sight, the entire process seemed to take only a few breaths of time..
When Wang Baole regained his vision, he immediately saw that the place he was in was completely different from the outside world.
It was an ocean!
At first glance, the color of the ocean was black. However, if one took a closer look, one would be shocked to discover that this ocean... was actually formed from countless pieces of black paper!
...
As for the sky... although it was a normal blue color, the sun hanging high up in the sky was also made of white paper. Looking around, everything around them... seemed to be made of paper!
Even the seabirds in the distance, as well as the clouds in the sky, everything was made of paper!
As for the colors, other than the sky, there were only black and white!
Only... The ship they were on and themselves were not made of paper in this world. Therefore, a sense of incompatibility caused Wang Baole and all the elites on the ship to be shocked.
“The Meteorite Paper Sea!”
“After crossing this sea, we can enter the meteorite empire...”
“We’ve entered the meteorite land!”Wang Baole didn’t know much about the meteorite land, however, the other elites were different from him. With the deep foundations of their respective clans and factions, they had a detailed understanding of the place. Someone immediately exclaimed in a low voice.
Listening to the cultivators beside him, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. The words ‘Sea of paper’and ‘empire’appeared in his mind. He swept his gaze across the surrounding Black Sea of paper. Just as he was about to take a closer look, suddenly... the voice of the giant paper figurine that had appeared earlier in the outside world.., reverberated throughout the entire world.
“Cultivators from the outside world, some of you may already know what this place is, but there should be some who don’t. Now, let me tell you, this is the Starfall Black Sea.”
“I am well aware of your purpose in coming here. You are here to obtain good fortune, to obtain a special planet, and to advance to a planet. This is also the reason why the Starfall Black Sea was opened. However... if you want to obtain these things, you will need to undergo some tests. Right now, this is the first test, and also the easiest entry test
“Among you, only those who can go ashore are qualified to become distinguished guests of the Starfall Empire
“The shore is far away. If you keep going, based on your average cultivation level, it will take about five days to reach it. The limit is five days. During that time, you can use any method. As long as you can get ashore, it will be considered a success. However, if it takes more than five days, it will be considered a failure
“I want to remind all of you that this sea contains a terrifying aura of black resentment. This aura can turn everything in the world into paper, including your bodies. In fact, it is not uncommon for cultivators to sink into this sea and become a part of it during the opening of the sea
“Now, it’s up to all of you to see what you can do!”The voice was loud and mighty. The moment it finished speaking, Wang Baole’s expression changed. He immediately realized that the Black Sea of paper seemed to have lost some sort of invisible suppressive force, a large amount of black gas spread out from within, directly covering the surroundings of the spirit cruiser. Wherever it touched, the cruiser could be seen with the naked eye... It was rapidly turning into paper!
It wasn’t just the ship he was on. The other eight ships were doing the same. Some of the people on the ship looked as calm as ever, but there were still quite a few whose expressions changed when they saw what was happening.
In fact, based on the speed at which the ghost ship was turning into paper, it wouldn’t even take an incense stick to burn, much less five days. The entire Starfall ship would turn into a paper ship. It was easy to imagine what would happen to the people on the ship if that happened, they would definitely die here.
The only way to save themselves was to leave the ship and fly through the sky. They would use their cultivation base to turn into speed. On the one hand, they would resist the invasion of the Black Qi, and on the other hand, they would use their fastest speed to fly to the shore.
Instead of saying that the meteor ship was a test for them, it would be more accurate to say that they would be eliminated. Those who did not meet the requirements would be eliminated. Furthermore, once they were eliminated, their fate would be death!
What a huge sum of money. It was just an entrance test, and they didn’t care about the nine extraordinary starfall ships and the nine paper figures on them? As for the sky, it wouldn’t be that simple. If they could really fly without any obstacles, the test would be meaningless, wang Baole was shocked. He instinctively looked at the paper figure that was still rowing, and he couldn’t bear to see it happen.
The good fortune that the paper figurine had given him, as well as the interactions they had had along the way, had made Wang Baole no longer view it as an inanimate existence. He felt that it was also an inanimate existence. It was just that its form was different.
However, this matter didn’t depend on his will. With Wang Baole’s current level of cultivation, he couldn’t protect it. Furthermore, on second thought, no matter how powerful a faction was, they probably wouldn’t use such losses to test outsiders, therefore, there was a high chance that he was wrong. The paper figurine and the boat would be fine.
After all, they were both paper figurine. How could they turn into paper again.
This thought made Wang Baole feel slightly at ease. He raised his head and looked at the other eight meteorite boats. At that moment, many cultivators had already abandoned their boats. They turned into long arcs in mid-air and sped off into the distance. It was the same for his boat, the masked woman, Li Linzi, and the others had all flown out.
Almost everyone’s bodies trembled more or less the moment they rose into the air. They were clearly affected by the unknown. There were even a few who fell headfirst, almost falling into the black paper sea, it was fortunate that their cultivation had erupted at the critical moment. They had barely managed to hold on and avoid the danger. However, their pale faces and the fear in their eyes still showed the difficulty of flying in the sky.
There is indeed something wrong with the sky! Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. In his eyes, the heaven’s favorites who had abandoned their ships were like eight immortals crossing the sea, each of them displaying their supernatural powers. Some of them were glowing with treasure light, they charged forward under the protection of their bodies. There were others who took out all sorts of Dharmic treasures that were clearly extraordinary. They used them to resist and charge forward.
There were others who formed hand seals and transformed into nine black dragons. They roared as they surrounded the dragons and stepped on them as they advanced. All sorts of methods, each different from the others, bloomed in the sky.
Their cultivation levels were all revealed at that moment. Even though they were all at the Perfected Spirit Immortal realm, the strength of their auras could still be detected by others.
There were four people among them. Their speed and Aura had reached an extreme, causing Wang baole to stare at them.
There were four people, two men, and two women. One of them was the masked woman on his boat.
