The woman immediately flew out of the boat, and in mid-air, a seven-colored glow appeared beneath her feet, transforming into a gigantic seven-colored phoenix, as she neared, she ignored the obstacles in the sky. Her speed was so fast that she became one of the four fastest people on the boat!
There was also a woman from the other boats. This woman was beautiful and had a smile on her face. Her body was incomparably graceful. At the same time, she had a bell tied to her right hand. With a slight shake, the sound of the bell spread in all directions, it formed ripples that could be seen by the naked eye, and she actually stepped on the ripples. The more the bell rang, the faster her speed became!
As for the other two men, one was swift and fierce, while the other was refined and refined. The Swift and fierce man wore a black robe. As he took a step forward, his right hand formed a seal in midair. Instantly, a long sword materialized from nothingness and waved around him like a long river, at the same time, a shocking murderous aura erupted from his body. Wherever he passed, the obstacles in the air seemed to be unable to stop him, and he directly swept through the air!
The last refined cultivator had the most unique method of crossing the sea. He held a bamboo slip in his hand, and as he lowered his head to read, he directly stepped on the Black Sea. He allowed the Black Qi to surge over, but it stopped thirty feet away from him, he was unable to enter the Black Sea at all, and his footsteps were neither fast nor slow. He stepped on the scraps of paper in the Black Sea and walked further and further away.
Seeing this, Wang Baole was also shocked by the four of them, but he also felt a little unconvinced.
I can do it too! Thinking of this, Wang Baole turned his head and cupped his fists at the paper figurine rowing the boat. He leaped up and sped through the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 926 - Divine Might Dao Lightning!
chapters.content:
Chapter 926: Divine Might Dao Lightning!
The moment he flew up, Wang Baole immediately understood why the bodies of the first batch of prodigies who had risen into the air had trembled the moment they rose into the air. Some of them had been unprepared and had almost fallen into the black paper sea.
That was because there was an intense pressure in the sky. The pressure made Wang Baole feel as if an earth-shattering mountain had suddenly pressed down on him. Even someone as powerful as him had his body shudder, even though his body didn’t sink, his cultivation was thrown into disarray.
It’s not just the increase in weight. It’s also the effect on my cultivation! Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He wasn’t ordinary to begin with. He could still withstand the effects and weight. If his speed was a little slower.., if he allowed the power of his cultivation to slow down, the effect would gradually decrease.
However, it was clear that the assessment would not be so simple. The moment Wang Baole’s thoughts surfaced, he saw the first batch of cultivators who had flown out from a thousand feet away. They were moving at a slower speed, their figures began to twist and turn. There were even three or four of them who had almost fallen into the sea. They had regained their composure, but now, they were trembling again. Their faces were filled with fear, they fell into the sea of paper once again.
Among the four people who fell this time, three managed to recover in the end. However, there was still one who was unlucky. He could have recovered and started again. However, the moment he fell, a huge wave happened to roll up, it actually enveloped him. Even though he struggled crazily, he was unable to change the outcome of his legs turning into black paper that could be seen with the naked eye!
Amidst the shrill screams, he lost control of his body and was completely submerged. His body could be seen. Within a few short breaths, he had turned into a black paper figurine and disappeared into the waves.
This scene shocked everyone. Wang Baole’s expression changed as well. As for the other three who had almost fallen, their faces were pale and their eyes were filled with fear. They didn’t dare continue forward and retreated rapidly instead.
As a result, the seventy to eighty people who had flown out of the first group were immediately divided into different levels. The first group was obviously the masked woman and the other two. They had already flown to an area of nearly ten thousand feet. The second group behind them.., there were more than fifty people. Even though their speed was obviously much slower, they seemed to be able to hold on for a period of time if they were cautious.
As for the others... They didn’t dare fly after seeing that someone had died. Their expressions kept changing, and they were in a dilemma.
At the same time, the second and third batch of elites also flew out. They had seen what was happening, but if they didn’t leave the ship, they would still fail. Instead, they might as well take the risk!
...
All of this made Wang Baole wary. He was about to increase his speed in mid-air, but at that moment, the masked woman and the other three, who were at the furthest distance away, suddenly stopped moving at a speed that was ten thousand feet away, even though their speed quickly returned to normal, Wang Baole’s eyes had a glint in them.
This was especially so when he was observing the others. Coupled with the fact that he had used his divine perception to scan the surroundings, Wang Baole could immediately tell that the pressure here... would increase exponentially with the increase in their speed and the increase in their flying distance. In other words.., it would be more and more difficult to maintain a normal speed!
No wonder the requirement is five days
If I want to maintain a speed that can reach the shore within five days, the pressure I will eventually face will reach an extremely terrifying level... Wang Baole took a deep breath. Even though the difficulty was there, he still felt that he should be able to.., at that moment, his body swayed and his speed exploded. Even though the pressure had increased and the impact on his cultivation had increased, it was still unable to restrict his figure. In just a few short breaths, he had already reached a distance of more than five thousand feet.
This scene was like a lone star in the crowd, causing many people behind him to look shocked. Even the four masked women in front of him turned their heads slightly at their respective spots and looked at Wang Baole.
In fact, if this burst of power could continue, Wang Baole would be able to catch up to the four of them in just a few more breaths. Even though they were confident that they wouldn’t fall behind, they had to admit that if Wang Baole caught up to them.., the other party had the right to keep up with them.
“Who is this person!”
“This speed is too ferocious!”
All sorts of thoughts surfaced in everyone’s minds. However... the development of the situation was different from what everyone had imagined. Wang Baole was brimming with confidence. Just as he was about to catch up to the four masked women in front of him in one go... suddenly.., his hair stood on end. A streak of crimson lightning that had disappeared without a trace before appearing appeared in front of Wang Baole out of thin air, striking straight at him!
“F * ck you!”Wang Baole screamed. He immediately recognized that the bolt of lightning was a side effect of the wishing bottle. He retreated rapidly, but it was too late. He was struck in an instant.
As he screamed, Wang Baole was nearly thrown into the Black Sea. He barely managed to withstand the force, and his body trembled. Madness appeared in his eyes, and the anger in his heart reached its peak in that instant.
“You Sly Old Fox!”Wang Baole roared, it was obvious that the Lightning had been hidden here for a long time. It didn’t flare up when Wang Baole had just left the ship, nor when he was in midair. It only waited for Wang Baole’s speed to explode, and it immediately arrived.
This feeling made Wang Baole feel that the Lightning was extremely sinister. At the same time, his vigilance against its viciousness was raised to the maximum. However, just as his anger was about to flare up, in the distant sky.., in an instant, dozens of scarlet bolts of lightning appeared. Behind them, hundreds of bolts of lightning were brewing in the void. If one were to look carefully from afar, one could see tens of thousands or even more of them, ready to make a move.
This scene made Wang Baole blink his eyes. He let out a wail, and his anger turned into fear. He turned around and used all his strength to charge five thousand feet away on his meteor ship.
Behind him, dozens of scarlet bolts of lightning chased after him. This scene caught the eyes of the crowd, and they were stunned. Even the first batch of people in the distance were shocked.
“Could it be that in addition to the pressure and chaotic cultivation, there’s also the Lightning Tribulation in the first trial?”
“What’s going on? Why is he the only one being struck?”
“The lightning... looks familiar...”
Amidst the confusion, there were still some elites who had been on the same boat as Wang Baole. Seeing this scene, they instantly understood what was going on. It was even more so for Li Lin. Anger appeared in his eyes, and he roared.
“Xie Dalu, so it was you who attracted the Lightning!”
The other people who had been on the same boat as Wang Baole also glared at him angrily. However, Wang Baole was no longer in the mood to bicker with them. As he sped along, he was chased by the dozens of lightning bolts. He returned to the boat.
There weren’t many cultivators left on the boat. There were only seven or eight of them. They all looked anxious. It wasn’t that they didn’t want to leave. It was that they felt that with their cultivation, it would be difficult for them to reach the shore after they left, it wasn’t easy.
The entrance test seemed simple. However, in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain, ninety-nine percent of cultivators at the perfected Spirit Immortal Realm wouldn’t be able to pass!
That was why they didn’t pay much attention to Wang Baole’s return. Instead, they gathered together and spread out their cultivation. It was as if they wanted to rely on everyone’s hard work to suppress the resentment that was spreading, the process of turning the ship into paper was slowed down as much as possible, so that they could use it to move forward.
In reality, they weren’t the only ones who had done so. There were a few cultivators on the other ships who had chosen this method. However, the results weren’t ideal. At that moment, more than half of the ship Wang Baole was on had turned into black paper, it seemed like he wouldn’t be able to hold on for long. However, at that moment, Wang Baole’s body landed with a loud crash. The instant he landed, the dozens of scarlet bolts of lightning that were chasing after him descended with a loud bang and landed directly on the boat.
The entire boat shook slightly. Just like before, there wasn’t much reaction. It seemed to be able to resist the power of the Lightning. However... the resentment of the Black Sea that was lingering on the boat was like a mouse seeing a cat. It had a huge reaction, it retreated instantly. There were even some places that couldn’t Dodge in time. After being struck by lightning, there were screams that sounded like screams. The resentment dissipated immediately, and the area of the ship that was revealed was visibly restored!
This scene immediately stunned everyone on the ship. Even the elites in mid-air widened their eyes in disbelief and disbelief.
Even Wang Baole himself was stunned for a moment. His eyes instantly lit up. He suddenly raised his head to look at Li Lin, who had just shouted at him angrily in mid-air, and snorted disdainfully.
“Idiot. This is me casting a spell to purify the entire Black Sea and return the world to its former glory!”As he spoke, he raised his right hand and made a hand seal.
“Divine Power Dao Lei, Come!”

chapters.title: Chapter 927 - grab it!
chapters.content:
Chapter 927:, grab it!
Wang Baole spoke arrogantly. As soon as he spoke, hundreds of crimson bolts of lightning struck the Starfall ship, causing the Black Sea resentment on the ship to retreat in a large area, more areas revealed their original appearance.
That wasn’t the end. In the next instant, more bolts of lightning struck. The bolts of lightning seemed to have intelligence. They didn’t search for anyone else. Even when they flew past the elites in midair, they didn’t harm them at all, all of them landed accurately on the ship..
The entire ship had turned into paper. It was rapidly recovering at a speed visible to the naked eye. Wang Baole was excited. He felt that this was the result of extreme sorrow and joy. He raised his head and roared towards the sky.
“Today, I, Xie, wish to completely wipe out the Black Sea and exterminate the Fiend Dao Lightning. Come, come, come, come!”
As soon as he said that, more bolts of lightning struck. They enveloped the entire ship, causing all the resentment in the Black Sea on the ship to instantly disappear without a trace. It even affected some of the surrounding areas on the surface of the sea, the black color gradually faded and turned white!
Even though more resentment gathered from the surrounding areas, resisting the lightning and forming a balance, the ship that Wang Baole was on had completely recovered. Even the paper figurine on the ship had a strange look in its eyes, it rowed the oars and sailed into the distance.
However, the scale of the Lightning was clearly still affected here. It was not as large as it was in the outside world, covering an area the size of a civilization. In this place, it only covered the area of a single ship.
Even so, this scene still left the seven or eight people on the ship shocked and overjoyed. It also caused the auras of the people in the sky and the other ships to change.
“What kind of lightning is this? One moment it’s divine might, the next it’s devil-exterminating...”
“No matter what it is, it seems to be able to restrain the resentment of the Black Sea! !”
...
Other than those who had already flown far away, all the chosen in a certain area who saw this scene were shocked to the extreme. The other eight ships had already mostly turned into paper, the worst one had already been reduced to 90% paper. At this moment, it could be seen that it had almost merged with the Black Sea, and the cultivators in it had no choice but to fly out.
The other ships could not hold out for long either. This made some of the cultivators who had come to the fallen star land, thinking that it would be difficult to reach the shore, extremely anxious.
Although there were not many of them, there were about a hundred of them. Under the pressure of the sky, they knew that they would not be able to reach the shore if they sped up. Although, if they slowed down and maintained their speed in mid-air, they had to be careful.., they could avoid falling into the Black Sea, but that would mean that they would lose the right to enter the fallen star lands and obtain the serendipity five days later.
How could they accept this? They had all been worried and depressed, but now... Wang Baole’s recovery of the ship gave them hope amidst their anxiety. Their eyes shone brightly.
It was obvious... that if they could board the ship, they could reach the shore in five days!
They weren’t the only ones who had such thoughts. Those who felt that they could reach the shore with their own cultivation and speed were also tempted. After all, once they boarded the ship, they would reduce the risk, and they would be unharmed, this would naturally bring great benefits to the subsequent assessment.
Very quickly, someone rushed out from midair and headed straight for Wang Baole’s ship. Behind him, there were even more cultivators who turned into streaks of light and were about to board the ship forcefully!
If anyone tried to stop them, they would become their common enemy. Some of them even looked at Wang Baole with a warning look.
Seeing this, Wang Baole felt sick to his stomach. He sighed inwardly. His thoughts had been cleared by the matter of selling the spirit spirit fruit. He knew that the elites from the large and powerful clans were all rich people, they could easily fork out millions of red crystals. He couldn’t help but feel depressed.
If only I could sell the tickets... that would be great. Wang Baole felt regretful, but he knew that it was unlikely. If he were to forcefully stop everyone, he wouldn’t be able to do it. He wouldn’t be able to do it alone, it would be difficult to stop them completely. If he were to do it, it would be equivalent to incurring the wrath of the masses..
Wang Baole could only let out a long sigh. He knew that there was money to be made, but he was unable to get his hands on it. However, just as he sighed, the figure of the Prodigy who had rushed in first approached him, the Crimson Lightning Bolt’s target was not him, so although it appeared to be soul-stirring, it was actually unharmed as it shuttled through the lightning bolt. A look of pleasant surprise appeared on its face, and it looked as if it was about to board the ship.
However, at that moment... the paper figurine rowing at the bow of the ship raised its left hand and waved it casually. Immediately, the youth who was about to board the ship let out a blood-curdling scream, as if he had been slapped by an invisible palm, he spat out a mouthful of blood, and his body tumbled backward at an even faster speed.
This scene made Wang Baole’s eyes widen, and it also shocked the other people who had rushed over. However, they were already close to the ship, and their eyes were filled with viciousness. They dispersed, still attempting to board the ship.
In the blink of an eye, dozens of people shuttled through the Lightning. However, the moment they boarded the ship, the paper figurine still raised its left hand and waved it gently. Immediately, screams of pain rang out. Out of the dozens of people, only two were unharmed, while the rest vomited blood, their bodies were slapped away!
Among the two unharmed people, one was Li Linzi. He was clearly excited. As he landed on the ship rapidly, he could not hide the excitement on his face. He did not care about Wang Baole’s gaze. Instead, he quickly found a corner and sat down cross-legged, he assumed a stance that he wouldn’t leave even if he died.
Seeing that someone had succeeded, the eyes of the hundreds of prodigies in the surroundings turned red. They rushed over and tried to board the ship. However, those who were waiting for them were still sent flying. Only seven or eight cultivators who seemed to be rather lucky weren’t stopped by the paper figurine, this allowed them to board the ship successfully.
It was also at this moment that Wang Baole saw the clues. The people who had successfully boarded the ship also saw the problem. The prodigies outside also saw the same thing.
“The people who boarded the ship... were the people on the ship from before!”
“Is this the rules of the meteorite ship? Cultivators from other ships are not allowed to board another ship?”
This scene made the elites in the sky extremely indignant, but they were helpless. They couldn’t even blame Wang Baole. After all... He wasn’t the one who had stopped them from boarding the ship.
However, they still had to try. After all, this was a matter related to the meteorite assessment. Therefore, there were still a few cultivators who hadn’t made a move earlier. They approached quickly, wanting to try boarding the ship.
This made Wang Baole’s eyes light up, and his mind spun rapidly.
Since Lightning has chased me all the way here, I wonder if my wish from before is still valid... my wish from before was that the paper figurine on the ship wouldn’t Stop Me
“If it is still valid, would the paper figurine not stop me if I took action and brought people in?”Thinking of this, Wang Baole’s heart pounded. Seeing that the people had arrived, the paper figurine raised its left hand, wang Baole suddenly roared.
“Little Fatty, don’t fight back. I’ll bring you in!”As he spoke, Wang Baole instantly raised his right hand and grabbed at one of the two cultivators closest to him who was trying to charge in!
The little fatty’s body was like a ball. The reason why Wang Baole had chosen him was partly because he felt that the other party’s figure was fated to be his, and partly because he felt that the other party looked very rich.
The Little Fatty’s reaction was also extremely fast. Seeing that he was grabbed by the other party across space, he did not react at all. He allowed Wang Baole to pull him, but he was ignored by the paper figurine and dragged onto the ship.
As soon as he boarded the ship, the little fatty was in disbelief at first. Then, he laughed loudly. The flesh on his face was trembling as he cupped his fists at Wang Baole.
“Thank you, fellow Daoist.”
As for the others, they did not receive such treatment. All of them retreated with a wave of the paper figurine’s hand. This scene immediately made everyone’s breathing quicken. Their eyes widened as they looked at Wang Baole.
Wang Baole was very excited, but seeing that the little fatty did not seem sincere enough in his gratitude, he glanced at him and said calmly.
“There’s no need to thank me. I’ll make a move once. Give me one hundred thousand red crystals.”
“One hundred thousand red crystals?”The Little Fatty’s eyes widened, and the gratitude on his face disappeared instantly. He glared at Wang Baole.
“You’re too evil. You can get one hundred thousand just by grabbing a handful. Why Don’t You Go Rob Someone? I, Zhou Linfeng, have never been ripped off like this in my life. Give You Money? Impossible!”
“You’re not giving me money?”Wang Baole was angry as well. He thought that his price was very fair. He hadn’t said anything about grabbing a handful of red crystals, which was already a rather benevolent act. However, the other party had actually repaid his kindness with enmity.
Therefore, he glared and was about to make a move. However, he felt that he had to let the other party know the value of grabbing a handful of red crystals. If he were to make a move, it wouldn’t be enough. Therefore, he turned his head and looked at the hundreds of people outside.
“Grab a handful of 100,000 yuan. Which one of you agrees? I’ll bring him in and then trade this little fatty out!”

chapters.title: Chapter 928 - - the abacus of the forest!
chapters.content:
Chapter 928: — the abacus of the forest!
Upon hearing Wang Baole’s words, the little fatty’s expression immediately changed. He was furious and felt that the fellow in front of him was really too greedy. Other than himself, how could there be such a greedy person in this world!
It wasn’t just the little fatty. The elites outside, faced with Wang Baole’s public offer, all of them looked at the boat that was being struck by lightning. Their expressions were ugly. They didn’t care about the hundred thousand red crystals.., however, they had no choice but to buy it after being blackmailed. This was contrary to their pride. They felt helpless, but at the same time, they were furious with Wang Baole.
However, they had no choice. Five days seemed like a long time, but they knew that with every delay, the chances of successfully reaching the shore would decrease. This was especially so when Wang Baole had flown out of the boat earlier, the speed at which they had sped up previously made them very clear that the other party was not a kind person.
It would have been fine if they had joined forces. However, if they were to fight alone, there was a high chance that they would not be a match for the other party. Furthermore, even if they could join forces, it would not be appropriate to force the other party to help them. Although having more people was advantageous.., however, they were not a team after all, so it was inevitable that they had all sorts of thoughts.
These thoughts quickly flashed through everyone’s mind. Due to their pride, even those who were tempted were unwilling to be the first to bow their heads, so they did not speak.
Seeing that, fatty heaved a sigh of relief. He looked at Wang Baole, and just as he was about to discuss how to ease the atmosphere, Wang Baole also saw the conflicted feelings of the people outside. He snorted inwardly and decided to add fuel to the fire.
“There’s a limit to the number of people that can be carried on the ship, and so is the time I can help. In the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, I can only catch thirty of them. If I’m too late, I won’t be able to board the ship. Don’t blame me!”
As soon as he said that, the people outside grew anxious. This concerned the fate of the fallen star lands. They had gone to great lengths in their respective clans and factions to obtain this qualification. If they were to fail because of the 100,000 red crystals.., even they felt that it wasn’t worth it when they returned. Therefore, when they heard Wang Baole’s time limit, how could they not be anxious? Immediately, a voice came from the crowd.
“I’ll buy! One!”
The first person to speak was a skinny young man. He was obviously quick-witted. As he spoke, he shouted out the number. That way, even if more than thirty people spoke at the same time as him.., he would still be qualified.
...
Wang Baole also felt that this fellow was not bad. A gratified smile appeared on his face. Just as he was about to nod his head, the others became anxious as well. Urgent voices sounded one after another, and in an instant, they spread across a large area.
“Buy, two!”
“Buy, three!”
The voices that agreed to Wang Baole’s bid rose to seventy to eighty places in just a few short breaths. However, the numbers that were shouted out did not exceed thirty. Naturally, many of them clashed with each other, even though it caused some internal anger, Wang Baole was still very pleased with such a heated scene.
He was happy, but the little fatty was trembling. He realized that it was not important whether he agreed or not. If he continued to be greedy and refused to give, the consequences could be imagined. Therefore, when the crowd outside reported the number.., without hesitation, he immediately took out a red crystal card from his pocket and quickly threw it to Wang Baole.
“Fellow Daoist, this is the greatest kindness in the world. In order to support you, I, Zhou Linfeng, am the first to agree to this matter!”
After taking the Red Crystal, Wang Baole glanced at the little fatty with a faint smile and let out a long sigh.
“I hope that everyone in the world can understand me as well as you do. How can I, Xie Dalu, covet such a small amount of money? “I am helping all of you. However, the Heavenly Dao has a way of compensating for the loss of humanity. When I act against the heavens, I have to use some worldly possessions to resist the invisible disaster.”
Looking at Wang Baole’s emotional outburst, the little fatty’s face twitched. He thought to himself that Wang Baole was too thick-skinned, and his words were too disgusting. However, he was also able to bend and bend. He was afraid that Wang Baole would go back on his words, so he put on a sincere expression, he nodded continuously.
At the same time, Li Linzi and the others on the boat saw that they could still make money like this. Although they knew that Wang Baole was special on the boat, they were still tempted, especially Li Linzi. He didn’t do it for money, instead, he felt that if he could be like Wang Baole, he could use this opportunity to gain the gratitude of everyone. If it worked well, it wouldn’t be impossible for him to gain the support of hundreds of people in the future.
“Stupid, networking is the most important thing!”Li Linzi narrowed his eyes. He didn’t want to offend Wang Baole too much, so he had no choice but to dismiss the idea of reprimanding Wang Baole to make him look bad. After all, the people outside weren’t stupid either, if he had a way to let them in, then such an act of lashing out at Wang Baole would naturally be a bonus.
However, if he had no other choice but to use his words, then it would be too much of a suspect to give an empty favor. Not only would he not achieve his goal, he would even be looked down upon by others.
With that thought, he stood up abruptly and suddenly spoke to the outside world.
“Fellow Daoists, I am Li Linzi of the Cloud Frost sect. Please don’t be in a rush to pay me. I would like to try and see if people like us who are already on the ship can invite others to board the ship, just like Xie Continent.”
“Fellow Daoists, if I succeed, I don’t expect anything in return. I have already offended fellow Daoist Xie by standing out. If I fail, please don’t blame me.”
Hearing Li Lin’s words, the people outside immediately responded. Their words were filled with gratitude and understanding. Even Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and swept his gaze across Li Lin. He instantly understood what was going on in his heart.
Can I sell it well and build my network? Li Linzi’s plan isn’t bad. Wang Baole thought, a dark glint flashed in Li Linzi’s eyes. After gaining the support of the outside world, he turned and cupped his fists at Wang Baole.
“Thank you, fellow Daoist. Please Don’t stop my attempt!”
His words immediately caused killing intent to flash in Wang Baole’s heart. Li Linzi’s words were extremely vicious. It would have been fine if Wang Baole hadn’t said those words. The resentment of the others towards Wang Baole wouldn’t have lessened, but it wouldn’t have continued to increase.
However, no matter how Wang Baole answered, he was wrong. If he stopped them, his resentment would naturally increase. If he didn’t stop them, he would be helping Li Lin establish his connections.
Li Lin is quite quick-witted! Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. In reality, he had considered pulling people onto the ship to establish his connections. However, he knew that connections were the most stable and fragile existence in the world, the reason why it was considered stable was that if the exchange continued, it would last until the end of one’s life.
Such an exchange was nothing more than emotions, value, and benefits.
The reason why it was considered fragile was that the connections that were not exchanged were just a mirage. They were of little use and could very well become a point of failure!
Therefore, it was not enough to just pull people onto the ship and build connections. Once done, it was equivalent to setting a personal setting for oneself, which required constant effort in the future.
If Wang Baole was truly a prodigy from a major faction, he would naturally have the strength to do it, and he would have the means to make it perfect. However, he was not.
The resources he had in his hands were what he needed the most!
Therefore, in the face of Li Linzi’s act of picking up scraps, Wang baole only smiled and did not speak. He allowed Li Linzi, who was secretly pleased with himself, to step forward and try to pull people in.
The outcome was obvious. Naturally, he would fail. Li Linzi was a little depressed. After all, if he failed, his previous words might be of some use, but it would not be enough to build a network. It could only be considered as having a small foundation.
Seeing that, Wang Baole suddenly spoke.
“Do you want to give me ten million red crystals so that I can help you pull in the people outside for free?”The viciousness of his words surpassed that of Li Linzi from before. After he spoke, Li Linzi’s body clearly trembled, and his expression instantly turned ugly, he was conflicted. Naturally, he wouldn’t take out ten million red crystals in exchange for his connections. He felt that it wasn’t worth it. Therefore, he snorted coldly and ignored Wang Baole. Instead, he cupped his fists at the people outside.
“Fellow Daoists, it’s not that I disagree, but I’m truly out of pocket...”
Even though there was a response, it was clear that the elites in the outside world were a little colder towards the forest. No one was a fool. They had seen clearly what had happened and what the forest was thinking, if the forest had succeeded, it would have been fine, but if it had failed, it would have been useless to them.
Wang Baole’s words had naturally played a part.
At the same time, even though he had offered a very high price, at the very least, he could have succeeded. Therefore, very quickly, the transaction of one hundred thousand red crystals began rapidly.
Seeing that, Wang Baole glanced at the forest and shook his head secretly. If the other party had really agreed, then he would have treated the other party as a person of importance. Looking at it this way, it was just grandstanding.

chapters.title: Chapter 929 - Outer Realm Lightning intent!
chapters.content:
Chapter 929:, Outer Realm Lightning intent!
Just like that, the transaction of one hundred thousand red crystals began one after another. One after another, the chosen ones in mid-air paid the red crystals after boarding the ship. It wasn’t that they hadn’t considered going back on their words, but if they did.., they would have to face the situation where Wang Baole didn’t help the others behind him.
As a result, for the one hundred thousand red crystals, not only did they offend Wang Baole, they also offended those who were waiting to board the ship. Such a thing... as long as they weren’t extremely stupid, they wouldn’t do it.
After all, although the hundred thousand red crystals weren’t a small amount, it wasn’t enough to hurt them. However, after boarding the ship, all of them had dark expressions on their faces. They looked at Wang Baole with hostility and swore in their hearts, this wasn’t the second time they had been ripped off by the other party!
If it weren’t for the fact that this place was extremely dangerous and that the paper figurine rowing the ship treated him differently, everyone would have been afraid. If they didn’t want things to change, they would have acted on their thoughts of attacking Wang Baole, wang baole naturally knew about this, but he didn’t care.
A prodigy? A bunch of useless chickens and dogs that have been piled up by resources! Wang Baole snorted coldly in his heart, however, he didn’t show it on the surface. Instead, he smiled and didn’t mention the previous restriction on the number of people who could enter. Instead, he pulled in everyone who wanted to enter.
After easily earning more than ten million red crystals, Wang Baole patted his storage bag. He felt refreshed and refreshed. Looking at the Black Paper Sea around him, he felt that it was a different scene.
“Thank you for your support, fellow Daoists. Don’t feel sullen. I have benefited from this transaction, and you have benefited from it. I, Xie continent, have always been reliable in doing business. I guarantee that I will send all of you ashore safely!”Wang Baole said as he waved his hand, instantly, the ship rumbled, and as the surrounding lightning continued to fall, it sped off into the distance.
Behind it, the other spirit boats had already been submerged by the Black Sea. They were nowhere to be seen. In the entire Black Paper Sea, they were the only spirit boats. They rode the wind and broke through the waves, producing whistling sounds.
Just like that, after the spirit boat sped for four days, from afar... one could faintly see the shore. The original five days had been shortened due to the speed of the spirit boat, this made the people who had bought the qualifications to board the ship feel a little better in their hearts.
In addition, what made their hearts feel better was that during the four days’journey, those who had relied on their own abilities to forcefully cross the sea had seen their hard work. They had even seen people who had fallen into the sea and died as paper dolls, this made the people on the ship suddenly feel that 100,000 red crystals did not seem expensive at all..
...
The only thing that made them unhappy... was that there were more and more people on the ship... in fact, on the surface of the sea, the elites flying in the sky would see their ship when they were tired and look at the people on the ship who were not as good as them, each and every one of them looked calm and relaxed. How could they not have thoughts in their hearts? Therefore, under Wang Baole’s shout, they quickly spent money to buy the qualifications.
Just like that, the number of people on the ship continued to increase. In the end, the cabin could no longer hold them. The people who boarded the ship were obviously powerful. If they wanted to have their own place to meditate, they had to forcefully seize it, therefore... as the number of people on the ship increased, the weaker the cultivation and combat strength of the people on the ship, the more they could only stand in other positions like the sails and the ship’s poles.
As a result, if one stood on the shore and looked at it from afar, the ghost ship had a deep draft. At the same time, it seemed to be stacked on top of each other. There were almost three hundred people on it. It was majestic and black, and it had a shocking aura, it made all the people waiting on the shore stunned.
“This is...”
“The ship isn’t submerged?”
“It can be like this...”
There were more than a hundred prodigies standing on the shore. The masked woman and the other three were among them. They had relied on their own abilities to forcefully cross the Black Sea. The only difference was the length of time it would take. For example, the masked woman and the other three.., they had only used two and a half days, while the others had arrived one after another. After arriving, all of them were extremely exhausted. When they saw the ghost ship where Wang Baole was, they couldn’t help but gasp in shock.
The same shock was felt by the strange cultivators on the shore. They... were all paper figures. They were different from the scraps of paper in the Black Sea. These paper figures were all white in color, densely packed together. There were thousands of them, when they saw the ghost ship, their eyes widened, and a strange expression appeared on their faces.
The fallen star lands had been opened many times, but such a scene had never happened before. The Lightning was still present, and it continued to land on the ship. It made the ship look even more majestic.
When the people on the shore saw the boat, the cultivators on the boat naturally saw the shore. Wang Baole was at the bow of the boat. He occupied a large area, and he was the first to see the shore, he instantly felt another difference in this world.
Looking at the shore, other than the prodigies and paper figurine, there were mountains in the distance, and there were buildings and plants around. However... without exception, the mountains, buildings, and plants in the distance were all made of white paper!
Other than the sky and the ground, everything else was made of paper. Wang Baole narrowed his eyes as he saw the paper figurines on the shore. Every single one of them exuded an aura that was no weaker than that of a boating paper figurine, it was especially so for the dozens of people in the lead. Every single one of them had a powerful aura that made Wang Baole’s heart skip a beat.
There was even the person in the middle who had a red line between his brows. Wang baole only took a glance at the aura of the paper figurine from afar, and his mind was filled with a thunderous roar.
These dozens of galaxies? The others are all stars? The one with the red line... seems to be even stronger. That can’t be.., wang Baole’s forehead broke out in sweat. This was the third person he had ever seen in his life... someone who felt similar to the blazing flame ancestor and his senior brother.
The Little Missy in the mask once said that senior brother had once killed the divine emperor... then his cultivation should be at least at the perfected galaxy. It’s even possible that he has surpassed the galaxy
The Blazing Flame ancestor’s aura may be weaker than senior brother’s, but it’s similar. This paper figurine with the Red Lines is the same as well... then, could his cultivation have surpassed the Starfield level as well? Has he reached the level of the Weiyang clan’s divine emperor
Thoughts raced through Wang Baole’s mind. This scene also made the other prodigies on the ship, who were aware of some of the news, nervous and uneasy.
They all fell silent. The ship was getting closer and closer to the shore. When it was about to reach the shore, the lightning around the ship seemed to be stimulated for some reason, and it became more frequent, it even spread out from the ship for the first time, as if it wanted to affect the shore.
Wang Baole was shocked. He didn’t know what to do. Suddenly, the paper figurine on the shore with a red line between its brows let out a cold snort.
“Outer realm lightning intent?”
As the words left its mouth, the paper figurine raised its right hand and swung it at the lightning bolt. There wasn’t a trace of supernatural power in the swing, but what shocked Wang Baole and everyone on the boat was what happened, it appeared before their eyes in an instant.
The lightning bolts suddenly stopped in their tracks, as if they had been frozen. At a speed visible to the naked eye... They quickly turned into paper!
The bolts of lightning instantly turned into strips of white paper. They floated down from midair and sank into the surrounding Black Sea!
“Turn lightning into paper!”Wang Baole’s mind was racing, the other party’s methods were beyond his imagination. As he stared at the strips of paper that had sunk into the Black Sea, the ghost ship they were on finally reached the shore. With a loud boom, the ship came to a halt.
Everyone, including Wang Baole, flew out immediately. None of them dared to show any signs of arrogance. They stepped onto land respectfully and cupped their fists and bowed deeply to the group of paper people.
Wang Baole was among the crowd. He lowered his head guiltily and followed the crowd in greeting. Although he didn’t raise his head, he didn’t know if it was an illusion. He could vaguely feel the gazes from the paper people landing on him.
They know that the lightning bolts followed me here? Wang Baole was nervous. Fortunately, the gazes didn’t linger on him for long before they were retracted. What followed was a calm and dignified voice.
“The seeds of the Weiyang Dao domain welcome you to the Starfall Empire!”

chapters.title: Chapter 930 - , a paper city!
chapters.content:
Chapter 930:, a paper city!
The meteorite empire... Wang Baole’s breathing quickened. His understanding of the meteorite empire was far inferior to that of the prodigies from the other great clans and powers. As he walked, he saw the paper sea, the starry sky, and the paper planet, he also saw the Black Paper Sea. Everything he looked at now was made of paper.
The paper man before him, who had an extremely powerful cultivation, said that he welcomed him to the meteorite empire.
All of this made him realize that the so-called Starfall Empire was just a place. The Starfall Empire was the ruler of this place, and its cultivation and foundation must be extremely deep, this made it so that even the Weiyang Dao Domain had to acknowledge its existence. It was difficult for them to force it, and they had to follow its rules.
Perhaps from the perspective of the Weiyang Dao Domain, even though the Starfall Empire is powerful, it has the geographical advantage... as Wang Baole thought about it, he felt more yearning for the vastness and mysteriousness of the Weiyang Dao Domain.
I wonder when I will be like senior brother, able to soar through the entire never-ending DAO domain, regardless of the vastness of the skies and the seas! As his thoughts churned, anticipation appeared in Wang Baole’s eyes, he watched as the people from the never-ending DAO domain, who were the same as him, greeted the paper figurine one after another. The paper figurine, whose cultivation had reached an unbelievable level, raised its right hand and waved it gently. Instantly, a vast power of teleportation spread out, it covered the entire area.
Wang Baole felt the irresistible power of teleportation. He couldn’t help but turn his head to look at the Black Paper Sea he had arrived in and the spirit boat by the shore. When he looked over, he saw the paper figurine accompanying him on the spirit boat, he was disembarking from the boat. He seemed to sense Wang Baole’s gaze. He looked back at Wang Baole and nodded slightly.
Wang baole nodded as well. Then, his gaze landed on the surface of the sea further away. As he stared at the Endless Black Sea, he suddenly felt that... The Black Paper Sea didn’t seem to be compatible with the entire Starfall Empire.
“Black paper, White Paper...”
As he muttered to himself, the teleportation power around him expanded. His vision blurred, and his figure blurred instantly. He disappeared without a trace along with all the other prodigies around him.
All the paper figurines disappeared along with him. In the blink of an eye, the entire shore was empty. When Wang Baole regained consciousness, he and the other prodigies who had passed the entrance examination.., they had already appeared in... a huge city!
...
To be precise, in the northwest corner of the city, there was a huge square. It was surrounded by many paper figurines. Some were big and some were small, some were old and some were young.
The big ones were like giants, and the small ones were like babies. The old ones had paper beards on their chins, and the few were as young as twenty-eight years old. Even though they were paper works, they gave off a youthful vibe.
Their gazes were all different. There was curiosity, coldness, hostility, and kindness.
They all looked at Wang Baole and the hundreds of others. It was as if in their eyes, Wang Baole and his group were all monsters. There were even some discussions that drifted in the wind.
“These outlanders are so strange. Their bodies are actually made of flesh and blood...”
“A body made of flesh and blood... Heavens, the creator is really amazing. He can do this!”
“I heard that most of the living beings outside are like this. They haven’t evolved perfectly.”
“That’s right, it’s really ugly!”
The discussions fell into the ears of everyone, including Wang Baole. However, no one paid too much attention to them. They were all observing their surroundings. They could tell that this was a city. Even if it was just a corner, as their divine senses spread out.., soon, everyone’s expressions changed.
What a huge city! Wang Baole’s pupils constricted slightly.
Through his divine senses, he could sense that the city was vast. It was about the size of the entire earth. All the buildings were made of paper. As for the specific details, as they were all gathered together, they were unable to examine it in detail, however, after a quick scan, Wang Baole was still very curious about this place.
As his curiosity grew, Wang Baole and the rest were quickly given a place to stay by the paper figurine cultivator from the Starfall Empire. The place they were assigned to was not far from the public square. It was like a clubhouse, each of them had their own room.
After settling them down, a paper figurine cultivator calmly informed them that the second trial would begin in three days. If they missed the time, their spots would be revoked. At the same time, those who had the spots.., fighting was not allowed before the trial. Whoever made the first move would lose their spots. Then, without further ado, they turned and left.
“There are no restrictions on us?”
“As expected, this place is just like the clan’s records. Everything is paper-based!”
“Three days is enough!”As the paper figurine left, the eyes of the elites in the area shone with a strange light. Some of them were familiar with each other, and after conversing softly with each other, they immediately dispersed.
There were still some who chose to stay in the Guild Hall to meditate, but most of them left for the city district. There were even some who were mysterious, and no one knew what they were discussing or researching.
Wang Baole ignored the mysterious people. After some thought, he decided to leave the guild hall and wander around the city of the Starfall Empire. In his mind, since he was here, he had to observe the place carefully, after all, the world he was looking at was a world of paper. It had broadened his horizons.
I wonder if this place is afraid of fire... as he walked along the streets, Wang Baole looked at the bustling crowd of paper people. For some reason, this thought appeared in his mind.
After realizing that his thoughts were very dangerous, he quickly suppressed the thought and allowed himself to relax. He was like a tourist, touring the city. As he walked, he saw too many paper people, he also saw the structure of the meteorite empire. It was similar to other civilizations. Although he didn’t have currency, spirit stones and red crystals were equally useful here. At the same time, there were many shops and restaurants.
The paper figurines also needed food. However, their food was also paper, but what was special was that the paper that they treated as food was transparent.
It was the same even for alcohol. It looked like water, but Wang Baole bought a bottle out of curiosity. He found that it was empty, like a gas. The various foods made from the special paper, with Wang Baole’s impeccable taste.., he had tried many times and decided to give up.
However, it wasn’t as if he hadn’t gained anything. The first thing that shocked him was the cultivation level of the paper figurine from the Starfall Empire. The weakest paper figurine he saw was comparable to a nascent soul realm cultivator. Even infants were like that.
He had no choice but to guess that the cultivation level of the nascent soul realm was the basic level for all the paper figurine here!
As for the Spirit Ascension Realm, Spirit Immortals, and even planets... Wang Baole was dazzled by the sight as he walked, and it was even more thrilling. On one hand, the cultivation of the paper figurine here was generally very high. On the other hand, he was in the crowd, he was like a torch in the dark night, attracting the attention of countless paper figurine wherever he went.
Wang Baole wasn’t used to all of this at first, but he quickly got used to it. He felt that he was the future federation president after all, and getting used to the attention of others was a basic quality.
Other than that, he also discovered that there were many shops in the city that sold various dharmic artifacts and cultivation techniques.
It was a pity that after Wang Baole bought a few of the cultivation techniques, he realized that they were all wordless heavenly books. They were completely blank, as if there was a law affecting them, preventing the cultivation techniques from appearing in his eyes.
That was indeed the case. In the shop he was in, an old man who had sent off a few customers turned his head to look at Wang Baole and laughed.
“I knew it was time for the tunnel to open again. However, you are still the first outer realm cultivator to come to my shop in all these years
“These cultivation technique scrolls are invisible to you due to the differences in the rules and laws. Take the one in your hand for example. It’s called the one crane art. Once you master it, you can change your body structure to become a paper crane, which will increase your speed by nearly a fold. However, the prerequisite is that your body must be the same as ours.”
Hearing the Elder’s words, Wang Baole immediately cupped his fists respectfully.
“Greetings, senior. This junior regrets it as well. It would be great if I could learn the cultivation techniques here.”Wang baole sighed.
“From ancient times until now, I have never heard of cultivators from the outside world being able to learn the cultivation techniques of the Starfall Empire on their own, unless they were taught by someone else. However... do you dare learn them?”The elder said with a faint smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 931 - was very cost-effective!
chapters.content:
Chapter 931: was very cost-effective!
“This...”Wang Baole hesitated for a moment. He wanted to say that he dared, but he knew very well that the difference between the rules and the laws meant that there was a completely different cultivation method for the cultivation technique. There was no reference or comparison, it was very difficult for him to figure it out unless he personally checked the authenticity of the cultivation technique.
Therefore, the other party could easily create some falsehood within it. Even if there was no falsehood, if he cultivated carelessly, his body would probably turn into a blank sheet of paper.
Unless he could understand it and see the words with his own eyes, he would need to ensure that it was authentic. Only then would it be possible to try it out, but it would still be dangerous.
With that thought, Wang Baole shook his head with a bitter smile.
Do I really not dare? Take this for example. It can be said to be one of the top cultivation techniques in my shop. It is called the Nine Thoughts Paper Art! Once it is activated, it will allow you to add the rules of the paper into your divine arts and spells. It will instantly incinerate any enemies you come into contact with... when the elites of the Starfall Empire fought with the outer regions, we used this technique to turn many enemies’bodies into paper and turn them into ashes,”the elder said, he raised his right hand and grabbed at the air. Immediately, a golden paper that was placed on the highest level flew over and landed in his hand.
“Even though you can’t see the cultivation technique on it, you can still buy it and collect it.”The elder looked at Wang Baole. He seemed to be pleased to see the depressed expression on Wang Baole’s face when he couldn’t see or cultivate despite his desire.
“Senior...”Wang Baole was about to speak when the old man coughed and waved his right hand again.
“You don’t want it? How about this one? It’s called the ape fire curse. As long as it’s activated, it can transform into a gigantic fire ape. Its power is so great that even a star will have a headache
“There’s also this one. This technique is incredible. It’s called the one thought stellar art. Once cultivated, it can transform a star into a paper star and fold it in one’s hand. It can be said to be the power of creation!”The old man showed off one cultivation technique after another, as Wang Baole listened to the detailed description of its power, he could not help but let out a long sigh. He raised his right hand and patted his storage bag. Immediately, a jade slip appeared in his hand.
“Senior, I wonder if you can read the contents of the jade slip in my hand. This cultivation technique is called the heaven-reaching telekinesis art. Once you master it, there will be no one else’s telekinesis in the world where you live. Everything will be based on your will, surpassing your domain and becoming Supreme!”Wang Baole held a map jade slip in his hand, he spoke calmly.
...
The elder was taken aback by his words. Before he could say anything, Wang Baole raised an eyebrow.
“I’m not satisfied. There’s also this. This cultivation technique is called the Kun Peng Dao swallowing technique. Once you master it, you’ll be able to transform into a gigantic kun Peng that will devour everything. It can be said to be an invincible technique!”
“You’re still not satisfied? “It doesn’t matter. The Xie family, where the Xie continent is located, is one of the top noble families in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain. I have many cultivation techniques. For example, this technique is known as the invincible three strikes. Don’t think that its name is strange, but its power is beyond imagination. Once you master it, the first strike will dry up the ocean. The second strike will cause the earth to collapse. The third strike will cause the stars to Fall!” Wang Baole took out three to four jade slips in one go. There were maps and blanks in them. He placed them in front of the old man, who had a blank expression on his face.
“Senior, do you dare to Learn?”Wang Baole coughed and asked again. In fact, he had just realized that the old man had clearly done it on purpose to tease him. Therefore, in order to cooperate.., wang Baole felt that it was necessary for him to let the elder experience a similar feeling.
“Are you here for the trial to obtain the fortunes of the planets, or are you here to sell things?”The elder had a strange expression on his face. After a long while, he snorted.
“The Xie Family? I’ve heard of them. No wonder... Fine, let’s Exchange!”As he spoke, the elder passed the four pieces of paper in his hands to Wang Baole.
Wang Baole was stunned. He blinked and quickly handed over the jade slip in his hand. He completed the trade with the elder as quickly as he could. His heart raced as he left.
The elder didn’t try to stop him. He was even a little nervous. When he was certain that Wang Baole had left, he beamed as he looked at the jade slip in his hand. He was extremely pleased with himself.
Haha, I used a few pieces of trash paper to exchange for a few jade slips from the outer realm. It doesn’t matter if there are any cultivation techniques in them. The material is enough. Not Bad, not bad. This thing is a rare item. Once these people from the outer realm leave, I’ll be able to get my hands on rare items
At the same time, Wang Baole, who had left the shop, was breathing rapidly. His eyes were shining as he stared at the few pieces of paper in his hand. He was equally excited.
A few trash jade slips were exchanged for these cultivation techniques? Even if the cultivation techniques inside were very low-level, this thing would definitely be able to fool a lot of people outside. No matter how much it was sold, it would still be more expensive than the jade slips... it’s worth it. I made a profit, wang Baole’s interest was immediately piqued. He might as well go to the shops that sold cultivation techniques or Dharmic treasures.
Two days passed in a flash. During these two days, Wang Baole went to many shops and exchanged trash jade slips for many pieces of paper. However, what made him feel regretful was that this tactic did not work in the Dharmic artifact shops.
Who would have thought that the Dharmic artifacts of the Starfall Empire were all drawn... Wang Baole sighed. He raised his right hand and a piece of paper appeared in his hand. There was a sword drawn on it.
It was only after he had taken out more than a dozen trashy dharmic artifacts that the other party had reluctantly agreed to give him this dharmic treasure. However, Wang Baole felt like an idiot no matter how he held it in his hand..
Forget it. The trial starts tomorrow. I should calm down and maintain my cultivation at its peak. Wang Baole shook his head. He threw the piece of paper in his hand into his storage bag and placed it with the hundreds of other pieces of paper, he walked towards the clubhouse where he was staying.
He returned very quickly. He was just about to step into the clubhouse and return to his room when a group of people walked out from the clubhouse, laughing and chatting. Before they arrived, the sound of a bell rang out and landed in Wang Baole’s ears, the group of people also bumped into each other at the entrance.
The leader of the group was one of the four people who were as strong as the masked woman. She smiled without saying a word. She was graceful and extremely beautiful. She wore a rainbow-colored long dress, concealing her graceful figure, she wore a bell on her fair wrist. As she walked, the sound of the bell was crisp and clear.
Among the seven or eight people beside her, Wang Baole saw Li Lin Zi, the little fatty, and another person. He was tall and straight, and his expression was arrogant. What was most attractive was his hairstyle. It was tied together in an exaggerated fashion, and he stood tall, from Afar, it was shocking. He seemed to be extremely tall.
His hair seemed to contain a special spell that was emitting light. Therefore, when Wang Baole saw this person, he was stunned for a moment. It was as if he saw a walking light bulb.
In his entire life, the only person who could compare to this person in terms of hairstyle was Xie Haiyang’s thick hair gel. However, after careful comparison, Wang Baole had to admit that Xie Haiyang was also slightly inferior to this person.
“An expert?”Wang Baole muttered in his heart. Just as he was about to bypass them and enter the Guild Hall, Li Linzi saw Wang Baole and his eyes flashed with mockery. He smiled and said to the expert beside him.
“Brother Gao, didn’t you previously ask me who was so insane and shameless as to sell the qualifications for a hundred thousand red crystals? It was this person. Not only did he sell the qualifications, but he also killed the purple gold civilization cultivators and snatched the qualifications!”
The moment Li Linzi spoke, the expert immediately looked at Wang Baole. Even the bell lady’s beautiful eyes swept over him and landed on Wang Baole.
Wang Baole raised an eyebrow. He was not a person who would swallow his anger. When he heard Li Linzi’s words, he immediately looked over coldly.
“Li Linzi, the next time you continue speaking to me like that, I will kill you.”Wang Baole’s tone was calm, but the seriousness on his face and the killing intent in his eyes caused Li Linzi, who was about to speak, to suddenly pause, for some reason, a chill rose in his heart.
After saying that, Wang Baole ignored lilinzi. Instead, he nodded at the expert and the Bell Lady. He turned and walked into the Guild Hall. From his back view, he did not seem to be on guard. Lilinzi’s expression was extremely ugly, and killing intent flashed in his eyes, staring at Wang Baole’s back view, he seemed to be unable to resist the urge to attack. However, the Bell Lady, who was also looking at Wang Baole’s back view, suddenly spoke.
“Fellow Daoist Li Linzi, I advise you not to provoke him. He was deliberately provoking you just now!”
“Have you forgotten the rules of this place? Once you take the initiative to attack, you will lose your spot. After losing your spot, if he wants to kill you, it doesn’t seem to be within the scope of the rules. The rules are only a requirement. Those who have a spot are not allowed to fight before the trial!”The bell lady said calmly, she looked at Wang Baole’s back with some interest. It was not the kind between a man and a woman. Instead, she felt that Wang Baole’s intelligence and methods could be used as her servant.
“Mind your own business!”Wang baole, who had his back to them as he walked into the Guild Hall, muttered to himself when he heard that. He put away the nightmare eye formula that he had been secretly operating.

chapters.title: Chapter 932 - set out!
chapters.content:
Chapter 932:, set out!
The effects of the Nightmare Eye art contained a mind-numbing thought. This thought could affect the minds of others, and it was often effective in battle. Wang Baole had secretly used this technique just now.
He had indeed wanted Li Linzi to attack him. According to the rules, as long as Li Linzi attacked, he would lose his qualifications. Wang Baole had no doubt about that.
Similarly, if Li Linzi lost his qualifications, Wang Baole could kill him without losing his spot in the fallen star lands. Of course, that was also because Li Linzi didn’t like him. After all, with his character.., it wasn’t easy for him to endure being provoked so many times until now.
I might as well throw him out on the ship. Wang Baole snorted in his heart. Since Li Linzi didn’t know what was good for him, he could just find an opportunity to kill him when no one else was around.
And that Bell Lady, why does she like to meddle in other people’s business! Wang Baole didn’t turn back to look at the gaze behind him. He walked into the interior of the Guild Hall and into his room.
After all, more than half of the three days of consolidation had passed. There was only one day left. Therefore, Wang Baole planned to adjust his cultivation on the last day to maintain his peak condition so that he could face the upcoming meteorite trials.
Time passed slowly. Soon, it was night time. The White Paper Moon emitted a gentle glow in the sky, illuminating the entire meteorite city. At the same time, all the cultivators like Wang Baole had returned and were making their own adjustments, they were preparing for the trials that would begin after daybreak.
It was already past midnight. It was quiet outside. It was less than six hours before daybreak. Wang Baole was in a meditative state. Every breath he took was in harmony with his body’s fluctuations. He seemed to blend into the surrounding void, wang baole, who had increased his cultivation, suddenly felt his eyebrows twitch!
He opened his eyes in that instant, and a look of shock appeared on his face. He looked at his storage bag, and the instant he looked over, his storage bag opened on its own. The storage ring inside also opened on its own, the paper figurine stuck its head out, and a strange expression appeared on its face. Its body swayed, and it flew out of the storage ring in the blink of an eye. When it reappeared... it was right in front of Wang Baole!
Wang Baole’s expression changed, and his breathing quickened. Strange laughter reverberated in his mind, causing his cultivation to be in a mess. Sweat broke out on his forehead. He wanted to get up, but to his shock, he realized.., he had lost control of his body!
...
No matter how hard he tried to control it, he could not move his body at all. He sat there, unable to close his eyes. In his shock, he watched as the paper figurine in front of him expanded rapidly from the size of a palm, in an instant, it turned into the height of an ordinary person.
As if it was not used to its appearance, the paper figurine moved around in Wang Baole’s room in front of him. Only after getting used to it did it raise its head to look at Wang Baole.
Just the sight of each other caused Wang Baole’s eyes, which could not close, to sting. Fortunately, the paper figurine withdrew its gaze after glancing at him. It stood by the window and looked up at the Paper Moon in the sky. After a long while.., just as Wang Baole’s eyes were beginning to tear up, the paper figurine’s eyes revealed a strange look. Then, it moved its body and seemed to have left the room, disappearing immediately.
As it disappeared, Wang Baole’s body instantly regained control. He instinctively closed his eyes and tried hard to adjust his chaotic breathing. After a long while, when he opened his eyes again, he looked at the place where the paper figurine had disappeared, he checked his storage ring again and confirmed that it had indeed left. After confirming that it had not returned, Wang Baole slowly narrowed his eyes. At the same time, a chill ran down his spine.
This paper figurine has helped me board the ship many times. It must be related to the fact that it wanted to use me to enter the ship
The way it entered the ship, no matter how I look at it, looks like it was smuggled in... Wang Baole suddenly felt a little guilty. He felt that there might be some shocking changes that would occur during this trip to the fallen star, and the source of these changes.., it was highly likely that it was done by the paper figurine that he had brought in.
Forget it. I’m also a victim in this matter! Wang baole sighed. After consoling himself, he remembered that there was still a living person in his storage bag. He quickly checked and discovered that the dao child prodigy of the purple gold civilization was still alive, he heaved a sigh of relief when he realized that he was still alive.
He couldn’t let the other party die. At the very least, he couldn’t die before he returned to the God’s eye civilization and was safe. After realizing that the person was fine, Wang Baole was about to retract his divine thought. However, when he thought about the paper figurine smuggling, a thought suddenly rose in his mind.
I wonder if this method of smuggling can be used on other people... Wang Baole suppressed the thought once again. If it was really that simple, he could have brought people to smuggle people.., the Starfall Empire would have been in big trouble long ago.
In order to prevent any unforeseen circumstances, Wang Baole thought for a moment and decided to try taking out the Dao child prodigy from the purple gold civilization from his storage bag. However, he soon realized that he could successfully take out other items, but as long as it was a living being.., he was unable to do so. It was obvious that the rules of this place were interfering with the smuggling process.
The paper figurine succeeded because it was a living being here! Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He saw that Dawn was approaching, so he suppressed his thoughts and calmed himself down. He readjusted his cultivation, the sky outside gradually brightened.
When the sky had completely brightened, a majestic voice suddenly reverberated in the minds of Wang Baole and all the other elites.
“The trial has begun!”
As the voice rang out, an irresistible force instantly spread throughout the entire hall. Although the force dissipated in an instant, the sound of crashing waves could be heard from the outside. However, the sound was a little strange, it sounded like waves at first, but if one were to examine it closely, it sounded like the sound of paper moving.
Wang Baole was no stranger to the sound. His eyes widened, and he instantly stood up and ran to the window. When he looked out, his pupils constricted. What he saw... was no longer the streets of Starfall City, it was a boundless... Black Sea of paper!
It was as if the past three days had been nothing more than an illusion. Wang Baole immediately spread out his supernatural awareness and realized that he was in a gigantic, boundless ship.
There were no paper figures on the ship, but the ship was moving on its own as if it was riding the wind and breaking the waves. It was so fast that even the black paper sea had to leave a long mark in front of it, causing countless pieces of black paper to fly backward.
Such a method of teleportation... Wang Baole narrowed his eyes instantly.
There were hundreds of rooms in the cabin of the ship, and he was in one of them!
As for the other rooms, some of the cultivators were shocked, and began to examine them. Even the bell-bell girl’s eyes shone with a strange light.
However, the chosen from the great clans and powerful organizations were naturally extraordinary, so they quickly returned to normal. It was at this moment that the dignified voice from the paper figurine rang out, once again, it echoed out in the minds of everyone present.
“Cultivators from the Outlands, if you wish to obtain the final opportunity in the fallen star lands, you will have to undergo three tests. You have passed the first test. Now, it is time for the second Test
“This test is an elimination test. The destination in front of you is a special planet called the illusory planet. Over there... all life forms that die in your hands will be transformed into Phantoms and become obstacles for you
“With all these obstacles, there are thirty illusory crystals in the illusory planet. From the moment you set foot on the illusory planet, seven days later, those who hold the illusory crystals will be able to pass the second stage and enter the final decision
“The journey will only take one day. All of you... Cherish this final peace.”As the voice spoke, it slowly faded away. The ship fell into silence. Everyone was silent, including Wang Baole, he felt that there was something wrong with the fallen star.
He wasn’t the only one who felt that way. Other than the few prodigies in the other rooms who seemed to know something, the majority of the people in the other rooms had similar questions in their hearts. The truth was that the opening of the fallen star this time.., it was slightly inconsistent with the records in the ancient records of their family clans. The number of tests had increased significantly!
The tests are here, and after entering Starfall City, there will be another test. From the looks of it, there will be a final decision after the second Test... why is the Starfall City like this? Does anyone else know the reason? Wang Baole narrowed his eyes, he was considering whether or not he should get some information. However, at that moment, he seemed to hear the question in his heart. A familiar and sharp voice suddenly rang out in his mind. It was a strange laugh, then came the words.
“That’s because... This might be the last time the fallen star land will be opened!”

chapters.title: Chapter 933 - Illusory Star!
chapters.content:
Chapter 933:, Illusory Star!
As soon as the voice rang out, Wang Baole’s hair stood on end. He looked around, but there was nothing else in the room other than himself. He couldn’t even detect anything with his consciousness.
The voice seemed to be Wang Baole’s hallucination, and it didn’t appear again. Wang Baole remained vigilant for a while. He even tried to speak, but there was still no response. He opened his storage bag and quickly checked the storage ring inside, then, his expression turned ugly.
He was certain that he hadn’t misheard. The reason why the shrill voice was familiar was because it gave him the same feeling as the paper figurine’s laughter when it left the storage ring!
It didn’t leave... or did it return after leaving? Wang Baole sensed that there was nothing else in the storage ring other than the wishing bottle and the galaxy bow. However, he had a vague feeling that.., the paper figurine... might be beside him!
Whatever. The paper figurine must have some ulterior motives with me. Otherwise, why would it return! Wang Baole pretended to be relaxed as he pondered. He sat down cross-legged and began meditating again. It seemed like he was adjusting his cultivation, but in reality, various thoughts were running through his mind, his consciousness remained in a scattered state.
Time passed slowly, and soon, half a day had passed. After half a day, the elites on the boat, which had no paper figurine paddling and seemed to be guided by some kind of force, had already gotten used to it, most of the people in the boat had left their rooms and gathered into small groups.
There were large and small groups, about a dozen of them. One of them was formed in the forest. Fatty was among them, as was brother Gao, who had towering hair.
However, there were also many people who did not pay attention to the others and were alone. For example, the masked woman and the cold black-robed cultivator, who was filled with a murderous aura, were in different groups, as for the other two, who had caught Wang Baole’s attention previously, who were among the four strongest prodigies, they were clearly very prominent in their status.
There were more than twenty people gathered around the bell-shaped woman. Even though brother Gao was not among them, the cultivators who gathered around the bell-shaped woman, despite the admiration in their eyes, were clearly cautious and fawning over her.
As for the refined cultivator, he seemed to be used to having people gathering around him. He only lowered his head to read a book and didn’t pay much attention to the dozens of people who had automatically appeared around him, however, the people who had gathered around him were clearly paying close attention to his every move. They would step forward as soon as they needed anything.
...
It was because the crowd had dispersed that Wang Baole was able to hear the whispers of many people. Of course, most of these discussions weren’t a secret, so no one deliberately hid them. For example, he knew the identity of the bell-shaped woman!
“In the side sect’s holy region, the nine Phoenix sect is the leader of the endless starry skies. This sect ranks third in the side sect’s holy region in terms of overall strength!”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. Before he knew about the side sect’s side sect, he didn’t have much of an understanding of the so-called nine Phoenix sect, however, things were different now.
He knew very well that the nine Phoenix sect was a powerful force that was countless times stronger than the purple gold civilization. It wasn’t much different from the Xie family either. To a certain extent, it could be ranked on the same level.
At the same time, Wang Baole had also heard about the origins of the scholarly cultivator. To a certain extent, he could be considered a fellow countryman... that was because they were both from the left dao sacred territory, but they were from the nine Prefectures Dao, which was ranked first in the left dao sacred territory, they were the only personal disciple of a certain Vice Dao Lord!
It could be said that with their status, a single sentence... could cause the purple gold civilization to be terrified. After all, the purple gold civilization had to accept the leadership of the Nine Prefectures Dao, based on their affiliation.
Wang Baole had also heard about the background of brother Gao Ren. He was from the Weiyang Dao Domain. Other than the Xie family, he was from a newly-established merchant family in the DAO domain. His influence was extraordinary, especially in the past few thousand years, from the outside, he could barely compete with the Xie family.
The Xie family had allowed him to grow. There was clearly some reason that outsiders didn’t know about.
Each and every one of them has an extraordinary background. Wang Baole pursed his lips and thought to himself, I’m not bad either. The dark child of the dark sect and my senior brother are even more ferocious. If I were to tell them, they would definitely scare a lot of people to death.
With that thought in mind, he felt much more at ease. At the same time, he could tell that the masked woman didn’t want to reveal her identity and refused to interact with everyone. As for the young man dressed in black with a longsword on his back and a murderous aura.., he didn’t seem to have any background. It was obvious that he was wary and hostile towards anyone who approached him.
Wang baole could vaguely make out some clues. However, the duration of the voyage was too short. It was only one day. If it had been longer, Wang Baole believed that he would have been able to gather more information.
When Wang Baole used his divine perception to listen to the conversations of others, there were many cultivators who did the same. However, there were many things that were useful to Wang Baole. However, to them, they already knew about it, so they didn’t pay too much attention to it, what they paid the most attention to... was Wang Baole’s background!
After all, Wang Baole’s appearance, even if he didn’t think that it was stunning, in the eyes of others, was already extremely detestable.
If it was just detestable, it wouldn’t be a big deal. However, his strength was clearly extraordinary, and he even seemed to be able to compare to the four strongest prodigies. This naturally attracted many people’s attention.
“Xie Continent? The Xie Family? I’ve never heard of the Xie family having such a name. This name... reminds me of the ignorant and extremely shameless xie haiyang from the Xie family.”
