“Plundering the Purple Gold Civilization’s quota? Forcefully boarding the ship and capturing him alive in front of all of you, despite the star stopping him?”
“What? The fallen star emissary didn’t stop him from taking the spirit spirit fruit!”
“He even allowed him to row the boat and draw on the Immortal Energy to cleanse his body?”
As the news spread, those who heard the news were all visibly moved. They scanned Wang Baole’s room with their telepathic thoughts. Even the bell maiden, the refined cultivator, and the youth in Black did the same, everything that Wang Baole had done was shocking.
There had never been such a thing as rowing a boat. Although he wasn’t the first person to eat the spirit spirit fruit, his status as the first person was too high. Everyone couldn’t help but compare and think about it.
In addition, Wang Baole was selling spirit spirit spirit fruits and boat rides... all of this made the cultivators who had spent the red crystals look strange.
“Has this guy gone mad from poverty?”
“I believe that he’s from the Xie family now!”
“I think that he’s most likely Xie Haiyang’s younger brother!”
Wang Baole heard all these discussions. He coughed and didn’t intend to pay them any attention. However, when he heard someone say that he was Xie Haiyang’s younger brother, he was a little displeased. He thought to himself that he was his brother.
However, it wasn’t appropriate for him to forcefully explain this matter. Furthermore, such a guess was beneficial to him. Therefore, after letting out a snort, Wang Baole didn’t pay too much attention to it. Instead, he raised his head and looked out the window at the Black Paper Sea outside.
Following his gaze, he could see a huge ball floating on the black paper sea in the distance. If he looked closely, he could see that the ball was actually a star!
In reality, such a planet could often be seen on the Black Paper Sea during the day’s voyage. It seemed to be in a different direction from the sea where he had first entered. That was why it hadn’t been there before, but now, it could be seen frequently.
They didn’t seem big, but Wang Baole had a feeling that once they stepped into the sea, the heavens and earth would immediately reverse and turn into a world.
“A planet floating on the surface of the sea...”he murmured. The day’s voyage gradually came to an end. As the speed of the ship slowed down, not only Wang Baole, but all the cultivators on the ship saw a planet far away on the surface of the sea, it was a planet that stood out from the rest!
The planet was like a dream. At first glance, some people couldn’t see anything, while others could only see a fog. At second glance, the image changed again. It seemed like the planet was changing all the time, however, no matter how much it changed, after looking at it for a longer period of time, everyone on the ship could see that it was a planet!
“Illusory star? !”When these two words appeared in everyone’s minds.., the illusory star instantly began to expand without limit. At a speed that even the eyes could not follow, it expanded to the extreme. It even gave people the illusion that it was even more majestic than the entire Black Paper Sea, then, it seemed to devour the ship that everyone was on... and directly fused into it!

chapters.title: Chapter 934 - killing a star?
chapters.content:
Chapter 934:, killing a star?
The star that was used as a training ground in the fallen star field was called an illusory star. However, in reality, the mountains, rivers, plants, and vegetation were all there.
The only difference was that the color of the plants was mostly blue, while the river water was as white as milk. As for the sky, there were many colors flowing through it, constantly changing. It looked very beautiful.
The ground was in line with what Wang Baole knew. Reptiles could occasionally be seen on the black surface of the ground, making the entire planet look full of life.
“This is a special planet!”As Wang Baole looked around, a voice came from beside him. The person who spoke was a cultivator who had once bought a spot for a boat. There was an unconcealable excitement on his face, it was as if he wanted to try fusing with the planet.
As for the boat they had used to cross the sea, it had already disappeared. The moment they were fused with the planet, all external objects except themselves had disappeared. When they reappeared, there wasn’t a single one of them missing, they were all together.
Even though they quickly separated and observed each other’s surroundings, there were many who discovered that this planet was a special planet. Even before the person had spoken, there had been people who had tried it out at lightning speed, but it was clearly impossible to succeed.
What a generous offer. It’s only a trial, and you’ve already brought out a special planet... Wang Baole was very clear about the significance and value of a special planet. It was an existence that surpassed the mortal, spirit, and immortal planets, and was only second to the legendary dao planets, it contained the power of laws. Once it was fused into one’s own planet, one would be able to grasp its laws.
Wang Baole had yet to meet a planet-grade cultivator who possessed the power of laws. The ones he had met before were mostly spirit planets that had been upgraded. However, that didn’t affect his ability to judge the strength of those who had been upgraded from special planets.
They have the power of Laws... Wang Baole’s eyes shone with desire. It would have been fine if he hadn’t come to this place. However, since he had come to the fallen star, ordinary spirit planets were no longer enough to satisfy him. Even immortal planets were barely enough, his goal... was a special planet!
Such a special planet was rare in the outside world, but here... it didn’t seem that hard to find!
...
This was the only way to maintain the path of a cultivator at the same level step by step. This was very important to him. After all, this trip to the fallen star didn’t allow Wang Baole to see too much of the world, however, it allowed him to see a large number of elites from various factions.
He didn’t want... After leaving the fallen star, the next time he met these people, those who were inferior to him back then would be able to suppress him in terms of cultivation and combat strength.
As this thought churned in his mind, Wang Baole lowered his head to look at the ground beneath his feet. The talent brought about by the star nascent soul in his body allowed him to feel waves of powerful reinforcement silently spreading out from the star, they continued to surround his body, allowing his battle prowess to increase greatly.
According to the rules set by the Starfall Empire, there are thirty illusory crystals on this illusory planet. Those who hold the illusory crystals seven days later will be promoted to the next round
If hundreds of people try to snatch thirty illusory crystals, ninety percent of them will be eliminated... it seems like it’s inevitable that they will fight for it! Wang Baole’s eyes lit up!
He wasn’t the only one who felt this way. The other cultivators also had strange looks in their eyes. Just as Wang Baole was in high spirits and planning to make a grand entrance here and obtain the right to enter the next round of the trials.., suddenly... no matter what the hundreds of chosen cultivators, including him, were doing, at that moment, their bodies began to glow!
The glow on everyone’s bodies was of the same intensity. The moment it spread out, a large number of illusory figures appeared in the void around them!
There were men and women, Old and young, and all sorts of races. Many of them seemed to have been torn to shreds. There were also some who seemed to have been burned to the ground. There were no bodies, only blurry figures!
As they appeared, waves of pressure gathered together, causing everything to explode out. Although their expressions were blank, and they looked like they were about to die, the fluctuations of their cultivation bases.., were incredibly real!
If you looked around, you would see that there were more than a few thousand of them. However... This wasn’t the end. Soon, more figures appeared.
Exclamations of shock and low roars were heard from the various elites. It was obvious that they had recognized... the people they had killed in the past!
Wang Baole was the same. He saw the Weiyang clan he had killed, the cultivators he had killed, and even the people he had killed in the federation.
This... was the rule of the illusory planet. It didn’t mean that one would be resurrected from the dead. It meant that the projections of all the people they had killed would be condensed and regenerated into combat power!
As more and more illusory figures appeared around him, the strongest among them was only a spirit immortal. However, Wang Baole’s heart trembled. He suddenly recalled... that he had once been on a certain planet, he had exterminated an entire race..
Just as this thought surfaced in his mind, the illusory figures around him immediately increased exponentially... at least tens of thousands of times more. Numerous lizard-like beast figures appeared, forming a dense mass of illusory figures.
In the blink of an eye, it was as if the entire world had been turned upside down and changed. Everyone around was shocked.
“Who has killed so many!”
“What’s wrong? Is this genocide?”
Wang baole blinked guiltily. Then, he realized that it was difficult to identify the source of this illusion. He was pleasantly surprised. He put on an ugly expression and glared at his surroundings, it was as if he wanted to find the culprit.
The culprit couldn’t be found. However, the rules of the illusory planet were clearly not over yet. Soon... seven people in the crowd began to glow brighter. Their brightness.., they were very eye-catching. Other than them, everyone else’s glow was normal. Only they were different from the rest!
Wang Baole was one of them. The other six included the masked woman, the four others, and brother Gao. The last one... was a young girl who appeared to be only thirteen or fourteen years old, the young girl looked weak and harmless. She was not very eye-catching in the crowd. She had joined a team that stood in the forest, and she did not seem to have a high status.
Even Wang Baole hadn’t paid much attention to her before. He was stunned when he saw her.
The radiance on the seven of them, if one were to compare them, could be stronger or weaker. The strongest one... was the black-robed youth who carried a large sword on his back. The radiance on his body was blinding.
As for the weaker one... it was brother Gao Ren. Wang Baole was in the middle level, neither too high nor too low. As the radiance on their bodies spread out, attracting the attention of the crowd.., the countless phantoms that had appeared in the void around them trembled and retreated rapidly.
As they retreated, more than fifty figures materialized amidst the loud boom. Each and every one of them looked ferocious and miserable. They looked pathetic, but in that instant, their bodies..! What erupted was... the pressure of a planet!
At the same time, their expressions were no longer blank. Instead, they were filled with hatred as they looked at the person who had killed them!
“Planet! !”
“The seven of them have killed planets before! !”
“That’s too many! ! !”
While everyone was in an uproar, in a White Paper Hall in the center of the capital city of the Starfall Empire, five paper figures were sitting cross-legged in meditation, staring at a basin of black water placed in front of them.
Within the black water floated a large number of white dots. Each white dot... was a planet. Suddenly, one of the densely packed white dots turned red!
The appearance of the red color immediately caused the five paper figures to stare in shock.
“This is... the illusory planet that is currently screening out those who meet the requirements of the outer reaches?”
“It actually turned red!”
“According to the rules of that low-level illusory planet, only when there are star cultivators among its illusory death figures will it reach its limit. This is impossible, right...”
“These people from the outer realms who are testing are all at the Great Circle of Spirit Immortal Realm. have any of them killed a star before?”
“Absolutely impossible!”

chapters.title: Chapter 935 - was killed?
chapters.content:
Chapter 935: was killed?
9
While the five paper figurines in Starfall City were puzzled, Wang Baole, who was on the illusory planet, was having a headache. He didn’t know what was happening outside. All he could see were the forty-odd planets that had appeared out of thin air, he saw Dan Zhouzi, Shan Lingzi, and even elder Zuo!
“Mountain spirit son was killed by the wishing bottle, and that’s on Me? and left elder... I didn’t kill him. That counts? Thankfully, elder you doesn’t count...”Wang Baole felt a headache coming on, he noticed that the three planets that were on his head were all looking at him with intense killing intent.
If it had been any other time, this would have caused a stir. However, now... Wang Baole’s brilliance was completely overshadowed by the others. That was because there were only three people looking at him, and there were a total of sixteen people looking at the cold, black-robed youth!
As for the Bell Lady and the scholarly man, the number of planets they had triggered was only about ten. They were far inferior to the black-robed youth, and brother Gao only had a few. Only the masked woman.., one person had attracted the angry gazes of ten planets. This scene caused many people’s hearts to tremble. However, the person ranked second... was not her, but... the girl who looked weak and frail!
The fifteen planets were glaring at her angrily, gritting their teeth!
In an instant... the crowd that she was in suddenly dispersed. Li Lin’s expression changed, and he was the fastest. He looked at the girl as if he had seen a ghost.
This made the girl very unhappy. She pouted, and there seemed to be tears in her eyes, as if she was about to cry.
Wang Baole was also shocked by this scene. He swallowed a mouthful of saliva. He felt that he shouldn’t be arrogant. There were clearly many perverts among the elites this time..
I thought that the cold man in Black was the hardest to deal with. I didn’t expect this little girl to hide so deeply. She’s the most insidious one! Wang Baole took a deep breath and raised the girl’s Guard to the maximum, he thought that the illusory rules should be over by now, so he was about to step back.
However, at that moment... a sudden change occurred!
...
In the eyes of the crowd, there was suddenly one person in the crowd. The light on his body shone at that moment... with an unprecedented brightness. It exploded, blinding and resplendent like the sun!
As the light appeared, all of the illusory figures in the area began to tremble. Even the fifty-plus planets began to tremble.
As they trembled, the chosen in the area were shocked. Even the masked woman’s eyes went wide. The black-robed young man’s breathing quickened. Even the scholarly cultivator who was reading a book.., the Sun, whose expression had never changed before... appeared in the world!
“Almighty Star! !”A Cry of shock rang out from the crowd.
The new Phantom was none other than a star cultivator!
As it appeared, the flames it conjured were incredibly vast, and the power of the star was even more violent than it had ever been before. It completely replaced the light from the planets around it, causing the world to tremble!
Just as everyone was in a state of shock, a blurry figure walked out from the scorching sun. It was incorporeal, as if it had been reduced to ashes when it was alive.
Perhaps it was because the grievance it had felt when it was alive was too strong, but even though its body was blurry, it still transmitted the grievance to its surroundings. People could sense it, and at the same time, they could feel its madness.
The moment it appeared, it looked at the crowd. The light from its body was the brightest, and compared to its surroundings, it was like a torchlight in the dark night!
This figure... was Wang Baole!
“Me?”Wang Baole was dumbstruck. He lowered his head to look at the glow on his body, then looked at the crowd that had dispersed in an instant. In the crowd... was the little girl whom he had thought was hiding the deepest part.
When the little girl looked at him, her gaze was similar to that of the forest. It was as if she had seen a ghost. She was afraid that she would be affected if she was too close to him. The masked woman was also clearly shocked by Wang Baole, even the black-robed youth, who was covered in a cold and murderous aura, was not slow in retreating. When he looked at Wang baole, there was even a faint desire to fight in his eyes.
It was the same for the others. In an instant, the area where Wang Baole was was empty. He was the only one standing there, and his body emitted a dazzling light.
He lowered his head and looked at his body, then at the crowd around him. Finally, Wang Baole raised his head in a daze. He looked at the star that was glaring at him with anger and anger. He was dumbfounded, a strong sense of grievance surfaced uncontrollably in his mind.
I must have made a mistake..
Wang Baole wanted to cry, but he had no tears. This incident was too bizarre. No matter how hard he tried to recall, he couldn’t remember that he had once killed a star..
I don’t even know myself... I must have made a mistake. I don’t even know this person... Sweat was already forming on Wang Baole’s forehead. His mind spun rapidly. In such a short period of time.., he recalled all the major events that had happened to him since he was young. However, he still couldn’t remember when he had been so fierce that he had cut down a star.
That was especially the case for the star cultivator. His figure was blurry. Based on Wang Baole’s previous observations of the other phantoms, he could roughly deduce that the person’s entire body had collapsed and dissipated before he died. Even his soul seemed unable to escape, he had been forcefully killed by someone who had exceeded the power of the stars, using divine abilities or Dharmic treasures!
What is going on... Wang Baole watched as the almighty star in the sky grew stronger and stronger. The ground was even trembling. It was as if the illusory star had been shaken by the stars formed by its laws, it was as if it had reached the pinnacle of its laws and was showing signs of instability.
All of this made Wang Baole anxious. It also shocked the five paper figures who were observing the illusory planet in the star Meteor Empire. Other than that, there were the other prodigies on the illusory planet who were far away from Wang Baole.
Li Linzi was dumbfounded. The others were shocked as well. Many of them were cursing in their hearts. After all, the appearance of the star meant that there would be too many changes in the trials this time. Even if they were all prodigies.., their backgrounds were extremely deep. However, in this place... their backgrounds were of no use. Strength was the most important thing.
As for the elites from the star... that was a terrifying threat that was enough to kill all of them. Therefore, all of them were shocked and terrified of Wang Baole. At the same time, they were filled with intense resentment.
They didn’t try to hide their emotions, so Wang Baole could feel them clearly. However, he also felt aggrieved and confused. His mind basically never stopped recalling. After a few breaths, Wang Baole’s eyes suddenly widened, his body trembled violently.
He was certain that he didn’t know this star, and he had never killed it. However, there had been a period of time in his life where he had been unconscious... he had been placed in a coffin by his senior brother, Chen Qingzi, he had been brought across the starry skies by Chen Qingzi.
Could it be... Wang Baole’s heart raced. A guess surfaced in his mind. Back when his senior brother had been carrying the coffin across the starry skies, perhaps an unlucky star had accidentally offended his senior brother.., and then been beheaded?
But being beheaded by senior brother doesn’t count as my fault. Could it be... that senior brother used the coffin I was lying in to smash the other party to death? Wang Baole’s eyes widened, and another thought surfaced in his mind.
Could it be... that while senior brother was carrying the coffin I was lying in, the star was crushed to death by the coffin I was lying in? Wang Baole felt that this was too unbelievable, and he didn’t know if his guess was correct, however, looking at the star Almighty, who was clearly smashed to the point where he didn’t even have a body, and was only able to form a blurry figure, he felt that... his guess might not be small.
Senior brother! Wang Baole cried out in his heart, however, he didn’t have the time to think about how to resolve it. The star Almighty’s Aura had already reached its peak. With a violent roar, all the illusory figures around him, including himself.., they immediately charged madly towards the hundreds of people, including Wang Baole.
There was a debt to a debt. Logically speaking, the illusory figures that had charged towards the group should have targeted the person who had killed them. However..
All of this wasn’t absolute on the illusory planet. The illusory figures might have targeted the person who had killed them, but when they attacked, the scope of their revenge included all the living!
As a result, the entire battlefield was thrown into chaos. Fortunately, there was still a gap between the strength of the illusory figures and the ones they had possessed when they were alive. Perhaps it was because of the influence of the rules of this place that they didn’t possess intelligence. It was as if they only had instincts.., as the rumbling reverberated in the air, Wang Baole retreated rapidly. He was anxious, but as he looked at the illusory figures, a thought suddenly surfaced in his mind.
Are these... considered ghosts? As the thought surfaced in his mind, his heart immediately came to life, and a faint glow appeared in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 936 - Dark Art!
chapters.content:
Chapter 936:, Dark Art!
However, there were too many people in the area, and Wang Baole felt that it was impossible for the Starfall Empire not to monitor the area. Furthermore, the paper figurine that had followed him in was clearly around the area as well. Therefore, logically speaking, it was better not to use the dark art.
In reality, that was indeed the case. The presence of a powerful star on the illusory planet had attracted the attention of the Starfall Empire. In the Starfall City, the five paper figurine had already activated their spells and were able to see everything clearly, naturally, they saw that the source of all the changes was Wang Baole.
If Wang Baole were to activate his dark art at that moment, the consequences would be unpredictable. Fortunately, he was cautious and didn’t show up.
However, the prodigies on the battlefield were complaining bitterly. After all, hundreds of people were facing phantoms that far outnumbered them. They couldn’t even calculate the number of phantoms, even if ninety-nine percent of them were weaklings, however, more than fifty planets was enough to make them anxious, not to mention... There was also a star.
What was in front of them was a situation where they were bound to lose!
The attacks of these phantoms were illogical. Therefore, no matter what choice they made, the first thing they had to do now was to trap the star that posed the greatest threat.
The first to make a move was Wang Baole. The instant the star charged at him, his retreating body armor instantly materialized. With a divine armament in hand, he turned around and slashed viciously at the distant star Phantoms.
He wasn’t the only one. The masked woman, the scholarly cultivator, the bell lady, the black-robed youth, and more than a hundred prodigies all attacked at the same time. It was impossible to kill the star, but it was still possible to trap it for a short while, it was still possible.
The bell lady in particular took out a ring-shaped magical artifact, which turned into a seal that enveloped the area. It gathered everyone’s power and turned into ice, causing the temperature around the star to drop infinitely.
After all, none of them were ordinary spirit immortals. To a certain extent, each and every one of them had more or less the battle prowess of a planet!
...
Therefore, as the booming sounds rang out and hundreds of people attacked at the same time, the charging star phantom trembled and was forcefully blocked. It had no choice but to stop. Then, it was instantly frozen in place by the cold air around it, it turned into an ice sculpture that was emitting seven-colored rays of light.
Although it was a star, there was still a gap between an illusion and a real existence. However, even so, this obstruction clearly could not last for long. Cracks were rapidly appearing on the ice seal. It seemed that it would collapse in the time it takes for half an incense stick to burn!
At this moment, with the help of the time it had been frozen, everyone did not hesitate at all. They began to retreat at full speed, trying to increase the distance between them and charge out of the area where there were many illusions.
After all, it was already impossible for them to last for seven days, not to mention that they had to find the illusion crystal within seven days. If that was the case, how were they supposed to fight? With such difficulty, even the masked woman and the other three had extremely gloomy expressions in their eyes, they could only charge forward on their own. They wouldn’t limit the battlefield to this area, but to the entire planet.
If that was the case, they might still have a chance of obtaining the final victory.
However, just as everyone’s thoughts were running wild, and they were about to spread out and widen the distance between them and their surroundings, a shrill scream suddenly rang out from afar.
The Scream was extremely shrill. Even though there was a lot of noise on the battlefield, it was still extremely clear. Everyone immediately looked over. As their gazes landed on that spot, their expressions changed.
Wang Baole retreated rapidly as well. He swept the divine armament in his hand and killed the Phantoms that were charging at him. When he turned his head to look, his pupils constricted.
In his eyes, he saw a rather familiar-looking prodigy being pounced on by dozens of Phantoms. The Phantoms had greedy looks on their faces as they frantically devoured his flesh and blood!
The screams didn’t just come from the pain of having his flesh and blood devoured. They also came from the torture of having his soul torn apart. What shocked Wang Baole the most was a planet that had been killed by the little girl, at that moment, the planet pounced forward at an extremely fast speed. It passed through the body of the Prodigy, bringing his soul... Out!
As it was brought out, the planet’s Phantom’s eyes were filled with greed. It placed his soul... into its mouth and tore at it crazily. The Prodigy’s screams came to an abrupt halt as his soul was devoured, his flesh and blood were ripped to shreds as a group of Phantoms frantically tried to snatch it away from him.
The scene was incredibly tragic, and it was a sign of what would happen to everyone once they were trapped!
However, even as everyone’s faces fell, and the man died, a small portion of the Phantoms in the area suddenly vanished, as if a gust of wind were blowing through them!
If one were to look closely, it seemed like the phantoms that had disappeared had been killed by the deceased prodigy. It was all because of him. This scene immediately caused everyone who had regained their senses to have a strange look in their eyes!
“So, this is how the rules work!”
“There is a hidden rule hidden in this illusory star trial!”
“Killing a living person can make the phantoms that have arisen here disappear, thus reducing the difficulty!”
Wang Baole also reacted immediately. However, in the next moment, his expression changed slightly, and his body retreated without leaving a trace. However, the moment he moved, almost all the elites around him realized the hidden rules, they all looked at him!
Their eyes were cold and filled with killing intent!
Fortunately... Wang Baole was not the only one who was being watched. Six others were also being watched by the crowd. These six were the ones who had killed planets.
However, the scholarly cultivator and the bell lady Gao Ren, who were watching them, hesitated for a moment before dispersing their gazes. It was the same with the masked woman. They didn’t gather too many people, but the black-robed youth and the little girl.., they became the most important targets, second only to Wang Baole!
They didn’t have a background that was worthy of respect. Even if they had powerful combat abilities, they were still the most important targets when it came to benefits!
This was especially so... when there were so many of them, it would affect everyone’s future!
“If we kill them, we’ll be able to reduce one star, thirty planets, and a large number of shadows
“Just killing three people will reduce the difficulty of this trial by at least eighty percent!”
Immediately, someone spoke up. As they were getting restless, some people even changed their direction and tried to surround the three of them. Seeing this, a cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes, and he retreated without hesitation, as he retreated, the young man with the large sword on his back did the same.
A murderous aura spread out from his body, and he sped off into the distance. As for the young girl, who looked weak and harmless, a cold glint flashed in her eyes when she realized that she had been targeted, her reaction was different from Wang Baole’s and the black-robed young man’s..
She had retreated as well, but she was headed in the direction of the mighty figure who had been trapped by the combined efforts of everyone. As she neared, she slapped the seven-colored block of ice hard. Immediately, the seven-colored block of ice surrounding the mighty figure exploded, the power of the star exploded from within, wreaking havoc in the surroundings. No one knew how the little girl had done it, but a glint flashed in her eyes. The mighty figure had actually ignored her.., he flashed past her and unleashed his cultivation on everyone around him.
No one else could see what was going on, but Wang Baole’s pupils constricted.
Dark Art? Wang Baole’s breathing quickened. The dark art ripples on the little girl’s body had been extremely weak, but as a dark child, he had still been able to detect it instantly.
This made him suspicious. However, he didn’t have the time to think too much. Wang Baole’s body sped forward, and he was about to leave the battlefield. However, at that moment... the bell-shaped lady looked at Wang Baole from afar, a smile appeared on her lips. Her body swayed as she chased after him!
At the same time, the scholarly man made his move as well. His target... was the black-robed youth. The masked woman did the same. She chased after the little girl.
It wasn’t just the three of them. The people around them also spread out and cooperated with the three of them. They surrounded Wang Baole and the other two, who were trying to escape from different directions!
However, with the escape of the star and the attacks of more than fifty planets, the battlefield became extremely chaotic. The intention of surrounding them might be good, but it was still extremely difficult to achieve, furthermore, everyone’s thoughts were clearly not in sync!
Therefore, with Wang Baole’s full speed, he managed to charge out of the battlefield and shake off all those who tried to stop him. However... behind him, the bell lady was as fast as lightning, she chased after him and left the battlefield together.

chapters.title: Chapter 937 - , chasing me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 937:, chasing me?
That Yin little girl, why is there a dark art fluctuation on her body... Wang Baole’s body swayed as he flew away from the battlefield. The image of the little girl appeared in his mind, and doubts rose in his heart, however, this thought only flashed through his mind at that moment, and he immediately suppressed it.
It was obvious that he didn’t have the time to think about it. Behind him, the gigantic bell lady from the nine Phoenix sect, The Prodigy of the nine Phoenix sect, was moving with seven colors all over her body. She was so fast that she was drawing a rainbow in the sky, she chased after him.
As she chased after him, she shook her wrist, and the crisp sound of a bell rang out continuously. It reverberated in the surroundings, forming circles of ripples. From Afar, it looked as if she was walking on ripples, she was elegant and graceful, but her speed was also astonishing.
The fluttering of her seven-colored dress and the beauty of her appearance gave people the illusion that she was a fairy from a painting who had stepped into the mortal world.
Is she interested in me? Wang Baole felt a headache coming on. He watched as the bell lady chased after him and left the battlefield together with him. As the sound of the bell grew louder and faster, Wang Baole felt helpless, he raised his right hand and took out a jade slip from his storage bag. He threw it at the bell lady behind him and roared.
“Stop chasing. This is my keepsake. After this trial is over, I’ll give you a chance to propose marriage!”
The Bell Lady, who was sprinting behind him, smiled when she heard that.
“I propose marriage to you?”Although her words were soft and pleasant to the ear, a glint flashed across her eyes. She had chased after him because she was indeed interested in Wang Baole. However, that interest was not between a man and a woman, instead, she wanted to use this opportunity to subdue him and see if she could take him in as a dao servant. As for the fact that he had once killed a star, that was too absurd. She believed that it must have been caused by a special occasion and could not be used to judge his combat strength.
After all, according to her understanding, the other party had been given a spot and had provoked the purple gold civilization. His background was lacking, but once he became her dao servant, even though he would lose his freedom, there would be many benefits.
However, she had changed her mind. She planned to capture him alive and let him experience the feeling of impending death as a punishment. Then, she would consider whether the other party was qualified to become her dao servant.
...
With that thought in mind, a cold glint flashed in the Bell Lady’s eyes. She raised her right hand and waved it gently. Immediately, the sound waves around her distorted and spread out. They charged toward the jade slip that Wang Baole had thrown at her. The moment they made contact.., the jade slip collapsed.
The moment it collapsed, a large amount of black fog spread out from the shattered jade slip. It formed a fist and punched toward the bell lady!
The jade slip looked ordinary, but it actually contained some of Wang Baole’s essence. That was why he had spoken rudely earlier, so that the other party could shatter the jade slip and create an opportunity to stop her.
Of course... if the other party ignored the jade slip, that would be even better for Wang Baole.
However, it was very difficult for Wang Baole to succeed with his second thought. As a prodigy of the nine Phoenix sect, the bell lady was not ordinary, and she was highly intelligent. She could tell at a glance that there was something strange about the jade slip. Now that the jade slip had collapsed.., the Black Qi within the jade slip transformed into a fist that smashed towards the bell maiden. However, it penetrated her body.
It didn’t cause any harm to her. It was as if her figure was an illusion. That was indeed the case. In the next instant, the bell maiden suddenly walked out from the right side of Wang Baole.
“Is that all you’ve Got?”As she spoke, the Bell Maiden raised her right hand again and shook it gently. Immediately, the sound waves around her erupted. They were like invisible threads that wrapped around Wang Baole.
Their sharpness was astonishing. As they streaked through the air, they even set off a sonic boom. On one hand, they were fast, and on the other hand, the air seemed to have been sliced apart.
If it had been any other ordinary spirit immortal, they would have died in the face of this attack. Even a planet would have to use its own planet’s power to resist it. The bell lady’s cultivation was extraordinary, and the bell on her wrist.., it was a supreme treasure.
It’s not simple! Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. The other party had realized that his setup was nothing, but the counterattack had been so swift and violent. The sound wave threads gave him a sense of danger. At the same time, the fluctuations in the other party’s cultivation.., it made Wang Baole realize how difficult it was to deal with. He knew that this was a formidable opponent. It would be impossible to defeat him in a short period of time.
The only way to resolve it was to fight to the death. However, it wouldn’t be worth it.
I’ll bet that she won’t want to fight to the death? The thought flashed through Wang Baole’s mind, but he immediately gave up. He had thought of a better way. As his eyes flashed, he saw the sound waves approaching him, they sealed off all directions. However, the moment they approached, Wang Baole’s body exploded with a loud bang, turning into a large amount of black gas.
The threads could seal off all directions, but they couldn’t seal off all the gaps. They used their bodies to turn into fog, and the moment the threads neared, Wang Baole turned into fog and pierced through the gaps. He wasn’t fleeing, he was heading straight for the bell lady, whose pupils constricted slightly.
As he did so, Wang Baole’s figure reappeared. The emperor’s armor on his body materialized, and the nightmare eyes appeared behind him. He raised his right hand and punched out with the star shattering explosion!
The star shattering explosion wasn’t good at augmenting one’s cultivation and techniques. However, as a means of unleashing one’s cultivation, its power was considerable, after all, its advantage was that it could unleash the maximum amount of cultivation power at one go.
Coupled with Wang Baole’s talent as a star nascent soul realm cultivator, he was already enhanced when he stood on the illusory planet. This made the star shattering explosion seem as if it could really destroy the stars. As it blasted out, it created a vortex that looked like a black hole, it tore through the void and swept through everything, heading straight for the bell lady like a black ball.
“Such a crude divine ability. Although its power is passable, it doesn’t have any dao techniques to speak of!”The bell lady narrowed her eyes. As she spoke, she formed a seal with her right hand and pointed forward. Instantly, the sky above where she stood suddenly rumbled, the sky seemed to have turned into chaos. The faint sound of a phoenix could be heard. It was as if a gigantic Phoenix was hiding in the void.
In the next instant, an illusory Phoenix claw materialized at an incredible speed and descended. It grew larger and larger. In the blink of an eye, it had grown to several thousand feet in size. It descended, it reached for Wang Baole and collided with Wang Baole’s star fragment explosion.
A loud boom reverberated in the air. The black hole formed by the star fragment explosion collapsed, and the Phoenix Claw shattered into pieces. However, in the next instant, as the Phoenix cried out, a second Phoenix claw descended from the sky.
Seeing that, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He had no desire to continue fighting. He retreated instantly. At the same time, he took out another jade slip and threw it directly at the bell lady.
“Is one not sincere enough? I Can’t help it. Who asked me to be so outstanding? If you don’t believe me, then I’ll give you another one. Remember, take this jade slip and propose marriage!”Wang Baole coughed and threw out a thick jade slip, he retreated even faster.
“You only know how to Glib!”Disappointment appeared in the Bell Maiden’s eyes, but her vigilance grew stronger. Wang Baole’s divine ability earlier might have seemed crude, but its power was something she took seriously. She ignored the jade slip at that moment, with a flash, she stood on the Phoenix Claw that had descended and chased after Wang Baole once more.
Just like that, the two of them chased after each other, one in front and one behind. The bell lady had many divine abilities, and two heavenly phoenixes had appeared in her illusion. That wasn’t too bad. After Wang Baole’s emperor armor was formed.., he could rely on his speed to slowly increase the distance between them, or he could avoid the other party’s divine abilities.
However... The thing that gave him the biggest headache was the bell on the bell lady’s wrist. As it shook, the sound waves formed from the sound waves, causing interference and weakening, causing Wang Baole’s speed to gradually slow down, it was as if he was deep in a quagmire, surrounded by sound waves.
After the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, Wang Baole was about to be caught up again. He appeared a little anxious on the surface, but he laughed coldly in his heart. He thought that it was about time, so he turned his head abruptly and raised his right hand, forming a large loudspeaker that was filled with cracks, it appeared in his hand.
“I also have a sound wave dharmic treasure!”Wang Baole placed the loudspeaker that he had repaired in front of him and used all his strength to let out a loud roar.

chapters.title: Chapter 938 - Speak Your Mind!
chapters.content:
Chapter 938: Speak Your Mind!
The roar was already as shocking as thunder. After being amplified by the loudspeaker, the sound waves that were transmitted immediately became extremely violent. The loudspeaker could no longer withstand the sound waves, and as the sound waves were transmitted, it collapsed inch by inch.
Even though it was in pieces, the sound waves still spread out. Like a violent storm, they swept towards the bell lady. In an instant, they collided with the sound waves of the bell, and as easily as breaking dried twigs, they smashed towards the Phoenix Claw that was blocking their way, following that, the force that swept in all directions charged towards the bell lady.
The bell lady’s expression changed. Although she had used this sound wave technique frequently, she was still shocked when faced with something like this. It was because the sound waves unleashed by Wang Baole’s megaphone were too violent, it even caused the surrounding world to distort. However, that was not the end. Within the storm-like sound waves, there was a finger that was formed from fog!
It was the cloud finger from Ethereal Dao College, Wang Baole’s most powerful divine ability and dao art that he had discovered after organizing his divine abilities!
To be precise, this finger was the key reason why the Bell Lady’s expression changed. In an instant, she sensed the difference between this attack and the crude divine ability that the other party had used earlier.
“This finger contains dao intent!”The bell lady’s breathing quickened. At the critical moment, she raised both her hands and shook them violently. Immediately, Phoenix cries rang out from the void around her. A total of eight phoenixes appeared in an instant, finally, a phoenix mark appeared on her forehead, forming nine phoenixes!
This was the signature divine ability of the nine Phoenix sect, the nine Phoenix Cry!
Almost at the instant the phoenix mark appeared on her forehead, the bell lady opened her mouth and let out a light cry that spread out in all directions. Together with the eight phoenixes beside her, the sound formed did not seem high, however, it was clear and clear as if it could purify everything. It spread directly toward the incoming cloud finger and the violent sound wave!
If the sound explosion of the megaphone was compared to a raging fire, then the simultaneous cry of the nine phoenixes at this moment was like a gentle spring. They touched each other like water and fire fusing together. The ripples that formed directly took this place as the center and spread out wildly in all directions.
The earth trembled, the mountains crumbled, and all the plants and vegetation were reduced to ashes. In fact, they even formed an endless amount of dust that obscured one’s vision. From a distance, this place was a blur!
...
It was not until more than ten breaths later that the blur dissipated, revealing the figure of the bell lady inside. Her clothes were the same as before, spotlessly clean. The bell on her wrist was not damaged at all, and the eight illusory phoenixes beside her.., she was still extraordinary. Only the mark on her forehead was flickering slightly, as if it was calming the fluctuations of her cultivation.
Her expression... she was no longer smiling without saying anything. Instead, there was a hint of gloom.
That was because... she had already lost sight of Wang Baole in the surroundings.
That jade slip... the bell maiden turned around and looked in the direction she had been chasing. A strong desire to fight slowly appeared in her eyes. She had already realized that the jade slip that Xie Dalu had thrown out earlier contained some tricks.., or perhaps... the Xie Dalu that she had chased after wasn’t his original body at all!
I actually chased after an avatar for such a long time. It wasn’t until the other party disappeared that I realized that I wasn’t chasing after his original body... The bell lady’s expression turned even uglier when she thought of this.
Xie Dalu
Just as the Bell Lady was unwilling to admit defeat and spoke, Wang Baole, who was sprinting far away, sneezed.
Someone is talking bad about me? It must be the bell lady. She doesn’t know my real name, so she must be calling me Xie Dalu... Wang Baole raised his head, there was a smug look on his face, but that smug look quickly disappeared, and his eyes slowly narrowed.
In reality, the first jade slip contained some of his own essence, making it easier for him to escape. The second jade slip contained more than half of his own essence. If the other party continued to shatter it, he would take the opportunity to strike, if he ignored it, he could use it to escape.
Although such a method of escape would result in the loss of some essence, after weighing the pros and cons, Wang Baole still felt that it was better than a silly life-and-death battle with the other party. In the end, regardless of whether he won or lost, he would lose the ability to fight again in a short period of time.
Most importantly, he realized that after eating the spirit spirit fruit, the recovery speed of his essence seemed to be much faster than before. According to his estimation, the loss would be completely replenished in three to five days at most, he would be able to make up for it completely.
It’s such a pity for my megaphone. Wang Baole shook his head. He decided to find time to refine another one. If he used this dharmic treasure properly, not only would it be extremely powerful, the most important thing would be its explosive aura, it would always be able to catch him off guard.
Also, during the battle just now, the bell lady seemed to have an aura that made me very uncomfortable... Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. As he was deep in thought, he spread out his spiritual perception and began searching for the illusory crystal, he knew that seven days was very short, and no one knew the clues and location of the illusion crystal. He could only try his luck and search for it, or... wait for others to find it and snatch it.
Perhaps there are other ways to successfully find the illusion crystal... However, this method is most likely in the hands of the families of the prodigies. They know about it, but I don’t know about it. Wang baole frowned, he didn’t slow down in his thoughts. While he was searching for the illusion Crystal, the Bell Maiden had no choice but to give up on her pursuit and continue searching for the illusion crystal on the illusion star.
At the same time, the young man in black with the large sword on his back and the little girl who had used the dark art were doing the same. They used their own methods to escape from the pursuit of the masked woman and the refined cultivator and began searching for the illusion crystal.
The two of them had different methods, and the little girl had a strange preference. Even though the masked woman’s cultivation base and battle prowess were extraordinary, she had unknowingly lost track of her opponent halfway through their pursuit.
On the other hand, the scholarly cultivator’s pursuit of the black-robed young man had gone quite smoothly. However, due to their different personalities, each of them had different ways of doing things. In the face of the scholarly cultivator’s pursuit, the black-robed young man chose to draw his sword and fight.
The battle between the two of them could be said to be earth-shattering. In the end, the scholarly cultivator from the first sect of the left path could only smile bitterly and stop. If this continued, even if he won, he would still be severely injured.
There was no need to weigh the pros and cons of this matter. Basically, any rational person would know what to do. As such... The top chosen among them began to search for illusory crystals. As for the others, although some of them were trapped.., however, there were still many who spread out, searching while avoiding the pursuit of the illusory crystal.
Just like that, a day passed quickly. Up until now, no one had found the illusory crystal. Wang Baole was feeling anxious as well. He had been flying for a long time, and his divine perception had spread out with all its might, searching continuously, he had even met some other cultivators, but he hadn’t sensed the existence of the illusory crystal anywhere.
This feeling... could it be that the reason why the Starfall Empire said that it would take seven days was because they wanted to give some hints at the final moment, so that people could start a life-and-death struggle in the midst of the search and the final rush of time? Wang Baole looked at the sky, he frowned. It seemed like he was muttering to himself, but his eyes were actually glowing.
He waited for a long while, but there was no reaction from his surroundings. Wang Baole pretended that he hadn’t noticed anything and continued muttering.
If that’s the case, then the purpose of the Starfall Empire isn’t that simple..
Sigh, it’s really hard to find. Where are these illusion crystals? Do I really have to wait until the end... Wang Baole paused at this point. He scanned his surroundings quickly once more, then blinked and muttered to himself again.
“I’m afraid I won’t be able to get it in the end.”
“What should I do? If there’s someone who can help me, even if I have to pay some conditions, I can accept it.”Wang Baole let out a long sigh and was about to continue speaking, but at that moment, suddenly, beside his ear, a familiar, faint sound.
“You want to ask me, you just say it, don’t beat about the Bush!”As the words came out, in front of him in the void, as the distortion, a paper figure from the inner moment revealed, step by step out.
As it appeared, the cold aura immediately spread, causing Wang Baole to feel as if he was in the middle of winter. After a shudder, he quickly cupped his fists and bowed deeply to the paper figurine in front of him.
“Greetings, Senior!”
This paper figurine was the one in his storage bracelet. Although he had not returned after walking out, the reminder on the way made Wang Baole guess that the other party... might be beside him!
Wang Baole had a hunch that the other party didn’t want him to fail so easily. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have needed to be reminded the last time. Therefore, if he were to make such a judgment, there was a high possibility that the other party would help him!
Therefore, after searching for a day and finding no results, he began to turn his attention to the other party. That was why he had been talking to himself just now..

chapters.title: Chapter 939 - was duty-bound!
chapters.content:
Chapter 939: was duty-bound!
From the looks of it, the other party had indeed been by his side as he had guessed. This made Wang Baole excited, and at the same time, the wariness in his heart increased.
After all, there was still a gap between guessing and the truth, especially when it came to the strange paper figurine. Thinking about how the other party had been observing him along the way, but he had not been able to see it, Wang Baole became even more cautious. However, he had experienced it for a long time, he was already able to hide his thoughts from the details on his face. Therefore, all that appeared on his face was excitement. He cupped his fists and bowed deeply to the paper figurine in front of him once again.
The paper figurine swept a glance at Wang Baole, and a dark glint appeared in its eyes. Even with Wang Baole’s meticulous observation, he couldn’t tell what it was thinking. However, he was confident that since the other party had followed him and appeared under his call.., it was obviously going to give him an answer.
No matter what it was up to, it had to say something. Otherwise, the paper figurine would not have had the time to entertain itself.
Wang Baole’s guess was right. After a glint flashed in the paper figurine’s eyes, it remained silent for about ten breaths before it slowly spoke.
“It seems like you are indeed smarter than that mountain spirit child... I can help you, but you need to exchange!”Its voice was sharp, as if it was being rubbed against each other, his cultivation fluctuated slightly when it reverberated in Wang Baole’s ears, but he quickly suppressed it and spoke with focus.
“Senior, please speak!”
The paper figurine didn’t speak immediately. Instead, it scanned Wang Baole carefully, as if in deep thought. After a moment, it nodded slightly and spoke again. However, it didn’t mention his exchange, instead, it talked about the trial.
“What you are facing now is only the beginning of the trial in the fallen star lands. The focus of this trial is to enter the next trial after obtaining the illusory crystal
“If I didn’t guess, you would be competing with others for ten... star-guiding drumsticks there!”
...
“Star-guiding drumsticks?”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and asked.
“The opportunity in the meteorite land is to allow cultivators from the outer realms to obtain high-level planets. There are also special planets in the meteorite land, allowing them to advance to a higher realm. The method... is to drum and attract planets
“Using the star-guiding drumsticks to drum on the meteorite heaven-reaching drum until its potential is exhausted and the drumsticks collapse, it will be able to transform the planets in the myriad realms and draw out the planets that are most suitable for them
“However, the number of drumsticks is limited. Every few hundred years, the land of the fallen star will form ten star guiding drumsticks. Every time the drumsticks are formed, the land of the fallen star will open on its own accord, allowing those from the outer realms who are qualified to enter. Ten of them will be chosen to obtain the good fortune of this land
“Thus... There was a series of trials. The first stage, the crossing of the sea, was for elimination, and the second stage, the illusory star, was the same. In the end, only thirty people were allowed to enter the final Third Stage!”The paper figurine said slowly, the words it said made Wang Baole’s breathing quicken slightly. He instantly gained a detailed understanding of his trip to the meteorite empire. However, a question arose in his mind.
“Senior, why is the meteorite empire... doing this? This is basically giving people a chance. Is this an agreement with the outer realm? “Or... does the meteorite empire itself have a reason and need to do this?”Seeing that the paper figurine was willing to talk about these things.., wang Baole didn’t hide his doubts and asked.
It would be best if he could answer. If he didn’t, he wouldn’t lose anything.
A dark glint flashed in the paper figurine’s eyes. It turned its head and stared at Wang Baole. Wang Baole looked back at the paper figurine as well. They stared at each other for a long while before the paper figurine suddenly let out a strange laugh.
“After you arrived at the meteorite land, did you feel that something was wrong?”The paper figurine said slowly and meaningfully after laughing.
“Something was wrong?”Wang Baole was deep in thought. He recalled what he had seen on the way in. After about ten breaths, his eyes narrowed. He remembered that the world clearly belonged to the opposite of black and white, then, he spoke softly.
“Black Sea, White Paper?”
“That’s right!”The paper figurine said flatly.
“The so-called good fortune is indeed the case for all of you. For the Fallen Star Empire, it is a matter of self-preservation!”
“The Starfall Empire is the guardian of the Starfall land. Their enemy... is the Black Paper Sea!
“In the beginning, the Black Paper Sea was not black, but as time passed and something happened, the sea gradually turned black. The trend of its expansion would eventually cover the entire Starfall Empire
“The Starfall Empire tried many times and failed one after another. Then, a Supreme Emperor thought of a way to make the laws of this place visible at the cost of his own body. He would turn his body into a heavenly drum and then split his own soul. Even if he tried his best, he could only make ten strands of his own soul descend every few hundred years and turn them into a star-attracting drumstick
“Using a drumstick to strike the heavenly drum can trigger the transformation of the stars in the myriad realms, forming a suppressive force that can slow down the spread of the Black Paper Sea
“However, due to the rules, the cultivators of the Falling Star Empire have no flesh and blood, so they are unable to strike the heavenly drum. This is why they have come into contact with the outside world, and the subsequent ones have been activated one after another!”The paper man’s voice was calm, and there were no ripples, it was only when it spoke of the former emperor of the Starfall Empire and the ten wisps of souls that it revealed a look of reminiscence in its eyes.
However, the reminiscence disappeared in an instant. If Wang Baole hadn’t been so observant and so close, he probably wouldn’t have noticed it.
Could This paper figurine be related to the Emperor of the Starfall Empire? Wang Baole suppressed his thoughts. After sorting out the information contained in the paper figurine’s words, his instincts told him that it was logical. Therefore, he believed about seventy to eighty percent of it, at the same time, his understanding of the land of the fallen stars increased.
“I wonder what senior needs me to do?”After a moment of silence, Wang Baole asked the question.
However, after he said that, the paper figurine’s expression clearly showed some hesitation. It seemed that even it had doubts about what it wanted Wang Baole to do.
That made Wang Baole suspicious as well. However, he didn’t continue speaking. Instead, he waited for the paper figurine to think.
After a long while, the paper figurine’s gaze landed on Wang Baole again. It stared at him for a long while, as if it wanted to see through him completely. Finally, it spoke hoarsely.
“You... are very strange!”
“Huh?”Wang baole blinked.
“You’re clearly a cultivator from the weiyang dao domain. Your Soul Age hasn’t even reached sixty years, yet you still have the feeling of time... if that’s all there is to it, then so be it. You still have the aura of the Weiyang Dao Domain on you. Normally speaking, this is due to frequent exposure to items from the Weiyang Dao Domain. However, you’re different!”
“I have observed you for a long time, and I have come to the conclusion that the aura of the non-weiyang DAO domain on you does not come from an item. Instead, it comes from one of your dao techniques and divine abilities... this dao technique has a huge origin, and I can not hear what you are saying clearly. However, every time you use it, the will to awaken and descend from the depths of the starry sky... it is the strongest I have ever seen in my entire life!”
As the paper figurine spoke up to this point, Wang Baole’s expression seemed normal, but his heart was already in turmoil. He knew very well that the other party was talking about his own dao scripture!
The divine ability that little Missy had imparted to him in the mask had helped him resolve many crises over the years. However, as more and more of the consciousness that had descended awakened and contained some emotions, it made Wang Baole’s heart skip a beat, however, while he used it frequently, he had never tried his best to recite it to the end.
He would usually stop immediately after reading the first few words.
“Therefore, I need you to follow me to a place. There... use your full strength to display your supernatural power and Dao Techniques!”The paper figurine took a deep breath and continued speaking.
“In return, I will help you obtain a drumstick. I will even lend a hand when you play the drum, allowing you to at least... obtain a special planet that contains laws as your planet in this fortuitous encounter!”
“Do... Do you agree?”The paper figurine asked with a deep gaze. It stared at Wang Baole, waiting for his reply.
Wang Baole smiled bitterly when he heard that. His mind spun rapidly. The other party’s conditions weren’t high, but... He didn’t dare.
If I go all out, if I really disturb that will, will it be like swatting a mosquito to death and kill me with a slap? Wang Baole thought of this and took a deep breath. He was just about to open his mouth to see if he could change his conditions.., the paper figurine spoke faintly before him.
“If you refuse, I will destroy you right now!”
Wang Baole’s expression turned solemn. There was a hint of dissatisfaction in his eyes, as if he felt that his personality had been severely insulted.
“Senior has underestimated me, Xie Dalu. I am not afraid of being threatened. If I don’t want to, I will definitely not agree even if I have to die. However, senior has helped me greatly along the way. Regardless of whether it is in my heart or in my actions, I am extremely grateful to you. This matter... is naturally something that I can not refuse!”

chapters.title: Chapter 940 - -- Thank You, senior!
chapters.content:
Chapter 940: — Thank You, senior!
Wang Baole’s words were firm and resolute, and there was a sense of fearlessness in them. It was as if he could give up his life, but even if he died in this life, he had to die standing, not kneeling. That was why he could help the other party, however, that was not because he was a threat, but because that was what he wanted to do.
He was a person who knew how to repay favors, and he was a person who was indomitable. His heart was filled with sincerity.
Even as he spoke, Wang Baole himself felt that he had always been like this. His gaze deepened, and he stood there like a pine tree. He stared at the paper figurine in front of him and spoke calmly.
“Senior, please do not threaten me. If not, wouldn’t junior’s repayment become a form of cowardice and submission?”
“Therefore, senior, please take back your words!”Wang Baole’s face was filled with displeasure. As he spoke, he flicked his sleeves, and anger appeared on his face naturally.
This stunned the paper figurine.
Even though it had observed Wang Baole for a long time and had some understanding of his personality, there was still a moment when it was shocked by Wang Baole’s words. It even showed respect on its face instinctively, however, it quickly felt that Wang Baole’s behavior did not match its understanding.
However, he had not been by Wang Baole’s side for long, so he could not make a judgment. After a moment of silence, it put down its thoughts and nodded at Wang Baole.
“It’s my fault for speaking wrongly. I will have an explanation for this matter in the future. In short... Thank you for your help, fellow Daoist!”
Wang Baole’s expression softened when he heard that. He looked at the paper figurine, shook his head, and sighed.
...
“Forget it. Senior is also concerned about the lives of the people. I can guess that what senior wants me to do is most likely related to the safety of the Starfall Empire. If senior thinks it’s appropriate, you can tell me what you need me to do. Although my cultivation is low, I still have some hot blood to spill!
“However, now is not the time to talk about this. Junior also has something that senior needs to help me with... where are the illusion crystals here?”Wang Baole said solemnly.
Deep down, he was very satisfied with his previous performance. After all, the high officials’autobiographies had said that mutual respect was the prerequisite for both parties to be satisfied with their cooperation!
For example, Wang Baole felt that if he gave the impression that he was cooperating because he was threatened, then he would definitely be in a passive position in the cooperation. It would be difficult for him to obtain additional benefits, but it was different now.
That was indeed the case. If Wang Baole did not agree to help, it would have been fine. The paper figurine could have used some forceful methods to force him. However, Wang Baole appeared to be extremely sincere, as if he was sincerely helping from the bottom of his heart, that made it impossible for the paper figurine to force him. After all, the other party was willing to help him from the bottom of his heart. That was already perfect for its purpose.
There was no reason for it to force him again.
However, their cooperation had turned into helping each other, and the atmosphere had changed unknowingly. This made the paper figurine feel a little lost in the depths of his heart.
“How did it become like this with just a few words?”The paper man frowned slightly. Previously, he had felt that the other party had many secrets, but to be honest, he had only cared about his background and background, he hadn’t paid too much attention to the other party.
But now... things were different. The paper man, who had come to his senses, realized that not only did this foreign cultivator have a mysterious background, his background was extraordinary, and his intelligence was excellent. Such a person, even if his cultivation base wasn’t very high.., however, if he was given time to grow, there would be a place for him in the starry skies in the future.
With such thoughts in mind, the paper man looked deeply at Wang Baole. After a moment of thought, he decided to change his previous thoughts. He had originally intended to reveal some clues so that the other party could eventually find the illusion crystal, that was easy for him. It wasn’t a problem at all.
However, now, he felt that he could be more direct. After all... He didn’t want to let Wang Baole’s sincerity cool down. Therefore, after looking at Wang Baole, the paper figurine spoke slowly.
“Little friend, I have some reasons that I can’t tell you. It’s not convenient for me to show my face for too long, so I won’t appear most of the time. However, I can use my senses to help you find the location of an illusion crystal. You have to retrieve it yourself.”
Wang Baole’s eyes lit up when he heard that. He nodded immediately.
The paper figurine had reached a consensus with Wang Baole. It closed its eyes. There were obvious ripples and distortions around its body. It seemed to be using a method that Wang Baole didn’t understand to sense the entire illusion star. It didn’t take long. It took about ten breaths of time, the paper figurine opened its eyes. It raised its right hand and formed a light spot, sending it to Wang Baole.
“Feel this object. There’s the location of an illusionary crystal inside!”
“Thank you, Senior!”Wang Baole was excited. After weighing the pros and cons, he felt that it was unlikely that the other party was trying to harm him. Therefore, he decisively took the speck of light in front of him and scanned it with his divine perception. Immediately, a loud bang rang out in his mind, a guiding force was formed.
He could clearly feel that there seemed to be a vibration resonating with him at a location not too far away. Therefore, after cupping his fists at the paper figurine, Wang Baole did not waste any time. He moved his body and headed in the direction that the resonance had pointed out, he charged at full speed.
He was so fast that after two hours, Wang Baole had arrived at the location of the resonance. It appeared to be a basin. It was completely empty, with only a few dozen phantoms that had scattered and drifted over.
Wang Baole was unfamiliar with these phantoms. He knew that he hadn’t killed them. They must have been death projections from other prodigies. He scanned the area with his supernatural awareness and confirmed that there were no other living people around. He didn’t hesitate any further, he dashed towards the basin.
His movement immediately attracted the attention of the phantoms. They raised their heads abruptly, and the moment they looked at Wang Baole, they roared and charged towards him frantically.
However, most of these phantoms were at the nascent soul realm, and the strongest one was only at the supernatural realm. To Wang Baole, their attack power was inferior to that of a mosquito. He didn’t even need to look at them. They swept through the area with a whistle, the windstorm that was stirred up was enough to tear them apart completely. There wasn’t even the slightest obstruction. Wang Baole entered the depths of the basin in the blink of an eye.
A moment later, when his figure rushed out, his expression was one of excitement. He held a white crystal the size of a fist in his hand.
The crystal was crystal clear and seemed to possess some kind of special power. If one looked at it for a long time, one would start to hallucinate.
It was... The Illusion Crystal!
“Little friend, with this in your hand, find a place to hide. When the trial ends, you can use this crystal to enter the next trial and fight for the star guiding drumstick!”The paper figurine’s figure appeared beside Wang Baole and spoke slowly, it materialized beside Wang Baole and spoke slowly.
“Thank you for your help, Senior!”Wang Baole immediately cupped his fists when he heard that. The trial was originally very difficult, but now, he had experienced the joy of being the chosen one. Obtaining the illusion crystal was actually so simple.., he couldn’t help but feel excited. He blinked, and his expression was filled with gratitude and passion as he continued speaking.
“Senior, can you bring me to find all the other illusion crystals?”
“Find all of them?”The paper figurine was a little surprised.
“I can, but there’s no point in doing so. There must be thirty people in this trial. Only then can all the illusion crystals be activated. Each person can only keep one illusion crystal. Even if you manage to obtain all of them, within a few hours at most, twenty-nine of them will automatically disappear and reappear in their original positions.”
“Is that so...”Wang Baole felt a little regretful when he heard that. He had originally planned that if it was possible, he would be in control of the decision of the trial. When he met someone who was pleasing to the eye, he would sell it to the other party at a lower price, with that, thirty illusion crystals would be enough for him to make a huge fortune.
“I can still sell the position... but if that’s the case, the price won’t be able to rise.”Wang baole sighed. He felt that it was too difficult to earn money. He was about to give up on the idea, but in the next moment, an idea flashed through his mind, he looked at the paper figurine and suddenly spoke.
“Senior, do you have any way to leave a seal on the illusory crystals so that when the time limit for the trial ends, if the seal is not removed, no one can enter the next trial?”

chapters.title: Chapter 941 - Self-improvement!
chapters.content:
Chapter 941: Self-improvement!
The paper figurine glanced at Wang Baole. It couldn’t help but wonder if it had misjudged the outer realm cultivator before it. The other party’s suggestion was extremely sinister..
He clearly wanted it to seal the illusory crystals and use them to achieve a certain goal. However, even if it could agree to it, it couldn’t do it.
“It’s useless. Even if you can seal them, the moment the trial ends in seven days, all the seals will collapse. It Won’t affect the next trial at all. Therefore, you...”
Before the paper figurine could finish speaking, Wang Baole’s eyes lit up completely. He spoke quickly, his face beaming with joy.
“Thank you, senior. It doesn’t matter even if they collapse after the trial ends. As long as you can teach me the method to break the seal, it’s fine. Senior, please help me!”
The paper figurine was stunned. After a moment of silence, it shook its head helplessly. This matter wasn’t that troublesome for it. Thinking about the mutual help it had with the cultivator from the outer realm, the paper figurine fell silent. Then, under Wang Baole’s eager gaze.., it nodded.
Seeing that the paper figurine had agreed, Wang Baole became even more excited. Soon, under the instructions of the paper figurine, Wang Baole began to fiddle around on the illusory planet. He spent a full day on the planet, during that time, he encountered many Phantoms and cultivators.
Among the phantoms, there were some planets. The most dangerous time was when Wang Baole sensed the fluctuations of the illusory planet. Fortunately, the paper figurine interfered, allowing him to successfully avoid them.
Just like that, a day later, Wang Baole found the remaining twenty-nine illusory crystals. He didn’t take them away. Instead, after he found them, he had the paper figurine set a seal before putting them back in their original positions.
After all the seals had been sealed, Wang Baole happily found a place to hide and waited there. At the same time, he was learning the method of unsealing that the paper figurine had taught him.
...
The method wasn’t difficult. In order to make it easier for Wang Baole to learn, the paper figurine didn’t use the techniques of the Starfall Empire. Instead, it used the method of the never-ending DAO domain, leaving behind a flaw that could be resolved.
To a certain extent, rather than teaching Wang Baole how to break the seal, it was more appropriate to say that the paper figurine was teaching him a runic symbol. This runic symbol was like a universal key. Even if he didn’t understand the principles behind it, he could still open it.
Then, at Wang Baole’s request, even his own runic symbol was sealed. At that moment, Wang Baole was already extremely excited, and he looked forward to the passage of time.
While Wang Baole was learning how to break the seal, the elites from the outside world who had come to this place also scattered and began to search for the illusory crystal. The process was a little difficult, there were also a large number of planet Phantoms and a star Phantoms wandering around the illusory planet. They would occasionally encounter attacks.
If they were unlucky and encountered many of them at the same time, or if they encountered them one after another, it was inevitable that they would fail the trial. That was not all. The most important thing was the lack of clues regarding the illusory crystal, which caused everyone to be stuck on this planet, they were like headless chickens, running around aimlessly. They had used up all sorts of methods, but they still could not find the illusory crystal.
However, there were also intelligent people who were certain that the trial would eventually give them clues. Therefore, just like Wang Baole, they had chosen a place to hide early on. They sat quietly and meditated, trying to maintain their peak condition.
There were not many people like that, but there were dozens of them. As time passed, there were less than three days left until the end of the trial. More specifically, twenty hours... The clues finally appeared, a strong ripple suddenly erupted from a spot where the illusion crystal was located, causing all the elites on the planet to be able to sense it immediately!
Wang Baole, who was hiding, also sensed it instantly. He opened his closed eyes abruptly. He wasn’t surprised by this. During his communication with the paper figurine over the past few days, he had known in advance that in the last twenty hours, every hour.., the location of an illusion crystal would be revealed. He also knew very well that the cruellest competition in this trial had already begun.
That was indeed the case. As the first illusion Crystal’s aura erupted and its location was revealed, all the cultivators nearby were shocked. They flew out together. There weren’t many people in the first batch, only a dozen or so, it was inevitable to fight over it, and so were the deaths and injuries.
In the shortest amount of time, someone stood out and snatched the illusion Crystal to escape. Then, the aura of the second illusion crystal spread out in another location.
As a result, the fight began again. Everyone had figured out the rules and knew that one would appear every two hours. Therefore, most of them wouldn’t rush over every time. Instead, they would judge the distance before making a choice.
Just like that, a day passed. The aura of the twelve illusion crystals spread out, and everyone made a decision. The twelve illusion crystals all had owners, and their positions were not hidden. It was as if after they obtained the illusion crystals.., their bodies would continue to be exposed, and they would continue to tempt others to snatch them.
As a result, the continuous competition and killing took place many times during the day. The owners of the twelve illusion crystals had also changed, but three of them were never contested.
One of them was in the hands of the scholarly young man from the first sect of the left Dao. He sat on the peak of a mountain, frowning as he stared at the illusory crystal in his hand. Anyone who sensed the arrival of the illusory crystal hesitated for a moment before eventually avoiding it.
The other one was the bell lady from the nine Phoenix sect. Just like the scholarly young man, no one dared to fight over the illusory crystal after obtaining it. At the same time, she seemed to have some doubts about the illusory crystal as she continued to observe it.
The other one... was the reason why no one fought over it, because all of the previous competitors had been killed!
That person was the black-robed young man who carried a greatsword on his back, and emanated a murderous aura. In this trial by fire, the number of cultivators who had died at his hands could be said to be the highest.
Other than the three of them, the competition for the other positions was ongoing all the time. Even if new illusory crystals appeared every two hours, there was no way to stop the competition.
