Wang Baole knew that those were... the ancient stars that the fallen star Emperor had mentioned!
He was looking at them, and they... were also looking at him!
What was strange was that even though Wang Baole was beneath them, he gave off a feeling of being looked down upon. The nine ancient stars looked at Wang Baole from above, as if they were looking up!
It was as if... He was also a star!

chapters.title: Chapter 965 - talent for the Stars!
chapters.content:
Chapter 965: talent for the Stars!
They stared at each other. It was only for an instant, but in Wang Baole’s heart and mind, it was as if they were eternal.
As he pondered, he stopped the operation of the star nascent soul. He closed his eyes and covered the stars that were hidden in the sky. He raised his right hand and waved the drumstick in his hand, causing the hearts of everyone around him to tremble, he struck the fourteenth time!
The refined cultivator and the black-robed youth were shaken once again. He struck the fifteenth time!
The bell girl’s eyes were bloodshot. She had sunk into despair. She struck the sixteenth time!
The goodwill of the entire world descended. Amidst the struggles of the dao stars in the sky, she struck the seventeenth time!
Dong, Dong, Dong, Dong. Four strikes in a row. Every strike caused the world to rumble. Every strike caused the sky to distort. Every strike caused all beings in the area to feel as if they had been struck in the heart. Their minds buzzed as if they had been struck by lightning.
Similarly, every strike was Wang Baole’s full strength. However, even with the blessing of the world’s goodwill, Wang Baole still found it difficult to breathe. It was as if his body was about to be torn apart. After all, from the tenth strike onwards.., the arrival of external forces required him to support himself.
However, in the end, he was still not a planet. He was not even his actual body. He was only a clone!
Seventeen strikes was the limit. His vision became blurry, and his body seemed to be on the verge of collapsing at any moment due to the inability to bear the goodwill of the world.
However, the effects of the four strikes were equally earth-shattering. It reached a level that was unprecedented in the fallen star. It was something that no one had ever seen or even imagined in their entire lives!
The entire sky seemed as if it was about to be torn apart. It had no choice but to turn into a huge whirlpool. It was as if a storm was roaring within, and the fallen star was trembling. As for the Dao star that seemed to be entangled by a large number of threads and was about to be forcefully pulled down.., as it struggled, threads kept breaking. However, as Wang Baole struck the heaven-connecting drum four times in a row, more threads suddenly materialized like a waterfall. They seemed to form a large hand that... grabbed onto the dao star!
...
The moment he grabbed onto the Dao Star, Wang Baole’s mind was filled with an intense roar. Even though he had only grabbed it from across space, the feeling of touching it allowed him to instantly understand the rules of the Dao Star.
The Aura from his entire body soared into the sky at that moment. It merged with the world and seemed to become one. It seemed to borrow the will of the entire meteorite land and the fate of the meteorite empire to gather itself, with an aura that couldn’t be reversed, Wang Baole grabbed the dao star with all his remaining strength. He roared and yanked it forcefully!
“Get Down!”
This Yank gave everyone the feeling that the starry sky had tilted to a large extent. The dao star, which had been struggling in an illusory state, erupted with an extremely bright light, it was forcefully pulled out of its illusory state by more than half.
With a loud boom, the starry sky caved in, and a huge star appeared in the sky. It occupied almost thirty percent of the starry sky, revealing almost seventy percent of the star!
It was now clear that the majority of the planet was no longer illusory. It was now corporeal, and in its corporeal state, everyone could clearly see... What the entire planet looked like, it was completely different from the other planets. It hung in the sky like... a paper star!
After being dragged out of the planet, the light of the planet once again erupted out, forming a blinding light that converged into a sea of light. It illuminated the entire fallen star region to the extreme, and at the same time, it radiated an unprecedented fury, the Sea of light descended from the sky from the Dao Star!
The Fury was intense and incomparably clear. It was as if it could transform into a sea of fire that wished to burn the entire world. That was because as a dao star, it had its own will. It could sense the tiny life form on the land, no matter how it compared to itself, it was extremely weak. There was a huge gap between it and its own level.
However... because it was born in the fallen star region, and because its laws were formed by the fallen star region’s laws, it was as if there was an ancient contract between it and the fallen star region, at the same time, it would also be restrained!
This restraint... it hadn’t paid much attention to it before, because the fallen star region wouldn’t interfere with the choices of the stars. However, today was the first time it had shown it.
Although it had been able to remain arrogant despite the arrival of the aura of a paragon from the outer reaches, it could only struggle passively in front of this tiny creature, and was unable to take the initiative to punish it for its crimes.
All of this was because of the fate of the entire Meteor Empire, which had been bestowed upon the tiny creature. It was because the will of the meteor domain had also descended upon it, as if it were telling it to choose that person to fuse with, to become its planet!
This was not its will, which was why it was struggling. It did not like that person, nor did it believe that he would not tarnish the name of its dao star. In fact, it was filled with loathing for that person, because from what it could see.., the reason why he had been able to strike it so far was because of external forces. It did not want such a person!
It wanted to choose the person next to it, the person who was willing to make it its master, and the person who was willing to make it its second.
That was its choice!
That was why it was angry. It struggled, and as that anger spread, the Sea of light erupted. A shadow of fire appeared around the Dao Star, as if it was about to burn. It wasn’t self-immolation, but... it was an attempt to sever itself!
The Dao Star had chosen to show its determination to sever itself from the fallen star to prove that it would never yield to its will and choose Wang Baole!
It was unable to speak, but its rage spread, causing every single existence in the entire fallen star empire to feel its will clearly. They fell silent.
The will that the dao star exuded seemed to be right in their dissatisfaction with Wang Baole’s reliance on external forces.
In comparison, both the bell lady and the black-robed youth had external forces to help them, but in their eyes, most of them still relied on themselves.
“You would rather be cut off from the fallen star lands than choose me? Because you think I rely on external help?”Wang Baole was silent, beside him, the bell lady’s eyes were filled with joy. The ups and downs of losing something and regaining it made her excited, and her body was trembling. She was about to speak, but before the bell lady could say anything, Wang Baole suddenly smiled.
He raised his head to look at the Dao stars in the sky that he had drawn out. There was coldness in his smile. He suddenly turned to the emperor of Starfall, who was standing in front of the main hall of the Imperial Palace. He cupped his fists and bowed deeply.
“Senior, please retrieve your fate!”
The Emperor of Starfall looked at Wang Baole silently. He seemed to understand Wang Baole’s choice. He raised his right hand and waved it. Immediately, cracking sounds came from Wang Baole’s body. The Wisps of Aura that had gathered previously belonged to the citizens of Starfall.., it instantly spread out from his body and spread in all directions, returning to the bodies of all living beings.
This scene made all the people of the fallen stars who saw it freeze in their eyes.
A strong sense of weakness appeared in Wang Baole’s body and mind at that moment, causing his body to tremble continuously. However, he still turned around and bowed once more towards the heavens and the earth, towards the fallen stars world.
“I request the supreme will of the fallen star world to withdraw its support!”
After a short period of silence, a soft sigh reverberated clearly in the hearts of every living creature in the world. As the sigh reverberated, a five-colored glow radiated from Wang Baole’s body. White represented the sky, black represented the land, green represented life, blue represented the ocean, and white represented the laws.
The light gathered between Wang Baole’s brows and finally dispersed outside his body, turning into five long arcs that returned to heaven and earth.
As they left, Wang Baole’s body instantly lost all support. At that moment, the fate of the Fallen Star Empire was gone, and the goodwill of the world had disappeared. His external forces... could be said to have all been returned. He held onto the heaven-reaching drum.., he barely stood there. Under his weak aura, there was a sense of dominance that was rising!
At that moment, all the living beings in the entire fallen star area were staring at him. Even Dao Xing, who had been dragged out of the sky and was filled with anger, seemed to hesitate for a moment before looking at Wang Baole.
“I don’t know if it’s just because you didn’t choose to fuse with me that you found an excuse.”
“Regardless, now that I’ve returned the external force, what happens next... you have to take a good look!”Wang Baole said calmly, however, when he said the last four words, he raised his head abruptly. His eyes, which had dimmed due to the loss of luck and goodwill, suddenly erupted with... a glow that was even more intense than before!
This glow... to be precise, it was... Starlight!
“Star, nascent soul!”Wang Baole roared in his heart. He raised both his hands and lifted them towards the sky!

chapters.title: Chapter 966 - came, but it still didn’t come!
chapters.content:
Chapter 966: came, but it still didn’t come!
The talent of a stellar nascent soul allowed those who possessed it to grow stronger. The closer they were to the planet and the more planets there were, the more powerful they would become.
The place where the Stars Fell wasn’t a planet, but an empty region. The stars in the sky weren’t visible, and there was only one dao star. It could be said that to Wang Baole, who possessed the talent of a stellar nascent soul.., there was a certain amount of support, but it wasn’t as great as he had imagined.
However... previously, when the world had been kind enough to support him, Wang Baole had been blessed with the talent of a star nascent soul. He had seen the hidden stars and all the stars, at that moment, he felt as if he had transformed into a star. The feeling kept appearing in his mind. At that moment, as the aura of his star nascent soul erupted, as his cultivation surged, and as his hands rose towards the sky.., instantly, the entire starry sky rumbled.
As the rumbles spread, not only did the starlight in Wang Baole’s eyes grow stronger, his body also shone with a bright light. The light grew brighter and brighter, and in the end, it almost completely enveloped him, it lifted his body up, and the light continued to spread outwards.
As he rose into the air and the starlight spread, the rumbling in the sky grew stronger. The faint stars that had lost their color and were no longer visible after the dao stars descended seemed to resonate with him as well, specks of starlight gradually appeared.
Even though the starlight was still very weak and was immediately suppressed by the Dao stars as soon as it appeared, as Wang Baole continued to rise into the air and the starlight on his body grew brighter and brighter.., as the feeling of him turning into a star grew stronger and stronger in his heart, the starry sky... began to slowly change!
More and more stars that were originally hidden began to resist the pressure of the Dao star and try to appear. More and more starlight began to spread. It was as if they were using their own actions to fight against the tyranny of the Dao star together with Wang Baole, however, the suppression of the Dao star intensified at that moment.
If the Dao Star had looked down on Wang Baole previously, it was already feeling uneasy at that moment. To It, Wang Baole was no longer a cultivator, but one of the stars. Therefore, his actions.., were a challenge to its own status.
All of this was because... the essence of the star nascent soul was a secret that Wang Baole had never discovered before. The star nascent soul... to a certain extent, was a star!
However, it didn’t have a physical body. It was the will of the Star!
If that was the case, Wang Baole’s previous acquisition of the Dao Star and his actions under the dao star were akin to the star’s own resistance and struggle. If the stars were compared to an empire, then the dao star was the emperor.., the star that Wang Baole represented was the rise of a minor figure to challenge the tyrant’s existence.
...
This scene caused everyone who saw it to have a drastic change in expression!
All the paper figurines in the plaza were shocked. The scholarly cultivator and the black-robed youth gasped. The little girl beside them was also stunned. The bell lady, too, had a look of shock in her eyes.
Even the emperor of Starfall took a few steps forward, disbelief in his eyes.
“It’s a stellar nascent soul!”As one of the five legendary nascent souls in the never-ending dao domain, the stellar nascent soul.., it was a miracle in itself. At the same time, its secrecy was so rare and rare that it was hard for outsiders to detect it. Even the emperor of Starfall had only heard of it, but had never seen it before, that was why he hadn’t noticed it on Wang Baole before.
He had done the same, and the others had done the same. They all realized the reason, but the shock in their hearts didn’t diminish. Instead, it grew stronger. That was because... at that moment, following Wang Baole’s body.., as the starlight enveloped the skies, the stars in the sky seemed to be struggling, eager to give it a try. It was as if they were unwilling to lose their light under the Dao Star. They wanted to resist, but they needed a leader!
The dao stars seemed to have sensed this as well. Their anger grew stronger, and a large amount of light erupted, shaking the entire starry sky. They wanted to suppress the stars that seemed to defy their will
As the light dispersed and the stars were about to be suppressed once again, Wang Baole suddenly raised his head. A strange look appeared in his eyes, and he said a sentence that spread across the entire starry sky!
“If the stars don’t show themselves now, when will they?”As he spoke, Wang Baole raised his right hand and the star guiding drumstick in his hand instantly shone with starlight. With a wave of his hand, the star guiding drumstick was like a shooting star, it shot straight towards the sky-reaching drum.
It fell in an instant and struck... eighteen times!
The sound of the drum rose into the sky in that instant. It could be said to be the eighteenth strike, but it could also be said to be an infinite strike. As the strike landed, the sound of the drum rang out continuously. It was like the sound of a mountain collapsing and the sound of an ocean crashing. It spread in all directions.
The sky changed, and the wind and clouds reversed. The starry sky seemed as if it were about to split apart, and huge fissures spread out in all directions. These fissures didn’t really exist, but rather, seemed to come from the suppression of the Dao Stars. At the same time that the fissures appeared.., massive rumbling sounds that sounded like the roars of stars could be heard from the heavens, and they exploded out in all directions!
Rumbling filled the air, and countless lives were filled with astonishment. The starry sky was completely transformed, and countless stars appeared. In the blink of an eye, the starry sky reappeared, and all of the stars appeared, shining with Brilliant Starlight!
No matter how the Exasperated Dao Stars tried to suppress the stars, it seemed impossible to completely stop them. That was because the stars that appeared were not just mortal stars, Spirit Stars, and Immortal Stars. There were also... Special Stars!
Thousands of special stars from the second to ninth grades appeared, and thirty-seven first-grade stars also appeared, all of which had never appeared before. Light spread out through the starry sky, and this scene could be described as a scene of stars fighting for Glory, perhaps it was still a bit off, but it was close!
Clearly, all of this had shaken the will-filled dao star time and time again. Under the provocation of its prestige, its fury exploded out, and the star body automatically changed from its previous state. Rumbling sounds could be heard as the complete star body.., for the first time, it appeared in the sky, and its suppressive power was fully unleashed, causing the starry sky to distort. The stars, including the special stars, could no longer hold on, and it was at this moment..
A planet that was like the morning star, second only to the Dao Star, appeared directly to the east of the distorted starry sky. As it did, an ancient, archaic aura spread out in all directions, making it seem like a king of the frontier, in that instant, it exploded with brilliant light, causing the starry sky around it to no longer distort!
Next, a second, a third, a fourth, and even a ninth ancient planet appeared, all of which occupied the entire area. At the same time, another planet appeared in the very center, as if it wanted to face the DAO star directly!
“Ancient planets!”Murmured the sovereign of Starfall. All of the people in the Starfall Empire who knew about ancient planets felt waves of shock in their hearts.
According to their historical records, ancient planets... were just like Dao Stars. They were legendary existences, ancient planets that had failed to advance to a dao star, but were unwilling to give up. They had existed for a very long time, it was as if they had existed before the Starfall Empire!
In fact, it could even be said that the reason they had failed was because they lacked a bit of luck and recognition. As long as they had enough luck, it wasn’t impossible for them to advance to dao stars.
The reason why the Dao Star with the paper-like laws had succeeded was because when it had advanced, it had received the recognition of the Starfall Empire. It had also received the support of the will of the Starfall land, which had given it a helping hand!
To a certain extent, the prestige of the ancient stars was above that of the special stars. It was an existence second only to the dao stars. Today... nine ancient stars and the Dao Stars had appeared at the same time. This scene was unprecedented and unprecedented!
In the midst of the world’s shock, the stars around them shone. The brilliance of the starry sky was indescribable. Everyone who saw this was buzzing in their minds. Only Wang Baole, who was standing in midair.., he raised his head and stared at the Heavenly Star Atlas.
He looked at the stars around him. He looked at the thousands of special stars that were close to the inner ring. He looked at the eight ancient stars in the central region. He looked at the ninth ancient star in the center. He looked at... the only dao star that seemed to be surrounded by the stars, he spoke slowly.
“This time, I didn’t use any external forces. Then... are you coming or not?”

chapters.title: Chapter 967 - , the arrival of the ancient star!
chapters.content:
Chapter 967:, the arrival of the ancient star!
Wang Baole’s voice reverberated in all directions. It traveled into the sky, and the starlight that was surrounded shone brightly for a few moments. Under everyone’s watchful eyes, its body suddenly shrank, it formed a ray of light that was as white as paper and shot toward Wang Baole’s position in the starry sky!
However... as if to take revenge on Wang Baole, the white paper ray turned abruptly after getting close to him. It bypassed him and headed straight for... The Bell Maiden, who was on the ground in despair!
In that instant, it sank into her forehead and disappeared. The bell maiden was barely able to withstand it. She coughed up blood and passed out before she could rejoice. The starlight surrounding her body grew thicker and thicker!
This scene caused all the cultivators who saw it to narrow their eyes. The entire world fell silent at that moment. They all looked at Wang Baole. It wasn’t just them. The stars in the sky were staring as well. The nine ancient stars.., they were staring as well. Perhaps it could be said that they were waiting.
Wang Baole lowered his head to look at the Bell Maiden, whose starlight was growing thicker and thicker. He was silent for a moment before he suddenly laughed.
“So, what you said before about me relying on external forces was just an Excuse?”After saying that, Wang Baole retracted his gaze and didn’t look at her again. He had tried his best, performed, and fought for her. Since she was still looking down on him.., from then on, she was no longer qualified to be taken seriously by him.
He looked at the starry sky and spoke slowly and calmly in a tone that had never been heard before.
“Who among you... is willing to accompany me on my journey through the mountains and seas, to accompany me for the rest of my life?”
As soon as he spoke, the Heavens Shook and thunder shook the world. The stars shone together. Whether it was a mortal planet, a spirit planet, or an immortal planet, all of them erupted with intense light. All the special planets, from the ninth-grade to the first-grade.., all of them revealed an unprecedented desire. This scene was enough to shake the heavens and earth. What was even more shocking was that the nine ancient planets, at that moment, erupted with starlight in an almost frenzied manner. Nine mutated beasts appeared faintly on them, they all bowed to Wang Baole!
The galaxy filled the sky, radiating with boundless light!
This was the true splendor of the Stars!
...
Such a wondrous scene had never been seen since ancient times!
At that moment, all the paper figurines in the plaza were once again shaken. Even though everything that had happened under Wang Baole’s actions previously had already shocked them, at that moment.., they were once again shocked even more.
There were also the people of Starfall who had witnessed everything with the refraction of the Almighty’s supernatural power in the entire territory outside of the imperial capital. Their hearts were also in turmoil. When they raised their heads, they saw the twinkling stars in the sky, it caused the minds of all the people of Starfall to buzz incessantly.
“Rather than saying that the stars are competing for Glory, it’s more appropriate to say that the stars are competing for this person!”
“What kind of opportunity does this person have? He actually... he actually caused the Sea of stars to boil with excitement!”
“He doesn’t choose the dao stars, but the stars worship him in unison!”
After a short period of silence, the uproar erupted throughout the entire Starfall Empire. The square in the imperial palace was no exception. It was the same for the officials and mighty figures behind the Starfall Emperor.
Even the meteorite emperor himself was in a daze. The words that Wang Baole had said to him suddenly surfaced in his mind, and he couldn’t help but mutter.
“Everything that we miss is for the best arrangement... then... which one will you choose?”
At that moment, it wasn’t just the lives of the people in the meteorite empire who were shocked. It was the same for the prodigies from the Weiyang Dao domain like Wang Baole. It was the same for those cultivators who didn’t have the status to come to the imperial palace and weren’t qualified to ring the heaven-reaching drum, li Linzi and the others, who were outside the imperial palace, were also shocked beyond belief.
From the beginning to the end, the chance encounter with the stars had brought them too much shock. The subsequent battle for the Dao stars and Wang Baole’s domineering rise, as well as the competition for the glory of the stars, had made them start from that moment on, wang Baole’s figure was firmly imprinted in their hearts. Only two words appeared in their minds!
Such a prodigy..
Other than them, a similar thought surfaced in the mind of the scholarly cultivator from the first sect of the left Dao. At that moment, he truly viewed Wang Baole as someone who was equal to him. His expression was unprecedentedly solemn, the black-robed youth beside him also gave Wang Baole a deep look. His eyes dimmed slightly.
As for the little girl, her eyes widened as she stared blankly at Wang Baole. No one knew what she was thinking, but her eyes grew brighter and brighter.
As for the others, such as the masked woman, the little fatty, and brother Gao, they had all chosen to fuse with the stars. Their consciousness did not spread out, and they did not know what was happening outside. However, compared to them, what was most shocking was the dao star in the body of the unconscious bell lady! It was the dao star in the body of the unconscious bell lady!
In the end, the Dao Star did not choose Wang Baole. Even when Wang Baole had used his full strength, it had still given up on him. However, the person it had given up on.., he had actually caused the stars to compete for Glory... if it had the emotions of a cultivator, then it must have been at a loss in its silence.
It had a vague feeling that it had... missed out on an important opportunity.
That was because... the cultivator that he had looked down on had only said who was willing to accompany him and hadn’t said what would happen after that. That was equivalent to not giving him any benefits. He had only asked who was willing to come. Even so.., it had still attracted the attention of the stars..
Even Wang Baole himself hadn’t expected such a grand scene. After a moment of silence, he looked at the sparkling stars in the starry sky. His expression became even more solemn. He cupped his fists and bowed deeply before giving his promise.
“Those who follow me, I will do everything in my power to make them rise to prominence and become the supreme stars of the DAO domain. This is my grand vow!”
The moment he said that, everyone who heard it was once again shaken. Even the falling star Emperor’s pupils constricted. That was because... Wang Baole’s words were too heavy!
A Dao oath was a prayer of one’s own future Dao. It served as proof of one’s heart, hoping to gain the approval of the heavens and the starry skies. If one could engrave it into the laws of the starry skies, the Dao Oath would exist forever. However, those who could engrave the laws of the starry skies with an oath.., they had to be mighty figures. The rest would find it difficult to influence the laws of the starry skies.
A grand vow was a vow that was even more solemn than a dao oath. It didn’t just serve as proof of one’s heart with the Dao of the future. It also served as proof of the sincerity of the oath through one’s own life and all traces of existence. Normally speaking, even an ordinary person.., a grand wish had a slight impact on the laws of the starry skies. If one were to go back on their word, they would more or less suffer some backlash. The more fated one was, the greater the impact on the laws of the starry skies would be.
If those with great fates were to open their mouths to make a grand wish, it would even cause a phenomenon in the heavens and earth!
It wasn’t that Wang Baole didn’t know how serious his words were, but his heart told him that since the galaxy was willing to choose him, he must not disappoint the stars that chose him!
As his words reverberated in the air, the stars in the sky trembled. Then, starlight erupted even more intensely, causing the sky to change and the clouds to shatter. The entire world was illuminated by starlight, and the desire that came from the stars.., it erupted crazily at that moment. It was as if every star was calling out, anticipating Wang Baole’s choice!
The nine ancient stars, in particular, shone with the brightest light. The one at the center even fell down decisively amidst the desire!
It had fallen down of its own accord. It had put its ancient dignity and its future on the line. If Wang Baole didn’t choose it, it would have lost its recognition once again. The only way for an ancient star to advance to a dao star.., was recognition. If Wang Baole didn’t recognize it this time, it would have a huge impact on it!
After all, choosing to be abandoned was harmful to both humans and the stars. The latter was worse!
This scene completely shocked everyone who saw it!
“The ancient stars have taken the initiative to descend!”
An uproar erupted again. Before it could spread, the other eight ancient stars in the sky, who seemed to be frantic and anxious, suddenly... all descended at the same time. Together with the one from before, they turned into nine beams of light, they descended from the sky and charged straight at Wang Baole. In the end, under everyone’s stunned gazes, the nine stars revealed their true forms. They exuded an ancient aura and countless potholes, but they also became smaller and smaller.
In the end, they all turned into the size of a fist, forming nine extremely bright pearls that floated in front of Wang Baole. As the light shone, the stars in the sky trembled.
Wang Baole’s breathing froze as he looked at the nine ancient stars before him. As they shone, his consciousness seemed to sense the desire of the nine ancient stars and touch their will.
I’m unwilling to stay like this forever. Even if the nine are one, I’ll still acknowledge it. As long as I can become a dao star, do I need enough recognition

chapters.title: Chapter 968 - approval!
chapters.content:
Chapter 968:, approval!
?
Wang Baole’s eyes shone with a strange light. As he muttered to himself, the light in his eyes grew brighter. After a moment of silence, he suddenly spoke.
“With my solemn vow as proof, I will allow all nine of you to become one and become a Supreme Dao Star!”
As soon as he spoke, the nine stars shone brightly, and the stars in the sky shone even brighter. Thunder rumbled in the sky, and as it spread, the sound of thunder reverberated throughout the entire meteorite land. A storm raged on the meteorite land, the storm didn’t affect any life or matter. It was as if its purpose was to respond to Wang Baole’s grand wish and his recognition of the nine stars!
If that was all, the grand wish might have caused some strange phenomena, but it wasn’t enough. Wang Baole’s current cultivation and luck were still too weak. He wanted to shake the entire Weiyang Dao domain’s starry sky, it was almost impossible to imprint it into the laws of the starry skies, not to mention to acknowledge the merging of the nine stars into a dao star. That was unless... There was a mighty figure willing to be a witness and acknowledge the matter!
The stronger the witness, the greater the magnification of Wang Baole’s grand vow. The greater the influence of the laws of the starry skies and the augmentation of the DAO domain. To a certain extent... this was the only way for a special star to advance to a Dao Star!
With sufficient recognition, the only law would be born!
That was why at that moment, the Falling Star Emperor, who was standing outside the Palace Hall, had a strange glint in its eyes. It suddenly spoke, and its voice spread across the heavens and earth.
“Allow!”
With the cultivation of the falling star Emperor and the power of its status, the moment it spoke, it meant that it was willing to bear the karma and become the witness of Wang Baole’s Grand Dao vow. It was also willing to become the person who recognized the nine stars combined into a Dao Star!
As soon as it said those words, the Thunder in the sky rumbled even louder. Its body shook violently. As it bore the karma, Wang Baole seemed to receive a boost. The power of its Grand Dao vow instantly increased, the nine ancient stars in front of it shone at the peak of each other’s radiance. The starlight between them began to show signs of merging together!
Because they were merging with each other, if they failed, the backlash would be too severe for them to be destroyed. However, they would no longer be qualified to advance to a Dao Star!
...
However, it was clear... that the recognition of the fallen star Emperor was not enough for them to advance to a dao star. That was because they were nine stars, not one. Therefore, the recognition they needed, as well as the difficulty of advancing to a dao star.., would rise to an unimaginable level!
It was at this point that ripples spread out in the sky. All of the paper figurines in the square, as well as the fallen star cultivators outside of the imperial city, began to speak in unison.
“Quasi!”
Heaven and Earth began to change, and rumbling sounds could be heard as the light from the nine stars grew even more intense. At the same time, the ancestral emperor, who was sitting cross-legged in the Black Paper Sea, opened his eyes, his eyes seemed to be able to see everything in the imperial city. After a moment of silence, he spoke calmly.
“Quasi!”
His words were integrated into the voices of all the cultivators in the meteorite empire. As they reverberated, the quasi word seemed to no longer be the voice of a cultivator, but... the voice of the Meteorite Empire’s Kismet!
This was witnessed by the Kismet of the Meteorite Empire!
With the blessing of the fate of the Empire, the mountains and seas rumbled, and the storm gathered around Wang Baole. The phenomenon grew even more majestic, and the power of the oath grew once again. The light of the nine stars finally began to fuse, but it was still not enough!
However, this was not the end. Other than the fate of the Empire, there was also the will of the world in the Starfall Empire. As the voice of the fate of the empire reverberated, the will of the world turned into a voice, it appeared in the hearts and minds of all the living beings in the land!
“Allow!”
In an instant, the land of the fallen star erupted with unprecedented waves. If one looked from high up in the sky, one could see that the waves were all gathered around Wang Baole, causing the storm around Wang baole to sweep across the entire land of the fallen star!
The Sea of light of the nine stars instantly expanded, and the light from each star became one. At the same time, the stars began to move closer to each other, showing signs of merging with each other!
This was the recognition of the entire fallen star land. The dao star that had merged with the Bell Lady’s body had been successfully upgraded under this recognition. However, at this moment... the recognition didn’t seem to be enough to support the merging of the nine stars into one, the speed at which they merged gradually slowed down, as if there were insufficient successors!
It was clear that once the DAO star that had been upgraded from the nine stars into one succeeded, its power would surpass that of the paper star!
Different levels meant different requirements!
Everyone was agitated. Wang Baole’s breathing quickened. All of this... wasn’t over yet. There were other mighty figures as witnesses!
Outside the fallen star, in the starry skies of the never-ending dao domain, Chen Qingzi, who was fighting coldly and surrounded the moon-splitting divine emperor from within a giant whirlpool array formation, swung his long sword and killed countless cultivators of the never-ending clan, the wind blew his black hair. He raised his head. His clear and Bright Eyes were deep. He looked into the starry skies through his subconscious senses. After a long while, he laughed.
“Accurate!”
As a super powerhouse who could fight against the divine emperor and even kill him, his influence on the laws of the universe was naturally extremely strong. His fate was naturally earth-shattering. That was why his approval was extremely precious!
As soon as he said those words, it was as if a raging fire was cooking oil. The storm that had been surrounding Wang Baole in the fallen star area instantly broke out of its restrictions and spread out of the fallen star area. The storm wasn’t visible to everyone, only those who were related to Wang Baole could sense it!
Wang Baole seemed to have heard Chen Qingzi’s voice. His heart was racing. The nine ancient stars before him shone brightly once again. The fusion of the stars between them became frenzied at that moment.
In an instant, the fusion reached almost thirty percent. The starry sky rumbled and the stars shone. Countless laws seemed to be manifesting on the nine ancient stars!
As they fused, the storm caused by Wang Baole’s grand vow spread beyond the fallen stars. Another familiar old voice rang in his ears.
“Allow!”In the Weiyang Dao Domain, the left Dao sacred region, a special area was marked out. Flames filled the area. The Blazing Flame ancestor threw his head back and laughed loudly. With his deep, old voice, he made Wang Baole’s vow.., he took another step forward, causing the storm to rise even higher. His and Chen Qingzi’s testimony immediately had a strong impact on the heavenly laws of the Weiyang Dao Domain. At that moment, within the storm around Wang Baole, there were faint nomological threads.., they were faintly discernible!
The appearance of these heavenly laws was a sign of initial recognition. For the nine stars that were in the midst of merging, it was basically the highest form of glory. In an instant, the degree of fusion between them increased from thirty percent to fifty percent, it had increased from thirty percent to fifty percent!
Even so, it still didn’t seem to be enough to support it. Recognition seemed to be insufficient... this not only explained the difficulty of becoming a dao star, it also explained another problem... The dao stars that they formed.., their quality had probably reached its peak. As their laws fused with each other, the only law that was created would be even more terrifying!
Seeing that there was no strength left to continue, and seeing that the light of the nine stars in the fusion was beginning to dim, Wang Baole fell silent as well. However, in the next moment, a look of unwillingness appeared in his eyes. His breathing quickened slightly, and in his heart.., he began to recite... The Dao scriptures!
“The will..
“The Dao of sealing the heavens..
“All living beings need to overcome the immeasurable tribulation..
“The will to leave the abyss..
“To serve, to cultivate!”
The moment the Dao scriptures appeared, the heavens changed again. The starry sky trembled, and the galaxy rumbled!
A consciousness from the outer realm, from the depths of the starry sky, suddenly descended at that moment. It was... the power of a paragon of creation from the outer realm!
Outside the Weiyang Dao Domain, in the unfamiliar depths of the starry skies, a pair of calm eyes slowly opened. Their faces couldn’t be seen clearly, only a head of white hair that seemed to float across the universe like a river of stars, as his eyes opened, he was silent for a moment before speaking calmly.
“Allow it!”
His words sounded like the sound of laws, like the laws of the universe, like the laws that followed his words, as if he was personally sealing them!
As his words fell into Wang Baole’s ears, his dao oath, the Hong Yuan, exploded to an unprecedented level. It ignored the laws of the starry skies and branded itself directly. At the same time, the nine ancient stars before him.., they trembled violently. It was due to excitement. They merged with the original fifty percent, and in an instant... they reached a hundred percent!
As the light erupted, the stars in the starry sky shone with Starlight and worshiped. The nine ancient stars instantly became one, forming a ball of nine-colored light that floated in front of Wang Baole. It was as if it had submitted and landed in his palm!
This was... The Eternal Dao Planet!
At that moment, all the living beings in the fallen stars lowered their heads!
At that moment, the countless stars in the starry sky outside were trembling!
At that moment, the nomological powers in the countless regions within the Weiyang Dao domain began to manifest, and the necessary changes began!
That was because... a new law would be born in this world. It would only belong to this planet, and it would only belong to... Wang Baole!

chapters.title: Chapter 969 - the return of the Dao Stars!
chapters.content:
Chapter 969:, the return of the Dao Stars!
?
The dao stars were also divided into different levels. The dao stars formed from the fusion of the nine ancient stars had clearly reached an extreme level, because the person who had acknowledged their birth was too extraordinary!
The fallen star ancestor, who had followed Wang Baole into the fallen star lands, was powerful enough to cause a stir regardless of whether it was in terms of cultivation or fate. There was also the current emperor of the fallen star, who was at the celestial domain realm, there was also the fate of the entire nation, which was formed by the gathering of all the citizens of the land of the fallen star.
This kind of support was enough to shake the entire universe. In addition, there was the world will of the land of the fallen star. Its recognition was even more crucial. The entire land of the fallen star, as a whole, became an eternal witness.
There was no need to mention the fact that the blazing flame ancestor, who was a mighty figure in the celestial domain, was also a witness of the planet and had given its recognition. His own existence was already able to affect the Weiyang universe. There was also Chen Qingzi... his recognition surpassed the former, he had basically reached the pinnacle of the unending universe.
This was because Chen Qingzi’s backer represented the dark sect, and his approval was, to a certain extent, the approval of the dark sect. As a result, although this dao star didn’t seem capable of succeeding, in reality, it already had all the necessary conditions, all it needed was time. As long as enough time was given, the nine ancient stars would definitely be able to successfully advance.
At that moment... the approval of the paragon from the other realms caused the entire Weiyang universe to tremble. His approval not only allowed the fusion of time to be completed in an instant.., it also gave the entire Weiyang universe an unprecedented chance for a dao star to ascend!
Because of that, the moment this dao star appeared, it could already be called a superstar within the Dao Star!
As the light shone, the stars in the sky of the fallen star worshiped it. All the citizens of the fallen star on the ground were shocked and lowered their heads.
Even the emperor of the fallen star and his ancestors in the Black Paper Sea were shocked and bowed their heads. It was clear that as the Dao planet was formed, the voices of approval shocked them.
The scholarly cultivator and the youth in black were also shocked. They stared at everything in a daze. They stared at Wang baole, who was hovering in midair. Their expressions gradually dimmed, and they lowered their heads in reluctance.
Even the little girl who had secretly activated her dark art had a solemn expression on her face at that moment. She seemed to have sensed a familiar aura that descended upon the fusion of the nine ancient stars.
...
The others were the same. Even though they had fused with the stars they had chosen and were in the process of upgrading to planets, they were still affected by the outside world and woke up within the stars, after sensing the outside world and seeing the nine-colored ball of light in front of Wang Baole, they were all shocked!
“This is impossible!”The Little Fatty, Lu Xiaohai.., his eyeballs almost fell out, and his heart was filled with grief and indignation. He felt that it was unfair. Why was it that he was only a special planet of the lowest level, and that the evil Xie Dalu had personally sealed it and created a Dao Planet!
What made him the saddest was that the special planet that he had fused with had wind dao as its rules. This Dao... was one of the rules of the nine ancient planets that had once existed within the nine-colored Dao Planet.
To a certain extent... even if he were to advance to a planet, he would be completely suppressed by the other party!
In contrast to him, the masked woman opened her eyes and stared at him for a moment. Suddenly, she laughed and murmured softly.
“Wang Baole...”as she spoke, she closed her eyes and ignored him. Instead, she continued her breakthrough.
It was a pity that Wang Baole couldn’t sense the movements on the planet where the masked woman was. If he could, he would be in a state of shock right now. That was because his real name was almost unknown even in the Divine Eye Galaxy, there was no need to mention that he was in the fallen star.
However... the masked woman had said it out loud!
Everyone in the fallen star was shocked and worshiped her. The stars in the sky shone brightly as if they were welcoming the new emperor. The bell girl was still unconscious, but the dao star in her body was trembling violently. It was filled with unwillingness, it was filled with anger and a hint of... Regret!
It could feel the level of suppression. They were both dao stars, but when it looked at the nine-colored star in front of Wang Baole, it felt a sense of admiration.
This feeling made it very clear to the conscious it. It represented the same status, but their statuses were completely different. It was like the Emperor of a mortal world. Some were the emperor of a small country, while others were the emperor of a large country. They were both emperors, however, how could their statuses and power be the same?
What made it tremble even more was that it had a faint sense of the unique law that was born from the Dao stars formed by the nine ancient stars. Its instincts told it that.., this unique law... was a powerful invasion and threat to it!
As the living beings worshiped it and the dao stars of the paper laws trembled, Wang Baole’s breathing was filled with excitement. He was extremely excited. At the same time, he placed all his attention on the nine-colored dao stars before him.
The nine colors, other than the usual seven colors, were black and white.
As he looked at the Dao Star, he could feel the worship coming from the other party. He could also feel the gratitude and vow of companionship that came from it. There was also a brand that was unique to him that was contained within the Dao Star!
This brand was an invisible manifestation of the power of Wang Baole’s grand vow. It represented the recognition of the star as its master and its determination to never betray its master. This was because the recognition of all the mighty figures was based on Wang Baole’s grand vow, to put it simply, it was both a witness and a fulfillment of Wang Baole’s wish.
Therefore, once the Dao Star betrayed and lost Wang Baole’s Great Dao Vow, it would lose everything, and its star would instantly shatter!
As he understood all of this, Wang Baole immediately sensed... the rules contained within the nine-colored dao star with the help of the brand within it!
The color was nine, and each color represented the different rules of the nine ancient stars. The moment they merged and successfully upgraded to a dao star, the nine rules solidified.
The solidification was enhanced by the upgrade to a dao star. If one were to compare the division of the rules to authority, then when there was no dao star with the corresponding nine rules in the world.., the nine rules that were solidified on this dao star were like kings under the Emperor!
Although they weren’t unique, the other planets in the world could also have these nine rules. However, when it was reflected on the person who owned this dao star, it would allow the person to unleash the power of the nine rules. Furthermore, the invisible resistance within the person’s body.., it would also be more effective when they encountered enemies with the nine rules.
The difference between the strong and the weak had already allowed Wang Baole to stand at the peak of the same level of cultivation on the planet. He wasn’t much weaker than the Bell Maiden who possessed the Dao Planet of the paper laws.
This was because the nine laws basically contained less than half of the dao techniques and divine abilities that cultivators could unleash!
From now on, any cultivator who cultivated the nine laws would be no match for Wang Baole in the same level of cultivation unless their cultivation level was much higher than Wang Baole’s and they were able to suppress him with their strength!
This... was not all that Wang Baole had gained this time. To be more precise, this was just the tip of the iceberg. What he had gained this time was that after the nine ancient planets merged together, they were influenced by each other’s laws, with the approval of a few mighty figures, what he had gained... was imprinted into the Weiyang universe and formed the only law!
This law only belonged to this dao planet. What exactly was it? It had just been formed, so even Wang Baole could only vaguely sense it. He needed to fuse it into his body and upgrade it to a planet, only then would he be able to fully grasp it. That way, it would be even harder for outsiders to know!
All he could determine was the laws of the nine ancient planets that it had once belonged to. As for the only law... he could only make guesses.
I can vaguely sense... that the only rule is very interesting... Wang Baole muttered to himself. His eyes shone brightly as he stared at the glowing nine-colored planet before him, he spoke calmly, as if he was speaking from a decree.
“The nine-colored dao planet has yet to return to its rightful place. When will it return?”
As soon as he spoke, the nine-colored dao planet let out a humming sound. It was as if it had agreed to Wang Baole’s request. As the light shone dazzlingly, it charged towards Wang Baole’s forehead and... merged into it!

chapters.title: Chapter 970 - nine stars and nine daos!
chapters.content:
Chapter 970: nine stars and nine daos!
The Great Circle of Spirit Immortal fused with a star to break through to the planet realm. Although the methods were different from each sect, the overall process and steps were the same. It was just that the details were different.
Generally speaking, if one fused with an ordinary spirit star, the process would not be too long. It was usually done in a short period of time, and the possibility of an accident was very small. If it was an immortal star, it would take a little longer, furthermore, they would need to find a place to seclude themselves and not be disturbed.
However, in general, the advancement of merging with a spirit planet and an immortal planet was very simple. However, if they merged with a special planet, the difficulty and risk would increase by a lot. Not only did they have an extreme requirement for cultivation, they also had a requirement for the soul.
The more complete the soul, the greater the possibility of success. As for the steps, they were different from the spirit and immortal planets. What was needed was for the cultivator to completely merge with the special planet. To a certain extent, they could be considered as an embryo, the cultivator would slowly absorb within the fusion until they perfectly fused with the laws of the special planet. Only then would they be able to break through and step into the planet realm!
There was a possibility of failure in the process, and there were also dangers. Of course, in the fallen stars, the degree of danger would be greatly reduced. For example, the little fatty, the masked woman, and the other cultivators who were currently in the heavenly planet.., what they were doing now was to integrate into the rules.
As for the method of integrating and upgrading the Dao Stars, no one knew. Since ancient times, only one person had managed to integrate with the Dao Stars. It had been too long, so naturally, it wouldn’t be known to the public.
That was why Wang Baole himself didn’t know what to do in order to complete the breakthrough in his cultivation. However... when the nine-colored dao star rushed into his glabella, Wang Baole understood.
To be precise, it wasn’t that he understood. It was that he had somehow sensed the method to achieve a breakthrough. He didn’t need to do anything himself. He just needed to rely on this feeling and walk up step by step, understanding the solidified rules of the Dao Star Step by step.
Walk up, huh... Wang Baole closed his eyes and felt the waves of power of rules emanating from the Dao Star in his body. Under the watchful eyes of the crowd outside, he slowly opened his eyes. He was already standing in the low altitude, as his eyes gained enlightenment, he took a step towards the heavens!
This was the first step.
The instant his foot landed, the shadow of a star appeared beneath Wang Baole’s feet!
...
The red color of the star seemed to have been dyed with fresh blood. From Afar, it didn’t look like a star, but more like a blood ball. As it appeared, a thick stench of blood spread out in all directions. If one were to take a closer look.., one could even see a red halo spreading out around the blood-colored planet!
“One of the nine planets, the Dao of the red blood!”Wang Baole muttered. Blood Qi spread out from his body instantly. This planet was one of the ancient planets. It contained the solidified law, and it used blood as the Dao. It was extremely evil!
As he spoke, the blood light on his body intensified. Wang baole instantly understood the law completely. It was branded into his mind and soul, causing blood to appear in his clone’s body, his entire aura and cultivation erupted at that moment!
“Two of the nine stars, the Dao of joy of the Orange!”Wang Baole’s eyes shone with a strange light. He took another step towards the sky, and the second star under his feet materialized. It shone with a bright orange glow. It was so bright that it sounded like an immortal’s voice was coming from within his body, it spread in all directions, falling into nothingness, into the heavens and earth, and into the minds of every living being in the area.
It was as if the heavens and earth were making a sound, as if all living things were humming. This was the second solidified law of the Dao Star, the Dao of Joy!
An orange ring of light materialized outside the star. As it reflected the Crimson Ring of light, Wang Baole’s aura and cultivation erupted once again, forming a shocking ripple. Judging from his aura, it was several times higher than before!
It wasn’t over yet. As his cultivation erupted and Rose, Wang Baole took his third and fourth steps towards the sky.
“Nine stars, three, Yellow Flame Dao”
“Nine stars, four, Green Plant Dao”
His figure rose higher and higher. It was no longer low in the sky, but close to high in the sky. As his feet landed, the third and fourth stars materialized, along with the yellow and green rings of light, they also spread out in all directions.
His aura rose once again, affecting the heavens and spreading across the land. The powerful ripples were ten times stronger than before. The Fire Dao technique, which was a fire dao technique, was now burning within the halos, causing the entire world to heat up, the Plant Dao technique was even stronger, causing the tens of thousands of flowers around Wang Baole, who was in the sky, to appear and Bloom!
This scene shocked everyone who saw it. Wang Baole took his fifth, sixth, and seventh steps... he stepped into the sky and stood among the stars. His voice also rang out at that moment, five, six, and seven stars appeared beneath his feet and spread in all directions.
“Five of the nine stars, the Blue Cloud Dao!”
.
“Six of the nine stars, the Blue Wind Dao!”
“Seven of the nine stars, the Purple Dao Devouring Dao!”
The Cloud Dao had many variations. It was the main illusion technique, the fog body. As soon as this dao appeared, Wang Baole immediately felt a vague sensation. As he gained enlightenment, the intent of the clouds appeared in his eyes. From then on.., unless a dao star with only one rule, the Cloud Dao, appeared, if he were to become the king among the Cloud Dao planet-level cultivators, who would dare be the King!
The dao of wind, on the other hand, had a formless sense of speed. The appearance of this dao caused the storms around Wang Baole to rumble. The increase in speed was self-evident. When combined with the dao of clouds, the speed could reach a terrifying level!
The Final Dao was the Purple Devouring Dao!
This Dao focused on devouring. Everything in the universe, everything in the universe, could be devoured. As it appeared, Wang Baole’s body instantly gave off the feeling of a whirlpool. The whirlpool had no end and seemed capable of devouring everything!
Wang Baole could imagine that when the Dao of devouring worked together with his devouring seed, its power would reach an earth-shattering level. He couldn’t help but Ponder in his heart! The devouring seed... could it have once been a dao star!
It wasn’t the time to ponder. The thought flashed through Wang Baole’s mind, but he suppressed it. What followed was the crazy increase in his cultivation and aura. As it rose, his hair flew in the wind, his clothes fluttered in the wind. His combat strength had increased by tens of times when he hadn’t been to the fallen star, and it was still increasing exponentially!
His figure was now high in the sky, accompanied by the stars. As they shone, Wang Baole took his eighth step!
“The eight of the nine stars, White as the Dao of light!”
The eighth star shone with a dazzling white light. It appeared with a loud bang. As it materialized and the halo spread, the blinding light surpassed everything else. That was because... light was the Dao!
Wang Baole looked up. The white light in the sky was like an ocean. As it rippled, Wang Baole’s aura rose once again. He was like a celestial being. Amidst the boundless aura, he took a ninth step, approaching the end of the sky!
“Nine of the nine stars. Black is the Dao of Death!”
The Dao of death was the Dao of death. It looked the same as the dark sect, but it was completely different. The latter was more like reincarnation, while the former... only represented death!
As he appeared, Wang Baole’s body trembled. His pupils were pitch-black as well. He exuded an endless aura of death, and the ripples of his cultivation surged to the maximum in that instant, causing the heavens to tremble, the earth rumbled. Wang Baole, who was at the end of the heavens, had a look of understanding in his eyes.
“In the future, I will use the nine stars’laws to create nine divine abilities that belong to me!”As he mumbled, Wang Baole lowered his head to look at the ground. Then, he raised his head again and looked into the sky. After a long while, the nine halos beneath his feet shone, everyone was shocked. As the nine stars buzzed, Wang Baole walked towards the end of the sky..
The tenth step!
The tenth step, ascending to the heavens!
As he landed, the nine stars trembled violently. They rose into the sky and merged into Wang Baole’s body. Within his body, they gathered into the nine-colored dao stars!
The nine halos neared him in an instant. They branded the mark between his brows and turned into the mark of the nine rings!
His cultivation erupted at that moment, instantly pushing his aura to rise wildly. The sound of the mirror shattering reverberated in Wang Baole’s ears, and his cultivation... broke through!
He stepped into... The planetary grade!
The world seemed to have changed in his eyes!
The Sky, the Earth, the wind, the clouds, and all living things... seemed to have their veils lifted, revealing their true nature. As he stared at all of this, Wang Baole finally understood what the only law that had been born, was!
“What an overbearing law!”Wang Baole muttered. He raised his right hand and flipped it, and a Cloud of mist appeared out of thin air. When it appeared in his hand, the cloud of mist rapidly transformed into a piece of paper!
With the approval of all the mighty figures and even the supremacies from the outer realms, the only law of a dao planet naturally couldn’t be paper. Wang Baole looked at the paper cloud in his hand and watched it transform back into a cloud of mist with his will. He smiled, the light in his eyes grew brighter. He murmured softly in a voice that only he could hear.
The art of engraving... it can engrave tens of thousands of Dao in the universe. With the support of the Dao Star, even if the person being engraved is the only rule of the Dao Star, he or she will not be spared. Once I succeed in engraving, it will be difficult to determine who is stronger

chapters.title: Chapter 971 - , the Starfall List!
chapters.content:
Chapter 971:, the Starfall List!
?
Nine ancient stars combined into one to form a dao star that contained a total of ten laws!
Nine of them were the original laws of the nine ancient stars. Now that they had been solidified, and with the support of the grade of the Dao Star, the grade of the nine laws had reached its peak before the corresponding dao star appeared, and even if a corresponding dao star did appear, its resistance would be quite high.
The nine laws were... The Red Blood Dao, the Orange Joy Dao, the Yellow Flame Dao, the Green Plant Dao, the Green Cloud Dao, the Blue Wind Dao, and the Purple Devouring Dao!
As for black and white, Black was the Dao of death, and White was the Dao of light!
Other than that, the Dao Star had a unique law that was above all laws. This law... was the Dao of engraving!
As Wang Baole understood the meaning of engraving, he knew very clearly that this unique law could engrave all the Myriad Dao in the world and the Infinite Dao in the universe into its own.
It was as if the Dao gave birth to one, and all living things were born. As long as the Dao of laws and laws appeared in front of him, they would be engrave. However, it was not a 100% probability. Based on the level of the other party’s laws and laws, there was a possibility of failure, however, the terrifying thing was that there was no limit to it!
That means... even if I encounter a law that can not be imprinted successfully in one go, as long as I have enough time, I can imprint it again and again. That way... I can succeed in the end! Thoughts surfaced in Wang Baole’s mind, his mind was filled with excitement. There was no doubt that his gains this time were beyond his imagination.
He had made a grand vow and gained the approval of the Almighty. He had condensed nine ancient stars and attained the Dao realm under his own witness. He wasn’t the only one who had obtained the dao star among the outsiders this time. There was also the bell lady who hadn’t been on good terms with him, however, the latter’s dao star was far inferior to Wang Baole’s dao star in terms of both the grade and the laws.
The laws on the paper were also imprinted on Wang Baole’s Dao Star. More importantly... The Bell Maiden was willing to take a secondary position in order to obtain the Dao Star. She made her dao star the primary one, and her future cultivation seemed to be smooth sailing, however, in the end, she had lost the right to decide for herself.
Wang Baole was different. The fusion and advancement of the nine ancient planets had been accomplished under his Grand Dao Oath. Therefore, Wang Baole was basically the eternal lord between the two parties!
...
The difference between him and the bell maiden was obvious!
As these thoughts surfaced in Wang Baole’s mind, he slowly closed his eyes. Although his cultivation had broken through to the planet level, there was still one final step left, and that was to accumulate breath!
The so-called accumulation of breath meant that all the essence, Qi, and spirit in one’s body had been restrained. They had been completely absorbed into one’s body, establishing a myriad of connections with the stars in one’s body, allowing them to adapt to the process of one’s body.
During this process, even though Wang Baole was a dao star, he was no exception. As his eyes closed, his body, which was high up in the sky, became blurry. The dao stars around his body materialized and filled his body. Finally, in the eyes of everyone on the ground.., wang Baole’s figure had already disappeared. What replaced it was an extremely bright and dazzling star!
At the same time, all the cultivators on the ground who had witnessed everything fell silent. All sorts of thoughts surfaced in their hearts. There was envy, emotion, unwillingness, and desire.
Amidst all these thoughts, the Dao star that had chosen the bell lady trembled a few times within her body before it erupted with Starlight. For the first time, there was no arrogance within the Starlight. Instead, it was the same as the nine ancient stars, containing a strong unwillingness, as its light shining, the stars will be unconscious bell woman covered, roll this woman straight to the stars.
Over there, at the opposite end of Wang Baole’s sphere of influence, under the guidance of the Dao Star, a breakthrough in the cultivation of the bell maiden began. Just as the thought of the breakthrough dissipated, suddenly, the emperor of the fallen stars, who was standing outside the Grand Hall.., he spoke.
“Please remember... The agreement between you and the land of the fallen star. Back then, we acknowledged your ascension to the Dao Star and your only law. You have to fulfill the agreement. We can use your law eternally, and it can not be interfered with. We will not invade each other!”
The starlight on the bell maiden’s body shone brightly as if she was acknowledging the agreement. Then, the aura of a breakthrough spread from the Bell Maiden’s body.
Clearly, the method of a dao star breakthrough was different. At that moment, the bell lady’s body began to turn into paper within the Starlight. As for the exact process, no one could see it clearly. Everything about her.., was completely covered by the Starlight.
At the same time, the scholarly cultivator and the black-robed young man looked up silently into the starry sky. They stared at the two dao stars. After a long moment... the scholarly cultivator sighed softly. Having recovered some of his cultivation base, he stood up, in the galaxy that filled the sky, he chose a special high-grade planet and began his breakthrough.
The black-robed young man did the same. He also chose a high-grade planet as his own. Although his heart was filled with regret, he knew that he had already done his best.
At that moment, the ten of them who were qualified to strike the heavenly drum had all chosen, except for the little girl. However, after some thought, the little girl still gave up on this opportunity.
As the people from the meteorite empire looked up, nine stars in the sky were rapidly accumulating their breath. The will of the meteorite land also arrived. It seemed to have transformed into a gentle wind that blew past the nine stars, it sped up the accumulation of their breath, and at the same time, it gave blessings from the meteorite land.
It wasn’t out of goodwill toward Wang Baole. It was because every time the meteorite land opened, all those who had obtained the stars would receive a good fortune.
With this serendipity, their fusion would be even more perfect, and it would be even safer!
Amongst the nine people, the meteorite empire’s ceremony of offering sacrifices to the heavens was coming to an end. As the grand ceremony was about to come to an end, the meteorite emperor, who stood in front of the grand hall, sighed with emotion.
It was clear that this ceremony of offering sacrifices to the heavens could be said to be the largest and most tumultuous event in the entire meteorite empire in countless years. He could even imagine that something like this wouldn’t happen in the future.
On one hand, the crisis in the Starfall lands had already been resolved. There was no need for outsiders to come in and use the heaven-connecting drum to suppress the Black Qi. However, due to the agreement with the Wei Yang Dao Domain, although it would still be activated, it wouldn’t happen so frequently.
On the other hand... there was probably no one else who could make the same grand vow that Xie Dalu had made that would be acknowledged by many major powers and even paragons from the other realms.
The Falling Star Emperor was filled with emotion at the thought of this. However, there was one more thing that had to be done after the fortunes in the land of the fallen star had ended. This was also part of the agreement between the Weiyang Dao Domain and the land of the fallen star, this time was no exception.
That Was... to announce the list of fortunes to all the powers in the entire Weiyang Dao domain who were qualified to obtain them!
If Wang Baole had any consciousness at that moment, he would have definitely chosen to stop or request to hide himself. However, he was still in the midst of his cultivation, so he didn’t know that, after the time it takes for an incense stick to burn.., a real list containing the fate of the Starfall Empire and the will of the Starfall lands was transmitted from the Starfall lands. It spread out like ripples in an instant, covering an endless area, causing the entire Weiyang DAO domain.., all the powers that were paying attention to this place instantly obtained it!
On this list, Wang Baole’s name was listed at the Top!
The name that appeared was not Xie Dalu, but his real name. This was because under the rules of the Starfall, nothing could be hidden. When every living being was promoted to a planet, their real name would be similar to the real name of the Universe True Spirit, it would be imprinted in the laws of the universe.
Therefore, the appearance of Wang Baole’s name immediately attracted the attention of the powerful cultivators from the various powerful factions in the Weiyang Dao Domain. After his name was written the words Dao star. This caused a storm, it immediately caused a huge commotion.
There was also a dao star after the bell lady’s name. The intensity of the storm was even greater. After the nine of them had their own stars, they also marked the place of origin. For example, after Wang Baole’s Dao Star.., they marked the God’s eye civilization!
This meant that he had obtained the right to enter this place with the quota for the God’s eye civilization!
In the blink of an eye, as the various political forces and mighty figures were shaken, the God’s eye civilization was also given intense attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 972 - was famous everywhere!
chapters.content:
Chapter 972: was famous everywhere!
Before this, although the divine eye civilization had a spot in the fallen star land, not many people knew about it. One reason was that the divine eye civilization had not used this spot for a long time.
After all, for many years, the divine eye royal family had never had a perfect-stage spiritual immortal royal cultivator. Therefore, this spot was more of a trump card and a bargaining chip.
There was another reason why outsiders did not know that the divine eye civilization had a spot. According to the agreement in the fallen star land, only those who were finally qualified to ring the heavenly drum could be listed on the list, from the moment the divine eye civilization obtained the spot, although at its peak ten thousand years ago, there were one or two clansmen who entered the fallen star land, but they did not have the final qualification.
Their civilization couldn’t be listed on the rankings, so naturally, it wouldn’t be known by outsiders. Even the purple-gold civilization had managed to find out about the situation by chance, which was why they had cooperated with the divine eye royal family previously.
However, with Wang Baole’s rise, the divine eye civilization was also known by many powerful factions. As they investigated and learned that the civilization was extremely weak, they became even more concerned about Wang Baole.
“Wang Baole? I’ve never heard of that name before...”
“There are too many civilizations in the Weiyang Dao Domain. The divine eye civilization is just an insignificant civilization, yet such an unprecedented prodigy has appeared in it!”
“Obtaining a dao star... This incident in the fallen star lands is too big. Throughout history, only the legendary Weiyang Zi has obtained a dao star. However, two of them have appeared this time!”
“And that Xu Yinling from the nine Phoenix sect has also obtained a Dao Star!”
“Forget about Xu Yinling. The nine Phoenix sect is not to be trifled with. However, this nameless Wang Baole... I’m afraid it will be difficult to keep the dao star on him!”
“Even if he advances to a planet and is completely integrated with the Dao Star, there are too many ways in this world to transfer the Dao Star... all he has to do is to make him volunteer!”
...
After the shock, greed quickly rose within the many factions. Without a doubt, Wang Baole’s background was insignificant in their eyes. be it the factions or his own strength.., it was as if he was committing a crime by possessing a treasure. It wasn’t enough to protect his own dao planet forever.
In their eyes, it was basically a benefit. As long as they could find him and get him to volunteer, they would be able to obtain his dao planet. That way, the elites of the various factions.., even the cultivators who were already on the planet were tempted.
In reality, it wasn’t that the Emperor of the fallen stars hadn’t considered this. However, the disparity in information meant that it didn’t care about this matter at all. Deep in its heart, Wang Baole’s background was so great that it could be said to be shocking, he was someone who had the protection of the supremacies from the outer realm. Therefore, it didn’t think that the spread of this matter would cause trouble for Wang Baole.
Therefore, Wang Baole, who was still resting, didn’t know that his real name had been exposed. He also didn’t know that because of the Dao planet, he had been targeted by many factions.
At the same time, the outside world was in an uproar. Everyone was shocked by the ranking list from the fallen star lands. Those who knew Wang Baole were also shocked.
Xie Haiyang was one of them. He had already thought of how to convince the blazing flame ancestor to help him and get the help of that noble. He was making preparations, the Xie family sent over the list of names from the fallen star lands. Xie Haiyang was stunned when he saw Wang Baole, who was ranked first on the list.
When he saw the dao star behind Wang Baole’s name, he nearly jumped up. Disbelief appeared on his face, and he cried out in shock.
What’s going on? Dao Star! Xie Haiyang’s heart was in turmoil, his breathing was extremely rapid. His mind was buzzing. His first reaction to the list he had seen was disbelief. However, after seeing the mark of the God’s eye civilization, Xie Haiyang had no choice but to accept this fact, he had no choice but to accept it.
That Long Nanzi is indeed Wang Baole. That Fatty... He’s too fierce
While Xie Haiyang was shocked, there was another person who was also feeling uneasy. That person was the blazing flame ancestor. With his cultivation, he was naturally qualified to receive the list. Even though he had gained some knowledge of the matter due to the recognition he had received previously.., however, after seeing it for himself, his heart was still unsettled.
I’m definitely going to take this disciple in! As his emotions fluctuated, the blazing flame ancestor’s eyes shone brightly. He felt that if he could receive Wang Baole’s legacy in the future, he would have no regrets in this life!
Chen Qingzi was also aware of the matter. Even though he was within the array formation created by the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao, his strength and his connection with Wang Baole’s acceptance of Wang Baole’s grand vow.., he immediately sensed the news that had spread from the fallen star to the entire Weiyang Dao Domain.
Chen Qingzi’s body swayed as he let out a long laugh. The slaughter began again. He didn’t plan to delay any longer. He wanted to end the battle as quickly as possible. He knew very well that the moment the ranking list was released, it represented his little junior brother, he was afraid that he would be at the center of a storm after a period of time!
At that moment, he needed someone powerful to protect him. Only then would he be able to dispel the countless evil thoughts and allow him to continue growing.
Chen Qingzi’s judgment was correct. However, as he was inside the array formation, he didn’t have a complete understanding of the outside world. Therefore, he didn’t know that those who harbored evil thoughts towards Wang Baole didn’t appear after a period of time. They had already appeared!
That was the purple gold civilization!
The moment they learned of the ranking list, the purple gold civilization was in an uproar. Through the divine eye civilization that was marked on the ranking list, they immediately analyzed Wang Baole’s name. That was long Nanzi’s real name!
They even discovered that the other party was most likely not a cultivator from the divine eye civilization, but an outsider!
As a result, they were already filled with anger over the fact that their dao child had been captured alive and that their spots had been taken away. Now that Wang Baole had actually obtained a dao star, the various thoughts in their hearts caused the purple gold civilization’s killing intent to erupt.
Amidst the eruption, the anger from the purple gold civilization spread rapidly as a series of arrangements were made. At the same time, in the fallen star lands, in the presence of Wang Baole and the others.., the prodigies who didn’t have the right to strike the heaven-reaching drum didn’t gain nothing either. Instead, in the days that followed, they exchanged with the fallen star lands at some cost and obtained what they needed.
This was the usual practice after the fallen star lands was opened. As the promotions continued, half a month passed slowly. During that time, more and more people chose to leave. It was different from when they came. They didn’t need to leave together, the ships in the fallen star lands would arrange for them to go out every day and send them back to where they had boarded the ships.
During that half a month, more than half of the elites had left. The masked woman’s cultivation had also ended. After she woke up, she raised her head and stared at the planet where Wang Baole was in the sky. Her eyes were filled with reminiscence and blessings. Then, she sighed softly, she chose to leave.
The scholarly cultivator, the black-robed youth, the little girl, the Little Fatty, and the others all looked at Wang Baole, who was still in his cultivation. They all chose to leave.
