The first two of them had complicated thoughts. The little fatty was filled with helplessness and jealousy. As for the little girl, her eyes shone brightly. No one knew what she was thinking. She took a deep look at Wang Baole’s planet and left the fallen star.
They knew very well that the longer one remained in the breath realm, the more powerful one would become after awakening. It was clear that Wang Baole would be the one to stay the longest this time.
As for the bell lady, Xu Yinling, she ended her breath realm three days before Wang Baole woke up. She swept her murderous gaze across Wang Baole’s planet, snorted coldly, and left as well.
Three days later, Wang Baole woke up and became the last person left in the fallen star. When he woke up, he felt that his cultivation had been completely stabilized, and his cultivation was so strong that it made his heart skip a beat, in his excitement, he found out about the ranking list. This made him dumbfounded and helpless.
However, he knew that even without the ranking board, the elites would eventually be exposed once they left. However, the matter still weighed heavily on his mind, and the pressure on his heart grew.
Who cares? I have a background too! Wang baole gritted his teeth as he felt troubled. He encouraged himself and bade farewell to the meteorite emperor.
However, before he left, he made a trip to the shops in meteorite city that sold dharmic treasures and cultivation techniques and divine abilities. This time... under the rules of the paper inscriptions on his dao star, Wang Baole realized that the cultivation techniques and paper slips were no different from Jade slips in his eyes, they were no longer any different from Jade slips. He could clearly see everything inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 973 - There were two more in chapter 973?
chapters.content:
Chapter 973: There were two more in chapter 973?
The shop owners in the shops were also familiar with Wang Baole. They were very respectful and courteous when they saw him. Even the old paper man who had once duped him was extremely enthusiastic when he saw Wang Baole.
Therefore, after buying some items in the shops, Wang Baole made another trip to the Black Paper Sea. He did not enter. Instead, he stood by the shore and looked at the sea that was gradually turning from gray to white. He bowed deeply before choosing to leave!
He knew that it was already too late for him to wake up. He couldn’t stay here for too long. The later he left, the greater the danger. In reality, it had taken him less than two hours to wake up and leave.
It could be said that he had left very quickly.
As for his departure, it was obvious that he had received special treatment. That was because the ship that the Starfall Empire had arranged for Wang Baole to leave was the Starfall ship that had brought him here. The person who had rowed the ship was the same paper figurine.
The paper figurine looked at Wang Baole with a gentler and more emotional gaze. It was as if it was looking at a junior. After Wang Baole had greeted and boarded the ship, the paper paddle swayed, the cultivators of the entire Starfall Empire raised their heads and watched. Wang Baole stood on the ship and bowed to the ground.
“Thank you, seniors. We... shall meet again if we are fated!”
On the ground, in the imperial palace, the Starfall Emperor smiled and nodded. On the Black Paper Sea, the Starfall ancestor rose slowly. He stood on the surface of the sea and stared at the ship Wang Baole was on. He watched as the ship moved further and further away, about to leave, he suddenly spoke.
“Kid, you have to pay attention to that bottle of yours. That bottle contains two extraordinary obsessions that can change the user’s thoughts. It can make the user more greedy for resources, but at the same time, it also has a strong desire for longevity. Based on my experience, the owner of these two obsessions isn’t weak at all... the supreme cultivator of destiny from the outer realm that you summoned with your scripture!”
The moment the Starfall ship under Wang Baole’s feet traversed through the void where the Starfall land was, the words of the paper man on the Black Paper Sea appeared in his mind. Wang Baole’s eyes widened at those words, his body trembled involuntarily. He subconsciously turned his head to look outside the ship, but what he saw was no longer the land of the Starfall, but a white, paper-like starry sky.
Before he could see it clearly, the paper-like starry sky quickly folded in half. It was the same as when he had arrived. After the starry sky was folded in half, the ship was covered within, until everything disappeared without a trace.
...
Then, in a starry sky in the Weiyang Dao Domain, the meteorite ship materialized silently. Wang Baole, who was on the ship, trembled. He regained his consciousness from his earlier daze and looked at the starry sky around him, he knew that he had left the meteorite land and returned to the never-ending DAO domain.
As he looked around him, the words that the Black Paper Sea paper figurine had said before he left echoed in his mind. He thought that it was unlikely that the other party would lie to him. His parting words were filled with good intentions and reminders, wang Baole couldn’t help but feel his heart skip a beat.
One supreme-being is one thing, but why are there two more... I knew that the bottle was strange. Otherwise, how could an upright person like me be so greedy in the meteorite land! Wang Baole was conflicted, on one hand, he felt that it wouldn’t be good to keep the bottle by his side. On the other hand, it was a supreme treasure after all. It was impossible to throw it away.
As he was conflicted, Wang Baole soon felt the difference between himself and what he had been in the past when he returned to the Wei Yang Dao Domain. There was an invisible aura in the starry sky, it was gathering in his body from all directions. As it was being absorbed, it was gathering in his body into the Dao Star.
This state of constantly cultivating wasn’t unique to Wang Baole. It was something that every planet-level cultivator possessed. It was also one of their strengths. They could use the stars in their bodies to merge with the starry skies, as they merged into one, they could also absorb the so-called immortal Qi in the starry skies!
However, the amount of immortal Qi that was gathering in Wang Baole’s body was immense. In the blink of an eye, it gathered into a huge vortex around him. Even more immortal Qi was gathering, the vortex was visibly expanding.
If other planetary-grade cultivators who didn’t know about Wang Baole saw this scene, they would definitely be shocked and their hearts would be in turmoil. Wang Baole’s vortex was simply too shocking. One could imagine how terrifying it would be if it wasn’t controlled, it would probably expand to a terrifying extent.
If one were to immerse themselves in cultivation in a civilized galaxy, it would be possible for the energy immortal Qi in the entire galaxy to be sucked dry for a short period of time. This would cause great harm to all life in the galaxy, including the stars, it would be a huge blow to all life in the galaxy.
Most planet-level cultivators wouldn’t be able to do this. At most, they would only be able to reach a small portion of the energy immortal Qi that Wang Baole had yet to fully unleash. From this, one could see how terrifying and domineering the Dao stars were.
Even Wang Baole himself was shocked. He knew that he had to keep a low profile, so he immediately stopped it forcefully. Only then did the vortex around him slowly dissipate. Only when it completely disappeared did he heave a sigh of relief.
I have to be careful when I cultivate in the future... Wang Baole rubbed the space between his brows. He had just advanced to a planet. Even though his body had adapted to it, his mental state hadn’t completely changed. For example, this was the case with cultivation, planet cultivation was completely different from that of a spirit immortal. If one did not control it, it was likely that people would notice it even if it was very far away.
After all... the ripples it created were different.
Especially now that I am most likely the target of public criticism... The Purple Gold civilization is eyeing me like a tiger watching its prey and will definitely take action against me... at the thought of this, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and swept his gaze across the storage bag, the dao child of the purple gold civilization, who had been sealed by him, pondered for a moment before looking at the paper figurine that was rowing the boat. He cupped his fists and bowed.
“Senior, can you send me to my designated location?”
Generally speaking, the rowers of the meteorite cruiser wouldn’t pay any attention to the cultivators from the outer realm. They would follow the instructions of the meteorite empire and send the person to the place where they boarded the boat. Their itinerary wouldn’t change during that period of time.
However, it was clear that both the paper figurine and the instructions of the meteorite empire had special treatment for Wang Baole. Therefore, after the paper figurine heard Wang Baole’s words, it turned around and looked at him, there was a questioning look in its eyes.
Wang Baole’s heart jolted when he saw this. He immediately sent over a set of coordinates. That set of coordinates was where he had arranged for Zhao Yameng, the donkey, and Xiaowu to go before he went to the meteorite cruiser.
According to Wang Baole’s plan, he would first pick up the people and then control his main body to wake up. Even if the divine eye civilization had set up an inescapable net to catch them off guard.., his main body would be able to use his authority over the Divine Eye Planet to teleport back to the Solar System.
He would also be able to teleport back to the Solar System and merge with his main body through the connection with the Divine Eye Planet once he was close to the divine eye civilization.
The main focus of this matter was the teleportation of the divine eye star. However, considering that the purple gold civilization might seal the star, Wang Baole still had a backup plan. However, all of these plans had a prerequisite, which was to pick up Zhao Yameng and the others, that way, he could advance and retreat. He wasn’t worried that if he chose to flee, he would lose contact with Zhao Yameng and the others. If they stayed here, they would be safe for a short period of time. If they stayed any longer, they might be in danger.
If I had known earlier that the meteorite party wouldn’t be in any danger, I would have just brought them along. Wang Baole shook his head. As he informed them of the coordinates, the meteorite ship immediately changed directions under the paper figurine’s rowing boat, it moved forward at high speed. Due to its unique materials and laws, not only was it fast, it was also rarely seen by anyone. Therefore, the journey was smooth and unimpeded.
Soon, they arrived near the ordinary planet that Wang Baole had arranged for Zhao Yameng and the others to be on. No one would pay attention to them. As soon as they arrived, Wang Baole spread out his divine perception, his expression changed abruptly in the next instant!
The planet was empty. There were traces of the ripples of the divine ability, but there were no signs of Zhao Yameng, the donkey, or Little Five. If that was all there were to it, it would have been fine. However, the traces of the ripples of the divine ability.., after Wang Baole scanned the planet with his divine sense, a dark and vicious voice echoed clearly in his mind!
“Long Nanzi, I’ll be waiting for you in the Divine Eye Civilization!”

chapters.title: Chapter 974 - was ready for battle!
chapters.content:
Chapter 974: was ready for battle!
?
Wang Baole sensed the voice that emerged in his mind from the remaining divine arts and spells on the planet. He clenched his right hand tightly in silence. His expression darkened. He stood on the ship and didn’t say a word, however, the icy aura emanating from his body seemed to be able to affect the starry skies in all directions, causing the starry skies outside the ship to show signs of being frozen.
Even though it was impossible for his emotions to affect the void, Wang Baole’s anger still caused ripples in the surroundings. The dao stars within his body began to spin rapidly after sensing Wang Baole’s emotions.
The Shadows of nine illusory ancient stars gradually appeared around Wang Baole. The rules within them began to change as well, forming nine colors. As they changed rapidly, a terrifying suppressive force spread out from Wang Baole’s body, it also spread out naturally from Wang Baole’s body.
Booming sounds reverberated in the surroundings. A vortex gathered from all directions, and the force of the vortex grew stronger and stronger. After a long while, Wang Baole saw that the vortex was growing larger and larger around the Starfall ship, it seemed to have turned into a huge mouth that could swallow the stars before it. Wang Baole closed his eyes.
I’ve done the wrong thing... Wang Baole mumbled. He felt that he had been overly cautious earlier. He shouldn’t have left Zhao yameng, the donkey, and Xiaowu here.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been so passive and put them in a life-and-death situation.
The purple gold civilization... Wang Baole suddenly opened his eyes, and a look of determination appeared in them. At this point in time, he couldn’t possibly leave on his own for safety. This wasn’t in line with his personality, it was also not in line with the killing intent that he could no longer suppress.
Ever since he had arrived at the divine eye civilization, his cultivation seemed to have gone smoothly. However, in reality, there were many twists and turns. Now that he had entered the planet, Wang Baole had no intention of suppressing his killing intent. As his gaze turned colder and colder.., wang Baole remained silent for the time it takes for half an incense stick to burn. Then, he cupped his fists and bowed to the paper figurine on the Starfall ship.
“Senior, please send me back... to the place where the God’s eye civilization boarded the ship!”
The paper figurine gave Wang Baole a deep look. It didn’t row the oars immediately. Instead, it spoke the first words it had spoken on the way back.
“Due to the agreement and the rules, I can not leave the ship, nor can I initiate a conflict. However, as long as you stand inside the ship, I can guarantee your safety and send you to wherever you want to Go!”
...
Wang Baole was grateful when he heard that. He bowed deeply towards the paper figurine once again.
“Senior, there’s no need for you to make a move. I have my own ways to deal with it!”
The paper figurine on the meteorite ship nodded and didn’t continue speaking. Instead, he waved the paper oar in his hand. Instantly, the meteorite ship silently disappeared into the starry skies and sped towards the location of the God’s eye civilization.
As it moved forward, the starry skies seemed to turn into flowing river water in Wang Baole’s eyes. It was blurry at first glance, but if one were to pay close attention, one would see that it was because the ship was moving at a speed that exceeded one’s imagination, it caused everything in the surroundings to seem to move, forming the image of flowing water.
Wang Baole’s mind was extremely calm as he looked at all of this. Only the coldness and killing intent in his heart grew stronger as the ship moved forward. He felt that after arriving at the God’s eye civilization, he had occasionally been high-profile, however, overall, he was still a little low-key.
Whatever. In the end... It’s because I have too many concerns. There are clearly other paths, so why do I have to do this? Wang Baole raised his head in silence and looked in a certain direction in the starry sky.
As he looked from afar, the speed of the Starfall ship grew faster and faster. At this speed, it wouldn’t take long to reach the God’s eye civilization from here. It would only take an hour... as the Starfall ship slowed down.., the divine eye civilization appeared in front of him!
Wang Baole didn’t look at the divine eye civilization immediately. He continued to look in the direction of the starry sky. No one knew what he was looking at but himself.
That was because, in his memories from the Dark Dream, the dark sect was where his master was!
After a long while, Wang Baole seemed to have made up his mind. He knelt down in that direction and bowed silently.
Then, he stood up. Killing intent flashed in his eyes. The paper figurine on the Starfall ship sensed Wang Baole’s thoughts. The paper oars swayed, and the ship roared. It moved forward once again, passing through the barrier outside the civilization. It moved like a flash.., it appeared right where Wang Baole had boarded the ship!
As soon as it appeared, an earth-shattering aura emanated from within the divine eye civilization. It swept across the area, and a sealing technique descended. It enveloped the entire divine eye civilization, and at the same time, at the periphery of the divine eye civilization.., at this moment, huge crystal chips filled with runes instantly appeared from nothingness.
Each crystal chip was the size of a planet. The number of such huge crystal chips was almost uncountable. At this moment, after they all appeared, they were actually connected to each other in an instant, from Afar, if one could stand at a height that overlooked the entire God eye civilization, then one could clearly see that these crystal chips were like walls, actually enveloping the entire god eye civilization.., they were completely enveloped within.
It was as if the God’s eye civilization... had turned into a giant crystal ball the size of a galaxy!
At the instant the Crystal Ball was formed, all the artificial stars in the conquered civilizations of the purple gold civilization, which were very far away from this place, shone at this moment, under the control of the purple gold civilization’s progenitor, he used a special method to gather all the power of the stars and transmit it to the giant crystal that enveloped the God’s eye civilization!
The crystal instantly shone with a blinding light, as if it had transformed into a giant star. It isolated all the auras within it, as well as all external senses.
Such a setup was naturally for Wang Baole’s Dao Star. The purple gold civilization was obviously confident. With such a setup, not only would wang Baole be unable to escape, even if someone wanted to figure out Wang Baole’s location.., they wouldn’t be able to do so in a short period of time.
This gave them time and opportunity!
Therefore, it wasn’t just the external seal. It was the same within the God’s eye civilization. The instant Wang Baole appeared, and the instant the external crystal chip materialized and enveloped the ship, the ripples in the starry sky spread out, the figures of cultivators appeared one after another!
The number of cultivators in the area reached a shocking level. There was an army of nearly a million soldiers at the periphery. They surrounded the area layer by layer. It was the same in both directions.
At the same time, the aura of planets continued to erupt in front of the Starfall ship. Other than the Sky Palm Grandmaster, the new Dao Grandmaster, and the Purple Gold Civilization’s Sky Spirit Sect’s sect master, there were three other planets, six male and female cultivators with planet presences surrounded them.
A total of nine planets were staring coldly at the Starfall ship and at Wang Baole, who was on the ship!
There was another middle-aged man in front of the nine people. His aura was overwhelming. It was as if he alone could suppress all directions and form endless ripples. He was the purple gold civilization’s star Grandmaster, he was also the one who had stopped Wang Baole from boarding the ship!
He wasn’t the only star in the area. Behind Wang Baole, the air distorted as another figure walked out. He was dressed in a black robe and was an old man. As he walked out, the surrounding heat erupted, the power of the stars was completely revealed.
“Nine planets, two stars!”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He saw a giant bubble floating outside the enemy’s encirclement. The runes on the bubble shone, but it was translucent, wang Baole could see Zhao yameng, the donkey, and Xiaowu, who were unconscious, within the bubble!
Wang baole stared at the bubble. He didn’t care if others noticed him. A planet appeared behind him. The color of the planet was green. It was the fifth ancient planet, the Dao of green clouds!
Clouds were impermanent and had endless variations. It could be called one of the illusory techniques. With the support of the Dao Of Cloud, Wang Baole could see through everything within the bubble. It wasn’t an illusory technique, but something real. Zhao yameng, the donkey, and Xiaowu.., they were weak, but their lives weren’t in danger.
Wang baole finally heaved a sigh of relief. In reality, this was within his estimation. After all, the purple gold civilization had gone to such great lengths to bring him here. As a bargaining chip, Zhao Yameng and the others.., there wouldn’t be a matter of life and death in the short term.
At that moment, just as Wang Baole realized that Zhao Yameng and the others were fine and was relieved, the middle-aged stellar mighty figure in front of him shouted in a low voice, a cold glint flashing in his eyes.
“Long Nanzi!”

chapters.title: Chapter 975 - have you ever heard of it?
chapters.content:
Chapter 975:, have you ever heard of it?
The voice was like Heavenly Thunder. The moment it was heard, it seemed to affect the rules of the starry skies. It was as if the words were followed by the law, causing ripples to form in the entire divine eye civilization’s starry skies. It was so powerful that it formed countless real Thunderbolts, it appeared out of thin air in all directions!
It even affected the divine eye civilization’s star, causing the star eye to shine a few times. Unfortunately, as it shone, countless runes appeared on the surface of the star eye. As if they were suppressing it, they actually suppressed the divine eye civilization’s star eye.., instantly.
They were unable to form a connection with Wang Baole, which meant that Wang Baole couldn’t use the eye of the star to teleport. At the same time, there were countless crystal shards surrounding the divine eye civilization. It could be said that the purple gold civilization had made this place.., it was like an impregnable fortress. Ordinary people wouldn’t be able to step in, nor would they be able to leave!
Only the mighty figures of the Galaxy region would be able to ignore this arrangement. However, the purple gold civilization knew very well that the powerful factions that were coveting Wang Baole’s Dao planet weren’t as convenient as the purple gold civilization. They had been able to lure Wang baole over as soon as possible, it could be said that the purple gold civilization had the upper hand in this matter.
If the other factions that were coveting the Dao Planet wanted to make a move, they would have to find Wang Baole first. As for the crystal outside the God’s eye civilization... rather than preventing Wang baole from escaping, it was more accurate to say that it was... hiding the traces of the God’s eye civilization!
The latter was the greatest use of the crystal. Even if they couldn’t hide it for a long time, there was enough time for them to acquire the Dao Planet. That would be enough. If they did, it would be coveted by the other major factions as well, however, the purple gold civilization had their own ways of handling this matter. After all, even if they offered it up, the purple gold civilization would definitely benefit greatly from it.
That was why, as the planet of the Purple Gold Civilization roared, there was an unconcealed greed in its eyes. It was extremely strong. This time, the purple gold civilization had deployed two planets and nine planets. They had set up an inescapable net, it was clear that they were determined to obtain the Dao Planet!
In fact, after seeing the name Wang Baole and the mark of the God’s eye civilization behind his name on the list that had been circulated through the fallen star grounds, they knew very well that the other party was long Nanzi.
That was why they had started setting up their plans at that moment. Not only were they going to find Zhao Yameng and capture them, but there were also a series of other plans, including if Wang Baole didn’t come as promised.., they were already prepared for what they were going to do. Even the matter regarding the Earth Federation had been calculated by the stellar ancestor of the Purple Gold civilization at a considerable cost.
It could be said that they had made ample preparations for the acquisition this time around, and they had come up with many plans. Wang Baole didn’t know the details, but as he watched the purple gold civilization’s army of cultivators.., he more or less understood what was going on. However, his expression didn’t turn ugly. Even the gloominess disappeared. What replaced it was a sense of calmness, as if he had made a decision in his heart.
After hearing the low growl of the stellar cultivator from the purple gold civilization, Wang Baole raised his head and looked at him with an even calmer expression.
...
“I’ll give all of you a chance to atone for your sins. Release my people, leave the divine eye civilization, and offer an apology. I... will not pursue this matter,”Wang Baole said calmly as he met the stellar cultivator’s gaze.
As soon as he said that, the planet cultivators, such as the new Dao Elder and the sky-palm Elder, were flabbergasted. There were even some planets from the purple gold civilization who started laughing mockingly.
The same was true for the two planets. Disdain appeared in the eyes of the one behind Wang Baole. The planet that looked into his eyes laughed loudly, and the killing intent in its eyes became even more obvious.
“Have you become a fool after merging with the Dao Star? “Long Nanzi, I don’t care if your name is Wang Baole or something else. I don’t care if you’re from the earth federation or a cultivator from the god’s eye civilization. All of this... is meaningless
“I’ll give you a chance to atone for your sins. Hand over the Dao Star and surrender. Otherwise... not only will your friends here die because of you, but the God’s eye civilization will also be wiped out. As for the Earth Federation... It will be wiped out before you in an instant!” The stellar mighty figure raised his right hand and waved it. Immediately, the void beside him distorted and an image appeared. The image that appeared was the solar system that Wang Baole was familiar with!
In the image, other than the Solar System, a stellar mighty figure could be seen sitting cross-legged in the starry sky outside the Solar System. His cultivation was extremely vast, and it seemed like every move he made could affect the rules of the starry sky. Furthermore, in his hand.., there was a ball of light that was emitting terrifying ripples, and it was shining.
The ball of light contained power. Wang baole only looked at the illusory screen through the void, and he immediately felt the terrifying aura that could destroy an entire civilization contained within it.
Based on the judgment of the mighty star figure, this scene would more or less cause Wang Baole’s expression to change. However, what disappointed him was that Wang baole only took a glance, and his eyes revealed a hint of reminiscence, however, there were no other changes in his expression. There was not even a hint of anger on his face when he was being held hostage.
This made his heart skip a beat, and he spoke again.
“Other than that, the purple gold civilization has set up a grand array formation that will trace your origin power. From there, we will curse all those who are related to your bloodline in this galaxy, and make them die because of you
“Now, compared to the Dao planet that you have just acquired, tell me whether your home, family, friends, and everything around you, including your own life, is more important, or is the Dao planet more important?”
Wang Baole, who was standing on the Starfall ship, looked at the place where Zhao Yameng had been sealed and listened to the words of the mighty figure from the star. He fell silent.
His silence made the two purple gold planets around him heave a sigh of relief. They appeared to be powerful, but they had some misgivings in their hearts. This was because the dao planet was different from the other special planets, even if the other special planets had fused with cultivators, there were too many ways to dig out the planets and change their owners.
However, the Dao planet was different. This involved the ownership of the sole law. To a certain extent, the special planets hadn’t been marked by the rules of the starry skies. The dao planet, on the other hand, was different. The moment it fused with Wang Baole.., it was as if it was recorded in the starry skies.
That way, even if it was forcefully dug out, it would be of no use. With just a thought from Wang Baole, he would be able to retrieve it. At the same time, if he killed Wang Baole, the dao star would dissipate on its own, it would return to the fallen star once again, unable to be stopped.
Therefore, the only way to obtain the dao star was for its owner to give it away voluntarily. It would be like a transfer of ownership, giving the Dao Star to someone else. Only then would one be able to truly obtain it.
That was why, while the purple gold civilization was trapping Wang Baole, their main focus was to capture him alive. They would seize his weak points and use everything they could threaten him with to force him to give it away voluntarily!
Other than that, there was another unforeseen event. That was... after Wang Baole returned, the meteor ship didn’t disappear. As long as he stood on the meteor ship, the Purple Gold Civilization wouldn’t dare act Rashly.
That was because they weren’t sure if the meteor ship could ignore their arrangements and take Wang baole away. If the other party really fled at all costs, then all their efforts would have been for naught. Even though the fact that the other party could come meant that there was a problem.., however, this matter was too big, so they didn’t dare be completely certain.
That made them even more apprehensive. That was why they had been so forceful and direct in threatening Wang Baole. That was to make Wang Baole feel apprehensive. He would be restrained by his thoughts and wouldn’t flee immediately.
Wang Baole didn’t know all of these details, but he watched coldly as the other party’s reaction after his return. He had more or less guessed the majority of the conditions for the transfer of the Dao Star. It had to be said.., the points that the other party had grasped were extremely important to Wang Baole. If he hadn’t already thought of a way to deal with them, he would have been extremely anxious and passive.
However, at that moment, he only sighed softly.
“I had planned to face all of you as ordinary people...”
Wang Baole muttered to himself. His expression remained calm, and his gaze was the same. He stared at the star before him. As he spoke, the calmness in his eyes slowly changed, and a hint of arrogance gradually appeared in his helpless expression.
“I had planned to conduct this cultivation trial in a normal manner...”
The reason why he felt so helpless was that he didn’t want to do what he was about to do. The reason why he was so arrogant was because the words he was about to say represented that, although they weren’t supreme, they were definitely of a supreme status, when the violet gold civilization cultivators heard this, especially the two stars’minds, it instantly turned into a thunderous roar that towered up into the sky!
Forget it, forget it... as an ordinary person, if I act normally, what I get in return is threats and humiliation. Now that I’ve laid my cards on the table, I won’t pretend anymore. My true identity is that I’m the personal disciple of the blazing flame ancestor
“Have you all heard of the name of my master, The Blazing Flame Ancestor?”The arrogance in Wang Baole’s eyes exploded. His voice was like thunder that reverberated in all directions!

chapters.title: Chapter 976 - the arrival of the patriarch!
chapters.content:
Chapter 976:, the arrival of the patriarch!
Wang Baole raised his head proudly. His eyes were filled with arrogance as he looked down at his surroundings. His gaze gave off the feeling that he was looking at an ant.
It was as if after he had said those words, he had removed all his concealment and revealed his true identity. He looked like a prince as he looked at the living beings who were trying to provoke him.
The Yellow Flame Dao circulated within him after he said those words. It exploded out in all directions. In the blink of an eye, it spread out to the outside world, causing him to look at it from a distance, it was as if a flower of flame had bloomed.
It shone with a brilliant light that Shook Heaven and earth!
At the same time, his words contained the power of the initial stage of the planet realm. As it spread out, he used his dao star to affect the natural laws, causing it to explode out in all directions like heavenly lightning, they even formed ripples that spread out in all directions.
Not only were the star almighties from the purple gold civilization in front and behind him bearing the brunt of the impact, the nine planets were also affected. The cultivators from the purple gold civilization who had surrounded the area, who were further away, all heard Wang Baole’s words, their cultivation began to tremble.
The power of the Dao stars erupted at that moment, instantly forming a suppressive force. Everyone below the planets were shocked. Wang Baole’s suppression of their cultivation levels was stronger than that of the other planets, even though they weren’t planets and didn’t have control over the rules, they had their own divine abilities that they were good at.
These divine abilities... even though there were all sorts of them, many of them were included in Wang Baole’s nine rules. Therefore, the Suppressive Force formed by his words was naturally stronger.
Not only were their cultivation levels shaken, their minds buzzed uncontrollably. Their vision seemed to blur. If not for the existence of stars and planets, this so-called predicament would have seemed like a joke.
Even the sky-palm Elder and the other nine planets’expressions changed immediately. Five of them were in the initial stage of the planets, two were in the middle stage, and two were in the late stage of the planets. However, at that moment.., the bodies of the five initial-stage planets trembled as well. Although they were much better than the cultivators below the planet, the trembling of the planets within their bodies forced them to admit..
Once they fought with Wang Baole, they were no match for him under the suppression of the rules and laws!
...
Even if they were at the mid-stage of the planet, they were only slightly better than the initial-stage. Even the sky palm elder and the Heavenly Spirit Sect’s Peak Lord, who were at the late-stage of the planet, were shaken. They felt a sense of oppression.
They knew very well that this scene represented the suppression of the laws and the suppression of the laws. It meant that this long Nanzi... was already a world away from what he had been before!
The two star Almighties’expressions also changed. However, what caused the waves in their minds was not the fluctuation of the laws caused by their dao stars, but... the name that they had mentioned!
“Blazing progenitor? !”
Their minds buzzed, and the fear that instinctively surfaced in their hearts could not be concealed. However, most of them still did not believe it. It was really... the name of blazing progenitor.., the meaning that it represented was too great.
He was a star domain almighties, an existence that surpassed countless stars. Even in the entire left Dao holy region, such a figure was as rare as a phoenix feather or a qilin horn. Any one of them was extremely famous, and the moment they were angered.., it would cause a disaster for countless galaxies.
And their purple gold civilization seemed valiant. It seemed like their progenitor was only half a step away from the Starfield, and could already be considered to be standing at the peak of the stars. However, they knew very well... the difficulty of this half-step leap was almost unimaginable, to describe it as a fish leaping over a dragon’s gate was already considered good.
It could even be said that if there was no external help, then the blazing flame progenitor alone could make their purple gold civilization disappear from this world.
Even though the purple gold civilization had a faction backing it, and there was a celestial domain ancestor in that faction, they were still a vassal, not the ancestor’s sect. Therefore, if they provoked the blazing flame ancestor, the consequences would be dire, it would be disadvantageous for the purple gold civilization.
Rumors had it that the blazing flame ancestor didn’t get along with the Weiyang clan. Not only was he powerful, he was also extremely protective of his own shortcomings. Anyone who got close to him in the blazing flame galaxy would cause him to be displeased, it was even more so when it came to bullying his disciple.
This made the two of them extremely shocked. However, the more shocked they were, the more they felt that it was impossible. The logic was simple. If Wang Baole was really the personal disciple of the blazing flame ancestor.., then, there was no need for him to hide his previous actions. It was obvious that he had some qualms about placing the people he cared about outside.
Other than that, there was also a strong sense of unwillingness. They couldn’t and couldn’t give up all their plans just because of Wang Baole’s words. All their efforts would be for naught, after all... This was the key to the Purple Gold Civilization’s advancement to the next level. It was also the purple gold civilization’s ancestor, who was at the pinnacle of the stars. He was using this opportunity to exchange for a rare opportunity to break through!
Therefore, in the next instant, the star Almighty before Wang Baole had a cold look in his eyes as he laughed out loud.
“The Blazing Flame ancestor is your master? What a joke. Why didn’t you say that Divine Emperor Wei Yang is your master? That’s a bunch of nonsense!”
Wang Baole stood on the boat and stared coldly at the star Almighty, who was clearly nervous but had put on an act. He was clearly filled with murderous intent. He thought to himself that the divine emperor wasn’t my master, but Chen Qingzi, who had killed the divine emperor.., he is my senior brother.
However, that wasn’t important. Wang Baole didn’t plan to reveal all his trump cards here. As soon as the star Almighty spoke, he raised his right hand and flipped it, taking out a jade slip.
The jade slip contained the power of a curse. It was given to him by the blazing flame ancestor. He had even told the star almighty that if he was done considering becoming his master, he would use the jade slip to inform him.
Just as he was about to pinch it... the star almighty laughed coldly and spoke again.
“Long Nanzi, don’t say those useless words. Since you insist on becoming a joke, then don’t blame me!”As he spoke, the star Almighty waved his right hand, and instantly, the killing intent in the eyes of the nine planets behind him grew stronger, they instantly formed hand seals, and in the next instant... the bubble that had sealed Zhao Yameng, the donkey, and Little Five suddenly began to shine.
Black gas appeared from within and surrounded their bodies. Wherever it passed by, Zhao Yameng, the donkey, and Little Five began to show signs of corrosion in their unconscious state. Even though they were unconscious.., pain appeared on their faces.
This scene caused the killing intent in Wang Baole’s heart to explode. He didn’t notice that Little Five, who was in the bubble, seemed to be moving his fingers slightly, but he held it in immediately..
Wang Baole, who didn’t notice this scene, laughed angrily as the killing intent exploded. He crushed the jade slip in his hand without any hesitation. His voice was filled with killing intent as he spoke to the starry sky.
“Disciple Wang Baole, please help me save people and suppress these two ignorant stars!”
The moment Wang Baole spoke, the moment the jade slip was crushed, an old laughter that seemed to have been waiting for a long time, filled with anticipation and excitement, immediately reverberated within the divine eye civilization. It was just laughter.., it caused the divine eye civilization to tremble and the stars to dim. Cracks appeared on the seal formed by the crystal piece.
It also caused the minds of all the cultivators in the area to rumble. Even the two star Almighties weren’t spared. Their expressions changed completely.
“The Galaxy!”
“Blazing Flame ancestor!”
As the two stellar almighties screamed in shock, their bodies retreated rapidly. Fleeing in front of the stellar almighties was nothing more than a joke. However, they were driven by their instincts, and they continued to run frantically.
However, as they retreated, in front of Wang Baole’s ship, a huge whirlpool suddenly appeared silently in the starry sky. A Sea of fire erupted from within the whirlpool, surging out like a volcano, it didn’t spread. Instead, as the suppressive force that shook the starry sky spread, it formed two flaming whips that shot towards the two escaping stars in front and behind Wang Baole!
In that instant... the two flaming whips, with the suppressive force of the Starfield and boundless power, landed directly on the bodies of the two star Almighties. As the whips passed by... their physical bodies instantly... collapsed!

chapters.title: Chapter 977 - Tyranny!
chapters.content:
Chapter 977:, Tyranny!
For star Almighties, killing a planet was as easy as flipping one’s hand!
As for Star Domain Almighties, killing a star... to use the word ‘as easy as flipping one’s hand’would be to overestimate a star. Although a star was powerful, the deeper one’s cultivation base was, the greater the gap between their realms.
If the comparison between a planet and a star was described as a thousand times, then the difference between a star domain and a star would be at least ten thousand times. As such, for the blazing flame ancestor, his true form didn’t even need to appear.., just the Flames released by his divine sense were enough to destroy the bodies and souls of the two stars of the Purple Gold Civilization.
As for his true form... even if he stood there and allowed the two stars to attack him, even if the starry sky collapsed, the blazing flame ancestor would still be unharmed, because the damage he received was far less than his own recovery.
This... was the difference!
Therefore, the instant the blazing flame ancestor’s divine sense transformed into a flaming whip, it had already determined this so-called predicament. Indeed, it was a complete joke.
In an instant... these two star Almighties within the purple gold civilization could be said to be below one person. They couldn’t even let out a miserable cry. Their bodies collapsed in that instant, and their flesh and blood were reduced to ashes in the flames, their souls... didn’t have the right to escape either. They were destroyed in body and soul!
However, due to the Heavenly Dao rules of the never-ending DAO domain, even though they were destroyed in body and soul, they had still left a mark in the Heavenly Dao. It wasn’t impossible for them to be resurrected in the future, but the prerequisite... was that Wang Baole hadn’t made a move!
He had long been filled with murderous intent towards the two stellar almighties. He would never show mercy to those who threatened him. Furthermore, the existence of the blazing flame ancestor here.., he didn’t need to worry about his secret being exposed.
After all... The Blazing Flame ancestor had been able to see through his relationship with Chen Qingzi and had exposed it with a single sentence. There was no need for him to hide it too much. That was why the moment the blazing flame ancestor made his move and the two mighty figures from the stars were destroyed in body and soul.., wang Baole’s eyes flashed. He raised his right hand and formed a seal. Immediately, a gigantic black nightmare eye appeared behind him!
This Black Nightmare Eye was different from when he was a spirit immortal. There was only one pupil in the eye, but there were a total of ten circles in it. This made the Nightmare Eye look extremely demonic. Even if a planet were to look at it, it would be extremely shocking.
...
“Swallow!”The moment the Black Nightmare Eye appeared, Wang Baole spoke coldly. Immediately, the black eye behind him emitted an evil glow, and there was an undetectable dark fire flickering within it, in an instant, it sucked in the invisible mark of the two star Almighty existences that had been destroyed in body and soul, wiping them away!
Wang Baole’s body expanded rapidly as well. A large amount of soul power from the two stars was transmitted frantically through the nightmare eye, causing his cultivation to rise slowly as it fluctuated.
The Starry Sky Shook, as if lightning had streaked across. The Blazing Flame ancestor witnessed the scene, but he didn’t say anything. More Sea of fire spread out from the whirlpool, sealing off the entire divine eye galaxy, it also enveloped the bubble where Zhao Yameng, the donkey, and Little Five were. It formed a protective barrier, and its voice reverberated in the starry sky, shaking the nine planets around it. Countless cultivators were shocked, and their voices reverberated in all directions.
“Disciple, do you need me to help you clean up this place?”
The Blazing Flame ancestor was very pleased with his disciple’s words. When Wang Baole heard it, he couldn’t help but feel emotional, but he was also grateful. After all, the blazing flame ancestor’s actions this time meant a lot to Wang Baole.
Not only did it resolve the crisis he was in, but it had also taken the responsibility for his possession of the Dao Star. Wang Baole was touched by this kindness. He had truly decided in his heart that this apprenticeship... no matter what happened in the future.., he would carry on forever!
Therefore, he didn’t stand on ceremony with his master. Instead, he cupped his fists and bowed before speaking respectfully.
“My heart is filled with murderous intent. If I don’t vent it out, I won’t be able to understand it. Therefore, I can handle the rest of the matters here. Master, please help me intimidate everyone and ensure the safety of my hometown!”
“Yes!”The blazing flame ancestor laughed loudly. He retracted his telepathic thoughts and disappeared!
As the blazing flame ancestor laughed, he left with his telepathic thoughts. However, the flames in the area still remained. As they sealed off the area, they also completely sealed off the area. The hundreds of thousands of cultivators and the nine planets around them trembled with fear in their eyes, they stared at Wang Baole, especially the heaven palm ancestor and the others. Their eyes were filled with despair and madness.
They had seen and heard everything. They knew very well that Wang Baole didn’t use the power of the Flames to purge everything. He wanted to personally suppress everything and end everything.
However, in their eyes, he was too arrogant!
After all, there were nine of them, especially the heaven palm ancestor and the Heavenly Spirit Sect’s sect Lord. They were in the late-stage of the planet realm. The blazing flame ancestor’s pressure made it impossible for them to unleash all of their combat abilities, however, if the nine of them joined forces... They would be able to defeat a planet that had just advanced. Even if the other party had fused with a dao star, they would still have a chance of victory.
However... They didn’t think that Wang Baole didn’t understand such an obvious thing. There must be other secrets hidden within. Therefore, everyone was anxious. Just as the sky-palm Elder was about to speak, Wang Baole took a step forward, he walked out of the meteorite cruiser!
“Without realizing it, I’ve been in the divine eye civilization for many years...”Wang Baole spoke calmly as he walked.
“Among all of you, there are some that I know and some that I’m not familiar with. Now that everything is about to end... in return for what you’ve done, I feel that... There’s something that I need to let all of you know,”Wang Baole said, wang Baole had already walked out of the Starfall ship and stood in the starry skies. He stared at the sky-palm and the others, whose expressions had changed.
“The person standing before you is merely... a clone!”When the sky-palm and the others heard those words, they felt as if they had been struck by lightning. Before their hearts could stir, Wang Baole raised his right hand, he pointed in the direction of the divine eye main star and spoke calmly.
“Return, my true self!”
As soon as those words were spoken, the divine eye main star roared and changed drastically!
At the same time, outside the Solar System, which was very far away from the divine eye civilization, in the starry sky where the strongest patriarch of the purple gold civilization was located.
The strongest patriarch of the purple gold civilization had been meditating with his eyes closed. His purpose in coming here was to use this place to intimidate Wang Baole and to hand over the Dao Planet. He was waiting for news from the divine eye civilization, he hadn’t received the news, but his heart had palpitated.
The moment the Blazing Flame Patriarch’s aura descended, his expression changed drastically. His breathing quickened, and he opened his eyes abruptly. He stared at the starry sky before him. Soon, he saw a vast sea of fire, a vast sea of fire appeared without a sound. The Sea of fire was so vast that it seemed to have no borders. It was larger than a galaxy.
When it appeared, the flames within roiled, forming a gigantic head. The head was vast and boundless, and its hair swayed as if it were a galaxy. It was right in front of the most powerful patriarch of the violet gold civilization, it looked at him coldly.
The two of them were like heaven and earth. Compared to the head, the most powerful patriarch of the violet gold civilization could not even be considered an ant.
His gaze alone caused the planet beneath the most powerful patriarch of the violet-gold civilization to wither. It was as if it had been burned into ashes. He trembled, his face pale and his body trembling, his heart was in turmoil, and he had no choice but to drop to his knees and kowtow.
The most powerful star of the violet-gold civilization spoke in a trembling voice. The intense pressure caused him to come to a realization. “I am Zhu Ming, the disciple in name of Dao Xin Zi Zun of the heavenly accumulation sect. Greetings... Patriarch Blazing Flame!” With a single thought, he would most likely be destroyed in body and soul.
That was because... the person who had appeared was the true body of a major power from the celestial domain, not his divine sense. That was why he had created such a crushing scene.
He was even more aware that for a major power from the celestial domain to descend upon his true body, it meant that he must have come with a very great purpose. It was clear that he had no good intentions, which made him even more nervous, that was why he didn’t mention the purple gold civilization for no reason. Instead, he spoke of his other identity.
The heavenly accumulation sect was the number one sect in the left Dao holy region. It was also the sect where the scholarly cultivator was located in the fallen star lands. Dao Xinzi was also one of the nine great galaxies in the sect!
However, to the blazing flame ancestor, he dared to provoke the Weiyang clan. Naturally, he didn’t care about Dao Xinzi. He spoke coldly, and as if he was giving orders, he spoke three sentences.
“Wang Baole is my personal disciple
“I’ll give you a month to send me an apology
“Now, Scram!”

chapters.title: Chapter 978 - was about to be reintroduced!
chapters.content:
Chapter 978: was about to be reintroduced!
The blazing flame ancestor’s dominance was evident from the three sentences. The first sentence was to tell the other party Wang Baole’s identity, the second sentence was to make the other party apologize and apologize, and the third sentence was to expel him immediately!
Regardless of whether it was reasonable or not, I will not argue with you. Rather than calling it a notification, it would be better to call it an order!
I will not ask for the reason, nor will I care about your background. I will only deal with it according to my way. As for you... you have to obey, and if you don’t, you have to obey!
As the number one expert of the violet-gold civilization, the patriarch, whose cultivation base had reached the pinnacle of the stars, knelt there. His body trembled, and his heart was filled with grievance. However, he did not dare to resist. He did not even dare to raise his head, the thoughts in his heart did not dare to show the slightest bit. The only thing he could do was to respectfully acknowledge. After the blazing flame elder’s flaming head slowly dissipated, he finally dared to raise his head. His expression was bitter as he stood in silence for a moment.
In the end, his expression was gloomy as he looked at the solar system in front of him. He turned around in a flash and chose to leave.
He had already guessed that the two stars under his command that had gone to the divine eye civilization must have fallen. and the fate of all the purple gold civilization cultivators that had remained in the divine eye civilization could also be predicted. Such a loss.., it could be said that the purple gold civilization had suffered even more than they had suffered.
All of this was because of Wang Baole!
However, he didn’t dare to take revenge. His heart was in a state of depression and madness. He couldn’t hold it in as he sped forward. He threw his head back and let out an extremely loud roar.
“Wang Baole... you have such a background. Why didn’t you say so earlier?”
As he roared, he sped up and left frantically. He knew that he still had to prepare an apology. No matter how aggrieved he felt, the apology had to be heavier. Otherwise, there would be endless trouble in the future.
As he sped forward, the nine sky-palm cultivators in the divine eye galaxy felt as if they were being struck by lightning. As Wang Baole spoke, he raised his right hand and pointed at the divine eye main star. The divine eye main star immediately shook violently.
...
The ground churned and the sky changed. Wang Baole’s original body, who was in the coffin, opened his eyes. The moment he did so, the ground shook violently once again. The soil around the coffin collapsed, giant cracks spread out, covering a radius of a thousand miles.
The land, which was a thousand miles away, exploded in the cracks. As the land collapsed, the coffin rushed out for the first time in many years. It left the ground like a shooting star, it drew a long, bright arc and charged into the starry sky!
It was so fast that it surpassed the speed of an ordinary planet. It appeared directly on the battlefield in the starry sky. Amidst the shock of the cultivators and the nine sky palm cultivators, the coffin whistled through the air and reached the top of the battlefield in the blink of an eye!
As it appeared, an even stronger pressure spread out from the coffin. As the runes on the coffin shone, an ancient aura of time spread out continuously, causing everyone on the battlefield to.., their hearts were once again in turmoil.
As their hearts were in turmoil, Wang Baole smiled, his eyes filled with anticipation.
“See you all in a while.”As he said that, Wang Baole’s body swayed, and he instantly turned into a cloud of fog that charged towards the coffin. Under the watchful eyes of everyone around, the fog that his figure had turned into.., it immediately spread to the coffin and entered it!
He had been in the divine eye civilization for many years. In order to avoid the Weiyang Heavenly Dao, he had no choice but to use the technique that his senior brother had taught him to condense his origin dharmic body. He had cultivated his dharmic body outside until now. At that moment... just as everything in the divine eye civilization was about to come to an end.., wang Baole finally allowed his clone to merge with his original body!
As the mist from his origin clone merged with the coffin, the mist that his clone had turned into instantly enveloped his original body. It flowed through his seven orifices and all the pores on his body. As it merged with his original body, it also merged with his cultivation!
Other than that, there were also the rules of the nine ancient stars and... The Dao Stars!
As the clone and his original body were of the same origin, the merger this time was a transfer of the Dao Stars. However, there was no hindrance at all. The merger ended almost instantly. The moment it ended, Wang Baole, who was in the coffin.., his body shook violently. The ripples of his cultivation erupted violently at that moment.
His original body was already powerful. Now that he had fused with his clone, his battle prowess had also increased exponentially. The feeling of finally having a physical body made Wang Baole’s body and mind become one, and the circulation of the Dao stars in his body became even smoother, the laws and laws continued to evolve in his body, and his cultivation had increased as a result. He hadn’t reached the mid-stage of the planet realm, but in terms of battle prowess... it had increased tremendously!
At the same time, as he was fusing with the laws, the sky-palm Elder and the others’eyes were filled with ferocity and an uncontrollable madness. They knew very well that no matter how arrogant Wang Baole was this time, under the suppression of the mighty figure in the galaxy.., they wouldn’t be able to leave this place alive.
Furthermore, Wang Baole was clearly not going to let them off. It could be said that no matter what, they would die. That being the case... amidst their madness, all of them grew frantic and agitated in despair, and their killing intent grew stronger.
Right at that moment... the coffin that was the focus of everyone’s attention, exuding an ancient and ancient aura, suddenly emitted cracking sounds!
The coffin’s lid could be seen with the naked eye. Under countless gazes, it slowly began to move. When it was halfway opened... a hand reached out from within the pitch-black coffin. It was a hand that was made of flesh and blood!
The moment the hand appeared, the Heavenly Spirit Sect’s sect master roared in grief and indignation.
“Listen Up, everyone! Cultivators of the violet-gold civilization, even if we have to die, we will die together with this scoundrel!”With that, he shot toward the coffin, and not just him, but all of the other planets, all of the planets, including the sect leader, also attacked.
As for the cultivators in the area, all of them went crazy, unleashing magical techniques and divine abilities that filled the sky as they shot toward the coffin!
However, even as the magical techniques and divine abilities slammed into the coffin, a calm voice echoed out from within the coffin.
“Talk about war on paper.”
At the same time, the hand that had emerged from within the coffin formed a hand incantation, which caused everyone who saw it to be completely shaken. In fact, the paper figure on the meteor ship, which had never left, suddenly began to shine with a strange light, a strange light appeared in its eyes!
The hand that had originally been flesh and blood... suddenly became a paper hand!
In the instant that it became a paper hand, a power of law that no cultivator in the area had ever seen before spread out. In that instant... countless divine abilities and magical techniques exploded out, including those of the nine planets, as well as the combined efforts of all the cultivators in the area! As they neared the paper hand... They transformed into pieces of paper!
“This is impossible! !”Cried the Heavenly Spirit Sect’s Peak Lord in shock!
“This... This isn’t a magical technique! This is a law! !”
“It’s not a law! I’ve never heard of any law that can transform everything into paper! !”
The other planets were all shocked to the extreme, and they began to cry out in shock. Only the heavenly palm patriarch was the first to fall back. He gave up and attempted to flee!
Clearly, he was completely shocked by what he saw. No matter what divine ability, magical technique, or magical item, they all turned into sheets of paper in the blink of an eye, it was a shocking scene.
All of the divine abilities and magical techniques that had been unleashed earlier had been unleashed with incredible momentum. Now, they floated down to the ground. From a distance, they looked like snowflakes, or rain of paper. It was a feeling of powerlessness that caused people to feel despair!
Just as everyone in the area was panicking and their scalps were tingling with fear, that paper hand... pressed down on the edge of the coffin, causing the figure within to slowly stand up from within the coffin!
It was revealed before everyone’s eyes!
It had black hair and was dressed in a long black robe. Its eyes were like stars, and its face was as sharp as a knife. Its edges and corners were distinct, and at the same time, it had an imposing aura that caused people’s hearts to tremble. It continued to spread out from the figure, affecting the starry sky, it caused the entire divine eye civilization to tremble. Flames surrounded it, and the eyes of the divine eye and the stars shone brightly!
This appearance was different from long Nanzi’s. It made everyone in the area feel unfamiliar, but at the same time, they felt a strong wave of emotions. Just as everyone was trembling in fear, the figure dressed in black walked out of the coffin, he spoke calmly.
“Let’s get to know each other again. I am the President of the Solar System Federation, Wang Baole!”

chapters.title: Chapter 979 - suppression!
chapters.content:
Chapter 979:, suppression!
As Wang Baole walked out, an orange star appeared faintly behind him. As the star appeared, Wang Baole’s words reverberated in all directions, spreading throughout the entire divine eye civilization!
All the planets, including the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord, and even the sky-palm Elder, who had retreated in an attempt to escape, trembled violently.
It wasn’t that the meaning behind Wang Baole’s words was shocking. It was that the moment the words entered their ears, they seemed to form a strange force, as if they contained a law. It turned into a thunderous roar that surpassed heavenly thunder, it exploded crazily within their divine senses!
They weren’t the only ones. The hundreds of thousands of purple gold civilization cultivators around them all felt their minds reeling at that moment. It was as if Wang Baole’s words had turned into hundreds of thousands of sharp blades that shot towards all of them without form, they pierced through their bodies and into their souls!
This was... the Dao of Orange Joy!
They had incorporated the Dao of Orange Joy into their voices, allowing their words to be imbued with the power of the Dao. It wasn’t particularly ingenious, which was why they weren’t able to accurately kill with their voices, however, with their dao of Orange Joy, they could use their voices to spread it out and shake their enemies’minds, causing their minds to buzz and become dazed. It was still possible!
In fact, among the hundreds of thousands of violet-gold cultivators in the area, there were some whose cultivation bases were weak or had internal injuries. At that moment, their minds began to Rumble, and their souls began to hurt. Their bodies trembled, and blood sprayed out of their mouths. Their eyes instantly grew dim, their souls were instantly destroyed, leaving behind only corpses that floated in the air!
Only the Heavenly Spirit Peak Lord and the other planets were affected by the Dao of joy. However, because of how powerful they were, they were able to quickly recover from the effects of the Dao of joy. Their eyes shone with madness, as if they were trapped beasts, at that moment, an even more intense struggle erupted.
“We’re all going to die in battle. Since that’s the case... I don’t believe that we can’t do anything to an early-stage planet cultivator who just advanced! !”
“We might only be immortal planets at most, but so what if we’re Dao Planets? !”
“The winner takes all. This time, we’re fighting for good fortune. Although we’ve failed, the consequences will be the most severe. We’ll die, and our dao will disappear. Kill! !” The planet cultivators of the purple gold civilization were much stronger than the divine eye civilization when it came to fighting with their lives on the line. That was why even though the sky palm had escaped and the new dao ancestor had hesitated, the eyes of the other purple gold planets were red, as the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord roared, their cultivation erupted. Planets materialized and charged at Wang Bao at high speed!
...
With them taking the lead, the hundreds of thousands of purple gold cultivators around them seemed to be encouraged as well, as if they were about to launch another attack!
As he watched all of this, Wang Baole’s eyes shone with a strange light.
What he wanted was this kind of imposing manner from the other party! The reason why he didn’t let his master, the blazing flame ancestor, make a move was partly because he wanted to vent the anger in his heart. After all, the other party had plotted against him first and threatened him to be behind. If it wasn’t for the blazing flame ancestor this time.., even the solar system would have been wiped out. Therefore, his anger wouldn’t show the mercy of a woman just because the other party had too many people and too many massacres.
What he wanted was a massacre!
On the other hand, he wanted to make use of this opportunity... to perfect his nine rules!
Therefore, after the Dao of joy of the orange was unleashed and the cultivation of Tian Ling and the others erupted, Wang Baole calmly took a second step forward. He raised his right hand and waved it gently in all directions.
“Blood!”
As soon as the words left his mouth, a series of shrill screams rang out from the hundreds of thousands of cultivators who had been led by the planets and were feeling restless, almost all of the hundreds of thousands of cultivators were bleeding from their eyes, ears, nose, and mouth at that moment!
The bleeding was not due to the shock. It was because the blood in their bodies seemed to reject them at that moment. It didn’t want to stay in their bodies. It was as if there was a strong call from outside, and it wanted to rush out of their bodies!
In that instant, tens of thousands of cultivators couldn’t control their screams. Their bodies collapsed with a loud crash. That was due to the impact caused by the blood rushing out. As their bodies were destroyed, their souls dissipated as well, the only thing that remained was the blood that gathered crazily towards Wang Baole. In the blink of an eye, it formed a sea of blood!
As for those who gritted their teeth and persevered, even though they could barely hold on because of Wang Baole’s scattered rules, they were now extremely shocked. The will to fight to the death that had just risen in their hearts also collapsed instantly, no one knew who started first. They retreated rapidly in fear, as if they had forgotten that even if they tried to escape, they wouldn’t be able to escape from the blockade. They continued to scatter in all directions.
As for the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord and the others, even though they were resisting Wang Baole’s Blood Dao rules with their own cultivation, they were still charging towards him. However, what awaited them was the Sea of blood that Wang Baole had gathered under the Blood Dao rules.
The Sea of blood seemed to possess sentience. As it swept towards them, it turned into a huge mouth and started devouring the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord and the other planets.
With a loud boom, as the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord and the others were blocked, Wang Baole spoke calmly and activated the third law!
“Cloud Dao!”
Clouds were ever-changing, and illusions were spells. The moment Wang Baole spoke, green stars appeared behind him. As the stars revolved, the laws in the area were immediately affected, in that instant... a strange scene appeared!
The hundreds of thousands of cultivators who had lost their will to fight and were frantically scattering in all directions suddenly shuddered. Their eyes turned red, and they turned their heads to attack their companions, they attacked with all their might!
It wasn’t just one or two of them. More than half of the cultivators were affected, as if they were hallucinating. Their senses told them that the people around them were the key to affecting their lives. As long as they killed their companions.., they would be able to survive.
As a result, under the illusory technique, the shrill screams in the area grew even louder than before. The entire battlefield seemed to be in a state of chaos. Hundreds of thousands of cultivators were engaged in a frenzied battle. There was even a hint of the blood dao.., the blood in the area grew thicker and thicker. It also highlighted... the strange look on Wang Baole’s face as he stood calmly in the center of the battlefield.
“Wang Baole!” The Heavenly Spirit Sect’s sect master let out a shrill scream. His hair was disheveled and disheveled. Due to his powerful cultivation, even though he had been suppressed, he hadn’t been affected too much. He remained clear-headed, but everything around him.., it caused his heart to ache with extreme pain.
That was because... the hundreds of thousands of cultivators were almost all disciples of his heavenly spirit sect!
“You Fiend!”
“So many people... they’re all weaklings. Don’t you have the slightest bit of compassion in your heart?”
Faced with the Heavenly Spirit Palm’s roar, Wang Baole turned his head to look at them, who were blocked by a large amount of blood. A cold glint appeared in his eyes as he stared at the crazed heavenly spirit palm.
“Compassion? When your purple gold civilization slaughtered the god’s eye civilization, did you show any compassion?”
“When the purple gold civilization forced me to hand over the Dao Star, did you show mercy
“When the Purple Gold Civilization threatened me with my home, the Solar System, did you show mercy
“Today, I am the one who has turned the tables. If not for that, all the lives in my home would have been massacred. I wonder if you, the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord, would show mercy if this happened
“Fine, I’ll show mercy once!”
As Wang Baole said that, he raised his right hand and formed another seal. A black star rose high behind him. Immediately, an aura that represented death erupted!
“The Dao of Death!”
As soon as he said that, the aura of death erupted from the Black Star and spread in all directions. The starry sky seemed to shatter wherever it passed. The purple gold cultivators who were engaged in battle trembled, they began to wither, and as they did so, their life force was forcibly converted into the aura of death. As it spread out, the entire battlefield turned into a gigantic vortex!
As the vortex spun with a rumble, it gathered all the aura of death that was spreading out from the bodies of the cultivators. Looking around, the hundreds of thousands of cultivators on the battlefield all had dull expressions on their faces. In the end, as the sect Master of Celestialspirit sect roared madly.., all of them turned into ashes and disappeared into the starry skies!
The entire battlefield was emptied!
“Now, it’s your turn.”As the four stars behind him materialized, Wang Baole looked at the Heavenly Spirit Sect’s sect master, raised his right hand, and said calmly.
“Everyone here can not escape!”

chapters.title: Chapter 980 - -- Dao star suppression!
chapters.content:
Chapter 980: — Dao star suppression!
As soon as he said that, Wang Baole raised his right hand and clenched it!
Instantly, the giant vortex that had absorbed the death Qi of hundreds of thousands of cultivators on the battlefield let out a loud boom. The vortex itself changed as well, turning into a giant palm. The moment Wang Baole’s right hand clenched.., the Palm also clenched!
The Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord and the others who were within the range of the palm were enraged. However, under this divine ability, their expressions changed. They spread out rapidly, and the palm that was formed from the death vortex.., with a sound that reverberated throughout the god’s eye civilization, the palm was completely gripped!
As the palm was gripped, a loud boom reverberated. Immediately, the sound of planets collapsing and self-destructing could be heard coming from the palm. However... Wang Baole’s opponents were, after all, multiple planets. Even though the quality of their own planets was not high.., they still had the advantage in numbers. Furthermore, the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord was at the late-stage of the planet realm.
Therefore, as the sound of planets self-destructing rang out, a flash of sword light erupted from the palm and sliced open a crack in the palm.
As the crack appeared, several beams of light shot out from within!
Of the original eight people, only seven were left. The one who had died... was the new dao patriarch!
Other than the heavenly spirit Palm Lord and the two mid-stage planet cultivators, the rest of the seven were all early-stage planet cultivators, and they were all injured. The moment they charged out, the seven quickly separated, and four of them retreated, they split into four directions, as if they wanted to escape!
As for the other three, they charged towards Wang Baole.
The leader of the three... was the heavenly spirit Palm Lord. The two behind him were from the purple gold civilization as well. Their cultivation might not be as high as the heavenly spirit Palm Lord’s, but they were still mid-stage planet cultivators. They were all in a sorry state, however, the madness and killing intent emanating from their bodies was extremely strong.
“Separate?”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and smiled faintly. The moment the heavenly spirit Palm Lord and the other two arrived, his body swayed. The blue stars behind him materialized, and the Wind Dao laws descended. His speed reached its peak in the next instant, an afterimage appeared. With a single step, he crossed the starry skies and arrived before one of the four planet cultivators who had split up and fled.
...
He was a middle-aged man. Even though he was in a sorry state, the moment he saw Wang Baole, a ferocious look appeared in his eyes. He seemed to be filled with despair and madness as he roared.
“You’ve been tricked. Seal!”As he spoke, he chose to self-destruct without any hesitation!
As the destructive ripples erupted, countless rays of light shot out from his body. His planet was also shattered at that moment. As the loud sound reverberated, his body, his soul, and his planet.., all of them exploded, and the power of the explosion spread out in all directions!
At the same time, the other three early-stage planets from the violet-gold civilization who had fled in other directions also laughed bitterly, and madness appeared in their eyes. At the instant the middle-aged planet self-destructed, they also chose to self-destruct without hesitation!
“Seal!”
“Seal! !”
“Seal! ! !”
The power of a planet’s self-destruct would be several times greater than its own. Now that the four early-stage planets self-destructed together, the power would be even greater, and the destructive ripples between them would overlap, therefore, the power of the self-destruct would be even more powerful!
The places where they had fled previously seemed to be scattered, but if one looked closely, one could see that even though the four of them were fleeing, the gaps between them seemed to contain some profound meaning, as if they were connected by branches and leaves, it was hidden within the array formation.
.
That was indeed the case. The self-detonation on the bodies of the four cultivators from the planet of the purple gold civilization was a type of sealing technique. In the purple gold civilization, this technique could be considered a great supernatural power, as it contained the laws of life, it was also a type of plant law that contained the will of life.
That was why it was so powerful. Now that the four of them had used the power of self-detonation, it was naturally even more powerful!
As the four of them self-destructed, a thread appeared in each of their collapsed bodies and planets. It was like a plant fiber that swept towards Wang Baole in an instant, as if it would lock onto him, there was no escape. In the next instant, the four threads surpassed Wang Baole’s wind path at an indescribable speed and wrapped around his body forcefully, with a sudden tug... Wang Baole was trapped in the starry skies!
It wasn’t over yet. Almost at the moment when the four early-stage cultivators on the planets self-destructed, the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord and the other two who had charged at Wang Baole turned their heads abruptly. They moved at a speed that was even faster than before, their lives were on fire at that moment. In exchange, they were able to move at an even faster speed and exhaust their potential. They formed hand seals and roared at each other.
“Heavenly Spirit Seal!”
As he roared, the heavenly spirit palm’s hair was disheveled, and his body exploded with intense light. The light transformed into a giant seal outside his body. It was supported by the burning of the cultivation of the two mid-stage planets behind him, causing the seal to instantly.., the light reached its peak, becoming the brightest light in the starry sky, second only to the stars. It buzzed towards Wang Baole.
It was a seal formed by the self-destruction of four planets at the initial stage. It was a heavenly spirit power formed by the self-destruction of one planet at the later stage and two planets at the middle stage at the cost of their lives. It could be said that... in such a short period of time.., the thought of this strategy and the planning of such a counterattack was enough to prove the heavenly spirit Palm’s shrewdness.
The seal formed by the self-destruction of the four planets at the initial stage contained rules, and the seal formed by the self-destruction of the four planets was even more so for the heavenly spirit palm. Even though the heavenly spirit palm had advanced from the immortal planet and the planets didn’t have rules, he had borrowed the power of the Heavenly Spirit Sect’s Mystic Arts, using his own cultivation base and the burning of the two planets at the intermediate stage, he unleashed the Heavenly Spirit Seal, the number one secret technique of the heavenly spirit sect. This allowed the rules of light contained within this secret technique to be revealed to the world!
