If it was someone else, even if it was someone at the planet completion level, they would definitely not be able to escape from their combined forces. However... the difference between the levels of the planets would sometimes cause those who had fused with lower level planets to despair, they would even feel a strong sense of injustice.
They were both planets. Those who had advanced from a mortal planet wouldn’t be able to withstand a single blow from a cultivator who had advanced from a Spirit Planet!
It was even more so when a spirit planet faced an immortal planet. As for the special planets... when faced with the rules, even an immortal planet wasn’t much different from a mortal planet.
Furthermore, Wang Baole had fused with a dao planet that had advanced from nine ancient planets!
It could be said that even though Wang Baole was only at the initial stage of the planet realm, the rules that he had mastered and the grade of his planet allowed him to be at the planet realm. If the other party didn’t have a special planet, then even if he was at the Perfected Planet Realm.., he still didn’t have the right to raise his head in front of him!
It was just like how no matter how big a balloon was, it was still a balloon. No matter how small a nail was, it was still a nail!
If numbers can make up for the difference, then... why must there be so many levels in cultivation, and why must planets contain grades? Of course... This is not fixed, but you... Don’t have it. Wang baole, who was entangled by the four binding threads, thought to himself, at that moment, he deeply understood the power of the laws of the special stars. To cultivators who did not possess the laws, it was terrifying.
At the same time, he also realized how earth-shattering it was to have his nine ancient stars upgraded into Dao Stars.
“The Dao of green plants!”As the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord Roared, the mark formed by his body and the two mid-stage planets shone and poured towards Wang Baole. Wang Baole spoke calmly.
As soon as he spoke, the threads around his body trembled violently. Even though they were formed by the self-detonation of the four planets, they were still trembling. They loosened their grip and were even suppressed, they floated around Wang Baole!
This scene caused the heavenly spirit Palm’s expression to change drastically. However, before he could react, Wang Baole had already raised his right hand. A cold glint appeared in his eyes as he pointed at the incoming light seal!
“White is the Dao of light!”
In an instant, the gigantic light seal grew dimmer the moment it neared. A large number of light spots dispersed and gathered in front of Wang Baole’s finger. It was as if wherever his finger was.., it was like the source of all light. In the next instant... The finger that had absorbed all the light spots replaced everything else and became the only existence in the four galaxies.
As the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord and the two mid-stage planets behind him were filled with disbelief and shock, Wang Baole’s finger landed in front of them!
“Ashes to Ashes, dust to dust, it’s over.”

chapters.title: Chapter 981 - was accurate!
chapters.content:
Chapter 981: was accurate!
He had used the Dao of light to gather the heavenly spirit seal’s rules and use it to counter-suppress them. The instant this divine ability was unleashed from Wang Baole’s hands, the impact it had had on the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord and the others could be said to be earth-shattering.
He could accept the fact that Wang baole had a powerful cultivator from the star domain as his master. He could accept the fact that Wang Baole had made a breakthrough in his cultivation upon his return. He could also accept how powerful the Human Dao Star before him had become after fusing with it, however, he could not accept... that the rules that he had put in all his effort to form were actually too exaggerated to describe as being unable to withstand a single blow in front of the other party..
“Is the gap between an immortal star and a dao star... really that big? !”The heavenly spirit palm master laughed bitterly, an intense look of unwillingness appeared in his eyes. Although he had never seen cultivators of the same realm on a dao star in his life, it was not as if he had never fought a cultivator of the same realm on a special planet before. Although he was not a match for the other party, he was still able to barely fight the other party with his dense cultivation base.
But now... he suddenly realized that he had been wrong. He had been extremely wrong. The suppression of the Dao planet against the immortal planet meant that his so-called powerful cultivation was nothing more than a joke.
In front of the rules, everything seemed insignificant!
There was no doubt that Wang Baole had grasped so many rules that the heavenly spirit Palm Lord felt like he was on the verge of breaking down. However, he was a late-stage cultivator of the planet, and he hadn’t inherited his status as the heavenly spirit Palm Lord, he had gained it through brutal slaughter.
That was why he was extremely experienced in combat. The moment Wang Baole pointed in the opposite direction, the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord’s eyes were filled with madness. He spread his hands out and grabbed the two mid-stage planets beside him, the two of them were pale and shocked. The Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord unleashed his full power and pushed the two of them toward Wang Baole’s incoming fingers!
“Palm Lord, you!”
“Palm Lord!”
Everything happened too quickly. With Wang Baole’s finger closing in, the difference between the mid-stage and late-stage planets, and the difference between the immortal planet and the Spirit Planet, the two mid-stage planets were unable to fight back. As they roared in anger.., they couldn’t help but pounce towards Wang Baole.
The instant they pounced, a destructive aura erupted from their bodies. It wasn’t that they wanted to self-destruct, but that the heavenly spirit Palm Lord didn’t just push them forward, the influx of his cultivation caused the already chaotic cultivation of his two kinsmen to be ignited. They couldn’t control the ripples of self-destruction.
...
In the next instant, when they collided with Wang Baole’s descending finger of light, a loud boom reverberated in the air. The bodies of the two mid-stage cultivators who had exhausted their potential and been set ablaze instantly exploded, their planets also shattered in that instant, turning into a destructive force that exploded crazily in front of Wang Baole.
From Afar, the self-destruction of the two planets was even more powerful than the destruction of the planets. They turned into two huge maelstroms of flesh and blood, drowning Wang Baole within.
However, this scene did not make the heavenly spirit palm lord heave a sigh of relief. He was still nervous. The danger of life and death grew even more intense. With the help of the self-destruction of the two mid-stage planets, he retreated abruptly, in that instant, his entire body was covered in a blood-red glow. It was obvious that he had activated a mystic technique and was trying to escape at top speed at all costs.
His speed was so fast that it was visible to the naked eye just a breath ago. However, in the next instant, he had disappeared without a trace. The only things left on the battlefield were the two blood and flesh vortexes. As they continued to rumble, they spread out in all directions, as if they wanted to destroy everything in this place.
However... They couldn’t destroy Wang Baole!
At that moment, Wang Baole was no longer a clone. He had fused with his original body and possessed a real physical body. His physical body was already powerful to begin with, and as a result of the fusion, his physical strength had improved. He had now reached the level of a physical planet, coupled with the transformation of the Emperor armor, he didn’t Dodge at all. He walked out of the two flesh vortexes step by step.
His long hair danced in the wind. Dressed in black, Wang Baole turned his head to look in the direction where the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord had fled. Then, he turned his head and looked in another direction, his expression calm.
“Only these two are left.”As he muttered to himself, Wang Baole raised his right hand and grabbed at the air. He spoke calmly.
“Yellow Flame Dao!”
As soon as he spoke, the starry sky around him rumbled. The Sea of fire left behind by the blazing flame ancestor, which enveloped the entire God’s eye civilization, instantly surged. It was as if at that moment, Wang Baole had used his ancient star Flame Dao.., fuse his own will into the Sea of fire around him and control and control it!
If it had been the Flames unleashed by a mighty figure from another galaxy, even if Wang Baole possessed the ancient star laws, it would have been nearly impossible for him to shake it. After all, the difference between them was too great. However, the blazing flame ancestor’s recognition of him.., made all the difference.
The Sea of fire that had remained in the divine eye civilization didn’t reject Wang Baole. Instead, it was filled with passion. In the blink of an eye, the divine eye civilization erupted according to his divine thoughts. It rose from the edges of the surrounding area.., it swept towards Wang Baole with a force that could topple mountains and overturn seas.
If one could stand at a high enough position and look down, one could clearly see the sea of fire that was filled with the god’s eye civilization. It was like a giant ring of fire. The Ring of fire was shrinking rapidly, and everything within it.., as long as one didn’t have Wang Baole’s permission, they wouldn’t be able to charge out of the Ring of fire. They could only retreat continuously as the flames churned!
The speed of the retreat was extremely fast. The entire process took about ten breaths of time. As Wang Baole raised his hand, two pathetic figures appeared on his left and right. They were forced back by the shrinking sea of flames, they were forced back.
On the left was the heavenly spirit Palm Lord, and on the right... was the heaven palm ancestor!
Both of them had looks of despair on their faces. The sense of powerlessness that came from the bottom of their hearts made them laugh bitterly. However, compared to the heaven palm ancestor, the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord was clearly more furious. After being forced out.., he glared at Wang Baole and roared.
“Wang Baole, kill him as soon as possible!”
“But!”Wang Baole’s cold voice was the response. The figure that appeared in front of the Heavenly Spirit Palm Lord in an instant and... Wang Baole’s right index finger!
However, the moment his index finger was pointed out, it was no longer flesh and blood. Instead, it turned into paper. It was the paper rules that the Dao Star had imprinted on it. As it landed, Wang Baole’s strange voice echoed in the heavenly spirit Palm Lord’s ears.
“Paper armament art!”
This art was a meteorite divine ability that Wang Baole had bought when he had left the meteorite lands. It was powerful, and with sufficient rules, it could turn everything into paper. It was like a seal, but also like a puppet!
In the next instant, when Wang Baole’s finger touched the heavenly spirit palm’s forehead, the heavenly spirit palm, who was unable to fight back under the suppression of the mighty figure’s flames and Wang Baole’s Dao Star, shuddered, the expression on his face froze. He forced himself to lower his head, and what he saw was his own body, which was turning into paper that could be seen with the naked eye.
The entire process took only seven to eight breaths. Eventually, the trembling sky palm elder witnessed it with his own eyes. He saw the heavenly spirit palm elder turn into a paper figurine and shrink rapidly, turning into the size of a palm, he landed in Wang Baole’s hand and kept it.
This scene made the sky palm elder’s scalp tingle. He was shocked to the extreme. He saw Wang Baole turn around and stare at him.
The moment their eyes met, Wang Baole raised his right hand and pointed. Instantly, a white light that contained the rules of paper approached the Sky Palm Elder. The moment the white light approached.., the sky palm elder knelt down without hesitation. At that moment, he didn’t care about his status, his cultivation, or anything else. He only cared about life and death. He spoke quickly!
“I am willing to be your slave, and I will never betray you!”
The moment he said that, Wang Baole’s paper law beam paused in front of the sky-palm Elder’s forehead. Wang Baole fell silent as well, as if he was deep in thought.
The entire process took about ten breaths. To the sky-palm Elder, these ten breaths were long and endless. It made him feel extremely tormented. His body trembled even more. Just as he was feeling anxious and desperate, as if he could no longer control himself.., he finally heard a voice that, to him, was like the sound of nature, filled with hope.
“Approved!”
As the voice reverberated, the beam of light in front of him changed abruptly, eventually turning into a mark that contained the will of the Dao Star. It was instantly imprinted between the sky-palm Elder’s brows!
From then on, all of his thoughts, all of his life and death, were in Wang Baole’s hands. Due to the will of the Dao Star, the mark was recognized by the laws of the starry skies. Unless someone from the same dao star could suppress Wang Baole.., only then could it be forcefully erased. Otherwise... it would exist forever!
—
Was the delay that serious.

chapters.title: Chapter 982 - , Return!
chapters.content:
Chapter 982:, Return!
After leaving the mark between the Heaven Palm Elder’s brows, Wang Baole turned his head and looked at the entire God’s eye civilization. His eyes were deep in thought. His silence caused the entire God’s eye civilization to be filled with a sense of oppression. The Heaven Palm Elder behind him.., was even more so.
Even though he had managed to survive and knew that his life wouldn’t be in danger for a short period of time, when faced with Wang Baole who had fallen silent, the Heaven Palm Elder’s heart was filled with more fear than bitterness.
On one hand, he was afraid of Wang Baole’s background. On the other hand, he was afraid of the changes in his abilities.
The entire galaxy was silent. All the cultivators from the purple gold civilization had basically been wiped out.
As for the native cultivators from the divine eye civilization, they were mostly scattered across the stars. Many of them felt the terror of the battle in the galaxy and were shaken.
Fairy Ling You and the others, the people Wang Baole was familiar with in the sky palm sect, were like that. They were all anxious and uncertain about the future. They knew very well... that the divine eye civilization had reached its end.
The three great sects that had once existed in name were now practically dead. There was only one planet left from the three great planets, and the royal family, which had been able to survive, had also disappeared, this caused all the natives of the divine eye civilization to feel bitter and uncertain about their future.
They couldn’t blame Wang Baole for all this. It could even be said that without Wang Baole, the current divine eye civilization would have been even more tragic.
Amidst the silence, the starry sky grew increasingly silent. After a long while, Wang Baole retracted his gaze and spoke calmly to the sky-palm elder behind him.
“Tidy up the battlefield and appease all the surviving native creatures. Pass down the instructions... The God’s eye civilization will not disappear, but it will welcome a new life. One month later, I will relocate the entire God’s eye civilization and join the Earth Federation.” Wang baole ignored the complicated emotions of the sky-palm Elder. Instead, in a flash, he shattered the bubble that had trapped Zhao Yameng, the donkey, and Xiao Wu. He carried them and took a step forward, disappearing from the spot.
When he reappeared, he was already inside the divine eye star.
...
Migrating a civilization back to the solar system and integrating it into the sun would increase the concentration of the Spirit Qi in the entire federation. At the same time, it would also greatly increase the level of the federation. This was the way to upgrade a civilization, it was also the decision that Wang Baole had made in his heart.
This process wouldn’t cause any life-or-death damage to the divine eye civilization. It was just that from then on, they would have a master-subordinate relationship. After integrating into the Solar System’s star, all the past and future life forms born within the divine eye civilization.., they would be closely connected to the solar system throughout their lives. They couldn’t be betrayed!
This price might seem cruel and could be considered a form of attachment, but it was still better than being enslaved by the purple gold civilization. At the very least, Wang Baole was there. As the first civilization to join the solar system, their status might not seem high, but they still had a certain level of dignity, furthermore, according to Wang Baole’s thoughts, if there was a chance, he would allow more civilizations to join the Federation. This would allow the federation’s level of civilization to increase again and again.
This would not only bring great benefits to the federation, but it would also bring great benefits to all the lives born in the federation. The most basic thing... was the increase in cultivation. Once the fusion was successful.., then, all the federation cultivators, including Wang Baole, would instantly receive a gift from the advancement of the level of civilization. Their cultivation would increase to a greater or lesser extent.
Now, all the conditions for migration had been met. However, to migrate a civilization, even with Wang Baole’s current cultivation level, he still needed to make some preparations in order to ensure that everything would go smoothly, therefore, while the sky-palm Elder arranged for the outside world to be reorganized, Wang Baole, who had appeared in the divine eye star, sat down cross-legged. He spread out his spiritual perception and merged it with the star, beginning to accumulate power.
According to his judgment, the accumulation of power would reach its peak in about a month’s time. When that time came, he would be able to begin his migration, instantly sending the entire divine eye civilization... into the solar system.
While he was accumulating power, Wang Baole’s clone also condensed once again from his original body. Even though the fusion of the clone and his original body would make the accumulation of power faster, the main source of power came from the divine eye star, therefore, even if the gathering of strength was faster, it wouldn’t be much faster. Furthermore, Wang Baole had already left the federation for too long. He needed to make a trip back first and make some preparations in the solar system so that there wouldn’t be any accidents during the fusion.
Therefore, Wang Baole planned to let his clone return first. Before he returned, he had a discussion with the awakened Zhao Yameng. Zhao Yameng didn’t choose to follow Wang Baole’s clone back to the Federation. Instead, she chose to temporarily stay in the divine eye civilization, that was because she had suggested to Wang baole that since the God’s eye civilization was to belong to the federation completely, other than the merger of the stars, there was also a place for the heart.
“Baole, I suggest that you... ascend to the throne in the God’s eye civilization and become the new divine emperor!”
“That is the only way you can gain the full approval of the God’s eye civilization. It will also allow them to be more loyal after they merge with the Solar System, and there won’t be too much of a panic.”
Wang Baole thought for a moment and nodded in response to Zhao Yameng’s suggestion. He didn’t need to be involved in this matter. Zhao Yameng’s purpose in staying behind was to help Wang Baole successfully integrate all the cultivators of the divine eye civilization.
With the cooperation of the sky-palm Elder and Zhao Yameng’s skill, this wasn’t difficult. What Wang Baole needed to do was to send a projection to carry out the ascension ceremony when he was needed.
All of this had to be completed within a month. After that, Zhao Yameng would return to the Solar System with the divine eye civilization through the stellar transference.
The donkey and Xiaowu didn’t return immediately either. They stayed behind to complete the task with Zhao Yameng.
After a discussion, Wang Baole thought about it and confirmed that there were no hidden dangers. After all, his original body was in the divine eye star. If there were any other changes, he could wake up at any time. He could rely on the stellar eye to bring his clone back in an instant.
After making his decision, Wang Baole and Zhao Yameng discussed the details. Finally, under the glow of the star eye, the Sea of light covered the entire divine eye civilization, wang Baole’s clone left the divine eye civilization.
As the power of the star exploded and was sent out, ripples appeared out of thin air in the space outside the Solar System. They formed rings of light that spread out in all directions. Wang Baole’s figure gradually emerged from the blurry outline, he slowly transformed from an illusion into a solid form. The entire process lasted for about an hour. It was only when the surrounding transmission rings slowly dimmed that Wang Baole’s silhouette truly appeared!
The reason why it took so long was because the distance was too far. This was also the reason why Wang Baole had to return first to make preparations. After all, migrating a civilization would take even longer, and if there was any interference in the process.., there would be some backlash.
His clone was fine. If anything really happened, he could just disperse. It might affect his original body, but it wouldn’t be too much. However, if there was a backlash during the civilization migration, it would be a huge loss.
As the teleportation ended, Wang Baole slowly opened his eyes. As he looked around, the cultivation of the planet exploded within his body. It came from the familiar starry sky around him, stirring up waves in his previously calm heart.
“Finally... I’m back...”Wang Baole muttered. He had been away for decades, and he missed his hometown very much. He missed his parents even more.
However, as he embarked on this path of cultivation, many things were beyond his control. At that moment, he felt as if he was afraid of his hometown. Wang Baole felt a little uneasy. He stood outside the Solar System for a long while before his body swayed and he flew towards the Solar System.
His speed wasn’t fast at first, but as he flew, as his mood fluctuated, it became faster and faster. In the end, his entire body turned into a long rainbow that seemed to be able to tear apart the starry sky, in the next instant, he passed through the invisible barrier set up by the federation outside the Solar System and appeared directly within the Solar System!
Earth, Mercury, Mars, Venus, Jupiter..
The moment he stepped into the Solar System, a happy smile appeared on Wang Baole’s face. He could not help but spread out his divine perception and saw the familiar stars, he also saw the Sun at its core and the ancient green-bronze sword that was inserted into the sun.
However, in the next instant, the smile that appeared on Wang Baole’s face froze..
That was because the glow of the sun seemed to be something wrong!
Something’s wrong? Wang Baole’s expression changed, and his heart skipped a beat!

chapters.title: Chapter 983 - anger!
chapters.content:
Chapter 983:, anger!
There was something wrong with the glow of the Sun in the Solar System. To be more precise, it was brighter than when Wang Baole had left. There was also a faint halo of light outside.
This halo was different from the normal halo of the Sun. It could only be seen when one’s cultivation had reached the planet. It was impossible to see anything below the planet.
At that moment, the circle of light was clearly visible to Wang Baole. At the same time, he saw the source of the circle... it was the ancient bronze sword. To be precise, it was at the tip of the sword! There was an aura that was using a special method to pull the sun. On one hand, it was slowly absorbing the power of the Sun. On the other hand, it was an indirect influence, causing the Sun in the Solar System... to slowly die!
The reason why it was getting brighter was that it was like a last ray of light. Even though it hadn’t reached the state of death yet, based on this process, it was estimated that in another thousand years, the Sun in the solar system would be completely extinguished.
This scene caused Wang Baole’s expression to change. At the same time, he couldn’t tell whether what he was seeing was something that had appeared after he had left, or... something that had happened before he had left. It was just that his cultivation wasn’t high enough.., that was why he hadn’t noticed it.
Regardless, Wang Baole could still sense the planet’s fluctuations from the aura emanating from the tip of the sword. This allowed him to be certain of one thing... that something had happened at the spot where the mighty cultivator from the vast expanse dao palace was sleeping, something must have happened.
“Using the stars of my solar system to heal my injuries...”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He didn’t act rashly. After all, as his cultivation increased, his understanding of what had happened in the Vast Expanse Dao palace grew deeper, at the same time, he needed to find out if there had been any changes in the federation recently.
If there hadn’t been any changes, it meant that the sun had been like this before he had left. It was just that he hadn’t noticed it. However, if there had been any changes in the federation, it was more likely that it had happened recently.
The former and the latter would cause him to have two different attitudes towards the vast Expanse Dao Palace. Therefore, after making a decision, Wang Baole immediately spread out his consciousness and enveloped earth.
However, in the next instant, Wang Baole’s expression changed again. His consciousness was hidden, so no one could detect his existence. However, in his consciousness, as his consciousness swept across, everything on Earth was clearly visible.
He didn’t find Duan Muque’s aura, nor did he find the aura of the ethereal sect’s grand supreme elder. There wasn’t even the aura of Lin You or anyone he was familiar with.
...
Wang Baole was shaken. He looked towards ethereal city. There... the ethereal dao college had disappeared. The lake that had once been there seemed to have experienced the flames of war. It had turned into a deep pit, and one could see it, there was a giant handprint.
It was as if a giant hand had descended from the sky and flattened all the islands in ethereal dao college.
What made Wang Baole tremble even more... was that he couldn’t find any trace of his parents’aura in ethereal city, or even in all the regions on Earth!
He could only see traces of the divine abilities left behind in many regions on Earth. There was also... no smile on anyone’s face. There was a deep sense of exhaustion on everyone’s faces.
All of this made Wang Baole feel a strong sense of unease. After experiencing the massacre within the God’s eye civilization, the killing intent that he had managed to calm down with great difficulty surged in his heart once again. He didn’t hesitate at all. His divine perception spread out instantly, it spread out from Earth and swept across the entire Solar System.
Mercury, Jupiter, Saturn, Pluto, and other planets flashed across his divine perception instantly.
It was a barren land..
Just as Wang Baole was about to lose control of his killing intent and anxiety, and he was about to explode from his trembling body, his mind covered Mars. There, he sensed a large number of familiar presences, which caused his body to tremble, he didn’t bother with the rest of the presences. Instead, he focused all his attention on the presences of the two people in a house in his new Martian city.
The moment he saw the two of them, the killing intent in Wang Baole’s body instantly subsided, and his eyes softened. They were his parents.
In the small house, he saw his father. His hair was mostly white, and he was sitting there looking at the distant sky. It was unknown what he was thinking about, but beside him, leaning on his shoulder.., it was Wang Baole’s mother.
She was clearly much older, and there were some wrinkles on her face. At that moment, she was lowering her head and coughing incessantly as she looked at the photo in her hand. In the photo, there was a little fatty with both hands raised high, his index and middle fingers stretched out.., he was in a victorious posture.
The Little Fatty’s body was round, and his eyes were like slits. A smug smile appeared on his face.
This scene was filled with longing. Wang Baole fell silent and felt guilty. He noticed his mother coughing occasionally, and he noticed the confusion in his father’s eyes.
“Dad... Mom...”Wang Baole mumbled. His body, which was in the starry skies, disappeared instantly. In the next moment... in the house in the new Martian city, behind his parents, Wang Baole appeared instantly, the moment he appeared, he knelt down.
The moment his voice was heard, his parents, who were in front of him, trembled violently. They turned their heads slowly and saw their son, whom they missed. However, everything happened too suddenly, they seemed to be unable to believe that what they saw was real. As their bodies trembled, the photo in Wang Baole’s mother’s hands fell to the ground.
“Baole?”
“Dad, Mom, I’m back,”Wang Baole said softly.
Even though his appearance had changed, his parents still recognized him at a glance. His mother hugged him, and tears streamed down her face unknowingly. She was unable to speak for a long while.
Patting his mother’s back gently, Wang Baole listened to his mother’s words, which were filled with longing and crying. Wang Baole felt even more guilty. At the same time, he could not suppress the anger in his heart, which had reached its peak.
However, in front of his parents, he hid his anger. He looked at his father, who was beside him and was filled with emotion and sorrow. Wang baole nodded gently. With the gentle comfort of his cultivation.., gradually, his old mother fell asleep in his arms.
He placed his mother gently on the bed and covered her with the blanket. Wang Baole raised his head and looked at his father. He went up and hugged his father, who was at a loss.
“Dad, Tell Me, who hurt my mother?”
Even though he was already controlling those words, the anger that filled his heart caused the entire Mars to Rumble. Everyone who lived on Mars couldn’t help but be shocked.
The reason why he was so angry was because... the moment he saw his mother, Wang Baole had already noticed that his mother’s body was extremely weak. It was obvious that her life foundation had been damaged, and she was at the stage where she was at the end of her life, furthermore, there was still the fluctuation of a spell that had been forcefully sustained by someone else.
“Baole...”Wang Baole’s father was clearly still in a state of agitation. Under Wang Baole’s comforting, it took him a long time to recover. Looking at his son, he finally could not control his tears, he held his hand and told him everything he knew after Wang Baole had left.
Three years after Wang Baole’s departure, the situation on Earth had changed drastically!
The five generation Sky clan had once risen to power. The Zhuo family and the Li family had taken the lead and changed the political situation in the Solar System. Feng Qiuran had been forcibly detained, Li Xingwen had been severely injured, Duan Muque... had died in battle, and all four dao colleges had been destroyed, all the members of Duan Muque and Li Xingwen’s lineage had lost their power. More than half of the council members had died in battle, and the rest had been severely injured.
In the end, the Martian colony governor and his wife had managed to defend Mars with their newly created antimatter weapons. All those who had been severely injured during the changes in the situation had been relocated to Mars. While they were barely holding on, they had no choice but to bow down to the five generation Sky clan and accept their rule in name.
Wang Baole’s parents had been affected by the destruction of Ethereal Dao College. During the relocation, the Zhuo family’s hatred for Wang Baole had prevented them from doing so. Li Xingwen and the others had eventually managed to send Wang Baole’s parents back safely, however, her mother had still been severely injured and had yet to recover.
The reason for the change was all because... a planet cultivator had awakened on the ancient green-bronze sword!

chapters.title: Chapter 984 - attacking the Federation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 984:, attacking the Federation!
Wang Baole’s father wasn’t too clear about the other matters. What he knew and what he had told Wang Baole weren’t any secrets. They were modern history that most people in the federation were aware of.
As he listened to his father’s words, the anger in Wang Baole’s heart surged. He hadn’t planned to act rashly when he had sensed the changes in the ancient green-bronze sword, but now, his thoughts had completely changed.
“And the five generation Sky clan... The Zhuo family... how dare you!”The change in Wang Baole’s emotions once again triggered the rumbling of Mars. The cultivators on Mars were shocked and didn’t know why, wang Baole looked at his father’s white hair. He raised his right hand, and the power of essence spread out without form, fusing into his father’s body.
In an instant, the wrinkles on his father’s face disappeared, and his hair recovered. Wang Baole treated his injuries more carefully, and his mother, who was in a deep sleep, also recovered her black hair. From her appearance, it didn’t matter if it was her age or her spirit energy, it was a visible change.
No one else in the federation was able to resolve it. The only problem was that Wang Baole could forcefully prolong their lives. It wasn’t difficult for him to do so. All he needed to do was to use his own essence.
He knew very well that he couldn’t allow his parents to exist forever. However, what he could do was to make them healthy and live to the limit of their soul years. When that time came, would he be able to extend their lives, wang Baole didn’t know about that, and he didn’t want to think about it.
What he was thinking about now was his parents’health and well-being. At the same time, the Zhuo family and the five generation Sky clan, who had almost caused the death of his parents, were nothing more than skeletons in his heart.
That was why he condensed his clone into a figure. While he stayed here to accompany his parents, his clone had already left home. When it appeared... It was in a secret chamber deep underground in the Martian capital.
An elder sat cross-legged in the secret chamber. He was thin and pale, and his face was clearly tired. There was a bulge on his neck, and it looked like a creature was squirming inside. Every time it squirmed.., it would bring immense pain to the elder, causing his expression to distort.
This elder... was the ethereal dao college’s Grand Supreme Elder, Li Xingwen!
Li Xingwen didn’t notice Wang Baole’s appearance at all. He was trying his best to suppress his injuries, which had been with him for many years. He had to suppress his injuries every day for a fixed period of time. That was the only way.., he could barely survive.
...
It wasn’t that he was afraid of death, but that he wasn’t willing to leave just like that. That was why he persevered despite the immense pain he was in. He understood that he was a pillar of support for everyone on Mars!
His existence meant that everyone on Mars still had hope. If he died, the senator, the governor, and all the other powerful cultivators of his generation.., they would all lose hope.
After all, he was the president who had created the spirit inception era. He had joined forces with his successor, Duan Muque, to push the federation into an alliance. He had reached an unprecedented height. His prestige was more important than his cultivation.
Duan Muque’s death in battle, everyone’s serious injuries, and Feng Qiuran’s imprisonment had placed an even heavier burden on him. Even so, he still went to treat Wang Baole’s mother regularly, it wasn’t because he knew that Wang Baole had become a planet. It was because in his heart, Wang Baole and the other people involved in the Dark Swallow Plan were the hope of the Federation.
Wang Baole looked at Li Xingwen, who had a pained expression on his face. His eyes were filled with respect and gratitude, and he felt even more apologetic. He instantly raised his right hand and pointed at the bulge on Li Xingwen’s neck.
The bulge trembled under his finger, and there seemed to be a cry for mercy coming from within. In that instant, the bulge shattered, and a black thread worm flew out rapidly from within. It seemed like it was about to leave, but what awaited it.., was the frozen look in Wang Baole’s eyes, as well as... Ashes and smoke.
As it shattered, Li Xingwen’s body trembled. He opened his eyes in a daze, and he immediately saw Wang Baole before him. His expression changed at first, but after a careful examination, his expression changed to one of excitement and disbelief.
“Baole?”
“Your disciple greets the grand supreme elder!”Wang Baole cupped his fists and bowed deeply. At the same time, he released his origin energy and infused it into Li Xingwen’s body, causing his injuries to recover rapidly in an instant. The entire process took three to five breaths, li Xingwen’s skinny body returned to normal. At that moment, his cultivation erupted. He was no longer in the nascent soul realm, but in the imminent deity realm!
This was not Wang Baole’s help. As the first batch of cultivators from the Earth’s spirit inception era, Li Xingwen was naturally talented. Due to the level of civilization, it seemed difficult for him to advance. However, after Wang Baole left.., he had relied on himself to achieve a breakthrough, and he had advanced to the Spirit Ascension Realm.
“It’s good that you’re back. It’s good that you’re back!”Li Xingwen didn’t care about his recovery. In his excitement, he looked carefully at Wang Baole. The Joy in his eyes made Wang Baole feel even more guilty, he felt that he had come back too late..
If he had come back earlier, the situation might not have turned out this way. Therefore, after paying his respects, Wang Baole immediately asked about the details of the changes in the Earth’s structure that he hadn’t gotten from his father.
With Li Xingwen’s words, Wang Baole finally gained a detailed understanding of the changes in the Earth’s structure!
To the Solar System and the federation civilization... The existence of the planet cultivators who had awakened from the ancient bronze sword was terrifying enough to cause a tremendous change in the entire civilization, it would be easy for them to wipe out the federation in the starry skies.
As for the awakened one, although he did not wipe out the federation at that time, he was not a gentle person like Feng Qiuran. Instead, he strongly advocated using the Solar System to restore the glory of the Vast Expanse Dao Palace, hence, he was very dissatisfied with the alliance between Feng Qiuran and the federation.
Hence, when he went out with the ancient bronze sword, he directly captured Feng Qiuran and the other disciples of the Vast Expanse Dao palace and imprisoned them in the Vast Expanse Dao Palace. At the same time, he took over Feng Qiuran’s authority, forcing the disciples of the Vast Expanse Dao palace to have no choice but to obey.
He even personally killed Duan Muque to establish his authority. However, due to the fact that he had not fully recovered from his injuries, after he had done all this, he supported the five generation Sky clan, who had voluntarily submitted to him, he made them the new authority figures of the Federation, acting as puppets of the Vast Expanse Dao palace to carry out his will.
The five generation Sky clan was already extremely displeased with Duan Muque and Li Xingwen. Hence, under their leadership and with the support of that planet mighty figure, they began a bloodbath!
The march group was plundered, the Jin family patriarch perished, and all four dao colleges were wiped out. Other than the ethereal dao college, which had more than half of its disciples relocated to Mars, almost all of the other three dao colleges were wiped out.
There was also the Council of Representatives. Nine of them died in battle, and the rest either surrendered or fled to Mars. Among them, the council member was severely injured, and his cultivation base had also dropped drastically. He was now a mortal.
As for Lin You, he rose to prominence in this battle. His cultivation base had broken through to the spirit realm, and with the cooperation of the Martian colony governor and Li Xingwen, he had migrated to Mars.
In addition, the stellar sources of Jupiter, Saturn, and Venus had all been extracted and used by the vast Expanse Dao palace to treat their injuries. The star Sun had also, with the help of the five generation Sky clan, followed the request of the planet mighty figure, a large number of array formations were set up, making it the source of power for the Vast Expanse Dao Palace to recover.
As for Mars, when everyone had fled to this place to defend, they had originally been unable to fight against the planet mighty figure behind the five generation Sky clan. However, after he had arrived and looked at Mars from afar, he was just about to make his move.., there seemed to be ripples spreading out from the Martian soil, causing the planet mighty figure to be a little apprehensive. That was why Mars had managed to hold on until now.
“It’s a dark artifact...”Wang Baole heard everything, and the coldness in his eyes grew stronger. He spoke slowly.
“That’s my guess. That’s what happened. Baole, the current federation... is what happened. What are you going to do next?”As Li Xingwen said that, his eyes lit up. He looked at Wang Baole. He had already sensed it, the dao college disciple before him had an unfathomable cultivation. In his opinion, he seemed to be even more powerful than the planet he had seen before.
What should I do... Wang Baole’s eyes flashed with killing intent.
“One punishment for each and every one of you is to pay the price for your wrongdoings. Those who hurt my family and friends will pay with their lives. As for the Vast Expanse Dao palace that lives in the solar system, it’s fine if they don’t pay the rent, but they still dare to do this. I will let them know that the owner of this place is angry!”Wang Baole said calmly, he spoke softly to the Masked Little Missy, who was standing in front of him.
“Little Missy, the Vast Expanse Dao Palace is at fault in this matter. Don’t blame me.”As he spoke, Wang Baole took a step forward and disappeared from Mars. When he reappeared... he was in the starry skies beyond Earth!
He took a step towards earth, filled with killing intent!

chapters.title: Chapter 985 - Crimson Star Rebirth!
chapters.content:
Chapter 985:, Crimson Star Rebirth!
The moment Wang Baole stepped onto Earth, a soft sigh reverberated in his mind. It was little Missy’s voice, but it was only a sigh. There were no other words.
It was obvious that even little Missy, who had sensed everything through Wang Baole’s doppelganger, found it inappropriate to speak up for the Vast Expanse Dao Palace. Wang Baole didn’t respond to the sigh either. He looked calm, however, the anger in his heart had already boiled over.
On one hand, it came from the experiences of his friends and acquaintances. More importantly... it came from his parents!
This was where Wang Baole’s reverse scale was located. At the same time, due to the guilt in his heart, he felt that he needed a place to vent his anger. That was why his figure instantly descended upon earth, when he appeared... It was the Earth Federation’s Presidential Palace!
The place where Duan Muque had once been was now ruled by the five generation Sky clan after Duan Muque’s death and the departure of Li Xingwen and the others. Compared to the past, it was obvious that the defensive array formation here was much stronger, on one hand, the hundred or so statues in the square were becoming more lifelike. They also contained extraordinary spirit qi fluctuations. It was as if these statues, which were refined based on legends and myths, could be revived and returned at any time, however, the original statues of Li Xingwen and Duan Muque had disappeared. They had been replaced by the statues of the five generation Sky clan’s family head.
There was also a layer of invisible light screen outside the presidential palace that cultivators could sense. This light screen formed a protective barrier. The source of the light screen was the divine weapon inside the Presidential Palace!
As a divine weapon that only the president could control, the scarlet flying knife in Duan Muque’s hands had been taken over by the five generation Sky clan after his death. It had been branded and continuously worshipped in the presidential palace.
As the figure appeared, Wang Baole stood in mid-air and lowered his head to look at the presidential palace below. Nothing could hide from his eyes. He saw the spirit qi attached to the hundreds of statues, he also saw the divine weapons being worshiped in the Presidential Palace, as well as the people coming and going in the area.
More than half of them were from the five generation Sky clan and were their clansmen. The person who had been elected president in the Presidential Palace was the head of the Chen clan, one of the five generation Sky clan!
His cultivation was also at the spirit realm. In the Presidential Palace, apart from him, there were four perfected nascent soul realm cultivators who were meditating deep underground.
It was clear that after they had become affiliated with the planet that had awakened in the vast Expanse Dao Palace, the five generation Sky clan had gained considerable benefits in terms of their cultivation, as well as their power. However, they had been so pleased with themselves that they had suppressed all opposition. They hadn’t truly realized that what they thought they had gained was nothing more than duckweed in the eyes of the true experts.
...
“Before I left that year, I should have been ruthless enough to wipe out the five generation Sky clan,”Wang Baole said softly. He was muttering to himself, but his cultivation was too high and he hadn’t been able to control it. That was why he was muttering to himself.., it instantly turned into bolts of lightning that exploded in the presidential palace.
To all the cultivators in the area, the sudden appearance of the voice, which was like a bolt of lightning, immediately caused their minds to rumble. They were completely unable to resist it. It was as if they were facing the might of the heavens, and they all spat out blood!
Those who didn’t have the bloodline of the five generation Sky clan might have coughed up blood and lost consciousness in an instant, but their lives weren’t in danger. However, those with the bloodline of the five generation Sky clan wouldn’t be spared.
There might be innocent people in the five generation Sky clan, but Wang Baole wasn’t a saint. He couldn’t search each and every one of their souls to see who was good and who was bad. He could only scan them with his divine sense, causing the five generation Sky clan bloodline cultivators to.., blood flowed out of their seven orifices and orifices, and they fell one by one in an instant. Whether they lived or died depended on their own fate!
As the five generation Sky clan’s bloodline cultivators fell one by one, the president of the Chen family clan’s face changed drastically. The four perfected nascent soul realm five generation Sky clan elders in the depths of the underground were also shocked. They were the first to be activated, there were more than a hundred statues in the square!
These statues were clearly enhanced by the power of the planets. It was obvious that the planet cultivator who had awakened on the ancient green-bronze sword had used this technique before. However, his strength wasn’t even fully recovered, let alone his injuries. Even if he had fully recovered.., in the end, he wasn’t a match for Wang Baole. There was no need to even mention this external object that he had just used.
Therefore, in the blink of an eye, the more than a hundred statues opened their eyes at the same time. Each of them released a wave of Aura, as if they had been resurrected and were about to soar into the sky to fight against Wang Baole. However, in the blink of an eye, Wang Baole raised his right hand slightly and pressed down.
Instantly, a seemingly supreme power erupted without warning. It seemed to have transformed into a gigantic, invisible palm print. As it pressed down, the heavens and earth changed instantly. The winds and clouds swirled, and the hundred-plus statues that had just woken up.., they trembled in unison. Their opened eyes closed, and their bodies trembled as they knelt down towards Wang baole, who was standing in the sky.
As they knelt, the five generation sky clan’s family head statue shattered. The invisible barrier formed by the divine weapons outside the presidential palace could not withstand the force and shattered in an instant, as the mirror shattered, the presidential palace collapsed with a loud crash.
A Crimson Rainbow with a sharp intent soared into the sky and charged towards Wang Baole, as if it wanted to pierce through him. However, its speed became slower and slower until it reached Wang Baole, the crimson streak of light came to a complete halt. It trembled visibly in front of Wang Baole, revealing its true form.
It was a crimson flying dagger. It was... The Federation President’s Divine Weapon!
At the same time, as the crimson dagger trembled, the head of the Chen family rushed out of the collapsed presidential palace, Trembling. The four perfected nascent soul realm cultivators behind him flew out in fear, all of them looking at Wang Baole in the sky.
Senior, please calm down. Everything is my fault. No matter what request you have, as long as the federation civilization can fulfill it, I will definitely fulfill it... the head of the Chen family’s trembling heart turned into intense fear, he didn’t recognize Wang Baole immediately. His first reaction was that he had either arrived from outer space, or he was someone who had just woken up in the Vast Expanse Dao Palace.
That was why he didn’t ask what was going on. He went to apologize first. As he spoke, he immediately knelt down, as did the four nascent souls behind him.
Wang Baole glanced at the spineless Chen family head and thought of Duan Muque. Compared to him, the dog-like Chen family head wasn’t even worthy of being the president.
Wang baole sighed softly in his heart at the thought of Duan Muque. He looked at the trembling scarlet flying knife and said calmly.
“Since you are a sentient being, why are you helping the Wicked?”
When the red flying knife heard those words, it trembled even more violently. A sense of unwillingness, grievance, and grief could be faintly felt from within the blade.
Wang Baole felt the emotions of the red flying knife and fell silent. He had some understanding. This divine armament was a special item for the Federation president, and it had an agreement with the federation. It had always adhered to this agreement — whoever was the president.., it belonged to whoever.
Duan Muque’s death had made it sad and angry. However, in the face of that agreement and under the gaze of the planet’s Almighty, it had no choice but to comply.
“Go and cleanse the stain on your body.”Wang Baole shook his head. One spirit mastery realm cultivator and four nascent soul realm cultivators were dirty hands to him. He had turned around after finishing his sentence, he walked towards the gathering place of the five generation Sky clan, which was marked with his supernatural awareness.
The instant he turned around, the scarlet flying knife suddenly erupted with a dazzling light. Its killing intent was even more intense. It instantly turned into a scarlet rainbow and charged towards the ground. The clan head of the Chen clan was shocked, and the four nascent soul realm cultivators were in disbelief, the scarlet glow whizzed past the four nascent soul realm cultivators.
Instantly, the four nascent soul realm cultivators’heads flew into the air. As their nascent souls were destroyed, the Chen family head’s scalp went numb as he watched the Crimson flying knife fly past him once again. He was so terrified that he went mad. He turned towards Wang Baole, who was about to leave in the sky, he screamed hoarsely.
“Senior, what did I do wrong? I...”Before he could finish his sentence, the crimson beam exploded even more violently. As it charged forward, the blade shattered into dozens of pieces. It was the price he had to pay, it unleashed an astonishing power. No matter how much the patriarch of the Chen family tried to resist, he was unable to escape. It pierced through his chest!
As the Patriarch of the Chen family screamed in pain, his body and soul were destroyed. Dozens of flying knife fragments flew out from his corpse. They carried the aura of a divine armament that seemed to be on the verge of dissipating. The fragments flew up into the air with great difficulty amidst the darkness, they caught up to Wang Baole and floated in front of him. They were once again pieced together into flying knives. However, the cracks and the signs of death made it obvious to everyone that they were about to dissipate.
“From now on, your mission is no longer just to listen to the president, but also... to protect my family. As for now, Follow Me First!”Wang Baole said softly. He raised his right hand and waved it. An aura that belonged to his dao star surged into the shattered divine armament crimson star, the flying saber shards trembled, and their bodies emitted a strong glow, as if they had been reborn. The cracks on the blade healed rapidly, and at the same time, there was an aura that was even stronger than before, it rose explosively from its body!

chapters.title: Chapter 986 - -- five generations extermination!
chapters.content:
Chapter 986: — five generations extermination!
Wang baole, who had made his own dao oath and upgraded the nine ancient planets to dao stars, had the power of his oath contained within the aura of his dao stars. To a certain extent, his words were like a seal that could be sealed. Even if the scarlet flying knife was a divine weapon.., it could still be sealed.
That was why his words had changed the agreement between the Scarlet Flying Knife and the federation. He had used his own power to make the scarlet flying knife condense once again. That was equivalent to giving the scarlet flying knife a stroke of good fortune, allowing it to remain a divine weapon despite its level, however, in terms of its power, it had some karmic ties with Wang Baole, so it had indirectly borrowed the force to become stronger.
After hearing Wang Baole’s words, the black and scarlet flying knife trembled. As its aura erupted, it seemed to respond. Then, with a flash, it turned into a scarlet hairpin and stuck into Wang Baole’s hair, his hair was also coiled up, making the now slender Wang Baole look like an immortal.
He didn’t look at the collapsed presidential palace and the corpses on the ground. Instead, he stood in mid-air and walked into the distance. Behind him, in the ruins, people of the bloodline of the four great clans gradually stopped waking up, they looked at the ruins around them in a daze. They also saw Wang Baole disappearing into the sky. At the same time, they saw... the posture of more than a hundred statues, which had changed from standing to kneeling.
At that moment, it was the setting sun.
The glow of dusk shone on Wang Baole’s body, seemingly forming a layer of multicolored robes. As he walked further and further away, it was unknown who was the first amongst the awakened cultivators to kneel and kowtow to Wang Baole. Soon, all of the awakened cultivators.., they all bowed in unison in awe.
Wang Baole walked further and further away.
The gathering place of the five generation Sky clan wasn’t scattered. It was in a single place. It was different from what Wang Baole had remembered. It had completely become a city!
The city was so big that it had three ethereal cities. Other than the five generation Sky clan, there were also cultivators from the galactic dusk sect and the plume manifestation connate sect. It was clear that the two sects from back then had been torn apart by the changes in the situation, a portion of them had followed Li Xingwen to Mars, while the rest had joined the five generation Sky clan.
However, to Wang Baole, that wasn’t important. When he appeared above the city of the five generation Sky clan, the anger in his heart spread outwards, causing the sky to change color. It formed a majestic black cloud that enveloped the entire city.
However, the appearance of the Black Cloud and the Suppressive Force it exuded made it impossible for anyone in the city who wasn’t of the five generation Sky clan’s bloodline to see or sense it. Only the five generation Sky clan members.., all of them watched in shock. At the same time, the scene that happened in the presidential palace was transmitted to the upper echelons of the five generation Sky clan. The family head and elders of the five generation Sky clan were all shocked, waves of shock rose in their hearts.
...
“What the hell is going on?”
“When did we offend such a mighty figure?”
“Hurry up and report this to the seniors of the Dao Palace!”
The clan head and higher-ups of the five generation Sky clan were all extremely shocked. They were all thrown into chaos. Wang Baole, who was in mid-air, looked coldly at the people of the five generation Sky clan in the city and said calmly.
“Li!”
Li was the first member of the five generation Sky clan!
As soon as the words left his mouth, the Li clan’s current clan head, as well as the elders from the other three clans, who were in the meeting hall of the five generation Sky clan in the city, began to tremble violently, their eyes widened, and before they could say anything, their bodies shriveled like deflated rubber balls. Then, they turned into nothingness, as if they had been wiped out. Their bodies and souls were destroyed!
They weren’t the only ones. All the nascent soul realm cultivators, including the elders who had gone into seclusion in the Li family’s restricted area, as well as the Grand Supreme Elder, had died instantly.
In the end, Wang Baole... hadn’t been too involved. That was why he had only taken the lives of the nascent soul realm cultivators. Even so, the heads and elders of the other four great families were still shocked beyond words, the fear in their eyes was indescribable. After all, they had watched as the family head and elders of the Chen family died mysteriously right before their eyes!
“Senior, please spare us!”
“Senior, the Li family’s mistake has nothing to do with us!”
.
“Senior, the five generation Sky clan is dependent on senior de Yunzi...”
The other four great clans rose into the air in fear. They knelt and begged Wang baole, who was standing at the center of the endless black clouds in the sky.
Until now, they didn’t know what they had done wrong, nor did they know Wang Baole’s identity. Only the Zhuo family head, who was also Zhuo Yifan and Zhuo Yixian’s father, looked at Wang Baole, he vaguely felt that he looked familiar, but his heart trembled. He couldn’t quickly find the source of the familiarity in his mind. As he instinctively tried to recall, Wang Baole said his second surname.
“Chen!”
As soon as he said that, he flew into the air. The family head of the Chen family, as well as all the nascent soul realm elders in the four great clans, who were begging and kowtowing to Wang baole, trembled violently. Their eyes widened, and their bodies melted instantly, they were reduced to ashes!
This scene was an intense stimulation for the Zhuo family and the remaining families. They let out shrill cries at that moment, especially the family head of the Zhuo family. As his body trembled, the sense of familiarity instantly spread, he finally found the source. His eyes widened, and he couldn’t help but exclaim.
“You... You Are... Wang Baole!”
As soon as the Zhuo family head said that, the elders of his family clan and the people from the Zhou family were stunned. Disbelief appeared in their eyes. Even though Wang Baole had already reached the spirit realm before he had left, and he was the first person to do so.., however, it had only been a few years, and he had already reached such a terrifying level. This was something unimaginable to them.
“Wang Baole!”The Zhou family head’s heart trembled. He was about to speak again as his breathing quickened. However, what awaited him were the words “Zhou”that Wang Baole had said with a cold expression, as well as the surname “Luo Ke”from the western family clan of the five generation Sky clan.
In the next instant, the Patriarch of the two families and all the elders of their families vanished into nothingness. They were all dead. As for the Zhuo family, all the elders had gone mad, fleeing in all directions.
Even though they knew that they couldn’t escape, they still did so instinctively. Only the patriarch of the Zhuo family laughed bitterly. The moment he recognized Wang Baole, he knew that the Zhuo family... was finished.
He had given the order to hunt down Wang Baole’s parents. He had done so to vent the anger that had accumulated in his heart. However, he had never expected that even though he had the support of a planet-based mighty figure, the incident would still happen at this very moment, it was the sound of the family’s death knell.
“Why didn’t the planet from the Vast Expanse Dao palace come?”
“I don’t believe that he doesn’t know what happened here, but why didn’t he come?”The Zhuo family head roared in his heart. He smiled bitterly as he spoke quickly.
“Wang Baole, for the sake of Yifan, I’m his father after all...”
Wang Baole fell silent. He had asked Zhao Yameng about Zhuo Yifan’s whereabouts, but she didn’t know either. As his figure appeared in his mind, Wang Baole remained silent for a few breaths before speaking calmly.
“Zhuo!”
As soon as he spoke, the Zhuo family head’s body trembled, and blood flowed out of his eyes, ears, nose, and mouth. His hair turned white in an instant, and his cultivation fell from the great circle of the nascent Soul Realm to the core formation realm, then to the foundation establishment realm, and then to the foundation establishment realm. Then, he collapsed, when he became a mortal, blood spurted out of his mouth, and his body fell to the ground.
Other than the Zhuo family head, the elders who had scattered all over the place had all melted. It was as if they had never existed.
“I’ll leave your life for Yifan to take personally,”Wang Baole said calmly. He didn’t bother with the Zhuo family head whose cultivation had been crippled. Instead, he raised his head and looked up into the sky. The killing intent in his eyes didn’t diminish. Instead, it became even colder, he spoke calmly.
“Have you seen enough? Have you considered enough?”
As Wang Baole spoke, ripples suddenly appeared in the sky. They twisted and morphed. Then, countless threads appeared out of thin air and gathered together to form the figure of an elder.
The elder’s expression was unsightly. His eyes were sharp. He wore the Daoist robe of the vast dao palace and had five flying swords on his back that emitted sharp sword qi. He stared fixedly at Wang Baole as he spoke slowly in a hoarse voice.
“Young man, it’s not easy to advance to a planet. I advise you... not to be too arrogant. Otherwise... When you’re suppressed, you’ll definitely regret it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 987 - That was Chapter 987?
chapters.content:
Chapter 987: That was chapter 987?
The moment the elder appeared, the scenes of Wang Baole exterminating the five generation sky clan on Earth were transmitted to all the planets through the array formation in the Solar System.
It was as if all the cultivators and sentient beings on all the planets in the Solar System were watching a live broadcast. Most of them saw everything!
To the people on Earth, the five generation Sky clan’s rule over the past few years had exhausted them. It was as if the entire federation had been enslaved. They had to sacrifice everything for the recovery of the vast dao palace.
Not only had the monastery been destroyed and abolished, making it impossible for people to obtain knowledge, but at the same time, their cultivation advancement had also been interrupted, making it difficult for them to obtain cultivation techniques. However, this was still nothing. The most unbearable thing was that after the five generation Sky clan took over the government.., they required everyone to hand over an extremely high amount of spirit stones within a fixed period of time.
Once they were unable to complete it, they would be subjected to extremely cruel punishment!
This life of enslaving all living beings as if they were absent from work was a huge boulder that weighed down on everyone. One could even imagine that if this continued, the federation would be completely squeezed dry. To a certain extent, it could be said that they would have to pay with their lives.., to pay for the recovery of the vast Dao Palace!
Therefore, when they saw Wang Baole’s appearance and the destruction of the five generation Sky clan, the excited and excited voices of the people on the various planets immediately spread in all directions. This was especially true on Mars, where the governor and the others.., they had already heard about Wang Baole’s return from Li Xingwen, and when they saw all of this, their hearts were filled with excitement and excitement.
However, there was also worry and anxiety. This was especially so when the old man from the planet appeared. This anxiety reached its peak. Everyone looked over. On Earth, Wang Baole, who was in midair above the city of the five generation Sky clan, raised his head, he looked at the old man who had walked out from the sky. He could sense the fluctuations of the middle-stage cultivation of the old man’s planet. He could also sense that the old man’s planet was at the Spirit Planet Level.
“Are you the one who gave the five generation Sky clan the right to be arrogant?”Wang Baole asked slowly. Everything about the elder couldn’t be hidden under his dao planet status. He could see everything clearly. On the other hand, in the Elder’s eyes.., wang Baole’s vision was blurry.
This was also the reason why the elder hadn’t appeared despite his arrival. He could only determine that Wang Baole was a planet, but he didn’t know the details. That was why he hadn’t acted rashly. He had planned to see what the elder would do before making a decision.
However, now that he had been discovered, the old man, as a planet, had a certain level of confidence despite his fear. That was why he spoke coldly after walking out. His words contained a hint of a lesson.
...
His confidence stemmed from his confidence in his own cultivation, his reliance on the ancient green-bronze sword, and his contempt for the aboriginal cultivators in the Solar System. That was why Wang Baole looked at him coldly, as he asked a question in return, the elder snorted coldly.
“Young man, I am De Yunzi of the Vast Expanse Dao Palace. I am a new planet like you, but my body is still in a state of emptiness. My Essence, Qi, and spirit are still unable to materialize into a physical cultivator. I have seen too many things in my life. Considering that your cultivation is not easy, if you can assist the vast expanse dao palace in its cultivation here, I can recommend you to join the Vast Expanse Dao Palace and become a guest elder.”
“Now, it’s up to you to decide whether you want to fight me or join the Vast Expanse Dao Palace!”With that, de Yunzi lifted his right hand and performed an incantation gesture. Immediately, the five flying swords behind him began to shine with dazzling light, five streams of sword Qi shot up into the sky and gathered above his head to form an illusory planet. The power of the planet instantly spread out, transforming into a mighty pressure that enveloped the entire earth.
From his point of view, this native planet before him must have had some fortuitous encounter. The planet that it had fused with had surpassed him and should be at the level of an immortal planet. This made him feel jealous, but at the same time, he snorted coldly in his heart, he thought to himself that the other party was obviously blessed and could not control an immortal planet. Otherwise, this seemingly corporeal but clearly illusory scene would not have occurred.
In his mind, he did not consider the concept of the other party being a clone. From what he knew, the native before him had just advanced, and his body and planet were still in an unstable state.
Such a person, even if he was on the immortal planet, if he went all out and used some trump cards, he would still have a certain degree of confidence in suppressing him. At the same time, he was very satisfied with his words pointing out everything. The hidden meaning was to tell the other party.., don’t think that just because you have advanced to a planet, you can be arrogant in front of me.
It was also because of these judgments that his tone gradually became more and more forceful. His words reverberated in the air. His cultivation erupted, and sword qi surged. It was as if he was about to make a move at the slightest disagreement.
Wang Baole’s expression didn’t change in the slightest. He continued to stare coldly at the elder before him and spoke calmly.
“You’re saying that I’m arrogant?”
“You won’t shed a tear until you see the coffin!”The elder raised his eyebrows. He raised his right hand abruptly and descended toward Wang Baole. He spoke calmly.
“Suppress!”
As soon as he spoke, the sword Qi from the five flying swords behind him rose and gathered into a star. The light shone brightly, and an invisible pressure that was as vast as the ocean instantly gathered in all directions within his senses, it was as if it had formed an invisible hand that pressed down on Wang Baole from above!
Not only was his cultivation at the mid-stage planet realm rampaging at this moment, but the power of the ancient bronze sword that he had borrowed also descended at this moment. It caused the stars in the Solar System to flicker slightly, and the Suppressive Force instantly increased exponentially, the earth beneath Wang Baole trembled under the loud boom, and the air around him began to show signs of shattering!
However... to De Yunzi, the Suppressive Force felt like the ocean. To Wang Baole, however, it was merely a gust of strong wind. It didn’t even blow his hair up. To his body, it was completely unshakable.
“You said that I overestimated myself?”Wang Baole’s expression remained calm as he spoke calmly.
This scene immediately caused de Yunzi’s eyes to widen. Shock appeared in his eyes, and he quickly formed a seal with his hands. He let out a low growl, and the five flying swords behind him immediately rose into the air and gathered in midair, the stars that emerged from them became more and more corporeal. At the same time, the Suppressive Force increased exponentially and pressed down on Wang Baole once again.
Not only that, the five flying swords also turned into five long arcs that charged toward Wang baole with a sharp whistling sound!
With a loud boom, the Suppressive Force formed by the Stars landed on Wang Baole’s body. This time, the force was clearly much stronger than before. It finally lifted Wang Baole’s hair a little, and the five flying swords turned into long arcs.., they approached in an instant. However... The closer they got, the more they trembled. In the end, when they were ten feet away from him, they trembled to the extreme, and the light dimmed rapidly.
As Wang Baole raised his right hand, the five flying swords flew into his hand instantly. They were extremely obedient, and at the same time, they turned into five rings that automatically circled around Wang Baole’s fingers.
“That’s it?”Wang Baole said coldly.
“That’s impossible!”De Yunzi’s mind buzzed, his expression changed completely. The scene before his eyes had exceeded his imagination, and he found it extremely unbelievable. His body instinctively wanted to retreat, but the moment he did so, a cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes, he took a step forward.
He was so fast that he disappeared in an instant. Before de Yunzi could react, he appeared before him, raised his right hand, and threw a punch!
With just one punch, the sky and earth changed color, and the wind and clouds shattered. De Yunzi let out a shrill scream. Fresh blood spewed out of his mouth, and his body exploded with a loud bang!
Even the illusory planet outside was not spared. As his body collapsed, it was torn into pieces and forcefully blasted apart!
Only its soul, which was about to be torn apart, suddenly released a beam of light from the ancient bronze sword. It landed and surrounded it, pulling it rapidly, allowing de Yunzi’s soul to escape the calamity. With a shocked expression, it used the force to retreat rapidly, it flew out of earth and, under the pull of the beam of light, headed straight for the ancient bronze sword.
“Where can you escape to? Even this ancient bronze sword is in the federation’s territory,”Wang Baole said calmly. With a flash of his body, he gave chase!
As he gave chase, everyone in the Federation, who had seen everything through the Solar System Array Formation, felt their hearts thump. Their excitement and excitement exploded.
“Wang Baole!”
“The legend of our Ethereal Dao College, the strongest head prefect since ancient times, Wang Baole!”
“The strongest person in the federation, Wang Baole!”

chapters.title: Chapter 988 - “Old Fart, who are you talking about!”!
chapters.content:
Chapter 988:, “Old Fart, who are you talking about!”!
The entire federation was excited. Many cultivators flew into the air and looked at the rainbow in the sky. Their hearts were stirred. As everyone watched the scene live through the Solar System Array Formation, Wang Baole was extremely fast, he rushed out of Earth in an instant and took a step into the starry sky. He chased after de Yunzi, who was being pulled by the beam of light from the ancient bronze sword!
Seeing that he was about to be caught, de Yunzi, who was in the light beam, trembled. His eyes were filled with intense fear and shock, and he let out a shrill scream.
“Senior brother, save me!”
Almost at the same time as he said those words, as Wang Baole’s figure approached the light beam rapidly, a crack suddenly appeared in the void at the side. A large hand extended from the crack. It was illusory.., however, it was extremely fast. It contained the power of a planet, and it surpassed de Yunzi’s. It wasn’t a mid-stage planet, but a perfected Planet!
The moment it appeared, the large hand grabbed at Wang Baole!
I was just thinking that there might not only be one person who woke up! Wang baole laughed coldly as the large hand grabbed at him. He raised his right hand and pointed, and a large amount of fog appeared out of thin air, in front of him turned into a huge finger, it is the cloud finger, toward the big hand with a bang.
A loud noise reverberated in all directions. Amidst the loud noise, when Wang Baole’s cloud finger made contact with the large hand, violent waves were stirred up and spread out in all directions. From within the crack in the void, straight out of the shadows.
The man did not look old, but middle-aged. His face was gloomy. The moment he walked out, he raised his hands and waved them. Instantly, stars appeared behind him. He formed a seal with his hands, a piece of talisman paper appeared in front of him. As soon as the paper appeared, it expanded rapidly and became bigger in an instant. It headed straight for Wang Baole, where it was printed!
At the same time, the light beam de Yunzi, at this time also fiercely clenched his teeth, did not continue to escape, but rushed out from the light beam, two-handed incantation issued a roar of the soul.
“Seal!”
As he formed a seal, an illusory talisman paper materialized in front of him. Together with his senior brother’s talisman paper, it flew towards Wang Baole’s seal.
...
Wang Baole remained calm in the face of the duo’s joint attack. However, he narrowed his eyes and ignored the two symbols. Instead, he turned around abruptly. As he swept his gaze towards the void behind him, he raised his right hand and pressed down hard.
Immediately, the nine ancient planets behind him roared and materialized. The nine laws shone together, turning into nine rays of light that shot straight towards the empty void!
At the same time, Wang Baole didn’t hesitate at all. He exploded instantly, turning into a large amount of fog that spread rapidly in all directions. He tried to avoid the talismans from de Yunzi and his senior brother, he wanted to leave the area as well.
That was because at the spot where the nine laws were attacking, an aura that shook his heart and soul was revealed. This aura... in Wang Baole’s senses, it was no longer something that a planet could possess, it was clearly... the fluctuations of a star!
This series of actions and reactions happened in the blink of an eye. Just as Wang Baole’s body turned into fog and spread in all directions, the area that was blasted away by the nine rays of light formed by the nine laws.., a crack suddenly appeared in the starry sky. A black gourd flew out from within the crack!
The moment the gourd appeared, the mouth of the gourd opened on its own. A huge suction force erupted from within, and an aged voice sounded faintly from within the crack in the starry sky.
“Withdraw!”
As soon as the words were spoken, the nine streaks of light formed by the laws were unable to dodge and were immediately absorbed by the gourd. At the same time, the suction force from the gourd spread across the starry sky in all directions in an instant, causing a large amount of ripples to appear in the surrounding starry sky, it was as if it had frozen solid. The Mist formed by Wang Baole’s clone seemed to be compressed at that moment, unable to continue spreading. It was then absorbed and swept towards the gourd!
Even though Wang Baole’s clone, who had transformed into mist, was struggling, the gourd was clearly extraordinary. Its power erupted once again, causing the mist formed by Wang Baole to be instantly swept away. It could be seen with the naked eye.., it was sucked into the Calabash in an instant!
At the same time, the moment the mist that Wang Baole’s clone had turned into was sucked into the calabash, Wang Baole’s actual body, who was meditating in seclusion in the divine eye star, which was located far away from the divine eye civilization, suddenly opened his eyes!
