As he opened his eyes, the flames of the divine eye star erupted. Bolts of lightning danced and spread throughout the divine eye civilization. Wang Baole, who had opened his eyes, was filled with a terrifying aura. A cold glint flashed in his eyes, a terrifying ripple erupted from within his body. The dao stars appeared, and the nine ancient stars shone faintly. Wang Baole snorted coldly.
“A severely injured star...”as he spoke, Wang Baole’s true self raised his right hand and formed a seal. The Flames of the divine eye star erupted once again, enveloping it with the force of teleportation, in the next instant... as the flames dispersed, Wang Baole’s true body disappeared completely!
At the same time, after Wang Baole’s clone was sucked away by the Calabash, a youth walked out from the crack beside the Calabash!
The youth was dressed in a brocade robe. He looked to be thirteen or fourteen years old, but his hair and eyebrows were white. There was an aura of time around him. As he walked out, he lifted his right hand and held the calabash. His eyes were like stars, and as they shone.., he swept his gaze over de Yunzi’s divine soul and the middle-aged cultivator.
The two men trembled, and immediately dropped to their knees to kowtow to the youth.
“Greetings, Master!”
Shockingly, the youth was their master. He was also the only stellar patriarch in the ancient Bronze Sword where the vast Expanse Dao palace was located!
Back then... De Yunzi wasn’t the only one who had awoken. His senior brother had awoken, as well as Stellar Patriarch from the Vast Expanse Dao Palace. However, his injuries had been too severe back then, and most of his cultivation base had been lost, over the years, he had only managed to recover a small portion of his cultivation base under the worship of his two disciples.
However, to be able to escape the annihilation of the Vast Expanse Dao Palace by the Weiyang clan and survive, it was clear that the star must have been extremely powerful and unique.
This could be seen from the fact that de Yunzi and his senior brother had knelt and worshiped him the moment he appeared. After that, the two senior brothers had even taken the initiative to admit their mistakes while kneeling..
“It’s just a newly promoted native meat bug causing trouble. Such a small matter has disturbed master’s cultivation base. Master, Please punish him!”
“Master, Please punish him!”Both de Yunzi and his senior brother were extremely nervous. After all, they knew their master very well. He was temperamental, and was decisive in killing. Back in the war, his disciples had been at a disadvantage, he had personally killed more than 1,000 of his fellow disciples. As for the two of them, they didn’t even dare to breathe loudly in front of him.
The young man narrowed his eyes as he looked at the gourd in his hand. Deep within them, confusion flickered. He had a feeling that something was off about the person who had just killed him. However, his cultivation base had only recovered less than 10% of its original level, he couldn’t use many of his divine abilities, so he couldn’t tell exactly what was going on. However, his instincts told him that something was off.
As of this moment, he planned to bring the young man back to the vast Expanse Dao palace and use external forces to try to refine him. He wanted to see if he could find the reason for the oddity. That was also why he did not punish his two disciples. Instead, he looked them over and said coolly,.
“This is no ordinary fleshly worm. This fleshly worm...”
Before the young man could finish speaking, his expression flickered, and he looked up into the starry sky. As he did, he saw a sea of light in the direction of the starry sky, with an indescribable aura, it erupted with a bang and poured down towards him!
This Sea of light was nine colors!
It contained nine laws. At this moment, it did not hide anything as it completely erupted, causing the starry sky of the Solar System to tremble. What shocked the youth even more was that within the Sea of light formed from the fusion of the nine laws.., there was also a seemingly supreme power of laws that suppressed all directions and shook all living things. It was like a mountain toppling over the sea as it madly closed in, directly enveloping the three of them!
“This law... This Is...”
“Dao Star?”The youth’s expression changed drastically, disbelief appeared in his eyes. The gourd in his hand began to shake violently. The entire process took only two breaths of time. As the sea of light spread and covered everything in all directions.., the gourd exploded with a loud bang and collapsed on its own. The Mist formed by Wang Baole’s doppelganger instantly fused into the sea of light. At the same time, a cold voice rang in the ears of the three of them!
“Old Fart, who are you calling a flesh worm?”

chapters.title: Chapter 989 - the attack on the ancient sword!
chapters.content:
Chapter 989:, the attack on the ancient sword!
The person who had spoken was Wang Baole himself!
His voice was cold and filled with endless killing intent. If it had been his clone who had spoken earlier, it would have caused some ripples, but it wouldn’t have caused too much shock. However, things were different now!
On one hand, the explosion of the nine-colored sea of light. On the other hand, there was the murderous aura contained in Wang Baole’s words!
The murderous aura... seemed illusory. However, powerful individuals could sense the terror of their opponents. This was especially so for the young stellar ancestor. Based on his cultivation and his unique techniques.., he instantly sensed... the death aura of at least five planets from the murderous aura contained in his words!
This meant that the other party had killed at least five planets not too long ago!
To be able to kill such a large number of people at the same cultivation realm, no matter what method was used, it could prove one thing..
The person who had come... was extraordinary!
That was indeed the case. Wang Baole’s murderous aura was unleashed without any restraint. This was due to the fact that the number of people who had awoken from the ancient green-bronze sword, as well as their cultivation, had exceeded his expectations. It was also due to the anger caused by the suppression of his clone.
He knew very well that this time, he had to end things with the vast Expanse Dao Palace. If he wanted to end things, he had to put on a strong front. He couldn’t let the other party think that he was forcing himself!
That was why the moment his clone was sucked into the gourd, Wang Baole’s original body had sensed it. He had used the power of the divine eye star teleportation and arrived in an instant. The first thing he did was to unleash all of his cultivation and the power of the Dao star without hesitation, it formed a nine-colored sea of light storm that erupted throughout the entire Solar System!
It could be said that Wang baole, who had fused with the dao stars, might only be at the early-stage of the planet realm, but his combat prowess was so strong that he could suppress all the perfected planets that had fused with the spirit and immortal planets!
...
Only planets that had been upgraded from special planets and whose cultivation was two minor realms higher than his could fight against him, who had a dao star. In other words, only those with special planets at the late-stage of the planet realm could fight against him.
Or perhaps... a person who had fused with a dao star was on the same level as him in terms of status. However, because of the terrifying power of his dao star, even if he met a cultivator with the same dao star and the same cultivation base, he would still be no match for him.
This was the terrifying aspect of a planet cultivator who had fused with a dao star. It was also because of this... that the quality of a planet in the Weiyang Dao domain would cause countless people to go crazy, it was also the reason why the meteorite lands attracted the attention of the large clans and sects!
The further one progressed on the path of cultivation, the greater the gap between them. It was the same even when they were at the same level. Sometimes, the gap between them could even be described as the difference between heaven and earth!
For example, at that moment, when Wang Baole’s true body arrived and the nine-colored sea of light swept across, de Yunzi let out a shrill scream. His soul couldn’t take it anymore. It showed signs of dissipating, and there was even pain in his soul, it was as if it wanted to tear everything apart. As de Yunzi screamed in pain, he chose to retreat rapidly. He merged back into the beam of light from the ancient bronze sword and fled frantically.
The reason why he instinctively chose to flee was partly due to his own fear. Another reason was that he had already realized that the person who had fought with them earlier was just a clone, an avatar required the combined efforts of the three of them to suppress it. Then... if the person’s original body had arrived, his master would have been fine if he hadn’t been injured. However, it was unknown whether he could resist in his current state!
Furthermore... even if he could resist, he didn’t think that he could withstand the ripples caused by the battle between the two powerful cultivators in his current state. From what he could see, he was afraid that once the two of them started fighting, he would be affected and killed.
Almost at the same moment that de Yunzi fled, his senior brother had chosen the same path as him. Although his senior brother wasn’t injured, the murderous intent from Wang Baole’s true body and the vast nine-colored sea of light.., it caused the middle-aged cultivator to feel a sharp pain between his brows. This pain stemmed from his innate ability.
The only use of this ability was to predict life and death. It was reflected in the pain between his brows. The greater the pain, the greater the possibility of death. The pain he felt now.., almost the same as when the vast dao palace was severely damaged and nearly destroyed, how could this not make him panic with his junior brother, crazy escape.
However, under the cover of Wang Baole’s nine-colored sea of light, how could the two of them escape in an instant? Unless their master was willing to do whatever it took to stall Wang Baole!
But for a star power, the long life of its emotions have disappeared too much, if itself is cold thin character, then it will be even more so, their own safety is the most important, that was especially so... after he had escaped the crisis of the sect’s destruction and had sustained serious injuries, he had finally managed to recover some of his cultivation from his deep slumber. He had cherished his life and cherished his injuries even more. Not only was it a last resort.., he would never allow himself to be injured again.
That was because it would make his injuries, which had not fully recovered, even more serious. There was a high possibility that he would fall into a deep slumber again. To the young man from the star, that was something he did not wish to bear, that was why, the moment Wang Baole appeared, the moment he cried out in shock, the moment the calabash in his hands exploded, the moment his two disciples escaped, he had already retreated, returning to the crack that had appeared earlier, he had disappeared in an instant!
His disappearance caused his two disciples to react as they retreated. Their faces turned extremely pale. However, they didn’t have the time to say anything. They could only run frantically, trying to escape.
What awaited them was Wang Baole’s true form, who had merged with his clone and emerged from the nine-colored sea of light with a long rainbow-like aura. His speed was so fast that it seemed to tear through the void in the next instant, he appeared directly within the beam of light that de Yunzi was in.
The pull of the beam of light boosted de Yunzi’s speed and allowed him to rapidly pass through the Sea of light. However, as Wang Baole arrived and de Yunzi screamed shrilly, the beam of light that he was in was invaded by the nine colors, as the changes occurred, Wang Baole’s right hand had already reached deep into the light beam and grabbed de Yunzi’s soul!
He pulled hard, and as De Yunzi screamed, his soul was pulled out. He didn’t even give de Yunzi the chance to beg for mercy. Killing intent flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes, and he threw de Yunzi’s soul back, it was instantly devoured by the black eyes that had suddenly appeared behind him!
The extent of his misery was indescribable!
As he sensed the feedback from the black eye, Wang Baole’s eyes were dark as he swept his gaze toward senior brother de Yunzi, who was so shocked that his scalp went numb.
De Yunzi’s senior brother’s teeth were chattering, and the fear in his heart was about to swallow him whole. The appearance of Wang Baole’s true body was no different from a star to him, and it was even more terrifying!
Therefore, when his eyes met Wang Baole’s, he lost sight of the other party. The piercing pain between his brows seemed to make his head explode, and De Yunzi’s senior brother let out an intense roar.
“I woke up three years later than de Yunzi. Senior, if you don’t believe me, you can search my soul. I didn’t give any orders against the federation, and my hands aren’t stained with any drops of the blood of the Federation’s Citizens!”
His words were hurried. As his voice reverberated, Wang Baole, who had disappeared from his sight, appeared behind him. He raised his right hand and was about to slap the person’s head, it was easy to imagine how powerful Wang Baole was now. With that slap, the person’s head would definitely shatter, and his physical body would be destroyed. His soul wouldn’t be able to escape the fate of being devoured.
However, it had to be said that the last words of De Yunzi’s senior brother had played a part. Due to Little Missy’s existence, even though Wang Baole was furious, he couldn’t be too ruthless. After all, the Vast Expanse Dao Palace could, to a certain extent, be an ally, they could also be allies.
However, all of this required the opponent to be beaten until they were in pain, and it also required sufficient deterrence. Therefore, in the blink of an eye, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. His palm turned from a slap to a cut, and in an instant, it sliced across de Yunzi’s senior brother’s neck, it cut across.
Immediately, fresh blood spurted out. As de Yunzi’s physical body below the head collapsed, his head remained intact. His soul was also suppressed in his head. Although he had managed to survive, Wang Baole grabbed his hair, he grabbed his head and headed straight for... The ancient bronze sword!
The matter was not over yet!
Deterrence was not enough!

chapters.title: Chapter 990 - reappearance in the Dao Palace!
chapters.content:
Chapter 990: — reappearance in the Dao Palace!
Not all the citizens of the federation were able to see the scene in the starry skies through the projection of the Solar System Array Formation. The Solar System Array Formation had lost its effectiveness after the appearance of the stellar youth.
Furthermore, the image of Wang Baole’s original body arriving couldn’t be seen by anyone. Therefore, everyone, including Li Xingwen, didn’t know that in such a short period of time.., wang Baole’s clone had already fused with his original body.
It was only after the stellar youth had left, under the suppression of Wang Baole’s Dao Star, that the power of the array formation of the solar system was restored. The projection of the scene in the federation reappeared.
Therefore... What the Federation citizens and cultivators saw was the scene of Wang Baole Devouring de Yunzi, beheading his senior brother de Yunzi’s body, and holding his head!
Everyone gasped at the sight. Li Xingwen’s eyes widened. He had seen how powerful Wang Baole was previously, but now, he realized that they seemed to be two different people compared to before.
“Those are two planets...”Li Xingwen muttered to himself. His eyes gradually revealed an even stronger sense of excitement. At the same time, he noticed.., the governor of the Martian colony, the giant tree, Li Wan ‘Er’s father, who was the head of the Senate, and the sect lord of the Galactic dusk sect!
These few people, along with Lin You, were the strongest people in the federation, including Li Xingwen. Their hearts were also in turmoil, especially the giant tree... his eyeballs almost popped out of their sockets, he was extremely glad that he and Wang Baole had resolved their conflict long ago. At the same time, he couldn’t help but picture the scene of the other party escaping from his hands all those years ago.
The sect lord of the Galactic dusk sect had a similar level of complexity to that of the giant tree. He was filled with endless emotions. However, the other two on Mars... perhaps due to some other emotions.., their thoughts were completely different.
The Martian colony governor, for example, had a strange expression on her face. As she looked at Wang Baole in the picture, she thought of her own daughter..
The head councilor also thought of his daughter, Li Wan ‘Er. In the end, as his daughter appeared, more wrinkles appeared on his face, and his eyes dimmed.
Other than these people, there were Lin Tianhao, Liu Daobin, Du Min, and Wang Baole’s companions who had witnessed everything with their own eyes. They watched as Wang Baole, who had his head in his hands, headed straight for the ancient bronze sword, they sighed in their hearts.
...
Among these people were those who had participated in the dark swallow project but had returned after failing due to other reasons. In the past, even though there was a gap between them and Wang Baole, deep in their hearts, they did not believe that such a gap could not be surpassed, now, as they watched Wang baole rush towards the ancient bronze sword, they no longer saw a person in their eyes. Instead, they saw a god who was walking further and further away!
A soft sigh came from Du Min’s mouth. The voice was very weak, and only Lin Tianhao, who was beside her, heard it. He turned his head to look at du Min, and Lin Tianhao held du Min’s hand. He smiled gently, and on the hand that they were holding.., a pair of wedding rings could be seen..
At the same time, in Wang Baole’s parents’residence on Mars, a girl was holding Wang Baole’s mother’s hand. She was accompanying the two elders as they watched the live broadcast projection from the array formation of the Solar System, as she watched Wang Baole, who was getting further and further away, the girl’s eyes dimmed. However, it was quickly replaced by calmness.
She was Zhou Xiaoya.
In the other regions, Li Wuchen, Jin duoming, and the others, who had returned from the dark swallow project due to various reasons and special methods, were all staring at Wang Baole. They were familiar figures to Wang Baole.
Wang Baole knew that he was being stared at by countless people in the federation. He didn’t want to hide his cultivation, nor did he want to hide the image of him attacking. He knew very well that the federation... needed to build up its confidence, it needed to build up its confidence!
What he could do was to use his own figure to give everyone the greatest amount of support. At the same time, he could also provide a buffer for the rapid increase in the level of life brought about by the fusion with the divine eye civilization’s star.
After all, all these years under the five generation Sky clan’s rule, the citizens of the federation had been enslaved to the point where they had lost their essence, Qi, and spirit. At that moment, the fusion with the divine eye civilization was like eating a huge tonic pill. It was a huge tonic in such a weak situation, it wasn’t a good thing.
Therefore, this buffer, like a seed, became extremely crucial.
That was why Wang Baole didn’t stop the spread of the array formation of the Solar System. However, he knew very well that as he approached the ancient green-bronze sword, the array formation of the Solar System wouldn’t be able to affect the vast divine armament. It would also cause everyone who paid attention to it.., they wouldn’t be able to see everything clearly.
However, that was no longer important. The seeds from before were enough. Therefore, Wang Baole’s figure grew faster and faster. Gradually, his entire body turned into a long rainbow that seemed to be able to tear apart the starry sky as he approached the Solar System’s Star!
Compared to the divine eye civilization’s star, the Solar System’s star was similar in size. At the same time, it was filled with vitality. Although the piercing of the ancient bronze sword had affected it somewhat.., however, the effects were acceptable to the sun, which seemed to be growing.
Wang Baole stared at the Sun, and a strange feeling rose in his heart. After his cultivation had reached the planet, he knew very well that all cultivators in the Weiyang Dao Domain had roots. This root... was the star of their homeworld.
This was a part of the laws of the universe. The stronger the star of the civilization, the higher the level of life in the civilization. As the star continued to grow, all life born under its light would receive a gift.
On the other hand... Once the star was enslaved or destroyed, the civilization would lose its vitality. Although it would not cause everyone’s cultivation to drop instantly, it would become a wandering civilization without roots, they needed to find a new star and establish a connection with it.
Therefore, when some civilizations reached a certain level of development, the strongest among them would choose to merge with the star of the civilization and become a true guardian, passing it down from generation to generation.
This was beneficial, but it also had its drawbacks. The choice was a difficult choice for many developing civilizations.
Wang baole shook his head gently and retracted his gaze from the Sun. He suppressed the thoughts that surfaced in his mind and continued walking towards the ancient bronze sword. As he approached, the ancient bronze sword gradually emitted a strong suppressive force.
The Suppressive Force seemed to be controlled by someone. Slowly but heavily, it spread towards Wang Baole, as if it was going to turn into a hindrance and stop him from coming.
However, the person who was controlling the suppressive force of the ancient bronze sword clearly didn’t know that it wasn’t just him who could affect the ancient bronze sword. Wang Baole could do the same!
As he approached, Wang Baole raised his right hand and flipped it. Immediately, a jade slip appeared in his hand!
This jade slip was the symbol of the vast Expanse Dao Palace’s Grand Supreme Elder and the recognition of his identity!
As the jade slip appeared, the suppressive force emanating from the ancient green-bronze sword immediately showed signs of dissipating. This scene clearly shocked the person who was pulling the ancient sword. It was unknown what method he had used.., the jade slip in Wang Baole’s hand seemed to have cut off its connection, but it also seemed to have erased his identity. The power of the ancient sword descended once more.
Is it interesting? Wang Baole raised an eyebrow, and a glint flashed in his eyes. The intrinsic scabbard that had been in his body for a long time and had yet to fly out from his true body within the God’s eye civilization... at that moment.., a violent tremor shook his body.
As it shook, an unseen force connected with the ancient green-bronze sword, causing the gigantic ancient green-bronze sword to tremble slightly. That single tremor immediately affected all the Suppressive Force, there was even a faint sense of attraction and joy emanating from the ancient sword, causing the invisible suppressive force in front of Wang Baole to spread out like a path separating the two sides. In the next instant, his figure stepped onto the ancient sword, he stepped onto the ancient sword!
He landed... on the hilt of the sword, which was the vast dao palace from back then. As he appeared, the Dao Palace cultivators who were sealed and unable to leave the dao palace trembled. Feng Qiuran was the leader, they all knelt down before Wang baole.
“Greetings, Grand Supreme Elder!”Even though they were unable to leave the Dao Palace, they clearly had a way of knowing and seeing what was happening outside. They looked at Wang Baole nervously. Only Feng Qiuran looked gloomy and guilty.
Wang Baole stared at the Dao Palace cultivators. He was silent for a moment before speaking calmly.
“Elder Qiu ran, Please Rise. The alliance between the Federation and the Dao Palace will not change!”With that, Wang Baole no longer looked at the vast Expanse Dao Palace. Instead, he walked towards the area around the sword. As he moved forward, the pressure on his body grew stronger, the Sea of fire beneath his feet rumbled and churned. The sky above him also changed rapidly. Other than the nine ancient stars and the Dao star in the middle, he was also hidden behind them, a gigantic sword scabbard that seemed to be able to contain the entire ancient bronze sword appeared and replaced the sky!
With such an imposing manner, Wang Baole followed Wang Baole all the way to the tip of the sword and gradually suppressed it!

chapters.title: Chapter 991 - the land of hibernation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 991:, the land of hibernation!
It looked like it was walking, but it was so fast that even though the ancient bronze sword covered a vast area, it was no longer the same as before in the eyes of Wang Baole, who had reached the planet realm.
Therefore, in just a few breaths’time, he had already arrived at the boundary between the ancient sword and the Sun. As he looked at the place, the image of the huge battleship that the never-ending clan had parked there all those years ago surfaced in his mind.
After sweeping his gaze across the empty space, Wang Baole’s expression remained the same. With a single step, he stepped into the ancient sword. The moment he stepped in, he was immediately greeted by the wind of flames. The ground was in ruins, there was also a sense of confusion. There were large numbers of restrictive array formations and rolling lava.
All of this could be said to be a crisis for Wang Baole back then. However, for him now, he could see everything clearly with a single glance. There was also a reason why he didn’t choose to step in directly from the other end of the ancient sword, there was a reason for that.
If he entered directly from there, it would be considered a forceful attack by an external force. He would have to bear the power of the restrictions from the sword’s tip. The gains wouldn’t outweigh the losses. Once his opponent was prepared, he could still launch a counterattack there, if he entered directly from the sword’s hilt, everything would be fine, as this was a normal path.
Therefore, after sweeping his gaze across the area, Wang Baole didn’t pause for even a moment. He grabbed the head in his hand and crossed the various areas, ignoring all the Sea of fire restrictions. He didn’t even look at the area, occasionally revealing his aura, the fire creatures and some spirit bodies that knelt down in fear and trepidation whizzed past him.
In the past, these existences had caused him trouble. However, now, the moment they sensed his aura, they could only tremble. They did not dare resist at all and allowed Wang Baole to enter the interior of the sword body.
Very quickly, he arrived at the Blood Lake where he had obtained the elder token. He saw the huge corpse and the swaying hairs on its body once again.
He scanned the area with his eyes in mid-air, and all the hair on its body trembled and bent down. The Sea of blood churned, and the gigantic dragonfly-shaped creature slowly revealed half of its head, its eyes were filled with shock as it looked at Wang Baole with an unprecedented level of alertness. From its trembling body, one could tell how terrified it was.
It’s only somewhere between the Spirit Immortal Realm and the Spirit Immortal realm. Wang Baole shook his head and shifted his gaze away from the creature in the blood sea. He didn’t stop moving and continued to move forward. As he continued to move forward, he saw many familiar scenes, he flew past many places that he had never been before. He even saw the eye of ten thousand arts once again.
Memories of the past surfaced in Wang Baole’s mind, causing him to pause in the air above the eye of ten thousand arts. He lowered his head to look at the eye-like landscape on the ground, and a strange glow slowly appeared in his eyes.
...
This was the only place he had been unable to see through with his current cultivation. However, he knew that it wasn’t the time to investigate further, so he only glanced at it before leaving, after that, he passed through a few areas that he couldn’t see through until a long border of ice and snow appeared in front of him. The moment he took a step forward, what appeared in front of him was the familiar land of ice and snow that he had seen before.
In the distance in front of him were three huge palaces that were thousands of feet tall!
Within these three palaces, there was a serendipity and a place where some of the older cultivators of the vast expanse dao palace were sleeping and recuperating.
Back then, Wang Baole had come to this place the most. However, now, his eyes shone brightly. As the dao stars in his body circulated, the world before his eyes changed.
Behind the three palaces, the empty space was enveloped by a fog. This fog might affect the vision and senses of many people, but it didn’t include Wang Baole, who had fused with the dao stars. His eyes flashed, he could vaguely see that there were three altars within the fog!
The three altars formed a trapezoid. On the lowest altar, there were seven figures sitting cross-legged in meditation. These seven weren’t corpses. They were full of life. Even though they weren’t full of life, judging from their auras, they were all at the planet-grade!
Judging from the positions where they were meditating and the shape of their surroundings, it was obvious that there weren’t seven people here before. There were nine people sitting in a circle. Now, there were two fewer people!
The ones who were missing were naturally de Yunzi and his senior brother. Wang Baole was certain of this. He had been to all three palaces before the fog. Even the spirit pool in the last palace had cultivators healing their injuries, however, with Wang Baole’s current cultivation, those people might not be planets, or they might have been. However, their cultivation had clearly fallen due to their serious injuries.
Other than that, there was also a figure sitting cross-legged on the second altar. There was only one figure. Even though the fog covered it, Wang Baole could still vaguely see that the person sitting cross-legged was the youth who had attacked his clone earlier, he was the youth who had fled the moment his original body arrived!
The youth didn’t close his eyes. Instead, he opened his eyes and didn’t say a word. He stared intently at Wang Baole, who was outside the fog. As their gazes met through the fog, the youth suddenly spoke.
“You have already killed my disciple who made a mistake, and I have already avoided the battle. Why did you pursue me to this point? Do you really think that the vast expanse dao palace is so weak that a planet can wreak havoc here?”The youth’s voice was filled with forbearance, there was also a chilling killing intent that seemed to be about to erupt. As it spread out, the fog instantly churned violently. Even the temperature in the outside world had dropped significantly.
Wang Baole’s expression remained the same. Although he had heard the youth’s words, his gaze swept past him and turned to look behind him... at the third altar!
This altar was what made him fearful. That was because there... he saw a figure sitting cross-legged and meditating. The figure’s entire body was blurry, and he couldn’t see clearly. At the same time, the aura of life and death lingered around him, it was as if his entire body was in the midst of yin and yang. Wang baole only took a glance, and his eyes couldn’t help but sting. If the Dao stars in his body hadn’t been spinning and dissipating rapidly at that moment, he would have been traumatized with just one glance.
The galaxy... Wang Baole muttered to himself. He wasn’t surprised that there was a mighty figure from the galaxy in the vast Dao Palace. That was indeed the case. The youth was indeed the only star, that didn’t mean that the Dao Palace didn’t have an almighty from the Starfield.
Clearly, the reason why the youth had fled back to this place and sat cross-legged in meditation, waiting for Wang Baole to arrive, and then said those words was because he wanted to rely on the existence of the almighty from the Starfield to intimidate Wang Baole.
If it had been any other planet, they might have been intimidated. However, even though Wang Baole averted his gaze with a piercing pain in his eyes, the chill in his heart erupted instantly. He no longer cared about Little Missy. He raised his right hand abruptly, and in front of the youth’s star.., he ignored the screaming head in his hand. He used all his strength to grab it.
With a boom, the screaming stopped abruptly. The senior brother of De Yunzi, whose body had been cut off by Wang Baole, whose head was the only thing left, collapsed instantly. His body and soul were destroyed!
“You!”The young star’s expression changed when he saw the other party killing his disciple in front of him. However, just as he spoke, Wang Baole leaped into the air and charged toward the fog!
He was so fast that he broke through the fog in an instant. The nine ancient stars behind him rumbled, and the dao stars materialized. The devouring seed in his body revolved crazily, and the Emperor armor covered his body. The intrinsic scabbard in his body vibrated, and a wisp of Sword Qi appeared, wang Baole guided the sword out of the scabbard and charged towards the index finger on his right hand. His entire body was like a sharp sword that had been unsheathed. It was indestructible. As it tore through the fog, he appeared in front of the stellar youth!
“You... continue to sleep for a thousand years!”Wang Baole’s voice was cold. As soon as he spoke, his right hand descended.
The young man was a star, after all, and he was in his own home ground. His expression was ugly as he roared. He didn’t care about his injuries. He raised his hands and waved them. Instantly, the light of the star within his body dispersed, his entire body seemed to have turned into a sun at that moment, pressing down on Wang Baole.

chapters.title: Chapter 992 - don’t be afraid!
chapters.content:
Chapter 992:, don’t be afraid!
“You overestimate yourself!”Killing intent flashed in the youth’s eyes. As he growled, he unleashed all the power he could muster in his body!
The two collided with a loud boom. In that instant, the nine ancient stars behind Wang Baole Shook, and the Dao stars shook. An illusory sea of fire could be seen, drowning in front of him. It was the power of the stars, even though the youth had been severely injured and had less than ten percent of his cultivation, he was still a star!
Under the suppression of his supernatural power, the fire formed from the stars appeared in Wang Baole’s mind and the stars behind him. It also appeared beside his physical body, as if it wanted to burn him in both form and spirit, it was all burned into the flames of the fire of the stars.
Almost instantly, the nine ancient stars behind Wang Baole began to tremble. They grouped together and formed the illusory image of a dao star. Even though the light remained the same, it didn’t seem to have changed much under the fire of the stars, however, Wang Baole was a planet after all. His physical body was the first to show signs of being unable to withstand it.
However... since Wang Baole had dared to come, he was naturally confident. Even though his physical body seemed to be on the verge of being destroyed by the flames, his eyes remained calm. There were no ripples. He continued to press forward with his right index finger!
In an instant, the sword Qi at the tip of his finger was about to erupt completely. However, his physical body seemed to be holding on to its limits. Under the high temperature, large amounts of black impurities appeared in the pores all over his body. It was as if all the impurities in his body were about to be destroyed.., they were forced out by the high temperature. They were about to exceed the limit of what they could withstand, and they were about to be destroyed..
However, at that moment, a sea of fire suddenly appeared from within his body. More accurately speaking, the Sea of fire did not appear from within his body. Instead, it appeared out of thin air, it covered Wang Baole’s entire body, but it didn’t harm him in the slightest. Instead, it gave him a gentle and nurturing feeling.
It even formed a defense. As it spread outwards, it came into contact with the flames of the young man’s star. With a loud boom, the young man’s star fire trembled and didn’t have the slightest ability to resist, it was instantly devoured by the flames that appeared outside Wang Baole’s body. After they fused together, the flames on Wang Baole’s body seemed to have received some nourishment. They expanded outwards once again. From Afar, at that moment, Wang Baole was.., he was like a fire god!
This was where his trump card was. It was also the reason why he dared to kill his way to the ancient bronze sword alone!
This fire came from the blazing flame ancestor!
Previously, in the Divine Eye Galaxy, although the blazing flame ancestor had left, the flames that remained remained. After the divine eye civilization was reorganized by Wang Baole, the fire fused into his surroundings and seemed to have disappeared, however, Wang Baole could clearly sense the existence of the flames. It was like a blessing to the soul. He understood the function of the flames, which was to form a protective barrier the moment he was in a life-and-death crisis!
...
It could be said that this was a blessing from his master, the blazing flame ancestor!
With this blessing, not to mention that the youth was only a severely injured star, even if he was at his peak, he would not be able to do anything to Wang Baole. However, even though the blazing flame ancestor had given him a blessing, he knew that he could not help the situation, he also didn’t want his disciple to rely too much on him. Therefore, the fire was only a defense and didn’t have any destructive power against the outside world.
However, it was enough for Wang Baole. As the fire spread, the youth’s star’s expression changed drastically, and disbelief appeared on his face. He retreated abruptly, wanting to leave the altar, wang Baole’s right index finger descended abruptly, and the sword Qi within it exploded in an instant!
This was the sword qi contained within the intrinsic scabbard in his body. Its power was astonishing, and it could be said to be one of the strongest abilities that Wang Baole possessed in terms of pure attacks!
At that moment, the sword qi whistled, and it was about to land on the youth. Once it landed, although it would not cause any life or death injuries to him, it would affect the original injuries in his body and cause his many years of healing to go down the drain, it was still possible.
This was something that the youth could not and did not wish to bear. Therefore, as his expression changed and his face turned ferocious, the youth bit the tip of his tongue and spat out a large mouthful of blood. He let out a shrill cry.
“Patriarch!”
As soon as he said that, a sigh reverberated from the third altar behind him. As soon as the sigh was released, a gust of wind appeared out of thin air. In the next instant, like a storm, it exploded in front of the youth, even though the sword qi was strong, it was still instantly shattered by the wind. The wind didn’t stop as it charged towards Wang Baole.
In the next instant, without giving Wang baole any chance to react, it collided with the flames outside his body. With a loud boom, Wang Baole’s body shook violently. Even though he was blocked by the flames, he wasn’t injured, however, his body was still pushed back by the impact of the storm. He was immediately swept out of the fog. At the same time, from the third altar, where the figure was sitting cross-legged, an ancient and majestic voice rang out!
“Outsider, I don’t want to see you again in the future. Leave!”
Outside the fog, Wang Baole’s body staggered back continuously. He only managed to stop after he had retreated a thousand feet. His breathing quickened as he raised his head and looked at the second altar within the fog, at that moment, the stellar youth, who had clearly heaved a sigh of relief, looked at him with killing intent and hatred. Then, he looked at the figure on the third altar, who had a piercing look in his eyes, and suddenly laughed.
The laughter grew louder. A cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes. His entire being was filled with viciousness and unruliness. His voice was like thunder that reverberated in all directions.
“Can the Galactic Realm Almighties be unreasonable? Who Are We Outsiders?”
As the words left his mouth, he activated the rules of the ancient star behind Wang Baole. Immediately, the flames that came from the blazing flame ancestor outside his body were drawn in. Even though he couldn’t use it to harm the enemy.., it was more obvious, however, that it could be used as a deterrent.
As the flames spread, the aura that belonged to the blazing flame ancestor was released more or less. This caused the mighty figure from the vast Expanse Dao Palace, who was on the third altar, to slowly raise his head, a gaze shot out like lightning from the blurry face that couldn’t be seen clearly. It landed on Wang Baole. After a moment of silence, the figure spoke slowly.
“The aura of the flames... you can ask the flames if they can do anything to the ancient Universe Sword of the Vast Expanse Dao palace even if they descend personally!”
“So, leave!”
“Ancient universe sword? I don’t know if my master can do anything to it, but I... Can’t do anything to it?”Wang Baole raised an eyebrow when he heard that, he circulated the intrinsic scabbard in his body with all his might. As it shook, the ground beneath his feet began to rumble, and the entire ancient green-bronze sword began to tremble!
This scene caused the eyes of the galactic almighties to contract. They remained silent for a long time before they spoke calmly.
“What do you want?”
“I don’t want this person to die, but at the very least, I want him to be severely injured. I want him to sleep for another thousand years as a punishment for disrupting the Solar System Federation!”Wang Baole spoke coldly, pointing at the star youth whose expression had changed.
“Your qualifications aren’t enough. I’ll say it one last time. Leave!”The reply he got was a cold, ancient voice that seemed to have weighed his options.
“Qualifications?”As Wang Baole operated the scabbard, he raised his right hand and took out the mysterious mask.
“Little Missy, are you qualified enough?”
As the mask was taken out, little Missy’s figure materialized from the mask and stood beside Wang Baole. She sighed softly, and as the expression on the Almighty’s face changed, Little Missy bowed.
“Greetings, master Xing Yi.”
The almighty from the Starfield on the third altar fell silent once again.
“If that’s not enough...”the arrogance on Wang Baole’s face grew even stronger. He had to make the Vast Expanse Dao palace fear him this time. Otherwise, other disasters would befall him sooner or later in the Solar System, determination flashed in his eyes. He raised his right hand and pointed towards the galaxy beyond the ancient sword, where Mars was located!
“Dark artifact... Return!”
As soon as Wang Baole spoke, Mars, which was some distance away, suddenly began to tremble. A terrifying force erupted from the center of the planet as the ground trembled, it charged towards the galaxy!
There were even cheers that seemed to respond to Wang Baole’s call. They erupted and spread throughout the galaxy!

chapters.title: Chapter 993 - fighting for the team!
chapters.content:
Chapter 993: fighting for the team!
Mars trembled and the Earth rumbled. Cracks appeared on the surface of Mars and spread rapidly in all directions. At the center of the cracks was... the new city of Mars!
If one looked from the sky, they could see that the ground with the new city of Mars as its core had formed a ring shape amidst the cracks. It spread rapidly in all directions and covered more than half of Mars in an instant.
However, the crack did not cause the ground to collapse. Although the people living on Mars could feel the earth shaking, not a single building was destroyed, and no one was hurt.
Instead, wisps of black aura instantly emerged from the crack that had spread across more than half of Mars and shot into the starry sky. If one looked closely, one could even see that there were a large number of tiny particles in the fog, there were also a large number of tiny particles.
As the hearts of the people from Mars trembled, they saw with their own eyes that the fog and particles were continuously gathering in the skies. They eventually turned into a storm, emitting a strong aura of death. It shot into the starry skies and turned into a long river, it shot straight for the tip of the ancient bronze sword.
It was so fast that it seemed like it could move. In the next instant... it gathered beside the tip of the ancient bronze sword. The moment it arrived, Cheers rang out in Wang Baole’s mind, the fog gathered together rapidly. The particles within it seemed to combine together. As they continued to merge, they formed a lone boat... it didn’t look big, and it could only fit one person!
On the lone boat, as the other particles merged, they formed a black robe that covered the head and an illusory lantern oar that emitted a dim light!
As it appeared, a divine armament aura that surpassed the federation’s Crimson Flying Dagger exploded on the lone boat’s black robe and the lantern oar!
It was the dark sect’s dark artifact!
It was inferior to the ancient green-bronze sword, and there was a gap between them. The gap was so great that Wang Baole couldn’t bridge it. However... if it had been a higher-being from the galaxy that he had approved of using the dark artifact, then under the control of the dark artifact.., the ancient bronze sword wouldn’t be able to move too much. However, breaking through the array formation and stepping into the sword would pose a direct threat to the galaxy higher-being from the Vast Expanse Dao Palace. He could do it!
This... was Wang Baole’s deterrent!
...
First, he had revealed the protection the blazing flame ancestor had given him. Then, he had used his intrinsic scabbard to move the ancient sword. He had told the other party that it wasn’t impossible for him to control and interfere. At the same time, he had allowed Little Missy to appear, this was to prove that his original relationship with the vast Expanse Dao palace shouldn’t have been a clash of arms!
After that, he summoned the dark artifact to carry out the final threat. Although he didn’t say it explicitly, the meaning behind it was clear. It was... that he, Wang Baole, had the ability to severely injure and even kill the injured galactic almighties who had yet to recover!
All of this shocked the galactic almighties on the third altar. It could be said that waves after waves of attacks continued. His pupils constricted slowly, and he grew more and more silent. No matter how hard he thought about it.., he also felt that if they were to become enemies, the consequences would be severe.
This forced him to pay more attention to Wang Baole. On the other hand, the stellar youth’s expression had completely changed. His breathing was rapid, and his eyes were filled with panic. He wasn’t a fool.., he had already sensed that something was amiss. His heart trembled, and he was about to speak.
However, before he could finish speaking, the almighty from the celestial domain on the third altar revealed a look of determination in his eyes. Although he could not afford to offend the blazing flame ancestor, he had the ancient bronze sword to protect him. However, this planet cultivator before him was actually able to shake the ancient sword, this caused everything to change. In addition to the appearance of the strange dark artifact, as well as... The SAINTESS whose physical body had been damaged, but whose background could be described as terrifying.
All of this was no longer something he needed to weigh. Therefore, in the next instant, the almighty from the celestial domain let out a sigh. He lifted his right hand and waved it. Instantly, an enormous pressure descended, amidst the rumbling, it descended directly on the stellar youth.
It caused the youth to cough up blood and let out a shrill scream.
“Progenitor...”
“Shut up!”The reply he received was the faint words of the almighty from the Celestial Domain. The instant he finished speaking, the young star coughed up blood once again. His already injured body was once again injured, all his recovery over the years had gone down the drain. It was even worse than before.
His entire body trembled. He didn’t even have the time to look at Wang Baole with hatred. In the midst of his extreme weakness, he fainted. His soul was in the same state. He could recover slowly on the altar, however, to recover to ten percent of his cultivation, unless he had some other good fortune, it would take him at least several hundred years. To reach his peak... it would take less than a thousand years.
After that, the almighty from the Star Domain, who was sitting cross-legged on the third altar, looked at Wang Baole. Wang Baole took a deep breath, and the anger and arrogance on his face disappeared, he cupped his fists and bowed deeply to the almighty from the Star Domain.
“I, Wang Baole, pay my respects to senior. Thank you for upholding justice!”
The almighty from the star domain snorted coldly. Deep down, he was displeased with Wang Baole. He couldn’t help but shift his gaze away. He looked at the Saintess from his sect, and his gaze softened. He was about to speak.., however, Wang Baole spoke loudly once again.
“I respect your personality, senior. I admire your integrity. At the same time, I have received the favor of the Dao Palace. I am willing to help you and the Dao Palace cultivators heal their injuries and make my own contributions. Therefore... I plan to hold a grand ceremony in a month’s time. I will ask my master, the blazing flame ancestor, for a galaxy with stars to come over and integrate into the Solar System
“With this, we can accelerate the recovery of senior’s cultivation. At the same time, we can also raise the level of civilization in the Solar System!”
As soon as Wang Baole said that, the eyes of the almighty from the Dao Palace Starfield, who was initially displeased with him, widened. He instantly turned to look at Wang Baole.
“You want to fuse with a civilization with stars?”
Wang Baole’s expression remained the same as usual as he nodded.
“This is only the first. I still have plans in the future. I will attract more stars and merge them into the Solar System, allowing senior and the others to recover their cultivation faster!”
A smile appeared on Wang Baole’s face, but his heart was calm. He knew that the vast Expanse Dao palace should not be an enemy. The hatred between the vast Expanse Dao palace and the Weiyang clan allowed them to become natural allies.
However, even if they were allies, they had to respect each other. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be allies, but enslaved.
That was why he had to put on a show. After all, if he could form an alliance with the Vast Expanse Dao palace, it would be beneficial to the federation. At the same time, he knew how to communicate with others. If he wanted to achieve some of his goals.., he had to give them something that would tempt them. There might be many things that could tempt the higher-ups in the galaxy. However, after thinking about it, Wang Baole realized that the only thing he could give them was the integration of the God’s eye civilization, which would indirectly double the amount of healing.
Furthermore, if he had proposed this so-called gift in the beginning, the effect would have been unsatisfactory. This was because their statuses weren’t equal. At the same time, if he had used this as a threat to punish the star, it would have had the same negative effect.
That was why, as soon as he had appeared, he had killed senior brother de Yunzi in a domineering manner. Then, he had forced the other party to reveal his trump card. That had forced the star domain’s mighty figure to punish the star youth.
By then, he had, to a certain extent, gained the right to be considered an equal. That was why, when the other party was displeased, he had proposed a gift, and he had done so with such a grand gift. He had done so with such a grand gift, he had done it with ease.
Naturally, the almighty from the Galaxy, who was sitting on the altar, instantly understood everything. This made him look at Wang Baole with a deeper look in his eyes. At the same time, he also understood the main point of the other party’s integration with the stars, it was to raise the level of the civilization in this place. However, he had to admit that as the level of the civilization in the Solar System increased, he and the others would also benefit greatly from the recovery of their cultivation.
At the same time, Wang Baole’s last sentence made him extremely tempted. If Wang Baole could continuously raise the level of the federation’s civilization and make the stars stronger, then it would be of great benefit to him.
After a moment of silence, the Galactic Realm Almighty looked at Wang Baole with a calm gaze and nodded.
“Thank you, my young friend. Qing Lingzi didn’t know his limits and almost made a huge mistake, destroying the alliance between the Dao Palace and the federation. He is indeed guilty of this. The Dao Palace and the federation shouldn’t be enemies. We have a common enemy...” The almighty from the celestial domain swept his gaze over the dark artifact outside. He suddenly realized that the planet in front of him had taken out a divine weapon that clearly carried the aura of the dark sect. Its purpose was to remind him that it was related to the dark sect, everyone’s enemy... was the same!
“What a meticulous, courageous, and resourceful cultivator...”the almighty from the celestial domain sighed softly as he thought back to his own Dao Palace’s junior.
“From now on, the Dao Palace will not participate in any internal affairs of the Federation. They will only share in cultivation. Furthermore, when foreign enemies invade, they will fight against them as one, advancing and retreating together!”
“Thank you, Senior!”Wang Baole took a deep breath, cupped his fists again, and bowed deeply

chapters.title: Chapter 994 - Federation reorganization!
chapters.content:
Chapter 994:, Federation reorganization!
As Wang Baole cupped his fists, the little missy beside him heaved a sigh of relief. She was actually in a difficult position, but she believed that with Wang Baole’s methods, he should be able to handle such matters well. After all, from what she knew.., wang Baole was very good at dealing with people.
At the same time, she didn’t believe that Wang Baole didn’t understand that both parties were natural allies. This was because they shared a common enemy, and her existence was also one of the reasons.
Therefore, ever since she had appeared, she had been observing without interfering. Now that everyone was happy, a smile appeared on Little Missy’s face.
Seeing Little Missy’s smile, Wang Baole smiled as well. He didn’t immediately invite her back to the mask. Instead, after communicating with her, he temporarily left her here to reminisce about old times. He took his leave and left the ancient green-bronze sword.
In the starry skies, he raised his right hand and waved. Immediately, the dark artifact at the tip of the sword whizzed over. Although the three dark artifacts were still incomplete, their bodies had already recovered to a critical point. There was no point in remaining on Mars, wang Baole grabbed with his large hand, and the dark artifact immediately fused into his body.
It turned into three black dots between his brows and then disappeared without a trace. However, with just a thought, they would instantly appear on his body, turning into a dark child that could graze the starry skies.
After doing all this, Wang Baole looked at the solar system from afar. He knew that he wouldn’t be able to stay here for long. Cultivation was like sailing against the current. If he didn’t advance, he would retreat.
Once he set foot on this path, he would have to keep moving forward. Only by doing so could he protect the people and things he wanted to protect and realize his dream.
The Federation president is my lifelong dream... it may be within my grasp now, but the federation is too small... I want to make the federation bigger and bring the level of civilization to the maximum. When that happens, I will be able to live up to my name as the President, at the same time, there was a reluctance to part before his departure.
For the sake of his dream and cultivation, after completing the fusion of the divine eye civilization, he had to go out. Therefore, his clone walked out of his original body once again and headed straight for Mars. He planned to spend more time with his family in the coming days.
As for his original body, he left the Solar System and relied on his connection with the divine eye civilization’s star. He was teleported away and returned to continue setting up the array formation and making preparations.
...
Time passed slowly after Wang Baole returned to Mars. A week passed quickly. During that week, the news of Wang Baole killing the five generation Sky clan and destroying the planet in the Dao Palace had spread throughout the entire federation, on one hand, too many people had witnessed it with their own eyes. On the other hand, Li Xingwen’s return to Earth and the publicity he had received after taking over the government affairs of the Federation had caused Wang Baole’s reputation to rise like a huge wave in the entire federation. It had reached its peak.
Everyone was excited. After Li Xingwen’s return, the federation began to reorganize itself. As the news of his appointment spread and the large number of cultivators on Mars returned, the federation was like a half-withered flower, after being doused with the water of life, it slowly began to bloom again.
First, there was the presidential candidate. After seeking Wang Baole’s opinion, they re-elected the members of the Parliament. Finally, Zhao Yameng’s mother, the governor of the Martian colony, Wu Mengling, was elected as the new president!
Zhao Yameng’s father was still in charge of the Spirit Sciences Academy and had entered the parliament.
Li Xingwen, like his previous status, was helping the Martian colony governor with matters regarding the federation.
The entire federation was shaken by the news, but no one raised any objections. Zhao Yameng’s mother had been able to take up the position of president, regardless of whether it was due to her hard work or her own experience.
Wang Baole personally attended to her promotion. He removed the divine armament crimson star from her hair and gave it to her, allowing the federation’s tradition to continue. He also informed Zhao Yameng of the recent developments. The vacant position of Martian colony governor.., the successor was... the current Vice President of the Senate, Lin You!
Not only was he the vice president of the Senate, he was also appointed as the vice president. Lin You, who held three positions, was undoubtedly being groomed as a future star in the federation.
Lin You didn’t fail to live up to his expectations. Not only was he resourceful and experienced, he had also made a breakthrough in his cultivation over the years. He had stepped into the spirit realm, and his improvement was extremely fast. He wasn’t far from breaking through to the late-stage spirit realm.
At the same time, the Venus project had been reactivated after the five generation Sky clan’s chaotic governance had been suspended. With Wang Baole’s help, they had retrieved the stellar source from the vast Expanse Dao Palace, allowing Venus to be built, this was going to be a major event for the federation.
It would be built into the second Mars, and it would become the core of the array formation of the Solar System. The person who would take over the position of the Venus governor would be... the former deputy governor of Mars, the giant tree on the Moon!
During the five generation Sky clan’s chaotic period, the giant tree had obtained the true trust and recognition of Li Xingwen and the others through its own choice. That was why it had been given such an important position!
At the same time, there were also Jupiter and the other planets. After Zhao Yameng’s mother, Wu mengling, became the president, they were all appointed one after another. This made the Solar System’s array formation even more majestic and left many openings. Once a large amount of spiritual energy was released.., it could expand the array formation’s scope.
All of this was in preparation for something that could be said to be an extremely important event for the Federation!
That was... the fusion of the divine eye civilization!
Wang Baole had already informed Li Xingwen and the others about this. Although it was still a secret, it had already spread among the higher-ups. Everyone who knew about this was extremely excited, because they already knew.., once the sun fused with the divine eye star, the level of civilization in the Federation would increase. At the same time, all life born in the Solar System would receive a feedback from the Sun’s will the moment it fused with the star!
This feedback was a rare supplement in the world. It could increase the aptitude of ordinary people and the cultivation of cultivators. Some people who were stuck at a cultivation realm could even use this opportunity to attempt a breakthrough!
How could such a thing not be exciting? Besides the appointments of the various planets, there were also a series of internal adjustments within the federation. For example, Jin duoming had officially taken over the position of the family head of the Jin family, becoming the Supreme Leader of the TRILUNARIS Corporation, after he took over, he immediately issued a plan to cooperate fully with the Spirit Sciences Academy and create more powerful Spirit Sciences Dharmic artifacts together!
Liu Daobin also rose in status. With his relationship with Wang Baole, his own hard work, and the contributions he had made to the federation over the years, he was promoted to the Deputy Governor of Mars and was fully in charge of the work of the Martian Special Administrative Region!
The other four dao colleges began rebuilding after the federation had straightened things out. The person in charge of the reconstruction of the ethereal dao college was Zhou Xiaoya. She had been appointed as the sect lord of the Ethereal Dao College!
While all of this was going on, Wang Baole had a lot of free time on his hands. He spent every day with his parents, and his life had returned to the calmness and gentleness that he hadn’t experienced in a long time.
While enjoying the warmth of his family, Wang Baole continued to nurse his parents’bodies. He slowly healed his mother’s injuries, and at the same time, kept the fire of life in his parents’bodies in a healthy state, they even looked much younger.
Based on the spirit Qi that Wang Baole left on their bodies, their lifespan could basically reach the limits of their souls. In order to prevent what had happened in the past from happening again, Wang Baole had spent the past few days, he had made some accessories with his planet cultivation.
With these accessories, even if a planet cultivator made a move, it would be very difficult to endanger his parents’lives in a short period of time. He would also be the first to notice.
Time passed once again, and half a month before the day of the integration of the god eye civilization, Wang Baole received an invitation to a wedding.
Lin Tianhao and Du Min’s wedding!
When he saw the invitation, Wang Baole had a strange expression on his face as he prayed for Lin Tianhao.
Although he and Du Min were old classmates, they had never gotten along. From Wang Baole’s point of view, with Du Min’s hot-tempered personality and her flat figure, it would be extremely difficult for her to get married in this lifetime.
“Tianhao, Oh Tianhao, you have to pray for yourself...”Wang Baole coughed. Even though he said that, he was still very happy deep down. After all, Lin Tianhao was a good friend that he wouldn’t get to know unless he fought with him, and Du Min was a classmate of the old class elder, therefore, he was very happy that the two of them could have a result.
Of course, this was also the reason why he didn’t have any romantic feelings for du Min. If not, he would have been furious by now.
Therefore, after receiving the invitation, Wang Baole sent a voice transmission to Lin Tianhao, sending him a message to attend. Ever since he had returned, other than going to Zhao Yameng’s mother’s promotion ceremony, he had been at home all the time, refusing visitors, therefore, after learning that Wang Baole would be coming, Lin Tianhao was very happy. At the same time, the news spread, causing everyone who wanted to visit Wang Baole to pay attention to this matter.
Just like that, a few days later, Lin Tianhao and Du Min’s wedding on Mars was packed with friends and elites. It was so lively that it could be said to be the wedding of the century!
Sigh –
Happy holidays, everyone. I plan to take a break during this holiday to spend time with my family and keep up with everyone’s holidays

chapters.title: Chapter 995 - came to pay their respects one after another
chapters.content:
Chapter 995: came to pay their respects one after another
Lin You’s status, Lin Tianhao’s status as the city lord of ethereal city, his relationship with Wang Baole, and his arrival made the wedding on Mars very grand.
Wang Baole had prepared a gift meticulously. The wedding reached its peak, and the banquet began. Wang Baole held a wine glass in the wedding hall and looked at the new couple in front of him. His heart was filled with emotion.
“Daobin, why do you think Tianhao is so stubborn? Why did he get married so early...”Wang Baole drank his wine and looked at Liu Daobin, who had followed him as soon as he arrived, he said jokingly, and the smile on his lips was tinged with sympathy.
“Boss is right. When we go out to play in the future, we’ll lose another good brother.”Liu Daobin laughed when he heard that. He coughed and said softly.
“Boss, when you weren’t around all these years, the Martian special administrative region received wave after wave of immigrants. They’ve put in a lot of effort for the construction of the new Martian zone. I plan to select a few people who are both good-looking and good-natured. I plan to form a female celebrity group and perform in the entire federation to promote the beauty of the Martian Special Administrative Region!”
“This matter is very important to the Martian special administrative region. Boss, you’re my old leader. I sincerely hope that you can give me some guidance...”Liu Daobin’s expression was solemn and filled with sincerity. He only said those words.., no matter how Wang Baole listened to him, he felt that something was amiss. That was especially so when Liu Daobin took out a jade slip and told him the information of the candidates. He asked Wang Baole to give him some guidance. Wang Baole’s expression turned odd.
“Daobin, ah, Daobin, you...”Wang Baole didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. Just as he was about to knock on the door, a gentle voice came from behind them.
“What female team? Liu Daobin, let me take a look.”
Wang Baole turned his head and looked at the familiar figure walking over. His eyes were filled with reminiscence as he spoke softly.
“Xiaoya.”
The person who had come was Zhou Xiaoya. She had changed a little from how she looked back then. She no longer looked like a timid person. Instead, she was gentle and gentle. At the same time, she also carried a hint of firmness. It was obvious that she was gentle on the outside but firm on the inside.
...
Her appearance made Liu Daobin Blink. He kept the jade slip in his hand without batting an eyelid and cupped his fists at Zhou Xiaoya with a smile.
“Greetings, sect Lord Zhou!”With that, he bowed to Wang Baole.
“Old leader, I shall not disturb you and sect Lord Zhou from catching up on old times. I will report to you later.”As he spoke, Liu Daobin bowed to the two of them again before retreating.
Zhou Xiaoya glanced at Liu Daobin, who had left. Her beautiful eyes eventually landed on Wang Baole’s face. She retracted her gaze and stood beside him without saying a word. Instead, she looked at Lin Tianhao and Du Min, who were in the middle of their wedding ceremony, her eyes were filled with blessings and a hint of envy.
“This Liu Daobin is too much of a troublemaker. I will teach him a lesson later.”Seeing that Zhou Xiaoya had arrived without saying a word, Wang baole coughed and tried to find something to say.
In truth, he felt guilty and grateful towards Zhou Xiaoya. His parents had often mentioned Zhou Xiaoya during this period of time, which made Wang Baole realize that Zhou Xiaoya’s company during his absence.., it was very heartwarming for his parents.
However, he was no longer the same person he was back then. He knew very well that he couldn’t stay in the federation for too long. Therefore, any emotional ties between him and his old friends would eventually make him wait alone.
Wang Baole didn’t want to and couldn’t do such a thing. That was why when he returned, he didn’t look for Zhou Xiaoya. She knew that he had returned, but she didn’t go to see him either.
There seemed to be some distance between the two of them that they both knew about. That was why they had met for the first time since their return.
“I need to teach her a lesson,”Zhou Xiaoya said calmly, not looking at Wang Baole.
Wang baole blinked and coughed. He then secretly glanced at Zhou Xiaoya. After a moment of silence, he sighed softly in his heart. He knew what she was thinking, but he couldn’t say the words to make her wait any longer. After a moment of silence, it turned into two words.
“Thank you.”
Upon hearing those two words, Zhou Xiaoya turned her head slightly and stared at Wang Baole with her beautiful eyes. After a long while, she smiled slightly. Her eyes curved into a crescent moon due to the appearance of the smile. She was very beautiful, but it also made her appear gentle and gentle, it became more and more obvious. She raised her hand and helped Wang baole tidy up his clothes. Then, she breathed softly into his ear like a orchid.
“Did you owe you in your past life? Is that why you wanted to seduce my heart when I first entered the DAO College in this life? You were able to hear about you from the mouths of the people around you time and time again. You made me unable to forget you and make my heart unable to contain anyone else. Since that’s the case... Your Little White Rabbit will wait for you.” Zhou Xiaoya blew into Wang Baole’s ear. She didn’t turn her head and walked away from him. She walked further and further away. Only the fragrance of the orchid still lingered in Wang Baole’s nose, he couldn’t help but turn his head to look at Zhou Xiaoya’s back as she disappeared into the crowd.
As he watched, the wedding had unknowingly come to an end. Lin Tianhao finally pulled his body out and found Wang Baole together with Du Min. As he looked at the couple before him, Wang Baole suppressed the image of Zhou Xiaoya that filled his mind, lin Tianhao smiled and gave his blessings. He also told Wang baole that the only person who had not returned from the dark swallow plan and had not received any news was Kong Dao.
“Kong Dao’s remaining lamp of life has not been extinguished, but its color has changed...”Lin Tianhao had wanted to say a few more words, but he was the main character today, so he was quickly dragged away, leaving Wang Baole in deep thought.
His thoughts didn’t last long. After the wedding ceremony ended, groups of people started chatting and laughing at each other at the banquet. There was an endless stream of people who came to visit Wang Baole amidst the bustle.
It was a good thing that he had a high status now, and his status was extremely high. Therefore, those who came to visit him didn’t dare disturb him too much. They would leave after they paid their respects. That was until an old friend of his appeared before Wang Baole, he bowed deeply to Wang baole, his eyes filled with emotion and regret.
“Greetings... My Lord.”The visitor was the current governor of the Golden Star City. He was a cultivator that had been formed by the Moon Hanging Tree, who had been involved with Wang Baole in the past. The giant tree didn’t know how to address Wang Baole respectfully. It hesitated for a moment before saying, “My Lord.” “My Lord.”.
His cultivation had improved over the years. He had advanced from the perfected nascent Soul Realm to the spirit realm. However, whether it was in the vast Expanse Dao palace or here now, the emotion and regret in his heart were extremely strong, at the same time, he didn’t dare slight Wang Baole. He was extremely respectful and respectful.
“There’s no need for that, fellow Daoist Gui,”Wang Baole said with a smile. He helped the giant tree, which had bowed down to greet him, up. He looked at the fluctuations in the other party’s cultivation, and the smile on Wang Baole’s face was sincere.
“Over the years, fellow Daoist GUI has done the federation a Favor!”
To the giant tree, this sentence was much heavier than what others had said ten thousand times. It made him shudder. It was true that he had never thought of betraying the federation, even when Li Xingwen’s faction was in danger, now that the situation had turned for the better and Wang Baole had agreed with him, it was enough for him.
The giant tree took a deep breath and bowed again. After a moment of hesitation, he said softly, “Sir, you are too kind. This is also my home.”.
“With your cultivation, if you have the time, you can explore the ruins on earth... perhaps you will be able to see some secrets about the Solar System.”
“HMM?”Wang Baole’s eyes flashed as he looked at the giant tree.
“Sir, my true form is the Laurel tree on the moon. It has existed for a very long time. In my blurry thoughts, there is a memory...”
“I don’t know if this memory is real... it seems like a very, very long time ago, there was a powerful cultivation force in the Solar System. I... was one of the cultivators in that force who planted it on the Moon.”
“Although this cultivation force has long left, I have a feeling that they... still exist in this starry sky. Furthermore, the disappearances that have occurred since the spirit inception era in the federation should be extremely related to this cultivation force!”
“They seem to be using such a method to... select disciples from the current Solar System!”
“For example... Lin You!”The tree spoke in a deep and soft voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 996 - Li Wan ‘Er!
chapters.content:
Chapter 996:, Li Wan ‘Er!
“Oh?”Wang Baole’s expression was the same as ever. He listened to the words of the giant tree beside him, the smile still on his face. He swept his gaze across the crowd and nodded politely at the few cultivators who were bowing to him. He also saw the scene of the wedding, lin You, who was surrounded by a crowd in the distance, was looking at him.
Wang baole smiled slightly and nodded at Lin You. Lin You’s appearance didn’t seem to have changed much compared to before. After all, after reaching a certain level of cultivation, the traces of time on his body would become lighter. Other than his aura.., it wasn’t easy to judge his appearance.
He had been paying attention to Wang baole the entire time. When he noticed Wang Baole’s gaze, Lin You’s expression was solemn. He bowed deeply at Wang Baole across the crowd. As he stood up, a hint of hesitation flashed across his eyes. However, that hesitation quickly turned into decisiveness.., he walked towards Wang Baole.
Seeing that Lin you, whom he had just mentioned, was walking towards him, the giant tree didn’t seem to have any abnormalities on his face. His expression remained respectful. However, his words had changed to reporting on his work on Mars over the years. His voice wasn’t loud, lin You, who was walking towards them, could hear a little of it. As Lin you approached and laughed, the giant tree turned around and cupped his fists at Lin You with a smile.
“Fellow Daoist Gui, I’m not disturbing you, am I? Can you give me a moment of Baole’s time?”Lin You joked, his eyes filled with kindness.
“President Lin, you must be joking. I’ve already finished my report. I wouldn’t dare disturb you any further.”The giant tree’s expression remained the same. He smiled and cupped his fists again before taking his leave respectfully.
As he watched the giant tree leave, Lin you swept his gaze across the area casually. When he turned his head to look at Wang Baole, his expression was filled with emotion and regret. Even though he didn’t speak to Wang Baole immediately, his expression.., the words he was about to say were very clear.
He didn’t need to speak, but his expression was enough to let others understand. Wang Baole had only seen Duan Muque and Li Xingwen among the higher-ups of the federation regarding his past abilities.
Many years have passed in a flash... Lin you sighed softly. His expression turned solemn once again. He took a step back and bowed deeply to Wang Baole.
“Moon Star Sect’s in-name disciple, Lin You, greets Senior!”
Wang Baole raised his eyebrows slightly. He looked at Lin You, who was in front of him, and asked, “Senior, what do you mean?”.
...
“Moon Star Sect? When did such a sect appear in our federation? Fellow Daoist Lin, what do you mean by that?”
“Baole, stop teasing me.”Lin you smiled bitterly and cupped his fists once again.
“Baole, I don’t know if fellow Daoist Gui said anything to you, but in order to avoid causing unnecessary misunderstandings, I still have to explain myself.”
“Back then, I went missing in a ruin on earth. I returned many years later. As for what happened during my disappearance, although most of it was reported to the federation for the record, there are still some secrets that I haven’t revealed...”Lin You was silent for a moment, he spoke softly.
“The place where I went missing was called the Moon Star sect. This sect should be related to the ancient Earth. Therefore, I wasn’t the first, nor was I the last person to be sent there. After a series of inspections, I became an in-name disciple and was taught cultivation techniques... Finally, I was sent back with a mission.”
“What Mission?”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and asked slowly.
