“To record the evolution of Earth since the spirit inception era, and to participate in it. In the midst of the danger that would affect the life and death of the entire federation, to send someone whom I believe to be a seed into the ruins.”Lin You’s eyes were full of honesty, he didn’t hide anything.
“I don’t know what the Moon Star sect is up to, but I do know one thing. The federation is my hometown. That’s why I didn’t send anyone there after I returned. Instead, I took the initiative to report it. As a result, the number of missing people in the ruins has decreased over the years
“However... Baole, if there really is an irreversible life-and-death crisis in the federation, I might still carry out that mission in the end and try my best to leave a spark for the federation
“The reason why I’m telling you now is because I, Lin You, have no regrets!”With that, Lin you bowed deeply towards Wang Baole once again. He raised his head and didn’t avoid Wang Baole’s gaze, allowing him to see his honesty.
He stared at Lin You for a long time before Wang Baole nodded slowly. There was a thoughtful look in his eyes, and he suddenly asked, “Tell me about the Moon Star sect.”.
“Tell me about the Moon Star Sect.”
“I don’t know where the Moon Star sect is, nor do I know how powerful it is. However, I do know... that there should be at least hundreds of cultivators like you, Baole.”
“As for the stars... just by looking up from the Moon Star sect, I can see that there are dozens of stars in the sky! “At the same time, the Moon Star sect must have a deep connection to the ancient Earth. In fact, it’s possible that they were created by the ancients who migrated from Earth. In addition... I’ve seen quite a few laurel trees in the Moon Star sect, just like fellow Daoist gui...” Lin You’s heart palpitated as he spoke, as if he had just recalled something.
“Oh, right. In the Moon Star sect, everyone who has reached a certain level of status wears a mask... masks come in all shapes and sizes, and most of them are different.”
“A mask?”Wang Baole was taken aback and fell into deep thought. Lin you heaved a sigh of relief after he had finished speaking. He hadn’t lied. He didn’t want to cause any misunderstandings between Wang Baole and himself, and he didn’t want them to become enemies.
After all, this was his hometown, and everything about him was in the federation. Now that his son was getting married, his feelings for this place were even deeper. That was why when he had seen the giant tree talking to Wang Baole earlier, even though he didn’t know the details, he had a feeling that something was amiss, that was why he had made up his mind after some hesitation. He revealed all the secrets that had been hidden deep in his heart. He believed that with Wang Baole’s intelligence and experience, he would be able to tell if what he had said was true or false.
After he finished speaking, Lin you felt much more relaxed. He saw that Wang Baole was deep in thought, so he didn’t continue disturbing him. Instead, he cupped his fists and left.
There were many people who could sense that Wang Baole was deep in thought. After all, those who could attend the wedding were mostly the upper echelons of the federation. They could tell when to stop. Therefore, no one came to disturb Wang Baole’s thoughts for the rest of the time.
Just like that, after the time it takes for half an incense stick to burn, Wang Baole muttered to himself.
I seem to have overlooked something... Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. When he heard the word “Mask”and thought about it, the image of the masked woman in the fallen star lands appeared in his mind!
The image of the woman could not be erased. As his mind became more and more focused, he finally fixed his eyes on the beautiful woman’s mask. As he recalled, the gaze of the woman in the mask became clearer in his mind.
Finally, Wang Baole raised his right hand and took out the jade slip that could contact the blazing flame ancestor. After a moment of silence, he sent a voice transmission respectfully.
“Is master around? Do you have the complete list of people who have been promoted to planet-level from the fallen star lands to the Weiyang Dao Domain?”
Wang Baole knew that not everyone could see the list. Only those who were qualified enough to receive it in the Weiyang Dao domain would receive it. In the fallen star lands, he could only see himself. He couldn’t see everything, he hadn’t paid much attention to the matter at first, but now, with the masked woman’s figure and suspicions in his mind, Wang Baole decided to look through the entire list.
Soon, the blazing flame patriarch, who had received Wang Baole’s voice transmission, sent the list over. He also replied to Wang Baole.
“My good disciple, I’ve already arranged for someone to pick you up. When you’re done with your matters, I’ll wait for you in the Raging Flame Galaxy!”
“As per master’s orders!”Wang Baole replied respectfully. He immediately opened the complete list that the raging flame ancestor had sent him. After scanning it, his breathing quickened, and his pupils constricted. He stared at the name on the list!
Li Wan ‘Er, Moon Star sect!
Li Wan ‘er... is this a coincidence? Wang Baole’s mind was filled with disbelief as Li Wan ‘er’s figure and the masked woman overlapped, he sent a voice transmission to Lin Tianhao, who was toasting with Du Min. Then, he left the wedding venue in a hurry. He stepped out of the hall and disappeared instantly.
When he appeared, he was no longer on Mars. Instead, he was speeding through the starry skies. He landed on Earth in an instant and appeared... outside the Chairman’s residence!
Outside the residence, Wang Baole took a deep breath and stood there, cupping his fists and bowing.
“This junior, Wang Baole, seeks an audience with uncle Li!”
Although the senator’s cultivation had fallen to that of a mortal, his contributions to the federation, especially his status as Li Wan ‘Er’s father, made it necessary for Wang Baole to treat him as a junior!

chapters.title: Chapter 997 - sealed remains!
chapters.content:
Chapter 997: sealed remains!
The visit didn’t last long. In the end, Wang Baole left the senator’s residence under the senator’s personal escort. It was late at night outside. He looked at the bright moon in the sky and felt the gentle breeze blowing in his face, wang Baole walked on the streets with a complicated expression on his face.
He wasn’t the only person on the streets. He could occasionally see a few passersby walking past him. However, none of the passersby seemed to be able to see Wang Baole in their eyes. This made his presence very abrupt and at the same time.., it was similar to how he felt, and there was a hint of sadness in his heart.
He thought of Zhao Yameng and Zhou Xiaoya.
He had learned from the head senator that Li Wan ‘Er had gone missing. Due to some unforeseen circumstances, she had not participated in the Dark Swallow Project. This incident made Li Wan ‘er feel guilty and unwilling, therefore... She, who had access to some of the Federation’s secrets, went to some of the ruins on Earth.
In the end, she disappeared without a trace.
After knowing all this, Wang Baole recalled everything that had happened at the fallen star. His guess had been confirmed. The image of the masked woman in his mind had completely overlapped with the familiar body of Li Wan ‘Er.
Why didn’t she tell me? was there something she was hiding, or was she unwilling to tell me? Wang Baole shook his head, he suppressed the thoughts in his heart. He felt that no matter what, they would meet again in the starry skies in the future. In order to reassure the council member, Wang Baole had thought about it and told him about Li Wan ‘er.
At the same time, from the council member, Wang Baole learned that Kong Dao wasn’t the only one who hadn’t returned to the Dark Swallow Plan. Li Wuchen hadn’t returned either.
However, just like Kong Dao, the flame of life hadn’t been extinguished. Based on a simple estimation, there shouldn’t have been too many life-and-death accidents. Wang Baole was a little emotional, but he understood that ever since he had embarked on this path of cultivation.., he could only wish each of them well.
As for the ruins... Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. This was a hidden danger after all. The relationship between the Moon Star sect and earth was uncertain. However, regardless, the other party had immense power. Compared to the current federation.., they were extremely weak. As a result, there was a strong imbalance between the two parties.
This imbalance meant that the federation had no right to take the initiative.
...
If that’s the case... It’s better to seal those ruins! Wang baole’s eyes shone brightly. He slowly closed his eyes and spread out his divine sense, covering the entire earth and searching for all the ruins.
As his divine sense spread out, everything on Earth instantly became clear in his mind. He saw the lights of tens of thousands of homes. They were the joys and sorrows of countless living beings in the cities.
The appearance of all living beings in an instant represented a different life. Wang Baole was deeply affected by it, causing ripples to form in his heart. Then, he saw the endless wilderness. It had once been the gathering place of ferocious beasts, now, he couldn’t see many ferocious beasts anymore.
Even some of them had slowly changed their habits and become harmless after being suppressed for so many years. That was the only way they could survive.
Other than that, Wang Baole also saw the vast ocean and the mysterious bottom of the ocean. As the ocean stretched as far as the eye could see, the gigantic sea beasts at the bottom of the ocean trembled as Wang Baole scanned them with his divine sense.
“There are no more secrets,”Wang Baole muttered. He saw the spirit Qi that was slowly growing throughout the entire earth.
The Spirit Qi was weak, but it continued to spread. Since the spirit inception era, the Spirit Qi on Earth no longer came from the fragments of the ancient green-bronze sword. Instead, it was slowly condensing itself under the constant changes in the environment.
It could be imagined that even without external help, the environment on Earth would become richer in spirit qi after tens of thousands of years.
Looking at all this, nine regions finally appeared in Wang Baole’s mind!
They were nine ruins!
The nine ruins were scattered across the earth. The distance between them seemed to be irregular, but Wang baole could vaguely sense the traces of the array formation restriction.
There were three locations in particular... Wang Baole didn’t see any records in the Federation’s Secret Manual. This meant that the federation hadn’t noticed the three ruins before!
.
They were located deep beneath the sea.
At the same time, with Wang Baole’s current cultivation, he couldn’t see any special fluctuations in the nine ruins. Everything seemed to be no different from the ruins.
However, there had been too many cases of intruders going missing since the spirit inception era despite the fact that there was nothing unusual about the ruins.
Is the Moon Star sect... an enemy or a friend? Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and took a step forward, disappearing from the streets. When he reappeared, he was already outside the first ruins!
The ruins were buried deep underground. There was a mountain range on top of it, where ferocious beasts used to gather. When Wang Baole appeared, all he could see was desolation. The mountain peaks were green in color, however, it was difficult to hide the thick aura of death that permeated the area.
It was clear that a long time ago, there had been a battle between ferocious beasts and cultivators. The entrance to the ruins was a mountain stream. Even though more than half of it had collapsed, one could still pass through it. Furthermore, it was located around the entrance, there was also the power of the array formation. With just a glance, Wang Baole could immediately tell that the array formation came from Ethereal Dao College. There was a unique, faintly discernible fog that was unique to ethereal dao college.
Was it sealed by the grand supreme elder back then... Wang Baole’s body swayed. He ignored the array formation and stepped into the mountain stream. He sped all the way until he reached the interior of the ruins. The place was already empty. There was only the ground at the end, there were obvious traces of the ancient array formation that had been destroyed.
The array formation seemed to have existed for a long time. There were even signs of weathering on the ground. With Wang Baole’s cultivation, he could tell at a glance that the array formation was used for teleportation. The area affected was large enough to cover the entire ruins, it looked like it had been destroyed, but it was still powerful. The only difference was that the area affected had been reduced.
Wang Baole stared at the array formation and memorized its structure. A glint flashed in his eyes. The nine ancient stars behind him materialized into Dao Stars. At the same time, he raised his right hand and pressed down lightly on the array formation.
With that, the ground began to tremble. The array formation trembled as well, and cracks appeared on its surface. The number of cracks increased. Finally, with a loud boom, the entire array formation seemed to have been torn apart by an invisible hand, it split into four parts.
Large amounts of spirit qi, visible to the naked eye, rose from the cracks and spread in all directions with a loud boom. Eventually, they covered the entire area and merged with the heavens and earth.
Only then did the power of the array formation be completely dispelled!
After checking the area again and making sure that he hadn’t missed anything, Wang Baole turned around and left. He went to the second, third, and sixth ruins!
The five ruins behind him were distributed in different regions of the Earth. Some were in rivers, some were deep underground, and some were in a primitive rainforest. They all looked different, and they all existed in rivers, it was a stone bull that didn’t look big, but it actually contained supernatural powers and spells. It was as majestic as a small world.
Deep Underground, there was an underground city. In the primitive rainforest, there was an altar that worshipped unknown gods.
These ruins were all recorded in the Federation’s records without exception, so there were signs of being sealed. However, to Wang Baole, these seals were not perfect. As he walked past, he tore apart the array formations in the five ruins, all of them.
However, what made him feel regretful was that although the five ruins looked mysterious, he did not see any clues inside. It was as if everything had collapsed the moment the ruins were opened.
Finally, Wang Baole turned his gaze to the depths of the sea. The three ruins that had not been recorded by the federation, or even detected by humans, were located!
They were... a humongous rotting whale that was tens of thousands of feet tall. Half of its body was buried in the mud at the bottom of the sea. The exposed parts of its body were filled with an aura of death that affected the surrounding sea, turning the place pitch-black.
The other was a temple that was covered in seaweed. It seemed to have been damaged by the mighty force of the changes in the world!
In front of the temple, there was a statue of a cultivator. Its face was blurry, but the stone sword on its back still exuded a sharp aura. It caused all the sea creatures that had approached it over the years to pile up into rings of rotting bones.
Finally, there was a mountain!
There was a stone door at the bottom of the mountain. There were runes engraved on the door. These runes contained a strange power that could make all cultivators who saw it instantly think of the meaning of the runes.
The meaning of the runes was..
Sea suppression!

chapters.title: Chapter 998
chapters.content:
Chapter 998: — good and evil are hard to determine!
The rotting whale, the divine temple, and the sea suppression? Wang Baole narrowed his eyes as he recalled the various legends he had heard of on Earth. Although there were similar legends, he was still certain that there were no records in any of the legends, there were no records of such legends.
Not only were there no records in the federation, but there were also no records of legends that had existed for a long time.
“Interesting…”Wang Baole muttered as his body swayed and disappeared. When he reappeared, he was at the bottom of the sea where the rotting whale was. As soon as he reappeared, all he could see was darkness, the thick death Qi made the seawater in the area seem to be filled with a strange corrosive power.
Not only were all sea creatures unable to get close, even Wang Baole felt a little uncomfortable. Even though he was a clone, he was still at the planet level. Furthermore, due to the existence of his dao planet.., this made his origin dharmic body weaker than his actual body in terms of combat power, but the difference wasn’t too great.
He could still fight even against a planet below the late-stage of the immortal planet. However, here, he could clearly sense that if he didn’t do something, his origin would be damaged if he stayed here for too long.
From this, it could be seen that while this place was strange, it also contained a shocking amount of power. If it was anyone else, even if it was a planet, the slightest hesitation would cause them to die here.
The rotting whale… Wang Baole’s eyes lit up. The nine ancient planets behind him transformed into dao stars, causing the light of the stars to spread out around his body instantly. It was like a torch in the dark night, appearing at the bottom of the pitch-black sea in an instant, it was particularly eye-catching. The light of the stars on his body spread out and illuminated the surroundings, allowing Wang Baole to see the details of the humongous rotting whale’s skeleton even more clearly!
All the exposed bones were engraved with symbols. There were also a large number of tiny insects that seemed to be sleeping within the decaying flesh. Each and every one of these tiny insects seemed to be formed from the aura of death, the number of them… was enough to shock anyone.
This scene was enough to shock most of the planets. Even the planet’s prodigies, who possessed the laws of the soul fusion planet, would have a drastic change in expression. Their first reaction would be to retreat and leave first, they would have to think about it after making their plans.
However, to Wang Baole, it only made him look a little odd. He narrowed his eyes, but the Black Star among the nine ancient stars shone brightly, instantly replacing the light of the other ancient stars, with the augmentation of the Dao Stars’laws, it shone brightly behind Wang Baole.
The hidden law of this black ancient star was death!
As a dark child, Wang Baole’s supernatural powers didn’t fear any spirits of the dead. With this double augmentation, Wang Baole’s existence was basically able to ignore all signs of death. With just a quick glance.., his body flashed and he approached the rotting whale. Without any hesitation, he followed the crevices in the rotting whale’s ribs and charged into it.
There was something else within the rotting whale. It was like a biological warship. As Wang Baole searched, he even saw cabins. However, as time passed, most of them had decayed. In these cabins.., wang Baole saw corpses!
......
There were so many corpses that there were probably more than a thousand of them. They had all decayed, and many of them were incomplete as time passed. However, it was clear that they… were not human cultivators.
Wang baole frowned. According to Lin You, the Moon Star sect had left Earth, so they should have been in human form. However, that was not the case here. Wang Baole examined them carefully and stopped in a cabin, he lowered his head to look at a corpse on the ground. He stared at it for a moment, then fell into deep thought.
There are no signs of struggle. It seems like all the beings in the whale died instantly… or did they lose their ability to resist? Wang Baole was deep in thought. Suddenly, a cold glint flashed in his eyes, the ripples of cultivation in his body erupted instantly. The instant they spread outwards, countless blood threads emerged from the ground beneath his feet and enveloped him.
However, they came into contact with the ripples of cultivation that spread outwards from Wang Baole. Amidst the invisible collision, there were continuous explosions.
Following that, even more blood threads appeared from within the rotten whale’s body. They charged towards Wang Baole in a frenzy, as if they wanted to devour him. Furthermore, the blood threads were strange. Wang Baole could sense that within these blood threads.., it seemed to contain a divine ability that could confine life. As long as one was touched by it, they would lose all mobility.
“Petty tricks!”Wang Baole snorted coldly. He raised his right hand abruptly, ignoring the blood strands that were surging wildly. He grabbed forcefully, and immediately, the rules of blood revolved, forming a blood ring that spread out in all directions, the blood strands that were drifting towards him trembled violently. They seemed to distort and showed signs of retreating. However, as Wang Baole snorted coldly, they seemed to be forcefully interfered with. They gathered towards Wang Baole once again. However, this time.., they gathered on his palm.
In an instant, all the blood threads rushed towards him. Finally, they formed a ball of blood in Wang Baole’s hand. As the ball of blood squirmed, it transformed into a human-shaped little person. As it struggled, it let out an invisible roar towards Wang Baole, it was as if it wanted to attack his soul.
“Artifact Spirit?”With Wang Baole’s attainments in Dharmic artifacts, he could tell the origins of the little person at a glance. At that moment, he grabbed the blood-colored little person with his right hand and pressed his left hand against the inner wall of the rotting whale. A cold voice rang out.
“You have guts. I control the spirits of the dead and the corpses of the dead!”
“Rise!”
As Wang Baole spoke, the laws of the ancient black planet spread, and the body of the hundred-thousand-foot-tall rotting whale shook violently. Under the laws of the ancient black planet, a strange force instantly spread throughout the whale’s body, it caused the black hole in its eyes, which had already rotted, to instantly reveal a dark fire. Its body trembled as if it had come to life, and it came to life!
Although more than half of its body was buried under the mud, as it was endowed with life, and as its body shook violently, with a loud rumble, the rotten whale’s tail and fins shook, and its body struggled out of the mud, it revealed the countless blood threads that were connected to its abdomen!
And at the other end of the blood threads… at the bottom of the mud, which revealed a deep pit… There was a huge array formation!
The blood threads on the array formation were connected to the rotten whale and the tiny blood-red humanoid in Wang Baole’s hands. This scene caused the tiny humanoid, which was struggling non-stop in Wang Baole’s hands and letting out a soundless roar, to be stunned for a moment. Then, its body began to tremble, it looked at Wang Baole with uncontrollable fear in its eyes.
Ignoring the tiny humanoid’s fear, Wang Baole’s body flashed and appeared outside the rotten whale. He lowered his head to look at the array formation in the mud at the bottom of the sea. He could feel that this array formation was similar to the array formation in the ruins that he had seen previously. They were all teleportation, at the same time, he could tell that it was different.
The array formations in the other ruins were all dilapidated. Even if there were some hidden fluctuations, they were mostly hidden. It was obvious that they had been around for too long and couldn’t be activated at all times without replenishment. They were like batteries, in a state of weak electricity.
However, the array formation was different. It was completely activated and in a state of strong electricity. Wang Baole immediately guessed the answer. The whale was indeed a biological dharmic cruiser, and it wasn’t from the Moon Star sect. It was from this sect.., or perhaps it was for some other reason that it was forcefully sucked onto the array formation, which was used to recharge the array formation.
It was also because of this that the teleportation array formation remained in a state that could be activated at any time. It even produced an artifact spirit, or more appropriately, an array spirit.
As Wang Baole guessed all of this in his mind, the array formation began to glow. It was as if the teleportation was about to activate on its own under the stimulation.
Wang Baole’s eyes flashed. As the array formation continued to glow, he stomped hard across the air with his right foot. There was a loud boom, and the array formation shook violently. Cracking sounds rang out, and the array formation shattered into pieces. The glow from the array formation slowly dimmed, the glow from the array formation also dimmed.
The blood-colored tiny being in Wang Baole’s hand let out a blood-curdling scream. It was extremely dispirited. After being sealed by Wang Baole, it was immediately put away. Then, without wasting any time, it put away the rotting whale. It turned around and left the sea, when it reappeared… it was at the bottom of another sea. In front of it was the sea grass, and in front of it was a stone statue with a stone sword on its back… The Divine Temple!
The moment Wang Baole appeared, the stone statue’s body trembled slightly. Sword Qi rose from the stone sword on its back, and it wagged its finger at Wang Baole!

chapters.title: Chapter 999
chapters.content:
Chapter 999: — the intimidation of the Galaxy Bow!
Wang Baole stood there, not moving an inch. A serious look slowly appeared in his eyes as he stared at the stone sculpture.
The face of the stone sculpture was blurry, and Wang Baole couldn’t see its exact appearance. However, from its appearance, he could tell that it was a human cultivator. It was filled with the aura of time, and its clothes were extremely ancient. The sword on its back, though made of stone.., however, it exuded a sharp sword intent, and Wang Baole even felt a strong sense of danger.
It was as if if he were to take a few more steps forward, the sword Qi within the stone sword would explode towards him.
This could be clearly seen from the countless piles of sea beast carcasses that had been dead for an unknown period of time.
This scene made Wang Baole hesitate in silence. If it wasn’t necessary, he didn’t want to disturb the arrangement of the temple. After all, the stone statue and the stone sword seemed to possess the power to kill him.
This was just the remnants of the sword’s power, which had clearly dissipated by more than half after countless years. One could imagine that if it had been countless years ago, when the stone statue and the stone sword had been at their peak, they would have been able to destroy the world with a single strike of the sword!
If the original body had been here, he could have used the power of time to force his way in. However, there was still a difference between the clone and the original body. However, when Wang Baole shifted his gaze away from the stone statue.., as he looked at the temple that was filled with seaweed, his eyes slowly lit up.
There was no door to the temple. Standing there, one could clearly see that there were no deities worshiped in the temple. Instead, there was a teleportation array formation. The array formation was active, but it was different from the rotting whale array formation. There were thin threads on the array formation, they extended to the surface of the sea and covered more than half of earth.
They were not connected to all living things. Instead, they were connected to the gathering points of Spirit Qi on Earth. Spirit Qi was continuously extracted from them and integrated into the array formation.
If Wang Baole did not have a plan to allow the solar system to integrate with the God’s eye civilization, he could have ignored the arrangements here and chosen to leave. However, that was no longer possible.
Through his analysis and judgment, after the Solar System had integrated with the God’s eye civilization, the array formation would absorb an indescribable amount of spirit Qi in an instant as the spirit qi increased exponentially, when that happened… Wang Baole didn’t dare to bet on what would happen.
That was also the reason why he had been sealed in the ruins on Earth. After a moment of silence, Wang Baole rubbed the space between his brows and cupped his fists and bowed to the stone statue.
“Senior, this junior really doesn’t know if this place is good or evil to the federation. In order to prevent any mishaps, I wanted to seal the array formation and cut off all ties with the outside world. I was forced to do so. Please forgive me, Senior.” Wang Baole lifted his feet and walked forward. One step, two steps..
......
However, the moment he took his third step, the stone sword on the back of the stone sculpture suddenly buzzed. The Sword Qi suddenly erupted and turned into a long rainbow that charged toward Wang Baole!
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and retreated abruptly. He took seven steps back and left the restricted area of the Divine Temple. However, the sword Qi could not suppress its murderous intent. No matter how far Wang Baole retreated, it continued to approach him with a murderous aura, it was as if it would kill him even if it was at the ends of the Earth. Just as it was about to reach Wang baole, a cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes.
“Looks like it’s Evil!”As he said that, Wang Baole raised his right hand. Immediately, a gigantic bow appeared in his hand. The moment the bow appeared, the seabed rumbled. Even the solar system trembled and the sun dimmed, even the masked little Missy and the Galactic Patriarch, who were reminiscing about the past on the ancient bronze sword, looked in the direction of Earth.
“This is…”
“The Galaxy Bow!”The Little Missy’s eyes were solemn. As she spoke softly, deep in the ocean on Earth, opposite the stone statue in the Divine Temple, Wang Baole pulled the bowstring with his right hand. He let out a low growl, and his cultivation erupted completely, the nine ancient stars behind him shone, and the dao stars that formed emitted a blinding light. All the power of cultivation gathered, and the bowstring… was finally pulled open by Wang Baole!
Even though it wasn’t a full moon, it was about seventy percent pulled open. The gemstones that looked like stars that were embedded in the bow were also shining rapidly. One of them… lit up!
Even though it wasn’t fully lit up, it still gave off a faint glow, causing the area around Wang Baole to glow with the fire of the stars. The source of the fire was this bow!
Just as Little Missy had said, this bow… was indeed the replica galaxy bow that Wang Baole had found in the storage ring that contained the mysterious bottle and the paper figurine!
Even though it was a replica, its power was still earth-shattering. Even the current Wang Baole could only reach the full moon once in his strongest state after fusing with his original body!
His current clone could only reach seventy percent. Even so… the suppressive force that emanated from it still caused the rapidly approaching sword Qi to suddenly stop in front of Wang Baole, as if hesitating.
I’ll only destroy the power that emanates from the array formation, preventing it from activating itself. I Won’t do anything else
Wang Baole stared at the rainbow formed by the Sword Qi. He didn’t release the bowstring, but the ferocity in his eyes had already spread out his will decisively. After seven to eight breaths, the rainbow instantly fell backwards and returned to the stone sword, the suppressive force that emanated from it also disappeared.
Even though the sword Qi had disappeared, Wang Baole didn’t let his guard down. He maintained the state of drawing the bow and walked towards the stone statue. As he approached, the stone statue didn’t move. Wang Baole stepped into the divine temple, the stone statue didn’t change at all.
Seeing this, Wang Baole didn’t waste any more time. He raised his right foot and stomped hard on the array formation. As he circulated his cultivation, a loud boom reverberated. The array formation of the divine temple shattered immediately. The threads that had been released also broke, after checking it again and again, Wang Baole finally left the area around the temple. He retreated a few thousand feet before putting away the galaxy bow.
He didn’t want to use the bow easily. Once it was shot out, he would be extremely weak. Unless it was absolutely necessary, he had no other choice. He didn’t want to release it.
He could resolve this peacefully. Although he hadn’t destroyed the temple to prevent future trouble, he had met his requirements. Before he left, Wang Baole turned around and gave the temple a deep look. Then, he turned around and disappeared.
When he reappeared, he was already outside the last vestige at the bottom of the sea. The vestige was the small mountain with the stone door. Wang Baole narrowed his eyes slowly as he looked at the symbols on the stone door that had the meaning of sea suppression.
However, it was different from what he had expected. Perhaps it could be said that the confrontation with the stone sword outside the temple had caused some changes to the sea suppression mountain. Therefore, when Wang Baole appeared before the small mountain.., the stone door on the mountain opened on its own!
As it opened, a figure walked out from within the mountain gate!
Wang Baole’s pupils constricted. He saw clearly that the person who had walked out wasn’t a real person. He looked like an elder dressed in a green robe, but in reality, he was a wooden puppet.
The puppet held two items in its hands. One was an ancient jade slip, and the other was an array disk. As Wang Baole was on guard, the puppet placed the two items in front of Wang Baole. Then, it turned around and returned to the mountain gate, with a wave of its hand, the small mountain at the mountain gate instantly became transparent, allowing Wang Baole to see everything inside clearly.
The small mountain was a cave abode. Other than the stone tables and chairs, it was mostly empty. There was only an altar, but it was empty. From the decorations on the altar, it was clear that there had been some items previously, it had been worshipped.
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. After a moment of silence, he lowered his head to look at the array disk that the puppet had sent over. The answer was self-evident. The array disk had been worshipped by the altar, and the reason why the puppet had been honest was to tell him that.., there was no more teleportation array formation in the cave abode.
There was something strange about this. After the puppet had made the mountain gate transparent, it cupped its fists at Wang Baole and walked into the mountain gate. The mountain slowly materialized.
Wang Baole stared at all of this. He was silent for a long time. He raised his right hand and grabbed. Immediately, the jade slip and the array disk landed in his hand. He first swept the array disk, and instantly, hundreds of light spots appeared in his mind. These light spots covered the entire earth, every spot was a teleportation array formation.
However, most of the light spots were dim now, as if they had lost their use. The array disk seemed to be the core that controlled the array formations.
He gave this to me? Wang baole frowned and looked at the jade slip again. The moment he scanned it with his divine perception, a historical record appeared in his mind!

chapters.title: Chapter 1000
chapters.content:
Chapter 1000: fusion of divine eyes!
This history was not complicated. It was just that a few years ago, there was spiritual energy on Earth. In this cultivation environment, there would naturally be cultivators.
However, as time passed, due to some unspeakable accidents, the spiritual energy on earth dried up. Therefore, at that time, the cultivators on earth gathered together. With a force called the Moon Star sect as the leader, they relied on the resources of that time.., to carry out a great migration.
The place they went to was no longer the left path holy region. Instead, they went to the side path holy region. After countless years of evolution, they had completely taken root in the side path holy region, and had grown to become a towering tree.
However… The Moon Star sect of the side path holy region paid attention to the direct bloodline. Therefore, regardless of whether they had left behind a teleportation array before the migration, or whether they had returned to Earth after the migration, they had left behind some backup plans.
Their main goal wasn’t to plot against the federation, but to absorb the bloodline and integrate it into the Moon Star sect. At the very least… from the jade slip, that was what it looked like.
Wang Baole didn’t know if there were any other secrets. However, after reading the jade slip, his eyes narrowed.
Maybe I’m a villain, but I still feel that the matter of the Moon Star sect leaving behind a teleportation array formation on earth and absorbing the bloodline… is definitely not as simple as it looks
Wang Baole’s eyes sparkled. He couldn’t explain the reason. All of this was just his guess. As for what would happen in the end, Wang Baole believed that he would find out one day.
Regardless, from the looks of it, the Moon Star sect didn’t have any ill intentions towards the federation.
We’ll talk about the future in the future. Wang Baole shook his head. He stared deeply at the small mountain at the bottom of the sea that had been shut down by the cave abode. He turned around and left the sea. When he reappeared, he was already outside the Sun in the Solar System.
He sat down cross-legged and looked into the distance. At the same time, he began making final preparations for the God’s eye civilization’s teleportation and fusion. Time passed slowly, and the day of the God’s eye civilization’s fusion drew nearer and nearer.
Under the leadership of Zhao Yameng’s mother, the new president of the Federation, all the planets were ready. They had prepared themselves for the arrival of a new era. The citizens also learned of the news during this period of time, although there was some panic, it was still stable on the whole.
Panic was inevitable. After all, the arrival of an extraterrestrial civilization, even if it was a fusion, would still have an impact on the federation. This unknown would naturally be used by people with ulterior motives to incite them.
......
However, the current federation was different from before. These people with ulterior motives didn’t dare to act rashly. Therefore, even though there were some minor disturbances, they were quickly suppressed by the upper echelons of the federation.
A few days later… Wang Baole’s clone, who was sitting cross-legged on the Solar System’s star, and his original body, who was meditating in the divine eye civilization’s star, opened their eyes at the same time. The teleportation… had officially begun!
A loud boom rang out within the divine eye civilization’s area and from the star. It swept across the entire divine eye civilization like a storm, causing the eight planets in the divine eye civilization to tremble, it also made all the people of the god eye civilization on the eight planets feel uneasy.
However, this anxiety did not last long. As all areas of the god eye civilization were instantly covered by the light from the star, and as the entire civilization turned into a sea of light, everyone’s mind went blank.
Only the sky-palm Elder, who was the only planet among the local cultivators of the god eye civilization, could barely see the changes in the starry sky. In his eyes, he saw the so-called sea of light, which was a teleportation ripple.
With the divine eye civilization’s star as the core, the Sea of light formed from the glow of teleportation spread out. It covered everything and merged with everything within the divine eye civilization.
Civilization teleportation… the sky-palm Elder’s heart trembled violently. He had lived for so long, but this was the first time he had witnessed the vastness of civilization teleportation with his own eyes. He couldn’t help but look at the woman who was sitting cross-legged not far away from him, she was sitting cross-legged and meditating. She had no expression on her face.
The Heaven Palm Elder had been fearful of Zhao Yameng during this period of time. This fear had something to do with the fact that he was under Wang Baole’s control and couldn’t fight back for the rest of his life, however, it also had something to do with the series of methods Zhao Yameng had used in the God’s eye civilization.
In a short period of time, Zhao Yameng had completely integrated the god’s eye civilization. Not only had she pushed Wang Baole to ascend the throne and become the emperor of the God’s eye civilization, she had also used ruthless methods to suppress all those who disagreed with her. During the bloody massacres.., she had terrified the cultivators of the God’s eye civilization.
If that was all there was to it, the sky-palm Elder wouldn’t be afraid. Zhao Yameng had even set up a set of laws for the God’s eye civilization. Theoretically, the law couldn’t escape the law of the jungle, but overall.., for ordinary cultivators, they could still protect their rights and lives. If they handled it well, it wasn’t impossible to suppress the strong with the weak!
This was like a storm to the god eye civilization. After all, before this, the god eye civilization had collapsed and lived by plundering. The imperial family didn’t have any means to interfere, causing the entire god eye civilization to be in chaos, it also made countless people suffer unspeakably.
Therefore, when this law was issued, it immediately gained the favor of a large number of low-level cultivators, making them willingly tie this legal rope to their bodies. Those experts had no choice but to agree, and apart from that.., zhao Yameng also announced the reward system, so that all efforts would be rewarded and appease the hearts of the people.
All of this was just a part of Zhao Yameng’s methods. However, just this alone made the sky-holding patriarch realize that if this continued, then it wouldn’t take many generations for the God’s eye civilization to be suppressed, everything could operate on its own.
And all of this would be dependent on the federation’s system. The Federation would become the law enforcer, and the Public Trust.
The sky-holding patriarch wasn’t sure if this was a good thing or a bad thing, so he could only sigh and watch as the teleportation light sea covered the entire civilization’s starry sky. Then… The teleportation began, and in the blink of an eye, everything around them began to blur!
It was as if the divine eye civilization had been wiped out by an invisible hand in the space where it had originally been. In that instant, it disappeared without a trace. The Stars, planets, all living things, and all living things all disappeared at that moment.
The area that was left behind was an empty space that formed a vortex black hole. It drew the space that was even further away from it over and made up for it. Only then did it slowly calm down. However, the ripples that were stirred up in this area didn’t dissipate for a long time.
In the next instant, within the Solar System, as the divine eye civilization teleported and as Wang Baole’s clone opened his eyes, he raised both his hands abruptly and waved them to the sides. Instantly, the entire solar system rumbled, the starry sky trembled, and the hearts of all living beings surged, the divine eye civilization… had appeared within the Solar System!
The divine eye civilization that had just appeared wasn’t corporeal. It was in a semi-transparent state. Eight planets were scattered in the starry sky of the Solar System, surrounding the sun together with the eight planets. This scene shocked everyone who saw it.
At the same time, when the illusory shadow of the God Eye Civilization teleported over, its star was at the position of the Federation’s sun.
The two sides overlapped in an instant. At the moment of overlap, a monstrous sound came from within the sun, as if it had swallowed a huge tonic pill. The Sea of fire within the federation’s sun churned intensely, the light reached its peak in an instant, and its size also rose rapidly at this moment!
Booming sounds continued to reverberate. As the size of the sun expanded and the radiance within expanded, the starry sky where the Solar System civilization was located seemed to be stretched and expanded outwards!
The area was larger, and the star field was wider!
Finally, after it had expanded by more than twice its original size, the stars that had appeared in the new Solar System had finally completed their fusion. Their size had also increased by more than twice its original size, and the ancient bronze sword had originally been able to pierce through the sun, but now, as the two stars fused, it was forcefully pushed out, allowing the sun to finally return to its original state!
As for the ancient bronze sword, it was like a battleship, being pulled by the stars. It began to revolve around it, just like the stars. At the same time… at the periphery, there were a total of 16 planets that were spread out around the stars, the eight planets from the God’s eye civilization, which had been illusory before, began to rapidly materialize!
The transformation lasted for three days. Under the control of Wang Baole’s true form and his clone, the cultivators from the God’s eye civilization only felt a little weak amidst their anxiety, as if something was about to happen, it was a strange feeling that had changed ever since.
However, for all the life forms born in the federation civilization, what welcomed them was the explosion of light from the stars. It was a blessing for all life… a gift from the level of life!

chapters.title: Chapter 1001
chapters.content:
Chapter 1001:, Universal Ascension!
There were countless civilizations in the never-ending DAO domain. To ascend, one needed a long period of time, as well as the overall ascension of both individuals and races. Only then could the level of civilization slowly rise.
But there was also a shortcut!
This shortcut was to devour the stars that had fused with other civilizations. It would enslave all existences within the other civilization, both fundamentally and spiritually, thus raising the level of their own civilization’s stars.
Once the level of the stars was raised, it would be like water overflowing, and a phenomenon known as spirit feed would appear. This phenomenon could allow all the life in the civilization to be born here, in an instant, the essence of life would be raised, and it would affect the changes in cultivation. It could even allow some people’s cultivation to instantly rise, and it could even allow cultivators who had been stuck at a certain realm for a long time to break through.
Because this kind of improvement was too overbearing and didn’t have any negative consequences, it caused countless people to go crazy, but at the same time, it also allowed the war between the civilizations in the Weiyang Dao Domain to continue.
And this… was perhaps what the Weiyang race needed. Otherwise, after they replaced the dark sect, they wouldn’t have added this shortcut to the advancement of space civilizations into the Heavenly Dao.
However, no matter what, under this law, war was eternal, and the survival of the fittest or the survival of the fittest had become the norm. It didn’t matter if they were willing or unwilling.., in this Weiyang Dao domain that couldn’t control fate without advancement, the only thing placed before the solar system was continuous improvement.
And at this moment, with the appearance of the spirit feed and the light from the Sun that had merged with the God’s eye star, the ecology of the entire federation had undergone an earth-shattering change!
Mountain peaks rose from the ground, and spirit mines were formed in an instant. Rivers flowed endlessly, and farms turned into spirit fields. All ordinary things possessed magical powers!
Birds and beasts neighed, and clouds and mist descended on the Spirit Rain. All living things in the world were evolving. The vegetation grew wildly, and the world was nourished. All living things were nourished, and naturally, humans were among them, under Wang Baole’s guidance, the changes were even greater!
The first thing that was changed was the aptitude. This increase in the aptitude of the entire population allowed those who were originally not qualified to cultivate to possess the aptitude from that moment on!
This increased the aptitude of those who were already qualified!
At the same time, their looks seemed to have been adjusted. Under the changes in the level of life, there were some changes. As for their lifespan… it was the same. The citizens of the Federation had experienced an increase in their lifespan since the spirit inception era, however, compared to today, it was insignificant!
......
With the increase in their life force, the people of the Federation would be able to live to about two hundred years old, even if they didn’t practice cultivation. Not only would their longevity increase, but their health would also increase.
Other than that, there were also magical items that had been improved by the spirit blessing. However, the ones that had improved the most… were still cultivators!
When you went from the spiritual martial realm to conjuring magical items, you didn’t need any special items. You could level up on your own. When you went from Qi condensation to foundation establishment, you still needed special items. However, with the appearance of the spirit feed, the number of items that met the requirements increased, in fact, some of the cultivators who had long since prepared for the great circle of Qi condensation were able to successfully fuse with foundation establishment items and achieve a cultivation base breakthrough!
It could be said that almost all of the cultivators’cultivation bases had been upgraded by the spirit feed. The weaker their cultivation bases were, the greater the increase!
It was the same even for nascent soul realm cultivators. Nearly a hundred nascent soul realm cultivators who had been breaking through in the past few years in the entire federation had their cultivation boosted by the spirit feed. Several of them had even advanced from the perfected nascent Soul Realm, they had advanced directly to the supernatural realm!
It wasn’t just them. Li Xingwen, Zhao Yameng’s mother, and the other high-ranking officials were all in the same boat. The one who had advanced the most was Li Xingwen.
As a cultivator who had risen to prominence during the spirit inception era, as the first core formation realm cultivator, the first nascent soul realm cultivator, and the first spirit ascension realm cultivator other than Wang baole, Li Xingwen’s talent was astonishing. However, he was limited by his level of life, he didn’t have Wang Baole’s fortuitous experiences, which was why he had slowed down.
But now… with the spirit feed, his talent had improved, and his level of life had improved. His cultivation had opened a floodgate at that moment. A loud boom erupted, and he had risen from the Spirit Ascension realm all the way to the Spirit Immortal realm!
Not only him, but also Lin You. Zhao Yameng’s mother’s cultivation base also rose. After stepping into the Spirit Immortal Realm, the Federation had a fourth person who stepped into the Spirit Immortal realm.
This person was big tree!
Very quickly, a fifth person appeared. This fifth person was sect master Xu from the Galactic Dusk sect. He had always kept a low profile, but now, with the explosion of his cultivation base, he had returned to the peak of the Federation!
Compared to them, the younger generation like Lin Tianhao, Zhou Xiaoya, and the others had also improved. However, at most, they had reached the Spirit Ascension realm. There was still a gap between them. However, as long as they were given time, in the current spiritual energy environment of the new federation.., it was only a matter of time before their cultivation base broke through!
At the same time, the vast expanse Daoist palace had also benefited greatly. Although Feng Qiuran and the others from the Daoist Palace had not received the spirit feed, on the altar at the tip of the sword, the eyes of the Daoist Palace’s Celestial Domain Patriarch suddenly opened, all the injured people, including him, were instantly healed twice as fast as the Spirit Qi in the entire Solar System!
The Galactic Patriarch was deeply moved by this. Wang Baole had proven what he had said with his actions. He had confirmed his previous promise. He looked at Wang Baole, who was sitting cross-legged on the star, the Galactic Patriarch lowered his head and looked at the woman in court attire sitting before him.
“I agree to the Saintess’suggestion. Perhaps he is the most suitable person.”
The Masked Little Missy, who had followed Wang Baole all the way until now, smiled when she heard that. She bowed, turned, and left.
At that moment, the gifts from the star continued. As everyone’s level of life and cultivation increased, there were two more people who had improved tremendously!
One of them was Wang Baole, and the other was… Zhao Yameng!
The fusion of the stars came from the Sun’s spirit feed, which was a form of gratitude and blessing. The latter was to all living things in the federation, while the former… was to Wang Baole and Zhao Yameng!
That was why Zhao Yameng had improved tremendously. It was terrifying. Her level of life had increased beyond that of others. At the same time, her cultivation had also reached the perfected Spirit Immortal realm under the gathering of Endless Spirit Qi!
As for Wang Baole… as the leader of all this, especially the divine eye star, which had been fused with the sun, he had an unspoken connection with it. Therefore, the gift he had received was naturally the ultimate. His cultivation had broken through from the initial stage of the planet realm, with the influx of boundless spirit qi, he had broken through to the mid-stage of the planet realm!
Even though he had only advanced by one realm, the amount of spirit qi required to advance to the planet realm was something that cultivators below the planet realm couldn’t imagine.
To be able to increase his cultivation by one realm among the planets was already the best that the solar system could do. Wang Baole wasn’t unsatisfied, because he knew that this fusion… was only the beginning!
The spirit feed lasted for a full month. When it was complete, the sixteen planets in the solar system circled around each other, and the divine eye civilization and the federation were connected.
There were no obstacles or accidents during the docking process. It went smoothly. The divine eye civilization was integrated into the federation, with the Federation taking the lead.
At that point, Wang Baole understood that the matter with the federation had come to an end. With the Dao Palace Starfield, the Federation’s forces, the sky-palm Elder’s protection, and his own background.., overall, the Federation was safe for a certain period of time.
He had also received a message from the blazing flame elder, informing him that the emissary who had come to fetch him to the blazing flame galaxy was about to arrive.
Is it time to leave… Wang Baole muttered to himself. He scanned the current solar system with his divine perception. After sensing its vastness, he took out a paper slip.
The paper slip came from the meteorite land. Before leaving the meteorite land, Wang Baole had requested a favor from the meteorite emperor. He had requested thirty planet slots!
The paper slip was a token to enter the meteorite land. It could be used thirty times. With the approval of the meteorite emperor, there was no time limit. As long as one held the slip in their hands, they could summon the meteorite ship to welcome them, they could go on a separate trial.
This was the foundation he had prepared for the federation. The first person to use the slip of paper was Zhao Yameng.
He gave it to Zhao Yameng and watched as the ship of the fallen star appeared. Zhao Yameng boarded the ship and left. Wang Baole returned to Mars. As he accompanied his parents, he waited silently for the arrival of the emissary that his master had mentioned to welcome him!
“The Raging Flame Galaxy…”as he waited, Wang Baole occasionally raised his head and looked into the starry sky. His eyes gradually lit up with anticipation!
The end of the volume. The next volume: The Dark Sect reappeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 1002
chapters.content:
Chapter 1002:, the sixteenth young master!
?
Wang Baole didn’t wait too long. On the third day after he returned to Mars, outside the new solar system, which had become twice as large as before, a crimson-red ripple of flames appeared in the starry sky.
The ripple appeared abruptly, as if it had appeared out of thin air. As it spread, the ripple split apart on its own. When one looked at it with the naked eye, one could see countless ripples spreading outwards.
At first glance, it looked as if a stone had been thrown into the calm surface of a lake. However, because the ripples were formed by flames, they looked more like a sea of fire that was spreading out continuously. After a few dozen breaths, the Sea of fire that was spreading out began to churn, an illusory figure slowly formed from the center of the Sea of fire.
As this figure appeared, an earth-shattering aura that seemed to be able to shake the starry sky erupted from his body, causing the Sea of fire to churn even more intensely, the surrounding starry sky also began to show signs of cracking, as if it could no longer hold on.
It seemed… that the figure that was slowly condensing was of too high a status, which was why when it appeared, it caused the starry sky to tremble. Even the solar system was distorted. Clearly, if this terrifying existence had malicious intentions.., then it would only take a single thought for the Solar System to dissipate!
However, it was clear that this condensing figure had some restraint, which was why its aura was quickly restrained. It no longer spread outwards and affected the solar system. Instead, it condensed within its body. At the same time, its body also slowly solidified, it slowly became corporeal.
Its true appearance was revealed!
What appeared within the Sea of fire in the starry sky was shockingly an old bull that was emitting flames all over its body. This bull’s entire body was red, and as the Sea of fire churned beneath its feet, its size was 30,000 feet. And this… seemed to be the result of its suppression, it did not completely reveal its true form.
But even so, it still made the nearby starry sky seem as if it would collapse at any moment. The terrifying pressure that emanated from its body had already surpassed that of the stars, and even compared to the mighty figures in the galaxy, it did not seem to be too far off.
Such a terrifying existence was rarely seen in the starry sky. In fact, if it wanted to, whether it was the left Dao or the side dao sacred region, it could run amok. Basically, most of the civilizations in front of it.., were so weak that they could not withstand a single blow.
And its arrival was immediately noticed by the ancient bronze sword tip in the Solar System. The Dao Palace patriarch who was meditating on the third altar instantly noticed it. The old man’s eyes suddenly opened, revealing a look of shock and uncertainty, his breathing was also rapid. As his chest rose and fell, he stared fixedly in the direction of the old ox. His expression changed again and again, and his body slowly stood up. He was about to open his mouth to speak, but at this moment..
The Old Ox, who had descended from outside the Solar System, spoke first. He didn’t speak to just one person, but sent out a divine thought that affected the entire solar system. At that moment, no matter what anyone in the Solar System was doing.., his words, which were filled with the vicissitudes of life and carried a sense of authority, suddenly appeared in his mind!
......
“I, Yan Ling, AM here under the orders of the exalted Lord Blazing Flame to welcome the sixteenth young master, Wang baole, back to the blazing flame galaxy!”
This thought was like a storm, instantly filling the entire solar system. The moment it entered the minds of all living beings, the Dao Palace cultivators on the ancient green-bronze sword were all shaken. Even those who had been injured, unconscious, and recovering.., their bodies began to tremble unconsciously. As for the Galactic Patriarch on the third altar, his eyes narrowed instantly. His breathing quickened, and although he heaved a sigh of relief after learning of the other party’s background, his mind was once again focused.
He had thought that Wang Baole wouldn’t lie to him. Since he had said that he was the disciple of the blazing flame patriarch, he had to be. However, he hadn’t expected that Wang Baole’s Disciple’s identity would be even more shocking than he had imagined.
What kind of disciple… would make the blazing flame patriarch arrange for a galactic realm mighty figure to come and welcome him
I’m afraid that apart from welcoming him, he would also have to intimidate the heart of the Dao Palace… as well as the other political forces. He would have to make sure that all the political forces that had been paying attention to the Solar System’s integration with the divine eye would be restrained..
“All of this is ultimately due to the importance that we place on Wang Baole…”the Dao Palace patriarch was silent. The importance that he placed on Wang Baole also increased.
At the same time, countless citizens and cultivators from the Federation, as well as Lin Tianhao, Liu Daobin, and others who were familiar with Wang Baole, were all shocked as the voices in their minds surfaced.
“The sixteenth young master?”
“Wang Baole…”
“Although I don’t know the details of his identity, he sounds impressive. He must be extraordinary!”
“As expected of the guardian of the Federation! The founder of the Martian Special Zone! The old leader that I, Liu Daobin, have followed for my entire life!”
Amidst the uproar, Zhao Yameng’s mother, Li Xingwen, sect Lord Xu of the Galactic Dusk Sect, and Lin you all took a deep breath and looked at Mars from different positions.
Wang Baole had told them that he was leaving, and he had also told them where he was going. However, even though they were mentally prepared, they were still shaken.
The Old Bull’s terror and the words he had said with his telepathic thoughts had given them a clear understanding of Wang Baole’s status and the unpredictability of his future. Their determination, which had never been about to change, was now even stronger.
Even Zhao Yameng’s mother had an idea in her mind. She planned to talk to Zhao Yameng about her future with Wang Baole when she returned.
At the same time, she had made up her mind to take special care of Zhou Xiaoya. She had a strong worry in her heart. She was worried… that Wang Baole, who was moving further and further away, would one day grow too big and too fast.., he would gradually grow distant from the federation.
Even though she felt that the possibility was very, very small, as the Federation president, she had to consider it. The best way would be to make the other party worry about her. Other than her parents, she would also be able to join in, naturally, that would be her woman.
The hearts of all living beings were shaken. Countless thoughts rose in their minds. Wang Baole, who was on Mars, put down the bowl and chopsticks in his hands. He stood up and bowed deeply to his parents, who were looking at him with reluctance.
“Dad, Mom… I don’t know how long we’ll be gone for, but I don’t think it’ll be too long. You guys… Take Care!”
“Go, baole. You have to take care too…”Wang Baole’s mother suppressed her sadness and said softly. His father nodded at the side. He watched as Wang Baole’s bent back gradually disappeared from where he stood.
After he had completely disappeared, Baole’s mother couldn’t hold it in any longer. Tears streamed down her cheeks.
A soft sigh came from Wang Baole’s heart, who had appeared in the starry skies. He was reluctant to part with her, but he knew that stepping onto this path of cultivation was like sailing against the current. If he didn’t advance, he would retreat. Therefore, he could only continue forward, only in this way could he protect everything that he wanted to protect, and he could see the wider world.
At the same time, Wang Baole was filled with gratitude towards the blazing flame ancestor. He knew very well that the divine thoughts that came from the Solar System were his master’s love for him. This love was reflected in the fear of those who harbored ill intentions, it was also reflected in the peace of mind for his family and friends back home.
Wang Baole was satisfied with his master’s kind intentions. He stood in the starry sky, looking at the Solar System and earth. He vaguely saw the figure of a woman standing on the mountain peak of Ethereal Dao College, which had been rebuilt on Earth.
Her beautiful hair fluttered in the wind. It covered her face, but it couldn’t hide the gentle gaze in her eyes.
They seemed to be able to touch each other across the starry sky. Wang Baole looked at her for a long time, then nodded. He turned around and dashed… towards the outer Solar System!
He wasn’t worried about the federation this time. Be it the Alliance Agreement with the Vast Expanse Dao palace or the improvement in the level of the people after they had integrated with the God’s eye civilization, the federation was completely different from before.
It was even more powerful, and the blazing flame ancestor was also present. All of this allowed the federation to develop steadily for a period of time in the future!
Then… I’ll go and see just how vast and resplendent this starry sky is! Wang Baole was in high spirits. His eyes shone brightly, and his body transformed into a long rainbow with a loud bang, he traveled at an astonishing speed across the current solar system and appeared… outside the Solar System. He saw the vast sea of fire and the center of the Sea of fire. His entire body was exuding a terrifying aura… The old bull!

chapters.title: Chapter 1003
chapters.content:
Chapter 1003: was very clear!
?
Wang Baole stood there the moment he saw the old cow. He couldn’t help but swallow a mouthful of saliva, and his eyes widened. The aura emanating from the old cow was simply too shocking.
Even the Dao Palace’s Galaxy Realm Patriarch was inferior to it. If one were to really compare it to the emperor of the fallen star, the difference wasn’t that great.
However, the emperor of Starfall didn’t display such a majestic aura in front of Wang Baole. Therefore, it wasn’t appropriate for Wang Baole to make a true comparison. However, the old bull in his eyes was different. He looked like a beast.., the Flames all over his body and the flickering runic symbols on his body made Wang Baole feel as if he could see countless laws circulating and encircling him.
If that was all there was to it, it would have been fine. The moment Wang Baole appeared and looked at the old bull, the old bull lowered its head and stared at Wang Baole with its scarlet eyes.
The moment their eyes met, a thunderous roar immediately sounded in Wang Baole’s mind, causing him to feel a piercing pain in his eyes. His heart jolted, and he thought to himself that something was not right. Could it be that the old bull was unhappy with him, if not, why would he act so arrogantly in front of him… these thoughts flashed through Wang Baole’s mind. He immediately cupped his fists and bowed deeply with a respectful expression.
“I am Wang Baole, paying my respects to senior. Senior is extraordinary, a mighty figure rarely seen in my life. I am touched, grateful, and even more grateful that you have come to fetch me from so far away!”
As he spoke, the old bull’s gaze seemed to change. He sized Wang Baole up carefully before speaking calmly.
“Sixteenth young master, you don’t have to be so polite. I will naturally follow the orders of the exalted one. Come to my back. I will bring you… back to the Raging Flame Galaxy!”
As he spoke, the old bull snorted and spat out two balls of wind. As the wind rumbled in all directions, the flames in front of him spread out rapidly, revealing a path.
Wang Baole hesitated in his heart. However, he used the process of cupping his fists and bowing to the old bull to quickly weigh the situation before returning to normal. His body swayed, and he followed the path created by the Sea of fire and headed straight for the old bull.
The closer he got, the stronger the invisible pressure coming from the old bull. In the end, Wang Baole’s body was trembling, and beads of sweat appeared on his forehead. He even activated his dao star to withstand the pressure from the old bull, and with a leap.., he stepped on the old bull’s Back!
The moment he landed, he heard the old bull’s muffled voice.
......
“Sit Tight!”As he said that, the old bull raised his head and roared. He raised his two front hooves and stomped hard into the starry sky. Instantly, a deafening roar reverberated in the air. The Sea of fire in the surroundings was instantly raised, and it rushed over from all directions, it engulfed the old bull’s body in an instant.
In the blink of an eye, the Sea of fire disappeared. The old bull’s body and Wang Baole, who was on his back, disappeared without a trace!
In the next instant, in an unfamiliar starry sky far away from where the solar system was located, flames flashed. The old bull’s figure materialized. He shook his head and didn’t continue moving. Instead, he raised his hooves abruptly, he started running in the starry sky.
It was too fast. The sonic boom it created spread in all directions, causing all the surrounding civilizations to be shocked. They trembled, and Wang Baole, who was on the back of the old cow, felt his heart skip a beat.
On one hand, it was its speed. On the other hand… Wang Baole felt that the old cow under his feet was a mad cow. Judging from its momentum, it seemed to see nothing but straight lines and no turns… even if there were stars in front of it.., it would still crash into them.
In reality… that was indeed the case. In the next few days, Wang Baole watched helplessly as the mad cow crashed into seven stars. It even opened its mouth and sucked in the Spirit Qi from the stars, it sucked all of it into its mouth.
This made Wang Baole’s scalp tingle. Fortunately, he was on the old cow’s back. Even if he was affected by the impact, it wouldn’t affect him much. However… Wang Baole needed to constantly circulate his cultivation at full range, grabbing tightly onto the hair on the old cow’s back, otherwise… he was afraid that he would be thrown out.
Therefore, in order for him to be able to head to the raging flame galaxy safely and alive, Wang Baole felt that he needed to use some methods to increase the chances of this happening. Therefore… when the old cow crashed into the third star.., as he rushed out, he raised his head proudly and roared. Wang Baole immediately shouted loudly.
“Mighty Grandpa Niu!”
The Old Bull was stunned when he heard Wang Baole’s voice. However, he didn’t pay much attention to it and continued running. Soon, he smashed one star after another. Wang Baole’s words didn’t repeat themselves.
“Mighty Grandpa Niu!”
.
“Mighty Grandpa Niu!”
“Invincible Grandpa Niu!”
Just like that, after smashing more than thirty stars and hearing Wang Baole’s thirty-plus words of flattery, the old bull seemed to feel much better. For the first time, he laughed out loud.
“You’re a good talker and a good flatterer. If you can say a few more words to make me happy, I’ll allow you to ask me a question!”
“Uncle Cow, how can I be flattery? How can a creature like a horse compare to you? I, Wang Baole, have never said flattery in my entire life. Every word I say is from the bottom of my heart. That’s why your request is a little difficult for me to handle.”Wang baole sighed deeply, he patted the old ox and spoke softly.
“Master Ox, do you smell something strange?”
“No, what is it?”The Old Ox was stunned. He sniffed around and replied in surprise.
“It’s a beautiful smell!”
“After seeing you, Master Ox, I feel that the starry sky is emitting a beautiful smell that is caused by my respect for you.”As soon as Wang Baole said that, the old ox stopped in his tracks, goosebumps appeared all over his body as he trembled.
“Lord Ox…”
“Stop, F * ck you… stop talking, it’s too mushy!”The old ox hurriedly shouted. Wang Baole laughed out loud, and the atmosphere between him and the old ox grew closer as he spoke.
It had to be said that Wang Baole’s EQ and the way he interacted with others were unique. Now that he was chatting and laughing with the old ox, the old ox couldn’t help but speak.
“Kid, where did you learn all these words from?”
“Lord Bull, it’s not that I’m boasting, but I’ve been researching all sorts of love words since I was three years old, and I’ve been trying to find people. Until now, it can be said that there isn’t a love word that I don’t know, and there isn’t a girl that I can’t flirt with. If Lord Bull is interested, I can teach you. I guarantee that in the future, in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain, no heifer that you value will be able to escape your grasp!”
The old bull hesitated for a moment, seemingly tempted. However, due to his embarrassment, he didn’t ask directly. Wang Baole was like a shrewd person. After sensing it, he immediately took the initiative to teach the old bull the Art of Love Talk. Just like that, as the old bull ran along the road.., their relationship became more harmonious.
In the end, the old bull was satisfied, or rather, full of vigor… in short, he spoke to Wang Baole with great satisfaction.
“I like you, Uncle Ox. Little Joy, if you have any questions regarding the raging flame galaxy, feel free to ask.”
Wang Baole had been waiting for these words. When he heard that, a strange look appeared in his eyes, and he immediately spoke.
“Uncle Ox, there are no outsiders here. Tell me about my master, the raging flame ancestor. What is his personality? What are his likes and dislikes?”
Wang Baole felt that since he was going to the blazing flame galaxy, he naturally needed to understand the blazing flame ancestor more. After all, it was true that the other party wanted to take him as a disciple. However, if he could be liked more, the benefits would naturally be greater.
“Exalted Lord Blazing Flame…”after hearing Wang Baole’s words, a crafty look that he couldn’t see flashed across the depths of Old Niu’s eyes. He coughed a few times and spoke with an aged tone.
“Little joy, I have no choice but to criticize you. I know exactly what you’re thinking. You’re worrying too much!”
“The exalted Lord is magnanimous and open-minded. He values freedom of speech. All the disciples in the Galaxy under his command can speak freely and speak their minds.”The old ox sighed with emotion as he spoke.
“Therefore, in the future, even if you are unhappy with the exalted Lord, you must not hide it. You must speak your mind and speak your mind. The exalted Lord doesn’t care about trifles. He is as magnanimous as the entire galaxy, and he is able to accept thousands of different words
“But you must remember one thing. You must never cheat, because the thing that the exalted one hates the most in his life is flattery, cheating, and insincere words
“In short, you only need to speak your mind. The exalted one is a rare master in this world

chapters.title: Chapter 1004
chapters.content:
Chapter 1004:, Raging Flame Galaxy!
“Do you have a plan?”Wang Baole was stunned.
“Yes!”The old bull nodded with certainty as he ran.
“You’re not going to fake it?”Wang Baole was a little confused and asked with uncertainty.
“That’s right!”The old bull coughed and nodded again.
“You can’t flatter me?”After hesitating, Wang Baole couldn’t help but ask again.
“That’s right!”The old bull was unusually patient, and he nodded his head.
It was only now that Wang Baole finally managed to believe a little, but he still had some doubts. Amidst his doubts, the old bull sped up.
Half a month later, as the surrounding starry skies changed and countless civilizations of all sizes flowed before Wang Baole’s eyes, a bright red area gradually appeared before him!
“Little joy, we’re Here!”The old bull laughed loudly and snorted. He spat out two balls of air, causing the surrounding starry skies to distort as if a storm was about to break out. Wang Baole’s thoughts were interrupted by the old bull’s voice, he stopped thinking about the blazing flame ancestor’s personality. He felt that if the blazing flame ancestor’s personality was indeed like that, it would be a good thing for him. It would make his life a lot easier in the future.
Therefore, when he saw the Crimson region, he felt a jolt in his heart.
As he stared, the Crimson region was like a giant ball of fire that was rising continuously. It spread out into the starry sky beyond the surrounding flames, releasing countless substances that looked like wisps of smoke.
Wang baole even felt as if he was looking at a ball of eternal fire in the starry sky. The old bull was even faster at that moment, bringing Wang Baole with him as he whistled, he was getting closer and closer to the area of flames.
When he was about to reach the edge, Wang Baole could no longer see the complete outline of the flames. He could only see the vast sea of flames before him.
......
As the heat waves churned, the surrounding starry sky distorted. The closer he got, the more severe the distortion became. Wang Baole was shocked. He was even shocked to realize that as the starry sky distorted.., other than space, time was also affected. There were also rules and laws!
Time seemed to be lengthening in the starry skies beyond the distorted flames. As it slowed down, all the rules, other than the rules of fire, were suppressed to the extreme.
Even the rules of the starry skies seemed to agree with the tyranny of the flames.
The blazing flame ancestor is actually so strong! Wang Baole was shocked. He had thought that the flames weren’t weak, but they were clearly inferior to his senior brother, Chen Qingzi. However, at this moment, he clearly realized that his view.., was Right and wrong!
The right part was that it was the truth, but the wrong part was… it wasn’t that the blazing flame ancestor was weak, but that his senior brother, Chen Qingzi, was so strong that he was insanely strong. That was why he was a contrast to the blazing flame ancestor.., he didn’t seem to be very strong.
“The reference objects are different…”
With such thoughts and emotions in mind, the old bull under Wang Baole’s feet roared into the sky. His voice spread in all directions, causing the Sea of fire in front of him to disperse instantly, revealing a path.
