The old bull didn’t slow down. It charged straight into the path and stepped into the flaming galaxy. As it entered, it seemed to be very excited. It leaped into the sea of fire instead of taking the path that had been cleared by the Sea of fire. Instead, it jumped straight into the Sea of fire, it stepped on the fire and moved forward.
This scene made Wang Baole’s heart skip a beat. He grabbed tightly onto the hair on the old bull’s back. All he could see was the Sea of fire. At the same time, the high temperature from the surroundings and the Suppressive Force from within the Sea of fire made him shudder in fear, there was a feeling that once he was thrown out, he wouldn’t be able to hold on for long, even if he had grasped the ancient star’s fire laws and had the Dao Star’s blessing. He would be reduced to ashes by the Sea of fire.
Fortunately, this feeling didn’t last for long. As the old bull ran wildly, it only took him about two hours to rush from the edge of the Raging Flame Galaxy to the center.
Soon, Wang Baole, whose face was pale from the old bull’s back, saw a huge star appear in the Sea of fire before him. The size of the star was almost as big as the entire Solar System. It looked like a huge oven..
This was the blazing flame main star!
Surrounding the blazing flame main star were hundreds of stars!
These stars revolved slowly around the blazing flame main star as if they were attached to it. At the same time, Wang Baole saw that there were different numbers of planets around each star.
However, with the vastness of the main star as a comparison, the other stars naturally didn’t have much presence in Wang Baole’s senses. However, when he calmed down and examined them carefully, the waves in his heart couldn’t help but roar.
“Hundreds of stars and thousands of planets all surround the blazing flame main star, forming the blazing flame galaxy… such a force, the Solar System Federation is extremely weak in front of it…”
“Shocked?”? “That’s nothing. Little Lele, let me tell you. This is because the exalted Lord keeps a low profile and doesn’t want to spread his wealth. You must know that in the Weiyang Dao Domain, anyone who is on par with the exalted lord in terms of cultivation and combat strength basically controls tens of thousands of stars… There are even people who control hundreds of thousands or even millions.”
“There are even quite a few who are far inferior to the supremacies. They all have a scale that far surpasses that of the raging flame galaxy. That’s not a big deal. It’s our great supremacies’fault for being so plain and unadorned.”The old bull exclaimed in admiration, his voice spread in all directions, reaching a wide area.
“However, even if the scale is ordinary… In the left Dao holy region, the raging flame galaxy has an extraordinary status. It’s unique, and it’s also known as one of the Holy Lands. In the left Dao holy region, we can basically do whatever we want. Even if we go to an unorthodox holy region, we still have our own status!”
Hearing the old bull’s words, Wang Baole’s emotions surged. When he had chatted with the old bull on the road, the old bull hadn’t said anything explicitly. However, his words had revealed some information, which allowed Wang Baole to know that in reality, the raging flame galaxy.., it was still in the left Dao sacred territory. However, due to its extraordinary status, it was like a vassal. Even the large sects in the left Dao sacred territory weren’t willing to provoke it.
After witnessing it with his own eyes, it was the first time he had heard the old ox speak so clearly. He felt even more deeply.
“Let’s not talk about it anymore. Xiao Lezi, you hold on tight. We will enter the main star. As for the position of the Raging Flame Galaxy, you will be able to experience it deeply when you go out for training in the future!”As the old ox spoke, he leaped once again, turning into a beam of light, with a thunderous roar, he shuttled through the stars and headed straight for the raging flame main star, which was the size of the Solar System. It was like an oven, and it instantly flew away.
It was so fast that Wang Baole’s vision blurred. In the next instant… What appeared before him was no longer the starry sky, but the heavens and earth. Old Niu’s figure stepped into the blazing flame main star and floated in the sky!
The sky was crimson, as if there was a layer of transparent film that covered the flames outside, preventing them from falling like rain. However, the pressure from the sky became stronger as a result.
The earth was different. There was no sea of fire, only a vast land. Mountains rose and fell, and there were many plants and trees. There was also sea after sea.
Occasionally, one could see birds and beasts roaming on the ground. There were also flood dragon-like beasts in the sea that would raise their heads and rise from the surface of the water.
As for the Spirit QI, its density had reached the peak that Wang Baole had experienced. Even the Spirit Qi in the world had turned into clouds that existed all year round. There was no need for one to circulate the spirit qi, and the Spirit Qi would enter one’s body, it made him feel extremely comfortable.
To the southeast of the world stood a towering supreme tower that was hundreds of thousands of feet tall. The tower exuded an astonishing aura. There were stone sculptures of auspicious beasts around it. It occupied a vast area, and there was an aura that seemed to be able to suppress the entire starry sky, it was contained within the Supreme Tower!
There were sixteen smaller, but identical-shaped towers scattered around the supreme tower. This was where the blazing flame ancestor and his disciples lived.
Unlike the other sects, the blazing flame ancestor and his disciples lived not too far away from each other on the blazing flame main planet. However, compared to the entire blazing flame main planet.., it was less than one-hundredth of a trillion!
Wang baole, who was watching everything from mid-air, was deep in thought. A figure flew out from the fifteenth tower and headed straight for the old ox and Wang Baole.
Before the figure arrived, a voice sounded!
“Junior XV greets the mighty and brilliant senior ox!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1005
chapters.content:
Chapter 1005:, where is it.
As the voice rang out, the figure of the person who spoke approached quickly. In an instant, he appeared in front of Wang Baole and the old cow. He was a youth who looked to be about fourteen or fifteen years old. He was thin, but his head was huge, he looked like he was severely malnourished, like a bean sprout. It was as if his head would pull his body down when the wind blew..
If that was all there was to it, it would have been fine. However, the youth had shifty eyes, and it was obvious that he was not a good person. When he arrived, his eyes shone with a strange light as he looked at Wang Baole, who was on the back of the old cow.
“This must be the sixteenth junior brother, Wang Baole, whom master mentioned a while ago. Haha, Sixteenth Junior Brother, how are you? I am your fifteenth senior brother.”
Wang Baole stood up immediately upon hearing that. He left the back of the old bull and cupped his fists and bowed to the youth before him. Although the youth didn’t look old, Wang Baole knew very well that cultivators couldn’t judge age based on their appearance, there were too many old freaks who liked to act young..
The planetary fluctuations coming from the youth’s body also proved Wang Baole’s judgment. Therefore, as he greeted the youth, he also spoke respectfully.
“Greetings, Senior Brother Fifteen!”
“Sixteen, you don’t have to be so polite. From now on, we will be a family.”Even though he spoke with a smile and a gentle tone, under fifteen’s shifty eyes, the words he said.., always gave people a feeling that he was harboring ill intentions.
This caused Wang Baole to feel a little wary. The Old Bull, who was beside him, yawned.
“Alright, I’ve brought him here. I’ll take my leave now.”As he spoke, the old bull’s body flashed and he leaped into the sky. Just as he was about to leave, Wang Baole hurriedly turned his head to bid farewell. Just as he was about to say something.., however, fifteen, who was standing beside him, sprawled in mid-air and shouted loudly.
“Senior Bull, who is unrivalled in the world, who is able to fight against the stars in all directions, and who will definitely win the battle!”
The voice was so loud that it spread in all directions. Wang Baole was shocked when he heard it. When he first heard fifteen’s respect for the old bull, he hadn’t paid much attention to it. However, now that he looked at it, it was clear that fifteen was flattering him.
This seems to be a little different from what the old bull had told him before… Wang Baole hesitated. The sound of the old bull’s nose rang out, and then it disappeared into the sky without a trace.
Even after the old bull had left, fifteen was still lying there. Seven or eight breaths had passed, and Wang Baole couldn’t help but open his mouth. Only then did fifteen slowly stand up and look at Wang Baole with his hands behind his back.
......
“Sixteen, it’s not that senior brother is criticizing you, but you should learn more from me in the future. You should know that senior bull is The Guardian Divine Beast of our raging flame star system. It was born in the Sea of fire, merged into the starry sky, and guarded all directions… Even master is very polite to senior bull
“That’s why, you should know… In the future, when you see senior NIU, you must be respectful and courteous. It’s not appropriate for you to bend over like you did just now and not show your sincerity.”
Wang Baole was stunned. He wanted to say that he didn’t understand, but he couldn’t say it out loud. Therefore, he raised his head and looked at the spot where the old cow had disappeared, then looked at the serious-looking Douya XV. He hesitated before replying.
“Senior brother fifteen… do you really have to do this? I’m young. Don’t lie to me…”
“You Child, I’m old enough to be your grandfather. Why would I lie to You?”Douya fifteen said. He looked around, then moved closer to Wang Baole and whispered mysteriously beside him.
“Let me tell you, sixteen. You’re right to listen to senior brother. That Senior Bull… You Know… you can’t provoke him. This bull is narrow-minded. It’s definitely a rare sight in the world. A single look from him can make him angry. Master is sometimes not only polite to him, but also tolerant. I’ve always suspected…”
“This old bull is the true boss of our Raging Flame Galaxy!”Fifteen said seriously. Hearing this, Wang Baole was even more confused. He thought to himself, what is this and what is this… could it be that there’s something wrong with senior brother fifteen’s head..
Regardless, regardless of whether it was the old bull or the fifteen senior brother in front of him in the raging flame galaxy, they both gave him a very strange feeling. Therefore, Wang Baole followed his advice and acted as if he was deeply in agreement. He nodded.
“Thank you for the Reminder, senior brother!”
Seeing that Wang Baole had acknowledged him, the bean sprout-like fifteenth was very happy. He coughed and spoke.
.
“Sixteenth, master had some matters to attend to yesterday. Before he left, he arranged for me to come and welcome you. You know, when Master returns, he will summon you. How about this? I will first familiarize you with the environment here and at the same time, greet the other senior brothers and sisters.”
“Thank you for your trouble, fifteenth senior brother.”Wang Baole had no intention of criticizing the other party for saying that he understood every few sentences. He quickly thanked him and did not have any objections. He was new here, so he naturally had to familiarize himself with the environment and meet his fellow disciples.
Through his senior brothers and senior sisters, Wang Baole felt that he could make a clearer judgment of the blazing flame ancestor. After all, this place… would be his second home in the near future, it would be his second home.
Therefore, he really wanted to get along well with his senior brothers and sisters. As for the fifteenth senior brother in front of him, although he seemed to have a problem with his head and had a strange appearance, Wang Baole had a vague feeling that the other party had no ill intentions.
Just like that, after Wang Baole agreed, Douya XV swaggered down the stairs with Wang Baole. At the same time, he began to introduce the buildings in the area.
“You know our raging flame sect… it’s actually very simple. There’s nothing much to introduce. All you need to know is that the largest pagoda is the place where master goes into seclusion, stays, and summons us.”
“As for the sixteen surrounding pagodas, they are our residences. The sixteenth pagoda that has just been built will be your training ground in the future.”As he spoke, fifteen pointed at the tall pagoda in the distance. Wang Baole took the opportunity to look over, after memorizing the location, fifteen quickly brought him to the fourteenth pagoda.
“I will bring you to meet senior brother fourteen first. Senior Brother Fourteen is a very good person, and his temper is extremely stable. He basically doesn’t fight back or retaliate when he scolds. You know… He is our role model.”Fifteen shook his head, he was filled with emotion.
Wang Baole was already slightly used to the way the other party spoke. He suppressed the strange feeling in his heart. As the other party arrived in front of the fourteen pagodas, he saw that the doors to the fourteen pagodas were closed. Other than a rockery as a decoration, there was nothing else, there was nothing else. At the same time, the fluctuations within the pagoda were blocked, making it impossible to sense them. Therefore, he was about to pay his respects to the pagoda in front of him..
However, before he could pay his respects, fifteen, who was beside him, took a few quick steps forward and bowed deeply to the rockery in front of the fourteen pagodas. He shouted loudly.
“Fifteen pays his respects to senior brother fourteen!”As he bowed, fifteen winked at Wang Baole.
Wang Baole was once again dumbfounded. He looked at the rockery and then at fifteen, who was winking at him. He braced himself and stepped forward, bowing deeply.
“Sixteen pays his respects to senior brother fourteen!”
Their greetings did not receive any response from the rockery. After waiting for a long while, fifteen stood up with a soft sigh and spoke to Wang Baole in a low voice.
“Am I right? Senior Brother Fourteen is our role model. Not only did he not fight back or curse back, he didn’t even care about our greetings.”
Wang Baole didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. At the same time, he looked carefully at the fake mountain and asked softly after some hesitation.
“Senior Brother Fifteen, is senior brother fourteen a stone life form?”
“A stone life form?”Fifteen looked at Wang Baole in surprise.
“Sixteen, senior brother wants to criticize you. How can you say such things about senior brother fourteen? Let me tell you, senior brother fourteen is extremely talented. Just like us, he has a body made of flesh and blood!”
“It’s just that…”at this point, XV paused and looked around. Then, he pulled the stunned Wang Baole to the side and spoke in a mysterious voice.
“However, he is too obedient. One hundred and thirty-seven years ago, he listened to his master’s instructions and cultivated an illusion technique that his master had gotten from God knows where. He transformed himself into a stone… in the end, an accident happened and he couldn’t change back… He is also stubborn. You know… He rejected his master’s help and wanted to rely on his own efforts to change back…”
It’s been a hundred and thirty-seven years… fifteen let out a long sigh as Wang Baole stared at him in a daze.
Based on my judgment, it should be another five hundred years. Fourteenth senior brother should be able to succeed
Listening to fifteen’s words, recalling how he had behaved since he had arrived, and looking at the rockery, Wang Baole could not help but look lost. A question arose in his mind.
Just… Where Did I come from..

chapters.title: Chapter 1006 - — master’s Benevolence!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1006: — master’s Benevolence!
In a daze, Wang Baole followed his fifteenth senior brother in front of him. His thoughts were in a mess as he walked into the distance. He saw his fifteenth senior brother walk normally at first, but as he walked, he started jumping up and down in front of him. The way he jumped up and down.., it was indescribably strange. After all, his bean sprout-like body made his fifteenth senior brother jump up and down like a golden needle mushroom..
He even sang an even more strange song..
“The raging flame galaxy is good, the raging flame galaxy is wonderful, and the raging flame Galaxy Croaks…”
The song was filled with magical power, causing Wang Baole’s mind to become even more confused. He gradually felt that there was an indescribable sense of absurdity in this world… deep in his heart, he could not help but think of how he had felt when he saw the old bull.., he then summarized everything that he had felt since arriving here.
In the Raging Flame Galaxy, there is an old bull who is so strong that even his master has to treat him with respect… this old bull is obviously sullen. He said that the raging flame galaxy doesn’t like the culture of flattery, but he is more enthusiastic than anyone else to hear such flattery..
In the raging flame galaxy, I have a shifty-eyed fifteenth senior brother who seems to have a problem with his head. This senior brother talks in a weird way, and his catchphrase is, you know… he likes to look around and speak quietly, but… he can clearly send voice transmissions, so why does he need to speak so directly? After all, even if there is no one around, speaking directly still carries the risk of being spied on..
I still have a fourteenth senior brother in the raging flame galaxy. There seems to be something wrong with his head. He cultivated an illusion technique and turned himself into a fake mountain. In the end, he can’t turn himself back… Wang Baole thought, and his head started to hurt, he couldn’t help but raise his hand to knead it. However… when he followed his fifteenth senior brother to the tower where his thirteenth senior brother was, Wang Baole felt his head hurt even more.
He had already made preparations after arriving, focusing on whether there were any rocks or other objects outside his thirteenth senior brother’s tower. When he didn’t see any rocks and only saw three to five withered trees, he subconsciously heaved a sigh of relief, however, his heart quickly trembled, and he suddenly looked back at the withered trees..
“That can’t be…”as he looked at the withered trees, Wang baole muttered to himself. His fifteenth senior brother, who was beside him, had already taken a few quick steps forward. He arrived in front of a withered tree and bowed deeply.
Seeing this, Wang Baole slapped his forehead and immediately went over to pay his respects.
“Greetings, thirteenth senior brother!”
The withered tree did not respond, but fifteenth revealed a gratified smile. He was about to speak, but before he could do so, Wang Baole spoke in advance.
“I understand, fifteenth senior brother. This tree is thirteenth senior brother. Did He also cultivate fourteenth senior brother’s illusion technique? He also had an accident and couldn’t change back after turning into a withered tree.”
......
“Sixteen, you are indeed talented and intelligent. You can infer from one example, and your mind is extremely sharp.”Fifteen’s gaze became increasingly gratified. He turned to look at the withered tree that they had worshiped and sighed.
“You are right. Senior Brother Thirteen and senior brother fourteen have a close relationship, but they also like to compete with each other. Therefore, after senior brother fourteen practiced his illusion technique, senior brother thirteen took the initiative to find his master and asked him to practice the same technique. In the end… you know, he naturally couldn’t change back. However, for senior brother thirteen, this is where his fun lies. Now, the two of them are competing to see who can change back first.”
Wang Baole didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. He felt his head ache even more. He was about to speak, but before he could do so, another withered tree beside the withered tree that the two of them had met suddenly spoke..
“Fifteen, you’re looking for a beating. It’s one thing if you’re worshipping the wrong tree, but you’re actually badmouthing me!”
The moment the withered tree spoke, Wang Baole shuddered. He quickly turned his head to look at the withered tree that had spoken, and he couldn’t help but look at the tree that he had worshiped previously..
“Stop looking. The tree that you are worshiping is a real tree…”thirteenth senior brother’s calm voice rang out slowly. Fifteen hurriedly greeted him once again.
“Congratulations, thirteenth senior brother. You have successfully defeated fourteenth senior brother. Senior Brother’s skills are unparalleled and unrivaled!”
Wang Baole took a deep breath as well. His chaotic thoughts were slightly better. He thought to himself that he had finally met a fellow disciple who spoke normally. He hurriedly greeted him once again.
“Sixteen greets senior brother thirteen!”
“You’re little sixteen. Little Sixteen, let me tell you something. Don’t listen to that flatterer, fifteen, spout nonsense. What do you mean, me and fourteen will compete to see who can transform back first? What nonsense!”The withered tree’s voice was filled with righteousness, it contained a sense of lesson, and Wang Baole’s heart was filled with respect. He was just about to agree when..
“How can that trash fourteen compare to me? His consciousness is already asleep, but mine is much stronger than his. I can send out my consciousness, and I can also appreciate the changes in the sky and feel the joy of the breeze blowing my branches and leaves.” The withered tree seemed to be very pleased with itself, and its entire body trembled a few times.
Wang Baole saw this and couldn’t help but fall silent.
“Little Sixteen, you’re not bad. You’re very good. Senior Brother will give you a welcome gift.”As he spoke, the trembling of the withered tree intensified, and it became even more intense. The entire tree gave off a feeling that it was about to collapse on its own, wang Baole’s heart skipped a beat as he watched. He had a vague feeling that if the other party had acted like a human, he would have used all his strength. His face had even turned red. Then, the withered tree finally let out a comfortable moan. On one of the tree branches.., a half-withered leaf condensed.
When it fell down and landed in front of Wang Baole, there was still a hint of heat that drifted away from the leaf.
Wang Baole was once again dumbfounded. He stared blankly at the leaf. Fortunately, he could feel the shocking spirit qi fluctuation from the leaf, which prevented any misunderstanding… however, the strange feeling in his heart grew stronger, and in the end, he could only brace himself, he took the leaf and thanked the withered tree.
“Fourteenth senior brother is biased. Sixteenth, this is fourteenth senior brother’s natal item. If you encounter any danger in the future, you only need to bring out this withered leaf. It will instantly attract the projection of thirteenth senior brother and fight for you!”Fifteenth took a deep breath, after exclaiming loudly, the withered tree let out a joyful laugh.
“Alright, you can go and pay your respects to the other senior brothers and sisters.”
With that said, the withered tree stopped swaying and returned to its calm state. Fifteen hurriedly pulled Wang baole away. Halfway through, Wang Baole couldn’t help but ask.
“Senior brother fifteen… um… have the other senior brothers and Sisters of ours all cultivated this illusion technique…”
“Shh!”Fifteen immediately turned his head when he heard that. He put his index finger to his mouth and signaled Wang Baole not to speak. Then, he led him a distance away and looked around before speaking in a low, mysterious voice.
“Sixteenth junior brother, you’re thinking too much. Among our fellow disciples, you know… Only the thirteen and fourteen senior brothers have some problems in their heads. They believed master so easily and cultivated this illusion technique. As for the others, why would they cultivate this technique?”
As soon as fifteen said that, a glint flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes. He hesitated for a moment before speaking in a low voice.
“Senior Brother Fifteen, why did you say that you believed master so easily? Could it be that master can’t be trusted?”
“I didn’t say that. You said it!”When fifteen heard that, his expression changed. He quickly looked around and quickly cleared his name. He pulled Wang Baole and quickly left the spot. Just as Wang Baole was feeling increasingly confused and confused.., fifteen pulled him to a corner and spoke in a low voice with a mysterious look on his face.
“Little Sixteen, you can’t just say things like that. Let me tell you… Master is an open-minded and magnanimous person, and he loves his disciples dearly. That’s why he likes to search for strange cultivation techniques in the ruins in the starry sky and let us cultivate them. He wants us to gain the strengths of the various families, and he wants us to be like dragons and phoenixes among humans, growing to a level that reaches the heavens.”
When Wang Baole heard that, his expression immediately turned solemn as he spoke loudly.
“Master is benevolent!”
“Yes, Master is benevolent!”Fifteen blinked and spoke in an even lower voice.
“But I advise you… If Master has given you a similar cultivation technique, you have to wait for the other senior brothers and senior sisters to finish their cultivation and confirm that there is nothing wrong before you cultivate…”when he heard that, Wang Baole could not hide the strange look on his face, after fifteen finished speaking, he suddenly looked into Wang Baole’s eyes and asked meaningfully.
“Sixteenth junior brother, after coming to the raging flame galaxy, I saw thirteenth and fourth senior brothers and heard what I said. I know that you must feel that master is a little unreliable now, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1007 - the different second senior brother!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1007:, the different second senior brother!
When Wang Baole heard this, he immediately became alert. At the same time, the words that old bull had told him in the raging flame galaxy surfaced in his mind. He had to remember to speak clearly and not to lie..
However, at that moment, his dark expression became even more solemn as he spoke in a deep voice.
“Senior Brother Fifteen has misunderstood me. I think that master is wise and wise. There must be a deeper meaning behind what he did, and I don’t dare to figure it out.”
When fifteen heard this, he couldn’t help but twitch his lips.
“Little Sixteen, you’re not being honest. You Don’t know what you’re saying. When you see Seventh Senior Brother later, you’ll know the consequences of saying something you don’t mean.”
As if sensing that Wang Baole wasn’t being tactful, fifteen didn’t say another word. He continued to hop around like a golden mushroom, but he didn’t speak to Wang Baole. Instead, he brought him to pay his respects to twelfth and eleventh senior sisters.
After Wang Baole paid his respects to twelfth senior sister, he finally heaved a sigh of relief. She was the only normal-looking person he had met since arriving at the raging flame galaxy. Her cultivation had reached the star realm, not only did twelfth senior sister look elegant and beautiful, her words and actions were also elegant. She treated Wang Baole warmly in her tower. After asking about Wang Baole’s situation, she also reminded him about some matters regarding cultivation, in the end, she even stood up and personally sent him and fifteen out.
After sending them out, she thought for a moment before taking out a bottle of pills and handing it to Wang Baole.
“Sixteenth junior brother, this pill is called the spirit continuation condensation. There are seven pills in total. If you are in danger or injured, you can consume it. It will allow your body and mind to recover significantly within the time it takes for an incense stick to burn.”
As for eleventh senior sister, she was also much more normal than thirteenth and fourteenth senior brother. However, her personality seemed to be the opposite of twelfth senior sister’s. She was not gentle and elegant, but extremely domineering. Furthermore, her entire body was emitting a fiery energy, she was like a volcano that could erupt at any moment. With her stellar cultivation, one could imagine how earth-shattering it would be once it erupted!
Her words were also in line with her personality. The first thing she asked after seeing Wang Baole was extremely direct.
“Sixteenth junior brother, since you’ve met the junior brothers and sisters in front of you, you must have some understanding of our raging flame galaxy. Tell me, after you’ve seen all of this, how do you feel about Master’s actions?”
Wang Baole found it difficult to answer her question. Although fifteenth had asked similar questions before, eleventh senior sister had put a lot of pressure on Wang baole, regardless of her personality or cultivation. The question at hand was especially sharp, wang Baole hesitated, but he could only force himself to cupped his fists and speak.
......
“In response to eleventh senior sister’s words, master’s actions are unpredictable and profound. My cultivation isn’t high enough and I can’t see through it, but I can vaguely feel his love and anticipation for his disciples.”
Wang Baole was still speaking in a conventional manner, and he didn’t mean what he really thought. Even though Old Niu had warned him not to flatter and speak his mind, he felt that there was no one in the world who didn’t like flattery, even if there was, it was only a matter of the level of the person who spoke.
Furthermore, what Wang Baole had seen during his journey to the Raging Flame Galaxy had left him filled with endless questions and absurdities. However, he had a nagging feeling that all of this wasn’t what he had seen, it seemed to contain something that he could not clearly understand.
There seemed to be an invisible layer of gauze that covered everything, making it impossible for him to see clearly or understand. Therefore, under such circumstances, he naturally had to be more cautious in his words.
After hearing Wang Baole’s words, eleventh senior sister’s expression remained the same. She did not show any obvious changes in her emotions. She only gave Wang Baole a deep look, shook her head, and said calmly.
“With your personality, you shouldn’t have come to the raging flame galaxy.”As she said that, eleventh senior sister waved her hand. Immediately, Wang Baole and fifteen, who had not spoken since they had arrived, were swept up by a wave of heat and instantly moved out of eleventh senior sister’s Tower.
When they were outside, fifteen glanced at Wang baole, sighed, and muttered to herself softly.
“Eleventh senior sister hates it the most when you don’t mean what you say.”
Wang Baole smiled bitterly when he heard that. He turned to look at eleventh senior sister’s Tower, shook his head, and didn’t say a word. After muttering to himself, fifteen didn’t say anything else. He brought Wang Baole to meet the other senior brothers and sisters, perhaps it was because there wasn’t much communication, so the process of meeting them naturally sped up.
Therefore, after two hours, fifteen brought Wang Baole to meet the eight people from tenth senior brother to third senior brother. There were more normal people among these eight people, which made Wang Baole feel less strange about the raging flame galaxy.
It was as if the tenth senior brother was a big man, like a giant. The strength of his physical body made his qi and blood extremely exuberant. Approaching him was like approaching a furnace. Wang baole could even sense that.., the taciturn tenth senior brother seemed to be much stronger than the eleventh senior sister, both in terms of cultivation and combat strength.
He treated Wang Baole with kindness. Before Wang Baole left after paying his respects, he even gave Wang Baole a bottle of beast blood. According to his introduction, it was the blood of a star-grade ferocious beast. By applying it all over one’s body, one’s physical strength would increase eternally.
It was normal for ninth senior sister as well, but the aura of death around her was a little heavy. As for sixth senior brother and fifth senior sister, these were the two people Wang Baole had seen. They were the same as the twelfth senior sister. They were the most normal disciples, and their cultivation levels were at the star realm as well, while expressing his kindness to Wang Baole, he had also given him a greeting gift.
As for fourth senior brother, he wasn’t in the raging flame galaxy and had gone to the outside world for the training. That was why Wang Baole hadn’t seen him. However, other than these people, there were a few others that Wang Baole found strange.
For example, eighth senior brother was a dwarf. He was only around Wang Baole’s waist, and his entire body exuded waves that could affect people’s minds. His smile and his mouthful of black teeth made Wang Baole’s hair stand on end, a strong sense of danger rose instinctively.
There was also seventh senior brother, whom fifteen had mentioned earlier..
This person wasn’t normal. The reason why he was normal was because he was gentle and refined in both his words and actions. He was like a gentleman. He had even brewed spirit tea for Wang Baole, and his words were all-encompassing, it was a display of his understanding of everything in the world.
The reason he wasn’t normal was that his entire body was bruised and swollen, and his body was swollen. He looked very disheveled. After paying his respects and leaving, fifteen, who hadn’t spoken to Wang Baole along the way, huffed a few times and spoke to Wang Baole.
“Sixteenth junior brother, did you see that? Seventh senior brother is such a handsome man. It’s because he was flattering master, and he didn’t say anything. Then… you know, master was unhappy, so he beat him up… Basically, seventh senior brother gets beaten up every month, so much so that I’ve forgotten his original appearance.”
“This…”Wang Baole took a deep breath.
“That’s why, Little Sixteen, you must remember that you must never speak out of turn. You must speak your mind.”
Wang Baole’s heart wavered when he heard that. Fifteen brought him to third senior brother’s Tower. Third senior brother… It couldn’t be said that he was abnormal. It could only be said that he had an overly domineering image.
He looked like a fire bull. No matter how one looked at him, he looked somewhat similar to Old Ox Yan Ling. Wang Baole didn’t believe that the two of them weren’t related by blood, fifteenth’s attentiveness and greeting tone after seeing his third senior brother made Wang Baole even more certain of his judgment.
Third Senior Brother’s expression was neither warm nor cold. He didn’t say a few words to Wang Baole before he left in a hurry. Wang Baole didn’t have the chance to get to know him better. He could only follow fifteenth and pay his respects to second senior brother.
After seeing second senior brother, Wang Baole was taken aback by the many senior brothers and senior sisters he had seen along the way. On one hand, Wang Baole couldn’t sense second senior brother’s cultivation. He didn’t look like a star, he didn’t look like the mighty figure from the galaxy that he had met. He didn’t even look like a cultivator!
On the other hand, although second senior brother looked like a handsome, middle-aged man with eyes like stars, giving off an extraordinary aura, Wang Baole had a strange feeling that second senior brother didn’t seem to really exist.
It was as if there was a cognitive gap between what he saw with his eyes and divine perception and what he saw with his real second senior brother. It was also as if… what he saw was merely what second senior brother wanted him to see.
This feeling made Wang baole very uncomfortable. Fifteen, who was standing at the side, noticed the scene and spoke softly in front of his second senior brother.
“Sixteenth junior brother, second senior brother’s cultivation is different from ours. He cultivates in the divine dao of incense. It can even be said that he doesn’t exist in the world, but is born in the world of incense… to a certain extent, second senior brother is more like an immortal God!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1008
chapters.content:
Chapter 1008: must, must!
Perhaps it was because second senior brother’s existence was something that Wang Baole had never seen before in his life, or perhaps it was due to some other unknown reason that Wang Baole did not notice when fifteenth said those words. Regardless of whether it was his tone or expression.., there was a hint of sadness that he could not control.
It was because second senior brother’s existence before him seemed to contain a strange attraction, causing everything in the world to become dull and eye-catching wherever he was.
The elegance of his white clothes and the elegance of his black hair combined together to form a faintly discernible immortal qi that lingered around him. His clothes and hair were fluttering elegantly. They were neither tied nor restrained, and they fluttered slightly even in the absence of wind, the figure that was suspended in mid-air seemed to be the descent of a god.
There was even a faint glow flowing on his skin. His eyes flashed with a thousand different colors of colored glass. As he stared at Wang Baole, a deep sense of familiarity appeared in second senior brother’s eyes.
“Sixteenth junior brother...”
“Greetings, second senior brother!”Wang Baole and his second senior brother met each other’s eyes, and their bodies trembled instinctively. Deep in their hearts, they did not know why, but they seemed to sense the deep sense of familiarity in each other’s eyes, which contained a hint of sadness, for some reason, they also felt a sense of sadness, and they greeted each other softly.
“Sixteenth junior brother, stay in the raging flame galaxy peacefully and treat this place as your home...”the second senior brother stared at Wang Baole, and his words came out of nowhere. His junior brother, Wang Baole, was stunned, and just as he was about to speak.., fifteen, who was beside him, sighed.
“Second senior brother, you said the same thing to me when I came here. In the end...”a depressed look appeared on fifteen’s face, disrupting Wang Baole’s thoughts. At the same time, the second senior brother, who was floating in mid-air.., a look of sadness and complexity flashed across his face. He didn’t say anything. He just bent over and nodded gently at fifteen.
Wang baole, on the other hand, strangely didn’t see his second senior brother Bend over. If he had, he would have been shocked and his heart would have been in turmoil.
It was obvious... that as his second senior brother, he was bending over his junior brother. There was something extremely illogical about his actions, but... Wang Baole didn’t see it at all.
As for fifteen, it was unknown if he didn’t see it either. After he finished speaking, he pursed his lips and started muttering again.
“Second senior brother, master has gone out again. I’ve secretly observed him before. I believe that master must have gone out to look for those unreliable cultivation techniques again. This time, I feel that I won’t be able to escape this calamity!”Fifteen said, with a sad face, fifteen sighed again.
“Before he left, he said that he would come back to give me a surprise...”
......
Hearing that, second senior brother smiled and didn’t say a word. Seeing that, Wang Baole didn’t want to interrupt. However, deep down, he was thinking that perhaps it was because of this matter that fifteen kept ridiculing him along the way, he also hoped that he would join him in ridiculing him..
After all, the example of thirteenth senior brother made Wang Baole hesitate about the blazing flame ancestor’s cultivation technique. Even though he didn’t say it out loud, he still felt that the other party wasn’t reliable.
This feeling had just risen, and fifteenth had just finished ridiculing him. At that moment... a cold snort suddenly came from the surrounding void. It landed in Wang Baole’s ears like a bolt of lightning, it made him shudder. When he raised his head, he immediately saw that behind fifteenth, the void distorted and formed the figure of a Woman!
The woman wore a long purple dress. Although she wasn’t extremely beautiful, she gave off a sense of decisiveness and determination. She was like a heavy sword that hadn’t been unsheathed. She was steady and didn’t lack a sense of dominance.
If eleventh senior sister’s dominance was apparent, then the dominance of the woman before him was deep in her bones. She wouldn’t reveal it easily, but once she did, she would never look back!
Her cold snort and appearance immediately made fifteenth shudder. He quickly turned to the woman behind him and bowed deeply.
“Greetings, eldest senior sister!”
“Greetings... eldest senior sister.”There was a complicated look on second senior brother’s face that Wang Baole couldn’t see. He sighed softly and bowed his head in greeting. The degree of respect he showed could be seen from the way he bent his back nearly ninety degrees.
However, that was not what Wang Baole saw. Therefore, he did not have any unexpected thoughts. Instead, he paid his respects to the head disciple of the blazing flame ancestor before him.
“Fifteen, master asked you to welcome sixteenth junior brother. What about you? You’ve been complaining all the way. Now, you’re making wild guesses about master. Are you asking for a beating again?”The woman’s figure gathered and appeared in the tower, she berated fifteen, then turned to look at Wang Baole. Her expression was no longer stern, but gentle.
“Sixteenth junior brother, please rise. I’m your eldest senior sister. Master may not be around often, but if you encounter any problems in the future, you can come and ask me. Treat this place as your home.”
Wang Baole agreed immediately. He raised his head to look at the eldest senior sister in front of him, and a sense of respect rose from the bottom of his heart. She was the most upright person he had seen on his journey.
Fifteen, who was standing beside him, pursed his lips when he heard that. He seemed to be a little unconvinced after being reprimanded, and he muttered to himself.
“Eldest senior sister, why are you making such a big deal out of nothing? Master isn’t around, so he can’t hear what I’m saying...”
Eldest senior sister turned her head and glared at fifteen. Fifteen shrunk his neck and didn’t dare speak again. Eldest senior sister turned around and gave Wang Baole a few words of advice before waving her hand.
“Fifteenth and sixteenth, you can go back. I have something else to discuss with your second senior brother.”
“Yes, Sir...”fifteenth replied in a depressed tone. He left the tower with Wang Baole, who had bid farewell to the two of them. However, before he left, the godlike second senior brother floated in midair, he gave Wang baole a stick of incense as a greeting gift.
He also told him that once the incense was lit, cultivating beside him would allow him to double his cultivation with half the effort. Then, as Wang Baole thanked him and left, XV stared at Wang Baole’s back and suddenly said something softly that made Wang Baole shudder.
“BAOLE, no matter what Master’s personality is, in my opinion, he is a lonely person...”
Wang Baole was stunned. While he was deep in thought, fifteen began to mutter beside him.
“He’s lonely, torturing us disciples every day... Let’s go, sixteen. I’ll send you back to your tower.”As he spoke, fifteen seemed to have inadvertently interrupted Wang Baole’s thoughts and brought him out of the tower.
At that moment, only second senior brother and eldest senior sister were left in the tower.
Eldest senior sister didn’t speak. Instead, she turned her head and stared. It was as if her gaze could penetrate the tower and see Wang Baole, who was walking further and further away as fifteen rambled on.
.
She stared at eldest senior sister, who was floating in mid-air and cultivating the Dao of incense. She was like a god, and as long as there was a trace of incense in her body, she would be immortal. Her eyes were filled with grief and sorrow, and her heart ached, he lowered his head and bowed deeply to the expressionless eldest senior sister before him.
“Disciple Greets Master.”
If Wang Baole had been there, he would have been shocked when he heard this. His heart would have been filled with unprecedented waves of shock and confusion. However, it was a pity that he, who had left this place, naturally didn’t know about this.
The eldest senior sister, whom the second senior brother called master, turned her head and looked at the second senior brother solemnly.
“Second junior brother, are you muddle-headed in your cultivation of the Supreme Dao? I am your eldest senior sister, not Master!”
Second Senior Brother fell silent upon hearing that. Bitterness surfaced on his face. Finally, he sighed softly and bowed once more. However, he did not say a word.
Eldest senior sister fell silent as well. She turned her head and continued looking in the direction Wang Baole had left. After a long while, she suddenly smiled.
“Second brother, is the raging flame galaxy now a little livelier? If there are no accidents, there will be another little fellow coming in a while. When that happens, our place will be even livelier,”she said, eldest senior sister’s smile became even happier. Second Brother, who was standing at the side, stared at her smile and slowly calmed down. It had been a very, very long time since he had seen the person he respected the most in his life.., a truly happy smile appeared on his face, and he gradually revealed a smile as well.
When his smile appeared, he also heard the person he respected the most in his life mumble softly.
“This time, I will protect you... definitely, definitely, definitely!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1009
chapters.content:
Chapter 1009:, you also have this day!
Wang Baole was naturally unaware of what had happened in second senior brother’s tower. At that moment, he was even more confused about the raging flame galaxy. He had a nagging feeling that something was wrong, but he couldn’t figure out what it was.
No matter how he tried to recall, he couldn’t find the exact feeling. Fortunately, after meeting second senior brother and eldest senior sister, Wang Baole felt that his senior brothers and sisters in the Raging Flame Galaxy were at least the same as the twelfth senior sister, in fact, they were even more reliable.
It was the same for both eldest senior sister and second senior brother. The latter left a deeper impression on Wang Baole. He had seen and experienced many things over the years, but this was the first time he had seen a living being like second senior brother.
A God born from incense, undying and indestructible... Wang Baole’s eyes revealed a hint of yearning. At the same time, the image of eldest senior sister appeared in his mind. The decisiveness and dominance that she exuded with just a few words.., it was definitely not because of her title as his eldest senior sister. It was obvious that it had something to do with her cultivation.
In the raging flame galaxy, other than master, there are three other star domains! Wang Baole took a deep breath. His second senior brother didn’t give him a strong feeling, but he could vaguely make a judgment, however, the fluctuations of the star domains from his third senior brother and eldest senior sister gave him a strong feeling.
There’s also that fourth senior brother who’s out training. I wonder if he’s also from the Starfield... Wang Baole was excited. He felt that even though the raging flame galaxy was very strange, such power was enough to allow him to do whatever he wanted while he was out, with that thought in mind, he felt comforted. He felt that it was understandable that even the strong might have some weird quirks.
However, just as Wang Baole was consoling himself, fifteen, who was leading the way, sighed and scowled. He turned to glance at Wang Baole and muttered.
“What bad luck. Why did I see eldest senior sister in second senior brother’s Tower... Sigh, sixteen, let me tell you, eldest senior sister... She’s a lunatic.”
Wang Baole raised his eyebrows. Along the way, he had realized that his fifteenth senior brother was basically a chatterbox with a bellyful of complaints. However, he had just arrived, so he couldn’t say anything. Therefore, he could only smile bitterly at the side.
“You’re still smiling?”When fifteenth saw Wang Baole’s smile, he was a little dissatisfied. He seemed to feel that Wang Baole didn’t believe him, so he wasn’t convinced. He looked around and spoke quietly.
“Sixteenth, senior brother said all this for your own good. Eldest senior sister is indeed a lunatic. If I were to tell you that once she goes crazy, even master will have a headache. Would you believe me?”
“This...”Wang Baole didn’t know if his master had a headache, but at that moment, he had a headache. He really couldn’t answer. If he said he believed her, it would be disrespectful to his master and eldest senior sister. If he said he didn’t believe her.., senior brother fifteen, the talkative bean sprout in front of him, would definitely not stop.
Fortunately, there was no need for Wang Baole to answer. After fifteen finished speaking quietly, he seemed to recall something. Suddenly, he beat his chest and stomped his feet in front of Wang Baole. He looked like he was in so much pain that he wanted to die, and he sighed.
......
“It’s not eldest senior sister’s fault. It’s all master’s fault. Sixteenth junior brother, senior brother, let me tell you the truth. That Master of ours... is especially unreliable!”
“You’ve seen it on the way here. I don’t believe that you don’t have thoughts in your heart. Sixteenth junior brother, the tradition of our raging flame galaxy is to speak one’s mind. Tell senior brother the truth. Do you also think that Master is unreliable?”Fifteen looked at Wang Baole with anticipation, his face was almost filled with the words, “Quickly come and acknowledge me.”.
Wang baole frowned slightly. The other party had spoken so many times, making it difficult for him to respond. However, if he didn’t say anything, his fifteenth senior brother wouldn’t give up. Therefore, he could only sigh.
“Fifteenth senior brother, Baole is new here. There are many things that he doesn’t understand. However, I still feel that all of this must be due to master’s benevolence and deep meaning.”As Wang Baole spoke tactfully, under fifteenth’s lead.., they arrived in front of the tower that belonged to him.
There were large trees covered in red leaves planted outside the tower, making the tower that was hidden inside look different under the light of the setting sun in the sky. At the same time, the place was filled with life. Other than the trees.., there were also some fire ladybugs dancing in the air. They were very agile. Perhaps they had sensed that someone had arrived and dispersed in the air. Some flew away, while others landed on the red leaves.
Upon arriving, seeing that he was unable to gain Wang Baole’s approval, a look of anger appeared on fifteen’s face.
“Little Sixteen, you... What do you want senior brother to say about you? Forget it, forget it. You’ll know in the future. Let me tell you... This time, before master left, he said that he was going to some ruins to search for cultivation techniques. Once he succeeded... the cultivation techniques that he brought back aren’t just for me to cultivate. There’s also you...”
“You’ll know if you’re reliable or not when the time comes.”As he said that, fifteen sighed and shook his head with a sad face. He ignored Wang Baole. As Wang Baole bowed and sent him off, he waved his hand and turned to leave.
After a few breaths, Wang Baole stood up and looked at the back view of his fifteenth senior brother. He only took a deep breath after he had completely disappeared from his sight. He recalled everything that had happened since he had arrived. He couldn’t help but raise his hand and rub the space between his brows, helplessness and exhaustion appeared on his face, and his eyes gradually stopped hiding the puzzlement in them.
He felt that apart from a few of his fellow disciples, most of them were extremely strange. This was especially so for his fifteenth senior brother, who seemed to be trying to get him to agree with his theory and say something unreliable about his master.
This was very strange. Wang baole, who wasn’t stupid to begin with, had long become vigilant. Naturally, he wouldn’t go along with what the other party had said. However, the other party’s actions along the way, especially the words he had said before he left.., still, it had affected Wang Baole somewhat.
“Searching for cultivation techniques from the ruins...”Wang Baole hesitated for a moment. Recalling how his thirteenth and fourteenth senior brothers looked like a giant tree and a rock, he had a faint premonition that something bad was about to happen.
In this premonition, Wang Baole stood under the tree in front of the tower. His eyes flickered imperceptibly for a moment, then he sighed and muttered to himself.
Is master really unreliable? That’s impossible
After saying that, he rubbed the space between his brows again. He decided not to think about it for now. He planned to observe the raging flame galaxy before his master returned and make a decision.
With that thought in mind, Wang Baole turned and followed the path between the trees to the end. He pushed open the door to the tower and entered his residence in the raging flame galaxy. After he left, among the red leaves in front of the tower.., one of the fire ladybugs flapped its wings and flew up from the leaves. It seemed to glance at Wang Baole’s tower. It circled leisurely in midair and flew into the distance..
.
After it left, the other fire ladybugs in the area instantly became blurry and disappeared without a trace. It was as if they were all fake. Only the one that flew away was real.
However, the moment the fire ladybugs disappeared, the door to the tower opened abruptly. Wang Baole’s figure appeared there. He stared at the leaves on the trees where the fire ladybugs had been resting, and a profound look appeared in his eyes.
There must be something wrong with the raging flame galaxy
Wang Baole’s words seemed to be unintentional, but in reality, he had said it deliberately. After seeing with his own eyes that a large tree and a stone were all his senior brothers, he had instinctively suspected that there was something wrong with the trees when he had arrived at the tower, or perhaps, among the fire ladybugs, there were also his senior brothers..
After all, even though fourth senior brother had gone out to gain experience, based on the weird personalities of his senior brothers and senior sisters, turning into a tree or a ladybug in front of someone else’s house could be considered a form of experience..
Seeing that the fire ladybugs were gone, Wang Baole’s eyes flashed. After pondering for a moment, he turned around and walked back to the tower. However, the moment he entered the tower, the image of the Little Missy that he had returned from before he left Earth appeared in his mind, she was extremely happy and even laughed with extreme excitement.
“Wang Baole, Oh Wang Baole, I’ve been holding it in for a long time. Your cleverness has backfired, and you’ve finally fallen into a trap. hahahaha, you have such a day!”
“No, no, I must celebrate!”
“What’s Going On?”Wang Baole was stunned. He had a bad feeling about this.

chapters.title: Chapter 1010
chapters.content:
Chapter 1010:, one-woman Show!
Little Missy used to refer to herself as ‘this queen’. This was the first time Wang Baole had heard her call herself ‘this queen’... This title gave Wang baole an even more ominous feeling.
He could imagine that if a woman who placed great importance on herself didn’t even care about her image, it was enough to show that she was extremely excited and happy, to the point of dancing with joy, she had forgotten about her image.
The other side was about to celebrate..
As a result... combined with the words ‘today will come for you too’in her words, Wang Baole’s breathing became a little chaotic. He immediately asked carefully.
“Beautiful, kind, gentle, virtuous, and not lacking in grace and integrity, Little Missy. That... can you tell me what happened?”Wang Baole looked at Little Missy, who had jumped out of her mask and was stomping her feet excitedly, she suppressed the closeness in her heart and put on a sincere expression.
“Do you want to know?”Hearing Wang Baole’s words and seeing how he looked sincere but could not hide the anxiety in his heart, Little Missy felt extremely comfortable. In fact, ever since she had followed Wang Baole, other than being able to be smug at the beginning.., she had been dealt a blow every single time.
If the blow had been intentional, it would have been fine. She could have turned hostile, but she had been dealt an invisible blow every single time. This had driven her crazy countless times. Now that she had finally seen with her own eyes that Wang Baole had fallen into a pit, other than the excitement in her heart.., she also felt a strong sense of excitement. Therefore, when she asked the question, Wang Baole quickly nodded his head. Little Missy blinked her eyes.
“I won’t tell you!”
Hearing that, Wang Baole raised his eyebrows. He wanted to play hard to get. However, based on his understanding of Little Missy, there was still some skill in using this method of playing hard to get. Therefore, he sighed in his heart, i’m gonna go with the good-looking guy.
Thinking of this, his expression slowly emerged with emotion, eyes more affectionate, staring at the little sister, softly opened his mouth.
“Little sister, do you know how lucky I am to be able to hear your carefree, pure, and lovely laughter in such a selfish, hypocritical, and deceitful Starry Dao Domain?”
“So, Little Missy, you don’t have to tell me that baole only has one request. You can smile for a little longer, and in the future, you will be able to smile the way you do today...”Wang Baole said in a deep, loving whisper, he slowly approached Little Missy. Every word he said seemed to contain a strange power. When Little Missy heard it, she started to feel nervous for no reason.
This nervousness made little missy very uncomfortable, and she glared at him.
......
“Fatty, do you think that I can be bribed with just a few words of flattery? Impossible!”
Wang Baole smiled warmly when he heard that. He walked up to Little Missy and raised his hand. Just as she seemed to be evading his gaze, he tugged at Little Missy’s illusory figure’s hair and murmured softly.
“Little Missy, did you know that in my eyes, there were no stars in this world? However, every time I think of you, a star will appear, and the sky will be filled with stars...”
As soon as she said that, little Missy’s body trembled and she took a few steps back. She was extremely nervous, but she put on a disgusted expression and waved her hands repeatedly.
“Stop, Stop!”
“Fatty, I didn’t realize that you were so curious.”Little Missy coughed to hide her nervousness and glanced at Wang Baole.
Hearing that, Wang Baole thought to himself, isn’t this what you wanted to see? I have no choice but to use my all-conquering beauty trap. However, on the surface, he put on a bitter smile and cupped his fists at Little Missy.
“Little Missy, please clarify my doubts.”
After calming herself down, she saw that Wang Baole’s attitude was rather sincere. Therefore, Little Missy sat at the side and waved her right hand. She grabbed a bottle of ice spirit water out of nowhere and sipped it, her eyes blinked repeatedly, and she did not hide her gloating. After scanning Wang Baole’s body, she put down the ice spirit water and coughed.
“Sigh, my shoulders are a little sore...”as soon as she said that, Wang Baole, who was shocked by the scene of Little Missy taking out the ice spirit water, felt his face Twitch. His body disappeared instantly, and when he reappeared, he was already behind Little Missy, he quickly pinched her gently.
Enjoying Wang Baole’s service and drinking the ice spirit water, Little Missy was satisfied and told him the whole story.
“Fatty, after you came to the Raging Flame Galaxy, did you feel that this place was filled with oddities and confusion?”
“You saw your senior brothers and sisters. Even though some of them were normal, most of them still made you feel that there was something wrong with their personalities, as if there was something wrong with their brains, right?”
“Even that old bull, you also felt that there was something strange in your heart. Am I right?”Little Missy said with a smile.
Wang Baole fell silent. He sighed and nodded.
“Let me tell you something, Fatty. The Blazing Flame ancestor’s reputation is not small in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain. There are many rumors about him. Some people say that his hometown was completely destroyed by the Weiyang clan, and all his disciples died. However, there are also some who say that his disciples did not die, but were heavily injured and in a deep sleep. There are also some who say that the blazing flame ancestor later took in more disciples
“There is even a saying that the disciples of the blazing flame ancestor are indeed dead. However, he used his great dharmic powers to collect the remnant souls and set up the blazing flame galaxy. In reality, it is a huge soul trapping array formation. It is specially prepared for his disciples so that they can continue to exist here.”
These words entered Wang Baole’s ears, causing him to pause in his hand that was massaging little Missy’s shoulders.
“There are all sorts of theories and opinions. Which one is the truth? Other than your senior brother Chen Qingzi’s level of cultivation, no one can see through it. Due to the blazing flame ancestor’s eccentric personality, it has become a taboo. Those who can see through the truth will not spread it.”
“However... other than those mighty figures, I should be the only one who knows the truth!”As Little Missy said this, a complicated and emotional expression appeared on her face. She put down the ice spirit water, she didn’t allow Wang Baole to continue massaging her shoulders. Instead, she seemed to have thought of something, and reminiscence appeared in her eyes as she muttered to herself.
“Baole, the blazing flame ancestor is actually quite pitiful... his story was something that my father said to himself when he passed by this galaxy. I heard it
“In reality, all the rumors outside are incorrect. Your Senior Brothers and sisters in the Raging Flame Galaxy aren’t severely injured and in a deep sleep. They weren’t forced to leave their remnant souls behind, and they weren’t illusory... the real answer is that everyone here is an avatar of the blazing flame ancestor! “
“Other than his second disciple, all the other disciples are his avatars. Even the old bull that received you is also an avatar of the blazing flame ancestor
“My father also said that the blazing flame ancestor is a lonely person. He has spent his entire life using countless avatars to build a world to accompany himself...”
.
When Wang Baole heard this, his heart shook violently. The strange and confused thoughts in his mind were instantly dispelled. They turned into waves in his heart and attacked his soul.
The truth made him unable to calm down. He had never expected that all of this was not a lie, nor was it a remnant soul. Instead, it was... a one-man show.
“Not only are your senior brothers and senior sisters the embodiment of the blazing flame ancestor’s clone, in the entire blazing flame galaxy, every plant and every living thing is basically... His clone. There are also the trees and the fire ladybugs outside just now. If I’m not wrong, they are also one of your master’s clones.”
Little Missy seemed to have recovered from her momentary depression. Her eyes were filled with intelligence and craftiness as she looked at Wang Baole.
“So, Fatty, you’re finished. Your cleverness just now was misjudged by your cleverness. You thought that if you spoke intentionally and someone heard you from the side, it would show your integrity. However, when I was in the Vast Expanse Dao Palace, I heard the old sect Lord say that even though the blazing flame ancestor’s cultivation was strong, he was a narrow-minded person. Even though the second half of your sentence was impossible, the first half of your sentence was enough.”
Wang Baole was a little confused. On one hand, he was still immersed in the story that little Missy had told him and the blazing flame ancestor’s grief. On the other hand, he had no choice but to divert his attention to think about whether he had been fooled by his own cleverness.
This multitasking gave him a headache. He raised his head and rubbed the space between his brows. Just as he was about to think of a solution, he quickly raised his brows.
“That’s not right. Seventh senior brother was indeed beaten badly. This can’t be fake, right? Could it be that master beat himself up for fun? And once a month?”
——
He asked everyone for a day off. He had private matters to deal with tomorrow and would make up for it at the weekend

chapters.title: Chapter 1011
chapters.content:
Chapter 1011:, summoned by Master!
It’s fine if you beat yourself up, but you can’t possibly kneel down for yourself, right? Wang Baole looked at Little Missy suspiciously. It wasn’t that he didn’t believe what she had said, however, he still felt that there might be some other problems.
For example, Old Bull and fifteen. Wang Baole felt that it was an unreasonable point. He had seen fifteen bow down to old bull with utmost respect when he had seen fifteen bow down to old bull with his own eyes. Such a matter of him bowing down to him.., wang Baole also had a clone, so after thinking about it, he felt that the blazing flame ancestor wouldn’t do it.
Faced with Wang Baole’s hesitation, Little Missy chuckled. She didn’t explain further. After yawning, she returned to the mask in a flash. However, before she disappeared, she left a sentence behind.
“Whether it’s true or not, wait until you meet the blazing flame ancestor and see if he makes things difficult for you. Then, you’ll know...”
Listening to Little Missy’s words and watching her figure disappear, Wang Baole thought for a moment. He was still skeptical, and he decided to wait for the blazing flame ancestor to summon him and observe carefully. He had this thought in mind, he sized up the layout of the tower.
The tower was divided into four levels. The first level at the bottom was considered a living room. The layout was simple, but it didn’t lack a sense of grandeur. Even the seats were made of special wood, and spirit Qi could be emitted from them, in particular, there was clearly a spirit gathering formation inside the tower, which caused the spiritual energy in the outside world to gather here, making the spiritual energy in the tower so dense that it reached an astonishing level.
Logically speaking, this level of spiritual energy should have turned into spiritual liquid and spread in all directions. However, the design of the tower clearly took this into account. Through an unknown method, it formed a staircase that was surrounded by stairs, the water of the waterfall that ran through the four stories could be drunk directly, as it was basically spirit Qi turning into liquid.
As a result, even though the tower was not completely quiet, the sound of the water flow was more natural, especially compared to the heat in the outside world. The coolness inside the tower made cultivating inside more comfortable.
As for the second story, there were pill formulas and tool rooms. Other than that, there were three empty rooms that could be matched according to different needs. The third story was the main point. The entire third story was divided into two parts. One was a secret chamber for seclusion, the other was the martial arts practice hall, which could be used to test one’s abilities and techniques.
After strolling through the first three levels, Wang Baole was very satisfied with the place. He felt the coolness of the place and the comfortable feeling of spirit qi entering his body on its own. He walked up to the top level of the tower. It could be considered a semi-spacious layout, it was like a loft. The surroundings were empty. Standing there, one could see the world from afar.
It was getting late outside, and the Sun in the sky had been replaced by a bright moon. However, unlike the federation, there were more than a dozen moons in the sky, each of which had a different shape. They hung high in the sky, looking very strange, at the same time, they illuminated the earth, making the vast blazing star appear bright and clean.
At the same time, as night fell, the hot sky during the day began to cool down rapidly. It was getting colder and colder. It was easy to imagine that by midnight, the temperature in the outside world would have dropped by quite a bit.
This polarized climate might affect many creatures, but it was extremely beneficial for cultivators. It could allow their cultivation to fuse yin and yang. Not only would their cultivation speed be faster, but it would also be more stable.
......
Overall, this place is basically a holy land for cultivation! Wang Baole took a deep breath. He was even more satisfied as he sat cross-legged in the attic on the top floor. He didn’t think about the strange things that were happening here, he didn’t think about the story little Missy had told him about the blazing flame ancestor. Instead, he calmed himself down, breathed in and out silently, and began his cultivation.
As he cultivated, his cultivation had reached the mid-stage of the planet realm. It swam slowly within his body, and the planets behind him gradually materialized. At first glance, it looked like a dao star, but upon closer inspection, one would be able to see the nine ancient planets within, now, they were all vibrating slowly, as if they were breathing. They were absorbing the surrounding spirit Qi in a large scale.
Back in the starry skies, Wang Baole had created a vast whirlpool when he was cultivating. However, there was sufficient spirit Qi here, and his tower itself was unique. Therefore, the whirlpool did not appear, but one could still see the spirit qi flowing into his body, it surged from all directions and entered his body.
Time passed slowly. Soon, three days had passed. During these three days, Wang Baole did not open his eyes, nor did he go out. He had even been meditating all along. As a large amount of spirit qi continued to flow into his body.., although his cultivation had not improved much, he had gradually stabilized his cultivation from the mid-stage.
One day of cultivation is like half a year of cultivation in the federation... Wang Baole opened his eyes. He could not hide his emotions. According to his calculations, he would only need to enter seclusion for a hundred years. He would not need any pills or fortune, he would be able to advance from the mid-stage to the late-stage.
A hundred years might be a long time, but the speed was astonishing. After all, he knew very well that if he were in the federation, it would be very difficult for him to reach the late-stage of the planet realm.
It’s just that I lack cultivation techniques at the planet realm... Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. This was one of the reasons why he had come to the raging flame galaxy. Planet cultivation techniques were classified as mystic arts to any sect, although Wang Baole had mastered some of the cultivation techniques of the dark sect, most of them weren’t suitable for him. Therefore, he wanted to gain something from the hands of the raging flame ancestor here.
With this thought in mind, Wang Baole cultivated for another four days. It wasn’t until the morning of his eighth day in the raging flame galaxy that the sound of a bell rang in the distance. Wang Baole’s mind trembled violently, and an old voice rang out in his mind, it reverberated in his mind.
“Disciples, I have returned. Come and see me as soon as possible!”
Wang Baole opened his eyes abruptly. He could tell that it was his master, the blazing flame ancestor. The doubts that he had buried deep in his heart surfaced once again. However, he quickly suppressed them. He stood up, tidied his clothes, and left the tower quickly.
As he left, figures flew out from the other towers one after another. They headed straight for the blazing flame ancestor’s tower in the center. It wasn’t far to begin with, so as streaks of rainbow neared.., soon, Wang Baole and his fellow disciples arrived outside the blazing flame ancestor’s tower.
Wang Baole saw the domineering eldest senior sister, the godlike second senior brother, the little fire bull-like third senior brother, fifth senior sister, sixth senior brother, seventh senior brother, twelfth senior sister, and fifteenth senior brother.
Other than the thirteenth and fourth senior brothers who didn’t appear, there were thirteen people in total, including Wang Baole. All of them had respectful expressions on their faces as they stood in front of the tower. They looked very normal.
.
Wang Baole couldn’t help but glance over them one by one. The words of Little Missy surfaced in his mind.
These... are all master’s clones? Wang Baole hesitated again. He saw fifteen winking at him and the smiles of the other senior brothers and senior sisters. He instinctively cupped his fists and bowed, before he could speak, the ancient voice of the blazing flame ancestor came from within the tower.
“Come in, all of you.”As his voice reverberated in the air, the door to the tower opened silently, revealing the blazing flame ancestor sitting at the head of the hall. He was dressed in a long robe of flames, and his hair fluttered even though there was no wind, his opened eyes seemed to contain a faint fire. Just his aura alone gave Wang baole immense pressure. His mind trembled, and he put away all his thoughts. He followed his senior brothers and senior sisters in front of him and quickly entered the hall.
As soon as he entered, his senior brothers and senior sisters immediately knelt down before the blazing flame ancestor and greeted him loudly.
“Greetings, Master!”
Wang Baole quickly knelt down and greeted him as well. At the same time, he couldn’t help but take a few more glances at the blazing flame ancestor and the other senior brothers and senior sisters around him. Suspicion flashed across the depths of his eyes.
“According to what little Missy said, almost everything in the blazing flame galaxy is a clone of master. That’s why the fire ladybug is the same. After hearing what I said, even if I don’t doubt it, the master that Little Missy mentioned is a petty person who likes to hold grudges. Will he make things difficult for me?”Wang Baole felt a headache coming on, on the one hand, he sighed secretly. On the other hand, he was skeptical. As he looked at the blazing flame ancestor, the blazing flame ancestor, who was seated at the head of the table, swept his gaze across the disciples before finally looking at Wang Baole, a warm smile slowly appeared on his face.
“Baole, have you settled all the matters at home? If you need help from master, you can tell me.”
“Thank you, master. In reply, I have already settled the matters at home,”Wang Baole immediately said respectfully. At the same time, he heaved a sigh of relief. He thought to himself, looking at it this way, master doesn’t seem to be angry, could it be that little Missy’s words were not true?

chapters.title: Chapter 1012
chapters.content:
Chapter 1012:, customs!
“We don’t dare to continue pestering the purple gold civilization. The follow-up compensation should be sent over very soon. You can just accept it.”The Blazing Flame ancestor smiled. He didn’t hide his admiration for Wang Baole, his tone was very gentle.
“Thank you, Master!”Wang Baole took a deep breath. He was very grateful for the concern and help the blazing flame ancestor had shown him. He cupped his fists and bowed deeply once more.
“There’s no need for this between you and me, master and Disciple.”The Blazing Flame ancestor smiled. He raised his right hand and waved it, transforming it into a gentle force that helped Wang Baole up. Then, he turned to look at Wang Baole’s eldest senior sister.
“Dong ‘er, I often go into seclusion, and I often go out. So, in the future, if I’m not around, you have to help me teach this little junior brother of yours.”
Eldest senior sister’s expression turned serious when she heard that. She nodded solemnly and looked at Wang Baole sternly.
“Sixteenth junior brother, regardless of cultivation or other aspects, if you have any problems, you can come to me immediately.”
“Thank you, senior sister!”Wang Baole looked at the eldest senior sister in front of him. She looked stern, but he could still feel the care and concern in her eyes. He could not help but clasp his fists and bow, at the same time, he could not help but doubt little Missy’s words once again.
Just as Wang Baole was clasping his fists, fifteen, who was beside him, curled her lips and muttered softly.
“Sixteen, you’re going to be unlucky...”
“Fifteen!”Fifteen had barely finished muttering when twelfth senior sister, who was beside him, glared at him and shouted in a low voice.
Fifteen immediately scowled and wanted to speak. However, when he raised his head, he saw the solemn expression on eldest senior sister’s face. He also saw his master raise his right hand to stroke his beard. He couldn’t help but shrink his neck, as if he didn’t dare speak.
“Master, although fifteen is mischievous, he has been diligent during this period of time. He’s much better than before.”Seeing how fifteen was behaving, twelfth senior sister seemed to soften her heart. After bowing to her master, she spoke gently. The moment her words left her mouth.., fifteen hurriedly raised her head and threw him a look of gratitude.
Wang Baole saw all of this, and he couldn’t help but feel even more hesitant. According to what little Missy had said, everyone standing before him now was actually his master..
......
However, their interactions with each other were too real... while Wang Baole was at a loss, seventh senior brother suddenly laughed.
“Master, I say that little fifteen needs to be taught a lesson. A few days ago, when he brought sixteenth junior brother to my place, I heard him say bad things about you!”
“Seventh senior brother, you!”Fifteen wanted to cry but had no tears. He hurriedly bowed to his master.
“Master, I was wronged. I...”
“Master, I heard it too,”said third senior brother, who didn’t wait for fifteenth to finish speaking.
“That’s right, master. Fifteenth did say it!”
