“That’s right, that’s right! I can swear that I heard it too!”The other senior brothers and sisters also began to speak. All of them had different expressions on their faces. Some had smiles on their faces, while others coughed dryly to add fuel to the fire, in short, everyone in the grand hall was very quick-witted, especially second senior brother. He coughed and spoke softly.
“Master, little fifteen might have done it unintentionally.”
“Second senior brother, you can’t do this... Sixteen, tell me, did I say anything bad about master?”Fifteen was anxious and pulled Wang Baole.
Wang baole blinked, feeling even more confused. He didn’t think that all of this was a one-man show no matter how he looked at it. Now that he was being pulled by fifteen, he really didn’t know how to speak. He could only laugh bitterly.
“Enough!”As if he was having a headache over his disciples, the blazing flame ancestor rubbed the space between his brows. He spoke calmly and glared at little fifteen. After little fifteen pretended to be wronged, the blazing flame ancestor looked back at Wang Baole.
“Baole, you’ve just arrived and aren’t familiar with the blazing flame galaxy. You’ll have to get used to the environment here in the future. Also, I’ve gone out this time and found a cultivation technique that suits you...” The blazing flame ancestor waved his right hand, and two jade slips flew out. One flew towards Wang Baole, while the other flew straight towards XV.
Wang Baole quickly caught them. He didn’t wait to examine them. He saw XV, who seemed to be lowering his head, give him a quick look. The meaning behind that look was simple, it was as if he was saying, “Look, am I right?”.
“This technique is called the star sealing art. Even if I were to look at its power, it would be described as unfathomable. You and fifteen will cultivate this technique.”After the elder said that, he stroked his beard and stopped talking about the cultivation technique, instead, he chatted with his disciples and asked them about their cultivation progress.
The entire hall gradually became harmonious. Every disciple, after being questioned, would flatter them. Even eldest senior sister was no exception. This opened Wang Baole’s eyes. He had a deeper understanding of the atmosphere in the raging flame galaxy, at the same time, the doubts and confusion in his heart deepened.
It doesn’t seem like it. be it master or Senior Brothers and senior sisters, they all seem very normal... Besides, Little Missy said that master is narrow-minded and would be angry because of what I said. However, this visit has been very gentle from the beginning to the end... Wang Baole secretly heaved a sigh of relief, he also had a vague feeling that little missy might not have been telling him the truth.
Perhaps what little Missy knows is just the past? Is it not like this now? Wang Baole thought to himself, after the blazing flame ancestor finished questioning the disciples, his gaze swept over Wang Baole. There was still a warm smile on his face as he spoke.
“Baole, the disciples that I have accepted do not need any ceremony. Everything goes according to one’s heart. However, there is a custom that must be carried out
“The Guardian Divine Bull of the blazing flame galaxy was once my mount and was loyal to me. Over the years, I have long regarded it as a fellow Daoist. Therefore, all of you must treat it with respect
“Every single one of my disciples, after acknowledging me as their master, have to bathe the Divine Bull as a show of respect. Your Senior Brothers and sisters have all done the same. Now, it’s your turn,”the blazing flame ancestor said amiably, upon hearing that, Wang Baole quickly cupped his fists and acknowledged.
The senior brothers and sisters beside him also looked emotional when they heard the blazing flame ancestor mention the matter.
.
“Senior divine ox has done too much for our blazing flame star system. Now that I think about it, the scene of me bathing senior divine ox is still vivid in my mind.”
“That’s right. There was once when I was in danger, and it was senior divine ox who saved me...”
“In the blink of an eye, so many years have passed. Back then, master once said that the more thoroughly you bathe senior divine ox, the more respect you will be able to show. Master, I request that you bathe senior divine ox once more after sixteenth junior brother.” Each senior brother and senior sister had their own memories. No matter how one looked at it, they all looked very real, especially fifteenth. He was the loudest, and his expression was extremely rich.
Seeing this, Wang Baole felt that something was amiss, but he didn’t think too much about it. After accepting the request, he chatted with his fellow disciples and the blazing flame ancestor in the grand hall. Finally, under the blazing flame ancestor’s smile.., they left.
However, the moment they walked out of the Grand Hall’s door, XV’s expression turned into one of schadenfreude. He patted Wang Baole on the shoulder and coughed. He didn’t say anything. The other senior brothers and senior sisters didn’t Pat him on the shoulder, but there was a strange look on their faces, they smiled at Wang Baole and left.
As he watched his senior brothers and senior sisters leave, Wang Baole had a faint feeling that something wasn’t right. This feeling wasn’t right. After he left the area of the tower, flew into the air, and paid his respects to the fire bull, telling him why he had come.., it exploded in his heart.
That was because... after hearing that Wang Baole had been ordered to bathe him, the fire bull, which was originally of normal size, threw its head back and laughed loudly. Its body expanded infinitely in the next instant. In a few short breaths.., its size reached the size of three to five planets. It floated in the starry sky, emitting buzzing sounds.
“Come, come, come, little sixteen. Bathe this old cow. Remember to wash it thoroughly. I haven’t been bathed in a long time.”
Wang Baole looked at the enormous old cow and felt a little dizzy. With its enormous body, if he were to bathe it personally, it would take at least a few months, even if he had to bathe day and night, only then would he be able to completely bathe himself.
This... This is a custom? Wang Baole was confused. He felt as if he had been physically punished.

chapters.title: Chapter 1013
chapters.content:
Chapter 1013:, Star Sealing Art!
Wang Baole was a little dumbfounded. However, no matter how hard he tried to recall the previous events, he could not find any flaws. be it his master or his other senior brothers and senior sisters, their words and actions were natural, making it difficult for him to differentiate between what was true and what was false.
Even now, he felt that this seemed to be in line with what little Missy had said about being narrow-minded. Due to his previous words, she had given him corporal punishment. At the same time, he felt that perhaps this was really a custom..
In any case, his heart was in a mess. It would have been fine if it hadn’t been for Little Missy’s words, but with those words, he was still unable to differentiate between them. This made Wang Baole sigh inwardly.
Forget it, forget it. If I continue to hesitate, I’m afraid that there will be more trouble in the future. I might as well... treat all my senior brothers and Senior Sisters as masters. The fire ladybug is, and so is this old cow before me, wang baole gritted his teeth. After confirming his thoughts, he looked at the old cow, whose body had become extremely large, and had a different opinion.
I’ll treat this old cow before me as master. After master heard my words, he came to punish me for giving him a bath! Wang Baole took a deep breath, put on an attentive smile, and flew toward the old cow’s large body, he started to clean his hooves.
“Not bad, not bad. Little Sixteen, dig into the old bull’s fingernails.”
“You’re a little weak. Little Sixteen, work harder!”
“That’s right, that’s how I feel comfortable!”
As Wang Baole worked hard to clean, the old bull’s voice carried a sense of comfort as it reverberated continuously. While Wang Baole was busy with his work, he did not idle his mouth as he said flatteringly.
As Wang Baole continued to flatter him, time passed slowly. Soon, half a month passed. During this half a month, Wang Baole worked extremely hard. He didn’t have much time to rest every day, and most of his energy was spent on the old bull, this made the old bull feel extremely comfortable physically and mentally.
As for the blazing flame ancestor, he came once during this period of time. Then, in front of Wang Baole and the old bull, he turned into a long rainbow and left the blazing flame galaxy. He said that he was going out to reminisce with his old friends.
After the blazing flame ancestor left, the old bull would occasionally ask some questions as if he was probing.
“Little Sixteen, your master may have asked you to bathe me, but you just need to give me some thought. I actually don’t need you to completely cleanse me.”
......
“Senior Bull, you’re wrong. In My Heart, master is like a father. I will obey his words without hesitation. If he asks me to cleanse your entire body, I will not let go of a single corner!”Wang Baole said sternly.
“Don’t talk about such lies. If your master is not in the raging flame galaxy, he won’t be able to hear you.”Old Niu laughed, as if he knew Wang Baole very well.
Wang baole blinked when he heard that, and his expression instantly turned solemn.
“Senior Niu, you are wrong again. Master’s orders and the customs of the raging flame galaxy are only one reason. There is another reason. I am grateful to senior NIU for his dedication and loyalty as Master’s mount over the years. It is fine that I did not come before, but now that I am in the raging flame galaxy, I must show my respect to you!”
“Come, senior Niu, don’t move for now. There’s a louse here. I’ll deal with it for you. This darn louse dares to bite me, senior NIU. I’m your sworn enemy!”
“Senior Niu, come and lift your feet... I’ll clean the soles of your feet.”
Seeing Wang Baole like this, Old Niu was clearly even happier. Laughter rang out many times during this period of time. At the same time, he used different methods to probe Wang baole. However, with Wang Baole’s intention.., every time, he would reply with straightforward words. Almost every sentence expressed his respect for his master.
Other than the old bull, fifteen, and the other senior brothers and senior sisters would also come here occasionally to take a look. Every time they came, regardless of how they spoke, Wang Baole’s reply would be filled with respect and passion for his master, even though fifteen had put on a look of wanting to Puke a few times, Wang Baole still continued to suck up to him.
Time passed again. Soon, a month had passed. During this month, Wang Baole had practically lived on the old ox’s body. While he was cleaning him up.., he had also spent a portion of his energy on researching the star sealing art given to him by the blazing flame ancestor.
The star sealing art was very strange. As Wang Baole gained a deeper understanding of it and received guidance from the old ox from time to time, his initial ignorance gradually became deeper and deeper. Eventually, after he had studied and comprehended the entire star sealing art.., his heart was already in turmoil because of the cultivation technique.
In fact, it was not an exaggeration to describe the star sealing art as unfathomable.
In simple terms, it was a seal!
The cultivation technique was divided into four levels. They corresponded to the four levels of the planet’s junior high school and the perfected stage. The first level of the planet’s early stage was known as the meteorite sealing art. In general, it could seal meteorites, and eventually, large amounts of meteorites could be used to seal them, it could be arranged to form an image that could be imagined at will.
The image could be anything, and once it was fixed, it could not be changed. The more realistic it was, the greater its power. The more meteorites that formed the image, the greater its power.
As a result, there were two problems involved. One was the need to seal a large number of meteorites, and the other was... the need to choose the image that was to be arranged, and to choose one that he knew very well, therefore, during the process of cleansing the old cow’s entire body, Wang Baole naturally... chose the old cow’s figure as the shadow formed by his meteorite sealing spell.
After all, as he washed every inch of the old cow’s body, his level of understanding continued to increase. As a result, the degree of realism of the Phantom image that was formed was basically at its peak.
That became Wang Baole’s motivation. How could he not put in more effort in cleaning and bathing the old cow... The star sealing art corresponded to the second level of the mid-stage planet, and its power was even greater.
It was no longer used to seal meteorites. Instead, it could be used to seal the ordinary planets on the planet. Using the ordinary planets to form the illusory image of the divine cow. Based on Wang Baole’s judgment, its power was terrifying!
As for the third level, it appeared to be similar. It was a sealed spirit and immortal planet, which formed the image of a divine ox. However, the difference in power was extremely great. According to the description in the cultivation technique.., if it could attract enough spirit and immortal planets, it would be able to fight and suppress even high-level planet cultivators who were facing a special planet!
However, before that, the limit of the cultivation technique was to seal the immortal planet. The special planet couldn’t be sealed. Old Niu had once told Wang Baole that, based on his calculations, if Wang Baole, who had mastered the dao planet, cultivated this technique, he might be able to break through the limit and reach an unprecedented level.
.
After all, Wang Baole had fused with the Dao Planet. Therefore, he was different from ordinary cultivators in terms of status.
That wasn’t the end of it. The fourth level of the star sealing art was a cultivation technique that pointed directly to the path of breaking through the stars. If he continued to cultivate the star sealing art step by step, it would be easier for him to break through planets and step into the stars!
What shocked Wang Baole the most was that this cultivation technique seemed to only have these techniques and abilities that belonged to the level of planets. However, based on his judgment, the stars that formed the divine ox could be replaced by the stars..
When he thought about the divine ox phantom that was formed by a large number of stars and how terrifying it was, even if there was a difference between it and a real old ox, as long as there were enough stars, there wouldn’t be too much of a difference. Wang Baole was flabbergasted.
After understanding all of this, Wang Baole had a deep understanding of the intention of his master, the blazing flame ancestor, for him to bathe the Divine Ox.
Regardless of whether the divine bull before him was his master’s clone or not, his master’s intention was clear. He wanted him to understand the divine bull to a microscopic level that he was extremely familiar with while bathing the divine bull, this kind of meticulous control would undoubtedly allow him to cultivate the star sealing art more smoothly and with greater power!
After all, Old Niu himself was a mighty figure in the galaxy!
A mighty figure in the galaxy would open up his mind and body to let him understand. Such opportunities and opportunities were rarely seen. Even the great sects and clans found it difficult to do so for a disciple or clansman, they had to do it to such an extent.
Therefore, even though Wang Baole’s cultivation hadn’t improved in the past month, his progress in the star sealing art had improved by leaps and bounds. It wasn’t an exaggeration to say that he had improved by leaps and bounds!

chapters.title: Chapter 1014
chapters.content:
Chapter 1014: was for in-name disciples
Time passed slowly as Wang Baole studied the star sealing art. Soon, another month passed.
During the second month, Wang Baole studied the star sealing art while bathing the old bull continuously. He flattered the old bull incessantly, causing the old bull to be in a good mood every day during this period of time, laughter reverberated throughout the blazing flame main planet.
Wang Baole’s gains weren’t limited to that. With the old bull’s intentional reminder, Wang Baole began to catch the lice on the old bull’s body..
“Little sixteen, the lice on the old bull’s body aren’t simple. Seeing that you’ve been working so hard these past few days, I’ll reward you with the right to catch them.”
Hearing that, Wang Baole didn’t understand the meaning behind the old cow’s words, and he pursed his lips.
Although it was called lice, it was actually a type of beetle. Its entire body was crimson red, and it contained flames. It looked ferocious, and it also had a sharp mouthpart. It was good at sucking blood, and its combat strength was basically comparable to that of a spirit realm cultivator.
Its defense was especially astonishing. Once its body shrunk together and turned into a sphere, Wang Baole’s full-strength attack was unable to damage it too much. Furthermore, its recovery ability was also extremely strong, even if he was injured, he would quickly recover after absorbing blood.
As for his size, it was also filled with strangeness. It could change in size. When the old cow’s body was fully revealed, every louse was like a giant beast. After the old cow shrank, they would change and shrink on their own.
To a certain extent, while the louse seemed to be parasitizing, it was more like they were following the old cow’s will. This was not difficult to understand. Otherwise, with the old cow’s cultivation, it would only take a single thought to kill them.
There were many lice on the old bull’s body. Wang Baole did a rough calculation and found that there were at least ten million of them. This shocked him and made him sigh at the old bull’s authority.
However, very quickly, Wang Baole realized the old bull’s intentions.
That was because Wang Baole had immediately discovered the lice. It was troublesome to capture them using conventional methods. However, if he used the star sealing art that he had researched and tried to cultivate to seal them, it would be extremely fast and violent.
It could rapidly increase his proficiency in the star sealing art. After all, even though there were quite a number of meteorites in the starry sky, they were all too big. To him, who had just tried to cultivate the star sealing art, the consumption of sealing a single meteorite was too great, it was far slower than sealing the lice.
......
In terms of cost-effectiveness, sealing the lice was even more efficient. This discovery was verified, and after realizing that his cultivation speed in the star sealing art was astonishing, Wang Baole was overjoyed.
Therefore, he worked even harder to catch the lice that were very suitable for him to use for his initial cultivation of the star sealing art.
In the days that followed, while Wang Baole bathed the old cow, his star sealing art went from a state of study to a state of cultivation.
Just like that, after three months, when Wang Baole had bathed and cleaned the old cow’s entire body, the number of lice that he had caught had reached more than ten thousand. As he continued to experiment with the star sealing art, he became more and more familiar with it, he wasn’t far from reaching the level of perfection of the first level.
The old bull had been flattered and flattered by Wang Baole over the past few months, and he felt extremely comfortable. At the same time, Wang Baole was also very clever. Every time he rested and returned to the tower, whenever he met his fellow disciples.., he would immediately look for any topics that could be used to flatter his master.
He had basically reached the point where he would speak well of his master whenever he met anyone. Perhaps it was because of all of these factors that old NIU’s body had gradually shrunk, reducing Wang Baole’s workload and allowing him to complete the custom of the raging flame galaxy, within three months, he had completed the custom of the raging flame galaxy.
All of this gradually made Wang Baole’s doubts regarding the one-man show that little Missy had mentioned earlier turn into a ninety percent certainty. Even though he had seen seventh senior brother being beaten up many times over the past few months.., he had also seen fifteen being punished. However, he remained determined and continued to flatter and flatter her.
With his hard work, the entire raging flame galaxy had been in harmony over the past few months... Wang Baole himself had slowly gotten used to life in the raging flame galaxy.
At the same time, the purple gold civilization had sent him an apology gift while he was bathing the old bull. The compensation was very heavy. The amount of red crystals used for cultivation alone had reached an astronomical figure. There were also a large number of pills and Dharmic artifacts, other than that, there were ten immortal stars and a hundred mortal stars!
These stars had already been refined. Other than the stars themselves, there was no other life on them. Therefore, it was extremely valuable to be able to allow cultivators at the perfected stage of the Spirit Immortal realm to perfectly fuse with them. It was clear that the purple gold civilization didn’t wish to offend the blazing flame ancestor’s sincerity.
To Wang Baole, the compensation was like a timely rain. It was of great significance to his cultivation of the star-sealing art. As long as he could refine the star-sealing art to the second level, the hundred mortal stars would be sealed by him and become part of his divine ability, he wouldn’t have to go out to search and deal with them.
At the same time, once he cultivated to the third level, he would have ten immortal stars, which would increase the power of his star sealing art. The moment he received the apology, Wang Baole immediately realized that.., his master must have instructed him to do so. That was why the Purple Gold Civilization had sent him what he needed.
I’ve made ample preparations. Next... I’ll focus all my efforts on cultivating the first level of the star sealing art so that I can quickly master it! After putting away the purple gold civilization’s apology, Wang Baole took a deep breath, he began his seclusion after coming to the raging flame galaxy.
He went into seclusion for another three months!
During these three months, Wang Baole didn’t leave the tower. He focused all his efforts on cultivating, and he finally managed to cultivate the first level of the star sealing art to perfection,
in the training room in the tower, Wang Baole waved his hand, and the area of the training room expanded infinitely under the influence of the array formation. Tens of thousands of cow lice that had turned into small balls flew out and gathered in front of him, they formed the figure of the old bull.
The bull’s entire body was wreathed in flames. It was extremely realistic and lifelike. After it appeared, it let out a roar and exploded with a shocking aura. Its suppressive force spread in all directions.
Wang Baole was also moved by it after sensing it.
This kind of aura and suppressive force... can already suppress all the cultivators on the spirit planets beneath the stars! Wang Baole was moved because the bull’s image was only made up of lice and not meteorites, at the same time, he had not been augmented by his own dao planet. The amount of cultivation he had expended was barely noticeable.
Next, I need to fill in the meteorites outside every single cow louse, so that the cow louse can hide inside. That way... The power of the Divine Cow Shadow formed by the ten thousand meteorites will increase once again, threatening the owners of special planets. If I add in my dao planet’s augmentation... Wang Baole’s eyes shone with a strange light, he felt that at this stage, he was basically at the planet-grade and could ignore ninety-nine percent of the cultivators.
.
The only way to fight him was if he met a cultivator who had fused with an ancient planet and had reached the perfected planet-grade.
That’s nothing... After ten thousand meteorites, I still have to seal an ordinary planet and fill it up, allowing the power of my star-sealing art to rise once again... It’s a pity that the price to replace all of them with ordinary planets is too high. Wang Baole narrowed his eyes, he muttered to himself.
Although he said that the price was too high, deep down, he was still eager to give it a try. That was because he realized that his cultivation of the star sealing art was a little different from the description of the cultivation technique.
When he had cultivated to the first level, he could only seal meteorites, and only when he reached the second level could he seal the mortal planet. However, at that moment, Wang Baole had a vague feeling that even if he had only cultivated to the first level, with the help of the Dao Star.., there was a certain possibility that he could attempt to seal a mortal planet.
Such thoughts churned in his mind. Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and left the martial arts practice room in a flash. He stepped out of the tower and sent a voice transmission to his eldest senior sister. Then, he turned into a long rainbow and charged into the sky!
He wanted to leave the blazing flame main star and search for meteorites in the blazing flame galaxy. He wanted to increase the level of his star-sealing art to its current level. As he was leaving, outside the edge of the blazing flame galaxy.., a flying shuttle was rapidly approaching the blazing flame star system, emanating magical fluctuations.
Inside the flying shuttle, Xie Haiyang stood there, his eyes filled with determination and determination.
“As long as I can become the disciple of the blazing flame ancestor, even if it’s just an in-name disciple, it’s enough. That way, I’ll belong to the same sect as that unknown expert... it’ll be much easier to ask for his help.”
—
The weekly update was to make up for Wednesday’s leave

chapters.title: Chapter 1015
chapters.content:
Chapter 1015: — the might of the young master!
The raging flame galaxy was too large, and although Xie Haiyang’s flying shuttle wasn’t slow, after entering the raging flame galaxy, he had some misgivings. He was worried that if he sped up, he would be regarded as arrogant and thus disliked by the blazing flame ancestor.
Thus, he didn’t dare to speed up too much and only maintained a uniform speed. Even so, in reality, his speed wasn’t slow. According to his estimation, he would be able to reach the raging flame main star in at most four months.
“Blazing Flame ancestor went through a drastic change. He has a great enmity with the Weiyang clan, so his personality has become strange and temperamental... although I have come into contact with him many times, I can not judge an old monster like him based on common sense.”Xie Haiyang stood in the flying shuttle, he took a deep breath. He had prepared a great gift for this time’s apprenticeship. Although he felt that the possibility of success was not small, he was still worried about gains and losses.
After all, whether or not he succeeded this time was related to his father’s life and death. He could not help but feel anxious. As a result, during this period of time, he had stopped all business arrangements outside.
“There are too many rumors about the blazing flame patriarch. However, according to my judgment, those disciples of the Blazing Flame Patriarch did indeed fall. However, they did not die, but left a remnant soul behind... now, the blazing flame patriarch has placed them in his galaxy and put them away for protection..
“The expert I’m looking for should be one of them. There’s a seventy percent chance that he’s his second disciple, the spirit son of deity!”Xie Haiyang seemed to be deep in thought. After a long while, he sighed.
Even though every step is difficult, it’s not like I don’t have any helpers. I heard that Wang Baole has already taken the blazing flame ancestor as his master. That fatty is greedy and lustful, so he should be able to be bribed. He might even know some insider information, xie Haiyang’s spirits were lifted. He felt that his plan was very likely to be realized.
Just as Xie Haiyang was thinking about Wang Baole, Wang Baole, who had transformed into a long rainbow and was flying in the starry sky beside the blazing flame main star a few months away, shuddered and sneezed.
Someone is thinking about me! Wang baole paused and looked around suspiciously. He didn’t notice anything unusual. He scratched his head, thinking that this was the blazing flame star system, his master’s territory, no one should dare provoke him.
There really is someone who is blind. HMPH, the other party might not know that all the existences here are my master! Wang baole coughed, ignoring the mental connection he had just sensed, the figure that had turned into a rainbow sped up once again, whistling into the distance.
His target was the meteorite belt next to the star in the fiery spirit civilization located in the 137th district of the Raging Flame Galaxy, located in the southeast of the raging flame galaxy, outside the raging flame main planet!
According to the jade slip he had obtained from the raging flame galaxy, the asteroid belt contained a large number of meteorites, enough for him to select a suitable one for sealing.
The Raging Flame Galaxy’s 137th Region... Wang Baole, who was speeding along, thought about the raging flame galaxy that he had learned about during this period of time. There were a total of 449 stars in the Raging Flame Galaxy.
......
Each star was a civilization, and there was life in it. They had been dependent on the blazing flame ancestor for all these years. While they respected the blazing flame ancestor as their leader, they also had to pay tribute every year, in exchange, they received the protection of the blazing flame ancestor.
The searing spirit civilization in District 137 was one of them. The strongest among them had a cultivation base at the late stage of the star. There were also several planet cultivators, and their overall strength was above average in the blazing flame star system, normally, they did not have the qualifications to pay respects on the blazing flame main star. Only on the occasion of the blazing flame ancestor’s once-in-a-century birthday would they be allowed to enter the main star.
To these subsidiary civilizations, The Blazing Flame main planet was a sacred land. The Blazing Flame ancestor was like a god, while the disciples of the blazing flame ancestor were like Daozi. They did not dare to be negligent, because within the blazing flame star system.., a single word from any of the sixteen Daozi could decide the survival of their entire civilization.
After all... The Blazing Flame ancestor was not only known for his protection, but everyone within the blazing flame star system was aware of it.
Therefore... even though Wang Baole had only been in the blazing flame galaxy for a short period of time and had not been notified of his departure, every time his flying shuttle entered a civilization, the strongest people in the civilization would fly out immediately, they bowed respectfully from afar.
The strongest people in the civilization were almost all at the star realm. They all had different appearances. Their supernatural abilities and the nature of their lives were mostly related to the fire laws. Wang Baole didn’t know them, but they knew Wang Baole’s appearance through various means, they bowed their heads and greeted him respectfully.
At first, Wang Baole was shocked.
After accepting little Missy’s explanation and getting used to the fact that everyone he saw was his master, when he saw the first star elite who had greeted him on his first trip to the blazing flame main planet.., his first reaction was to suspect that the other party was his master’s clone.
He felt that the possibility of that was extremely low. After all, it was unlikely that his master would send out a clone that covered hundreds of civilizations to play every role.
However, Wang Baole was getting a little jumpy from all this. However, when he noticed how respectful the other party was when he greeted him, he finally heaved a sigh of relief.
It’s not my master. With master’s personality, he still cares a lot about his reputation. He won’t come and worship me... The bottom line that he can accept is that he will worship himself
After coming to this conclusion, Wang Baole relaxed. However, he was still not used to being greeted by the stars. However, when more civilizations passed by and more powerful individuals like him appeared.., he had no choice but to accept and get used to it. At the same time, he was filled with emotions.
This feeling is enjoyable... but all of this is because master is so powerful. If I immerse myself in the feeling of being worshipped by others, it will be disadvantageous to myself
Only when you are strong and receive worship will you have true self-confidence! Wang Baole’s eyes shone brightly as he recalled the high officials’autobiographies that he had read before.
The purpose of borrowing power is not to suppress, nor is it for pleasure, nor is it to be domineering. Instead... it is to create an environment where I can advance rapidly, so that I can grow more smoothly and faster! Wang Baole muttered, he slowly calmed down and headed toward the 137th zone.
Finally, half a month later, he arrived at the 137th Zone. He saw the burning star that looked like a fireball, and the vast meteor that surrounded the star!
There were also... six figures that looked different from humans. They looked more like fire spirits. The leader had a purple mark on his forehead, and his stellar cultivation was forcefully suppressed by himself, the moment he saw Wang Baole, he immediately knelt down and kowtowed!
The five fire spirits behind him also knelt down together. The moment they knelt down, they sent a respectful telepathic thought to Wang Baole.
.
“Greetings to the sixteenth young master!”
Wang Baole stopped in his tracks. His gaze swept across the fire spirits, then turned to the meteorite behind them. He spoke calmly.
“Stand Guard for me!”
Wang Baole didn’t say anything more. He only said one sentence, and with a flash, he leaped past the six of them and headed straight for the star. As he neared, he disappeared into the meteorite belt outside the star. There was no trace of him.
However, his words were like a decree from the Heavenly Dao to the fire spirit civilization. Soon, under the arrangement of the powerful cultivator from the star, the entire fire spirit civilization was sealed. Even the other civilizations around them.., all of them acted upon the news and didn’t give up on this opportunity to pursue Wang Baole. They sealed one after another, and many stellar elite cultivators arrived. They sealed more than twenty civilization galaxies and sat cross-legged in the starry skies, meditating, they protected Wang Baole.
At the same time, dozens of planets and a large number of flying ships from different civilizations flew out from the surrounding civilizations. They surrounded the area, causing the surrounding starry skies to be protected like a metal bucket, and this wasn’t the end... Soon, more nearby civilizations learned of this matter, and all of them immediately tried their best to seal it up and move out again. So... the scope of this protection.., it got bigger and bigger... until a month later, it hit almost half of the Raging Inferno Galaxy!
I can not blame these civilizations for their hospitality. For many years, the young masters of the blazing flame main star had hardly been detected by them when they went out. Now that they had such a rare opportunity, how could they not show off when they finally saw one.
As a result... Xie Haiyang, who was flying towards the blazing flame main planet, was stopped when his shuttle was very far away from where Wang Baole was cultivating!
“Under the orders of the young lord, seal off the area and kill anyone who disobeys. Stop immediately!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1016
chapters.content:
Chapter 1016: of the Divine Art had just been completed!
In the distant galaxy, far away from where Wang Baole was cultivating, Xie Haiyang was intercepted not by a cultivator from a nearby civilization, but by a cultivator from a planet.
The cultivator’s body looked similar to that of a human, but the blood in his body was different. It was formed from lava, and he was born with a natural affinity for the fire element. This made his battle prowess in the raging flame galaxy much higher than in the outside world, even a cultivator of the same level could not do anything to him.
Therefore, even though he could sense that Xie Haiyang’s flying shuttle was extraordinary and that Xie Haiyang’s cultivation level was somewhat unfathomable, his expression was still incomparably cold and arrogant.
This was because he did not care how the other party thought. He was currently working for the young master. If the other party had a great background, he would naturally explain. If he did not have a great background and still dared to forcefully barge in, then he was worried that he would not have the opportunity to perform meritorious deeds.
Therefore, after saying those words, he stood there, looking coldly at the flying shuttle, and began to observe.
“Young Master?”Xie Haiyang heard the other party’s words, and was shocked. From the way the other party addressed him, he naturally realized that this was one of the disciples of the Blazing Flame Patriarch, who had appeared nearby, he was in the middle of something important, which was why he had ordered the starry sky to be sealed off from all outsiders.
“I wonder which disciple of Patriarch Flame... . Maybe this is an opportunity? !”Xie Haiyang hesitated, the cultivator in front of him immediately noticed what was happening. After noticing Xie Haiyang’s performance, he sighed regretfully. He knew that he probably wouldn’t have a chance to perform any meritorious service. The person in front of him.., even if he had some background, he obviously wouldn’t dare to force his way in.
Thinking that he didn’t have the chance to make a meritorious service, the cultivator waved his hand impatiently.
“Why aren’t you retreating? !”As he said that, he waved his hand, and a flaming storm appeared out of thin air. It turned into a sea of fire in front of him and rapidly pushed towards Xie Haiyang’s flying shuttle, intending to drive him away.
If it were any other time, with Xie Haiyang’s status, he would definitely not allow the other party to be so arrogant in front of him. However, now that he was in the raging flame galaxy and had a favor to ask of someone, he could only restrain his temper, while controlling the flying shuttle to quickly retreat from the flames, he appeared outside the flying shuttle. Standing on it, he cupped his fists in front of him.
“Fellow Daoist, May I know which disciple of the blazing flame ancestor is up ahead? I am Xie Haiyang of the Xie family, and I am here to pay my respects to the blazing flame ancestor!”
Hearing this, the planet Cultivator’s expression changed slightly. He retracted his divine ability and carefully sized up Xie Haiyang before cupping his fists in return.
“So, it’s fellow Daoist Xie. If fellow Daoist wishes to pay a visit to the patriarch, you’ll have to take a detour. The sixteenth young master is cultivating ahead of us. It is our duty. Outsiders are not allowed to enter. I’m Sorry!”
......
“Sixteenth young master?”Xie Haiyang was taken aback. He immediately reacted based on the information he had gathered.
“Is that sixteenth young master Wang Baole?”
“How dare you. I Don’t care what your intentions are. How dare you address the young master by his name in the Raging Flame Galaxy?”The planetary cultivator’s expression turned solemn immediately. He let out a low growl, and his cultivation erupted. He looked as if his master had been humiliated, xie Haiyang cursed his lackeys in his heart, but he shouted loudly on the surface.
“It’s a misunderstanding, fellow Daoist. This is a misunderstanding. I, Xie Haiyang, and brother Baole are sworn friends. I have come to pay my respects to the patriarch, and I also have the intention of visiting an old friend. Please inform him that... Xie Haiyang is here. I hope brother Baole can meet him!”Xie Haiyang laughed heartily, his expression was calm, making his words persuasive.
This caused the planet cultivator to hesitate. He looked carefully at Xie Haiyang and didn’t chase him away. Instead, he told him to wait there while he took out a jade slip and sent a voice transmission to his planet Patriarch.
However, even the planet Cultivator’s patriarch didn’t have the right to contact Wang Baole directly. Their civilization was too far away from where Wang Baole truly cultivated. Therefore, the news of Xie Haiyang’s arrival could only be passed on, it could only be transmitted layer by layer. Even when it reached the scorching spirit civilization, it couldn’t be transmitted immediately to Wang Baole.
After all, Wang Baole was currently sitting cross-legged in the asteroid belt, isolating himself from all contact with the outside world. He was completely immersed in the operation of the first level of the star sealing art.
As his cultivation roamed and as the star sealing art was activated, the ripples on Wang Baole’s body grew stronger. In the end, the nine ancient stars around him materialized into dao stars. As the Suppressive Force spread out, it affected the asteroid belt, the sound of explosions occasionally spread out in all directions.
At the same time, layers of ripples gradually spread out as Wang Baole circulated the star sealing art. Half a month later, when the ripples spread out from Wang Baole’s body and covered the entire asteroid belt, his eyes suddenly opened.
It’s about time. The next step is to find a suitable asteroid to complete the first level of the star sealing art! As he mumbled, Wang Baole raised his right hand and grabbed forward, immediately, one of the many meteorites in front of him broke free from the pull of the star and charged toward Wang Baole.
As he neared, a strange light shone in Wang Baole’s eyes. He quickly formed a seal with his hands. He was surrounded by the dao stars formed from the nine ancient stars. A giant star chart appeared around him.
The star chart was formed from the light spots formed by the ten thousand stars. Each light spot that looked like a star was actually a cow louse that had shrunk into a sphere. They lined up together to form the outline of the Divine Ox’s body, the center of the Divine Ox’s brows was where the dao star was located. Inside the Dao Star was... Wang Baole, who was sitting cross-legged and meditating.
The moment the outline of the star chart appeared, the meteorite that he had absorbed rapidly shrank under the guidance of the power of the star chart. It eventually turned into a long rainbow and merged with Wang Baole’s star chart, it merged with one of the dots of light rapidly.
.
After it had completely merged with the star chart, the cow louse that had originally been in the dot of light had successfully entered the interior of the meteorite. The moment it merged into one, the Suppressive Force emitted by Wang Baole’s star chart clearly increased!
After sensing it carefully, Wang Baole became excited. He formed another seal. Immediately, from within the meteorite zone, one after another of the meteorites that he had selected flew towards Wang Baole from all directions, as they approached, they were affected by the Starlight and became smaller and smaller. Eventually, they turned into a rainbow and fused rapidly with the specks of light in Wang Baole’s divine ox star Atlas.
Time passed slowly, and Wang Baole’s cultivation progressed rapidly. The number of meteorites fused increased from two or three at the beginning to more than a hundred. Then, more than a thousand. Another half a month passed, the number of meteorites exceeded six thousand!
The suppressive force of his divine ox star chart continued to increase. Now, the ripples that emanated from the entire star chart shocked even the star ancestor of the scorching spirit civilization, who was outside the asteroid belt.
Even as a star cultivator, he could still sense a growing force within the asteroid belt that made him feel a sense of danger. It was spreading wildly.
Another half a month passed. Xie Haiyang sighed as he waited. Wang Baole’s body, which had been sitting cross-legged in meditation, suddenly trembled. He opened his eyes again. Ten beams of light that had been formed by the asteroids flew towards him, they filled up the last ten spots of light in the outline of his star map in an instant, causing the first level of the star sealing art... to be completely perfected!
With a loud boom, the divine ox shadow formed by tens of thousands of meteorites seemed to come to life. As Wang Baole stood up, he also stood up in the starry sky and let out a roar that shook the entire area.
The Roar alone formed an invisible wave that spread wildly in all directions. It was like a storm that swept in all directions, causing all the cultivators in the outside world, below the stars, to tremble. They had no choice but to retreat, unable to get close, even the stars were shaken. They looked at the enormous image of the divine ox that had appeared in the asteroid belt, and then lowered their heads.
“Congratulations, young lord! You’ve just completed your divine ability!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1017 - Please!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1017:, Please!
Just as the Divine Ox Phantom appeared outside Wang Baole’s body and appeared outside the star of the scorching spirit civilization, it roared into the sky and let out a soundless roar, stirring up a storm that spread in all directions. On the blazing flame main planet.., fifteen, who was lying on the rock that his fourteenth senior brother had turned into, with his hands behind his head and humming a tune, suddenly stopped. He sat up and looked at the scorching spirit civilization from afar.
His expression was completely different from what he had looked like before. A smile appeared on his face, and his eyes were filled with gratification. It was as if an old soul had appeared within the young man’s body!
He wasn’t the only one. A face also appeared on the rock beneath him. His expression was exactly the same as fifteen’s. There was also the tree that thirteen had transformed into, as well as the gentle twelfth senior sister, the domineering eleventh senior sister and the others all had the same expression!
Whether it was the bruised and battered seventh senior brother, or the third senior brother who was soaking in the lava, or the eldest senior sister who was playing chess with him in second senior brother’s tower, or even old bull who had been sleeping, all of them had the same expression, their smiles and expressions were the same!
They were filled with relief, care, and hope.
“This kid has already begun to gain momentum,”said the eldest senior sister, smiling as she put down the chess piece in her hand.
“To be able to cultivate so quickly in such a short period of time and achieve such momentum,”said the second senior brother warmly, looking up. “In addition to the bath arranged by master, the sealing star incantation is also very important.” He knew very well that a suitable cultivation technique was extremely important to cultivators, especially a cultivation technique like the sealing star incantation. It was a technique that could allow one to rise up into the heavens!
After all, this was the most imposing cultivation technique of the flame branch!
“When master went out, he asked Guru Heavenlaw to personally take action. He used his junior brother’s hair to deduce the ancient and modern heavenly daos, allowing the sealing star incantation to evolve and adjust itself to the most suitable aptitude for the sixteenth junior brother. If it was custom-made for him, then master must have paid a huge price to achieve this...”the second elder brother said softly, his eldest senior sister laughed.
“The price may not be small, but it’s worth it. For us cultivators, if we want to walk out of the true Great Dao, our cultivation techniques may be heavy, our aptitude may be heavy, our opportunities may be heavy, our magical treasures may be heavy... but in reality, these are all secondary. What should be placed first is our aura!”
“From the planet realm, we must begin to nurture... a fearless aura!”
“Only with such a will can one have an indomitable aura that can not be stopped by anything in the world, the Heavenly Dao of the universe, or even hundreds of millions of laws and Daos!”
“If this aura is not extinguished, one is destined to step onto the peak and become invincible in the world!”Eldest senior sister threw her head back and laughed loudly, her eyes filled with intense anticipation as she muttered words that only she herself could hear.
“All the disciples of the raging flame lineage possess this force. However, the Heavenly Dao is unkind and has fallen one after another... However, I believe that if this force continues, it will be the path of the Great Dao!”
On the raging flame main planet, everyone’s gaze was fixed on the scorching spirit civilization. At that moment, outside the star of the scorching spirit civilization, between the brows of the divine ox that was throwing its head back and roaring, Wang Baole, who was on the Dao planet, had a domineering look on his face, it was slowly growing!
PLease reading on Mybo x n o ve l. com
From the looks of it now, the planet realm... is just a transition! Wang Baole sensed the fluctuations in his cultivation. He was only at the mid-stage of the planet realm, but he had the feeling that if he went all out, he would be able to defeat him with his planet realm cultivation, perhaps there was, but if he wanted to kill him at this realm, even if there was such a thing in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain, it would be as rare as a phoenix feather or a qilin’s horn.
“The dao stars have only one engraving law, the rules of the nine ancient planets. The Nightmare Eye Art assists in killing, and the power of the star sealing art...”Wang Baole muttered to himself. The domineering look on his face grew stronger and stronger, it was as if his entire being and the Divine Ox’s shadow were being guided by an invisible force as they merged. His aura grew stronger and stronger at that moment.
The law of the starry sky in all directions was affected, causing the power of law in the area to materialize. The starry sky rumbled, and the cultivators from the burning spirit civilization and other nearby civilizations all paid their respects. Then, he waved his right hand.
Immediately, he took out all of the hundred mortal stars that the violet-gold civilization had given him as an apology. These mortal stars had been refined and sealed with magic, so they only looked like fist-sized beads of different colors.
However, if the seal was broken, they would immediately turn into planets, spreading out in the starry sky and transforming back into planets.
Even though I have only perfected the first level of the star sealing art... I have yet to reach the second level, but I feel that... I should be able to fuse with these mortal stars! Wang Baole narrowed his eyes, instantly, the dao stars around his body shone brightly. The dao stars filled the entire divine ox star chart, causing the divine ox to tremble violently. Even though its power hadn’t increased by much, it had borrowed the power of the Dao Stars on a different level.
At the same time, Wang Baole raised both his hands and immediately formed a seal. Immediately, the Divine Ox’s shadow around his body roared once again. It opened its mouth wide and sucked hard at the light pearls formed from the hundreds of stars.
With that one breath, the hundred stars immediately shone brightly and charged towards the divine ox. It was instantly devoured by the divine ox and spread throughout its body. It began to fuse with the meteorites in different locations, this process didn’t last long. It lasted for about ten breaths. As Wang Baole waved his arms, the image of the divine ox outside his body roared once again.
This time, it was even louder and more imposing. There were one hundred locations in the divine ox star map where the meteorites had been fused with the mortal stars, turning them into stars!
Compared to the overall picture, the one hundred mortal stars was only one out of a hundred. However, it was still a huge improvement for the divine ox as a whole. This made the light in Wang Baole’s eyes shine even brighter.
With the Dao Stars’augmentation, when I was at the first level of the star sealing art, I could go through normal cultivation. Only when I reached the second level would I be able to fuse with the ordinary stars
That way, I’ll be confident that when I reach the second level, I’ll be able to fuse with the spirit and immortal stars ahead of time. That way... When I reach the third level, I’ll be able to fuse with the special stars. That shouldn’t be a problem
If one day, I can fuse with more than ten thousand special planets and transform into the Divine Bull’s shadow, how powerful will it be? Wang Baole was shocked. He couldn’t imagine how powerful it would be. However, such anticipation was deeply rooted in his heart, it kept emerging.
The enhancement of the DAO stars is like adding one to my cultivation technique. If I reach the fourth level, then to a certain extent, I’ll reach the unprecedented fifth level
If that’s the case... my method of breaking through to the planet might no longer be to fuse with a star... Wang Baole thought to himself. At that moment, his mind was filled with happiness, and a bold thought appeared in his mind.
.
Can I use the star sealing art to upgrade my dao star and turn it from a planet into a star? Once I do that, my cultivation will naturally break through and step into the Star Realm from a planet! Wang Baole’s eyes shone with a strange light, it didn’t matter if it was the dark dream or the questions he had asked Old Niu on the raging flame main planet, as well as the books he had read.
He was clear that there were many ways for planet cultivators to upgrade to a star. Due to the changes in their level of life, they were no longer limited to a fixed number of methods. There were too many choices that could allow one to upgrade.
However, no matter what method one used, there was no guarantee of success. The chances of failure were usually very high. It wasn’t completely foolproof, but the time and cost of preparation were unimaginable, for example... if the civilization didn’t have a star, then as long as the civilization upgraded, the cultivator’s life level would be boosted, allowing him to successfully step into the star realm.
With that thought, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and didn’t continue thinking. After all, he was still quite a distance away from breaking through. Now that he had just mastered the divine art, the most important thing before him was to think of a way to obtain enough mortal stars, the most important thing was to replenish the ten thousand mortal planets. Wang Baole thought for a moment, then raised his head. With a thought, the image of the Divine Ox appeared. It was filled with a domineering aura, and as it flashed, it shrank rapidly, it was as if it had rolled backwards and returned to Wang Baole’s body. Wang Baole took a step forward, and in the next instant, he appeared in front of the star cultivators from the scorching spirit civilization and the nearby civilizations who had come to protect him.
“Greetings, Young Master!”The star cultivators bowed their heads and bowed respectfully.
“Thank you!”Even though they were of different statuses and could decide the fate of many beings in the raging flame galaxy with a single word, Wang Baole knew very well that this was because of his master. It was the influence of others, not him. Therefore, he returned the greeting politely, just as he was about to leave to return to the raging flame main planet, the star cultivator from the scorching spirit civilization, who was standing beside him, hesitated and spoke softly.
“Young lord, there’s a cultivator named Xie Haiyang. He claims to be an old friend of yours and has been waiting outside for a long time...”
“Xie Haiyang?”Wang Baole was stunned. Then, he blinked. A look of surprise flashed across his eyes. He had been worried that he didn’t have enough mortal planets... he cleared his throat and spoke immediately.
“Please!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1018 - A Pair of Good Brothers!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1018: A Pair of Good Brothers!
After Wang Baole gave the order, he waited for a full seven days... Xie Haiyang finally rushed over. Xie Haiyang couldn’t be blamed for being slow. It was just that the place where he was located was quite a distance away from where Wang Baole was, seven days was already the maximum effort he could muster. He even had the help of the star. Otherwise, it would have taken him at least half a month or more.
Fortunately, Wang Baole wasn’t impatient. He sat cross-legged outside the star of the scorching spirit civilization for the past seven days. He consolidated his divine abilities and familiarized himself with the operation and execution of the star sealing art.
Finally, after Wang Baole had become completely familiar with the star sealing art and was able to instantly spread it out to form a powerful divine ability that could shrink and cover his entire body as a form of self-defense, Xie Haiyang arrived.
Xie Haiyang, who had stepped into the scorching spirit civilization from afar, was shocked when he saw Wang Baole, who was exuding an astonishing amount of energy outside the distant star.
On one hand, it had been a long time since they last met. Wang Baole’s cultivation was now as different as heaven and earth, shocking him greatly. On the other hand, the star cultivators who were surrounding Wang Baole respectfully seemed to only need a single word from Wang Baole.., it was as if they could fight for him. Their current status was completely different from before!
All of this made Xie Haiyang take a deep breath. He immediately adjusted his state of mind. The moment he got closer, he immediately shouted out loud.
“Xie Haiyang, greetings to the sixteen young masters of the Raging Flame Galaxy!”As he spoke, Xie Haiyang cupped his fists and bowed deeply.
The moment Xie Haiyang spoke, Wang Baole, who was sitting cross-legged, slowly opened his eyes. The moment he looked at Xie Haiyang, he immediately stood up. A smile appeared on his face, and in a flash, he welcomed him, at the same time, laughter spread in all directions.
“Brother Haiyang, why are you being so polite? We are old friends. There’s no need to be like this.”Wang baole laughed as he approached and helped Xie Haiyang up. His eyes revealed his sincerity.
“All these years, if not for brother Haiyang’s help, I wouldn’t have gotten to where I am today. Brother Haiyang, if I don’t acknowledge you, you don’t have to acknowledge me either.”
Xie Haiyang was touched when he heard that. He pressed down hard on Wang Baole’s arm.
“For you to get to where you are today, my help is insignificant. It’s all because of your own abilities. Brother Baole, you mustn’t belittle yourself!”
“Brother Haiyang!”
“Brother Baole!”
Both of them spoke loudly and enthusiastically, as if they had not seen each other for many years. They chatted and laughed with emotion. The people around them turned to look at them. They could sense the friendship between the two of them, they must be like gentlemen, supporting each other, respecting each other, and not taking credit for each other.
PLease reading on Myb ox no ve l. com
However, in reality... the onlookers still didn’t understand Xie Haiyang and Wang Baole. Xie Haiyang seemed enthusiastic, but he felt sour deep down. After all, Wang Baole had changed too much. He was only a spirit immortal before, but now he was at the mid-stage of the planet, the ripples emanating from his body were especially shocking. Even though he had the protection of the patriarch, he still felt a little apprehensive.
All of this, apart from his status as the disciple of the blazing flame patriarch, was clearly due to his trip to the fallen star field.
What made Xie Haiyang’s Heart Ache was the fallen star field!
If it wasn’t for his father’s unexpected situation, which caused him to have no time to take care of the spot in the fallen star field and rush back to deal with it, then... according to his previous plan, one step at a time.., in the end, the spot in the purple gold civilization would have been obtained by him.
Then, whether he sold it or gave it away, he would have benefited greatly. But now... everything was in the past.
However, as a businessman, he could quickly adjust his smile. Therefore, it was inevitable that his smile was commercialized in a way that others couldn’t see.
At the same time, he was thinking about how to use his previous business relationship with Wang Baole to achieve his goal.
As for Wang Baole, he naturally recognized the familiar smile at a glance. However, he didn’t mind it at all. Even though his smile wasn’t commercial, the focus of his enthusiasm was more on the benefits that Xie Haiyang could bring, after all, what he lacked the most right now was a mortal planet. The arrival of Xie Haiyang had given Wang Baole Hope.
That was the nature of their relationship. In Xie Haiyang’s eyes, the sour feeling had dissipated. After he regained his rationality, Wang Baole’s value had increased greatly, making his previous investment.., become even more valuable.
From Wang Baole’s point of view, even though they couldn’t become close friends, they were still of value to each other. That was the most stable relationship. As they chatted and laughed, after learning that Xie Haiyang was going to pay his respects to his master.., wang Baole immediately invited him to head to the blazing flame main planet.
“Brother Baole, I won’t stand on ceremony with your kind invitation.”Xie Haiyang laughed heartily. As he chatted and laughed with Wang Baole, he flew towards the blazing flame main planet under the escort of a large number of cultivators from the blazing flame star system, on the way, the two of them talked about the past. Unknowingly, they started talking about the land of the fallen stars.
“Brother Baole, it’s interesting. A few days ago, someone came to ask me if I had an elder brother named Xie Dalu. I told him that my elder brother’s name is not Xie Dalu, but I have a younger brother named Xie Dalu.”As Xie Haiyang spoke.., he looked at Wang Baole with a faint smile. His words were not meant to make things difficult for him. Instead, he was hinting to Wang baole that he knew that you had used the Xie family’s name. That was why he owed him a favor.
Wang Baole laughed when he heard that.
“I’ve made a fool of myself, Brother Haiyang. There was a reason for that. I ran into an emergency when I returned, so I didn’t explain myself to you immediately. However, I don’t think brother Haiyang will mind. After all, I was able to obtain a spot in the fallen star lands, and brother Haiyang has helped me a lot.”Wang Baole smiled faintly as well, he nodded at Xie Haiyang. His words were both an explanation and a hint. On the spot for the fallen star, the other party had set up a series of arrangements, whether it was the burial ground for the divine eye royal family in the beginning or the rescue that he had requested, all of them contained the intention of hiding in the dark and using him to obtain the spot. He had already seen through this. Therefore, there was no such thing as a favor.
Xie Haiyang laughed when he heard that. His expression was the same as ever, as if he hadn’t heard the hint. However, he didn’t talk about the fallen stars anymore. Instead, he told Wang Baole about the past in the federation.
Wang Baole’s smile was the same as ever. He talked about the past with Xie Haiyang, occasionally sighing. The two of them were getting closer and closer to the blazing flame main planet. In the end, the blazing flame main planet was right in front of them, xie Haiyang seemed to casually mention Wang Baole’s cultivation. Wang baole blinked when he heard Xie Haiyang’s words, and he sighed as well.
It was only after I came to the blazing flame star system that I realized how much cultivation required. Just one star sealing art actually requires tens of thousands of ordinary stars. Wang Baole could already tell that Xie Haiyang had come to the blazing flame star system, he had a request. Even though he didn’t know what it was, it didn’t stop him from directly stating what he needed.
It’s that Big? Xie Haiyang thought to himself. Wang Baole was asking for such a big favor. He hadn’t even asked for his help, yet he was asking for tens of thousands of mortal stars. He looked troubled.
“Brother Baole, I’ll keep an eye out for you later. Tens of thousands of mortal stars isn’t cheap, but I’ll definitely do my best to help you with this. Besides, since you need mortal stars... I have some here for you. Consider it a gift for our reunion after a long time.” Xie Haiyang generously took out a storage bag from his pocket and handed it to Wang Baole.
Wang Baole didn’t stand on ceremony. He took it and scanned it. He saw that there was a mortal star inside, and his eyes instantly narrowed. The other party’s gift seemed to be only one, but the value of the mortal star was shocking. Therefore, although the gift wasn’t very heavy.., it wasn’t small either.
From this, it could be seen that Xie Haiyang had come to the raging flame galaxy for a great deal as well. Therefore, Wang Baole stroked the storage bag and didn’t put it away immediately. Instead, he looked at Xie Haiyang.
“Brother Haiyang, if you have something to say, just say it. May I know what you need me to do?”
Xie Haiyang smiled. He thought for a moment before speaking softly.
“Brother Baole, I want you to help me introduce one of your senior brothers or senior sisters... also, if necessary, help me put in a good word for you. After the deed is done, I will give you another mortal star.”
Wang Baole was stunned when he heard that. He raised his eyebrows and thought to himself that his senior brothers and senior sisters were actually masters. However, he naturally couldn’t tell Xie Haiyang that. At the same time, even though one or two mortal stars were worth a lot of money, for him to introduce them and put in a good word for them.., it would be a little low if he were to use his favor to help them. His sincerity wasn’t enough... however, after some thought, he still asked.
“May I know which senior brother and senior sister of mine you wish to meet?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1019 - You actually know chapter 1019 as well!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1019: You actually know chapter 1019 as well!
It wasn’t that Xie Haiyang didn’t know that his sincerity wasn’t enough. However, he felt that two ordinary stars were enough. He didn’t want the person he was investing in to develop a greedy personality, nor did he want the other party to think that his resources.., were that easy to obtain.
It wasn’t that he didn’t like Wang Baole. It was just that he was a businessman by nature. He had always felt that the amount of things he did and the amount of resources he gave were the same.
At the same time... This was also necessary for his position as an investor. In Xie Haiyang’s opinion, having a large amount of resources and investing in cultivators meant that he was in a superior position. To a certain extent, both parties were cooperating, at the same time, he had to have a certain degree of initiative.
That was the only way that it wouldn’t develop to an uncontrollable stage. It would also be the best way to protect his position. It would also allow the other party to slowly develop habits and dependencies, and he wouldn’t be able to leave his resources completely.
That was the only way to make a perfect investment!
Therefore, the gifts and promises of the mortal planet were all part of his business model. He had even thought about how he would continue to give the mortal planet to Wang Baole based on his value in this matter. It would be like giving bait to a fish, step by step, he would allow the other party to continue in the direction he wanted to go.
That would be until he achieved his goal.
With that thought in mind, Xie Haiyang smiled faintly when he heard Wang Baole’s question.
“Brother Baole, I will tell you when I meet with the blazing flame ancestor. I hope that you can help me when the time comes.”Xie Haiyang had a detached attitude, but he was very humble in his actions, as he spoke, he cupped his fists and bowed to Wang Baole.
An undetectable glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes. With his intelligence and experience, he could naturally see through Xie Haiyang’s thoughts. However, he didn’t mind. To him, no matter how Xie Haiyang thought about it, this was just a transaction, to him, it was just a transaction.
Two mortal planets in exchange for a referral is still acceptable. As for putting in a good word... basically, all senior brothers and senior sisters are Masters. It doesn’t matter anymore. Wang Baole coughed. He had made up his mind, he and Xie Haiyang discussed other matters. The two of them transformed into a rainbow and entered the blazing flame main planet. They whistled through the sky and headed straight for the tower where the blazing flame ancestor, Wang Baole, and the other disciples were.
Xie Haiyang was a little nervous as they approached. He couldn’t help but feel a sense of loss and gain. Even though he felt that the plan shouldn’t be a problem, he couldn’t help but ask Wang Baole in a low voice.
“Brother Baole, do you know which of your senior brothers and sisters are close to Chen Qingzi?”
“Chen Qingzi?”Wang Baole was stunned for a moment. He looked at Xie Haiyang in surprise.
“He’s the number one divine king of the Weiyang clan. He’s able to fight against the divine emperor and is extremely terrifying. He’s like the Fiend God, the one who was once a disciple of the dark sect... Chen Qingzi!”Xie Haiyang explained in a low voice. He sighed after he finished speaking.
PLease reading on Myb ox no ve l. com
“You probably don’t know this person. Sigh.”
Wang Baole had a strange expression on his face. He thought to himself, if I don’t know, no one will know. However, he didn’t show it on his face. Instead, curiosity appeared on his face.
“Are you looking for Chen Qingzi or my senior brothers and Senior Sisters?”
“Just tell me if I know anyone who is familiar with him,”Xie Haiyang replied impatiently as he thought about the matter with his father. He was feeling a little irritated.
Wang Baole raised his eyebrows when he heard that, but he still replied patiently.
“To be honest, I haven’t been in the raging flame galaxy for long. I haven’t heard of any of my senior brothers and sisters who have a good relationship with Chen Qingzi... But...”Wang Baole was deep in thought, and before he could finish his sentence.., xie Haiyang, who was beside him, had already sighed and shook his head.
“Forget it. I’ll handle this matter myself.”Xie Haiyang hadn’t placed his hopes on Wang Baole. He had been worried about his own gains and losses, which was why he had asked about it. He had been frustrated, and he had seen that the tower was right in front of him, therefore, after hearing what Wang Baole had said earlier, he wasn’t in the mood to listen to the rest. He cupped his fists at Wang Baole and was about to head over first.
Wang Baole hesitated for a moment. He looked at Xie Haiyang, who was heading straight for the blazing flame ancestor’s tower, and couldn’t help but speak.
New novels chapters are published ᴏn !
“Xie Haiyang, why are you looking for Chen Qingzi?”
If it had been any other time, Xie Haiyang, with his shrewdness, might have been able to hear some special meaning in those words. However, at that moment, he was feeling anxious and had overlooked something. This was especially so when Wang Baole kept asking him about his personal matters, impatience had already risen in his heart.
“Baole, there’s no point in telling you about this. You Can’t help me. Once I meet the blazing flame ancestor and get an answer, I’ll ask for your help.”As he spoke, Xie Haiyang didn’t even turn his head as he flew towards the blazing flame ancestor’s tower, after pausing outside, he cupped his fists and bowed deeply towards the tower. His expression was one of unprecedented respect as he spoke loudly.
“Junior Xie Haiyang wishes to see the blazing flame ancestor!”
“Come in!”Xie Haiyang’s arrival naturally could not escape the blazing flame ancestor’s divine perception. In reality, the blazing flame ancestor had already known since the moment he stepped into the blazing flame galaxy. As the words left his mouth, the door to the tower slowly opened, xie Haiyang took a deep breath and stepped into the tower with a solemn expression.
Wang Baole was a little displeased as he watched Xie Haiyang enter his master’s Tower. He thought to himself that Xie Haiyang’s words clearly implied that he did not think that he was of much use in this matter. This made Wang Baole very uncomfortable, he thought to himself that he had originally intended to help him, but that was no longer the case. He turned around and flew straight to his tower.
After returning to his tower, Wang Baole sat down cross-legged. His eyes slowly narrowed, and he couldn’t help but recall Xie Haiyang’s words and actions along the way. His eyes slowly revealed his thoughts.
Xie Haiyang’s actions clearly indicate that he has something to ask senior brother Chen Qingzi for help... with the Xie family’s influence, they don’t lack powerful people, so there shouldn’t be anything that can’t be resolved. unless... this matter is related to senior brother in the first place. At the same time, Xie Haiyang is so anxious. Clearly, this matter is closely related to him and far exceeds his family clan’s
Xie Haiyang came here... he probably couldn’t contact Chen Qingzi, so he asked which of my senior brothers and sisters had a good relationship with Chen Qingzi... master must have said something to him, which caused this misunderstanding... Wang Baole was quick-witted, he quickly guessed what had happened from Xie Haiyang’s behavior.
Then, a strange expression appeared on his face. He raised his head and looked at his master’s tower from afar.
This is the trap that master has dug for Xie Haiyang. He should have vaguely told Xie Haiyang that he has a disciple who has a good relationship with Chen Qingzi... at the thought of this, Wang Baole could not help but cough. His thoughts became active, his eyes slowly lit up.
If there are no guesses, Xie Haiyang will come looking for me very soon... Brother Haiyang, I feel very sorry for you. Wang baole blinked as anticipation rose uncontrollably in his heart.
In addition, through Xie Haiyang, I can also understand where senior brother went... This fellow left me in the God’s eye civilization and disappeared... Wang Baole rubbed the space between his brows. He knew about these things, he soon had an answer. He took a deep breath, closed his eyes, and meditated, waiting for Xie Haiyang to arrive.
His judgment was correct. Xie Haiyang was kneeling in the blazing flame ancestor’s tower with a devout look on his face. Three golden storage bags were placed in front of him.
As for the blazing flame ancestor, he sat there with a meaningful look on his face. Beside him was Wang Baole’s eldest senior sister. She stood beside him with a solemn look on her face. As she sized Xie Haiyang up and down, the blazing flame ancestor spoke calmly.
“You wish to acknowledge me as your master? That’s impossible. I no longer accept disciples. If you really want to, you can just acknowledge me as your first disciple.”
Xie Haiyang hesitated for a moment upon hearing that. However, he quickly gritted his teeth and kneeled before the eldest disciple beside the blazing flame ancestor, shouting loudly.
“I hope that master will agree to accept Haiyang. Haiyang will definitely remember master’s kindness!”
“This...”eldest senior sister’s expression was one of hesitation as she looked at the blazing flame patriarch. The Blazing Flame Patriarch stroked his beard, looking as if he was making his own decision.
When Xie Haiyang saw this, he felt anxious. He once again knelt down and took out a few more bags of holding, placing them in front of him before pleading once more.
In the end, eldest senior sister nodded reluctantly. She accepted Xie Haiyang as a disciple and gave him the status of a disciple. Seeing that the plan had been accomplished, Xie Haiyang was ecstatic. Ignoring the issue of seniority, he immediately spoke in front of the blazing flame patriarch, he opened his mouth in a hurry.
“Master, Grandmaster, can you tell me which of my uncles in the line of fire is on good terms with Chen Qingzi?”
Hearing the words of Xie Haiyang, the flame ancestor narrowed his eyes and did not speak. The big senior sister next to him also turned from grave to weird. After coughing, she slowly opened her mouth.
“Speaking of those uncles of yours who are as close to Chen Qingzi as brothers, in fact... you know them too.”
As soon as eldest senior sister Wang Baole said those words, Xie Haiyang’s heart jolted before he could finish his sentence. He could tell that something was amiss from those words..

chapters.title: Chapter 1020 - Drama Queen!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1020: Drama Queen!
“I know him too...”Xie Haiyang’s breathing quickened, and his eyes went blank. At that moment, he felt that his brain was running out of ideas. A figure had appeared instinctively, but in the next moment, it was forcefully erased by him, he even kept telling himself that it was impossible..
“That’s right, you know him too.”Eldest senior sister coughed, and her expression changed from the strange look she had before to one of seriousness. However, there was a hint of pride in her eyes that Xie Haiyang could not see. She forced a straight face and said calmly.
“He is your... sixteenth uncle-master, Wang Baole!”
Xie Haiyang’s entire body trembled. He felt as if millions of heavenly thunders had exploded in his mind, splitting the voice of his cheap master into countless echoes that reverberated in his ears.
“Your...”
“Sixteenth... uncle-master...”
“Wang Baole...”
Xie Haiyang’s head was spinning. He couldn’t help but raise his hand and knock on his forehead. His expression was blank as he stared blankly at his master and Grandmaster, who were both solemn. His master had yet to finish his sentence.
“Yang ‘er, I’ve heard about you from your grandmaster. You’re usually a very astute person, and you’re familiar with Wang Baole. Don’t you know that in our lineage, his relationship with Chen Qingzi has already reached a level where they’re like family?”Eldest senior sister said with a sigh, she even shook her head and sighed in response to her own words, making her appear helpless.
“Grand... Grand Ancestor...
