“The power of the rules...”
“He’s worthy of being the fifth young master of the Xie Family!”
As the uproar broke out, Xie Haiyang, who was on the balcony, was equally shocked. He wasn’t surprised by Xie Yunteng’s strength. Xie Yunteng was a warmonger in the family clan, and he wouldn’t be surprised by his opponent’s Gu Xing, that was because he himself... was also an Gu Xing!
However, the rules were different. The person who shocked him was Wang Baole!
Xie Haiyang had seen Wang Baole with his own eyes many times along the way. Even though he had a rough estimate of Wang Baole’s combat strength, his thoughts were still churning in his mind at that moment.
He knew that Wang Baole, who had already displayed his might, had yet to use the star sealing art and the Dao Stars!
And his nine ancient stars... as Xie Haiyang muttered to himself, a smile appeared on Wang Baole’s face in mid-air.
This is getting interesting. Wang Baole was very pleased with his attack. He had encountered such strange rules. As a smile appeared on his face, the battle intent in his eyes grew stronger. He didn’t retreat or Dodge at all, he took a step forward. He raised his right hand, clenched his fist, and used the most direct method to punch!
The punch was crimson in color!
It was... one of the rules of the ancient planet, the Crimson Blood Dao!
As the punch landed, the ripples in all directions surged like waves. The color was crimson, and it carried an ancient and ancient air. It was like the blood of an ancient immortal. It struck the web of threads that enveloped the area!
“Gu Xing?”Xie Yunteng was taken aback.
It wasn’t over yet. A domineering look appeared on Wang Baole’s face. He took a step forward and punched again!
The fist was orange in color. It was the Dao of Orange Joy. As soon as it appeared, countless heavenly sounds appeared around it, forming sound waves that reverberated in all directions once again!
This scene caused Xie Yunteng’s expression to change drastically once again!
“It’s Gu Xing again!”
Before this, he had come in a hurry, so he didn’t know who the person beside Xie Haiyang was. However, at this moment, a name suddenly appeared in his mind. It was a person who had risen to prominence recently!
Wang Baole

chapters.title: Chapter 1032 - condensing the Ancestral Shadow!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1032:, condensing the Ancestral Shadow!
Recently, Wang Baole, who had been cultivating in the raging flame galaxy, did not know much about his fame in the outside world. In fact, after the name list of the Fallen Star Lands was released, his name had spread like a storm, it had spread throughout the entire Weiyang Dao Domain.
He had attracted the attention of countless powerful families and factions, and he had grown greedy. At that time, although he had placed a lot of importance on him, most of them had harbored ill intentions. Most of them had been thinking about his dao star. As for himself... he did not have much influence, after all, he hadn’t grown up yet, and he was already the center of attention in the early stages. It wasn’t a good thing.
However, soon, news spread throughout the raging flame galaxy that the blazing flame ancestor had accepted Wang Baole as his disciple. He had even acted on behalf of his disciple, causing the purple gold civilization to tremble in apology. This matter swept across the entire Weiyang Dao domain like a hurricane, it caused the countless families and factions that were paying attention to Wang Baole to be alarmed.
They had no choice but to restrain their malicious intentions. The blazing flame ancestor’s reputation of being protective and vicious was a cause for fear. That was why Wang Baole’s name had once again entered the eyes of the various factions. It was completely different from before.
He had the blazing flame ancestor behind him. As the blazing flame ancestor’s disciple and possessing a dao star, Wang Baole was publicly acknowledged as a prodigy.
At that moment, Xu Yinling, the bell girl, added fuel to the fire, and Wang Baole’s fame spread even wider. Almost all the prodigy cultivators from the various clans had heard of him, and they knew that he had a dao star formed from nine ancient stars!
That was why when Xie Yunteng saw the powerful enemy before him display two ancient stars’rules, and when he thought of Xie Haiyang joining the blazing flame galaxy, the identity of the person in front of him was immediately revealed in Xie Yunteng’s mind.
“Wang Baole!”
The moment Xie Yunteng opened his mouth, Wang Baole’s blood and joy rules erupted, forming a tearing force that caused the huge net to tremble and begin to collapse.
However, Wang Baole wasn’t satisfied with the mere collapse. He took another step forward, and the third, fourth, and fifth punches landed abruptly.
The dao of green plants, the Dao of green clouds, and the Dao of blue wind!
Three rays of light exploded in an instant, fusing into Wang Baole’s fists. They seemed to set off a storm, forming a gigantic tree that reached the heavens, as well as a layer of rolling clouds. There was also a hurricane that appeared out of thin air from all directions, they were all the manifestation of laws. After the Sea of blood and the sound waves, they headed toward the web of threads that was already in a state of collapse. It was as if they were crushing it, wreaking havoc.
Amidst the rumbling, the web of threads was an ancient planet, but it was only comparable to one of Wang Baole’s ancient planets. With nine ancient planets, he was naturally able to destroy it with ease. The laws of threads contained within Xie Yunteng’s ancient planet.., were completely unstoppable.
As it continued to shatter, it was as if an egg had hit a rock. Everyone who saw it was shocked. Xie Yunteng himself was also spitting out blood. Within a short period of time.., he spat out five mouthfuls of blood!
It was an attack, and he was spitting out blood. His figure was forced to retreat every time Wang Baole attacked. The ancient star projection behind him became more and more distorted.
PLease reading on Myb oxn o ve l. com
However... it wasn’t over yet. Wang Baole was so fast that he threw out a sixth punch, a seventh punch, and an eighth punch!
They were... The Purple Devouring Dao, the Black Death Dao, and the final White Light Dao!
The moment these three laws appeared, the devouring seed in Wang Baole’s body was drawn in. His fist seemed to have turned into a black hole that could devour everything, exuding an extremely terrifying pressure, the aura of death and the Endless Sea of light intersected together, exploding in all directions as if it had been purified.
A loud boom rang out once again. The remaining net of threads collapsed, turning into ashes and disappearing without a trace. Xie yunteng spat out three mouthfuls of blood. His hair was disheveled, and the shadow of the ancient star behind him.., unable to withstand the force, cracks began to appear on its surface. Eventually, it could no longer withstand the force and dissipated.
Wang Baole didn’t continue attacking. He stared coldly at Xie Yunteng, who was retreating, and shook his head. He hadn’t even activated the augmentation from his dao star, nor had he activated the law of fire, he hadn’t used his other trump cards, such as the star sealing art and the flame spirit curse.
Even so, he had completely crushed the so-called prodigy. Wang Baole had lost interest in him. Such a weakling was no longer qualified for him to prove himself.
“Don’t disturb me.”Wang Baole spoke calmly. He turned his gaze away from Xie Yunteng and walked towards the only intact VIP Pavilion in the ruins.
“You!”Xie Yunteng rarely encountered such disregard in his life. His dignity and pride were unbearable, and he let out an angry roar.
His ancient planet might not have completely collapsed, but to him, such heavy injuries had damaged his foundation. As he retreated, the eight stars that he had stopped earlier appeared around him. Their expressions were ice-cold, they instantly raised their right hands and pushed down toward Xie Yunteng.
With that one push, Xie Yunteng’s body recovered visibly. The shadow of the ancient planet behind him also did the same. The foundation that had originally been injured was also rapidly recovering!
“Fifth young master, let’s do it,”said an old man among the eight people coolly.
“There’s no need. All of you, stand down. I can squash a piece of trash to death myself!”Xie Yunteng’s body trembled. Although his expression had recovered, his eyes shone with madness, and wisps of Black Qi emanated from his body, as he roared, he raised his hands and waved them violently. His body rushed out abruptly, charging straight at Wang Baole once more.
“Wang Baole!”As he roared, the black qi emitted from Xie Yunteng’s body became more violent and violent in an instant. It instantly spread out of his body, causing his figure to appear as if he had turned into a ball of fog.
The ball of fog was pitch-black. As it rolled, it expanded rapidly, visible to the naked eye. There was also an increasingly powerful suppressive force. As he neared Wang Baole, and as the area of the ball of fog grew larger and larger, it exploded with a loud bang.
The strength of the Suppressive Force instantly surpassed Xie Yunteng’s previous cultivation fluctuations. It quickly doubled, doubled, and tripled... as he neared, the Suppressive Force continued to increase!
Wang baole, who was about to enter the balcony, suddenly stopped in his tracks. He lost his interest, and as a sense of danger rose rapidly, it gathered together again. He turned around and looked over.
The moment he looked over, Xie Haiyang’s anxious voice suddenly rang out.
“Baole, be careful. This is... The trump card of the Xie family’s direct line of descent, the shadow of the condensed ancestor! It’s ineffective against fellow clansmen, but it can be used to strengthen one’s own body. It can greatly increase one’s combat strength in a short period of time!”
The moment Xie Haiyang spoke, the mist surrounding Xie Yunteng’s body, which was charging towards Wang Baole at high speed, surged like flames and exploded with a loud bang, the mist gathered into the shape of a human figure.
The figure was a thousand feet in size. As soon as it appeared, it shook the entire flying ship and affected the starry sky outside. The starry sky rippled, and the flying ship had no choice but to stop.
As the silhouette of the fog figure took shape, an ancient and ancient aura that seemed to contain an endless sense of time spread out from within the giant fog figure without reservation, it formed a powerful suppressive force that enveloped the surroundings. At the same time, Wang Baole could clearly see the face of the fog figure. It was an elder who exuded power without being angry. His gaze was deep, and it contained an indescribable power, it seemed to be able to affect all nothingness!
“The shadow of the ancestor?”Wang Baole’s pupils constricted slightly. At that moment, a sense of danger surged within his body. At the same time, the aura of the figure in the fog continued to erupt, and a low growl could be heard from within as it charged towards Wang Baole, it came crashing down abruptly.
“Wang Baole, die!”
“As expected of the Xie family... they have such supernatural powers. They allow their descendants to borrow the shadow of the ancestor. Even though they aren’t borrowing the power of the ancestor, they are only borrowing the shadow of the ancestor. However, they can also strengthen their own bodies to an astonishing degree. This so-called shadow of the ancestor should be the ancestor of the Xie family who invested in the never-ending clan and founded the entire clan!”Wang Baole took a deep breath, even though the sense of danger in his body was intense, what was even more intense was the extreme desire to fight. The desire to fight spread throughout his body, making him even more excited. The moment the misty figure approached, Wang Baole let out a long laugh, he suddenly raised his right hand, and his eyes shone brightly!
“If you want me to die, you’ll have to ask my master if he agrees!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1033 - Divine Bull!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1033:, Divine Bull!
As soon as Wang Baole spoke, Xie Yunteng, who had been brimming with energy and had gathered the figure of the Xie family’s patriarch to strengthen his body and greatly increase his combat strength, suddenly froze, and his aura weakened slightly.
It was clear that Wang Baole’s master, the Blazing Flame Patriarch, was too infamous and overprotective. If his disciple was in the wrong, it would be the fault of his disciple’s enemy. If his disciple was in the right, it would be the enemy’s fault. In short... his disciple.., no matter what he did, he was in the right. The one in the wrong would definitely be his disciple’s opponent.
It wasn’t just a rumor. It was the fact that blood had been spilled over and over again. Almost every once in a while, similar stories would be spread. Therefore, even Xie Yunteng, the fifth son of the Xie family’s direct line of descent, couldn’t help but feel his heart tremble.
That was because he knew very well that even the number one dao child in the Xie family’s current generation, let alone himself, wouldn’t be able to take it if he really killed Wang Baole.
As such, how could his aura not be reduced? However, in the next moment, Xie Yunteng’s eyes were filled with ferocity. He knew very well that he could not think too much at the moment. It was impossible for him to kill the other party. Therefore, he had to fight for it, he had to fight for it!
These thoughts might seem like a lot, but in reality, they flashed through his mind in an instant. In the next moment, the aura that he had weakened once again surged and gathered. It erupted once again and roared towards Wang Baole.
However, he was still a little lacking. He was unable to reach his initial peak, and the momentum of his ascent had also stopped. At the same time, Wang Baole, after seeing the starlight in his eyes, raised his right hand and waved it forward, a deep voice came from his mouth.
“Seal, Star, art!”
As the words were said, streaks of black light instantly appeared out of thin air and landed directly in front of Wang Baole. It was tens of thousands of cow lice!
They lined up together and formed the outline of an old bull. They formed a shocking ripple that spread out in all directions. The Suppressive Force erupted, and the force was so strong.., it was still unable to compare to Xie Yunteng’s ancestral shadow mist body, but it was about the same!
Xie Haiyang’s eyes widened. Everyone around him who saw this was the same. Even Xie Yunteng himself felt waves of shock in his heart.
“This is...”
“The Raging Inferno Divine Bull!”
“The Guardian Divine Bull of the Raging Inferno Galaxy!”
Amidst the commotion around him, Wang Baole’s expression remained the same. Although the Divine Bull’s shadow seemed to be weaker than his opponent’s, that was only the beginning of the star sealing art. In the next instant, the bodies of the cows and lice began to twist and distort, meteorites began to materialize in an instant. As they enveloped the outside world and were replaced, the Suppressive Force instantly surpassed what it had been before. It surged violently, causing the starry sky to Rumble, the flying ship to tremble, and all the cultivators in the area.., their hearts were filled with shock and astonishment.
PLease reading on Myb oxn o ve l. com
Even the stellar cultivators were shaken at this moment, and their eyes shone with a bright light. That was because the outline of the Divine Ox was so vast that it had already fused with a special planet, and its cultivation base had reached the great circle of planets, xie Yunteng, who had used the blessing of the ancestral shadow, was now on par with him!
However... his ascent was still not over!
In the blink of an eye, all the meteorites distorted and expanded rapidly. They became clearer and clearer as they became clearer and clearer. One after another, the ordinary stars... replaced the meteorites, and after shrinking countless times.., they appeared in front of Wang Baole!
After replacing the 3,000 meteorites with the 3,000 ordinary stars, the Divine Ox raised its head and roared. Its aura rose once more, directly surpassing Xie Yunteng’s ancestral mist body. In the next instant, after replacing the meteorites with the 6,000 ordinary stars.., the Divine Ox’s aura was enough to shake the heavens and earth, tearing apart the starry sky in all directions. The flying ship continued to tremble.
Xie Yunteng’s expression also changed drastically. The rushing fog once again stopped, not daring to continue moving forward. In the next instant... After all the meteorites had become mortal stars, a divine ox that was enough to shock everyone... ! It had truly descended onto the flying ship!
The Divine Bull’s entire body was engulfed in flames. As it raised its head and roared, its aura reached a shocking level. The expressions of the eight stars behind Xie Yunteng changed completely, and they charged forward, they wanted to rescue him.
However, it was still too late. Wang Baole’s eyes were filled with a fervent desire to fight. The moment the divine bull appeared, he pointed at Xie Yunteng with his right hand.
“Fight!”
The Divine Bull roared and charged forward. It was as if a sea of fire had erupted. It was like a star that could burn everything and shatter everything. It charged towards Xie Yunteng with a roar!
Xie Yunteng’s expression changed drastically. The intense threat of life and death made him lose the desire to fight. The Divine Bull before him gave him the feeling that it wasn’t a spell. It was a true mythical creature, it could destroy the starry sky and tear apart anything that stood in its way.
From a distance, the divine ox was violent, and the shadowy fog was aghast. One charged forward, and the other retreated hesitantly. There was no need to distinguish who was stronger or weaker!
In the next instant, the Divine Ox, which was domineering and crazy, collided with Xie Yunteng’s ancestral mist. The flying boat trembled, and cracks even appeared on it. The starry sky caved in in a large area, violent power spread out in a frenzy, and deafening booms erupted endlessly.
Xie Yunteng’s ancestral mist body couldn’t even last for a breath of time. It instantly collapsed and exploded, revealing Xie Yunteng’s pale-faced body inside. He coughed up a large amount of blood, his eyes were filled with unprecedented fear and panic. In the midst of this panic, it reflected the divine ox that occupied his entire vision!
“No!”
Xie Yunteng let out a shrill cry and wanted to retreat. However, under the impact of the Divine Bull, he seemed to have lost all his strength to resist. He was about to be touched and completely destroyed in body and soul. However, at that moment.., his eight Stellar Dao Protectors had already closed in and appeared directly in front of him. The elder among them had an ugly expression on his face, but there was also a serious look in his eyes. He pressed down on the approaching divine bull!
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He had initially planned to retract his divine ability after seeing how weak Xie Yunteng was. After all, the two of them only disliked each other because of Xie Haiyang. They didn’t have a life-and-death grudge against each other.
However, now that the star had made its move, Wang Baole’s eyes lit up. He didn’t retract his divine ability. Instead, he unleashed the power of his cultivation. The nine ancient stars behind him materialized and formed a dao star, bolstering the divine ox, the image of Dao Stars instantly appeared between the Divine Ox’s brows. Its aura rose once again, and with a loud boom... it collided directly with the old man in the Star!
The moment the two collided, the black-robed old man’s eyes lit up, and the ripples of the star emanated from his body. His entire being seemed to transform into a real star, and with the power of the star.., he forcefully received the Divine Ox’s attack. He roared and grabbed violently, as if he wanted to crush the Divine Ox!
The tens of thousands of ordinary stars that formed the divine ox let out cracking sounds. In the end... They were still inferior to the stars!
Wang Baole was also affected. His face flushed, and he retreated. He raised his right hand, and the Old Ox, which was formed by his supernatural ability, shone. Its entire body instantly turned into pieces, turning into countless threads. These threads.., they were also the power of laws. They were Xie Yunteng’s laws of threads!
This scene was beyond everyone’s expectations. The old man from the star was taken aback as well. He watched as the divine ox that had turned into threads swiftly escaped from his grasp. This made him feel embarrassed. After all, he was a star, and he wasn’t at the initial stage of the star realm, he was at the mid-stage of the star realm.
With such a level of cultivation, he was still able to escape from the illusion created by a planet cultivator. Anger appeared in his eyes. He snorted coldly and raised his right hand. Just as he was about to grab it again, the other stars around him didn’t make a move either, after all, they were all stars. against a planet cultivator, it was fine if it was just one. If there were more of them, they wouldn’t be able to face them. After all... Wang Baole wasn’t someone with no background.
However, in the next instant, the expression on the elder’s face changed drastically. He quickly retracted his right hand. When he looked over, he noticed that his right hand had turned into paper at a speed visible to the naked eye!
Even though he had quickly neutralized the suppression with his powerful cultivation, with this delay, Wang Baole’s Divine Ox, which had turned into a thread, had returned safely and was quickly absorbed into his body!
This scene immediately caused the surrounding onlookers to gasp. Even Xie Haiyang did the same. Without a doubt... Wang Baole’s simple exchange with the stellar elder had resulted in him being able to escape unscathed. This was already unbelievable in itself!
In the never-ending DAO domain, the gap between the cultivation levels of the stars and planets was like a chasm. No one had ever been able to overcome it, because they were on completely different levels!
Even the old man from the stars narrowed his eyes as he stared at Wang Baole. His heart trembled, and he saw the eight figures of the stars walking out from the void behind Wang Baole!
“Old slave Xie, it’s understandable that you saved the fight between the Young Lords, but you still want to destroy my young lord’s Divine Bull. You’ve gone too far. You have to give the raging flame galaxy an explanation!” The elder of the burning spirit civilization said calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1034 - Xie Haiyang’s guess!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1034:, Xie Haiyang’s guess!
The star cultivator from the scorching spirit civilization was also at the mid-stage of the star realm. He was the strongest among the eight stars that had served as Wang Baole’s Dao Protector. He stood beside Wang Baole with the others, he looked coldly at the Dao protector elder from the Xie family.
The more he looked at him, the more displeased he became.
His appearance also caused the dao protector elder from the Xie family to narrow his eyes slightly. The other star Dao protectors beside him also changed their expressions and stepped forward, they looked as if they were facing a great enemy as they stared at Burning Spirit Patriarch and all the stars around him.
After sweeping through them, their eyes filled with a solemn expression.
“The raging flame galaxy sure is generous... to actually use a profound dao star as a dao protector! Could it be that none of you have any grievances?”said the black-robed old man slowly.
“Grievances? “Being able to protect the young master’s Dao is a supreme honor. On one hand, we can protect the young master’s safety, and on the other hand, we can repay your kindness. How could you, Huang Dao and Mortal Dao Stars, experience it! ?”Burning Spirit Patriarch laughed heartily, the other stars around them also began to laugh.
This scene immediately caused the dao protectors of the Xie family to have unsightly expressions on their faces. As stellar cultivators, they naturally knew that stars were divided into five levels. Similar to the immortals and mortals of planets, stars were divided into heaven, earth, profound, and Huang fan!
Different levels, within the same cultivation realm, were vastly different in strength.
Generally speaking, the status of Dao Protector could only be taken up by those who were trusted. However, to a certain extent, it was like being a guard. Stellar cultivators had their own pride, and even large clans and powerful organizations could not easily humiliate them, to make them act as dao protectors for juniors, one had to treat them with respect.
Even so, most people at the level of Profound Dao and above would not choose to become dao protectors. Even if they were at a lower level of the Yellow Dao star, there would be very few Dao protectors. They were usually Mortal Dao stars, due to their extreme talent and opportunities, it was difficult for them to advance. That was why they chose to become Dao Protectors. They would use their loyalty and meritorious service to exchange for the opportunities offered by the exalted.
For example, the dao protectors around Xie Yunteng, other than the black-robed elder who was at the Huang Dao realm, were all at the Mortal Dao realm. On the other hand, on Wang Baole’s side, other than the scorching spirit patriarch, they were all at the Huang Dao realm. As for the scorching spirit patriarch himself.., he was on a higher level, a planet of the Mystic Dao!
That was why the moment they appeared, the black-robed Elder’s expression changed. He was secretly shocked. He thought of the rumors about the blazing flame patriarch in the outside world, describing him as a protector of his own.
With a dark expression, the black-robed elder flung his sleeves and shouted in a low voice.
“Let’s Go!”
As he spoke, he retreated. Xie Yunteng’s expression was a little strange. He seemed to be in a trance, allowing the Dao Protector beside him to guide him. As he retreated and was about to leave, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and spoke calmly.
PLease reading on Myb oxn o ve l. com
“What’s your explanation?”
As soon as he spoke, the scorching spirit patriarch seemed to have a backbone. He laughed loudly, and his cultivation erupted instantly. He and the Stellar Dao protectors from the other raging flame galaxies dispersed in an instant, blocking Xie Yunteng and his group.
“This is the Xie family’s galactic marketplace!”The black-robed elder saw this and roared.
“So What? We’re from the Raging Flame Galaxy!”The reply was the scorching spirit patriarch’s arrogant voice. His confident tone caused the black-robed elder to pause in his speech.
“You...”
All the onlookers had different expressions on their faces as they waited for the situation to develop.
“What do you mean by you? Why did you participate in the fight between the Young Lords? You even wanted to destroy my young lord’s divine ability with evil intentions. This is a great disrespect to the exalted lord of Raging Flame. If I don’t Give You an explanation today, I can only capture you and send you to the Raging Flame Galaxy to make amends!”The Burning Spirit Patriarch said slowly, he spoke slowly.
Such dominance made the black-robed elder’s breathing quicken. However, when he thought about how powerful the other party was and his background, he could only endure it. He turned to look at his young lord and realized that Xie Yunteng was still in a daze. He couldn’t help but sigh.
“What explanation do you want?”
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and sent a voice transmission to the fire spirit patriarch. The Fire Spirit Patriarch raised his eyebrows and laughed. Then, he looked at the black-robed elder and sent a voice transmission.
“Young Lord, Be Merciful. You can just pay the bill that Little Lord Xie has signed during this period of time.”
Xie Haiyang blinked and quickly took out a jade slip. He branded a few more strokes on it and immediately threw it out. The jade slip turned into a rainbow and was caught by the black-robed elder. He scanned it with his supernatural awareness, and his expression changed instantly.
“A hundred spirit stars? That’s impossible. There aren’t a hundred spirit stars on this flying ship. You...”
“That’s possible, but I have a question that I need an answer to!”Xie Yunteng, who was standing beside the black-robed elder, had finally recovered from his daze. He spoke with a dark expression on his face. He didn’t look at the jade slip in the black-robed elder’s hand, instead, he looked at Wang Baole.
“What you used just now was the rule of threads?”
“What do you think?”Wang Baole smiled faintly. He didn’t admit or deny it. He couldn’t keep the secret of the Dao Stars’laws a secret for too long. After all, during the battle with the Purple Gold civilization back in the divine eye civilization.., he had already used the rules of paper. If someone investigated carefully, they would be able to find out the crux of the matter.
If he hadn’t activated the rules of silk and allowed the divine bull to turn into threads and disperse, he would have suffered a great loss. Therefore, the moment he attacked, Wang Baole no longer cared if he was exposed.
Xie Yunteng heard his answer and had his answer. His eyes were filled with fear. He was silent for a moment, then gave Wang Baole a deep look before turning around and leaving with his men.
Xie Haiyang’s expression didn’t change much. He had been shocked when Wang Baole had activated the silk law just now. He had forcefully suppressed the waves of emotions that had stirred up in his heart, however, with an answer in his heart, he felt that his decision to enter the raging flame galaxy and become closer to Wang Baole had been the right one.
Replicating laws, huh... Such heaven-defying and shocking laws... Wang Baole doesn’t even need to reach the celestial domain realm. As long as he reaches the star realm, it will be difficult for him to stop his rise
He has the protection of the raging flame grandmaster and a close relationship with Chen Qingzi. Even the never-ending clan will have to think twice before attacking him! Xie Haiyang took a deep breath and quickly stood up from the balcony, he bowed respectfully to Wang Baole.
“Thank you, sixteenth uncle-master!”
“Since we are from the same sect, there’s no need to be so courteous.”Wang Baole was in a good mood. He had roughly estimated his combat strength during the battle, and he had also engraved a very special rule. He felt refreshed, so he said with a smile.
The rest of the Xie family members on the flying ship reacted quickly as well. Not long after Xie Yunteng had left, a few stellar cultivators from the Xie family, including Yao Lao, personally came to pay him a visit.
They spoke very politely to Wang Baole. At the same time, they informed Xie Haiyang that the family had clarified their misunderstanding of him and branded his name into the clan artifact. The protection of his bloodline had returned to normal.
Xie Haiyang was deeply moved by this scene. However, he wasn’t surprised at all. The battle between Wang Baole and Xie Yunteng had shown the Xie family enough value. Based on his understanding of the family, for a prodigy like Wang Baole.., the family clan had always focused their attention and investments on Wang Baole.
His relationship with Wang Baole meant that this time, he was destined to rise even higher. It was the bond between the family clan and Wang Baole, and it was extremely beneficial to him, it could even affect his share and status in the direct line of descent of the family clan.
These matters made Xie Haiyang even more determined. He was prepared to be completely tied to Wang Baole. This was because this series of events had already caused him to rise and fall together with Wang Baole.
Even though this wasn’t in line with the concept of investing, Xie Haiyang couldn’t care less at this moment.
I wonder if his previous actions were intentional, or... was it just a simple accident? Xie Haiyang lowered his head and quickly glanced at Wang baole, who was chatting and laughing with the elders of the Xie family on the flying ship, an unfathomable feeling rose in his heart.
Wang Baole noticed Xie Haiyang’s gaze and continued chatting and laughing with the elders of the Xie family as usual. However, there was a deeper look in his eyes that others couldn’t see through..
After a long while, the Xie family members left. Before they left, they informed Wang baole that Xie Yunteng had paid off all of Xie Haiyang’s previous contracts, including the One Hundred Spirit Stars!
However, the value of the spirit stars was too high, and the number wasn’t small either. There weren’t that many spirit stars on the flying ship, but arrangements had been made to send them to him as soon as possible.
Wang Baole was quite satisfied with this. He gave Xie Haiyang an appreciative look, and Xie Haiyang quickly suppressed the guesses in his heart. He chuckled. This wasn’t the first time he had cooperated with Wang Baole. When the scorching spirit grand ancestor had spoken.., he immediately understood what he should do.
At the same time, he knew very well that guesses were no longer important. The truth didn’t matter. If Wang Baole hadn’t done it intentionally, it meant that his luck was heaven-defying. If he had done it intentionally.., it meant that his scheming had reached a terrifying level. He was convinced by either of these two points.

chapters.title: Chapter 1035 - the Fated Star!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1035:, the Fated Star!
In the Xie family’s interstellar cruiser, Wang Baole’s group received an endless stream of visitors in the days that followed. be it the deacons of the Xie family or the cultivators on the cruiser who were heading to the fated star to pay their respects to the Heavenly Dharma Lord.., they were all very enthusiastic about Wang Baole.
This was related to Wang Baole’s background, but it also had a lot to do with the strength he had displayed. After all, the might of the Divine Bull had shaken the world that day. The law of silk threads, as well as the paper-based divine ability from before.., as well as the numerous ancient stars’laws that Wang Baole had used when he had attacked, any one of them could have shaken the hearts of people.
All of them converged on one person, and that person would become a hot topic. He would be stared at by countless gazes, not to mention that his dao protector was also extraordinary. This also showed how much the blazing flame ancestor cared and valued this disciple.
At the same time... Although most of them only saw how powerful and domineering Wang Baole was, there were still some people who were quick-witted and quick-witted. They could vaguely sense something else from this incident. Even though they weren’t as involved as Xie Haiyang.., they could see it more clearly, but they could more or less sense the depth of Wang Baole’s thoughts.
While there were many people on Wang Baole’s side, Xie Yunteng, who was on the flying ship, returned home empty-handed. Even though he wasn’t completely ignored, there were still very few people who came. Half a month later.., the Xie family’s flying ship sped forward and arrived near the fated star. Xie Yunteng and his group didn’t wait for the flying ship to stabilize before they flew out. They left without looking back, entering the fated star ahead of time.
They’re moving fast! On the flying ship, in the residence that the Xie family had rearranged for Wang Baole, Wang Baole and Xie Haiyang stood on a balcony that was several times larger than before. The new residence was located at the top of the entire flying ship, standing there, one could see more than half of the flying ship with their head lowered. When they looked up, they could see the endless starry sky.
The departing figures of Xie Yunteng and his group could be clearly seen from where Wang Baole and Xie Haiyang were standing. Xie Haiyang stared at Xie Yunteng’s figure and sneered.
“Uncle-master, I’ve received news from my clan. My father offended senior Chen Qingzi, so most of the clan had nothing to do with him. Someone even added insult to injury and took advantage of the patriarch’s seclusion to seal my father’s location, preventing him from leaving. This is to be handed over to senior Chen Qingzi to deal with later..
“As for me, it’s also because of this that the clan’s current elder council has removed the protection of my bloodline. At the same time, I’m no longer among the Young Lords. Although I’ve recovered due to uncle-master’s intervention, but...”Xie Haiyang said, before he could finish his sentence, an ethereal bell chime rang out from the starry sky ahead!
It sounded like a bell, but also like a copper bell. It was crisp and long, and it turned into sound waves. When one looked at the starry sky, it was as if it had turned into a surface of water, with layers upon layers of ripples that were endless.
Hearing that, Wang Baole raised his right hand and interrupted Xie Haiyang’s words.
Xie Haiyang’s voice paused, and he didn’t continue speaking. Wang baole, on the other hand, looked at the starry sky that was as clear as the surface of water. Where Xie Yunteng and the others had gone... was a very strange planet.
It was strange because layers of star rings that were emitting a purple glow surrounded the planet. The layers of star rings surrounded the planet, and the bottom layer was the largest. The higher the layer, the smaller the star ring. If one looked closely.., the shape of the star ring was like a giant bell!
The real planet was the billiard ball inside the bell!
The ball moved within the bell at a certain frequency. It would occasionally touch the inner wall of the bell, producing crisp sounds that reverberated throughout the starry sky. Those who heard the sound were all focused in that instant, silence fell.
PLease reading on Myb oxn o ve l. com
“The fated star,”Wang Baole murmured with a strange look in his eyes. As the sound of the bell faded, the people on the flying ship recovered. Soon, voices of discussion could be heard.
“It’s the fated Star!”
“We’ve finally arrived!”
“The galaxy where Exalted Heavenly Dharma is located is indeed extremely magical!”
While the people on the flying ship were excited, Xie Haiyang’s heart calmed down as the bell rang. Even though he knew many secrets that Wang Baole didn’t know, it was still his first time on the fated star, as he looked at the bell-like star ring, anticipation slowly appeared in his eyes.
“Haiyang, your family wanted to hand over your father’s seal to Chen Qingzi to handle. This didn’t happen before, but now, they’re making a move... it seems like Chen Qingzi is about to break free,”Wang Baole said with a smile. He was filled with anticipation, he hadn’t seen his senior brother for a long time, and he missed him.
However, Xie Haiyang was by his side, so his anticipation wasn’t too obvious. He didn’t mention the word senior brother in his address, which caused people to speculate.
“Sixteenth uncle-master, please help me!”That was what Xie Haiyang had been waiting for. He quickly averted his gaze from the fated star. When he looked at Wang Baole, he was about to bow sincerely.
.
“Why are you doing this again?”Wang Baole didn’t accept Xie Haiyang’s bow. He raised Xie Haiyang’s arm in advance.
“I’ve already said that I’ll help you with this matter. How about this? Tell your father that if Ruochen Qingzi goes, he can help me pass on a message to Chen Qingzi.”
“What message?”Xie Haiyang asked hurriedly.
“Just say...”Wang Baole blinked. After some thought, he felt that this was a very suitable opportunity to scare Xie Haiyang and make him more loyal to him from now on.
“Just say that I prepared a pot of good wine and asked him to come over to taste it quickly. If I’m late, I’ll drink it myself,”Wang Baole said calmly with his hands behind his back and a casual look on his face.
When Xie Haiyang heard those words, his heart jolted once again. From his tone, he could sense that Wang Baole’s relationship with Chen Qingzi must have reached a certain level, at the same time, the unfathomable feeling that came from Wang Baole once again surfaced in his mind. After cupping his fists to express his gratitude, he quickly took out the jade slip and sent a voice transmission to his family clan. He asked those who were on good terms with the family clan to pass on the message to his father.
After the voice transmission ended, Xie Haiyang looked at Wang Baole. He didn’t know what was going through his mind, but he suddenly spoke out of the blue.
“Sixteenth uncle-master, I have a younger sister. Her name is Xie Taotao. She is a beauty of the nation, and her beauty burns brightly...”
Wang baole blinked. He was about to listen carefully when he heard a cold snort from Little Missy in his mind. When he heard the snort, Wang Baole instantly frowned and looked at Xie Haiyang with displeasure.
“Haiyang, I, Wang Baole, am not the kind of person you think I am. Don’t mention such things in the future. It will make me look down on you!”
Xie Haiyang’s heart skipped a beat. Seeing that Wang Baole’s displeasure didn’t seem fake, he suddenly realized that his previous judgment had been wrong. The Wang Baole before him was definitely not the kind of person he thought he was. He took a deep breath, he bowed once again. He had already made up his mind that he would never mention such things in the future.
At that moment, Wang Baole coughed. As the flying ship neared the fated star and finally stopped outside, his body swayed and he flew out first.
Xie Haiyang followed closely behind, as did the scorching spirit grandmaster and the others. They turned into streaks of light and left the flying ship, heading straight for... The Fated Star!
As they got closer and closer, the celestial ring in their eyes grew larger and larger in their eyes. They were about to step into the celestial ring. However, at that moment, perhaps it was a coincidence, or perhaps they had been prepared.., all in all... at that moment, the starry sky in the distance suddenly distorted. A gigantic peacock shot out from the void of the starry sky!
The peacock was thousands of feet in size. Its aura was like a rainbow, and its entire body was emerald green. As it flapped its wings, countless strands of feathers fluttered behind it. These strands of feathers were of various colors, and they reflected the starry sky in all directions. They were all very bright.
The instant it appeared, an astonishing chill spread out in all directions. Wang Baole and the others were standing on the path that the peacock had to pass through. They were instantly enveloped by the chill, as if they were about to be frozen.
The eyes of the scorching spirit grand ancestor and the others lit up. They spread out their cultivation. The power of the stars spread out, guarding Wang Baole’s left and right. Wang Baole narrowed his eyes, not paying attention to the chill around him, he didn’t pay too much attention to the approaching peacock. Instead, his gaze landed on the figure of a woman sitting cross-legged on top of the peacock’s head.
The woman was dressed in a red robe and wore a phoenix crown. There was a diamond-shaped cinnabar seal between her brows. She was extremely beautiful, and her necklace, earrings, and wrists were all adorned with bells. One look and one could tell that she was extraordinary!
To a certain extent, she seemed to resonate with the fated star!
The moment Wang Baole looked over, the woman opened her eyes. When she looked at Wang baole, a murderous look flashed across her eyes. Behind her, a paper star appeared as if it was being pulled by a Qi dynamic!
It was the Holy Maiden of the nine Phoenix sect, who was ranked third in the collateral Saint Realm, and the winner of the other Dao star in the land of the fallen stars, the bell lady... Xu Yinling!
“Brother Baole, long time no see.”Xu Yinling suddenly smiled when she saw Wang Baole. She was like a hundred flowers in full bloom, and her voice was beautiful and beautiful. It was very pleasant to the ears. It complemented her expression, instantly causing her entire body to exude a boundless charm.
“Little Missy, someone is seducing me!”Wang baole blinked and quickly complained to the masked little Missy in his heart.
“B * Tch!”What responded to him was little Missy’s seemingly calm snort in his mind.
—

chapters.title: Chapter 1036 - was directed at Xu Yinling!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1036: was directed at Xu Yinling!
The moment Xu Yinling appeared, seven or eight divine senses appeared from the heavenly fated star below. They had clearly sensed xu Yinling and wanted to welcome her.
These seven or eight divine senses might only be planets, but they were extraordinary. They were sharp and powerful, and their auras were even more domineering. They were like long rainbows as they approached rapidly.
Seeing this, Wang Baole had a rough idea of what was going on. He knew that Xu Yinling’s appearance wasn’t a coincidence. She had known that he would come, and that was why she had been waiting for him here, her goal was clearly to use her intimacy with him to cause misunderstandings among some people.
She had created an enemy out of thin air for him, and the other party could find an opportunity to accomplish her goal.
After all, the two of them didn’t have much enmity with each other in the fallen star lands. However, the connection between the Dao stars and the law of engraving made Xu Yinling’s desire to kill him grow stronger.
Furthermore, Wang Baole had already identified the familiar source of Xu Yinling’s divine ability. Therefore, it was highly possible that there was a factor that made her the daughter of the stars.
However, Wang Baole didn’t care about that. Instead, as his eyes sparkled, a smile appeared on his lips.
I wonder if being able to suppress a generation will make my star sealing art even more domineering
As this thought surfaced in his mind, Wang Baole also heard little Missy Snort coldly and address her as a slut. He felt very comfortable. He felt that little Missy’s mood had been a little off recently. Considering how they had been friends for so many years.., there was also his father-in-law, whom he had acknowledged as his father-in-law. That was why he had looked for opportunities to make little Missy happy.
However, even though there were many such opportunities, and Wang Baole was also very good at coaxing people, he had used little missy too many times before. He was worried that he would be able to resist her, so this time, he did the opposite, using XU Yinling as little Missy’s outlet to vent her emotions seemed to have some effect now.
That was also why he didn’t eat Xu Yinling’s malicious sugar-coated cannonball as usual. After all, he was used to eating sugar-coated cannonballs and throwing them back.
After coughing, Wang Baole looked at the smiling Xu Yinling and shook his head slightly. Just as he was about to speak, Xu Yinling covered her mouth with a smile and spoke in advance.
“Brother Baole, I know what you want to say. Previously, you suggested that the sound spirit become your dao companion in the fallen star. The sound spirit has already considered it. We can try to interact with it first. What do you think?”
As soon as he said that, Wang Baole immediately felt the seven or eight divine senses that were rushing over from the heavenly fated star. They instantly fluctuated in varying degrees, but he still shook his head.
“I’m sorry, that’s not what I wanted to say. What I wanted to say was that... you were a step too late. There was an older sister who I respected the most in my life, who made me feel ashamed of my inferiority. She was filled with love, but I didn’t dare say it out loud. She reminded me that you’re a SL * T!”
PLease reading on Myb oxn o ve l. com
Xu Yinling’s eyes flashed when she heard that. However, she instantly bit her lower lip and sighed softly.
“Baole, even if we’re not fated, we can only blame fate for playing tricks on us. Why do you have to humiliate me?”As she said that, Xu Yinling lowered her head. She seemed to be disappointed as she flew past Wang Baole on the gigantic peacock.
Wang Baole’s pupils constricted slightly when he heard that. He realized that Xu Yinling was even more scheming than she had been in the fallen star lands. He had thought that she had deliberately flirted with him, causing her pursuers to harbor ill intentions toward him.
That was why she had deliberately said those words, cutting off any thoughts of using him. However, Xu Yinling’s reaction had been extremely quick. She had immediately put on a look as if she had been humiliated. As a result.., she could still deliberately give her suitors a reason to cause trouble for her.
“You’re so annoying!”Wang Baole raised his eyebrows. He couldn’t be bothered to pretend to be polite, and a look of disgust appeared on his face.
“I don’t like you. I hope you won’t Pester me anymore. Xu Yinling, please have some self-respect!”
“You...”Xu Yinling, who was sitting on the peacock, paused when she heard that. She turned to look at Wang Baole.
As she looked over, a loud boom came from the direction of the fated star. Soon, the seven or eight divine senses arrived and formed seven or eight figures around them. Each of them was in high spirits, and every one of them had an imposing aura, regardless of whether it was their clothes or their aura, they all gave off the aura of a chosen one.
.
One of them had long golden hair and wore a long golden robe. He looked radiant, as if he was the son of the Sun. As he stood there, the temperature around him increased significantly, as if he was born from flames, his gaze was burning as he looked at Xu Yinling, a bright smile on his face.
“Junior sister Yinling, I’ve been waiting for you for many days. I’ve finally welcomed you.”
“Yinling greets senior brother Sun Yang. Thank you for coming to pick me up. Let’s... Go.”
Xu Yinling looked weak and absent-minded as she lowered her head and spoke softly.
Her expression was very pitiful, and it caught the attention of the people around her. A few of the seven or eight people had a fiery look in their eyes. Sun Yang was the same. He looked at Xu Yinling, then at Wang Baole. When they had arrived earlier.., he had already heard the conversation between the two of them. A glint flashed across his eyes, and his expression slowly turned cold as he spoke calmly.
“Wang Baole, right? A beautiful woman falls in love with you. It’s fine if you don’t cherish her, but it’s your fault for speaking so viciously. We are here today, regardless of background or reason. Fellow Daoists and I want you... to apologize to junior sister Yinling!”
As soon as he said those words, a fierce aura erupted from his body. It locked onto Wang Baole, and the people who had arrived with him did the same. They all spread out their cultivation, they gathered around Wang Baole.
The eruption of power attracted the attention of even more people who had arrived on the fated star to pay their respects. They all spread out their divine senses to observe the area.
Wang Baole’s eyes slowly narrowed. He looked at Xu Yinling, who had a delicate figure that made others feel pity for her. He then looked at Sun Yang, who seemed to be filled with righteous indignation and had assumed the stance of standing up for a beautiful woman. A smile appeared on his lips. He had now understood, it wasn’t that these elites were stupid and couldn’t see things clearly, which led to them being used by Xu Yinling. It was that... they had seen everything clearly. However, because of their master, the blazing flame ancestor, who stood behind them..
While they were concerned about their own dao planet, they were also afraid of their master. Therefore, they blamed all their conflicts and attacks on jealousy. This made it difficult for the older generation to interfere, so they took action on their behalf, they found an opportunity.
Thus, these people hit it off and were willing to do so.
After all, they needed a reason to deal with the current Wang Baole, a reason that wouldn’t allow the older generation to protect their own interests.
“You think you’re so smart. With master’s personality and the situation on the blazing flame main planet, there’s no need for a reason to protect your own interests.”Wang baole laughed coldly, but there was a glint in his eyes. The other party’s method seemed ingenious.., but in reality, it had also restricted their seniors.
This trip to the fated star is going to be interesting. Wang baole muttered to himself, and his smile grew brighter. He ignored Xu Yinling and Sun Yang. He only focused on the cultivation beside him, xie Haiyang, who was prepared to make a move, spoke calmly.
“Let’s go.”As he spoke, Wang Baole ignored everyone and flew towards the fated star. However, the moment he flew out, a cold glint flashed in Sun Yang’s eyes. He moved and blocked Wang Baole’s path, the elites who had come with him also approached and blocked Wang Baole’s path.
At the same time, from the fated star, streams of divine senses belonging to their dao protectors spread out and locked onto the spot.
“Senior Dao Protector, please do not participate. This is between us!”Sun Yang said flatly. Their dao protectors immediately changed their divine senses and placed them on the scorching spirit patriarch and the others behind Wang Baole.
With the advantage of numbers, the scorching spirit patriarch and the others’faces darkened. At the same time, Sun Yang, who had blocked Wang Baole’s path, stared at Wang Baole and spoke slowly.
“Apologize to junior sister Yinling!”
Almost at the same time as he spoke, the other prodigies around him also spoke.
“Apologize!”
Their voices formed a shocking force that pressed down on Wang Baole. At the same time, the flying ships from the other family clans that had just arrived from afar also approached and watched the scene.
Even more divine senses spread out from the fated star and locked onto the spot. Under the watchful eyes of the crowd, Sun Yang was certain that Wang Baole would definitely have a conflict with him because of his pride.
After all, if it were him, he would have done the same. To elites like them, their pride was extremely important!
However, he still didn’t know Wang Baole very well..

chapters.title: Chapter 1037 - Elimination and destruction!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1037: Elimination and destruction!
“Everyone welcomes me so much.”Wang Baole looked at Sun Yang in front of him, then at the observing flying ships around him. He felt the attention from the many divine senses on the heavenly fated star, and his face turned slightly red, he revealed a hint of shyness as he looked at Xu Yinling quickly.
Xu Yinling was initially very pleased with her actions. She knew that she had to give the other people who were greedy for Wang Baole’s Dao planet a reason.
As for herself, even though she was also a dao star, she still had the risk of being coveted by others. This was also one of the reasons why she had been targeting Wang Baole during this period of time. Through repeated opportunities.., she kept sending out a signal that her dao star was completely restrained by Wang Baole.
Her Dao Star wasn’t the best, and the best was with Wang Baole. Therefore, even if she managed to obtain her own dao star, she would still have to face Wang Baole’s suppression. Instead of that, she might as well target Wang Baole.
It was indeed effective. It made her focus less on Wang Baole, and it was considered a successful diversion. Now that Wang Baole was about to become the target of public criticism, regardless of whether Wang Baole managed to escape or not.., her goal of attracting the attention of the public was completely achieved. However, when she saw Wang Baole’s shy gaze, Xu Yinling suddenly felt that something was amiss.
Before she could say anything to remedy the situation, Wang Baole had already let out a long sigh.
“Forget it, forget it. Since everyone thinks so highly of me and Yinling, then...”Wang Baole coughed loudly and cupped his fists towards the various family flying ships that had arrived. Then, he cupped his fists towards the fated star.
“Fellow Daoists from the various family clans, seniors from the fated star, Please Bear Witness for me today. Yinling and I have been attracted to each other for a long time due to the attraction of the Dao Planet...”
Xu Yinling’s expression changed as soon as she heard Wang Baole’s words. Sun Yang was taken aback as well. The expressions of the other prodigies changed as well. Wang Baole’s voice continued to echo in the air.
“I rejected Yin Ling because I consider myself a prodigal. I couldn’t bear to let her heart go to waste and suffer the pain of unrequited love. However, from the looks of it now, I have neglected the persistence of cultivators of my generation. I apologize to Yin Ling today. Yin Ling, I shouldn’t have rejected your love for me. I agree!”Wang baole said sincerely, it was as if the prodigal son had returned, but his words completely changed Xu Yinling’s expression. If Wang Baole had said that when no one had paid attention to him, it would have been in line with her plan.
It would have caused others to suspect him, giving him a reason to be jealous. However, the situation was different now. She had a premonition that Wang Baole was going to say more than that.
That was indeed the case. As Wang Baole said that, his tone changed rapidly, revealing a hint of dominance.
“Yinling, from now on, anyone who dares to have designs on the Dao Star in your body must first ask me if I agree. If I don’t agree, the heavenly king must not touch my Yinling Dao star at all!”
“Unless I agree... cough cough, Xiaoling, come, let brother Baole hug you. Let’s see if you’ve gained any weight during this period of time.”As he said that, Wang Baole’s face was filled with emotion as he walked towards Xu Yinling.
Xu Yinling’s expression instantly turned ugly, and she instinctively retreated towards Sun Yang.
PLease reading on Myb oxn o ve l. com
This scene also caused the expressions of the people around them to become strange. Xie Haiyang was the only one who was not surprised. He knew Wang Baole too well, and he thought to himself, Sun Yang, Oh Sun Yang, your mistake is in the thickness of one’s skin.., the estimation failed.
Sun Yang’s expression was dark, and he frowned. It was obvious that he had not expected that there would be someone in this world who was a prodigy and had such a great reputation. He was so thick-skinned that he could ignore the issue of his face, and in front of everyone.., he had obviously been forced by him, but he had still chosen to apologize. His punch seemed to have missed.
It would have been fine if that had been all that had happened. However, the other party’s apology had contained an air of dominance. He should have been the one being forced. He should have apologized as well, but he felt that he was the one suffering.
Seeing Xu Yinling’s expression change and retreat, Wang Baole pointed at Xu Yinling with a smile.
“You Lass, why are you still shy?”
As he spoke, Wang Baole looked at Sun Yang, who had an ugly expression on his face. He cupped his fists and bowed sincerely.
“Fellow Daoist Sun, thank you so much. It was you who let me know that I can not let down this beauty. I’ve decided that from now on, the child that I will have with little lingling will be called Wang Xieyang! This is to commemorate our gratitude for you! “But now, please step aside. I want to bring my wife to the fated star.”
“Wang Baole, you...”Sun Yang’s expression turned even uglier. He was about to speak, but Wang Baole interrupted him.
“Fellow Daoist Sun, we are grateful for your matchmaking. Therefore, I respect you. I’ll say it again. Please step aside. I want to bring my wife to the fated Star!”Wang Baole was still smiling as he looked at Sun Yang.
As soon as he said that, the onlookers and the many divine senses on the fated star gathered once again. Some people who had good intentions towards the Raging Flame Galaxy praised him in their hearts.
Wang Baole’s actions seemed simple, but they had reversed the situation. He had changed from being forced by others to being forced by them. He had changed everything from being forced by them to being forced by them. He had resolved everything with a simple gesture.
Such a method was easy and casual. It was a stark contrast to what Sun Yang had done.
“You...”Sun Yang was caught between a rock and a hard place. He wasn’t as thick-skinned as Wang Baole. With so many people watching, if he retreated, it would mean that he had failed in his original scheme. He would have lost all face, but if he didn’t retreat.., there would definitely be an argument.
His initial goal was to cause an argument, and it could be attributed to jealousy. It could be achieved to a certain extent, but the situation had completely changed.
This wasn’t just jealousy. It had become a situation where he had agreed to help Wang Baole set him up, and after Wang Baole had agreed, he had come back to interfere. He couldn’t afford to lose face in such a situation, and the logic behind it was too unstable.
He wasn’t the only one who felt this way. Xu Yinling, who was standing behind him, was filled with anger and panic. In reality, her fear of Wang Baole was far greater than that of others. In her heart, Wang Baole had already become a shadow, that was especially so when Wang Baole had said that if someone wanted to take her dao star, they would have to ask Wang Baole for his consent. That had made Xu Yinling even more flustered.
If she were to speak now and renege on her words, Wang Baole would be completely free from all of her previous arrangements, and he wouldn’t have any reason to attack her. After all, the blazing flame ancestor was there, and few would dare provoke him directly.
However, if she didn’t speak, the situation would be very disadvantageous for her. Just as she and Sun Yang were in a dilemma, Wang Baole’s smile slowly disappeared, and his expression gradually turned cold. He didn’t look at Sun Yang and walked towards Xu Yinling.
Sun Yang instinctively raised his hand to block Wang Baole’s approach. However, the moment he raised his hand, a cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes. He formed a seal with his right hand and threw a punch.
The punch landed in front of Sun Yang and immediately formed a storm that spread out. Sun Yang retreated instantly. His companions, the prodigies, also erupted with their cultivation and surrounded Wang Baole.
“Fellow Daoist Sun, you were the one who brought us together just a moment ago, and now, you’re stepping in. Are you looking down on the Raging Flame Galaxy and me, Wang Baole? Is that why you want to humiliate us like this? I can let you off the hook for bringing us together, but I want an apology! Wang Baole licked his lips, he laughed coldly. With a sway of his body, the power of his flames erupted and charged toward Sun Yang and the others. At the same time, a cold voice reverberated in all directions.
“Senior fiery spirit, seal off the area. How dare you humiliate the Raging Flame Galaxy and steal my master’s Disciple’s daughter-in-law. This matter is no longer my personal matter. If you don’t apologize sincerely, this matter will cause a stir in the heavens. I will also protect the dignity of the raging flame galaxy!”
“Your Majesty!”The eight members of the fiery spirit grand ancestor also assumed an angry stance. With a roar, they dispersed in an instant. Their cultivation in the stars spread out, sealing off the area. Sun Yang and his companions, the dao protectors, were rapidly approaching, however, it would be difficult for them to break through within a short period of time.
As for the sealed off area, Wang Baole’s aura was already overwhelming. He closed in instantly. It seemed like he was going to kill Sun Yang, who had a look of desperation in his eyes. However, in reality, the moment he closed in, his body suddenly disappeared, when he reappeared, he was already behind one of Sun Yang’s companions.
“Apologize!”Wang Baole’s eyes shone with killing intent as he punched out.
It was a long-faced youth. His clothes were luxurious, and his cultivation was at the late-stage planet cultivation stage. However, under Wang Baole’s punch, no matter how much he resisted, his expression changed drastically. Blood spurted out of his mouth, and his body was like a kite with its string cut, he was instantly sent tumbling backward.

chapters.title: Chapter 1038 - It’s better to have fun together than to have fun alone!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1038: Chapter 1,038. It’s better to have fun together than to have fun alone!
A glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes as he gave chase. Sun Yang and the others’expressions changed, and they wanted to stop him. However, Xie Haiyang’s figure flashed, and he appeared directly in front of Sun Yang. He raised his right hand and pressed across the air.
“Sixteenth uncle-master is making his move. Fellow Daoist Sun, it’s not your turn yet.”
“Xie Haiyang!”Sun Yang glared at him angrily. However, Xie Haiyang responded with a cold glint in his eyes.
While the two of them were confronting each other, Sun Yang and the other dao protectors rushed over as well. They were intercepted by the scorching spirit grand ancestor and the others, causing a commotion in the surroundings as they engaged in battle.
Meanwhile, Wang Baole had caught up to the long-faced young man who had spat out a mouthful of blood. His killing intent erupted, forming a deterrence. When he was about to strike again, the long-faced young man’s heart was filled with resentment and unwillingness.
These two emotions weren’t directed at Wang Baole, but at Sun Yang. He felt wronged. Sun Yang had clearly been the leader, but he had been the one to be beaten up. When he saw Wang Baole’s murderous gaze.., the long-faced youth immediately shouted.
“I apologize!”
“That’s a good boy.”When Wang Baole’s voice rang out, his figure had already disappeared in front of the long-faced youth. When he reappeared, he was beside another prodigy, and he threw a punch.
Blood spurted out of his mouth, and his body was sent flying backward. To them, Wang Baole’s strength was beyond what they could endure. They were all shocked, and they quickly apologized.
Even though they had a lot of face, in the face of Wang Baole’s ferocity, especially since he was not the leader of the group, it was not that they could not accept an apology.
As they spoke one after another, Sun Yang’s expression darkened to the extreme. He circulated his cultivation and shifted his gaze from Xie Haiyang to Wang Baole.
“Wang Baole, this is also good. You and I. . .”
“It’s a little noisy. Little Lingling, don’t you think so?”Wang Baole raised his eyebrows and looked at Xu Yinling, who was retreating after the previous battle.
Xu Yinling stopped in her tracks when she was swept by his gaze. Her face was pale, and she looked at Wang Baole with a complicated look in her eyes.
“I say, Xu Yinling, aren’t you tired of acting like this? Others may not know your background, but I think I do...”Xu Yinling looked so weak, wang Baole smiled coldly. His body swayed, and he once again ignored Sun Yang and charged straight at Xu Yinling. He was so fast that he closed in on her in an instant. Wang Baole didn’t hold back at all. The nine ancient stars behind him transformed into Dao Stars, the nine laws erupted!
They formed a nine-colored sea of light that swept across the huge waves, sweeping straight at Xu Yinling!
Sun Yang had been prepared to fight Wang Baole. Seeing that he had been ignored once again, his body trembled, and his expression turned even uglier. Being ignored was the greatest humiliation he had ever felt.
“Wang Baole!”Sun Yang roared angrily, he was about to rush out, but Xie Haiyang chuckled and stopped him once again. Sun Yang was like a clown, jumping around on his own. As he jumped, Wang Baole made his move, and the nine-colored sea of light erupted, a Phoenix cry shot up into the sky from within the Sea of light.
The Sea of light was visible to the naked eye as it turned into paper. It lost all its supernatural powers and spread outwards, revealing Xu Yinling, who seemed to have merged with the peacock beneath her!
Her face was like a tattoo, with a picture of a peacock on it. The picture clearly covered her entire body. At that moment, Xu Yinling looked extremely demonic. A Dao star had materialized behind her, forming a suppressive force that resisted Wang Baole’s Dao Star!
With a loud boom, the ripples that erupted from the dao stars of the two of them collided with each other. A loud boom rang out, and Xu Yinling spat out a mouthful of blood. She retreated abruptly, a bitter look on her face.
“Wang Baole, I know I was wrong. There’s no need for us to be like this...”
“Still pretending?”Killing intent flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes. He charged forward again, and with the support of the Dao Stars, the nine laws transformed into a large hand that attacked once again.
The loud boom reverberated. Xu Yinling barely managed to dodge it. She spat out a mouthful of blood, and her expression was one of misery.
“I’m not lying to you, Wang Baole. I know that you’ve always wanted to seize my dao star and complete it. You’ll be able to step into the star-grade in an instant, and you’ll become a Rare Heavenly Dao Star. I’m indeed inferior to you, and I can’t defeat you. However, you don’t have to kill me. I have a method that can help you achieve dual cultivation
“I admit that what I’ve done previously was all a ploy against you. However, I did it to protect myself and to have such a method between us, so that I could avoid being killed.”
“To show my true intentions, I’m willing to give up my soul blood. This way, can you trust me for once!”Xu Yinling was filled with bitterness. As the blood spurted out and she retreated, she raised her right hand and drew a line between her brows. Immediately, a drop of seemingly illusory liquid flew out, it was a golden liquid that seemed both real and real. It flew out suddenly and released soul power, charging straight at Wang Baole.
This was soul blood. Once it was controlled by someone, if it was destroyed, it would cause a huge impact on the main body. It was usually between cultivators. Unless it was absolutely necessary, no one was willing to give it away. This was because for the party that controlled the soul blood.., it basically meant that they had complete control over the situation.
The soul blood also contained Xu Yinling’s Dao Star’s fluctuations. It couldn’t be fake, and it also caused the surrounding onlookers to be shocked. Greed rose in their hearts, and although they were hindered by the battle between the stars surrounding the encirclement.., they still slowly approached.
Sun Yang’s eyes were burning with passion. Even though Xu Yinling’s Dao Star wasn’t as good as Wang Baole’s, it was still... A Dao Star!
Even Wang Baole’s expression was solemn. He seemed to be shocked by Xu Yinling’s actions. He hesitated for a moment and didn’t make a move like before. Instead, he raised his right hand and grabbed the soul blood.
Seeing Wang Baole grab the soul blood, Xu Yinling seemed to heave a sigh of relief. A look of survival appeared in her eyes, but the bitterness on her face deepened. She was about to speak.
However, at that moment, Wang Baole suddenly smiled. He tightened his grip on the soul blood with his right hand, and with a loud bang, he crushed the soul blood!
Xu Yinling was clearly taken aback. She let out a shrill scream. Blood spewed out of her mouth as she retreated rapidly. A cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes.
“Xu Yinling, oh Xu Yinling, if you continue to act at this point in time, you might really die in my hands!”As he spoke, Wang Baole sped up. With the enhancement of his dao star, he attacked once again. This time, it was even more incisive, he formed a cloud finger and pressed it towards Xu Yinling!
“Wang Baole!”Seeing this.., xu Yinling’s expression was unsightly, and killing intent erupted from her eyes. The Aura on her body surged in that instant. It didn’t increase by a tiny bit. Instead, it erupted several times, directly surpassing Sun Yang’s aura, it surpassed all the cultivators on the surrounding planets, with the exception of Wang Baole!
To a certain extent, it was on par with Wang Baole. The dao star behind it shone brightly!
“That’s right. This is the bell lady from my memories!”Wang Baole smiled. As they neared, the two of them came into contact with each other, sending out a shocking ripple. What shocked the onlookers the most was that amidst the ripple.., the laws of paper were spreading out!
It wasn’t one, but two!
Wang Baole’s Dao Star spun. Beyond the nine laws, the Dao Star also spread out the laws of paper. As it attacked, all the divine abilities and spells around him and Xu Yinling.., they turned into paper as they approached with the naked eye. They exploded continuously, scattering in all directions, causing more and more pieces of paper to float in the air!
This bizarre scene caused everyone to stare intently at the might of the Dao Star. At the same time, shock filled their hearts. The truth was... Xu Yinling was far, far more powerful than she had been before!
Sun Yang’s eyes went wide, and his heart began to pound. In his memories, Xu Yinling had only recently stepped onto a planet, so she shouldn’t have been so powerful!
However, looking at it now, it was clear that his previous judgment was clearly fake. Even the soul blood just now was clearly fake!
That was indeed the case. Xu Yinling had been concealing her weakness, secretly using her dao seed cultivation technique to improve herself. At the same time, she had led everyone to target Wang Baole, and she had shown her weakness.
However, now, all her preparations had to be exposed. This was also Wang Baole’s goal. It was better to bear the greed and concerns of the outside world together than to bear them alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1039 - Purple Moon’s thread!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1039:, Purple Moon’s thread!
“This Xu Yinling is so well-hidden!”
“HMPH, another scheming B * TCH. He makes people subconsciously think that he’s weak based on his looks. I hate people like him the most!”
“What a good plan. From the looks of it now, all of Xu Yinling’s previous actions were to make Wang Baole stand out and attract the greedy gazes of the dao stars onto Wang Baole while secretly improving himself...”
Under Wang Baole’s pressure, Xu Yinling had no choice but to reveal her cultivation. The onlookers around her immediately understood the cause and effect. They weren’t the only ones. The people on the heavenly fated star who were paying attention to her.., they all understood something.
In reality, Xu Yinling’s plan wasn’t that brilliant, and it wasn’t that no one had seen through it. However, regardless of whether it was to touch Xu Yinling or Wang Baole, they all needed a good reason to do so.
Therefore, those who had seen through it allowed XU Yinling to stir up waves. However, now that she had seen through it, there was no longer a reason to act. Xu Yinling was naturally aware of this. That was why the hatred in her heart grew stronger, amidst the rumbling, the battle with Wang Baole intensified.
As for Sun Yang, his expression kept changing.
Even though he needed a reason to attack Wang Baole, he didn’t care too much about Xu Yinling’s combat strength. Xu Yinling’s attacks were extremely powerful, and Sun Yang felt his face burn, the feeling of being plotted against by others kept stimulating his mind.
Wang Baole is right. He’s a SL * T! Sun Yang gritted his teeth. The booming sounds grew stronger. The dao star ripples formed from Wang Baole and Xu Yinling’s attacks spread out, he had no choice but to retreat.
A loud bang rang out. Xu Yinling spat out blood once again. A large number of divine abilities were turned into confetti that flew in the air. She took a few steps back. Killing intent flashed in her eyes. She raised her right hand and waved it. The sound of a bell rang out, the dao stars behind her grew clearer. The laws erupted once more, forming a large number of ripples. As the ripples spread out, Xu Yinling’s voice rang out.
“Paper life!”
As her voice reverberated, and as the Dao Stars’laws erupted, Xu Yinling’s body began to turn into paper... visible to the naked eye. Her hands were the first to turn into paper, and as she turned into paper.., waves of aura that were stronger than before began to rise from her body.
In an instant, she reached a certain height. Her aura was like a rainbow, shaking everything in its path. Wang baole’s eyes shone brightly. Ever since he had become a planet, he had fought many people, but compared to Xu Yinling.., all his opponents were inferior!
Ultimately, Xu Yinling was the same as Wang Baole. They were both Dao Stars, and the improvement in their cultivation wasn’t slow at all. They were almost in sync with Wang Baole, both at the mid-stage of the planet.
The mid-stage of the planet, enhanced by the Dao stars, could basically crush more than half of the planet’s cultivators. This was especially so now that Xu Yinling had clearly unleashed her secret technique-like trump card. As her aura erupted.., wang Baole’s expression turned solemn. He raised his right hand, and the star sealing art circulated rapidly within his body, causing the divine ox star chart behind him to form an illusory outline.
The Dao Scripture was brewing in his heart. He saw that an even more intense battle was about to begin between the two of them. However, at that moment... a calm voice rang out faintly from the fated star.
“That’s enough. You two juniors, if you want to fight, go outside the fated star system. Don’t come and pay your respects to the exalted.”
As soon as the words left his mouth, it was as if he had spoken a spell. Instantly, the starry sky outside the fated star trembled. An earth-shattering aura descended, forming an impact that landed on the battlefield.
The expressions of all the stars surrounding the Fire Spirit Exalted and the others who were fighting changed. Under the terrifying aura, they had no choice but to retreat. They didn’t dare to fight anymore. Wang baole and Xu Yinling were even more affected. They were suppressed by the aura, the divine ox phantom behind Wang Baole immediately lost its stability. However, the Dao stars formed by the nine ancient stars were eager to give it a try. They seemed to instinctively rise up, unwilling to be suppressed. They wanted to erupt and fight for glory and resist.
However, Wang Baole was the Lord of the Dao Stars, and he had the initiative. With a thought, the dao stars immediately dissipated, and so did the star sealing art. He stood where he was and faced the direction of the heavenly fated star, where the aura and words were coming from, he cupped his fists and bowed.
“I have been rude. Please forgive me, Senior!”With that, Wang Baole lowered his head. However, he glanced at Xu Yinling from the corner of his eyes, revealing a profound look.
