It didn’t seem to stand on its own feet as it shot toward the fingertip that had been slashed down by the resentful weapon, it whistled through the air!
When it came into contact with the finger, there was no rumbling sound. Instead, all of the Black Qi shot through the crack on the fingertip and into the hand. Then, it exploded madly!
The translucent hand instantly began to grow a bit murky, and of course, that wasn’t the end of it. The appearance of the Xin Huo Divine clan caused a roaring sound to fill the air as it suddenly punched out, it was as if it wanted to gather everything it had into the fist. It was filled with doubts about heaven and earth, doubts about the truth of the world, an unspeakable headache, and madness. As the fist descended.., combined with the supernatural power of the illusory figures from the previous few lives, the crack on the fingertip of the hand instantly expanded by several times!
It covered the entire finger and half of the hand!
The moment the crack spread, Wang Baole’s little white deer suddenly charged out. It was filled with a sense of confusion that was formed from its obsession with the heavens and earth, as well as a sense of obsession that was formed from a sense of confusion about the world, the white deer used its obsession to smash through the starry skies in its previous life. It faced the finger, and amidst the deer’s screeching, it smashed..
Head First!
A loud boom immediately erupted within the sea of light, the resentment, the hatred, and the Divine Madness. The white deer’s antlers crumbled instantly, and its body shattered as well, however, the hand... the hand that was filled with cracks seemed to have reached a certain limit, and it began to break into pieces!
Unfortunately... it only broke into pieces, and it didn’t collapse!
The hand split into five fingers and a palm that split into three. It spread in front of Wang Baole amidst the loud boom, but it didn’t disappear. It was as if the centipede had been cut in half and could still struggle, it tried to approach Wang Baole from eight different directions!
A sharp glint appeared in Wang Baole’s eyes. The moment the hand that had turned into eight parts rushed towards him, he closed his eyes. A black wooden board... appeared outside his body in an instant!
As soon as it appeared, it expanded endlessly. In an instant, the black wooden board that could have been held in one hand turned into the size of a person. It was like... a coffin!
It appeared in the void. It was pitch-black in color, and it exuded an ancient aura. Its appearance caused the void to tremble. The fingers and palms that were formed by the approaching hand also trembled at that moment, as if they were hesitating.
As they hesitated, Wang Baole merged himself into the black wooden board. With a leap, the coffin-like black wooden board suddenly rose into the air. It was as if an invisible giant had picked up the black wooden board, it fell... towards the hand that had been divided into eight parts!
Bam!
A crisp sound that caused the entire void to begin to crumble reverberated. The ripples that formed intensified the collapse of the void. One could even see the mirror-like surface of the surroundings shattering one after another.
The hand that had been split into eight parts also shattered along with it!
The three parts of the hand were instantly shattered. The four fingers seemed to be unable to hold on any longer and dissipated immediately. Only the index finger of the hand was still able to hold on despite the cracks spreading out. The tip of the finger was blurry, a face appeared on it. The body of the finger was illusory, and the body of a centipede seemed to appear faintly!
It stared at Wang baole, its eyes shining brightly. The expression on its face was one of surprise and joy. It was as if this failure and collapse was not a bad thing for it, but a good thing instead.
“Very good. You did not disappoint me...”
“Although what has appeared now is only one of my countless thoughts, to be able to dispel it... you have still given me quite a pleasant surprise.”
“Black board... I’m more and more interested in you. What I’m even more curious about... is your background...”
“Interesting, very interesting. I’m about to wake up. When I completely wake up, it will be the moment we meet again. And that day... is not far away.”Amidst the strange laughter, the Centipede’s finger.., it disappeared in a blur. The moment it disappeared, the void was completely torn apart.
In the next moment, when Wang Baole opened his eyes, he was standing on the island at the crater of the fated star. In front of him was the exalted Heavenly Dharma, as well as... The Book of Heavenly Dharma, which was clearly dimming under his palm.
The sounds of breathing around him, as well as the shocked gazes from the old exalted slave, did not bother Wang Baole. After a few breaths of silence, he first checked the book of Heavenly Dharma to confirm the consciousness of the book of Heavenly Dharma, now that he had woken up, he raised his head and looked at Exalted Heavenly Dharma, who was also looking at him with confusion in his eyes.
“How Long Did I spend comprehending this time?”Wang Baole asked after a moment of silence.
“Seven whole days!”Exalted Heavenly Dharma replied softly.
“Seven days...”Wang Baole mumbled. What followed was a sense of weakness that came from within his body. It was as if he had completely exhausted himself, making him feel as if he was barely able to stand there.
However, his eyes shone brightly. Wang Baole knew very well that this time, he had avoided a crisis. If he failed, the result would be that he would be possessed and appear... The Divine Emperor’s disciple and the Dao child of the nine prefectures, xing Jingzi, Xie Haiyang, and the other three saw the afterimage of the future. It was not him!

chapters.title: Chapter 1098
chapters.content:
Chapter 1098: reappeared in his previous life!
Translator:
549690339
Everything in the world had a cause and effect.
Every gain had a cost. Even though the magnitude of the cost was different, it was still the same. Wang Baole understood this principle.
It was just like the time he had been at the Heavenly Dharma Lord’s birthday banquet. From the beginning of the trial until now, he had naturally gained a lot. His cultivation had risen from the mid-stage of the planet to the perfected stage.
Such a heaven-defying serendipity naturally had to be paid for. Wang Baole had attempted to break out of the world to see the truth of the outside world. There had to be a huge cause and effect.
In the end, he had only succeeded halfway. He had seen part of the truth of the outside world, but he had also seen... the blood-colored centipede that was lying on the crystal coffin.
Perhaps it was the gaze that had caused the cause and effect between them. It had led to the appearance of the hand that had appeared at the end of the life of the Infernal God clan in his previous life, and the words that had been spoken.
Perhaps all of this was inevitable, but no matter what, in his previous life... due to the appearance and interference of the blood-colored centipede, there had been some unexpected variables.
But overall, his gains had been tremendous. Therefore, the price he had to pay had been raised to an astonishing degree. If he wasn’t careful, the possibility of him dying was extremely high.
It would have been fine if he had only died. However, it was clear that the other party was trying to possess him.
That was why the birthday banquet ended after Wang Baole finished watching the afterimages of the future. A large number of cultivators left, but Wang Baole... didn’t leave.
He stayed on the fated star to recuperate.
Wang Baole had resolved the crisis during the possession battle within the afterimages of the future, but the price he had to pay was shocking. It was... five lifetimes’worth of injuries!
One Life for the Celestials, one life for the zombies, one life for the resentful soldiers, one life for the hateful cultivators, one life for the white deer... these five lifetimes’worth of injuries were severe. If he didn’t fully recover, he would have to leave the heavenly fated star. That would be very disadvantageous for Wang Baole.
......
There was another reason why he wanted to stay. That was... the opportunity that his master, the blazing flame ancestor, had given him. He had used the crystals that he had brought with him when he had entered his previous life to increase his life force on a large scale.
Wang Baole no longer needed that. However, the words that the blood-colored centipede had said before it had disappeared were still fresh in his mind!
My origins... Wang Baole sat cross-legged on a mountain peak on the fated star. After breathing in and out the Qi of heaven and earth, he slowly opened his eyes. A profound light flashed in the depths of his eyes.
He had thought about this question before. When had he appeared in the hands of the ancient remnant soul, Sun De? It was a pity that no matter how he tried to recall, he couldn’t find an answer.
Then, the face formed by the blood-colored centipede said something similar. It was curious about his origins, which made Wang Baole even more lost in thought.
That was why he had chosen to stay. On the one hand, he was treating his injuries. On the other hand, he was planning to... after his injuries had healed, he would ask the Exalted Heavenly Dharma Lord to carry out an epiphany for him in his previous life.
He didn’t want the past ten lifetimes. He wanted to see if he had existed in the previous seventy-nine restarts of the universe. He wanted to... see his origins!
That was crucial. Only when he knew his origins could he deal with the possession crisis that the blood-colored centipede would face in the future.
Wang Baole also admitted that he was already in an intense crisis as the blood-colored centipede stared at him. This crisis made him anxious. He was anxious that his cultivation wasn’t high enough, he was anxious that he could solve this problem.
After knowing my origins, I’ve found a direction. I need to focus on this direction and constantly improve myself. Only when I reach the peak of my cultivation as soon as possible can I fight against the danger of the blood-colored centipede possessing me
Wang Baole was silent for a moment. He closed his eyes and continued to treat his injuries.
Xie Haiyang and the dao protectors from the raging flame galaxy were also present. However, they couldn’t stay on the fated star. They could only wait for Wang Baole on the warship outside the fated star.
As for Li Wan ‘er, she had planned to wait for Wang Baole as well. However, she chose to leave in the end. Xu Yinling did the same. After some hesitation, she left as well.
However, Chen Han didn’t leave. He followed Xie Haiyang attentively, waiting for Wang Baole in the warship.
Time passed day by day. Three months later, with the help of the Spirit Qi in the heavenly fated star and the help of the Exalted Heavenly Dharma, Wang Baole’s injuries were finally healed!
As he recovered, his cultivation improved. Then... Wang Baole arrived at the crater where the exalted Heavenly Dharma was located. On the Empty Island, Wang Baole sat before the exalted Heavenly Dharma.
The old exalted slave stood at the side, his eyes filled with complicated emotions. He would look at Wang Baole from time to time.
However, neither Wang Baole nor exalted heavenly dharma seemed to see him in their eyes. They only saw each other.
“Since you have recovered from your injuries, do you wish to bid farewell this time?”Exalted Heavenly Dharma asked softly.
“I wish to bid farewell as well as make a request.”Wang Baole’s gaze was clear as he looked at exalted Heavenly Dharma.
As if he had guessed what Wang Baole wanted to say, exalted Heavenly Dharma fell silent.
Wang Baole didn’t continue speaking, nor did he urge him. He remained silent.
The old slave exalted, who was standing beside him, felt an itch in his heart. He thought about it, but he couldn’t figure out what Wang Baole’s request was. Now, he only felt that the two people before him seemed to become more unfathomable as they spoke.
After a long while, exalted heavenly dharma sighed. He looked into Wang Baole’s eyes and spoke seriously.
“This life is different from the past. You Don’t have to leave. Staying here is the safest.”
“I’ve made up my mind. Please agree to my request, Exalted Heavenly Dharma.”Wang Baole stood up, cupped his fists, and bowed deeply to exalted heavenly dharma.
There was a complicated look in exalted Heavenly Dharma’s eyes as he looked at Wang Baole. Vaguely, he seemed to see a little white deer walking carefully towards him from outside the courtyard. When it saw him, it stared at him curiously.
“I can not guarantee that you will be able to see all of your past lives. I can only gather the guiding light of the entire book of Destiny and send your consciousness back. I am not sure how much you will be able to see, what you will be able to see, and what dangers will happen
“Also, I have to remind you that the dangers that exist in your past life are a form of cognitive mystery. That is to say... If you can not see, perhaps some dangers will never appear. On the contrary... you should understand.”
Wang Baole fell silent. He naturally understood, because he had thought that if he had not forcefully charged out of the world and seen the blood-colored centipede, the other party would not have appeared.
Wang Baole did not know what the answer was.
However, he knew that he would rather understand the existence of no regrets than a muddled and confused existence.
“Please help me!”Wang Baole took a deep breath and bowed again.
The Heavenly Dharma Lord closed his eyes and opened them abruptly after a long while. He raised his right hand and waved it. Immediately, the crystal that he had given to Wang Baole flew out and floated in front of the two of them. The crystal emitted a bright light, in the next instant, the light exploded and spread out like waves in the surrounding area.
As it spread out, the Heavenly Dharma Lord formed a seal with his right hand. The Book of heavenly fate behind him materialized. The pages on it shone with a gentle light. From the back to the front... They began to flip!
Every time a page was flipped, the Exalted Heavenly Dharma Master’s body would tremble, and Wang Baole’s soul would also shake. Gradually, as the pages flipped one by one, until the eleventh page from the bottom was flipped open, and just as he was about to flip through it.., wang Baole’s body shook violently, and his consciousness began to sink.
He continued to sink, until at a certain moment, he disappeared.
He sat cross-legged, and it was as if all that was left of him was his body. His soul was nowhere to be found. The Exalted Heavenly Dharma opposite him also had his eyes closed. His body shone with a vast light, and the surrounding heaven, earth, and the entire fated star seemed to tremble, it was as if they were all trembling.
The exalted old slave was even more shocked. This was the first time he had seen such a scene. He looked at Wang Baole, then at the Exalted Heavenly Dharma, and finally... his gaze fell on the fated book behind the Exalted Heavenly Dharma.
He looked at the book and slowly flipped the pages!
Page seventy-nine, page seventy-eight, page seventy-seven..
Every time he flipped the pages, the closed-eyed exalted Heavenly Dharma would speak.
“Seventy-nine.”
“Seventy-eight.”
“Seventy-seven.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1099
chapters.content:
Chapter 1099:, different Sun de!
Translator:
549690339
How many times had this world been reincarnated?
How many times had this universe been restarted?
What kind of status did each person have in different reincarnations and restarts?
What kind of status did each wisp of soul have in different worlds and in different life and death situations?
When Wang Baole wasn’t experiencing his previous life, he didn’t understand all of this. He didn’t even have similar questions in his cognition. After experiencing his previous life, he began to ponder these questions.
He wanted to know the answer. He didn’t want to exist. He wanted to exist.
He wanted to know the truth. He didn’t want to be just a piece of building block in a different universe, in a cycle of reincarnation. He didn’t want to appear in different places again and again. He wanted to live and understand.
He knew a lot about the experiences he had experienced in his previous ten lives. However, what followed were deep doubts. These doubts... were no longer important at this moment, because as his soul sank in.., as the heavenly fate book behind Guru Heavenly Dharma flipped page by Page, Wang Baole’s previous life appeared before his eyes. However... as his consciousness dissipated, he gradually forgot who he was, he slowly forgot everything and became purer. That was until he heard Guru Heavenly Dharma’s voice.
“Seventy-nine...”
..
“Who am I... Where am I...”In the pitch-black void, I heard a voice mumbling in my ear.
It seemed to be coming from a very far place, and it also seemed to be echoing around me. I didn’t know where the voice was, nor did I know why the voice was asking these two questions.
The voice echoed endlessly, as if it would continue to echo out for eternity. However, I didn’t hear any response. It was as if no one was paying attention to the voice, and I didn’t know how to open my mouth. Gradually, in the pitch-black void.., seemed to be filled with only the voice.
......
Time passed by in the void without a single trace.
Perhaps it was because of the voice that I began to think. Who... was I? Where... was I?
I thought about it for a very long time, but didn’t have an answer. The more I thought about it, the more confused I became. Eventually, I heard a voice.
“Who am I... Where am I...”
The voice was very familiar. After I heard it, I waited for a while before I heard an echo.
Then, I understood that the first thing I heard was my own voice. And I... seemed to have repeated this sentence for an unknown number of years.
This discovery caused my emotions to fluctuate. I didn’t know how to address this fluctuation, so I continued to think about it. After a long, long time, I remembered a word.
Happy!
Yes, this emotion should be called happy. I was very happy because I discovered the origin of the sound, but how did I know the word happy..
I was confused, so I continued to think. However, this time, before I could think of an answer, the dark void that didn’t exist in my eyes suddenly... suddenly appeared a light!
The light seemed to come from the outside world, illuminating the entire void. After that... it didn’t disappear. The entire void also changed at that moment. I saw a finger rapidly materializing, it turned into a hand.
A hand seemed to be holding me. Then, I saw an arm, a body, and finally, a young man. He had his eyes closed and didn’t open them.
I was very surprised, because the young man seemed familiar, but also unfamiliar. Before I could continue thinking, ripples appeared in the air around the first person.
As the ripples spread out, I saw a table, and other tables and chairs appeared in the air around me. Finally, a teahouse appeared in front of me, and then the ripples spread out again, outside the teahouse appeared other buildings, rivers, trees, and soon a small town seemed to be painted.
Then... the ripples spread out over a wide area, and I saw the Earth, the sky, the other cities, and a star that had gone from obscurity to reality.
Not the end, I saw the stars outside this star, in the Ripple Reverberation, appeared other stars, many, many, with the appearance of one after another, a universe, a world, showed in front of me.
Then, life appeared.
All living things, all living things, appeared as if they had never existed before. They appeared at every location where they were needed. There were men and women, Old and young. Different species, different auras, but they remained still, they didn’t move.
As for the young man who was holding me, he was sprawled on the table. He didn’t move either, but he was holding me tightly. It was as if he wouldn’t let go even when his life came to an end.
However, I didn’t like him very much.
Just as I was thinking about why I didn’t like him, the entire world suddenly seemed to be filled with life force and vitality. In that instant... all living things began to move.
The wind appeared, the sunlight became gentle, the leaves swayed, the river flowed, and the sounds of singing, laughter, crying, and roaring could be heard from every corner of the world.
The Teahouse suddenly erupted with a lively din. At that moment, the young man who was holding me tightly trembled slightly. He opened his eyes and lifted his head.
The moment he lifted his head, I saw his eyes.
I saw myself reflected in his eyes.
It was a black wooden board. He was holding the black wooden board tightly in his hand, and then... I was lifted up and knocked on the table, causing a clear cracking sound to be heard.
With this sound, the world in front of me began to continue. I saw the life of Sun De. He became the most famous storyteller in the county. He married the daughter of a rich family and inherited the inheritance, he was well-fed, and he loved his wife for the rest of his life. He died with a smile when he was eighty-nine years old.
As for me, I was buried with Sun De because his descendants couldn’t break his fingers.
Although I didn’t like him, I had to admit that it was quite interesting to watch his life’s performance. As for being buried together with him, it wasn’t a big deal, because after his death, everything in this world disappeared, everything turned pitch-black once again, and my consciousness sank into darkness once again.
That was until I heard a voice.
“Seventy-eight.”
The voice seemed to have transformed into a vortex that pulled me into... a void without any light. I couldn’t remember who I was. I couldn’t remember everything. I was thinking about a problem.
“Who am I... Where am I... ?”
My voice echoed in the air. After thinking for a long time, light appeared in the void. The world appeared in front of me. The first thing that appeared was a finger that slowly spread out to form a young man. He was lying on the table, his hand was holding onto me tightly.
His name was Sun de. I felt a little familiar, but there were also some unfamiliar faces. His life wasn’t bad. He became a storyteller. Although he didn’t marry the daughter of a large family in a small town, he returned to the capital and obtained a title. Although he was imprisoned in his later years.., but overall, it was still very interesting. As for me... I was always held in his hand and never left his side.
Unfortunately, after his death, the world disappeared, and I heard a voice.
“Seventy-seven.”
This voice dragged me back into nothingness, until I forgot everything. I saw the light, saw the world, and saw Sun de.
“Seventy-six.”
..
“Thirty-one.”
..
“Fourteen.”
..
“Three.”
I experienced it again and again, forgetting it again and again. From the moment I realized that something was wrong, until I wasn’t surprised, because I understood that I was in a battle. After this life, I would forget this life, i would also forget the special memories of the past and the future..
Strange, how could I have such a feeling? Why did I know that I was remembering?
It didn’t matter if I didn’t understand, as long as there was a story to read, it would be fine, although in this story, it would definitely be sun de’s different life.
But I was very curious, when we first met, would there be different scenes

chapters.title: Chapter 1100
chapters.content:
Chapter 1100: suppressing immortals?
Translator:
549690339
I found Sun de very interesting in his third life. Although he told the story of Luo and Gu vying for the immortal seat, and became a popular figure in the small town, he was chosen by a passing cultivator by chance. From then on, he entered the sect, he began a bumpy but interesting life.
In my life of cultivation, I watched as he rose to prominence. There seemed to be fluctuations in his soul that constantly stimulated the world, causing Sun de to experience many disasters along the way.
This was mainly reflected in... His sect. I watched as Sun de joined a total of ninety-seven sects in his life. Each sect... would be destroyed by a powerful enemy not long after he joined, it would last for three months, but it would only last for one day.
In the end, sun de, whose cultivation base wasn’t very high, became a famous figure in the world of cultivators. He was even kidnapped by the devil cultivators multiple times, and had his appearance changed to control him, he was quickly arranged to be sent to the enemy’s sect... to be used as the ultimate treasure!
During this process, there were a few times when the sect that kidnapped him couldn’t withstand his supreme fate and was exterminated because it was too late.
But generally speaking, Sun De’s fame was like thunder in the entire cultivation world. When his supreme fate shortened the time it took to exterminate the sect, it became as if a disaster would descend upon him as soon as he entered the sect, sun De was already an existence that everyone was terrified of. Countless sects guarded against him day and night.
It wasn’t as if no one had ever thought of exterminating him, but... what was terrifying was that all those who took action would die before they could succeed due to various accidents.
The most exaggerated one was a powerful expert who had prepared for a long time. He had even used multiple magical items that could resist bad luck, but before he could make a move, he was struck by thousands of meteors that suddenly fell from the sky, he was severely injured.
As for the others who wanted to harm him, there were all sorts of strange ways to die. Some were struck to death by lightning, while others tripped and crashed to death as soon as they rushed over.
It was hard to imagine that as a cultivator, it was one thing for him to trip, but he actually knocked himself to death... This was something that even sun de himself was shocked by.
I was also shocked.
Thus, as time passed, Sun de gradually completed his strange life. When he naturally died of old age, I faintly heard the cheers of the entire world, even though the cheers only lasted for a moment, with Sun De’s death, the world turned into ashes and vanished into nothingness.
But I was very satisfied and watched with relish. Although I knew that the next time I recalled, I would forget everything, but I still looked forward to it.
......
In my anticipation, I heard the old voice that echoed in my ears.
“Two.”
This time, the voice seemed to be much weaker. It was as if it was trying very hard to say this number. However, I didn’t have time to think too much before my consciousness was pulled back into the pitch-black nothingness.
“Who am I... Where am I...”I muttered and asked the entire nothingness. There was no answer, but I was patient because very soon... I saw light, saw the world, and saw Sun de.
This was Sun De’s second life.
In this life, it wasn’t enough to describe him as brilliant. After watching his entire life, I concluded with one word.
“Miracle!”
Only a miracle could be described in Sun De’s life. If it wasn’t a miracle, then why would a mortal like Sun de suddenly have an earth-shattering cultivation base in his body the moment he finished telling the story of Luo Yugu’s fight for the immortal seat! !
The terrifying power of that cultivation base was something that could cause all living things, regardless of their level, to be destroyed with a single thought!
If it wasn’t a miracle, then why would sun de suddenly have a cultivation base? After leaving the small town, he would pick up magical items that would suddenly appear in front of him almost every day. In fact, whenever he wanted to, anything would appear.
I saw it with my own eyes. When he wanted to have a dao partner, hundreds of thousands of female cultivators appeared out of nowhere and fell in love with him mysteriously. They were completely devoted to him..
I saw it with my own eyes. When he wanted to have a friend, millions of cultivators would appear on the same day. They would fly over from all the planets, and when they saw him, they would be incomparably passionate. They would drag him along and kowtow to him.
I also saw him mumble about how he didn’t have any enemies. The entire world, the entire universe, and all the other existences would instantly become extremely hostile toward him. They would go crazy and become irreconcilable enemies when they met.
This kind of omnipotent life that could be achieved as long as one dared to imagine it made me extremely, extremely, extremely envious.
And so, I couldn’t help but secretly transmit a stream of consciousness to guide sun de’s thoughts. One day, an idea suddenly appeared in his mind. He wanted to have an heir.
And so... the entire world, the entire universe, and all species suddenly had the aura of his bloodline in their bodies at this moment... it was difficult to imagine how terrifying this was, sun De was also stunned for a long time when he saw a gigantic tree appear in front of him.
This tree also had the fluctuations of his bloodline. In a certain sense, this tree was his descendant.
Sun De seemed to be shocked by this matter as he lowered his head and started to look at me. As for me... I was also exposed because of this matter.
Naturally, there wouldn’t be any bloodline aura on my body, so I became the focus of his interest. In the following days, Sun De, who had already destroyed the entire universe, began to study me.
Whether it was the suppression of spells, the bombardment of heavenly lightning, or the cutting, sealing, and burning of blades, as well as the suppression and killing of the entire universe, all sorts of methods were used by him.
This made me very unhappy!
Obviously, Sun De wouldn’t have any results. No matter what methods he used or what actions he took, all of them were fruitless. During this process, I could see that Sun De’s body.., it was as if an incredibly weak remnant soul was slumbering in his body. That Soul had always been slumbering, and was in the midst of dissipating. It would require some sort of opportunity before it could awaken. However, such an opportunity was incredibly difficult.
Within the remnant soul’s body, I saw two threads, one black and one red. Compared to the latter, the former stretched out into the void, and I didn’t know where it connected to, but it was incredibly weak. If I wanted to break it, I could do so with just a thought.
It was more like a curse. I didn’t know how I had come to realize this.
However, what made me wary was the red thread. It was definitely not a curse. Furthermore, the thread wasn’t a complete entity with the soul. Even the soul itself seemed to be incomplete, and it didn’t seem like an external seal, it was more like the remnant soul was trying its best to obtain it, trying to forcefully fuse it into its body.
It had a very high status, an extremely high status!
What was this..
I didn’t know, but I felt that it looked somewhat familiar. Perhaps I had seen it before?
However, I knew very clearly that the instant I saw this thread, I was extremely displeased. This was because I felt a sense of greed on the thread, and it was a threat to me.
Thus, the displeased me thought for a moment before saying something to Sun de.
“This thread will be suppressed forever!”
Almost at the instant I said those two words, the blood-colored thread in Sun De’s discarnate soul suddenly trembled and began to twist violently. It looked just like a centipede, it even let out a frenzied, sharp screech.
“You dare to suppress immortals? !”
The entire world instantly collapsed under the blood-colored thread’s screech. It shattered into countless pieces, which then tumbled back to form a vortex that devoured everything. My consciousness also returned to nothingness, i heard an ancient, weak voice that seemed to have reached its limit. It trembled as it spoke with all of its power.
“One!”
— heave
I had been writing all this time, but I had just finished, and it was too late to update. I covered my face

chapters.title: Chapter 1101
chapters.content:
Chapter 1101:, first life!
Translator:
549690339
The old voice seemed to have reached its limit. It was as if an extremely weak person had used the last of his strength to send it out. It passed through the endless universe, passed through the endless years, sank into the cycle of reincarnation, and reverberated in the pitch-black void, it filled Wang Baole’s ears.
It seemed to have touched his soul, causing Wang Baole’s consciousness to fluctuate. At first, the fluctuations were still weak, but as the aftersounds came in layers, the fluctuations in his consciousness gradually grew stronger. Eventually.., wang Baole’s entire body trembled. His consciousness woke up, and his eyes..
Opened.
What he saw wasn’t the fated star, nor was it the book of Heavenly Fate, nor was it the exalted Heavenly Dharma. It was... a starry sky!
The dazzling starlight, the countless stars, and the distant galaxy that seemed to stretch beyond the horizon, formed from the countless stars that had fallen into this place countless years ago... a vast galaxy.
There didn’t seem to be anything out of the ordinary about it. Even though it was extremely beautiful, Wang Baole had seen a similar galaxy in the Weiyang Dao domain when he was speeding through the galaxy.
However... it seemed to be slightly different. The galaxy here might be more turbid, but it was also more vast. Everything was filled with an indescribable sense of vicissitudes. It was as if one could see the galaxy, one would naturally feel a sense of grandeur, as if time had passed in an instant. One would also feel as insignificant as dust.
Wang Baole looked at everything, his eyes filled with confusion. His consciousness had awakened as the voice reverberated in the air, but his memories had yet to fully emerge. He only remembered that with the help of the Exalted Heavenly Dharma Master.., he was immersed in his previous life’s Epiphany. It was as if everything had happened in an instant. He had just been immersed in it a moment ago, and the next moment, when he opened his eyes, he saw the starry sky.
However, just as Wang Baole was in a daze, the memories of the past seventy-eight reincarnations appeared in his mind in an instant. The memories of each life were like a bolt of lightning, exploding in his mind, they turned into a large amount of information and images, filling his mind.
One after another, three after another... when the memories of the seventy-eight reincarnations appeared, Wang Baole’s body trembled, and his expression was one of pain. The pain did not come from emotions, but from the fusion of all the memories in an instant, it made his mind feel like it was about to explode, and his mind felt like it was being torn apart.
“Sun de!”
“Sun de!”
“Sun de!”Wang Baole roared, repeating the name, repeating the only person who had appeared in all the seventy-eight lifetimes in his memories!
......
In all the seventy-eight lifetimes, other than Wang Baole himself, Sun de was the only person. He had evolved over and over again, experiencing sun de’s different lives. It was as if he was looking for a direction and an opportunity.
Instinctively, an opportunity to awaken the remnant soul... Wang Baole pressed between his brows. Blood vessels appeared in his eyes as a large number of memories surfaced. However, as he integrated all the memories, absorbed and digested them.., his rationality slowly returned. His eyes gradually narrowed, and they shone brightly.
Everything seemed to be completely clear!
Sun De, who was an ancient remnant soul, had tried to wake himself up from his second life. Unfortunately, the ancient remnant soul did not appear until the 79th life. Although it waited for Wang Yiyi and her father, this remnant soul.., did not wake up in the end. It dissipated in the world for eternity.
Sun De’s endless reincarnation also ended because of this.
The world that followed might have fallen into darkness. There wouldn’t be any life left, and it would have turned into a deathly stillness. However, all of that had changed because of Wang Yiyi’s injuries and the arrival of her father and daughter.
That was why in the eightieth life in the universe, Wang Baole had used Xu Yinling’s enlightenment to see bubble after bubble of dreams. He recalled that it might have been the earliest birth of life.
The words, pictures, butterflies, and so on that followed were the process of life growing on its own and becoming richer..
The last ten lives of this universe were created by Wang Yiyi and her father... Wang Baole murmured. He thought of a sentence. There was a God in heaven, and he understood it now.
Wang Baole knew what Wang Yiyi’s father’s goal was. It was to treat Wang Yiyi’s injuries. The reason why the father and daughter were able to create all living things in this universe must have something to do with what Sun De had said before his death in the seventy-ninth life, it’s about what he said.
He promised Wang Yiyi’s father to help him save his daughter.
As for Wang Baole himself, at that moment, he knew that he owed Sun de a favor in the end, as his memories from his second life to his eighty-ninth life were integrated.
Because if it wasn’t for Sun De’s inheritance in the 79th life, when his remnant soul dissipated, then perhaps he would still be a black plank floating in the starry sky, although he was born with an instinct, but he wouldn’t have been born with true life.
Wang Baole had also guessed the origins of the blood-colored centipede. He didn’t know which of the two answers was correct, but the truth... was one of them.
The first possibility is that when Luo and Gu were fighting for the immortal seat, in countless lives and within karma, they fought endlessly. In the end, Luo won, but Gu managed to escape from the remnant soul, leaving Luo’s immortal seat incomplete and flawed. However, he didn’t know that within the remnant soul... There was still a sliver of Luo’s consciousness. This consciousness... for some unknown reason, eventually gave birth to sentience
“As for the second possibility...”Wang Baole was deep in thought. As he reorganized his thoughts, he thought of the roar that came from the blood-colored thread in his second life, which he had suppressed instinctively and disliked.
“You dare to suppress immortals...”Wang Baole murmured. That was the source of the second possibility that he had guessed.
“The second possibility is... that the blood-colored thread is not a wisp of Luo’s consciousness. It is... Luo and Gu, who fought over the entire ring... the immortal seat. Perhaps the immortal seat itself has a spirit, or perhaps it doesn’t have a spirit. But here, under a special environment and conditions, it has given birth to a spirit. As for the centipede that I saw, it wasn’t its true appearance. It was just a symbol!”! ”!”
Wang Baole fell silent. Either of these two guesses could be correct, and it made sense logically. That was why Wang Baole had no way of knowing for himself. Just as he was thinking about the deeper details.., suddenly... he felt his heart palpitate. When he raised his head, he saw a sea of light in the distance in the murky starry sky.
The light encompassed an endless area, and it carried a strong sense of dominance. It spread out from the distant starry sky. If one looked closely, they would see that within the Sea of light was a universe!
The universe was infinitely large, containing countless stars. There were even shocking ripples that erupted within it. As it arrived and as Wang Baole turned his head, he saw a giant beast that was extremely pale in color in the starry sky behind him, it was howling as it materialized.
The giant beast was like a whale, and its size was similar to the sphere of light. Upon closer inspection, one could see that there was a continent within its body. Countless cultivators flew out from the continent, transforming into the flesh and blood of the giant beast, giving it the power to.., shake the gods.
In the blink of an eye, as the giant beast and the Sea of light collided, a great battle that affected the entire universe erupted before Wang Baole. At that moment, he immediately realized what he was seeing in his first life, what he was seeing!
It was... the Battle of annihilation between the first and second universes that had been born at the beginning of the second cycle. It was... the battle between the Endless Dao Domain and the vast dao domain that had occurred countless years ago!
Wang Baole, who was on the battlefield, watched the battle between the two vast universes with his own eyes. He saw countless deaths, saw madness, and tragedy. He saw the entire process of the battle.
Be it the vast dao domain or the Weiyang Dao Domain, the power they displayed was so strong that it shook Wang Baole’s heart. He remembered the secret that Wang Yiyi’s father had told the ancient remnant soul.
Weiyang wasn’t the real Weiyang!
As those words reverberated in Wang Baole’s mind, he saw all the cultivators on the continent, who were at a disadvantage within the pale giant beast’s body, kneel down and worship it!
The object of their worship was a statue!
It was the statue of an elder!
That was... the first cultivator to be born in the vast expanse dao domain. It was also the highest will in the vast expanse dao domain. He didn’t have a name, only a title.
The vast expanse patriarch!

chapters.title: Chapter 1102
chapters.content:
Chapter 1102:, three-foot-long Black Wood!
Translator:
549690339
Wang Baole saw with his own eyes that on the continent within the body of the vast beast, as countless cultivators worshiped and worshiped, the statue of the elder standing in the middle of the continent transformed from a statue into flesh and blood, until it opened its eyes.
At the same time, an even stronger palpitation, accompanied by a resonance that made Wang Baole tremble, suddenly emerged from within the light ocean universe of the never-ending DAO domain!
“This feeling...”Wang Baole turned his head abruptly. In that instant, across the starry skies, across the light ocean universe, he saw countless cultivators in the never-ending DAO domain kneeling and worshipping!
What they worshipped... was a vortex!
It was a vortex that connected to an unknown place. As everyone worshipped it, and as the vast expanse patriarch, who was the statue inside the giant pale Beast’s body, stared at it, a piece of wood appeared within the Vortex!
The appearance of this piece of wood caused all of the cultivators in the Weiyang Dao domain to be filled with excitement. Their eyes shone with fervor, and even the powerful experts and almighty experts felt the same way!
It was a black piece of wood, more like a black wooden coffin. From within the vortex was a foot and a half long... . Although it was only a foot and a half long, it caused the vast expanse continent to tremble, and the vast expanse beast to wail in pain, it was on the verge of collapse, and patriarch vast expanse was trembling, and blood sprayed out of his mouth.
Next... the coffin emerged from within the Vortex, a foot and a half long. This Time... The vast expanse beast collapsed, and miserable shrieks echoed out through the starry sky, revealing the vast expanse continent within, as well as the land mass itself, all of the cultivators were screaming in madness as they charged out, seemingly ready to perish together.
The countless cultivators in the Weiyang dao domain who were worshipping the coffin were clearly not having an easy time either. Although they were still as fanatical as ever, most of their lives had already faded away. It was as if they had lost seventy percent of their life force, it was as if the power that supported the black wooden coffin was their life force.
At that moment, they were already at their limit, and could no longer support it. They could only allow the black wooden coffin to stretch three feet out from the vortex, and that was when they had no choice but to end the ritual.
As the ritual ended and the vortex disappeared, the black wood that was only three feet long and was clearly only a portion of the complete coffin fell down as if it had self-destructed.
As it fell, all of its power seemed to disappear, leaving behind only a trace of reluctance to part with the unknown place in the vortex. Gradually, it became ordinary and unremarkable, just like ordinary wood.
At that moment, Wang Baole’s body trembled as he stared fixedly at the three-foot-long black wood. Then, he slowly raised his head and looked at the spot where the vortex had disappeared. Countless bolts of lightning seemed to explode in his mind at the same time, and a loud boom rang out, a sense of reluctance that seemed to be buried deep within his soul also surfaced in his consciousness.
......
The war had reached its final stage as the countless cultivators in the vast expanse dao domain went crazy. The cultivators on both sides began to clash with their lives. The tragic battlefield was like a giant millstone of flesh and blood, rolling endlessly, it was constantly being crushed..
Eventually, everyone in the vast expanse dao domain was destroyed and turned into ruins. Patriarch Vast Expanse was transformed into a broken statue. After being destroyed several times, a portion of the ghost-like land mass floated out into the starry sky. The war.., was finally over.
Although the Weiyang Dao Domain won, it was equally bitter. The Sea of light had been torn to pieces, and the universe within had been shattered. However, given enough time, the Weiyang Dao Domain, which had absorbed all of the vast expanse dao domain’s resources, would become even more powerful, it would definitely become even more powerful. However, just as the Weiyang Dao Domain was trying to chase after the last piece of land that the vast expanse dao domain had escaped from... something unexpected happened!
It was a streak of light. A streak of black and red surrounded it, forming a purple streak of light that was constantly dimming!
The streak of light flew over from the depths of the distant starry skies. It was so fast that it surpassed everything else. Wang Baole was still immersed in the Black Wood’s reluctance to part with it, but he could still see a vague figure within the streak of light.
It was... Sun De!
In the blink of an eye, the moment Wang Baole saw it clearly, the ray of light charged straight into the Weiyang Dao Domain, which had suffered a crushing victory. It was almost in pieces. The Ray of light seemed to have an accurate direction as it dissipated rapidly within itself, it was about to disappear completely. It charged straight towards... the three-foot-long black wooden coffin that had fallen!
It approached in the blink of an eye and disappeared into the black wood.
Wang Baole’s heart trembled violently. Deep in the starry sky, where the purple light had appeared, the starry sky collapsed instantly. A gigantic figure emerged from the collapsed starry sky, step by step.
The figure was extremely tall. His appearance was blurry, and he couldn’t be seen clearly. It was as if his face was the universe. Only his eyes could be seen. There was coldness in his eyes, as if there were no emotions in them.
Other than that, his two arms were the most eye-catching. Although he was in human form, his arms were much longer than the average person’s. It was as if he could touch his knees when he stood up!
He stood there, staring coldly at the shattered Weiyang Dao Domain, as if he were looking at an ant nest. When his gaze fell on the three-foot-long black tree, his eyes, which seemed to have never changed since ancient times, suddenly shrank!
There was confusion, shock, and disbelief in his eyes. He stood there without moving for a moment. Finally, he raised his hand, as if he wanted to grab the black wood within the Wei Yang Dao Domain. However, when he raised his hand.., hesitation appeared in his eyes again, and he gradually put it down.
After a long silence, he raised his hand again. This time, he didn’t grab it. Instead, he waved his finger and pointed at the entire Wei Yang Dao Domain. A deep voice rang out from his mouth.
“Seal!”
As soon as he spoke, Wang Baole immediately saw that ripples had appeared silently around the broken Weiyang Dao Domain. The ripples gathered and formed a bubble that enveloped the entire Weiyang Dao Domain, then, it gradually became blurry, as if it wanted to immerse itself in the passage of time and be sealed forever.
However, as the tall figure stared at the sealed bubble, he didn’t seem to be at ease. He raised his left hand again and pointed towards it.
“With my left hand, seal!”The index finger on his left hand snapped, transforming into a gray light that shot toward the bubble. As it surged in, the entire bubble turned turbid, as if it had turned into a ball of dirt.
However, the tall figure didn’t leave. He stood there thoughtfully for a moment, then spoke again.
“With my second finger...”the tall figure paused for a moment. After a moment of silence, determination appeared in his eyes, as if he had made up his mind. He lifted his left hand, and a deep voice that seemed to echo out over countless years rang out.
“With my left hand, seal!”As soon as he said that, his entire left arm disappeared in an instant. It turned into a gray light that seemed to cover the entire starry sky, enveloping the sealed Weiyang Dao domain, the shape of the earthen ball changed rapidly as the gray light merged with it. When all the gray light in the starry sky gathered together, the earthen ball turned into... a gigantic stone tablet!
Wang Baole’s heart was in turmoil. He watched as the stone tablet exuded an earth-shattering pressure and slowly sank into the starry sky. It continued to sink and fall, as if it was buried in an endless abyss.
The tall figure, who had lost his left arm, stared at the stone tablet as it gradually disappeared and was buried. A deep loneliness appeared in his eyes. He slowly turned around and walked towards the starry sky. However, the moment his figure slowly disappeared into the starry sky.., wang Baole suddenly heard his deep voice.
“I like the second-level universe. It’s mine.”
“Do you know... What it feels like to like it?”
The tall figure only said those two words before he slowly disappeared. Wang Baole was the only one left in the starry sky. He stood there, staring at the spot where the stone tablet had sunk, and then at the direction where Luo Yuan had gone. He was silent for a long time, he murmured.
“Where... Did I come from?”
As he murmured, the starry sky slowly blurred in his eyes. Eventually... it disappeared completely. The fated star, the fated book, and the tired figure of the heavenly dharma master replaced everything that had appeared before his eyes.
“I thought you wouldn’t be able to come back.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1103
chapters.content:
Chapter 1103: left!
Translator:
549690339
“How long has it been?”Wang Baole’s eyes were a little dazed. After a long while, he looked at the exalted Heavenly Dharma.
“Seventy-nine days.”It was difficult to hide the fatigue in the eyes of the exalted Heavenly Dharma. As blood vessels filled the air, the aura on his body also fluctuated. Coupled with his pale face, all of this revealed that Wang Baole had been enlightened about his previous life, it had been a huge drain on him.
The old exalted slave beside him was even weaker. He sat cross-legged and closed his eyes to recuperate. It was obvious that the exalted Heavenly Dharma Lord alone could not allow Wang Baole to fully immerse himself in his past life. The Enlightenment he had gained in his past life.., it had been the combined effort of the two of them.
The Book of Heavenly Fate was also extremely dim. It no longer looked as bright as it had once been. It had become much more ordinary. It would take a long time for it to slowly recover.
Even though he had used the book of Destiny as a medium in his previous life and used his own strength as a catalyst, and it was mainly due to Wang Baole’s own strength, he was still unable to hold on for much longer.
The second to seventy-ninth lives were fine, but the first life involved some unimaginable existences. It was already a miracle that he could hold on until Wang Baole woke up.
Wang Baole didn’t know the details, but he could understand the general situation. In the next moment, gratitude appeared in his eyes. He took a deep breath and stood up. He faced the Heavenly Dharma Master and the old slave, who was meditating with his eyes closed, he faced the book of Destiny and cupped his fists and bowed three times!
These three bows couldn’t express his gratitude completely. Wang Baole had gained too much from the insights he had gained in his previous life. He had integrated all his memories, learned about his past life, and learned about the present, he had also learned more than half of the truth.
This made his entire aura change. The moment Wang Baole stood up and bowed three times, the ripples of his cultivation erupted.
All the Epiphany he had gained in his previous life, the accumulation of all the years, spread through Wang Baole’s body at that moment, pushing his cultivation to continue rising and breaking through the limits of the planet, he had reached... a unique realm that he had never reached before!
The reason why it was unique was that no planet cultivator had ever reached such a level before him. This level was reflected in Wang Baole’s nine ancient planets, as well as his Dao Planet!
The resonance of the ancient planets returned with the insights he had gained in his previous life. The resonance of the nine ancient planets and the nine laws continued to rise, eventually stopping at ninety-nine percent!
It wasn’t appropriate to describe it as an ancient star. They... should be called quasi-dao stars!
......
This change had given Wang Baole an unparalleled boost. It had increased his combat strength from its original peak. What had changed was his Dao Star!
The dao star shone brightly in his soul. The biggest change was the size of the dimension!
The original Dao Star had been a high-ranking planet, but now... It was still a planet, but its size had surpassed that of an ordinary star!
At the very least, all the stars that Wang Baole had seen so far were far inferior to his own dao star. The power contained within such a massive planet shocked Wang Baole when he sensed it.
If one were to compare the cultivation of a planet to a lake, after reaching the level of a star, there would be a qualitative change. The water in the lake would turn into ice, and Wang Baole’s battle prowess would improve accordingly. Then, at that moment, Wang Baole.., he was still at the level of a planet. However, the water in his lake was not a lake, but... a vast ocean!
The ice in this ocean surpassed that of a star. Even though it was inferior in quality, the sheer amount of ice could make up for everything. The impact of the massive ocean might be strong, but the ice in the lake would be easily destroyed!
It wasn’t easy for Wang Baole to judge just how strong he was. However, he knew... that cultivation wasn’t his trump card. His trump card was his understanding of the world and... The Shadow of his previous life!
That was why he was said to be the most unique planet-grade cultivator in the entire world of the stone tablet!
All these gains were inseparable from the help of the exalted Heavenly Dharma. After three bows, Wang Baole looked up at the exhausted exalted heavenly dharma and said softly, “Thank you.”.
“Thank you!”
He didn’t make any promises, but this heartfelt thank you was enough to express his feelings. The exalted heavenly dharma naturally understood, and a smile appeared on his face.
“Take care.”
Wang baole nodded. He raised his head and looked around. He spread out his supernatural awareness and enveloped the heavenly fated star. He stared at it for a long while, and a look of anticipation for the future appeared in his eyes. He bowed once more to the exalted Heavenly Dharma, and Wang Baole’s body swayed, he turned into a long rainbow and shot into the sky!
As he rose into the sky, nine laws from the quasi-dao stars appeared around him. As he rose into the sky, the power of the Dao stars lifted him up. His entire body shone brightly, the void formed auspicious unknown totems in front of him, making him look like the center of the sky as he flew into the sky.
As he flew further and further away, the Heavenly Dharma Lord muttered to himself with a look of blessing in his eyes.
“Actually, I should be the one thanking you. You have also made me... understand the origins of this world.”
Wang baole, who had flown into the sky, also heard those words. His body paused slightly, then sped up. As he flew into the starry sky, he was also pondering a question in his mind.
I, where did I come from... Wang Baole’s memories of the whirlpool that led to the unknown place surfaced before his eyes. He wanted to know. He even had a vague feeling that within the whirlpool, in the unknown place.., there seemed to be something calling to him.
After a long while, he flew into the starry skies and saw the battleship that was still there. Wang Baole suppressed his thoughts. His body swayed, and he headed straight for the battleship at the front.
He used his divine perception to cover the entire area. He ignored the protection of the battleship and saw Xie Haiyang, Chen Han, and the others inside. He also saw the stellar dao protectors from the raging flame galaxy, after he scanned the area with his divine perception for a few breaths, the expressions on their faces changed drastically.
“Who are you?”Shouts rang out from within the battleship. The Stellar Dao Protectors who were protecting Wang Baole and Xie Haiyang, as well as the dao protectors who were following Chen Han, rushed out of the battleship. They stood outside the battleship as if they were facing a great enemy, they looked at Wang Baole, who was approaching.
There were more than thirty stars in total. Other than two yellow-grade stars, the rest were mortal-grade stars. Even so, as these stars appeared, their auras and the ripples they emitted were still as powerful as ever.
Even though they were filled with powerful auras, their expressions changed as they stared at the terrifying shadow that had rushed out from the fated star.
They couldn’t see Wang Baole’s real body. It was as if there was some sort of cognitive barrier between the two parties that prevented them from seeing everything about Wang Baole clearly. It didn’t matter if it was his presence or his figure.
They could only see... an illusory star that surpassed the stars. It had an extremely majestic presence. It had suddenly appeared outside the fated star and was approaching them with a loud bang.
It was clearly not a star, but a planet. However, the suppressive force emanating from it made the stellar cultivators shudder in fear and shock. That was especially so when they saw that outside the gigantic illusory planet.., there were nine planets orbiting around it. It was like a satellite, making its presence even more terrifying. This made the stars instinctively want to unleash their supernatural powers.
Xie Haiyang and Chen Han’s eyes were solemn at that moment. Fortunately, Wang Baole immediately sensed his condition. It was as if these familiar people couldn’t see him clearly. He paused for a moment before speaking.
“It’s me.”
As his words reverberated in the air, under Wang Baole’s deliberate suppression, the dao stars and quasi-dao stars outside his body shrank rapidly. Eventually, they were all retracted into his body, and he used the origin illusory art, after allowing his appearance to be reflected in the eyes of others, his figure finally appeared in front of everyone’s eyes.
“Young Lord?”
“Uncle-master Baole?”
“Dad?”
The stellar cultivators from the raging flame galaxy, Xie Haiyang, and Chen Han widened their eyes in disbelief as they stared blankly at Wang Baole.
They knew that Wang Baole had gained a lot during the heavenly fated star trial and had performed well during the birthday banquet. However, now that they had witnessed the vast expanse of stars and the strange state that seemed impossible to see with their own eyes, their hearts.., they couldn’t help but stir up huge waves.

chapters.title: Chapter 1104
chapters.content:
Chapter 1104:, arrogance!
Translator:
549690339
The storm outside the fated star quickly ended. Everyone was shocked, but they eventually accepted the fact. The way they looked at Wang Baole was no longer the same as before.
The dao protectors from the raging flame galaxy respected Wang Baole, but it was mostly because of the blazing flame ancestor. However, things were different now. Wang Baole had used his own combat strength and his own aura to make the stellar cultivators.., they were filled with awe and respect.
In their entire lives, they had never seen a planet that could exude such a terrifying aura like Wang Baole. Furthermore... that state of being invisible had also caused all the stars on the battleship to.., they had too many guesses in their hearts.
This was because normally, such a situation would only occur when there was a huge difference in levels between the two of them. For example, the gods could not be looked at directly. This was because all the rules around the gods had to be distorted. Those who were not at a high enough level, once they looked at them.., they would be strongly affected, and they would be unable to withstand the distorted rules. Their perception would be affected, and they would self-destruct.
Wang Baole was just like that just now. Although it was not that exaggerated, it had this characteristic. And this... was the source of the shock in the hearts of all the stars.
Xie Haiyang was equally shocked. However, he recovered very quickly. Beside Wang Baole, he was even more enthusiastic than on the way back. However, on the way back, he had an even more hardworking person by his side.
This person was Chen Han. He had recovered the fastest. He kept calling out for his father, not caring about the strange expressions on the dao protectors’faces or Xie Haiyang’s frown.
Wang Baole didn’t care about that. After stepping onto the warship, he was deep in thought.
Where was he going!
According to his original plan, after attending the birthday banquet, he would return to the raging flame galaxy to report for duty. At the same time, he planned to make a trip back to the Earth Federation to visit his parents and friends.
However, after experiencing the trials in his previous life and learning more than half of the truth, Wang Baole’s thoughts changed. This was especially so after experiencing a crisis where he had almost been possessed.
Although he knew that his previous life was a black board with a mysterious origin, and that he had finally gained true intelligence thanks to Sun De’s gift, Wang Baole did not believe that he could not be possessed.
At the same time, he had another guess.
......
I am the black board, but the black board... is not necessarily me
The black board can be reincarnated and indestructible, but I am not necessarily... in other words, I am the spirit that was born on it, and I can be erased, just like the artifact spirit on the Dharmic artifact
“Even though the artifact spirit has been erased and the Dharmic artifact has been damaged, it doesn’t have much of an impact. A new artifact spirit can be slowly refined. Or if it isn’t changed, as it is nurtured, the Dharmic artifact itself can give birth to a new artifact spirit under some special circumstances..
“The new artifact spirit that is Born is me, and not me.”Wang Baole was silent. Perhaps it was because he had come into contact with artifact refinement from the start, but Wang Baole had his own logic and judgment regarding this point.
He knew very well that the blood-colored Centipede’s greed and malice towards him was very strong. Perhaps it wouldn’t be long before he was faced with the appearance and possession of the other party. It would be like a Dharmic artifact changing into a different artifact spirit.
If I treat the black wooden board as a Dharmic artifact and my previous life as an artifact spirit, then... There’s a problem here. I should be able to display the divine might of the three-foot-long black wood
The arrival of the three-foot-long can suppress all living beings in the vast dao domain... Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He understood this, but he also understood... that at this moment, he was still unable to control the black wooden board.
There were two reasons behind this. One was that only in this life could he truly fuse all the memories of his previous life. In his previous life, be it the zombies, the resentful soldiers, or the little white deer, none of them could do this.
Therefore, based on Wang Baole’s analysis, he felt that this might be the opportunity to start controlling the black board.
The other reason was that even though it seemed like his intelligence had been born for a very long time and had gone through several lifetimes, compared to the countless years that had passed on the black board, he was merely a newborn on its body. He might not even be considered an infant.
Therefore, it was extremely difficult to control the black board.
That was why... the most important thing before him now was to control the black board and how to defend against the blood-colored Centipede’s possession. After thinking about it, the only thing he could do was to increase his cultivation!
Only by becoming stronger could he resolve everything.
The star realm is no longer difficult for me. If I wanted to, I could advance immediately... However, even though this kind of advancement is powerful, it’s still a little lacking. Wang Baole thought to himself, the star realm that he wanted was the reflection of thousands of stars, supporting his own star.
To achieve this, he needed even more stars!
Special Stars!
I still have to make a trip to... the land of the fallen stars! Wang Baole thought to himself. A look of determination appeared in his eyes. He immediately sent a telepathic thought to Xie Haiyang, informing him of the coordinates of a starry sky.
The coordinates were the entrance to the land of the fallen stars that he had visited previously.
Once there, he didn’t need a token. Wang Baole believed that the paper figurine in the fallen star lands would be able to sense him. That was because the token had been left behind for Zhao Yameng when Wang Baole had left the federation, it was one of the foundations of the federation.
As the telepathic thought was sent out, Xie Haiyang immediately acknowledged the order. Soon, the fleet of warships that had stopped outside the fated star began to move with a loud bang. They headed toward the coordinates that Wang Baole had given them, whistling through the air. They were about to leave the fated star system.
At the same time, Wang Baole’s thoughts continued. This time, what he was thinking about was... Luo!
“I like the world in the second ring. It’s mine...”Wang Baole mumbled and repeated what Luo had said. It was hard for him to imagine that a mighty figure with cold and emotionless eyes.., would say the word “Like”.
However, in his memories, he could clearly feel that what Luo had said was true.
Wang Baole fell silent. He thought of the story that Wang Yiyi’s father and Sun de had told him about demons, demons, and demigods and demiimmortals. The ending of that story was that they had cut off Luo’s fingers one by one, then, they had gathered everyone’s strength and killed Luo!
These stories had obviously happened after he had seen the time node in his first life.
There’s also Luo’s seal on the black wooden board. From the beginning, it was an ordinary seal, all the way until it was sealed with one finger. In the end, he didn’t hesitate to use his entire left arm to seal it..
Why is he doing this? Is he afraid of the black wooden board, or... is he trying to protect the world that he likes? Wang Baole couldn’t figure it out, but he thought of Luo’s final question. Does he know what it feels like to like.
This made Wang Baole even more silent. At that moment, Little Missy’s voice reverberated in Wang Baole’s mind.
“Fatty, you’ve been influenced. Liking often means possessing
“If you like butterflies, do you think it’s better to watch them fly freely, or to turn them into a specimen and place them in a book?”
Wang Baole was shocked. After carefully savoring little Missy’s words, he whispered softly.
“It’s not good. I don’t like butterflies. I like you.”
“Damn Fatty, I’m talking business with you!”Little Missy snorted.
“I’m also talking business!”Wang baole blinked and coughed. He realized that Little Missy was the best way to soothe his emotions. She could soothe his emotions to the greatest extent. However, just as he was about to change his mind.., just as he was about to continue to soothe his emotions, he left the fated star system with the fleet of warships he was on..
The moment he left, a sense of danger appeared in Wang Baole’s mind. He raised his head and looked into the distance. He saw... in the distant starry sky.., a middle-aged man dressed in black sat cross-legged on a meteorite that seemed to have been suppressed to the point where it couldn’t move. He was holding a longsword in his arms.
The man’s body emitted a strong vibration. At that moment, he opened his eyes abruptly and looked at the group of battleships where Wang Baole was. However, he did not seem to be able to sense Wang Baole. Therefore, the corners of his mouth remained curled into a lofty smile, a calm and arrogant voice came from his mouth.
“Wang Baole, thank you for saving your head for me for so long. Now, you can hand it over to me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1105
chapters.content:
Chapter 1105: came and went in a hurry!
Translator:
549690339
The person who had spoken was the clone that Zhong Yizi had arranged for him. The clone had actually arrived a long time ago, but he didn’t dare act rashly in the fated star system, so he had chosen to wait here.
After all, although the fated star system was large, due to some special reasons, there was only one entrance and exit. Therefore, if he waited here, he could naturally wait for Wang Baole to appear.
In his opinion, killing Wang Baole this time wouldn’t require much effort. The only thing he needed to worry about was the blazing flame ancestor. However, he believed that the person who had asked him to kill Wang Baole would be able to block karma.
Therefore, what he needed to do now... was to silence everyone here.
He didn’t care if there were other prodigies among them. As for the so-called dao protectors, in his opinion, they were all trash from the mortal path. If they could win in terms of numbers, what was the point of everyone cultivating.
That was why when he said those words, his arrogance was evident.
His words were indeed too arrogant!
At that moment, almost everyone in the battleship had similar thoughts when they heard those words. It caused all the dao protectors to be displeased.
They could already tell that the newcomer was also at the cultivation level of a star. They couldn’t see through the details, but... There were more than thirty stars, and there was only one person on the other side. No matter what, they had the advantage in numbers.
Furthermore... There was Wang Baole, that terrifying existence. Therefore, most of the people present were displeased and didn’t seem worried at all. Xie Haiyang was about to speak, but someone was one step ahead of him.
“Dad, this guy is too arrogant. Let me capture him for you!”After hearing the words of the person sitting cross-legged on the meteorite outside the warship, the first person to express his anger and displeasure wasn’t Wang Baole himself, it was his son... Chen Han.
Chen Han was furious. He didn’t wait for Wang Baole to speak and immediately waved his hand, shouting orders to his left and right.
“Please, dharma protectors, capture this person and bring him to my father for interrogation!”
......
As a dao child of the Seven Spirit Dao, the dharma protectors around Chen Han were at the mortal realm, but they also possessed mystic arts. They were extraordinary. As soon as he spoke, the Seven Stellar Dao protectors following him immediately obeyed his orders, they flew out into the starry sky outside of the battleship and shot toward the Coxcomb clone.
However, in the instant that the seven of them charged out, a vicious smile appeared on Chong Coxcomb’s face. He lifted his head and looked up into the starry sky. Almost at the same time, a violet beam of light shot down from the starry sky with a supreme divine might, it turned into a purple screen of light, enveloping the area where everyone was, as well as all the battleships and Chong Weizi’s clones!
It was like a spell formation, but also like a seal, isolating all auras, isolating some karma, isolating all senses from the outside world. It was as if... This place had been separated from the starry sky.
Before any of the seven people could react, they saw that the area was covered by a violet shield of light. As for Chong Weizi, she sat there laughing, and killing intent exploded out in her eyes. She leaped into the air, and the meteors beneath her shattered into pieces, they transformed into countless pieces of rubble that shot toward the battleships with shocking power. She shot forward as fast as lightning.
In an instant, they collided with the seven incoming stars. The two parties merely crossed paths, and Chen Han’s seven dao protectors coughed up blood. Their bodies were sent tumbling backward, as if they were so weak that they couldn’t withstand a single blow!
“Too weak!”As he laughed maniacally, Chong Coix charged towards the battleship where Wang Baole was. The killing intent in his eyes was intense, and a murderous aura erupted from his body. To him, this was a simple attack. However, in case something unexpected happened.., it was better to kill Wang Baole to complete the mission first before silencing the others. That would be safer.
Wang Baole’s expression remained the same as he stood within the warship and stared coldly at Chong Coix who was charging towards him. He didn’t move, but the expressions on the faces of the Stellar Dao protectors beside him changed. They charged out instantly and charged towards Chong Coix.
Chong Coix’s strength was fully demonstrated at this moment. Even though the cultivation of this clone was only at the early-stage of the star realm, when faced with the arrival of more than ten stars, all he did was raise the sword in his arms and slash down abruptly, a terrifying shockwave erupted from his body, causing the more than ten stars to tremble and retreat.
“What’s the difference between a mortal star and a stray chicken or dog?”Chong Coix threw his head back and laughed loudly. The faces of the stars changed as they retreated and exclaimed in shock.
“An earth-grade star!”
Stars were divided into the heaven, earth, and profound Huang fan. The five levels were the weakest among the early-stage stars. The mortal level was the weakest, followed by the yellow level. The profound level was rare, and the earth level was even rarer. As for the heaven level... it could only be described as rare!
Therefore, the moment the earth level appeared, it could sweep across stars of the same level. At that moment, Chong Weizi was sweeping across the area. She laughed loudly as she strode towards the warship where Wang Baole was, laughing maniacally.
“Wang Baole, no one can save you. I really want to see what the Crushed Dao star looks like!”As Chong Weizi spoke, she was already a thousand feet away from the warship where Wang Baole was.
Inside the battleship, Xie Haiyang’s expression changed slightly, but he returned to normal in an instant. As for Chen Han, he didn’t seem to be worried at all. Instead, he crossed his arms over his chest, his eyes filled with contempt and disdain.
As for Wang Baole, there was a hint of curiosity in his eyes. He really wanted to know what level of combat strength he was currently at. If he were to test himself, he wouldn’t be able to let go. Now that he saw that someone had taken the initiative to approach him.., his interest had increased significantly.
Of course, the most important thing was that he saw the purple screen of light, as well as... the afterimage of the future that he had seen in the book of Heavenly Fate. There was a scene that wasn’t exactly the same as the one before his eyes, but it wasn’t much different.
“Purple Moon, huh...”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and released his control over the dao star in his body. In the blink of an eye, his dao star appeared outside the warship from a young age!
At first, it was just a speck of light, but it rapidly expanded to the size of an ordinary planet. This made Chong Yizi, who was approaching rapidly and was already seventy feet away, laugh.
“That’s it?”Chong Yizi seemed a little disappointed. He shook his head and approached again. When he was fifty feet away, his footsteps paused for the first time. The dao star in front of him was no longer the same size as before, it had expanded to the size of half a star.
“Interesting.”Chong Yizi’s eyes lit up. He laughed again, and his speed increased. He was three hundred feet away. However, in the next moment, his footsteps paused again. His eyes were filled with surprise, he looked at the Dao star that had expanded to the size of an ordinary star.
“Not bad, not bad. This is what makes it interesting!”Such a dao star did not deter Chong Yizi. Instead, after a pause, excitement and a strong desire to fight appeared on his face. His laughter grew louder, and he crossed another hundred feet, when he was only twenty feet away from where Wang Baole was, his footsteps... stopped for the third time.
Following that, he blinked rapidly, and the excitement in his eyes was shattered into confusion.
“What is this?”Chong Yizi muttered. He stared blankly at the terrifying star before him that was growing larger and larger. It was now three times the size of an ordinary star, and it was still expanding.
As he watched, the Dao Star continued to expand by five times, six times... until it reached a terrifying area that was ten times the size of an ordinary star.
It was like a small galaxy, and nine ancient, satellite-like planets appeared around the enormous dao star. They emanated shocking, earth-shattering power that shook the natural laws of the starry sky.
From a distance, the Majestic Dao Star looked like a cosmic eye that was staring at the incredibly tiny chong job son. His body trembled uncontrollably, and all of his excitement and fighting spirit instantly vanished.
Chong job son didn’t want to tremble, but he couldn’t control his body. The terrifying natural laws and power from the Dao star and its satellites affected and distorted his surroundings, causing all of his flesh and blood to tremble instinctively.
“This is... This is a planet?”As Chong Yizi muttered to himself, the confusion in his eyes finally turned into shock. He was silent for a few breaths..
Then, he suddenly turned around and retreated. He used almost all of his cultivation base to speed up, and fled frantically without looking back!

chapters.title: Chapter 1106
chapters.content:
Chapter 1106: was a little numb!
