Translator:
549690339
“Your sister, your sister!”
“Who told me that this is a Planet?”
“I’ve never seen such a freakish planet!”
Chong Weizi’s speed was so fast that it was like a ray of light. In an instant, she had retreated thousands of feet in front of Wang Baole. She did not stop, nor did she care about her reputation. Even when he had previously appeared, he had spoken arrogantly, even as he approached Wang Baole, he had done so in a disdainful manner.
However, there was nothing he could do. His clone was also a part of his original body. Once something happened to his clone, his original body would also be partially affected. The fear in his heart and the sense of danger that made his scalp tingle made Chong Weizi.., he hated himself for being too slow.
He was going crazy. He felt that he was the most unlucky person in the entire universe. It was as if he had placed his hopes on a girl. He had rushed into her room and locked the door with excitement, making it difficult for her to escape from his devilish grasp, however, the moment he pounced on her, the young lady had turned into a burly man who was even scarier and stronger than him..
Something must have gone wrong. How could this be... Chong Lizi howled in his heart. He felt even more regretful. He felt that it would have been great if the main body had arrived. Killing Wang Baole would have been effortless, however, the clone that only had thirty percent of the combat power of the main body now had no way to kill this planet that he had never heard of..
This drove him crazy. He cursed the existence who had told him that Wang Baole was only a planet. His speed became faster and faster, and in an instant, he was far away.
The surrounding Stellar Dao protectors weren’t surprised to see the reversal. In fact, when they saw the appearance of Chong Weizi, they had already predicted this scene.
Chen Han, on the other hand, had an arrogant look in his eyes as he snorted coldly.
“He dares to fight with Daddy. This kid must have lost his mind. He doesn’t know that Daddy will always be daddy!”
Xie Haiyang, who was standing at the side, heard those words. He felt uncomfortable no matter how he listened to them. His discomfort didn’t come from Wang Baole, but from his disdain for Chen Han. In his eyes, Chen Han was extremely shameless, he didn’t let go of any opportunity to flatter Wang baole. He had completely lost his dignity as a cultivator. This kind of person made him, who was full of righteousness and proud of the world, look down on others.
Therefore, after letting out a humph, Xie Haiyang’s face revealed a respectful and fanatical smile. He bowed deeply to Wang Baole and shouted excitedly.
......
“Congratulations, uncle-master. You have succeeded in your divine art. From now on, you are unrivaled and unrivaled in the world. I, Xie Haiyang, am the luckiest person in my life. I hope that uncle-master will allow me to follow uncle-master and listen to uncle-master’s teachings for the rest of my life!”! “Uncle-master!”
Hearing Xie Haiyang’s impassioned voice, Chen Han was instantly alarmed. He narrowed his eyes and swept Xie Haiyang a cold glance. He felt that this person was really detestable. He was of the same sex, but he was still trying to curry favor with his father. His intentions were definitely not pure, he snorted coldly and was about to continue running toward Wang Baole.
However, at that moment, a loud bang was heard from Chong Coix, who was about to escape from everyone’s sight. It was as if he had crashed into an invisible wall.
The sound spread in all directions, turning into ripples in the starry sky. As the sound spread, Chong Coix stood there with tears in his eyes. His head was dizzy, and his gaze was a little dazed. He stared blankly at the void before him, there was nothing to be seen with the naked eye. However, if one used their divine perception to observe carefully, they would still be able to see... that there was a purple screen of light around them..
It was sealed in all directions, blocking out karma, making the place seem independent..
The seal, which was originally meant to prevent Wang Baole from escaping and prevent the blazing flame ancestor from discovering him, had now become a barrier to Chong Coix.
It was obvious that the removal of the seal would require time... even the purple figure who had set up the seal did not expect such a reversal to occur. Therefore, the seal remained in place for a short while.
This... made Chong Coix zi even more frantic. When he paused, Wang Baole, who had revealed all of his dao stars, looked at Chong Coix’s figure, who had stopped in the distance, with interest, and said faintly, “You didn’t open the door?”.
“You closed the door yourself, but didn’t have the key to open it?”
Chong Coix Zi shuddered. He turned to look at the giant planet. He couldn’t see Wang Baole’s figure clearly on the planet. He could only see a vague outline. He was silent for a few breaths. Then, in an instant, his eyes lit up, they shone brightly.
He seemed to be in contrast to the figure that had fled earlier. He looked like a sharp sword that was about to be unsheathed. Rumbling sounds reverberated throughout his body, and his fighting spirit rose in an instant, surging in all directions, the expressions of the surrounding stellar dao protectors changed.
It was clear that Chong job was completely different from before. He wasn’t fleeing in a hurry, nor was he arrogant and arrogant. He was calm and composed, and at the same time, he exuded the aura of a powerful individual.
He stood there with his back facing the seal barrier. He stared at the planet where Wang Baole was and spoke calmly.
“I was indeed negligent in this matter. Wang Baole, I wish to leave and have nothing to do with you anymore. Do you agree with me?”
The change in his aura, coupled with his deep voice, caused Chong Coix to immediately give off the feeling that he shouldn’t continue provoking him. The surrounding stars and Dao protectors were also fearful, they looked at the planet that Wang Baole had transformed into.
Wang Baole didn’t say a word. He raised his right hand and pressed down on the spot where Job’s tears was. With that, his planet vibrated slightly and emitted a ball of light, as if it had transformed into a gigantic illusory palm, the nine quasi-dao stars around the planet also emitted light. They spread outwards rapidly and fused into the illusory palm, causing five fingers to appear!
In the end, the palm seemed to be able to turn the sky upside down. It brought with it the power of laws and laws as it charged into job’s tears!
Chong Job’s eyebrows shot up, and his body instantly shifted to the side. His aura changed again. He was no longer as calm as before. Instead, he exuded a domineering air, and his eyes narrowed, he exuded a terrifying light as well as a fierce look.
“Interesting. It seems that I really shouldn’t have only arranged for this 10% combat power clone to come. An opponent like you is worthy of my main body descending. As for you... Are You sure you want to fight to the death with me? !”As Chong Yizi spoke.., he had already grabbed the hilt of his sword, and the desire to fight in his eyes surged to the heavens!
In the instant that the illusory palm pounced on him, Chong Yizi suddenly pulled out the sword from his bosom and slashed it down toward the incoming palm!
The slash caused his star to materialize and merge with the sword. With an extremely sharp aura, it collided with the palm in the blink of an eye!
However... There was no loud boom. The moment the shocking sword Qi touched the palm, it was as if it had pressed a block of ice into water. It instantly sank into the palm and disappeared..
“That’s it?”Wang Baole was a little disappointed as he looked at Chong Weizi.
This scene changed Chong Coix’s aura once again. He forced out a smile that was uglier than crying as he spoke awkwardly.
“Fellow Daoist Wang, I think there must be a misunderstanding between us...”
Before he could finish speaking, Wang Baole shook his head. The illusory palm that he had conjured approached with a loud bang, not giving Chong Coix’s clone any chance. He didn’t even care about the person’s resistance or struggle, he enveloped the clone in an instant and grabbed the clone in his palm.
Without any hesitation, Wang Baole raised his right hand and clenched it slightly. Immediately, the illusory palm that he had conjured was the same. With a loud boom... he couldn’t even let out a scream before the clone’s body exploded.
As Wang Baole opened his palm once again, everything in the illusory palm was reduced to ashes.
“Too weak.”Wang baole shook his head slightly. Everyone around him was shocked. They looked at Wang Baole in shock, not noticing the calm and disappointed Wang Baole, he retracted his palm and shook it gently..
It was a little numb and painful.
However, Wang Baole would never reveal any of it. After returning from the fated star, he realized that he had fallen in love with the attitude of a supreme being. He felt a little regretful at that moment. There were too few onlookers around him, but the attitude that he should have had.., he still had to integrate himself into his daily life. Therefore, Wang Baole maintained his calm and composed attitude. He retrieved the planet and returned to the battleship. A faint voice that seemed to have remained unchanged since ancient times rang out.
“Let’s set off.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1107
chapters.content:
Chapter 1107:, the main body descended!
Translator:
549690339
Just as Wang Baole’s planet transformed into a giant hand and destroyed Chong Job’s clone, which was still useless despite its ever-changing aura, the first sect of the left Dao sacred region, within the mountain gate of the Nine Prefectures Dao.., chong Job’s main body, which was floating in the starry sky like a vast star, suddenly opened its eyes!
As it opened its eyes, a sea of fire instantly appeared in its eyes. The fire instantly spread out and covered the entire area, enveloping a large area in flames.
The Void was burned, and the starry sky distorted. Chong job-ee, who was sitting there, instantly withered his left arm. His face turned paler. He didn’t spit out any blood, but his aura was much weaker.
He opened his eyes in shock, and a sinister look appeared on his face. He frowned slowly.
His clone has fallen? Chong job-ee’s expression was ugly, but he didn’t know the exact process. The seal was able to interfere with karma and block out the mighty figures in the galaxy. He would be affected even if he was inside.
That was why the memories the clone sent back were limited to seeing Wang Baole’s battleship fly out and the seven or eight stellar dao protectors. Everything behind it was blank.
Could there be a powerful cultivator hiding inside Wang Baole’s battleship? or could there be an extraordinary person among his dao protectors... or could it be that exalted Heavenly Dharma is helping him? Chong Yizi couldn’t understand, however, he felt that the last possibility was the smallest, and the biggest possibility... was that there was someone among the dao protectors who was not weak.
The thought of Wang Baole personally killing his clone didn’t exist in Chong Coix Zi’s mind. What couldn’t have happened naturally didn’t appear in his mind.
The Blazing Flame Patriarch really loves this disciple... Chong Coix zi snorted coldly. He narrowed his eyes and lowered his head to look at his withered left arm. Killing intent flashed in his eyes.
“How dare he destroy my clone? How can this matter end like this? Patriarch Flame might be powerful, but it’s not like I don’t have a Master!”Having reached this point in his train of thought, he narrowed his eyes and slowly rose to his feet. As he did, the starry sky around him began to rumble, it was as if an enormous pressure were emanating out from him, causing the starry sky in all directions to be unable to withstand the pressure. Cracks began to appear on the surface of the starry sky.
In fact, numerous threads of natural law could be seen materializing out of thin air, twisting and distorting his surroundings. It was as if they were a foil to his surroundings, causing his aura to be shocking.
In truth, that was indeed the case. As a late-stage star, Chong Weizi was an earth-grade star, and therefore possessed incredible battle prowess. Even someone at the great circle of the Black Realm would not be a match for him, not to mention that he had been in closed-door cultivation for many years to break through to the great circle. Although he had not reached it yet, he was only a hair’s breadth away.
And once he reached the great circle, what was placed in front of him would be a test like a fish leaping over the dragon’s gate. If he succeeded... then the nine regions Dao would have one more mighty figure from the celestial domain!
......
At the same time, this was more related to the struggle for the orthodoxy within the nine Regions Dao. It was a competition between him and the first dao child who was not a zero. Whoever became the celestial domain first would be able to take over the nine Regions Dao’s orthodoxy.
“At this critical moment, you destroyed my clone...”a cold light flickered in Chong Job’s eyes. He was very frustrated. If he didn’t owe him a favor, he wouldn’t have attacked at this time. However, now that his clone was destroyed, if he didn’t deal with it.., his Dao Heart wasn’t perfect, and it would also affect his cultivation base.
“That’s fine. I’ll bring back a dao star and see if it can be of any additional help to me.”With that thought, Chong job rose to his feet, causing the starry sky in all directions to tremble. His body flickered, and in the blink of an eye, he left the nine Regions Dao’s mountain galaxy, when he reappeared, he was already in the vast starry skies. He raised his right hand and did some calculations. He raised his head and took large strides, one step at a time, towards the spot where his clone had died!
At the same time, in the starry skies far away from Chong Weizi, the warship that Wang Baole was on was also moving at an astonishing speed. It kept moving forward, and its target was very clear. It was the entrance to the meteorite land.
Although there was a large area from here to the entrance of the Starfall, it was still much shorter than the distance between Chong Yizi and the Starfall. Therefore, even if the latter was faster, with the speed of the battleship, the battleship and the Starfall entrance.., still getting closer.
Half a month later, Wang Baole could vaguely see the empty white galaxy in the distance as the warship sped along.
From Afar, the white galaxy looked the same as what Wang Baole remembered. That Was... the paper galaxy, or rather, the paper galaxy.
At the edge, the warship stopped. As Xie Haiyang and Chen Han were curious, Wang Baole walked out of the warship and looked at the paper galaxy in front of him. After a moment of silence, he did not ride the warship to show his respect, instead, he left the battleship and the people in it outside. He walked forward and stepped into the paper galaxy.
The moment he stepped in, waves of ripples spread out from under his feet, causing the paper galaxy to ripple and rise and fall like a sea of paper.
Wang Baole’s expression was the same as ever. He continued walking forward. A few days later, he arrived at the center of the paper galaxy, where the meteorite cruiser had stopped. He stood there and looked at the void around him. Wang Baole cupped his fists, he bowed forward.
“An old friend has come to visit. I wonder if senior meteorite emperor will allow me to enter.”
He had been acting like an expert the entire journey, and he had gained the ability to look down on the entire world of the stone tablet due to the knowledge he had gained from his previous life. However, Wang Baole knew very well when it would be beneficial to him, when it would be disadvantageous to him.
For example, he had to put away his attitude now. Otherwise, it would backfire.
After bowing, Wang Baole didn’t panic. Instead, he waited silently. After about ten breaths, an ancient voice reverberated throughout the paper starry sky.
“Please!”
As the voice rang out, the entire paper starry sky began to fluctuate violently. As the ripples spread, the paper starry sky began to fold in half, then in half, then in half, just like a piece of paper.
After the endless folding, the paper starry sky became smaller and smaller, but its height grew higher and higher. This didn’t seem logical, but it was the truth. Xie Haiyang, Chen Han, and the others, who were outside the paper starry sky, saw this, this scene shocked them, but they also felt that Wang Baole was even more mysterious.
That was because they knew that other than a fixed invitation, the meteorite land didn’t care about the outside world. Even if a mighty figure from the star domain arrived and wasn’t allowed to enter, the mighty figure from the star domain would have no choice but to leave.
However, Wang Baole... had arrived here and successfully entered. This made Xie Haiyang even more determined towards Wang Baole, and it made Chen Han even more proud of his status as the son of man.
Amidst their determination and pride, their gazes met subconsciously.
“HMPH!”
“HMPH!”
They quickly moved away from each other..
Similarly, they saw the paper starry sky where Wang Baole was, and the scene of the paper being folded infinitely. There was also... Chong Yizi’s true form, who was currently far away in the starry sky, walking out of thin air. He stood there, clearly very eye-catching, however, Xie Haiyang and the others didn’t notice anything.
They stared at the paper starry sky that was being folded continuously. They watched as the height of the paper became more and more astonishing, until it turned into a streak of white light and disappeared into the starry sky. Chong Yizi’s eyes narrowed solemnly.
That was because he had already seen Xie Haiyang and the others’battleships. He hadn’t seen any cultivator in there who could threaten his clone. This caused many guesses to arise in his heart.
“The person who killed my clone has left?”
“Or is it that the other party came from the fallen star land?”
“Interesting...”while muttering, Chong Weizi glanced at Xie Haiyang and Chen Han’s battleships. Then, he withdrew his gaze and did not bother with them anymore. He also did not have any thoughts of capturing them or searching their souls. He was too confident, he disdained to know the answer in advance.
He liked the unknown, because it would make a dull life more colorful. He smiled faintly and sat cross-legged in the starry skies.
He believed that Wang Baole, who had entered the fallen star lands, would eventually come out. The answer to everything would be revealed when he killed Wang Baole after he came out.
“I hope I won’t be disappointed.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1108
chapters.content:
Chapter 1108:!
Translator:
549690339
In the starry sky, as the paper galaxy continued to fold in half, and when it completely disappeared from everyone’s sight, in another void, the world before Wang Baole’s eyes changed abruptly.
It was still the vast sea of paper, but it was no longer black, but white. As for the sky, the Sun, and even the flying birds and seagulls, they were all familiar paper-like existences.
A kindness that came from the will of the entire world emanated from heaven and earth and from all living things. It filled Wang Baole’s surroundings, as if he was delighted and welcoming.
Waves rose from the Sea of paper around him, as if they were worshipping him. This feeling made Wang baole feel comfortable inside and outside his body, and it was even more intimate.
“Welcome back to the land of the fallen stars.”Wang Baole turned his head. He was no longer in nothingness. Instead, he was in a boat. The paper figure paddling in front of him was the one he was familiar with back then, the paper figurine turned its head and looked at Wang Baole.
“Senior, how have you been?”Wang Baole took a deep breath and cupped his fists in greeting.
The paper figurine grinned and cupped his fists at Wang Baole as well. Then, it paddled on the paper pulp and broke through the waves. A gust of wind blew against him, blowing up Wang Baole’s hair. Then, it didn’t leave. Instead, it stayed around him, it turned into gentleness, as if it was dancing.
Wang Baole smiled. After returning to the fallen star, he felt the kindness of the world. He felt an unrestrained freedom and safety. He decided to sit on the deck of the ship. He raised his right hand and took out a bottle of ice spirit water, he looked at the world around him. In his comfort, he drank one mouthful after another, as if he was drinking alcohol.
“We have an important guest visiting. How can we let him drink alone?”Wang Baole had only taken a few gulps when a voice reverberated around him. The waves churned again, and a paper figurine rose from the surface of the sea. Step by step, it walked onto the ship, it stopped beside Wang Baole, and it raised its right hand and extended it towards Wang Baole.
Even though the paper figurine looked similar, Wang Baole could already tell at a glance that the paper figurine walking towards him was the first emperor of the Starfall Empire who had been in his storage bag back then.
When Wang Baole had obtained the Dao Star and left the Starfall Empire, the first emperor had chosen to stay behind. He had stayed deep within the sea of paper to guard the newly sealed mouth of the mirror vortex.
Looking at the first emperor’s outstretched hand, Wang Baole stood up with a smile and bowed. Then, he took out a bottle of ice spirit water and handed it over. Wang Baole wasn’t worried about whether the first emperor would be able to drink it. To a mighty figure like the first emperor.., the body was just like clothes. It wasn’t important.
That was indeed the case. After receiving the ice spirit water, the first emperor of the paper figurine raised his head and took a big gulp. Just as he was about to let out his usual sigh after drinking, his expression changed. He lowered his head and looked at the ice spirit water in his hand carefully, then, he looked at Wang Baole.
......
“What is this? It’s So Sweet.”
“Is it good? This is my favorite drink. In the entire universe, only the federation produces it. It’s called Ice Spirit Water.”Wang baole blinked and looked at the paper figurine.
The paper figurine remained silent for a few breaths as it silently tasted the ice spirit water in its hand. After a long while, it curled its lips and placed it aside, looking at Wang Baole.
“You’re early.”
“Senior, you don’t seem to be surprised by my arrival?”Wang Baole smiled upon hearing that.
“When you left that day, I had a premonition that one day, you would return to this place and search for the whirlpool beneath the Sea of paper.”
Wang Baole didn’t say anything immediately. Instead, he lowered his head and looked at the Sea of paper. The whirlpool at the bottom of the Sea of paper was one of his goals for coming here.
He wanted to verify whether the whirlpool was the same one he had seen in his first life, the one that had appeared in the three-foot-long black wood. However, he didn’t plan to go now. He wanted to break through on his own, he would explore it once he reached the star realm.
After some thought, Wang Baole turned to the emperor before him and cupped his fists slightly.
“I have come to seek permission from the Emperor and the Starfall Empire to summon a special planet and... upgrade to a star here!”Wang Baole’s expression was solemn as he looked at the Emperor of the paper figurine generation.
“It’s a small matter. How many do you need?”The Emperor of the paper figurine generation asked in a relaxed tone. On one hand, Wang Baole was a benefactor to the Starfall Empire. On the other hand, he had an impressive background. Naturally, he wouldn’t reject such a request, after all, there were more than ten thousand unique planets in the Starfall Empire. It wasn’t a big deal to give some away.
“This... is about ten thousand?”Wang Baole asked in a low voice, a little embarrassed.
”...”the first emperor of the paper figurine fell silent. He picked up the ice spirit water that he had placed aside and took a big gulp. He couldn’t help but ask.
“Are you sure you only need to upgrade to a star?”
“I plan to use the tens of thousands of unique stars as embellishments. As I transform them into a starry sky, my dao star will be raised and my dao star will break through and evolve from a planet to a Star!”Wang Baole knew what he was asking for, basically, he had emptied out about ninety percent of the capital of the Starfall Empire. Therefore, after he finished speaking, he added another sentence.
“If there’s anything that you need me to do, please tell me. Also... If you can’t give me that much, I can give you less... that’s fine too...”
“I can make the decision if it’s less than a thousand, but if it’s ten thousand... I’m no longer in charge of the current Starfall Empire... That’s why even though I want to give it to you, I can’t make a decision. The emperor is here. You can ask him yourself.”The first emperor of the paper figurine cleared his throat, he looked into the distance as if he was trying to shift the blame. Naturally, Wang Baole realized that something was wrong. He felt a headache coming on. As he pondered how he could get the other party to agree, he raised his head and looked over. Soon, they saw more than a hundred paper figurine charging towards them from the distance.
The paper figure in front of them was the current emperor of the Starfall Empire. The ripples from the galaxy around him were extremely powerful. He landed on the ship as he took a step forward and smiled at Wang Baole.
Wang Baole greeted him with a smile. He hesitated for a moment before saying the same words as before. The Emperor of the Starfall Empire hesitated as well. He exchanged glances with the first generation patriarch and fell silent for a moment, it was obvious that he was in a difficult position. He was about to decline politely.
However, at that moment... The Sky, which had been bright during the day, suddenly rumbled. Distorted ripples reverberated in the sky. It was as if a white curtain had been lifted by someone, revealing the Black Sky!
In the sky, the light of the stars rapidly materialized. When the stars of all levels were added together, the number exceeded a million. It spread across the entire starry sky. Faintly, the will of the entire meteorite land came from within, it seemed to have turned into a voice that reverberated in the minds of Wang Baole and the two emperor paper figurines.
“But!”
The reverberation of the will caused the two emperor paper figurines to look at each other again. The current emperor had an awkward expression on his face.
“Baole, Don’t blame me for hesitating earlier. It’s really...”
“What’s there to hesitate about? I’ve already said that there’s no problem with this matter. Wang Baole is the benefactor of the meteorite empire. His request is worth a hundred thousand, let alone ten thousand. We are all willing to repay his kindness as a person!”The first generation elder of the paper figurines was obviously thick-skinned, he was the same age as the first generation paper figurine ancestor. Therefore, after sensing that the entire world’s will had agreed, he immediately spoke with a solemn tone and reprimanded his junior at the same time.
“You’re right, ancestor.”The current emperor of the star Meteor Empire smiled bitterly when he heard that and bowed to the first generation emperor. The first generation emperor coughed and waved his hand.
“Baole, I’ll give you this starry sky. I don’t ask for anything else. I only hope that one day, when you have the strength and opportunity to truly enter the Vortex, you will bring me along!”His tone was rather magnanimous. Wang baole blinked his eyes, he suppressed his laughter and hurriedly thanked him. At the same time, he nodded his head seriously. After agreeing to the matter, he took a deep breath and didn’t wait any longer. He leaped into the air and headed straight for the starry sky!
In the eyes of the surrounding paper figures, Wang Baole was like a shooting star. As he flew continuously into the starry skies, his dao star appeared outside his body.
The dao star expanded rapidly. In an instant, it reached a terrifying level. The nine ancient stars around him materialized as well. They seemed to be cheering, but they also seemed to be yearning. They accompanied Wang Baole and merged into the starry skies.
In the starry sky, the countless starlight dimmed automatically. It seemed like they didn’t dare compete for Glory. They seemed to be paying their respects, but they also seemed to be suppressing their excitement. It was as if they possessed a certain level of intelligence. They could sense... this opportunity.., to them, it was an opportunity for the stars to transform!
When Wang Baole’s figure completely merged into the starry sky, his voice suddenly reverberated.
“Please bear witness that I, Wang Baole, will be promoted to a star here today!”
As soon as he said that, the millions of stars in the starry skies seemed to be excited, and they shone brightly!
—
They were halfway through writing, and the live broadcast lasted for a few minutes. Did anyone see that? hahahaha, they were a little shy

chapters.title: Chapter 1109
chapters.content:
Chapter 1109:, the return of the stars
Translator:
549690339
Sigh, if only girls were like these stars. With just a word from me, they would all be excited. That would be great. Wang Baole stood in the starry sky, looking at the excitement and brilliance of the millions of stars around him. He didn’t know why, but.., he had such a strange thought.
However, in order to maintain the status of an expert he had gained after comprehending his previous life, he could only put these thoughts to the bottom of his heart. On the surface, he was as calm as water. He was calm and unhurried, reflecting on the extraordinary feeling he had gained in his previous life, his performance was perfect.
However, he had forgotten that little Missy had a hobby of prying into his thoughts. Therefore, almost the moment Wang Baole’s sigh appeared, he heard a cold laugh.
“Is this the reason why you dream of becoming the Federation President?”
Wang Baole’s body trembled, and he nearly lost his status as an expert. He thought for a moment, sighed softly, and spoke in his mind with deep affection.
“The madness of a million girls may be good, but they are all to set off my dao star. Little Missy, you... are the Eternal Dao Star in my heart, causing my eyes to be filled with you!”
“Ptui!”Little Missy’s angry voice responded to Wang Baole. However, from her voice, Wang Baole could still sense the change in her emotions. He coughed, and his expression became solemn. He sat down cross-legged, he was completely immersed in the circulation of his cultivation, and a strange glow appeared in his eyes.
Little Missy knew that this was the crucial moment for Wang Baole. She spat and didn’t speak. Instead, she watched silently. As she watched, Wang Baole’s cultivation circulated faster and faster.
From the beginning, it took four breaths of time for his cultivation to circulate through his entire body. Then, it accelerated to one breath of time. As his speed increased, Wang Baole’s body became like a huge furnace, emitting a high temperature, it was absorbed by the Dao stars outside his body, causing the light from the dao stars to become brighter and brighter. Even the nine ancient stars around him absorbed a portion of it, causing the light to become brighter and brighter.
It’s not enough... Wang Baole’s eyes shone with a sharp light, and he was filled with anticipation. Before he went to the raging flame galaxy, he had some understanding of the stellar grade, but he didn’t have a complete understanding of it. As the raging flame ancestor sat down and cultivated.., as he read through a large number of ancient texts, his understanding of the stellar grade increased greatly.
He knew very well that stars were divided into heaven, earth, and Huang fan. It was rare to see a person of these five levels reach the mystic grade, and it was usually due to a certain amount of luck. For example, among his dao protectors, there was one at the mystic grade, this person had an unusual status among the stars in the Raging Flame Galaxy.
Previously, when Chong Yizi attacked, this person seemed to have been defeated as well. However, in reality, his injuries were minimal. This was the strength of a black-grade star. As for the earth-grade star... it could only be described as rare, like Chong Yizi.., it was the earth-grade star!
However, he was the Second Dao child of the first sect of the left Dao sacred region. From this, one could see how rare the earth-grade star was. In the entire raging flame galaxy, there might have been earth-grade stars in the past. However, now..
......
There are no more. As Wang Baole muttered to himself, he retracted his thoughts from the raging flame galaxy. His understanding of heaven-grade stars surfaced in his mind.
Heaven-grade stars were extremely rare in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain. There seemed to be some secrets involved. That was why, from ancient times until now, only the royal family of the Weiyang clan had ever had a heaven-grade star!
Regardless of whether it was heaven-grade or mortal-grade, the method of advancing to a star was similar. They would find a star of sufficient level and fuse it into their bodies. After fusing with their bodies, they would make a breakthrough and form a galaxy within their bodies.
Therefore, the star grade also had another name, which was the galaxy grade!
As for the original planet, it would also become the first planet in the galaxy after the breakthrough.
However, at this time, regardless of whether it was the heaven or the mortal level, although there was a gap, it was not as big as the gap between heaven and earth. The strength between them was mainly reflected in the later cultivation and accommodation, just like a container.., if the mortal level was just a cup, then the earth level would be a huge water tank, and the heaven level would be a pool!
The higher the grade, the more stars that could be contained in the subsequent cultivation. To a certain extent, the cultivation of a star-grade cultivator, in addition to their own cultivation techniques, was to devour and fuse with the stars to complete the transformation of their own body.
When they reached the pinnacle, their own galaxy would be infinitely vast and turn into a galaxy. At that time, it would be the moment when the star-grade cultivator broke through their own cultivation.
But what I Want... is not these five levels, but above them... even rarer than a phoenix feather or a qilin horn. The legendary... Dao-level Star! Wang baole’s eyes shone brightly. Dao-level.., this was a level that could only be achieved after one possessed a dao star and had great opportunities!
It was to allow a dao star to advance to the Permanent Dao realm!
This was something that only the first generation patriarch of the never-ending clan had done before. After him, no one else had been able to do it. After all, there were too few Dao stars and even fewer opportunities to advance to the Permanent Dao realm. Therefore, no method of advancement had been spread, they had to rely on themselves to figure it out.
On the way here, Wang Baole had already figured out a few methods. For example, the reason why he had been constantly increasing the speed of his cultivation was one of the methods he had analyzed, it was the method that he had considered the most likely to achieve.
He increased the speed of his cultivation, causing his body to continuously emit high temperatures like a fireball. He allowed the fluctuations of his planet to reach its peak, allowing him to sense... the opportunity for a breakthrough.
As his thoughts spun, Wang Baole didn’t hesitate at all. The cultivation in his body increased the speed of his cultivation. It gradually changed from one cycle of one breath to three cycles of one breath, five cycles of one day, and ten cycles of one day. He felt that he had reached his limit.
His Dao stars, under the crazy rotation of his cultivation, became extremely hot. The sky above the fallen stars seemed to be burning, and a fiery red glow appeared. The paper figures on the Sea of paper looked at it, their expressions changed.
As their expressions changed, Wang Baole grew anxious. He had already reached his limit of ten cycles of one breath. He couldn’t hold on for too long in this state, however... he still didn’t feel any signs of advancement.
My instincts tell me that as long as I burn my dao star and consume the power of my dao star, I’ll be able to advance in one leap. However, I don’t want to burn it and consume it! Wang Baole’s eyes flashed. Immediately, the shadow of a zombie appeared outside his body, the illusion of a resentful weapon appeared, as did the illusions of other lives. The Little White Deer was among them. It spread out and merged with his Dao Star, causing the Dao Star to tremble violently. It was as if it had been given a boost of power. Light and heat.., it exploded.
The entire sky in the fallen star area lit up instantly. The dark night turned into a vast expanse of white. As it exploded, it merged with the Dao Star. Wang baole, who was indistinguishable from the rest.., he finally felt a faint barrier!
The barrier seemed to have some sort of restriction that prevented the dao star from advancing. It was as if there was a boundary in the universe. Only by leaping like a fish through the dragon’s Gate, allowing the Dao Star to leap up and cross the boundary that had collapsed, could it advance successfully!
He had instinctively felt that as long as he allowed the Dao Star to burn and consume more energy, it would be the same. That was because burning would give him more motivation to leap up. That was because the consumption would reduce the amount of energy that the dao star would consume, allowing it to leap up more easily!
However, he wasn’t willing!
At that moment, Wang Baole raised his head abruptly. His voice was solemn and solemn, and it reverberated throughout the entire sky.
“Among the stars that fill the sky... who is willing to accompany me? To walk the galaxy and see the real starry sky!”
As soon as he spoke, the millions of stars that were already shining with excitement went crazy. The light erupted with an unprecedented intensity, causing the starlight in the sky to be countless and vast.
There were tens of thousands of stars within. The light was the strongest. Those were... special stars. As they shone intensely, Wang Baole raised his right hand. His eyes were filled with determination as he spoke softly.
“Return to your positions!”
As his words reverberated, the millions of stars roared and rushed towards Wang Baole. However, the tens of thousands of special stars within were the fastest. In the blink of an eye, they surpassed the other stars, they arrived directly around Wang Baole and surrounded him. They seemed to have formed a stance with each other. As they excluded the other non-special stars, they gathered their strength and released the Starlight, merging into Wang Baole’s Dao Star!
The moment the light from the tens of thousands of special stars merged into it, Wang Baole’s Dao Star’s aura instantly surged. Its range expanded once again, and its aura reached a level that caused the expressions of most of the paper figurines to change drastically.
Wang Baole seemed to be able to hold on all of a sudden. His breathing quickened, and he formed a seal with both hands. He stood up straight from his cross-legged position and let out a low roar.
“Star-sealing rise!”
— Fu —
Tonight, at 6 p.m. , I was broadcasting live in Douyu. My room number was 9199288. Cough, cough. I heard that five girls had transformed into characters from my book and invited me to eat chicken... Don’t get me wrong. It’s a spirit tail chicken... ...

chapters.title: Chapter 1110
chapters.content:
Chapter 1110: godlike!
Translator:
549690339
The moment Wang Baole spoke..
The tens of thousands of unique stars returned to their original positions and merged all the Starlight into the Dao Stars!
The moment Wang Baole stood up and extended his arms, a huge star chart appeared behind him!
The star chart was the shape of a cow. It was small at first, but it expanded instantly and grew larger. Everyone who saw it was shocked. Eventually, amidst the rumbling sounds, the star chart covered more than half of the starry sky, other than the tens of thousands of unique stars that had fused into the star chart, the other stars had no choice but to retreat and make space for it. When everyone looked up, they even felt as if the star chart had replaced the starry sky.
Only Wang Baole’s Dao Star was at the core of the star chart. It was like a huge furnace that was burning fiercely!
The star chart also encompassed the tens of thousands of unique stars. At that moment, the tens of thousands of unique stars seemed to return to their original positions within the star chart. They were arranged according to certain rules. In the blink of an eye, the cow.., it shone with boundless light, as if it had transcended the mortal realm and become a divine cow. However, it was not clear, but rather a little blurry!
One could see that the divine cow had its eyes closed and did not open. It seemed to be in a deep sleep, but even so, its body still emitted an aura that caused the entire fallen star region to be shaken!
It was mighty, it was divine courage, and it was a domineering aura that could shake the heavens and shake the heavens once it opened its eyes!
“This is...”the first emperor of the Starfall Empire’s pupils constricted. Beside him, the current emperor of the Starfall Empire’s expression changed when he saw the Divine ox star chart.
Such a domineering aura... is this the projection of the Starfield? The two exchanged glances and saw the shock in each other’s eyes.
However, their shock wasn’t over yet. A new change appeared once again. Wang Baole’s eyes shone with intense anticipation. The star sealing art in his body started operating abruptly. He flew from the first level to the third level, then to the fourth level.., after a brief pause, he broke through and reached the fifth level!
With each breakthrough, the Divine Ox’s glow grew stronger by a third!
During this process, the giant divine ox star chart quickly turned from blurry to clear. When Wang Baole’s star sealing art reached its peak, the tens of thousands of unique stars.., they immediately replaced the meteorites that were originally stored in the Divine ox star chart. They replaced all the ordinary stars within, covering all the immortal stars within. This caused the divine ox star chart to emit a blinding glow.
......
The light made the starry sky lose its color, made all things dim, and made all eyes seem as if they were about to turn into eternity. It even covered up the light of the Dao stars that were like a furnace!
It enveloped the entire meteorite land in its light!
Wang Baole’s body trembled. It wasn’t easy for him to push the star sealing technique divine ox, which was formed from tens of thousands of special stars, alone. He had taken the opportunity to successfully break through to the fifth level of the star sealing technique.
However, after sensing it, Wang Baole still felt that that wasn’t enough to lift his even heavier dao star. If he wanted to advance... he needed to go one step further!
In my deduction, the star-sealing art exists on the sixth level! Wang Baole’s eyes shone with a strange light, he took a deep breath in the starry sky and immediately activated the DAO star that had been formed at the core of the star map. The dao star spun with a loud rumble. The power of law spread from it, and the surrounding satellites erupted, gathering the laws.
All of this caused the dao star’s light to shine brightly once again. It was so bright that it surpassed the divine ox star map. It was as if a new source of light had been injected into the star map, causing the light of the star map to be enhanced and strengthened.
This indirectly pushed the star sealing incantation to rotate once again!
The originally dazzling and shocking state rose once again. With the help of more than ten thousand special stars, as well as the power of his own dao star, the light of the Divine ox star map reached an extreme level of brightness. Finally, it exploded with a bang!
It broke through the limit and reached an unprecedented level... the sixth level!
Booming sounds were like heavenly thunder. They continued to explode, as if they could cause the galaxy to explode. They continued to reverberate in the hearts and minds of all the living beings in the fallen star area, becoming the only one.
Almost at the instant the star sealing incantation reached the sixth level, the divine ox trembled. Its eyes also opened under the attack, revealing two rays of extreme light that were formed from countless starlight.
When the light entered the eyes of all living beings in the fallen star land, it caused all the paper men to tremble. At the same time that they trembled, the divine ox that had opened its eyes threw its head back and let out a roar that shook the world!
Moo! !
It was as if... It was alive!
At the same time, outside the fallen star land, in the left Dao holy region, in the Raging Flame Galaxy, the Divine Ox’s true body, which was sleeping in the starry sky outside the main star, also trembled the instant the divine ox roared, he opened his eyes and looked into the starry skies. A strange glow appeared in his eyes at that moment. Beside him, the blazing flame ancestor’s body also materialized and looked into the distance.
“I didn’t expect my disciple to begin his advancement so quickly!”An ancient voice came from either the blazing flame ancestor or the divine bull. As it reverberated in all directions, Wang Baole’s senior brothers on the raging flame main star.., also have raised their heads, staring at the starry sky, as if the vision can penetrate the void, see the falling stars outside the land, at this moment gathered to the majestic vortex.
The whirlpool was attracted by Wang Baole’s promotion. It condensed from nothingness and silently circled the starry sky, causing Xie Haiyang and the others to be shocked. They didn’t know why, but they could guess what was happening, perhaps it had something to do with Wang Baole.
“It’s just the advancement to a star. There’s no need to be so grand...”Xie Haiyang took a deep breath and mumbled.
“Shut up. How can you mortals know about Daddy’s prowess? HMPH, mortal, you don’t even know where Daddy came from. If you say it out loud, it’ll scare the hell out of you. My Daddy... is the father of all living beings!”Chen Han was shocked as well, however, when he heard Xie Haiyang’s words, he immediately gave up and spoke proudly. The dao protectors behind him all lowered their heads, as if they felt that the young master seemed to have become a different person after returning from the fated star, words always made people feel ashamed..
“Your father isn’t here. What’s the point of trying so hard to flatter him!”Xie Haiyang glared at Chen Han unhappily.
“Mortal!”Chen Han crossed his arms over his chest and snorted, as if he didn’t care to explain further.
Chong Weizi, who had been waiting here without anyone knowing, was also shocked from afar. He quickly turned his head to look at the vortex that was slowly spreading around him, then at the entrance to the fallen star that Wang Baole had disappeared into earlier, his expression was one of shock, and he had a vague feeling that something bad was about to happen.
This is the aura of the tribulation... What’s going on
As the outside world shook, the same thing happened in the fallen star. The world changed, and the wind and clouds swirled. Amidst the rumbles, the first emperor of the fallen star held his breath.
“Breaking through to a planet can actually attract the aura of the tribulation... quick, set up the Array Formation!”
As he spoke, the emperor of the fallen star, as well as all the officials, immediately spread out their cultivation, their hearts palpitating. The array formation of the Empire also began to operate abruptly, causing layers of white light to rise across the entire fallen star, they covered the skies.
As for Wang Baole, his aura had reached its limits. He had made ample preparations. After a few breaths of silence, Wang Baole suddenly raised his head and spoke in a deep voice.
“Lift my dao star... break through the void and ascend to the star of the Eternal Dao!”
As soon as he spoke, Wang Baole waved his hands. Immediately, his dao star and the nine satellites rose from the Divine Ox’s body and floated above the Divine Ox’s head!
As the divine ox raised its head, its eyes lit up. It raised its head to the sky and once again emitted an overwhelming aura. It roared in all directions, and its domineering aura was extremely violent. It shook its body and pushed against the Dao Star, it carried Wang Baole and headed toward the starry sky, toward the invisible boundary. It was like a fish leaping over the dragon’s gate... It charged forward!
From Afar, this scene was reflected in the eyes of everyone in the fallen star. They would never forget it for the rest of their lives!
In that scene... The Divine Bull was mighty, Majestic, and domineering. It charged crazily towards the end of the sky with the Heavenly Dao star that looked like it was about to turn into a scarlet sun!
On its back, Wang Baole, dressed in white and with his long hair fluttering in the wind, had a calm expression on his face. His gaze was calm, and his hands were clasped behind his back. He looked like... a God!
—
I’ll go and make some preparations before starting the live broadcast. I heard that there will be a game segment (covering my face) . I’m a rookie... ... And I’m nervous, and I’m going live for the first time in my life, so I’m Gonna need you to come and support me and give me some courage... ... Douyu, search for “Ear Root,”and you’re good to go, 6:00

chapters.title: Chapter 1111
chapters.content:
Chapter 1111:, Dao Heng!
Translator:
549690339
The celestial was tall and straight. There was not a single trace of fatty on him. All that could be seen was a mountain-like, pine-like figure standing tall between heaven and earth!
His clothes fluttered in the wind, and he stood on a star ox. The dao star above his head transformed into a beam of light that seemed to be eternally visible in the sky. With the help of the Divine Ox’s power, he lifted the Dao Star... and shot straight up into the sky!
It grew higher and higher!
At that moment, the sky began to change, and the wind and clouds began to swirl. Rumbling sounds in all directions transformed into bolts of lightning that exploded out in all directions throughout the entire fallen star region!
At the same time, the Divine Ox let out a shocking roar, and the Dao Star it lifted up began to rapidly turn crimson. It was as if there was an enormous furnace within it, which emanated boundless flames that caused the temperature of the DAO Star to rise, it seemed to have reached an extreme, spreading outwards. Everyone who saw it seemed to have seen... a Sun!
At that moment, everyone in the fallen star area held their breaths. At that moment, all the cultivators who saw the scene felt their hearts thump!
As their hearts thump, the Divine Bull sped up. The light from the dao stars grew brighter and brighter, and the flames within grew stronger and stronger. Finally... at the end of the sky, the Divine Bull, which was charging forward aggressively, suddenly stopped in its tracks!
It was as if there was an invisible barrier in front of it, preventing the advancement of the Dao stars and the leap of the Divine Bull. As it stopped, Wang Baole, who was standing on the back of the Divine Bull, had a sharp look in his eyes.
He could feel the barrier. He could even see and sense the various repulsive forces emanating from within the invisible barrier. It was like a seal, like a suppressive force.
“Heaven does not wish for the Dao to become eternal, which is why there are restrictions...”Wang Baole muttered. This was exactly the same as what he had experienced previously.
“However... all my preparations have been accumulated in order to break this restriction!”Wang baole’s eyes shone brightly. He raised both his hands and waved them violently!
Immediately, a vast force seemed to accumulate within the Divine Ox’s body. It suppressed everything in all directions, causing the Divine Ox’s two front hooves to bend slightly in the sky. It was as if the void beneath its feet was like land, and it was making its final preparations!
“The most critical moment has arrived!”
......
“Legend has it that Dao stars are as constant as a fish leaping over a dragon’s gate. One has to break through the limits of the Starry Skies!”
The first generation patriarch and the Emperor of the fallen star looked at each other solemnly. Their cultivation levels were high, but even they had only heard of such a scene where Dao stars were as constant as a dragon’s Gate in legends. They had witnessed it with their own eyes, it was the first time in their lives!
As they looked over, Wang Baole suddenly lowered his raised hands and let out a low growl!
“Rise!”
As he spoke, the divine ox beneath his feet trembled and let out an even louder roar. As it roared, its majestic body charged forward violently and crashed into the invisible barrier in the sky!
A soundless boom filled the hearts and minds of all living beings in the fallen star region. Cracking sounds rang out from the barrier, and in the next moment, it shattered, transforming into ripples that spread out in all directions. At the center of the ripples.., the Divine Ox lifted the dao star up into the air!
However, that was not the end. As it charged forward, the light and heat from the dao star grew even more intense, and yet another barrier appeared!
In other words... what existed here was not a single barrier, but an astonishing number of layers!
As the first layer collapsed and the ripples spread, the invisible barrier, which had previously been invisible, finally appeared. It was reflected in everyone’s eyes and before Wang Baole’s eyes!
It’s not a single layer... Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. With the help of the Divine Bull’s might, his divine perception spread out abruptly, spreading towards where the barrier was. As it spread out.., he gradually realized that the barrier that restricted the advancement of Dao Stars had reached a million!
A million barriers blocked all living beings and suppressed the starry skies. Like a million laws, they formed a huge seal that sealed everything!
However... Wang Baole’s heart and soul were soon blessed. From the feedback from the Dao stars and their state, he gained some enlightenment. The advancement of a dao star... in reality, as long as he broke through the first barrier, it would be considered a success, he didn’t have to break through all the millions of barriers.
Now, with just a thought, he could instantly upgrade the DAO star that was lifted up by the divine ox formed by his divine ability into a permanent dao!
However, even though such a permanent dao could be considered a breakthrough, in the end... It wasn’t the limit!
According to Wang Baole’s enlightenment, before the advancement, every time the DAO star broke through a barrier, its power and potential would increase after the advancement to a permanent DAO!
Then, let’s see where my limits lie! Wang Baole’s eyes were filled with determination and a strong desire to fight. He didn’t continue thinking after he had made his decision. Instead, he took a deep breath, and the cultivation in his body felt like it was about to explode, with a loud boom, he merged with the Divine Ox, causing its entire body to glow. It roared crazily, carrying the dao star... and ramming into it once more!
Rumbling sounds echoed out in all directions, and the sound of layers of barriers collapsing spread out in all directions. From a distance, the divine ox could be seen transforming into a beam of light that carried the dao star as it charged forward, smashing through the layers of barriers as easily as breaking dried twigs!
Three layers, ten layers, thirty layers, fifty layers, a hundred layers..
Three hundred layers, nine hundred layers, 1,500 layers!
It wasn’t over yet. Three thousand levels, five thousand levels..
Amidst the rumbling and shattering, the Divine Ox, which was supporting the Dao star, only slowed down when it reached the five thousand nine hundred and seventy-fourth level of the barrier. After gathering its strength slightly, it roared and charged again, this time, it shattered to the nine thousand three hundred and ninety-seventh level!
At this point, it was as if the limit was about to be reached. The Divine Ox’s dim figure erupted with its final strength, supporting the Dao star and shattering a few hundred layers of the barrier. Only when it reached ten thousand levels did it lose all of its power and dissipate!
Ten thousand layers, how can that be enough! Wang Baole roared into the sky. He raised his left hand and lifted up the Majestic Dao star that was no different from a star. It was so massive that it could shock other stars. He formed a seal with his right hand and pointed!
Immediately, the illusory figure of the zombie from his previous life transformed into a ray of light as he pointed forward. It shot forward with such speed and destruction that everyone who saw it was shocked, in that instant... ten thousand layers of the light shattered!
The light dissipated, and Wang Baole’s figure, carrying the dao star, stepped onto the twenty thousand layers. It wasn’t over yet. Within his body, the devil blade, the Xin Huo Divine clan, and the figure formed from the terrifying hatred walked out, the shattering of the barrier was shocking!
Thirty thousand layers, forty thousand layers, fifty thousand layers..
In the next moment, as the remaining thirty thousand layers of the membrane collapsed, the white deer’s figure crashed forward with a dazzling light. This collision shattered another thirty thousand layers!
Wang Baole lifted the figure of the Dao star and stood atop the eighty thousand layers of the membrane. His dao star... as the layers of the membrane collapsed, its body grew larger and larger. It no longer looked like a star, it looked more like a strange celestial body that had been gathered by a large number of stars!
There’s still... one last attack! Wang Baole’s body trembled, and madness appeared in his eyes. He lifted his right hand, and the afterimage of the black wooden board appeared in an instant. The image of the Black Wooden Board’s life appeared in his mind, and it descended abruptly!
As it descended, the sky buzzed like never before. The remaining nine hundred thousand or so layers in front of it trembled. An indescribable power erupted, causing the layers of the barrier to shatter like paper!
The 100,000 th layer, the 200,000 th layer, the 400,000 th layer, the 600,000 th layer..
“Continue!”Wang Baole’s eyes were bloodshot, he charged forward, causing the power radiating from the black wooden board to be like a sharp blade that could cut through everything. In an instant, it shattered to 700,000 layers, 800,000 layers, and finally, 990,000 layers. Finally, it reached its peak!
Even so, the remaining power was still unleashed. Ten thousand layers were blasted open at its peak, and the invisible seal formed by the millions of Laws... shattered with a loud bang!
As it shattered, an epiphany appeared in Wang Baole’s mind. It was as if at that moment, ten thousand laws couldn’t cover his eyes, and Ten Thousand Dao couldn’t cover his heart!
At that moment, his dao star... finally exploded with light and heat to its peak, until there was no light at all!
It became... a black hole that could swallow up a star!
His cultivation base surged, and he broke through the planet and stepped into the star!
It was an extremely unique, unprecedented... Star! !

chapters.title: Chapter 1112
chapters.content:
Chapter 1112:, is there any wine? !
Translator:
549690339
Stars were mighty figures who had half a foot into immortality. Although there were more stars in the Weiyang Dao Domain, this was due to the large number of stars, and most of them were at the mortal and yellow levels, but even so... The star realm was still a terrifying existence that could support a galaxy by itself.
Not to mention a high-grade star.
For example, Chong Weizi, as an earth-grade star, was already the Second Dao child of the nine regions road, the first sect of the left path of the holy region. From this, one could see that high-grade stars were extremely powerful and rare!
As for the heaven-grade... that was a method that only the unending royal family could grasp. A heaven-grade star, even if its cultivation was only at the middle stage of the star realm, killing Chong Weizi... Although it was not an easy task.., however, it did not require too much effort.
That was also one of the reasons why the never-ending royal family had remained strong for generations.
As for Wang Baole, his star could no longer be judged by conventional standards. In terms of grade, he had surpassed the heaven-grade and reached the legendary level of Dao Heng. In terms of magnitude... he had shattered millions of barriers, he had raised his dao star... to the level of a black hole!
It was difficult to judge his current combat strength, and Wang Baole himself couldn’t make a definite comparison. He only knew... that he could kill several stars like the job-tears clone with a single finger!
I might not be invincible now, but there are very few people who can kill me. Wang Baole raised his head. He was filled with emotion, and a sense of pride rose in his heart.
As Wang Baole was deep in thought in the sky, all the paper figures in the fallen star area below were shocked. They hovered outside the exit of the fallen star area. The vortex formed by the aura of the tribulation caused by Wang Baole’s advancement suddenly increased in speed, bolts of lightning appeared in the vortex as it spun rapidly!
The moment they appeared, the bolts of lightning flew out. It was as if they could accurately find the entrance to the fallen star area. They flew out instantly. At a glance, there were too many bolts of lightning. There were countless of them, they continued to appear from the Vortex and fly into the fallen star lands!
This scene shocked and bewildered even Chong Weizi.
It was even more so for the living beings in the fallen star lands. They saw the bolts of lightning charging into the sky. Each bolt of lightning seemed to have a destructive aura. As soon as they appeared.., they crashed into the array formation protecting the meteorite land.
The loud boom erupted from the start. The sky turned pale, and the array formation distorted. It was as if the sky and earth were about to collapse. Wang Baole raised his head to look at the bolts of lightning.
......
“Wang Baole, this is the heavenly tribulation. Make your preparations as soon as possible. The array formation of the meteorite empire won’t be able to withstand it for long!”The first generation Patriarch Roared. He and the meteorite emperor beside him quickly formed hand seals to reinforce the array formation.
They were unable to help Wang Baole directly because doing so would be against the rules and would affect the entire Starfall Empire. Therefore, the only thing they could do was to rely on the array formation to buy some time for Wang Baole.
“There’s no need to stop me. I’m no longer the person I used to be,”Wang Baole said calmly. The air of an expert reappeared on him. As he spoke, he placed his hands behind his back. His expression was calm, and he exuded the aura of a powerful expert.
This scene made the emperor and the emperor look at each other strangely. They looked at each other and retracted their divine abilities. They opened a crack in the array formation. In an instant... the lightning bolts that were charging towards them from outside the array formation rumbled, they seemed to possess intelligence as they descended through the crack!
The targets of the lightning bolts had nothing to do with the fallen stars. As they descended, they charged towards Wang Baole. They were so fast that they closed in on him in an instant. There were so many of them that the first wave alone numbered tens of thousands!
Wang Baole had a faint smile on his face. As the bolts of lightning approached him, he raised his right hand and pointed forward. Instantly, the stars behind him materialized. There was no light or heat radiating from them. All that could be seen was a gigantic black hole.
As the bolts of lightning approached him, they collapsed and twisted. They circled around him and were drawn into the black hole, where they were devoured.
“That’s it?”Wang Baole raised his head and asked calmly.
In the next instant, tens of thousands of bolts of lightning came roaring from outside the crack. However, they all collapsed and twisted as they approached Wang Baole and were absorbed by the black hole behind him. Seeing this, Wang Baole sighed softly, there was a hint of boredom in his expression as he looked at the first-generation emperor.
“Do you have any wine?”
The first-generation Emperor’s face twitched. He felt that Wang Baole was very different from before. He had become... very good at posturing. He felt an inexplicable urge to beat Wang Baole up, it took him a long while to suppress the urge and speak calmly.
“This is just the lightning tribulation in the front. It gets stronger the further it goes.”
“Is that so?”Wang Baole smiled faintly. It was as if even the lightning tribulation outside the heavens felt humiliated. In an instant, more than a hundred thousand lightning tribulation bolts descended at the same time. Their colors changed as well, and their auras grew even more majestic. As they descended.., all of them exploded around Wang Baole. They were eventually destroyed and absorbed by his black hole.
Wang Baole shook his head. He flicked his slightly blackened fingers under his sleeves. He endured the act of baring his teeth and spoke slowly.
“It’s still boring.”
However, the moment he said those words, a deafening explosion erupted. Hundreds of thousands of lightning bolts descended from the sky. It would have been fine if it was just an increase in the number of lightning bolts. However, the lightning bolts that appeared now.., they looked like weapons, and they looked extremely powerful. Amidst the loud boom, they shot towards Wang Baole through the cracks.
Wang Baole’s gaze remained fixed, and his scalp couldn’t help but feel numb. Before he could react, the bolts of lightning exploded around him.
As the loud boom reverberated in the skies, a large number of shattered lightning weapons were sucked away by the black hole. After about seven to eight breaths of time, when all the lightning weapons had dispersed, Wang Baole was revealed standing in the skies, his hair was standing on end, and his body was in tatters.
However, his calm expression and his usual smile made it seem as if his sorry state on the outside was nothing. After realizing that the sky was slowly calming down, Wang Baole felt a piercing pain in his internal organs, however, he felt that this was the time for him to maintain his status as an expert. Therefore, he maintained his usual smile on his face. He raised his head to look at the entrance outside the crack and continued speaking calmly.
“The Tribulation Lightning isn’t bad. It made my body itch a little. Is there more?”
The first emperor couldn’t be bothered to speak. The emperor beside him had a strange expression on his face. The two of them could tell that Wang Baole was strong, but the other paper figurines couldn’t. They were all shocked as they looked at Wang Baole, they were in disbelief. However, before they could make a sound, a muffled thunder that shook the entire world rang out from the sky!
As the muffled thunder reverberated, outside the meteorite land, where Wang Baole couldn’t see, the vortex of calamity that was floating around seemed to be enraged. It shrank rapidly and eventually turned into a giant finger of lightning.
During this process, even Xie Haiyang and the others who hadn’t been affected couldn’t withstand it. They trembled and fled at high speed. Even Zhong Yizi’s scalp went numb as she retreated rapidly. She turned her head back with lingering fear, he saw that a small portion of the shocking lightning finger had rushed into the entrance of the fallen star lands!
What exactly happened inside? The Lightning Tribulation has appeared, and it has even materialized... Chong Coix Zi’s heart palpitated. He watched as the giant lightning finger disappeared completely at the entrance of the fallen star lands, he wanted to go over and take a look. However, when he thought of the fluctuations of the finger, Chong Coix decisively gave up on the thought of danger.
At that moment, in the fallen star lands, Wang Baole, who had just assumed the posture of an expert, raised his head and saw... the huge lightning finger that had reached in from the outside world, that finger... occupied more than half of the sky. Just a glance at it made his body tremble violently. An intense sense of life-and-death danger instantly erupted in his mind.
“Your sister... It can’t be...”Wang Baole’s eyes were completely blank.

chapters.title: Chapter 1113
chapters.content:
Chapter 1113: was a great supplement!
Translator:
549690339
Wang Baole’s expression changed. He looked at the giant lightning finger that had occupied more than half of the sky. His heart skipped a beat, and he felt a strong sense of danger.
He knew very well that his true form was an indestructible three-foot-long black wood. Based on what he had experienced in his previous life, it was impossible for the mere lightning finger to shake his true form.
However... just because it couldn’t touch the black wood didn’t mean that it couldn’t touch the consciousness that had been born on it!
These were two completely different concepts. The life-and-death crisis at this moment made Wang Baole clearly feel... that the finger of lightning that had appeared in his eyes now had the ability to wipe him away!
Once he was wiped away, perhaps a few years later, the black wood would be able to give birth to a new consciousness. Perhaps it would be him, but to a certain extent, it would no longer be him.
This made Wang Baole panic. He wondered if it was because he had been too arrogant just now. Otherwise, why would such an unprecedented lightning tribulation appear when he was promoted to a star!
Could it be related to the side effects of the wishing bottle... Wang Baole thought of his wish on the fated star. The side effects didn’t appear after that. He couldn’t help but make a guess at the scene before him.
The bigger guess was that his dao star had risen into the stars. This was something that had only happened in legends throughout the entire Weiyang Dao Domain. Wang Baole had even made a self-judgment. The founding patriarch of the Weiyang clan had also risen into the stars, however, he might not have broken through the million barrier like he had!
After all... to break through to the seventy to eighty thousand levels was something that Wang Baole had accumulated in his previous life and ten lifetimes. To a certain extent, this was the pinnacle of all life.
Even if there were people who were more fortunate than him, they would never be able to break through to the hundred thousand levels. The reason why Wang Baole was able to do so was because the black wooden board’s status was so terrifying that it was difficult to describe with words.
Therefore... with a high probability, Wang Baole believed that he might be... the only person in the entire stone stele world who had broken through the suppression of the entire stone stele world while the Dao Star was rising!
It’s as if a force had been created within the stone tablet, causing a crack to appear on the stone tablet... and the wishing bottle must have contributed to this incident... That’s why the Lightning Tribulation has reached such a level! Wang Baole’s breathing quickened, as his thoughts raced, he no longer cared about his status as an expert.
“Little Missy, save me!”
......
As he retreated, Wang Baole shouted.
“Great Emperor of the first generation, please buy me some time!”As he spoke, Wang Baole immediately recited the Dao scripture in his heart.
At that moment, when the surrounding paper figures saw the shocking finger, their expressions changed drastically. The Starfall Emperor and the Great Emperor also looked extremely solemn.
They couldn’t just stand by and watch Wang Baole’s kindness towards the fallen star lands and their relationship. Even if they could measure it, the will of the fallen star lands that was clearly gathering in the heavens and earth.., had already made the decision on their behalf.
Even the array formation in the heavens began to resist the sealing of the finger with cracking sounds!
However, both the first emperor and the Starfall Emperor knew very well that if they were involved, Wang Baole would be implicated in the entire Starfall land. The target of the Lightning Tribulation would be.., everything in the world that they were in.
Unless it was absolutely necessary, the two of them were unwilling to do such a thing. However, it was unrealistic to not help at the moment. This made them anxious. However, almost instantly, the eyes of the first emperor lit up, he immediately shouted.
“Baole, to the Sea of paper, to the place where the whirlpool is sealed!”
As the first emperor’s voice reverberated, Wang Baole was retreating rapidly. As he heard the words, the closing of the array formation in the sky and the resistance of the finger caused a loud boom. The array formation... could not be closed, the finger descended abruptly amidst the loud boom. It seemed to represent the sky as it pressed down on Wang Baole.
At this critical moment, Wang Baole didn’t have time to think too much. He continued with the Dao Sutra. He turned abruptly and charged towards the sea of paper beneath him. His speed was so fast that he disappeared into the sea of paper in an instant.
At the same time, the moment Wang Baole entered the sea of paper, the giant finger that had descended from the sky didn’t slow down. However, its range shrank rapidly. Eventually, it gathered to a size of a thousand feet. No traces of lightning could be seen, it was as if a real finger had suddenly charged into the sea of paper!
As soon as it landed, an arc-shaped bolt of lightning followed the edge of the finger and spread towards the entire sea of paper. The sound was loud, and it was as if the entire sea of paper was about to be ignited by the Lightning.
From Afar, the Sea of paper churned, and the color of the sky changed. All the paper figures were shocked once again, and they didn’t dare get too close. At that moment, Wang Baole, who was speeding through the sea of paper.., he also felt the power of lightning from the surface of the sea behind him. His body trembled slightly, and the circulation of his cultivation increased.
However... even though he was fast, the lightning fingers chasing after him were even faster. As they chased after him, they rapidly closed the distance between them and Wang Baole.
From a thousand feet at the start, he flew to five hundred feet. When he reached three hundred feet, Wang Baole was shocked to the extreme. He had already chanted the Dao scripture in his heart, but Wang Yiyi’s father didn’t appear.
This made Wang Baole even more anxious. It was a good thing that as he sped, he saw the mirror-like seal at the bottom of the Sea of paper, the female corpse on it, and the entrance to the whirlpool under the seal!
There must be a reason why the Great Emperor asked me to come here! Wang Baole’s eyes were filled with anxiety. He gritted his teeth. His fingers were almost a hundred feet away from him, and the waves of lightning that emanated from them seemed to be tearing his body apart, wang Baole roared in his heart as he sped up once again. He crossed the distance from the seal and appeared... on the mirror-like seal.
The instant he stood there, he turned abruptly and looked at the giant lightning finger that had replaced all the images in his eyes. It was charging towards him.
In an instant... the finger neared the seal. It didn’t pause at all as it charged towards Wang Baole!
However, just as the finger was about to touch Wang baole, suddenly... a huge suction force erupted from the vortex under the seal. The suction force was so strong that even if it passed through the seal.., it could affect the outside world.
It caused the approaching lightning finger to tremble violently. It began to distort visibly. A large amount of lightning was pulled out of the finger uncontrollably, fusing into the seal and entering the vortex under the seal!
It was as if the lightning finger was a gathering of dust and was flowing in the wind!
Wang Baole’s eyes widened. He saw the previously powerful finger being sucked away uncontrollably. His heart started to race.
Riches are sought in danger! Wang Baole’s eyes turned red instantly. He formed a seal with his hands and waved them violently. Immediately, the black hole behind him appeared with a loud bang, emitting a suction force as well.
A loud boom erupted. The finger that was being absorbed by the seal also released some of it under Wang Baole’s suction force, and it was forcefully absorbed by Wang Baole!
The power of the Tribulation Lightning contained countless laws and the aura of heaven and earth. After absorbing just a tiny bit, Wang Baole’s body shook violently, and he accelerated his devouring speed. Just like that... the finger of the tribulation lightning dissipated, wang Baole and the seal absorbed it together, and they lasted for about ten breaths. Then, as they continued to blur and shrink, they turned into dust and disappeared completely!
However, compared to the total amount absorbed by the seal, Wang Baole had only absorbed less than ten percent of it. Even so, it allowed him to quickly pass through the incubation period when he had just stepped into a star, he had completely stabilized himself at the level of a Star!
This is a great tonic! Wang Baole was ecstatic. Seeing that the crisis had been resolved, he was about to leave. However, at that moment... something unexpected happened!
A chilling aura suddenly gathered from under the seal and from the whirlpool. It seemed to have turned into a pair of cold eyes that stared at Wang Baole through the Whirlpool and the seal!
Wang Baole’s body trembled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1114
chapters.content:
Chapter 1114:, the Lord of Unending!
Translator:
549690339
As his body trembled, his soul seemed to be frozen in that instant. The eyes were formed from the aura gathered within the sealing vortex. Not only were they cold, they were filled with a towering murderous aura!
The power of the murderous aura was so great that even though Wang Baole had experienced what he had experienced in his previous life, he was still shaken.
