That was because whether it was Luo, Gu, or Wang Yiyi’s father, in terms of the level of the murderous aura... they were all different from the presence within the Vortex! There was a difference!
It was also because of the terror of the murderous aura that Wang Baole was able to be influenced by just his gaze, even though it was separated by the vortex and the seal. As his body trembled, he didn’t dare continue forward. Instead, he slowly turned around, he looked at the seal below.
As he looked, waves of purple mist emanated from the vortex under the seal. Even though it didn’t penetrate the seal, as the mist spread under the seal, the pair of eyes became even clearer. faintly.., wang Baole seemed to hear the sound of footsteps coming from within the vortex under the seal.
“Senior...”Wang Baole was nervous. He repeated the Dao scripture a few times, but Wang Yiyi’s father still didn’t appear. In his anxiety, he looked at the pair of purple eyes and heard the sound of footsteps coming from within the fog, he suddenly spoke.
“Senior Xu, my surname is Wang!”
As soon as Wang Baole spoke, the footsteps stopped. After a long while, a deep and cold voice came from within the vortex through the seal.
“You Know Me?”
“I met senior Xu here with my father-in-law.”Wang Baole’s expression was solemn. He did not pause in his speech, nor did he blush. It was as if even he himself thought so, he had completely assumed the identity of a son-in-law. He cupped his fists and bowed.
The sound of footsteps didn’t come out. However, within the Vortex, the eyes that had gathered revealed a strange look,
“Are all cultivators from the Weiyang Dao Domain as shameless as you are? Even if the place you are at is merely a boundary of the Weiyang Dao Domain.”As his words reverberated in the air.., wang baole retracted his gaze. The sound of footsteps could be heard once again. However, they didn’t come close, but far away. However, when Wang Baole heard those words, his pupils constricted. His mind rumbled, and he immediately spoke.
“Senior, you just said that the place where I am located is only a boundary of the Weiyang Dao Domain? What do you mean by a boundary? Isn’t the Weiyang Dao domain the real Weiyang Dao Domain?”
“You Little Brat, you don’t have to try to trick me. There are some things that I know you already know when I see you, but there’s no harm in telling you.”
......
“Other than the main domain, the Weiyang Dao Domain has countless boundaries. They are scattered like seeds in all levels of the universe. You are one of them.”
Those words fell into Wang Baole’s ears. They merged with the memories he had gained from his previous life and transformed into heavenly lightning. As the rumbling reverberated, Wang Baole’s chest rose and fell as he spoke rapidly.
“Senior, could you please tell me how to get to the real Weiyang Dao Domain?”
The sound of footsteps grew further and further away. Wang Baole waited anxiously for a long time. When the fog in the vortex had completely dissipated, a voice that seemed to come from afar reverberated in his mind.
“When the avatar of the Emperor awakens in the Weiyang realm you are in.”
“Who is the Emperor?”Wang Baole’s mind was once again shaken. He spoke again.
After a long while, he vaguely heard an answer, but he wasn’t sure if it was an illusion.
“The emperor of the Weiyang Realm!”Wang Baole murmured. Those were the last words he heard. Countless thoughts formed in Wang Baole’s mind through those four words.
“Weiyang has a number of divisions. Does that mean that the first world that was born at the beginning of the second ring is actually just a division of the Weiyang Dao Domain...”
“Senior Xu has also mentioned different levels of universes. If that’s the case, could it be that the universe where the first and second rings are located is just one of the many universes...”
If that’s the case, then how strong is Weiyang? The emperor is the master of Weiyang, and how strong is he? Also, could it be that the emperor’s clones are related to cultivation and require countless clones to grow
Also... If what senior Xu said is true, then who is the Emperor’s clone in the world of the stone stele? Wang Baole’s mind was a mess. The information he had received this time was too great!
After pondering over these thoughts in his heart, Wang Baole couldn’t tell how much was true. However, his instincts told him that what the other party said was most likely true.
In the silence, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He felt that the world he was in was filled with endless mysteries. The blood-colored centipede, Wang Yiyi and her father, the ancient remains, Luo’s seal.., and his true form... The black wooden board from another whirlpool.
He was now certain of one thing. The whirlpool that the black wooden board came from was different from the one here!
There’s still a date sixty-eight years from now, Wang Baole muttered. After a long while, he raised his head and buried all his doubts deep in his heart. A deep sense of urgency spread through his heart.
Even though I have reached the level of Dao Heng, it’s still not enough... I need to become stronger faster! At the thought of this, Wang Baole’s eyes flashed. He took a step forward, and with a loud bang, he turned into a long rainbow, he jumped directly under the sea, and from the surface of the sea of paper, he leaped with a loud bang!
As he flew out of the Sea of paper, Wang Baole, who was standing in midair, immediately saw the eyes of the first emperor, the Starfall Emperor, and the surrounding paper men.
“Thank you, senior, Thank You, Your Majesty!”Wang Baole took a deep breath, cupped his fists, and bowed deeply to the first emperor and the Starfall Emperor. He didn’t say any words of gratitude, because all the gratitude had already been recorded in his soul.
Wang Baole knew very well that if he hadn’t been promoted in the Starfall lands, it would have been very difficult for him to achieve such a smooth advancement. He would have been in danger of dying, and his dao would have disappeared. That was why he had done him a great favor.
Seeing that Wang Baole was unharmed, the Great Emperor and the fallen star emperor heaved a sigh of relief. They went forward to greet each other, then Wang baole bade farewell and left. Under their gazes, he no longer needed to be escorted by a ship, instead, he rose into the sky. At the edge of the fallen star array formation, Wang Baole turned his head and bowed once more towards the crowd below.
“If I need anything in the future, I will definitely give it my all!”As he spoke, Wang Baole turned towards the end of the sky and took a step forward. His figure instantly turned into a black hole and... disappeared!
“I seem to be able to see that in the outside world, there will be another legend soon!”The meteorite emperor stared at the spot where Wang Baole had disappeared. His eyes were filled with anticipation as he muttered to himself.
“This has nothing to do with us anymore. Wang Baole obtained his dao planet here and was promoted to a star here. The gratitude he has received from Starfall is already sufficient. If he rises to power in the future, our good karma will be fulfilled. If he doesn’t rise to power, there’s no point in looking forward to it.”The emperor shook his head, he retracted his gaze from the sky.
At the same time, as he unleashed his cultivation, Wang Baole, who was like a black hole, disappeared. He seemed to blend into the void. When he reappeared in the next instant, he was already in the starry sky outside of Starfall.
The first thing that appeared in the starry sky was a piece of paper that was folded in half. As it continued to open, the starry sky was instantly covered by a piece of white paper. At the center of the white paper was Xie Haiyang, Chen Han, and the others, they instantly saw... Wang Baole, who had appeared there!
He was dressed in white, had black hair, and his eyes were like stars. His shadow was like the Bright Moon, and his body was like the blazing sun!
Almost at the moment he appeared, all the cultivators who saw him felt their hearts thump. Their eyes were filled with uncontrollable reverence. Chen Han’s fawning voice reverberated rapidly in the hearts of the crowd.
“Congratulations, father! Congratulations, Father! You’ve advanced to the Star Realm!”
“Congratulations, uncle-master. uncle-master has advanced to the star realm in one fell swoop. Such talent is rare in this world. From now on, there will be no place that uncle-master can not go!”
As he listened to Chen Han and Xie Haiyang, who followed closely behind Chen Han, speak, Wang Baole’s face unconsciously revealed a faint smile that resembled that of an expert. He swept his gaze across the area, he landed in the distance... the empty starry sky in the eyes of an outsider. He spoke slowly.
“Sorry to have kept you waiting.”
The moment Wang Baole spoke, he looked as if a curtain had suddenly been lifted, revealing... a tall figure with an extremely grave expression and a hint of fear in his eyes!
It was Chong Weizi!

chapters.title: Chapter 1115
chapters.content:
Chapter 1115: — the solemn look on Chong Job’s face!
Translator:
549690339
In that instant, the two of them looked at each other from a distance not too far away in the starry sky!
“Wang Baole?”Chong Job’s voice was low and deep. There was uncertainty in his expression. The information he had received was that Wang Baole was only a planet. Even if he had advanced and broken through, he was only at the early-stage star realm.
Even if he was at the earth-grade level, as long as he was not at the late-stage of the star realm, he would not care. However, the person before him now... gave him a feeling of trepidation. He was much stronger than all the enemies he had ever met in his life, he seemed to be much stronger.
Especially the feeling of his body and mind trembling slightly when he met his gaze. To him, he only had a similar feeling from the first dao child, but it was not as strong as it was now.
It was also because of this that a wave of disbelief and disbelief appeared in Chong Coix’s mind. It was difficult for him to immediately determine... that the person in front of him was Wang Baole.
“Chong Coix?”Wang Baole spoke slowly. The reason why he could recognize him at a glance was because he could sense the same aura from the other person as the clone he had killed previously.
The Aura seemed weak, but Wang Baole could sense it clearly.
Xie Haiyang and the others had just realized that there was someone else hiding beside them. Their expressions changed immediately. They looked over, and when they saw Chong Yizi’s tall figure, their pupils constricted!
The hearts of those who heard or recognized that it was Chong Yizi’s true self were racing. Chong Yizi’s name was indeed impressive in the left Dao Sacred Territory!
After all, he was the Second Dao child of the nine Regions Dao, and the nine Regions Dao was the number one sect in the left Dao holy region. There were more than ten mighty figures in the Starfield, and they could suppress all sects of the left Dao!
There were even rumors that the grand patriarch’s cultivation base had already broken through the Starfield and stepped into the universe realm, which was comparable to the nine divine emperors of the Weiyang clan!
Such a sect, as the leader of the left Dao Holy Region, was also extremely famous in the entire Weiyang Dao region. Therefore, as the second dao child of this generation, his fame could not only intimidate the entire left Dao holy region, he was even heard of by the side sects of the sacred region, as well as the families and royal families of the Weiyang Central Region.
To describe him as a prodigy was well-deserved. Furthermore, Chong Coix was one of those prodigies who had grown up. He had fought countless battles throughout his life. He wasn’t just a flower in a greenhouse, but he had relied on his own battle achievements, he had fought his way to the position of Dao Child.
......
However, Chong Coix had often used his avatar to project himself outside, so not many people had seen him in person. Seeing that Wang Baole didn’t deny it, Chong Coix’s heart sank.
Even if he didn’t want to believe it, he had to admit that the person in front of him was Wang Baole. At the same time, anger and realization welled up in his heart. He was angry at the person who had asked him to come here and kill Wang Baole, it was obvious that the information was incomplete.
This resulted in him being on the defensive. At the same time, he didn’t have any reason to hold a grudge against such a powerful person. What he realized was the death of his clone... it was obvious that he hadn’t been killed by someone else, but by Wang Baole.
It was also because of the death of his clone that he couldn’t retreat now that he was here. This battle... he had to fight. Otherwise, retreating without a fight would affect his dao heart.
Zi Yue, you deserve to die! Chong Weizi growled inwardly, but she only appeared gloomy on the surface. She didn’t reveal much of her thoughts. After Wang Baole called out her name, she cupped her fists and bowed at Wang Baole.
“Fellow Daoist Baole, this is a misunderstanding. I wonder if you know a person named Zi Yue...”his words were slow and sincere. As they reverberated through the air, they contained the power of laws, causing everyone who heard them to.., naturally, they would focus their attention on listening.
However, the moment the words “Zi Yue”left his mouth, Chong Weizi, who gave off the feeling that he had yet to finish his words and was about to continue speaking, suddenly had a cold glint in his eyes. He raised his head abruptly, and with a loud bang, he charged forward.
His speed was so fast that it was like a rock breaking through the heavens. In an instant, he had crossed the distance between him and Wang Baole. When he appeared, he was already beside Wang Baole. As the light from his raised right hand flashed, he conjured a large white sword and swung it at Wang Baole, he swung it viciously!
Everything happened too quickly. Just a moment ago, Chong Coix had been speaking sincerely from afar. The next moment, his killing intent had exploded. If it had been anyone else, they might have been careless, or they might have sensed it but couldn’t avoid it, even if the attack didn’t cost them their lives, it was inevitable that they would be injured.
However, Chong Coix had underestimated Wang Baole. Even though he had fought many life-and-death battles, he had only gained an understanding of Wang baole from all the previous lives. To a certain extent, Wang Baole’s experience had reached the pinnacle.
That was why the Instant Chong Coix approached, Wang Baole raised his right hand. The power of the stars in his body appeared, and countless clouds of mist instantly materialized, rapidly gathering into a finger in front of Wang Baole.
Upon closer inspection, one could see that the finger was somewhat similar to the finger of the Lightning Tribulation. It was the stronger cloud finger that Wang Baole had made adjustments with reference to the Lightning Tribulation, as well as the support of the stars.
As soon as it appeared, the heavens and earth changed. The winds and clouds tumbled, landing in front of Chong Coi Zi, who was trying to seize the upper hand in the Battle of Dharmic Powers with a sudden thought.
In an instant, a loud noise was heard as Wang Baole’s finger and Chong Coi Zi’s fist collided. It spread in all directions, and there was a violent impact that spread like the waves in the sea. Chong coi zi’s body trembled violently, and he staggered backward, wang Baole’s face was slightly flushed. When he looked at Chong Coix, his eyes shone with excitement.
“Not weak!”
Wang Baole’s eyes shone. He was worried about his combat strength. However, Chong Coix’s cultivation was not ordinary, and his cultivation was not ordinary. Even his combat awareness was not ordinary. It could be said that he had.., he could not find any major flaws. As such, this person was clearly the best test tool.
That was why Wang Baole was extremely interested in this battle. His body flashed as he gave chase. However, just as he was about to approach Chong Weizi, who was retreating, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He had a vague feeling that there was something wrong with Chong Weizi’s retreat, that was why his body seemed to be moving at the same speed, but he suddenly retreated in an instant. His speed was too fast, and the reversal was too fast. That was why he left an afterimage on the spot.
The instant he retreated, Chong Weizi, who seemed to be staggering from the recoil, raised her head abruptly and let out a low growl towards the sky. As she growled, the image of a gigantic black lizard appeared behind her, the image was thousands of feet in size. As Chong Weizi growled, it opened its mouth wide and swallowed the afterimage that Wang Baole had left behind in an extremely swift and violent manner!
A loud boom reverberated, and the surrounding starry skies rippled violently. The area that had been swallowed by the lizard seemed to be missing a part of the starry skies, and it was about to collapse.
There is indeed a trap! Wang Baole’s eyes shone even brighter. If he was weak, he would prefer opponents who didn’t have brains. Although battles weren’t fun, his chances of winning would increase. On the other hand, what he liked was.., it was like the job-changing battle style before him!
Just now, if Wang Baole hadn’t avoided the attack due to his paranoia, he might have been swallowed by the Lizard. Although he wouldn’t have died, the attack that the opponent had prepared for a long time still contained a certain amount of power that could shake him, once he was swallowed, he would more or less be injured, affecting his stance as an expert.
After avoiding the attack, Wang Baole remained calm. He instantly raised his right hand and waved it. Immediately, the cloud mist finger appeared once again and charged straight at job’s tears!
As for job’s tears, he had an ugly expression on his face. He had indeed prepared this move for a long time. While it specifically injured his soul, it also contained a strange poison that no one could detect!
Even Wang Baole had not noticed this. As a result, the poison was hidden, and even if he was hit, it would be difficult to discover it. However, when combined with the Abhijna and spells that job’s tears had unleashed, the poison could be unleashed at a critical moment.
This was a technique that only a few people who were stronger than Chong Coix had used. It was difficult to use continuously. Furthermore, in his many battles, he had managed to turn the tide of the battle by surprise, causing all his opponents who relied on their powerful cultivation to.., all of them were filled with hatred. However, at that moment, Wang Baole had noticed it in advance and avoided it. This made him realize that the Wang Baole before him... was very difficult to deal with!

chapters.title: Chapter 1116
chapters.content:
Chapter 1116: Total Suppression!
Translator:
549690339
Thus, as he retreated, a bright light flashed in Chong Job’s eyes. He raised his hands and suddenly waved them. Immediately, behind him, his star suddenly materialized!
Chong job’s cultivation level was in the late stage of the star realm. His star was even more of a rare earth-grade. This meant that his star’s capacity had reached an astonishing level.
If it was any other small sect, even if they had an earth-grade star, they would not be able to support the vast resources and consumption of cultivation. However, as the dao child of the nine regions, Chong Job’s resources were not lacking. He had already filled his earth-grade.., to the extreme of the later stage of the star. Therefore, the size of the star that was displayed caused everyone who had seen it to be shocked!
If an ordinary star was compared to a lake, then Chong Weizi’s star at this moment was like a vast sea that could not be called vast, but far surpassed a lake!
At the same time, Chong Weizi’s magical ability did not end with the transformation of his own star. Almost at the instant his star appeared, his body suddenly retreated, and his entire person directly merged into the astonishing star behind him.
As he merged with the star, a deafening roar came from within the star. Its shape changed abruptly, and as it shrank rapidly, it seemed as if its power continued to gather. In the blink of an eye, a head appeared, and four limbs appeared, when the body appeared, what appeared before Wang Baole and the others was a giant that was hundreds of thousands of feet tall!
The giant had Chong Weizi’s face, and his entire body shone with a hundred thousand feet of light. Light and heat spread wildly, causing the starry sky to distort. The high temperature spread, and his existence was like that of a god. Clouds and mist pointed in front of him, it was like a drop of water that evaporated before it could even get close!
Xie Haiyang and the others were also protected by all the DAO protectors. They were only able to escape very far away. Their hearts were filled with shock and shock.
Only Wang Baole stood where he was. He watched as his cloud and mist finger dissipated in front of Chong Weizi. His eyes were filled with even more interest. Just as his fighting spirit rose, Chong Weizi, who had turned into a giant, roared towards the sky, he stomped towards Wang Baole abruptly. He raised his right hand and threw a punch towards Wang baole like a shooting star!
The starry sky shattered and rumbled in all directions. An indescribably destructive force erupted incessantly at that moment, filling the entire starry sky. Wang Baole threw his head back and laughed. The emperor’s armor around his body materialized instantly, and the instant it materialized.., it was filled with his cultivation at the star realm, allowing him to possess the power of a star in the blink of an eye.
At the same time, the power of his physical body also erupted at the same time, along with a regular vibration. Even though his body size didn’t change much, the power contained within it had reached an astonishing level at that moment, the instant the giant stepped forward, Wang Baole leaped into the air. He dodged the Giant’s attack and accelerated at full speed, charging straight for... The Giant’s incoming fist and smashing it into each other!
It was a long story, but it all happened in the blink of an eye. In the next instant, Wang Baole’s fist and the Giant’s right fist, one small and one large, collided in the starry sky!
Wang Baole was clearly more like an ant from a visual perspective, trying to stop the giant with his mantis arms. However, the moment they collided, a deafening boom and powerful ripples that resembled raging waves reverberated, the one who retreated... was not Wang Baole, but... Chong Weizi, who had transformed into a giant!
......
Chong Weizi’s entire body trembled violently, and disbelief appeared in his eyes. He knew that Wang Baole was very strong, and that was why he had been prepared to injure his soul from the start. He didn’t want to compete with his opponent in terms of cultivation. After failing to do so, even though he had revealed the stars, he still avoided the important points as much as possible, he didn’t want to fight for victory in terms of cultivation. Instead, he strengthened his physical body, allowing his physical body’s defense and strength to reach a certain extreme, in an attempt to suppress Wang Baole.
According to his plan, Wang Baole would definitely use his cultivation and divine arts. That way, both parties would be able to achieve what he wanted in battle. With his own defense, he would be able to fight against the other party’s divine arts and spells for a period of time, his own strength would be enough to injure Wang Baole with just a single blow.
However, he had never expected that Wang Baole would only display his physical strength. Furthermore, in terms of strength... he was even stronger than himself. At that moment, with a loud bang, he retreated abruptly toward job’s son, he was already filled with regret for pursuing Wang Baole.
However, with the arrow on the bow, he had no choice but to strike. He knew that even if he wanted to stop the fight, Wang Baole would not agree. Hence, a ferocious look flashed across his face. As he retreated, he formed a seal with his hands and struck nine times on his body, every strike produced a loud bang. Every strike made him cough out blood.
“Mystic technique, the ninth dao third technique!”
As he spoke, and as he retreated, the nine mouthfuls of blood that Zhong weizi spat out squirmed rapidly in front of him, and in the blink of an eye, they transformed into multiple versions of himself!
Nine versions of himself, nine clones!
Each of the nine clones had the same combat strength as his original body. This was one of the nine great mystic techniques of the nine Prefectures Dao. It could be overdrawn in a short period of time, and it was as if it had been created out of nothing, gathering nine versions of himself with the same combat strength!
As soon as it appeared, the starry sky trembled, and the ripples were violent. With a roar filled with killing intent, he and the nine clones rushed out at the same time, charging straight at Wang Baole!
“Die!”
“Interesting!”Wang Baole’s eyes lit up. Not only did he not Dodge, his desire to fight grew even stronger. He raised both his hands and waved them abruptly. Immediately, stars appeared behind him!
In that instant, tens of thousands of unique stars appeared behind him, forming a star chart. At the center of the Star chart was a black hole. Around the black hole.., there were nine stars that shone like stars!
“Nine!”Wang Baole waved his right hand. Immediately, the tens of thousands of stars on the star chart behind him dimmed. Only the nine stars shone brightly. They broke away from the star chart and gathered around Wang Baole, they formed nine human-shaped light figures!
These nine stars were Wang Baole’s ancient stars. After he had advanced to a star, they... had also advanced to a star with the help of the Dao Stars. Now that they had appeared, not only did they radiate with light, they also gathered with the power of laws, the nine figures that formed were the bodies of Laws!
The moment they appeared, they seemed to possess their own consciousness. They first bowed to Wang baole, then rushed out abruptly. They charged at the nine avatars of job-tears. In an instant, they were engaged in battle!
Amidst the loud boom and the surging waves, the true body of the coix seed charged forward. This time, he was no longer empty-handed. Instead, he joined his hands in front of him and pulled them apart. A long golden spear appeared suddenly, as he grabbed it in his hand, his aura erupted even stronger.
The moment he charged at Wang Baole, Wang Baole raised his right hand and grabbed at the air. What appeared in his hand was no longer the divine armament from back then. Instead, it was a seemingly illusory, but rapidly solidified... Long Saber!
This saber was... the resentful weapon that had slaughtered countless creatures in Wang Baole’s previous life. At that moment, when it was held by Wang Baole, the resentful weapon seemed to have come to life. An Eye appeared on it!
A red eye. If one looked closely, one would be able to find similarities between it and Wang Baole’s eyes. At that moment, they were filled with the desire to fight, and they were filled with the determination to witness their own combat prowess. Following Wang Baole’s long howl.., the moment the golden spear in his hand rushed towards coix seed, Wang Baole leaped up and charged towards coix seed. He lifted the grievance weapon and slashed down!
The blade sliced through the starry sky, and the grievance shook the heavens!
One could see the blade of the grievance weapon tearing apart the starry sky in front of Wang Baole as if it was tearing it apart. A huge crack appeared, sweeping through everything as it charged towards Coix seed!
At the same time, endless resentment erupted in the starry sky as if it had turned into the howls of all living beings. Job’s tears bore the brunt of the attack, and her entire body trembled violently. Her expression changed drastically at that moment, and a life-and-death crisis erupted in her mind, it was like a storm that had never erupted before!

chapters.title: Chapter 1117
chapters.content:
Chapter 1117:10% of My Combat Power to suppress you!
Translator:
549690339
“This is...”Chong job-ee’s expression changed drastically, and a strong sense of danger erupted in his mind. Even his clones formed by his secret techniques were affected and began to tremble.
At this moment, the only thought that appeared in Chong job-ee’s mind was to avoid the sharp edge. Even though he was unwilling to accept this, he was in the late-stage of the star realm after all. However, regardless of whether it was the feeling of fear or the perception of his mind.., his instincts overpowered his rationality, and his body retreated rapidly.
As he retreated, he held the golden spear in his right hand and threw it at Wang Baole with all his might. Immediately, the Golden Spear turned into a bolt of golden lightning and charged at Wang Baole, trying to block it.
However, even though his reaction was extremely fast and he didn’t hesitate at all, it was still too late!
In other words, the appearance of Wang Baole’s resentful weapon, as it slashed down, was destined to happen. It was already done, so there was no way to retreat or Dodge!
Therefore... as soon as the golden spear, which had turned into lightning, appeared in front of Wang Baole, it collapsed on its own. In the blink of an eye, it shattered into pieces, turning into countless golden fragments that spread in all directions.
Even though I have just advanced to the early-stage of the star realm and have only displayed thirty percent of my battle prowess... Chong job-tears, if that is all you have, I will be very disappointed. Wang Baole was filled with joy. In this battle.., other than a few trump cards that were useless, he had already unleashed his full strength.
However, the demeanor of an expert had been imprinted into his instincts. As he spoke, his expression revealed a look of disappointment that was difficult to hide.
However, in reality, his internal organs were churning. The power of the stars was erupting continuously, destroying the golden spear. It wasn’t as calm as it appeared on the surface, nor was there an indestructible barrier in front of it, instead... Wang Baole’s resentful weapon, with a speed and aura that was imperceptible to the naked eye, swept past the Golden Spear in that instant.
The combination of the resentment from his previous life, the sharpness of the resentful weapon, Dao Heng, and the support of the stars made him look as if he was invincible!
In the next instant, the resentful weapon appeared in front of Chong Yizi, who was retreating. He didn’t give Chong Yizi any chance to fight back. As Chong Yizi’s expression changed completely, suddenly... it fell from his huge body, it was as if a mountain had been split open as it fell!
At that moment, the starry sky collapsed, and a loud boom reverberated in all directions. Chong Lizi’s gigantic body was cut into two halves in front of everyone’s eyes. Half of it turned into ashes, while the other half withered instantly, however, it didn’t disappear into the starry sky. Instead, a figure appeared once again.
However, the moment the figure appeared, it spat out three mouthfuls of fresh blood and retreated abruptly. At the same time, the nine clones that Wang Baole had transformed into erupted at the same time. The nine quasi-dao stars erupted at the same time, they each unleashed their own laws that resonated with each other to the extreme.
......
From Afar, one could see crimson blood shaking the skies, orange music resonating in the sky, yellow flames erupting, endless greenery, green clouds shaking the stars, blue winds like a hurricane, and purple devouring the Skies!
There was also the black fog of death and endless light!
The explosion of the clones of the nine quasi-dao stars caused Chong Coix’s clones to tremble and retreat simultaneously. Blood spewed out of their mouths as they shattered. However, Chong Coix’s cultivation was deep, so even if his divine ability was shattered.., however, his essence wouldn’t be injured so easily. As his clone shattered, his essence retreated and merged with the retreating body of Chong Coix’s giant clone.
As it merged with the giant clone, the retreating body’s trembling aura quickly stabilized. However, his aura was still damaged. It was only when he was out of the range of the grievous weapons that he came to a halt in shock, it glared at Wang Baole and roared in its heart.
Is this the early-stage of a star? Thirty percent? F * ck... who are you trying to fool
Even though it roared in its heart, the expression on the face of job-tears instantly returned to normal. There was even a smile on its lips. It was as if the pathetic state it had been in and the loss of its clone and original body had been nothing more than a test to him.., he spoke calmly.
“Interesting, Wang Baole. Since you managed to survive my warm-up, it’s worth it for me to use twenty percent of my combat power to let you know what it means to be powerful!”
What twenty percent of My Combat Power? I’m still warming up. I’ve already vomited blood a few times. What a hypocrite! Wang Baole laughed coldly in his heart, but on the surface, he tried his best to remain calm and composed. He smiled calmly.
“I won’t bully you. Next, I’ll withdraw twenty percent of my combat power and use ten percent to suppress you!”As he spoke, the cultivation in Wang Baole’s body surged, and all twelve percent of his combat power became active.
What a shameless person. Even the star Atlas has appeared, and he still has the audacity to say that he only used thirty percent. Could this Wang Baole’s face be formed from a star? Chong Weizi despised him in her heart, who doesn’t know how to Brag? Hence, he unleashed all of his cultivation and spoke calmly.
“Ten percent? Fine, I’ll use half of it to receive your divine ability!”
The conversation between the two fell into the ears of Xie Haiyang, Chen Han, and the others. Even though they were all shocked by the exchange between the two, they still had odd expressions on their faces.
Even Chen Han, who had become an instinctive sycophant, hesitated for a moment. He did not know how to speak. As for Xie Haiyang, he kept blinking, trying to hide the helplessness in his eyes. He felt very tired.
The other stars were also silent, but their hearts were filled with rich emotions..
“These two... aren’t fighting magic. They’re competing to see who has the thickest skin, right?”
As the crowd’s hearts were filled with excitement, as Chong Lizi spoke, and as his cultivation was fully activated, the star behind Chong Lizi appeared once again. It was even more majestic, and one could even see countless runes materializing within it, these runes were the power of an array formation!
Each rune possessed extraordinary power that could destroy planetary cultivators the moment they came into contact with it. He knew that Wang Baole had many rules, and he could also feel how terrifying and powerful those rules were, that was why he didn’t fight against the rules that he was familiar with. Instead, he planned to use the power of the infinite array formation to suppress his opponent.
He waved his hands violently, and countless array formation runic symbols exploded from the star behind him. They instantly filled the starry sky. They looked like a sea of array formations, charging towards Wang Baole and his clone, they surrounded and attacked him!
“Xiao Shu, array formation kill!”As the vast sea of array formations filled the starry sky and charged towards Wang Baole, Chong Coix didn’t forget to say something, as if this was his trump card that he had unleashed with all his might, it was just his countless Xiao Shu spells.
“Do you have any sense of shame?”Wang baole frowned. As he felt contempt in his heart, he narrowed his eyes and said calmly.
“An array formation?”Wang Baole shook his head. He formed a seal with his hands, and as he circulated his cultivation, he waved his hands outward. The star chart behind him shone brightly, but all of the light was the background of the stars in the star chart!
The brighter they were, the brighter the black hole-like stars in the star chart became. Eventually, as Wang Baole waved his hands and his cultivation erupted, the laws contained in the stars exploded!
“With the paper transformation of one of my three thousand little techniques, you will be enough!”
Xie Haiyang, Chen Han, and the star Dao Protectors’faces twitched once again. The tiredness in their hearts grew stronger... as their hearts grew tired, Wang Baole’s paper laws erupted.
The first thing that was affected was all the starlight outside the Stellar Dao. It instantly turned into a paper strip. Then, with his full support, it spread out abruptly and collided directly with Chong Weizi’s boundless sea of array formations.
A loud boom reverberated in all directions in the starry sky. Countless array formation runes could be seen with the naked eye. In that instant, as if they were infected, they instantly turned into paper talismans!
The starry sky looked like a sea of paper at that moment!
In the middle of the Sea of paper was Wang Baole’s calm figure. He suppressed the tremor in his body and raised his right hand. He pointed at Chong Coix, who was as calm as ever, but his heart was in turmoil.
“Suppress!”
—
I’m sorry, fellow Daoists. I just returned at noon today. I was exhausted like a dog last week. In the afternoon, I immediately started typing and updating without stopping. After that, I owe ten chapters. I’ll fill them in as soon as possible!

chapters.title: Chapter 1118
chapters.content:
Chapter 1118:, Star Battle Axe!
Translator:
549690339
As soon as the word left his mouth, the Sea of paper that was formed from the array formation runes instantly stirred up huge waves. Countless paper runes collided violently with each other, producing loud booms!
It was visible to the naked eye that the paper runes crumbled as they collided with each other, turning into scraps of paper. This process was extremely exhausting for Wang Baole. After all, it was Chong Job’s trump card, even though he was only an earth-grade star.., the gap between him and Wang Baole’s Dao realm was two levels.
However... his cultivation at the late-stage of the star realm allowed him to reduce the gap between them. Even though he couldn’t surpass it, the vastness he displayed still made it extremely difficult for Wang Baole to move them!
Therefore, Wang Baole’s cultivation had already been fully activated. The star on the star chart behind him was even darker. He really wanted to know what level he, who had entered the star realm, was at in the never-ending starry sky, he was at the same level of cultivation as him!
“Suppress me!”Wang Baole controlled the countless paper talismans around him to collide. As the paper fragments filled the air, he formed a seal with his hands. He waved his hands once again, and a low growl came from his mouth.
It was as if he had spoken a spell. The entire sea of paper instantly rumbled. Countless pieces of paper fragments gathered together in an instant, forming paper swords. They charged toward Chong Coix, whose expression had changed drastically!
From a distance, the scene was heaven-shaking and earth-shattering. Countless paper swords filled the starry sky, and as they whistled through the air, they seemed to contain incredible power as they neared Chong Coix.
However, it was at this moment that a bright light appeared in Chong Coix’s eyes. He performed a double-handed incantation gesture, causing the star behind him to explode out. It was like a huge heart, and it gave off a feeling of thumping. As it beat.., the countless paper swords that were approaching the area were instantly affected. The first batch that approached the area immediately collapsed and recovered from their papery state!
They became array talismans once again. However, due to the collapse of the papery state, they had recovered, but they had lost their power!
Wang Baole’s eyes narrowed rapidly. He endured the backlash within his body, and the glow in his eyes intensified. He raised his right hand and pressed down once again. Immediately, the light from the star atlas behind him intensified once again. The second batch, the third batch, and the endless number of paper swords.., they charged at Chong Coix Zi at an even faster speed and with an even stronger aura.
Even Chong Coix Zi’s star throbbed even more intensely, causing batch after batch of paper swords to collapse. However, there were simply too many paper swords here, and the power of the Dao stars added to them was even more ferocious, this caused many paper swords to finally charge out and approach Chong Coix Zi while the star throbbed!
“Wang Baole!”Zhong He Zi’s eyes turned red at that moment, he couldn’t care less about his bragging and posturing. Wang Baole’s strength had made him feel an intense threat time and time again. The laws of paper were especially difficult to deal with.
That was why at this critical moment, zhong he zi roared loudly. He retreated and raised his right hand. Madness flashed in his eyes. He raised his right hand and grabbed at the star behind him!
......
“Nine, Eternal Transformation!”As he roared, the star behind him distorted, and its shape changed rapidly. It was as if his right hand had turned into a real black hole, it absorbed the star!
It was a long story, but it all happened in an instant. As he roared, the star twisted and gathered on his right hand, in the blink of an eye... it transformed into a crimson battle-axe!
The battle-axe was vastly superior to the golden spear he had unleashed earlier, both in terms of energy and aura. The instant Chong Yizi grabbed it, it was as if the star was in his hand, and his eyes shone with madness, suddenly... the battle-axe descended!
The Axe had gathered all of his cultivation and battle prowess in the entire star. It was as if he had compressed them all into a single point. The moment he swung his axe, it was earth-shattering. The starry sky shattered, and loud rumbles rang out in all directions. It was as if a giant wave was splitting the sky, a demonic god was about to tear everything apart!
Judging from its aura, it was on par with the might of the resentful weapon that Wang Baole had displayed earlier. The moment it landed, all the paper swords in front of it trembled and shattered. They were destroyed as easily as dried twigs, and they were reduced to ashes!
It wasn’t just the paper swords in front of it, but around it as well. All the paper swords in all directions seemed to be unable to withstand it. The moment the battle axe landed, they collapsed layer by layer, causing the starry sky to distort even more violently as it trembled, after all the paper swords had collapsed, Wang Baole’s face turned pale as he stared fixedly at Chong Job-i Zi, especially the battle axe in his hand!
To Chong Yizi, the ability to condense his own star into a battle axe was an ultimate technique. His body was trembling, but he couldn’t back down now. He had to fight, he had to kill Wang Baole. At the very least... he had to severely injure him.
Otherwise, the late-stage star realm would be defeated by the early-stage star realm. Even though one of them was at the Earth realm and the other was at the Dao realm, as the dao child of the nine Prefectures Dao, he couldn’t accept it. It would leave a knot in his heart that would affect his breakthrough!
That was why when the first axe landed and shattered the starry paper sword, the Bloodshot Eyes of Chong Lizi grew even more bloodshot. She jumped up crazily, raised the battle axe in her hand, and slashed the second axe at Wang Baole!
She was so fast that she didn’t give Wang Baole any chance to counterattack. The second axe landed with a loud bang, tearing the starry sky apart. The quasi-dao star clones around Wang baole trembled. They didn’t last long and couldn’t maintain their clones, they transformed back into quasi-dao stars and retreated together, merging into Wang Baole’s original body.
His original body, on the other hand, had withstood more than half the force of the axe. Blood oozed out of the corners of his mouth as a loud bang rang out. His body retreated continuously. It was only when he was tens of thousands of feet away that he stopped. His internal organs seemed to be on the verge of being torn apart, the star chart behind him shook even more. However, his expression didn’t look dejected. Instead, it was filled with excitement!
“Chong Lizi, that’s more like it. It’s worth forty percent of my combat strength!”
“Wang Baole, shut up. Why are you still putting on airs at this point in time? Who doesn’t know how to F * cking brag? Let’s see if I can kill you with a light axe without using my cultivation!”Chong Lizi could not take it anymore, he blurted it out. At that moment, the aura in his entire body erupted. The moment he spoke... it was as if a balloon had deflated a little. The axe that he had raised paused slightly, and the light from it dimmed slightly.
Wang Baole saw that and a glint flashed in his eyes. He took advantage of the opportunity to circulate his cultivation, and a gigantic figure appeared before him. The figure exuded divine might and held flames in his hands. It was... the shadow of his previous life.., the Infernal God clan.
The moment it appeared, the gigantic figure of the infernal God clan charged forward, charging straight for job’s tears. At that moment, Chong Yizi endured the backlash from her body. Beads of sweat formed on her forehead, and she activated the remaining strength in her body. She slashed at Wang Baole with her third axe!
In the blink of an eye, the third axe collided with Wang Baole’s Xin Huo Celestial race. With a loud boom, the battle axe shook, and the figure of the Xin Huo Celestial race was torn apart. As it exploded, a wave of hatred rose from within, it was another figure of Wang Baole from his previous life. It charged at the battle axe without any pause.
The Battle Axe shook once more, and blood spurted out of Chong Job’s mouth. However, as it exploded crazily, the second figure of Wang Baole from his previous life was also torn apart. However, what Chong Job’s tears didn’t expect was that within the second figure from his previous life.., there was actually another shadow from his previous life!
It was... the little white deer!
The moment it appeared, the little white deer charged straight at Chong Job’s Battle Axe!
In an instant, it collided with the Battle Axe!
All of this happened too quickly. Wang Baole’s shadow from his previous life appeared again and again, causing Chong Job’s job’s job’s job’s job’s job’s job’s job’s job’s job’s job to be in shock. The Little White Deer’s charge made him feel as if he was unable to fight back, at that moment, his battle axe finally reached its limit. A loud boom reverberated in all directions. The battle axe and the white deer... collapsed together, disintegrating into pieces!
Chong coi zi also let out a blood-curdling scream. Blood spewed wildly from his mouth as his cultivation aura fell abruptly. His body was like a kite with a broken string. He was swept up by the impact of the loud boom in all directions and thrown far into the distance. However, even though he was severely injured.., however, after letting out a blood-curdling scream that he could not control, he began to laugh loudly.
“Wang Baole, I know that your blazing flame lineage’s trump card is a curse that comes at the cost of your life. However, the nine prefectures dao... is also good at curses. Today, let’s see if you dare to gamble your life. I’ll injure you in exchange for my injuries. Nine... Same-life curses! ”!”
—
He started writing after he returned. He had been writing all this while, and he was finally relieved. He felt rather guilty this week, and he would do his best to make up for it. Thank you, everyone. He cupped his fists!

chapters.title: Chapter 1119
chapters.content:
Chapter 1119:, curse resistance!
Translator:
549690339
The instant he opened his mouth to speak, a world-shaking aura erupted from his body. As it did, a strange light appeared in his eyes as he stood in the starry sky.
His hair was disheveled, and he was severely injured. His aura was weak, and his face was pale. Even the stars behind him were starting to blur. It was the same for his body.
His internal organs were continuously rupturing, and all the bones in his body were trembling. His flesh and blood were being torn apart at all times.
If it were anyone else, they wouldn’t have been able to withstand such injuries. However, Chong Yizi forced himself to endure it. As he spoke, a smile tugged at the corners of his lips.
“Why do you think I went all out to fight you despite my injuries the moment I made my move?”As Chong Yizi spoke, he took a step towards Wang Baole. As he took that step, a purple aura instantly spread out from all the wounds on his body, it formed one rune after another, emitting a strange glow that was similar to his eyes.
Seeing that, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes slightly. He immediately felt that there were many spots on his body that were tingling with pain. He didn’t even need to compare them carefully. Just by looking at them with the naked eye.., he could see... that the areas of his body that were tingling with pain were exactly the same as the wounds on Chong Coix’s body!
“Why do you think I used a spell at the cost of even more injuries after my divine ability was shattered?”Chong Job’s laughter rang out as he took another step forward. This time, it wasn’t just the wound that was emitting violet qi, more Violet Qi spread out from his seven apertures and pores. This... came from his internal organs, his bones, and his flesh and blood!
The Purple Qi that was spreading out from inside and outside had already spread to the surroundings of Chong Job’s body. The surrounding starry skies around him were instantly filled with purple qi.
At the same time, Wang Baole immediately sensed that the piercing pain outside his body was getting stronger. His internal organs, bones, flesh, and blood were also rapidly exuding a piercing pain.
“Do you really think that you have victory in your hands?”
“Do you really think that you can suppress me?”As he laughed loudly, Chong Weizi took the third step. As he took that step, the dim and blurry star behind him suddenly... changed color, more than half of it turned purple, and it spread rapidly towards the area where the color had not been changed!
All of this brought an extremely strong sense of danger to Wang Baole. Wang Baole’s narrowed eyes shone with a strange light. He could feel that his star chart was trembling, and tiny cracks were appearing, they were appearing out of thin air!
Chong Lizi is... scheming! Wang Baole’s expression was solemn. Ever since he had left Earth with his senior brother, Chen Qingzi, he had experienced all sorts of things along the way. There had been countless battles, big and small.
......
However, there were only a limited number of people who had left a deep impression on him. Now, there was one more person.
It was Chong Coix.
This person had laid out his plans the moment he had made his move. If he had been a little careless, he would have fallen into the other party’s calculations. At the same time, this person’s personality was changeable. He seemed to possess the pride of a powerful warrior, however, when he lowered his stance, he did not feel the slightest bit awkward.
Such scheming, coupled with his powerful combat strength, made Chong Lizi very impressive. What made Wang Baole even more concerned was that this person had already thought of a second plan after his first plan had failed.
This second plan was the so-called... Same Fate Curse!
This curse... in simple terms, it was like a mirror. Once it was activated, it could reflect one’s own state on the enemy’s body. In other words... the more serious one’s injuries were, the more serious the enemy’s injuries would be once the curse was activated.., the enemy’s injuries would be equally serious!
Therefore, if one wanted to use the curse, one had to be extremely miserable. Only then could one succeed. On the surface, it looked like a method of mutual destruction, but in reality, there were other methods to use the curse, it could allow one’s injuries to recover for a short period of time after the curse ended, thus turning defeat into victory!
“Therefore, although the battle before was real, it was also intentional by this job-seeker. If he could win, that would be for the best. If he couldn’t... then why did he use the curse at such a critical moment? Is he afraid of My Constant Dao? Or is he afraid of My Laws...”
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and muttered to himself. Rumbling sounds came from his body, and wounds appeared out of thin air. Blood spurted out, and his internal organs began to shatter. The star chart behind him grew dim and blurry, all of this was exactly the same as Chong Weizi’s current state.
Interesting. You know that the raging flame lineage specializes in curses, and you know that the curse of my lineage comes at the cost of my life force, yet you still dare to challenge me to a battle of curses
It seems like you are very confident that my life force... is not enough to curse you? Wang Baole ignored the injuries inside and outside his body, not to mention the dimness of the star chart behind him. Since the start of the battle.., in reality, he still had too many trump cards that he had yet to use.
Although it wasn’t twenty to thirty percent of his combat strength as mentioned earlier, it was still not all he had.
He didn’t use the divine ox projection, the Dao scriptures, or Wang Baole’s intrinsic scabbard.
After all, he had just advanced to a star. Wang Baole needed a battle to give himself a better understanding of his combat strength. He also needed a very good whetstone to sharpen his blade.
In Wang Baole’s eyes, Chong Weizi was the most suitable whetstone!
He even had a vague feeling that it wasn’t that his master, the blazing flame ancestor, didn’t know about the battle, but that he had done it on purpose. He wanted the other party to sharpen his blade!
That’s good... I haven’t used the curse in a long time. I don’t look like a disciple of the blazing flame lineage anymore. Wang Baole suddenly laughed. The curse of the blazing flame lineage was known as the Flame Spirit Curse!
The foundation of this curse was life force, an endless life force. More importantly, there was... resentment, an endless amount of resentment!
As he laughed, Wang Baole raised his left hand. Black threads immediately appeared around his left hand. In an instant, they filled his entire palm, as if they had turned into even more wrinkles and veins, causing his left hand to turn completely black!
In the darkness, endless resentment spread wildly from within, spreading throughout the starry skies in all directions, causing the surrounding starry skies to distort. Xie Haiyang and the others, who were in the distance, had their expressions change drastically. In their eyes.., it was as if they could no longer see Wang Baole. All they could see was a merciless and endless resentment... the left hand!
It wasn’t just the power of the resentful soldiers. It was also the madness of the Xin Huo divine race, as well as the determination of the zombies and their hatred for the world, as well as their determination to shatter the void!
The resentment that had gathered from all his previous lives might not have all gathered in this life, but even a portion of it was enough. The appearance of the resentful left hand caused the expression on Zhong Yue’s face to change!
Before he could react, Wang Baole’s life force erupted!
What Wang Baole didn’t lack the most was life force. Wood represented life force, and Wang Baole’s true form was a three-foot-long black wooden board!
As his mind raced, an illusory black wooden board appeared in the dim star chart behind him. As it appeared, boundless life force exploded within Wang Baole’s body.
He raised his right hand, causing all life force to instantly fuse into it and become its source. As he raised his hand, Wang Baole’s left hand was filled with resentment, and his right hand was filled with life. The moment his ten fingers touched.., he raised his head abruptly and looked calmly at the changing expression on Chong Coix’s face. He spoke calmly.
“Flame Spirit Curse!”
As soon as he spoke, the starry sky rumbled. Wang Baole’s resentment and life force instantly thinned. Chong Coix, on the other hand, was extremely shocked. He let out an incredulous roar.
“This resentment, this life force... Impossible!”As he roared, he retreated abruptly, however, it was too late. All of the Purple Qi around his body began to boil, and he broke free from Chong Weizi’s control. He spun and transformed into three black daggers that were filled with skulls. They let out soundless roars, they charged toward Chong Weizi and stabbed into his body!

chapters.title: Chapter 1120
chapters.content:
Chapter 1120:, shadow of the Divine Emperor!
Translator:
549690339
The three daggers were made entirely of black gas. Outside the seemingly real daggers were countless skulls of various sizes, all of which were roaring.
No one else could hear the roaring, but Chong Weizi could. The impact on his mind was naturally huge. Even a late-stage star cultivator would bleed from all seven orifices from the Roaring Impact, his body, which had retreated, swayed a little, and he couldn’t avoid it at all!
In that instant, the first dagger pierced through Chong Coix’s chest at an indescribable speed. As it pierced through, the dagger turned back into black gas and entered his body rapidly.
The moment the black gas entered his body, Chong Coix let out an extremely shrill scream. The flesh and blood all over his body seemed to have been corroded at that moment, instantly withering. It would have been fine if it was just withering, but after withering..! The flesh and blood had actually... melted!
They turned into drops of black blood. As Chong Coix retreated, they flowed continuously from his body, scattering into the starry skies. At the same time, what appeared in Wang Baole’s eyes was no longer Chong Coix, it was... a skeleton!
This scene caused Xie Haiyang and Chen Han, who were watching from afar, to feel their scalps go numb. Their breathing quickened, and waves of emotions surged in their hearts. Wang Baole’s curse was too cruel and vicious, and its power was equally terrifying.
Chong Yizi was a late-stage star cultivator. As the Second Dao Child of the Nine Prefectures Dao, not only had his cultivation reached an extremely high level, but his physical body was also the same. That was why when he had attacked Wang Baole previously, even though he had been severely injured.., he had only suffered a lot of injuries.
But now... it was no longer a matter of injuries. There was no flesh and blood left. With this comparison, everyone could feel how terrifying Wang Baole’s curse was!
It was an overbearing manner that disregarded the strength of one’s physical body and used one’s own resentment and life force to forcefully wipe it out!
Clearly, Wang Baole’s flame spirit curse had not ended. Even though Chong Coix’s screams stopped with the loss of his flesh and blood, the second dagger approached quickly. It did not give him any chance to resist or dodge as it stabbed forward!
As it stabbed forward, the dagger also turned into black gas. It instantly spread to all the bones in Chong Coix’s body, causing the skeleton to turn pitch black in the blink of an eye. Then... it melted again!
The pain caused by the melting of the bones caused intense ripples to spread out in her divine soul. If she had sent her divine sense out to sense her divine soul, she would have heard an indescribably mournful howl.
The entire process took a long time to describe, but it actually happened in an instant. In the next moment... Her body completely vanished, leaving behind only her divine soul in the starry sky.
......
His physical body had been destroyed, and his divine soul had no place to rest. It was extremely tragic, but the curse... was still ongoing. The third dagger brought with it an endless amount of black smoke. Amidst the howls of the countless skulls, it stabbed directly toward Chong Weizi’s divine soul!
Fortunately, Chong Weizi himself was not ordinary. In the instant that the life-and-death crisis erupted violently, his divine soul actually did not hesitate to split itself. With a bang, it split into more than ten pieces. At the same time that it avoided the third dagger, it rapidly tumbled backward, it merged with the star that was exposed to the outside world, swaying and dimming.
As it merged, the star flashed and seemed to disappear from its original spot. However, the third dagger of the flame spirit curse continued to chase after it. As it whistled through the air, it pierced into the star just as it was about to teleport away.
This thrust broke the teleportation of the star. The star was unable to stop the dagger from merging with it. The entire star turned black rapidly, as if it had formed countless daggers, it charged straight for Chong Job’s soul, which was hidden within.
A life-and-death crisis erupted. Chong Job’s soul trembled, and despair and madness appeared in his eyes. He had never expected Wang Baole to be so powerful.
Not only were the rules and laws powerful, but his physical body and divine abilities were also powerful. Even the curse... was so terrifying. At that moment, he finally understood why, among the nine mystic arts of the sect, the curse was ranked highly, however, they were not well-known in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain.
That was because, above the curses of the nine regions dao, there was an even more powerful curse, and that was... the technique of the blazing flame branch!
Perhaps it was because the blazing flame patriarch had not made a move for a long time, or perhaps it was because the blazing flame branch rarely left the blazing flame galaxy. Therefore, although Chong Yizi knew about the curses of the blazing flame branch, he had not paid much attention to them. But now... he had paid a painful price, he finally understood what a curse was!
“I don’t want to Die!”
“I can’t Die!”Chong Job’s soul was on the verge of going mad. Within his own star, countless black daggers were about to engulf him. Furthermore, he could sense that this curse... could destroy everything about him, if he was stabbed, then even if he could be resurrected by the sect in the future, it would be of no use.
That was because the curse... existed for all eternity. It wasn’t aimed at him, but at his life mark. unless... he could neutralize the curse here, there was nothing he could do!
“Wang Baole!”In that moment of life and death, he roared at the Coix’s soul. The Madness in his eyes reached its peak. He seemed to have made up his mind. His soul suddenly contracted and turned into the shape of a scroll.
This was the first time Wang Baole had seen such a scene. However, he immediately recalled the information he had read in the books in the Raging Flame Galaxy.
Soul Art? Wang Baole’s eyes narrowed. He remembered that there was a mystic art in the never-ending DAO domain that could only be activated in the soul state. Any soul art was filled with a strange power.
What appeared on Chong Job’s body was the soul art.
As Wang Baole was on high alert, the scroll that Chong Job’s soul had transformed into flashed. It seemed to have transformed into a real scroll, and it unfurled abruptly!
As it unfurled, the image within the scroll was revealed.
Within the image was a galaxy map. Countless stars shone, and at the same time, there was a person standing there. That person wore a long gray robe, and he seemed to be admiring the starry sky. Therefore, it seemed like his back was facing the outside world.
His back was facing the outside world, but when the scroll was unfurled and the picture was revealed, an indescribable suppressive force exploded from within the scroll!
It suppressed all the dust on both sides, suppressed all the laws in the area, suppressed the endless laws in all directions, suppressed all living things, and suppressed the starry sky!
“Wang Baole, even if I have to sacrifice half of my soul, I will still suppress you!”From within the scroll, a mental thought that rushed towards job’s soul was transmitted.
Xie Haiyang and the others spat out blood. Their bodies were pressed to the ground by the Suppressive Force. It was the same for Chen Han, as well as the other stars.
Even the warship was distorted. It lost all its spirit energy and fell downwards. That was because they were far away, so the impact wasn’t too great. Wang baole bore the brunt of the impact, and his entire body began to rumble, his body seemed like it was about to explode under the Suppressive Force, but it wasn’t completely suppressed by the force.
That was because there were nine quasi-dao stars in his star map, and one was a star Dao Star!
How could a dao star be subdued!
In the next instant, even though the nine quasi-dao stars were dim, the black light from the star Dao Rose into the sky like a black hole. Wang Baole’s body trembled, but he slowly raised his head and stared at the unfurled scroll!
“The Divine Emperor’s Shadow?”
The Suppressive Force and the terror it contained far surpassed what Wang Baole had seen from the mighty figures in the galaxy. Only the universe-grade cultivators above the galaxy could possess such power!
The moment Wang Baole looked over, the figure in the scroll, whose back was facing the outside world, suddenly turned his head slowly, as if he wanted to turn back to look at Wang Baole.
As he turned his head, the Suppressive Force increased once again, and with a loud boom, the surrounding starry skies began to collapse in a large area!
“Interesting. I’ve always used similar methods to suppress others. This is the first time I’ve seen someone suppress me. Let’s see whether your divine emperor is stronger or my father-in-law is stronger!”Wang Baole’s body trembled, however, his eyes were extremely bright. As he spoke, he silently recited... The Dao scripture in his heart!
“Ming Zhi..
“The Dao that seals the heavens requires all living beings to overcome the immeasurable tribulation..
“The obsession to leave the abyss..
“Is to serve, to cultivate! !”

chapters.title: Chapter 1121
chapters.content:
Chapter 1121:, Dare or Not!
Translator:
549690339
The instant Wang Baole recited the Dao scripture in his heart, the back of the figure in the scroll formed by Zhong Weizi had already turned half of his body. When he looked over, he could see a small side profile.
It was a middle-aged man with a high nose bridge and long eyebrows. Xie Haiyang and the others, who were standing in the distance, only took a glance at him before they coughed up blood once again. Their minds were on the verge of collapse.
The middle-aged man in the scroll looked at the corner of his eyes with a force that shook the heavens and earth. The starry sky outside the scroll rumbled incessantly.
At the same time, an even stronger suppressive force erupted violently. The force was invisible to the naked eye, but it seemed to have turned into invisible ripples. As it spread, the starry sky, which had already collapsed, collapsed completely!
The starry sky was like a shattered mirror, turning into countless shards that tumbled backwards. Loud Bangs Rose into the sky, and the battleships that Xie Haiyang and the others were on also collapsed instantly. Thankfully, they had been caught in the battle between Wang Baole and Chong Yizi, they had already retreated continuously. As the battleships were destroyed, they spat out fresh blood once again, but they managed to remain stable. At the same time, they used their trump cards and the impact to retreat rapidly.
Only when they had retreated far away did they stop. They were shocked and bewildered, their faces filled with shock.
As for Wang Baole... he was too close to the scroll, so he was naturally affected the most. As the invisible ripples formed by the Suppressive Force arrived, Wang Baole’s entire body shook violently. The stars behind him flashed with black light, they seemed to be resisting. Even though his physical body could withstand the suppressive force due to the black wooden board, his soul was still unable to withstand the suppressive force from the universe-level.
Even if... This was just a projection from the universe-level, it was still like the heavens to Wang Baole!
The power of the Dao scripture couldn’t be unleashed instantly. There was a slight delay. Even if the delay wasn’t long, it was still a severe test for Wang Baole.
It could even be said that the divine ability unleashed by Chong Coix had already surpassed the level of a star. Even the mighty figures in the galaxy would be affected. However, it was obvious that the use of this technique would definitely cost Chong Coix an indescribable price, it would be an indescribable price to pay!
After all, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that this technique could kill all stars.
However... Wang Baole wasn’t one of them. At that moment, Wang Baole’s body was trembling, the star chart was about to shatter, and his soul seemed to be on the verge of collapsing amidst the raging waves. However, his eyes were filled with a shocking desire to fight.
Even though the technique that Zhong Yizi had used in the end had exceeded Wang Baole’s imagination, he had too many trump cards. Other than the Dao scripture, he also had... the true technique that he had learned from his Epiphany on the heavenly fated star in his previous life!
......
“Waning moon!”Wang Baole let out a hoarse roar almost as the figure in the scroll turned half of his body around, and the Suppressive Force erupted.
He raised his hands and formed a hand seal, then pointed at the scroll!
With that finger, the collapsing starry sky shook. A strange force seemed to gather the infinite laws of the universe and pull out... the time art!
Time had descended!
Reverse flow... twenty breaths!
If it had been a true universe-grade cultivator, even if Wang Baole had mastered the waning moon, he wouldn’t have been able to affect a universe-grade cultivator. A single look and a single breath from the other party was enough to cause his spell to collapse and his body and soul to be destroyed.
But now, it was just a projection... even if he still couldn’t unleash the full twenty breaths of the waning moon spell’s reverse flow, he could still do it in three to five breaths.
That was why, the moment the waning moon spell was unleashed, the shattered fragments of the starry sky around him were sent tumbling back, as if they were about to heal. Xie Haiyang and the others, who were standing far away, spat out blood and spat it back into their mouths, their bodies moving uncontrollably.
That wasn’t all. What was truly shocking was the suppressive force that had struck Wang Baole and shattered his soul. At that moment, the Suppressive Force suddenly reversed in front of him, moving towards the image of the scroll, the figure that had turned half its body around returned rapidly.
However... that was the best that Wang Baole’s crescent moon could do. It could affect the surrounding starry sky, the people in all directions, the laws of law, and the Suppressive Force, however... it couldn’t affect the figure on the scroll!
After all, he was a star, and the figure on the scroll was a projection of a universe-grade cultivator. Even so, if a mighty figure were to witness this scene with their own eyes, their hearts would definitely be filled with shock and shock.
That was because... this was something that had never happened in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain. A star could actually affect a projection of a universe-grade cultivator. It was a miracle even if it only affected the projection slightly!
This didn’t represent how powerful Wang Baole was, but it did represent... that the level of the technique that Wang Baole was using surpassed... that of a universe-grade divine ability!
If one were to think about it carefully, it would definitely be terrifying!
Amidst the rumbling, the figure within the scroll wasn’t affected. However, there was a soft gasp. He turned around quickly, as if he was looking at Wang Baole.
However... time was still a little late. Wang Baole’s waning moon could reverse the flow of time, but it didn’t affect the entire universe. It only affected the starry sky. Therefore... the flow of time outside the region.., it was still normal. Therefore... the moment the figure on the screen of the scroll was about to turn around completely... the power of the Dao scripture exploded after the delay!
An aura that did not belong to this starry sky, nor did it belong to this universe, suddenly descended from beyond the starry sky... . It was as if a sleeping deity had... opened his eyes beyond the starry sky, he looked at the never-ending DAO domain, at the exit of the heavenly fated star, at the battlefield, at... The scroll that Chong Weizi had transformed into, and then at the figure on the scroll who was trying to turn around!
The starry sky rumbled and shook in all directions. The entire battlefield seemed to freeze in that instant. Xie Haiyang and the others lost consciousness, and the figure on the scroll froze!
He didn’t dare turn around anymore!
It was as if he was shocked, as if he was locked on, as if he was in a life-and-death crisis. The figure shuddered and had a hunch that if he continued to turn around, he would die the moment he finished!
This scene made Wang baole excited amidst his nervousness. His eyes shone with a strange light as he stared at the figure in the scroll, who seemed to be in a dilemma.
Very quickly, Wang Baole saw the figure in the scroll. After a few breaths of silence, the figure that had already turned half its body slowly... slowly turned back!
It can do that? Wang baole blinked. He looked at the figure on the screen of the scroll and saw that it had turned back. It did not stop. Instead, it walked further into the screen until it reached the end of the screen, finally... it disappeared!
It escaped
Wang Baole was stunned. Then, he immediately noticed that the scroll that had lost its screen seemed to have suffered a backlash. It collapsed with a loud bang and exploded into pieces. There was even a shrill scream from the soul that came from the collapse.
Then, Wang Baole saw... the soul of Chong Lizi!
The soul had shrunk by ninety percent compared to before, and it was extremely weak. After it appeared, it couldn’t even maintain its consciousness. It fainted from the scream. Wang Baole raised his right hand and grabbed it, grabbing it in his hand.
After throwing it into his storage bag, Wang Baole’s chest heaved up and down. He sensed that the aura from the DAO scripture had also dissipated rapidly. Then, he sensed that the battle had attracted a lot of aura from the surroundings, as if he was observing the situation, he blinked a few times. Suddenly, he turned toward the distant starry sky, cupped his fists, and bowed deeply.
“Thank you, Father-in-law!”
His voice reverberated in all directions, reaching the ears of Xie Haiyang and the others, who were slowly regaining their senses. Xie Haiyang and the others were stunned, and their expressions changed.
Before the shock in their hearts could fade into silence, Wang Baole had already tidied up his clothes and secretly swallowed some healing medicine. He turned around and walked toward them with his usual air of an expert, he took three steps and arrived before Xie Haiyang, Chen Han, and the Stellar Dao protectors. He lowered his head and glanced at them before speaking calmly.
“Regarding my father-in-law, do not spread the news. Let’s go back to the Raging Flame Galaxy.”As he spoke, Wang Baole placed his hands behind his back and walked forward.
Xie Haiyang and Chen Han looked at each other. They saw the shock in each other’s eyes and quickly followed him. The dao protectors around them felt the same way. They looked at Wang Baole with awe and respect and followed him quickly.
As they followed, Chen Han suddenly turned to look at Xie Haiyang, who was still in shock, and sent a voice transmission.
“Say... how should I address my father-in-law?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1122
chapters.content:
Chapter 1122:, Moon Splitter, was about to fall!
Translator:
549690339
Xie Haiyang was at a loss, unable to react in time. Chen Han was also deep in thought. As he thought about how he should address the group, as the group left, in the starry skies surrounding the battlefield.., waves of auras descended.
If the battle between Wang Baole and Chong Yizi had ended quickly, it might not have attracted much attention. However, the battle between the two of them had lasted for a long time. At the same time, the divine abilities they had unleashed were too shocking, as a result, they had naturally attracted the attention of some mighty figures!
Even if Chong Coix had attacked with the interference of Purple Moon’s karma, it had not been able to affect all of them. As the streams of auras descended, all traces of the battlefield were swept across by the incoming auras.
There was no interaction between them. There was only shock and fear as they watched Wang Baole leave!
They were afraid of Wang Baole’s strange time reversal. They were afraid of... the will that came from the depths of the starry skies and didn’t seem to belong to the Weiyang Dao Domain!
It was a terrifying existence that could make even a projection of a universe-grade cultivator not dare turn around after a moment of silence. Such an existence... they had all heard what Wang Baole had said. It was his father-in-law..
After a moment of silence, even though the presences that had descended had dispersed, news of the battle between Wang Baole and Chong job-tears continued to spread rapidly.
The speed at which the news spread caused the battle to shake the heavens and earth. It happened extremely quickly. In just seven to eight days, while Wang Baole and his group were still on their way back to the raging flame galaxy, almost all the large sects and top-tier clans in the left Dao sacred region.., learned of the news.
In an instant, shocked voices could be heard in different regions of the left Dao Sacred Region!
“The Second Dao Child of the Nine Prefectures Dao, Chong Coix, was defeated by Wang Baole and captured alive?”
“Wang Baole advanced to a star?”
“I heard that a universe-grade projection and the powers from the outer domains appeared in this battle!”
Wang Baole’s fame had already attracted the attention of many factions in the left dao sacred region due to the acquisition of the Dao planet and the matter of the heavenly fated star. Now, with this incident occurring in the midst of the attention, his name quickly spread throughout the entire left dao sacred region, he was already famous.
......
At the same time, as Wang Baole and the others were on their way back to the raging flame galaxy, and as the battle between him and Chong Weizi escalated, his fame spread even further.
