The elder from the food qi sect had a drastic change in expression as well, all of this had happened too quickly. Wang Baole’s attack was too strange, and the shock it brought was naturally intense.
The elder could sense that the remaining disciples from his own sect were no match for Wang Baole. He didn’t have time to think too much, and he formed a double-handed incantation gesture to stop him.
The Blazing Flame ancestor, on the other hand, was laughing loudly as he made his move. A loud boom rang out as he neutralized the Qi Eater sect ancestor’s rescue. At the same time, Wang Baole’s ten figures instantly made contact with the remaining cultivators of the Qi Eater sect. A loud boom reverberated in the air, and the slaughter began once again!
A shrill sound rang out, followed by a loud boom. One after another, the disciples of the Qi Eater sect were annihilated in body and soul. This scene caused the Qi Eater sect ancestor to erupt in rage, and he let out a loud roar.
“Everyone,”he said, “If you won’t help me now, don’t tell me you’re waiting for the Raging Flames to chase you away! ?”
As soon as the old man spoke, more than a dozen auras from the Starry Sky exploded out, transforming into numerous figures that appeared in the starry sky above Patriarch Flame. They all attacked, unleashing a suppressive force that enveloped patriarch flame, a voice reverberated in the air.
“Blazing Flame, let’s stop here.”
“We can just spar. There’s no need to be so aggressive!”
“You dare threaten me? My disciple, continue to kill. Show me your dominance and kill an invincible opponent at the same cultivation realm!”The Blazing Flame ancestor glared, he roared and roared like a divine ox beneath him. His aura erupted once again, and a sea of fire appeared around him. It transformed into a gigantic flaming palm that pressed down violently towards the starry sky above!
The starry sky rumbled, and ripples spread out violently. Wang Baole’s ten clones each killed one of the Qi Eater sect disciples. Then, they gathered together and transformed into their real bodies. They charged towards the remaining seven or eight people!
The Permanent Dao was revealed. Quasi-dao surrounded them, and tens of thousands of stars filled the sky. At that moment, Wang Baole looked like a god!
“Kill!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1130
chapters.content:
Chapter 1130:, the Divine Emperor appeared!
Translator:
549690339
The moment the word left his mouth, it was earth-shattering!
Wang Baole’s figure was surrounded by stars. He didn’t use any supernatural powers. He simply clenched his fist and gathered the power of more than ten thousand special stars, nine quasi-dao stars, and one dao star into his fist. He erupted with it!
This power, as it erupted, was completely Wang Baole’s due to the effects of the astral projection technique. It could be compressed infinitely, and it reached its limit in an instant. As the fist landed, it was as if a galaxy was crashing down on someone!
In an instant, a stellar cultivator from the Qi eater sect in front of him bore the brunt of the impact. He let out a shrill scream, and his body exploded. His soul was unable to escape, and it was shattered into pieces. His body and soul were destroyed!
It wasn’t over yet. Wang Baole’s aura surged. He took a step forward and unleashed a second, third, and fourth punch!
One punch killed one person!
In the blink of an eye, three more early-stage star realm cultivators from the Qi Eater sect were blasted apart, turning into a cloud of blood mist that shook the entire area. The remaining three Qi Eater sect cultivators were also shocked to the extreme, they had long lost their will to fight. They retreated abruptly and were about to escape. One of them roared at the top of his lungs.
“Wang Baole, we’re all weaklings. If you have the ability, go inside and kill my third senior brother. My third senior brother is at the perfected star realm. Do you dare go and kill him?”
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He knew that the various sects and clans stationed at the edge of the gray space were meant for their chosen ones to rest. The gray space was vast, and it was only natural that they would need to return and replenish their supplies while exploring, therefore, it was normal for the food qi sect to have disciples inside.
Perfected Stellar Realm? Wang Baole smiled. He was about to chase after them, but at that moment, his master, the blazing flame ancestor, could not take it anymore. The blazing flame ancestor might be strong, but he was facing the combined suppression of more than ten mighty figures from the galaxy, he was barely able to do so. The giant hand that was spreading out with the divine ox was showing signs of cracking.
After all... He wasn’t at his full strength. He still had at least thirty percent of his strength left in the blazing flame galaxy. He had created his disciples, flowers, and plants.
Seeing that his strength was lacking, the blazing flame ancestor and the divine ox blinked at the same time. Then, the blazing flame ancestor raised his head abruptly, looking as if he was about to perish together. He roared loudly.
“You actually dare to join forces to bully me? Good. You want to drink a pot of curses that I’ve been holding in for ten thousand years?”
......
“I’m afraid of Death? I’m not afraid of anything. Since you want to drink, then F * ck you! I’ll show you how it’s Done!”The Blazing Flame Patriarch roared, the various starfields that had joined forces to suppress him also felt a headache coming on, and couldn’t help but restrain themselves a bit.
Seeing that the other party had restrained themselves, the blazing flame ancestor became even more arrogant. He roared even louder.
“With this outburst of mine, not only will I exterminate all of you, but I will also exterminate all the sects and clans in the area. Am I afraid of You? F * ck you, I’m going to explode!”The Blazing Flame ancestor roared, the aura of a curse instantly appeared around his body. As soon as this aura appeared, the sky changed color, and the wind and clouds tumbled. The starry sky rumbled.
The expressions of the mighty figures from the galaxy who had joined forces to suppress the blazing flame ancestor changed. The expressions of all the surrounding sects and clans changed as well. Wang Baole was shocked as well. He thought to himself that his master couldn’t be serious.., he could just scare people..
Just as the blazing flame ancestor’s aura of curse spread and the starry sky rumbled, a helpless cough came from above the gray starry sky.
“Enough, blazing flame. Hurry up and put away the curse you’ve been holding back for 10,000 years. It’s not a big deal.”
As soon as the words left his mouth, the empty void above the gray starry sky began to distort. It was as if a curtain had been lifted up, revealing what was inside..
There were at least 100,000 battleships, densely packed together, covering the entire area above the gray starry sky!
These warships were completely different from the Wan Zong clan. They were golden beetles, one after another. From Afar, they looked like a sea of golden beetles that covered the sky and covered the earth, enveloping the entire area.
“The Wei Yang clan!”
Cries of alarm instantly rang out from within the Wan Zong clan. Wang Baole instantly recognized the origins of these golden beetles. They were indeed... The Wei Yang clan!
They were identical to the ones he had seen on the ancient green-bronze sword, but their auras were different. The auras of any of the golden beetles here made him shudder. It was especially terrifying, to the point that his eyes hurt, three golden figures were floating above the Sea of golden beetles!
The three figures were completely enveloped by golden light. Their appearances couldn’t be seen, only their blurry outlines could be seen... and the monstrous ripples that emanated from their bodies seemed to be able to affect the entire universe.
However, if one were to look closely, they would be able to see that although the three figures were all shining with golden light, only the person at the very front was the source. As for the other two, they were slightly dimmer than the others. They were merely being set off by the light, they looked the same.
As for the ripples, they were the same. The ripples coming from the person in front of them were terrifyingly terrifying. They seemed to be able to destroy natural laws, change laws, affect spacetime, and suppress the myriad sects and clans of the universe. Compared to him, the almighty experts from the star fields.., he was like a newborn child. The two of them were on completely different levels!
As for the last two, they were clearly much weaker. They were also on completely different levels.
The appearance of the three of them instantly caused the galaxies that had joined forces to suppress the blazing flame ancestor to retreat and bow in unison.
Almost all the surrounding clans and sects also bowed in the same manner.
“Greetings, divine emperor! Greetings, left and Right Radiant Kings!”
“Divine Emperor!”Wang Baole’s mind was in turmoil at that moment. At the same time, his mind was shaken by the sweeping gaze. He didn’t have time to kill the remaining disciples of the qi-eating sect. He retreated abruptly, he retreated onto the Divine Bull’s back. The feeling of fear still lingered.
At the same time, he saw green wisps of smoke falling from the countless golden beetles and merging into the gray starry sky below.
It had clearly been going on for a long time. The never-ending clan hadn’t intended for everyone to see it, but the curse of their master, the blazing flame ancestor, had forced the never-ending clan to intervene.
Could it be that everything that had happened just now had been done on purpose by master just to see this? Wang Baole was shaken. The Blazing Flame ancestor looked at everything before him, and an unnoticeable glint flashed in his eyes, he remained unafraid of death. Whoever provoked him, he would risk his life for them. He snorted.
“Divine Emperor Mystic Flower, I’ll give you some face. I’ve been holding back the curse for ten thousand years and won’t release it. However, you must get the hell out of this place. I get annoyed whenever I see them!”
Wang baole, who was standing behind the blazing flame ancestor, heard those words and broke out in a cold sweat for his master. He thought to himself that his master was indeed a fierce person. As a celestial domain cultivator, he actually dared to speak to the divine emperor in such a manner. It seemed like he hadn’t been deceived, he indeed possessed the ability to perish together with a universe-grade cultivator at the divine emperor’s level.
The distant divine emperor mystic flower shook his head slightly when he heard those words. He was sick of it. He was in charge of the plans of the Weiyang clan. In reality, before the blazing flame ancestor had arrived, he had been in charge of the array formation. Whether he would appear or not depended on his mood, when he saw the blazing flame patriarch, he felt a headache coming on. He had already given up on the idea of showing up.
However, he had never imagined that the blazing flame patriarch would have such a bad temper today. He had actually spread out the curse a bit. If something went wrong with the Blazing Flame Patriarch’s head and he exploded, then even he would be affected because he was too close to the blazing flame patriarch, he would still be affected.
Furthermore... it was hard for him to say whether or not the blazing flame patriarch would perish.
Patriarch Blazing’s curse was both bizarre and extreme. Therefore, he had no choice but to call for a halt. At the same time, he was very displeased with the Qi Eater sect.
You people have nothing better to do than to provoke the Madman Blazing Flame!
You clearly know that the other party has a grudge against your sect, so why do you still want to Talk Back? The other party can scold you for a bit, but if he wants you to leave, then leave. Why do you want to stir up trouble.
With that thought in mind, divine Emperor Xuan Hua said coolly,.
“Qi Eater sect, leave immediately!”
As soon as the words left his mouth, the old man from the Qi Eater sect let out a sigh of relief. He immediately bowed his head and said, “Yes!”Then he led the remaining disciples, who were still in shock, he didn’t care about the disciples who had entered the gray starry sky and had yet to return. He left at top speed.
As they left, the mystic flower divine emperor cast a deep glance at the blazing flame ancestor. He waved his sleeve, and the surroundings distorted. It was as if a curtain had reappeared, covering everything once again.
At the same time, the blazing flame ancestor narrowed his eyes. He suddenly sent a voice transmission to Wang Baole, who was behind him.
“When you see your senior brother, remember to tell him that he owes me a favor. I helped him find out about the Wei Yang clan’s arrangements and the identity of the Divine Emperor!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1131
chapters.content:
Chapter 1131:, entering the gray domain!
Translator:
549690339
This is an old fox! After hearing the voice transmission from the blazing flame ancestor, even though Wang Baole felt that it was a little inappropriate to describe his master in such a manner, he thought that since the person before him was able to ride on him, he probably wouldn’t care about such things.
In fact, when Wang Baole had made his move earlier, he had thought that his master wanted him to establish his authority. Although he had some doubts in his heart, he didn’t expect that his master’s goal would be this.
That’s indeed the case when I think about it carefully. The Weiyang clan covered themselves up because they didn’t want anyone to find out what was going on. The trouble that master had caused caused the Weiyang clan to have no choice but to make an appearance, which indirectly exposed their plans
As Wang Baole thought about this, he looked at the blazing flame ancestor and squeezed out some admiration. He knew what his master needed, and that was indeed the case. After feeling the admiration in Wang Baole’s eyes, the blazing flame ancestor cleared his throat, he raised his head proudly, his heart filled with joy.
The divine ox that he was sitting on also narrowed its eyes, revealing a smug expression.
“My good disciple, now you know how powerful master is, right?”The blazing flame ancestor lifted his chin and spoke to Wang Baole.
“Master is mighty, and his deductions are astonishing. My Dream in this life is to achieve one-tenth of master’s achievements. I thought that I had it, but now that I look at it, I’m still far from it. Master, please accept my sincere bow!”Wang Baole’s eyes were still filled with admiration, he spoke with emotion and bowed deeply to the blazing flame ancestor.
The Blazing Flame ancestor was even happier. Even the divine bull trembled a few times.
“Don’t be discouraged. As long as you work hard in your cultivation, this day will come.”The Blazing Flame ancestor turned to look at Wang Baole and patted him on the shoulder. His gaze landed on the gray starry sky not far away.
“You see the Gray Starry Sky, right? Spread out your divine perception and feel it carefully. Then, tell me what you’ve noticed.”The blazing flame ancestor was delighted, and he wanted to give Wang baole some pointers.
Wang Baole swept his gaze across the gray starry sky. When he had first arrived, he had already noticed the figures coming and going within the gray starry sky. He had already made some guesses, and he knew that there must be something strange within the gray starry sky, it made it impossible for ordinary cultivators to stay inside for long. They would have to return after a period of time to recuperate and enter again.
That was why there were so many figures coming and going.
It was just as the disciples of the Qi eating sect had said. Their third senior brother was like that. He hadn’t reached his limit in the gray space, and that was why he hadn’t come out for a while.
......
At the same time, if one looked at the gray space for a long time, one would easily notice that as more and more people entered, the color of the space would gradually become denser.
Even though he had these analyses and judgments in his heart, Wang Baole still spread out his divine sense and extended towards the gray space. Soon, he made contact with it. The moment his divine sense made contact with the gray space, Wang Baole’s body shook violently, he felt a suppressive and repulsive force.
Huh? Wang Baole’s eyes focused as he sensed it carefully.
He realized that the repulsive force wasn’t very strong, but it was persistent. As Wang Baole’s divine sense spread out, the suppressive and repulsive force grew stronger. At the same time, based on the performance of the others who had entered the gray space zone.., he immediately noticed the difference.
The force of repulsion grew stronger with each cultivator as they went deeper. However, the degree of increase was different. Some planet cultivators didn’t seem to have much of a reaction to the force of repulsion, but some stars.., they were obviously exhausted when they came out, as if they had used up a lot of energy.
“The increase depends on the level of cultivation. The higher the level of cultivation, the stronger the repulsion and suppression after entering. In other words... there are restrictions here, restricting the entry of cultivators above a certain level!”Wang baole immediately understood, after another round of observation, he suddenly spoke.
“You are not allowed to enter this starfield. As for the planets... Even though you will be able to enter more smoothly, they are too dangerous. Only the stars... are the most suitable levels to enter this place!”
The Blazing Flame ancestor smiled when he heard that. He too looked at the gray starry sky, his eyes deep. After a long while, he spoke softly.
“You are right. There is suppression here. It’s not that you are not allowed to enter the Starfield, but once you enter... it will be difficult for you to take even a single step forward
“That’s why when the Wan Zong clan found out about this place, they arranged for the chosen of the various sects and clans to come here to cultivate and acquire good fortune. Although the Wei Yang clan didn’t seem willing, in truth... They were willing.”
“That’s because the more people who enter, the more chaotic the power of karma in the gray starry sky will be. Once the karma is completely chaotic, then their ritual will be even smoother!”
“However, there is a life-and-death danger here, which is why the Weiyang clan did not invite them. Instead, they chose to appear as if they were acquiescing. As a result, if a large number of elites from the various sects and clans die in there, it will have nothing to do with the Weiyang clan
“The various sects and clans are not fools. They are well aware of this. However, the opportunities are too great, and it is difficult to give up. That is why the current situation has occurred,”the blazing flame ancestor said slowly, he explained the reason for the gathering of the myriad sects and clans.
“The power of Karma?”Wang Baole was stunned when he heard that. He looked at the blazing flame ancestor.
“What do you think the Weiyang clan’s goal is to suppress the situation outside?”The Blazing Flame ancestor smiled.
“Of course, their goal is not to save the Moon splitting divine emperor. That is because it is too difficult to do so unless Xuan Hua joins in the battle. However, would he dare? Therefore, their goal is to make the death of the moon splitting divine emperor more valuable and meaningful.”
“For example... self-destruct!”The Blazing Flame ancestor narrowed his eyes. Wang Baole’s expression was solemn.
“At the same time... Even though the Weiyang clan fears Chen Qingzi, they’re only afraid of him. No matter how much of a threat Chen Qingzi is, he’s just one person. But things are different now. The Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao has awakened!”
“The wisps of smoke that you saw from the Weiyang warship are good stuff. That’s the power of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao. It’s using the Weiyang Heavenly Dao to suppress the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao.”
“That way, it can help split moon and make him last longer. It can also give him the power to self-destruct in a life-and-death situation. At the same time, it can prevent the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao from reviving. It’s not impossible... to severely injure Chen Qingzi
“However... I have a feeling that Chen Qingzi is fishing!”The Blazing Flame ancestor mumbled. His words made Wang Baole think for a long time. His consciousness lingered at the edge of the gray starry sky for a moment. He was about to withdraw.., however, he suddenly felt a call coming from the depths of the gray starry sky.
The moment he felt the call, Wang Baole’s eyes lit up. He didn’t withdraw his consciousness. Instead, he extended it further. The blazing flame ancestor sensed it and didn’t stop him.
Soon, Wang Baole’s consciousness extended beyond the edge of the gray starry sky. However, he didn’t have a physical body to support it, so it was difficult for it to extend further. It only extended to a few thousand feet, but it was enough.
The moment it reached a range of a few thousand feet, the summoning suddenly grew stronger. A familiar voice faintly reverberated in Wang Baole’s mind.
“Come... little junior brother, come to me.”
Wang Baole’s eyes lit up again, and he looked at the blazing flame ancestor.
“Since you want to go, then go.”The Blazing Flame ancestor was silent for a few breaths. He smiled, and encouragement appeared in his eyes.
“Don’t worry. If you feel that something is amiss, ignite the tree leaves that I gave you. With me here, I will definitely ensure your safety!”The blazing flame ancestor rubbed Wang Baole’s head.
“Thank you, Master!”Wang Baole was touched and warm. He cupped his fists and bowed to the blazing flame ancestor. Then, with a flash, he charged out into the gray starry sky. Xie Haiyang, who was on the divine bull behind him, hesitated for a moment and didn’t follow him, instead, he quickly sent a voice transmission.
“Uncle-master, don’t forget to put in a good word for my father.”
Wang baole laughed heartily and stepped into the gray starry sky. The moment he stepped into the gray starry sky, in the deepest part of the gray starry sky, there were nine gigantic ovens.
Eight of them surrounded the ovens, and one of them was in the center. At that moment, in the center of the ovens, there seemed to be a world. In that world, there was a young man dressed in white, with long hair, and a flask of wine in his hand, next to him was a young man with a green wooden sword. He lifted his head up and drank the alcohol in the flagon. Then, he looked off into the distance and laughed.
“Junior brother is coming.”
Almost at the same time that he spoke, a shrill cry could be heard coming from off in the distance. Black Mist could be seen spreading out from the source of the cry, enveloping an enormous figure from the never-ending clan, causing it to rot away, at this moment, only thirty percent of his flesh and blood remained.
“Chen Qing Zi, kill me! Kill me! ! !”
“There’s no rush.”Chen Qing Zi drank another mouthful of wine and smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1132
chapters.content:
Chapter 1132:, the place where senior brother created the serendipity!
Translator:
549690339
I’m in a hurry! Wang Baole’s emotions surged the moment he charged into the gray starry sky. He was in a hurry to reach his senior brother. He finally understood that his earlier judgment had been correct.
His senior brother, Chen Qingzi, had deliberately let the news of the moon splitter divine emperor’s imminent death spread. He had done so both to fish and to hint that he should hurry over.
Senior brother, senior brother, can you be a little more obvious when you hint at me next time? If it weren’t for my unparalleled intelligence, I wouldn’t have been able to react this time. Wang Baole was elated, he sped up after entering the gray space.
He felt that there was a unique opportunity waiting for him ahead, so he wished that he could speed up and rush to his senior brother’s side to receive the big gift bag.
The divine emperor... Wang Baole’s eyes lit up. He couldn’t help but lick his lips.
I forgot to ask Master. How many star domains, stars, and planets are there in the body of a divine emperor... There must be quite a number of them. They might even be comparable to a small universe. Wang Baole thought, he became even more excited. If it had been anyone else, they might have only been able to absorb the Dao rhythm and laws of the divine emperor after his death and gain insights into opportunities.
However, he was different. He was currently practicing the Star Point Technique. It was a forbidden cultivation technique that could turn any star point into his own star. Even though practicing this technique would bring him disaster, Wang Baole wasn’t afraid.
I’ll absorb, I’ll swallow, I’ll point! The more Wang Baole thought about it, the more excited he became. He felt that this time, he might be able to advance to the celestial domain realm in an instant.
It’s a little exaggerated... however, breaking through a few minor realms shouldn’t be a problem. Wang Baole’s eyes shone. As he sped forward, he gradually approached from the edge of the gray starry sky.
However, the gray starry sky was too big. Even with Wang Baole’s current speed and flying in a straight line, it would take him a long time to enter the true core region.
After flying for a while, Wang Baole calmed down. He knew that he couldn’t be too anxious about this matter. Otherwise, it would be easy for other changes to occur due to his own impatience.
I’ll take my time. Senior Brother is here, and master is here. I Won’t be able to escape fate, and I won’t die either. Wang Baole cleared his throat at the thought of this. He felt completely at ease, and he spread out his spiritual perception to observe his surroundings.
As he flew over, he saw some differences in this place.
......
First, there were people.
There were many cultivators in this place, and most of them looked mysterious. Wang Baole met quite a number of them along the way in the gray starry sky. They noticed each other from afar, and they quickly spread out, not wanting to come into contact with each other, it was as if they were all hurrying on their way and searching.
These people were all elites from various sects and clans, looking for opportunities and opportunities here.
There are so many of them. There must be tens or millions of them... Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He saw another seven or eight figures flash past in the distance. A few of them paused slightly after noticing him, as if they were weighing the pros and cons, then, they left quickly.
Following that was the feeling of rejection and suppression. As they ventured deeper into the gray starry sky, the feeling grew stronger. Wang Baole felt that if there was no other way to counteract the rejection and suppression.., he would stay here for at most five days. Then, he would have to go out and recuperate.
That was because there wasn’t only rejection and suppression here. There was also... a thick aura of death. As the rejection and suppression came together, the aura would forcefully fuse into the cultivator’s body, corroding his soul and body, once it was corroded for a long period of time, he would die without a doubt!
However... if it were anyone else, that aura of death would have been the case. Even if some of the mysterious clans and sects had methods of restraining it, which could last for a longer period of time, they would not be able to completely negate it.
Even if the Weiyang clan was powerful, it would still be difficult for them to act tyrannically in this place. It could be said that in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain, the only people... who could act like fish in water here... were the members of the dark sect!
The repulsion and suppression in this place came from the array formation. However, the thick aura of death contained within it came from... The Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao, which had been awakened by Chen Qingzi!
That was why when Wang Baole felt the aura of death permeating his entire body, he blinked, and his heart immediately became alive. The aura of death in this place didn’t harm him at all, on the contrary... There was a certain degree of enhancement!
After he secretly absorbed some of it, the cultivation in his body became active. The dark fire in his eyes also manifested on its own, as if it was cheering. It made Wang Baole feel extremely comfortable.
What a nice place! Wang Baole’s spirits were lifted. He was about to continue absorbing, but his expression changed quickly. He felt a strong sense of danger. He saw Wisps of green smoke in the gray starry sky, it seemed to be between illusion and reality. It had initially spread in all directions, as if it was fighting against the death qi and canceling each other out.
However, after Wang Baole absorbed the death Qi, three or four wisps of green smoke immediately shot toward him. They seemed to be splitting apart, and they seemed to threaten his soul. When Wang Baole sensed them.., he immediately retreated, his expression solemn.
These green wisps... they should be the green wisps of smoke that fell from the Weiyang clan warship. According to master, they are... a part of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao
Why are they only hostile towards me? The other elites who entered this place were also attacked by the death qi... as Wang Baole retreated and observed, he had an answer in his heart. The others were passively attacked, therefore, the never-ending Heavenly Dao did not pay attention to him. To a certain extent, it was thought that they were helping to share the burden.
However, it was different for him. He was not being attacked passively. Instead, he was absorbing the death qi. This might be the reason why the never-ending Heavenly Dao was hostile towards him.
There was another reason. Wang Baole felt that it had something to do with him cultivating the star art.
Wang Baole had a headache. After weighing the pros and cons, he felt that he could still withstand three or four strands of the death qi. If there were any more, he would be in danger.
“If you have the ability, give me thirty to fifty Wisps!”Wang Baole snorted. He chose to give up on absorbing the death qi. Only then did the three or four green threads that were chasing him dissipate. He watched helplessly as the thick death Qi filled the area, once he absorbed it, his cultivation would increase, and the dark fire would become stronger. However, he could only watch and could not absorb it with his heart. This feeling made him feel a little depressed.
I have to think of a way... As Wang Baole was deep in thought, he walked forward and saw that other than humans and the Heavenly Dao Aura, there were other oddities within the gray starry sky.
They were... vortexes of various sizes!
These vortexes caught Wang Baole’s attention. In most of them, there was basically one or more cultivators meditating. As for the others, there were cultivators of varying sizes competing with each other.
After examining them carefully, Wang Baole’s eyes flashed. He knew the origins of the vortexes. There was a thick aura of death within them, as well as the presence of the dao intent of broken rules of varying strength.
“The place where the powerful fall!”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and muttered. He didn’t know how many vortexes there were in the gray starry sky, but he could tell that they were all under the command of the Moon splitting divine emperor!
They had either been killed by his senior brother, or they had been attacked by the death Qi here.
A Legion under the command of a divine emperor... Wang Baole thought for a moment. Then, with a flash of his body, he flew toward a small vortex where seven to eight cultivators were fighting fiercely.
He was so fast that he got close in an instant. He raised his right hand and waved it. Immediately, a powerful force erupted and landed around the seven to eight cultivators like a storm. The seven to eight cultivators trembled violently and coughed up blood, they looked at Wang Baole in shock and retreated rapidly, not daring to stay any longer.
Wang Baole didn’t chase after them when he saw how relieved they were. Instead, he appeared in the small whirlpool in a flash. He sat down cross-legged and tried to comprehend it.
However, the moment he sat down, the intrinsic scabbard, which hadn’t moved for a long time, suddenly trembled. Instantly, the dao intent of the broken rules in the small whirlpool charged toward him, it instantly fused into his body and entered the scabbard!
The scabbard shone at that moment, as if it was eating the broken laws.
“Huh?”Wang Baole was stunned. He was about to check, but his expression changed abruptly in the next moment. After the remaining dao intent of the laws in the whirlpool was instantly absorbed, it was like a vacuum, attracting a large amount of death qi from the surroundings, it would have been fine if it was just death qi. There were even more green threads that followed.
There were quite a number of them. There were more than forty threads!

chapters.title: Chapter 1133
chapters.content:
Chapter 1133:, the Heavenly Dao was displeased!
Translator:
549690339
“What kind of mouth is this!”Wang Baole’s eyes widened. He let out a mournful howl and charged forward, intending to escape. He felt as if he had jinxed the situation. He had even shouted about thirty to fifty wisps of the Heavenly Dao, it hadn’t been long since then, but so many had actually come..
This gave him goosebumps. The three or four wisps of the Heavenly Dao from before had given him goosebumps. Even though they could be neutralized, he could still feel that they would pose a serious threat to him.
After all, this was the power of the Unending Heavenly Dao, just like the unending law. His star-tapping technique had been considered a crime by the Unending Heavenly Dao. Furthermore, he was a dark child. If the power of the Unending Heavenly Dao entered his body, he would probably notice it instantly, he would be classified as a remnant of the previous dynasty.
Remnant. This was what Wang Baole had come up with from the perspective of the unending clan.
Felonies and survivors of the previous dynasty... Sweat broke out on Wang Baole’s forehead as he thought of this. He fled even faster, and with a loud boom, he charged out of the vortex. He wasn’t slow, but due to the vacuum of the vortex.., the Weiyang Heavenly Dao black hair that had been attracted to him was even faster than Wang Baole. The moment he charged out of the vortex, it enveloped him, not giving him the slightest chance to react. It descended with a murderous and destructive intent.
Wang Baole’s pupils constricted. He was about to summon his senior brother and master to rescue him. However, at that moment... the intrinsic scabbard that had absorbed the broken rules in his body suddenly began to glow, a suction force was released in an instant, causing the black strands of the Unending Heavenly Dao that were closing in on Wang Baole to increase their speed once again. They didn’t wait for Wang Baole to ask for help. They followed every part of Wang Baole’s body and burrowed into his body.
F * ck, am I going to die just like that? Wang Baole’s mind jolted. He wanted to cry, but no tears came out as he instinctively let out a scream. However, the moment he let out that scream, Wang Baole’s eyes widened instantly, he revealed a look of shock and uncertainty as he looked inside himself.
He saw that the green strands of Weiyang Heavenly Dao that had burrowed into his body were tearing apart part of his flesh and blood. At the same time, they headed straight for his intrinsic scabbard. In that instant, they were sucked into the scabbard as if they were being swallowed.
More than forty strands of green strands disappeared from Wang Baole’s body in an instant. They were so fast that if it weren’t for the fact that the flesh and blood in the path of the green strands were being torn apart and emitting a piercing pain.., wang Baole would have thought that he was hallucinating.
It’s gone? Wang baole blinked and immediately looked at his intrinsic scabbard. The instant his divine sense swept across it, a powerful force was suddenly released from the intrinsic scabbard.
The release of this force contained the power of the scabbard itself, as well as the charm of breaking the laws. It also contained the power of the Unending Heavenly Dao. The three of them were strangely fused together, and as they erupted.., with the intrinsic scabbard as the center, they spread throughout the entire area of Wang Baole’s physical body.
As they spread, the areas where he had been injured healed instantly. At the same time, his physical body seemed like a dried-up land that had suddenly received a drop of dew. It immediately absorbed it.
Wang Baole was immediately shaken by this scene. He didn’t act rashly. Instead, he observed carefully, and eventually, a look of shock appeared in his eyes.
......
My intrinsic scabbard is evolving... the broken rules here and the power of the Unending Heavenly Dao can trigger the evolution of my intrinsic scabbard
Besides the evolution, the aura that emanates from this intrinsic scabbard is also very helpful to my physical body. It can make my physical body stronger
This place... To me, this place is a treasure trove
I understand now. Senior brother called me here not only to give me the opportunity to absorb the divine emperor’s power, but also to give me the dark qi here. At the same time... senior brother predicted that the Weiyang clan would descend with the power of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao, so... senior brother lured these Weiyang Heavenly Dao here for the sake of fishing! Wang baole immediately understood, he was extremely excited.
That must be the case. Haha, I’m Too Smart. Thank you, senior brother! Wang Baole laughed heartily. He was both touched and proud. He decided not to look for the vortex. Instead, he stood where he was and instantly activated the dark fire, he absorbed the surrounding Death Qi.
In that instant, the surrounding death Qi surged and surged into Wang Baole’s seven orifices. It made his dark fire even more vigorous and his cultivation even more refined. Although he was still at the early-stage star realm, Wang Baole could sense that his combat strength was slightly stronger than before, it seemed to be slightly stronger than before!
At the same time, in the depths of the gray starry sky, Chen Qingzi, who was drinking in the central oven surrounded by the eight stoves, had a change in expression. He sensed the death qi around him and muttered to himself.
“Someone is absorbing... the only person who can absorb the dark sect’s power of the Heavenly Dao other than me is little junior brother.”
As he spoke, the void next to Chen Qingzi suddenly churned. A black fish that seemed to be the size of a palm but seemed to have another universe materialized there and roared at Chen Qingzi.
“I know, I know. It’s just some aura that has been absorbed. Little Junior Brother is not an outsider. Moreover, how much can he absorb? Don’t worry,”Chen Qingzi comforted him.
The black fish seemed displeased and roared again.
“He even ate some of your food?”? “It’s fine, it’s fine. Don’t be so stingy. Just because you like to eat the power of the Unending Heavenly Dao doesn’t mean that little junior brother likes it as well. He might be curious. Besides, he can’t eat too much of that thing.”
Under Chen Qingzi’s comforting words, the black fish suppressed the displeasure in its heart and slowly dispersed. At the same time, outside the oven, in the gray starry sky, Wang Baole was absorbing the aura of death, gradually, dozens of green threads appeared rapidly around him. As soon as they appeared, they locked onto their target and charged at Wang Baole with killing intent.
“Good timing! Suck it!”Wang Baole’s expression was arrogant. He didn’t Dodge and allowed the dozens of green threads to approach him. In the blink of an eye, the three threads that were closest to him entered his body first and exploded in his body!
Wang Baole’s body shook, and he spat out a mouthful of blood. His eyes were glazed over.
“Why aren’t you sucking!”The intrinsic scabbard in his body seemed to have its own temper. It had tried to absorb the black hair earlier, but now, it was motionless. It didn’t even look at the black hair that had entered Wang Baole’s body.
This made Wang Baole’s scalp tingle. Seeing the remaining unending heavenly dao black hair coming at him, he let out a blood-curdling scream and retreated quickly. He didn’t dare absorb the aura of death anymore. After exhausting all his strength and pulling a large area.., only then did the wisps of green hair from the unending heavenly dao slowly dissipate.
What’s going on! Wang Baole wanted to cry but had no tears. He looked at the wisps of green hair from the Unending Heavenly Dao, which were gradually dissipating. He sensed the death qi in the area and observed his physical body.
After absorbing more than forty wisps of green hair, the aura released by the intrinsic scabbard to strengthen his physical body hadn’t increased his cultivation, but it had made his physical body more refined. It seemed like he was on the verge of a breakthrough.
Death Qi can increase my refined cultivation. Black hair can strengthen my physical body... Wang Baole’s eyes slowly turned red. He saw that he was surrounded by treasures. He recalled the scene of him absorbing the black hair and shook, he searched the area rapidly for the vortex.
Soon, Wang Baole found another vortex. This vortex was slightly larger than the previous one, and there was someone meditating in it. However, Wang Baole’s eyes were red. It didn’t matter who was in the vortex. He was extremely fast, he approached in an instant. The person meditating in the whirlpool was a middle-aged cultivator with a cultivation of the late-stage star realm. He immediately sensed it and opened his eyes. He was about to shout angrily.
However, in the next instant, Wang Baole’s cultivation exploded. The Nightmare Eye Art descended, and the law threads gathered. The Divine Bull’s shadow charged forward!
Amidst the explosion, the middle-aged cultivator’s expression changed drastically. Blood trickled out of the corner of his mouth, and his eyes were filled with shock. His body tumbled backward. He hesitated, but didn’t continue pestering Wang Baole. Instead, he left quickly, feeling aggrieved.
“Who is this guy?”He did not know Wang Baole, but he could feel the sharpness of his attacks. He was afraid. Furthermore, this place was a fortuitous encounter. He did not want to waste any more time. Therefore, after giving Wang Baole a deep look, he turned around and sped up, he disappeared in an instant.
After chasing the person away, Wang Baole was not in the mood to pursue him. Instead, he sat down cross-legged. With anticipation and trepidation, he immediately absorbed the damaged rules in the area. In an instant, the intrinsic scabbard in his body erupted once again, after swallowing all the broken rules in the surroundings, more than seventy strands of black hair appeared in all directions and charged toward Wang Baole.
Looking at the many strands of black hair, Wang Baole felt his scalp go numb. He resisted the urge to dodge. He wanted to try and see if this was the only way to absorb the strands of black hair.
Although it was dangerous, Wang Baole was unwilling to give up without trying. Therefore, under the relentless attack, seven to eight strands of black hair instantly entered Wang Baole’s body. In the next instant... Wang Baole’s eyes lit up.
As expected
His intrinsic sword sheath was rapidly devouring the black hair that had entered his body. Wang Baole, who was in the midst of his excitement, didn’t notice that a black fish had materialized in the void beside him, looking aggrieved, it was as if its food had been snatched away, and it was glaring at him angrily.

chapters.title: Chapter 1134
chapters.content:
Chapter 1134:, Mine!
Translator:
549690339
The black fish didn’t notice that in the storage bag on Wang Baole’s body was a donkey that had been asleep for an unknown period of time. It hadn’t woken up yet, but its nose twitched instinctively, it seemed to have smelled something delicious..
Wang Baole wasn’t too sure about all this. He was currently immersed in the joy of devouring the green strands of the unending heavenly dao in his intrinsic scabbard.
He looked at his intrinsic scabbard and rapidly absorbed all the green strands of the Unending Heavenly Dao that had fused into his body. Not long after, the intrinsic scabbard exploded, as if it was giving something back, he released the aura that could increase the strength of his physical body once again and fused it into his entire body.
That comfortable feeling made Wang baole even more excited, especially when he realized that his physical body had become stronger. The Glow in his eyes grew brighter.
I understand now. My natal scabbard needs to absorb the shattering rules first before it can absorb the Weiyang Heavenly Dao’s black hair. There might be some proportion to it... the more shattering rules I absorb, the more black hair I can absorb. I guess that means the more black hair I can absorb
This is perfect. The only regret is the death qi here... Wang baole blinked and looked around. Then, he suddenly dispersed the dark fire and inhaled with all his might.
Immediately, the death Qi in the surroundings began to churn violently. It was as if Wang Baole had turned into a small black hole, instantly swallowing the large amount of death Qi in the surroundings into his body. Then, he ignored the fact that he had swallowed too much, the two hundred strands of black hair that had been attracted to him instantly sped up and fled. He also stopped absorbing and restrained the dark fire.
With this method, even though the two hundred strands of black hair chased him for a while, Wang Baole managed to shake them off quickly. When he was completely safe, Wang Baole, who had reappeared in the gray starry sky, could not hide his pride.
“I’m still the smartest. I’ll eat it and run. What can you do to me?”Wang Baole laughed loudly. His eyes shone brightly as he began to search for the next whirlpool. However, behind him, the black fish that had appeared out of thin air.., the grievance in his eyes grew stronger. He glared at Wang Baole, as if he was gritting his teeth. If he could read his lips, he would definitely be speaking like a thief, a shameless thief, or a bandit.
At the same time... In Wang Baole’s storage bag, the donkey, who had been sleeping passively with its eyes closed, twitched its nose even more frequently..
Just like that, Wang Baole’s journey of Destiny began.
He moved extremely quickly, heading to one whirlpool after another. Basically, when he arrived, regardless of the size of the whirlpool, he charged straight into it. First, he used the nightmare eye incantation to suppress it. Then, with a wave of his hand, he blasted out the shadow of the Divine Ox. He killed as many as he could.., those who couldn’t be killed were all chased away. They were so frightened that they didn’t dare to move forward.
That wasn’t enough. Wang Baole saw that some of the people he had chased away were lingering around. He decided to kill his way out. Amidst the rumbling sounds, no one dared to approach any of the whirlpools that he had entered.
......
This allowed him to absorb the broken rules, the Heavenly Dao black hair, and strengthen his physical body. At the same time, Wang Baole would also inhale a breath of death from time to time.
Therefore, very quickly, Wang Baole was like a catfish in the gray starry sky. He was constantly moving, absorbing, and stirring. The area of impact grew larger and larger.
However, there were still some arrogant and unruly prodigies. Even though they were chased away, they joined forces to return. Even though they didn’t approach, it was clear that they wanted to see how Wang Baole was going to absorb them. After all, all the vortexes that he had occupied.., they disappeared after he left.
Wang Baole wasn’t in the mood to care too much about these people. He simply unleashed the power of the Dao Star and immediately sealed the vortexes after he occupied them, covering up everything.
Even though he wanted to cover it up, it could also block the view. At most, it would cause a lot of speculation. Wang Baole didn’t care about that anymore.
There’s my master outside who has been holding back the curse for ten thousand years, and there’s my senior brother who can kill the divine emperor inside. Who Am I afraid of
This is the land of opportunity that my senior brother has specially prepared for me. Everyone else who comes here can be considered to be snatching me away! Wang Baole was arrogant, but at the same time, he was confident. Such an imposing manner made him even more domineering.
As for the elites from the various sects and clans, even though they were angry and suspicious, there was nothing they could do. They were all suppressed by the death Qi here, and they were getting weaker and weaker. Wang Baole was originally strong, and he seemed to be suppressed as well, however, he was much better than them.
With the pros and Cons, he was no match for Wang Baole. Therefore, Wang Baole became even more arrogant in the gray space. At the same time, his physical strength became stronger after absorbing the feedback from the Weiyang Heavenly Dao’s black hair in his intrinsic scabbard, he had faintly surpassed his cultivation and appeared to have reached the mid-stage of the star realm.
The absorption of the death Qi had brought Wang Baole great benefits. Although his cultivation remained the same, his soul grew stronger and stronger, far surpassing those at the same cultivation realm.
Such an opportunity and such good fortune made Wang Baole’s eyes turn even redder. Soon, he no longer cared about the small whirlpools and began to search for the large ones.
The vortexes in the gray space were formed by the dead under the command of the Moon splitting divine emperor. The strongest under his command was the Divine King!
I have to absorb the larger ones. The larger ones will taste even more delicious
Wang Baole charged into the depths of the gray space in excitement. He wasn’t interested in the smaller ones along the way. He scanned the medium-sized vortexes a few times. As he absorbed them, he continued to search for the larger vortexes.
As for behind him... The black fish was still following him in secret. It was like a little wife who had encountered a thief. She felt wronged but didn’t dare attack him. She didn’t want to leave, so she could only follow him and grit her teeth, she gritted her teeth continuously.
The donkey’s nose moved even faster. Even its closed eyes were trembling, as if it was trying its best to wake up..
Time passed. The entire gray starry sky became more and more chaotic with Wang Baole’s appearance. A large amount of death qi was lost, and the green hair of the Wei Yang Heavenly Dao was lost at an even faster rate.
This caused the Wei Yang clan in the outside world to notice it. However, compared to the total amount, the loss was insignificant, so they didn’t pay too much attention to it.
That was until... a few hours later, Wang Baole, who had ventured deep into the gray galaxy and was approaching the inner region, saw... a vortex that made his body tremble violently, and an intense glow appeared in his eyes!
The size of the vortex was several times larger than what Wang Baole had absorbed previously. He couldn’t even see the boundary of the vortex with his naked eye. With just a glance, he saw that there were at least thirty cultivators in the vortex, they were absorbing and comprehending at different locations.
The Vortex, despite supporting so many people in comprehending, was still powerful. It was evident that the people who had fallen here had extraordinary statuses and cultivation levels!
They must be the godly monarchs under the command of Moon Splitter, and they must be extraordinary godly monarchs! Wang Baole grew excited. The scabbard in his body trembled violently, as if it was filled with desire.
After absorbing so many broken rules and Heavenly Dao black hair, the scabbard was now covered in streaks of blood. At first glance, it looked as if most of it had turned red, and its aura was different as well. Once the intent to kill was unleashed.., it would definitely be earth-shattering.
Mine, these are all mine! After feeling the desire in his intrinsic scabbard, Wang Baole was filled with desire as well. He felt that the people in the vortex were all bandits!
Shameless, bandits, little thief, these are all left to me by my senior brother! Wang Baole roared in his heart and charged forward. Behind him, the black fish, who had been following him in secret, was also visibly trembling. It seemed to be shouting ‘Shameless, bandits...’ The little thief was very anxious at the same time. In a flash, he disappeared. When he reappeared... he was standing beside Chen Qingzi in the furnace in the center of the Gray Starry Sky.
The moment he reappeared, the black fish let out an aggrieved howl. It seemed to be complaining, and its body kept growing bigger and smaller. It seemed to be complaining as it described the size of the vortexes that Wang Baole had absorbed..
Chen Qingzi was about to get up and walk towards the moon splitting divine emperor, who was shrouded in black fog. The appearance of the black fish surprised him. After listening for a while, he smiled disapprovingly.
“I still understand that junior brother of mine. Don’t worry. It’s just a small matter. His absorption is limited.”
The black fish continued to roar. It became even more miserable, and at the same time, it grew larger rapidly. This time, it seemed like it wanted to describe the super-large whirlpool that Wang Baole was currently in..
Chen Qingzi sighed. He thought to himself that the dark sect’s Little Heavenly Dao was too stingy. He had merely swallowed a bit of his breath. It wasn’t a big deal. Therefore, he didn’t wait for the other party to finish transforming. He circled around and headed straight for the seal, he spoke at the same time.
“Alright, Alright. I’m going to add a seal to the moon-splitting beast first. I’ll help you stop it when it comes out, alright?”
The Black Fish’s body, which was growing larger and larger, paused. It looked aggrievedly at the area of the Mist where the moon-splitting beast was. Then, it looked angrily in Wang Baole’s direction. It let out a roar, as if it was cursing someone..

chapters.title: Chapter 1135
chapters.content:
Chapter 1135:, self-absorption!
Translator:
549690339
Just as the black fish was cursing, Wang Baole was in a state of excitement. His eyes were filled with excitement as he transformed into a flaming rainbow, his speed reaching its peak, he charged straight towards the giant whirlpool.
However, things weren’t going as smoothly as before. There were very few giant whirlpools like the one Wang Baole was looking at. After all, this was the manifestation of the fallen deity king of the Weiyang clan, there were only seventeen divine kings under the command of the Moon splitting divine emperor who had participated in the killing of Chen Qingzi!
In other words, in the gray space, there were at most... seventeen vortexes of such size. At the same time, it was because of their rarity that the prodigies who were able to occupy this place and gain enlightenment here.., they were all elites from the various sects and clans.
Even if the batch of elites from the first tier didn’t come, these people were all in the second tier and were infinitely close to the first tier.
That was why the moment Wang Baole rushed over from afar, the eight people in the giant vortex, who were each isolated and not disturbing each other, instantly opened their eyes.
Among the eight people, two were from the Weiyang clan. One was a man, and the other was a woman. They were both young, and there was a flame mark between their brows. When they opened their eyes, a divine might appeared.
Other than them, there was also an enormous turtle. The turtle did not take human form. Instead, it lay in the center of the Vortex, breathing in and out. When it opened its eyes, they revealed vertical pupils that looked like the eyes of a snake, and they were cold and merciless.
As for the other five, there were three men and two women. Two of them were men and one woman. They were dressed in gorgeous robes, and although they looked human, they had wings on their backs. One of them had feathered wings, one had black mist wings, and the other was like a bat. Although they were all different.., however, all of them had shocking auras!
The last man and woman were even more extraordinary. The woman had a small white horn on her head. She was extremely beautiful and had a graceful figure. However, there was a golden scale between her eyebrows.
As for the man, his upper body was in the shape of a human. He was extremely handsome and looked like a god. However, his lower body was covered in sticky liquid and was covered with many lumpy tentacles. He was extremely ugly and disgusting, this perfect fusion of beauty and ugliness made his body filled with a terrifying feeling!
The eight of them looked at Wang Baole. The youth with the feathered wings, who was the closest to where Wang Baole was in the vortex, said calmly, a cold glint flashing in his eyes.
“Scram!”
“Scram your sister!”The moment the feathered youth said those words, Wang Baole’s growl was like a bolt of lightning that struck the sky. It exploded with a loud bang, causing the surrounding space to ripple and distort, the youth with the feathered wings’s expression changed. He was about to get up..
......
However, it was too late. Wang Baole’s figure flew over, and the sound of the void exploding rang out. In the next instant, he disappeared. When he reappeared, he was right in front of the youth with the feathered wings. He threw a punch!
The youth with the feathered wings raised both his hands to block with all his might. His cultivation at the late-stage star realm erupted instantly. The wings on his back extended at that moment, enveloping his body, he used both of his hands to block Wang Baole’s shocking punch.
A loud boom reverberated. The youth with feathered wings was extremely talented and powerful. He wasn’t blown up by Wang Baole’s punch. Instead, his entire body shook, and he seemed to show signs of counteracting Wang Baole’s violent strength.
However, in the next moment... Wang Baole lifted his right leg and kicked at the youth’s crotch with even greater speed and strength. It was as if he could shatter the void!
The sudden kick was unpredictable, and it was as smooth as flowing water. It was as if it was instinctive. As it landed, the feathered youth’s expression changed. His body trembled with a loud bang, and blood spurted out, he retreated in horror.
“I am Yu Zi from the Green Feather Dao sect. Who Are you to dare hurt me?”
Seeing that the feathered youth had been pushed back, the other seven people’s expressions changed, and they turned solemn instantly. Four or five of them stood up, their cultivation fluctuating.
“Huh?”Wang Baole was surprised. He hadn’t used this move for a long time, but he had kicked countless crotches back then, so he had some experience with the sensation. The kick just now had severely injured the youth.., however, he felt that something wasn’t right.
“The structure is different!”Wang Baole didn’t think too much about it. He rushed out once again with a flash of his body. He rolled his eyes and roared loudly.
“Shang Yuzi, you took the opportunity to snatch my supreme treasure previously. How did you know that I wouldn’t die after such a disaster? Instead, you have more luck. Now that we meet here, I will snatch your luck too. I will beat you up!”After Wang Baole’s roar was heard, in the whirlpool.., those who had already stood up and dispersed their cultivation froze. They looked at Wang Baole and then at Yu Zi. Although they didn’t sit down again, they didn’t immediately choose to attack.
“I stole your precious treasure?”Yu Zi was stunned as well. He had done this many times. Even though he was unfamiliar with Wang Baole, he couldn’t help but recall.
Just as he recalled and retreated, Wang Baole’s figure charged forward once again. He closed in and punched again. With a loud boom, the two of them struck from one end of the vortex to the other end. The sounds continued, shangyu Zi was beaten until he spat out blood continuously. He felt even more aggrieved. He roared and wanted to retaliate, but it was useless. He was suppressed by Wang Baole all the way.
When they reached the Vortex, where the two male and female cultivators from the Weiyang tribe were, Shangyu Zi spoke quickly.
“I am willing to give you ten drops of the Immortal Ascension Ascension Liquid. Fellow Daoists, help me suppress him. There is something wrong with this lunatic’s Head!”
Everyone’s expressions changed when they heard Shangyu Zi’s words. However, the one who reacted the fastest was the youth from the Wei Yang tribe. A glint flashed in his eyes as he shouted in a low voice.
“The one who comes after you, leave immediately. Otherwise, I will suppress you!”
“Suppress your sister!”Wang Baole glared at Shangyu Zi. He blasted Shangyu zi away with a punch. With a wave of his hand, he conjured a divine bull and hurled it at the Wei Yang tribe who had spoken!
He had only intended to target one person and seize a spot, but now that someone had interfered, he had no choice but to chase them away.
Amidst the rumbling, the youth from the Weiyang clan formed an incantation gesture and waved his hand, intending to resist. However, in the next instant, his expression changed drastically. He retreated abruptly, revealing his true form. However, he instantly lost one head and three arms, in his pathetic state, shock appeared in his eyes.
The female cultivator from the never-ending clan beside him also had a glint in her eyes. She moved to support Wang Baole and immediately attacked him without hesitation. In the blink of an eye, she joined forces with Shangyu Zi and the three of them fought against Wang Baole together.
As for the others, their expressions changed slightly. Three of them frowned and retreated rapidly after a moment of silence. They did not participate in the fight. At the same time, their attacks had messed up their auras, making it difficult for them to continue comprehending. Therefore, as they retreated.., they left.
The three of them were smart and didn’t want to waste their cultivation here. However, there were two others whose expressions had changed as well. After looking at them, they ignored them and continued to sit cross-legged and continue comprehending, as if they weren’t going to disturb them, i couldn’t be bothered to participate either.
One of them was the giant turtle, while the other was a handsome being with an ugly lower body.
Just like that, the area continued to rumble. However, the entire process did not last long. In the span of thirty breaths, the upper plume let out a blood-curdling scream. The two wings on his back were torn off by Wang Baole, and he fled at high speed, the two Weiyang clansmen, on the other hand, spat out blood and fled at high speed.
“How dare they come to snatch my fortune!”After defeating the three, Wang Baole did not chase after them. Instead, he snorted coldly and found a spot in the vortex to sit cross-legged. As for the two who remained, since they did not participate.., wang Baole did not chase them away.
“They will have to leave soon anyway,”Wang Baole muttered. With a wave of his hand, his surroundings blurred, concealing his figure. As he did not reveal his secret, he activated his cultivation and sucked hard!
Immediately, the intrinsic scabbard in his body trembled violently. The suction force was instantly enhanced. With Wang Baole as the center, it covered the entire vortex with a loud bang. In that instant, the vortex trembled, and all the damaged rules within it.., it was immediately pulled toward Wang Baole and gathered with a loud bang.
This scene immediately caused the person who was the combination of the giant turtle and the beautiful and ugly person to open his closed eyes once again, revealing shock.
“What’s Going On!”
“Your strength is alright, but there’s no need for you to be so bold. Fellow Daoist xuantian, why don’t we join forces and chase him away?”The person who was the beautiful and ugly person said calmly.
“Fine!”said the turtle, his eyes shining with a cold light. However, in the instant that he responded... a drastic change occurred outside of the Vortex!
Numerous strands of black hair appeared. There were hundreds of them!

chapters.title: Chapter 1136
chapters.content:
Chapter 1136: Calm Xuan Hua!
Translator:
549690339
“But... Wait a moment!”Big Turtle took a deep breath and looked around at the green light around him with a serious expression.
“What’s going on! ?”The beautiful and ugly people who were in the same body trembled violently as well. They suddenly looked into the void outside the vortex and saw the green threads.
“Threads of Weiyang’s Heavenly Dao! !”In that instant, they recognized the item, and their hearts began to palpitate. They knew that some of the arrangements made by the Weiyang clan in the gray starry sky could also sense the existence of the green threads under special circumstances, they had also come into contact with the threads over the past few days.
Therefore, they knew very well that the green threads were very powerful. Any one of them contained enough power to injure them severely. If there were too many of them, they would definitely die.
Thankfully, as long as they didn’t actively provoke the green threads, they wouldn’t be a threat to them. As a result, the chosen gradually got used to the existence of the green threads.
However, it was the first time the two of them had seen hundreds of black strands appear at the same time. In the past, they had only seen one or two strands at most. Therefore, their hearts were trembling, and they stood up instantly.
As they were in shock, the whirlpool was absorbed by Wang Baole. As a large number of damaged rules surged into the intrinsic scabbard in Wang Baole’s body, the intrinsic sword Qi also turned crimson, a buzzing sound that only Wang Baole could hear was heard.
A large amount of aura was sent back, causing his physical body to continuously explode and rise. In the process, the number of strands of black hair that gathered around him increased from the hundreds before to more than a thousand!
This scene immediately caused the giant turtle and the ugly person to feel a wave of shock in their hearts. Not only did their hearts palpitate, their eyes were filled with fear.
“What the hell is going on!”
“More than a thousand...”the two felt their scalps go numb. They wanted to leave, but they were surrounded by dense strands of black hair. They didn’t dare move, but they soon regretted it..
That was because the number of strands of black hair around them increased from more than a thousand to a few thousand in a short period of time. It was still continuing. This caused their souls to tremble as they looked at Wang Baole, it was obvious that they had already realized that this person... was the source.
“What has this fellow done!”
......
“He’s crazy. Isn’t he afraid of Death!”The big turtle’s body trembled. He swayed, and his entire body shrank continuously. Finally, he turned into a ray of light and charged towards the outside world. He had thought it through and decided not to participate. If he still didn’t leave.., there would probably be even more black hair here. He could sense that the Weiyang Heavenly Dao black hair seemed to be extremely irritable.
It was as if... They were about to pounce on him at the same time. He was afraid..
The person who was both beautiful and ugly was also afraid. He spat out a mouthful of blood and turned into a cloud of blood mist. He continued to shrink as he sped towards the outside world.
Just like that, the person who was both beautiful and ugly used different methods to carefully shuttle through the strands of black hair. Fortunately, the target of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao black hair was Wang Baole, which made the two of them nervous, they managed to escape successfully. In the process of their escape, the number of strands of hair had already reached more than five thousand.
After escaping, the two of them didn’t leave immediately. Instead, they looked at the distance with fear in their hearts. They wanted to see what the maniac was up to and whether or not he would be destroyed immediately.
However, the moment they looked over, the whirlpool where Wang Baole was was filled with loud booms. The huge whirlpool had been continuously absorbed by Wang Baole for a long time before it was finally sucked dry. All the broken rules within it.., they were all integrated into the intrinsic scabbard within Wang Baole’s body!
The scabbard seemed to be continuously being absorbed. It was like dry and cracked soil, and it needed to be neutralized in order to absorb it better. Therefore, in the next instant, as the whirlpool turned into a black hole with loud booms, the thousands of unending heavenly dao green hair around it.., it became violent in an instant. Amidst the loud booms, it charged straight towards the whirlpool, whistling through the air!
From Afar, the scene was shocking and earth-shattering. The Black Hole in the vortex was so large that the green strands of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao were attracted by it and were charging toward it rapidly. This made the giant turtle and the beautiful and ugly people who shared the same body.., their hearts trembled even more.
However, in the next instant... an even more shocking scene appeared!
The thousands of green strands of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao tunneled into Wang Baole’s body amidst the loud boom. However, not only did Wang Baole not die as the two of them had thought, but he also didn’t die, instead... as the green strands of the Unending Heavenly Dao fused into his body, his body trembled, and waves of powerful aura erupted!
It was the power of his physical body!
The intrinsic scabbard in Wang Baole’s body absorbed the green threads, and the sensation of dryness and cracking dissipated. As it nourished his body, it also released a large amount of aura, causing Wang Baole’s physical body to rumble, he immediately broke through the cultivation level and reached the mid-stage of the star realm.
It wasn’t over yet. It was still rising. The green threads around him were still fusing rapidly. In an instant, five thousand green threads were absorbed by Wang Baole, and even more green threads came whistling in from all directions. There were more than ten thousand of them.
The large turtle and the beautiful and ugly cultivators were all dumbfounded. Confusion appeared in their eyes. They looked at each other in a daze, as if they couldn’t believe what they were seeing.
I must be hallucinating. This fellow... is absorbing the power of the Heavenly Dao
It must be an illusion. I’ve never heard of anyone being able to absorb the power of the Heavenly Dao. Only those who have reached the level of the divine emperor can attempt to absorb it to aid their cultivation. This is common sense... this... could he be an incarnation of the divine emperor
The two men trembled even more. They looked at Wang Baole. They were no longer in a daze, but they looked as if they had seen a ghost. They noticed that the suction force of the vortex had decreased, and the green threads of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao were no longer being pulled, the big turtle trembled and fled.
He was completely afraid. Regardless of whether the other party had used a special method to absorb it or was really an incarnation of the divine emperor, it was not something he could afford to provoke. If he continued to stay and observe, it would be very easy for him to silence the other party.
The person with the same beauty and ugliness did the same. He fled instantly without looking back.
As the two of them fled at high speed... the black fish materialized next to the area where they had been previously. Its body was clearly swollen, and there was anxiety in its eyes. It let out a wheezing sound, it was like... a puppy that was extremely anxious when it saw its food being snatched away.
In the end, it seemed to be unable to hold it in any longer. In a flash, it charged out of the vortex and bit at the black strands of hair. One by one, it ate crazily, as if it was competing with Wang Baole.
As it ate, the black fish suddenly blinked. As it ate the black strands of hair, it turned its head to look into the vortex. At that moment, Wang Baole, who was sitting cross-legged with the black strands of hair continuously drilling into his body, vaguely felt that this seemed to be a good thing.
Previously, the black hair had been like bugs. It was very agile. As soon as it sensed that it was gathering a large amount of it, it seemed like it was about to bite back. It was also afraid, so it could only stealthily devour a small amount of it. It also had to curry favor with the shameless Chen Qingzi, that was because Chen Qingzi could catch the black hair for it.
But now... The black hair was ignoring it. In a short period of time, it had eaten more than a hundred strands.
“It seems... this little thief is better than Chen Qingzi?”The black fish thought, and immediately became happy. He ate even faster.
As the two continued to devour the strands of black hair, the hundreds of thousands of unending clan’s beetle battleships that floated in the sky above the gray starry sky, which the Wan Zong clan could not see, trembled, the green smoke they released also became thinner.
This scene once again caught the attention of Divine Emperor Xuan Hua. He sat cross-legged in the void and opened his eyes to look at the gray starry sky. However, the Heavenly Dao there was chaotic, so he could not see it clearly. He could only feel that there seemed to be a vortex inside, it was continuously devouring the Endless Heavenly Dao.
“The dark sect’s heavenly dao... dares to devour it so brazenly... well, if I can flatten it, the array formation here will be broken instantly.”
“Interesting. I want to see how much you can absorb from a weak Heavenly Dao!”
“Generals, listen up. Increase the flow of the Heavenly Dao Aura and flatten the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao!”Xuan Hua said calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1137
chapters.content:
Chapter 1137:!
Translator:
549690339
As mystic flower divine emperor spoke calmly, hundreds of thousands of unending race warships below increased their strength. They used strange methods to extract the aura power from the Unending Heavenly Dao, turning it into an even more majestic green smoke, large balls of smoke fell into the gray starry sky below.
After merging, the green smoke balls formed by the aura of the Unending Heavenly Dao spread out soundlessly, turning into countless green threads that filled the surroundings.
As they merged with it, the color of the originally gray starry sky gradually changed. It was as if Green had been added to the gray fuel, gradually neutralizing it.., there were signs that it was about to be completely transformed into green.
When outsiders saw this scene, they were all shocked. However, they could only see the color change of the gray starry sky. They could not see the Weiyang Heavenly Dao Green fog released by the Weiyang warship, otherwise, they would have been even more shocked. This was because each of these green clouds contained the power of the laws of the entire Weiyang Dao Domain.
Although only divine emperors could use the aura of the Heavenly Dao to cultivate, and the rest could not touch it, or else they would definitely suffer a backlash. However, one could still see how precious it was.
“This is not good...”outside the gray space, patriarch raging flame frowned slightly. He looked at the gray space that was beginning to change color, then looked up at the place where the Weiyang race was hiding. A dark look appeared in his eyes.
He didn’t know what was happening inside the gray starry sky, but from the outside world’s perspective, once the Gray Starry Sky was truly transformed into green, then the formation would be broken.
The result of breaking the formation was that the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao would be changed, and the Moon splitting divine emperor, who was fighting Chen Qingzi, would receive a huge boost. There was even a possibility that the outcome of the battle would be reversed.
“What is Chen Qingzi thinking... ?”Patriarch raging flame murmured to himself. In truth, he wasn’t the only one who had made such a judgment. Outside the Gray Starry Sky, the dao protectors of the myriad sects clan had also made some inferences, they were all making guesses.
As the almighty experts made their guesses, in the depths of the gradually fading gray starry sky, in the core furnace, which was shrouded in the mist of the Moon splitting divine emperor, the moon splitting divine emperor screamed even more shrilly.
“Chen Qingzi, you didn’t kill me, but you tortured me and reversed the array formation, turning the nine dao furnaces into nine underworld furnaces. Wasn’t all of this to melt me down and transform me into the Dark Clan? That’s impossible!”
“Moon-splitting, you’re thinking too much.”Chen Qingzi smiled as he sat cross-legged in the Black Mist. His right hand formed hand seals as he continuously waved his finger at the moon-splitting divine emperor, causing a series of explosions to ring out from his body.
Every time a loud boom rang out, the moon splitter divine emperor’s body would obviously burrow into a large amount of black fog. It looked as if... he was really forcefully transforming it.
......
The fish I want to fish isn’t that simple. Chen Qingzi narrowed his eyes. A dark glint flashed in the depths of his eyes, but he returned to normal in the next instant. He smiled as usual and continued to point his finger downwards.
The screams continued!
At the same time, outside the core oven and within the gray starry sky, the giant whirlpool where Wang Baole was was beginning to dissipate. The large amount of black hair around him was also rapidly fusing into Wang Baole’s body, it caused his physical body to rise continuously.
After a long while, Wang Baole opened his eyes. A bright glow erupted in his eyes. As he felt the strength of his physical body, he also felt the intrinsic scabbard in his body emitting an aura that shocked even him.
It really is a land of fortune! Wang Baole licked his lips excitedly. He looked around and suddenly opened his mouth. The dark fire in his body rose instantly and inhaled sharply.
It was as if there was a muffled explosion of thunder. A loud boom spread out in all directions. A large amount of death qi in the gray starry sky surged towards him instantly and was directly absorbed into his body, his soul was trembling, and it was rising rapidly. The black fish, which he couldn’t see, was also trembling, and it let out a roar that Wang Baole couldn’t hear.
