The black fish had thought that Wang Baole was doing well, but the anxiety it was feeling now was a stark contrast from before. It was clear that Wang Baole’s absorption of the death Qi was akin to eating its own body..
This made it extremely anxious. It disappeared in a flash and reappeared outside Chen Qingzi’s black fog. It howled continuously, but Chen Qingzi, who was inside, was completely immersed in refining the split moon and did not pay any attention to it.
This made the black fish feel even more wronged.
Thankfully, Wang Baole did not dare to absorb too much. After absorbing all of it in one go, the green colors around him were attracted over. There were tens of thousands of them.
Wang Baole’s eyes shone with desire as he looked at the many strands of black hair. He dashed into the distance, and the strands of black hair chased after him. However, after Wang Baole withdrew the dark fire, the strands of black hair gradually lost their target, they dissipated.
Wang Baole was already familiar with the way. He was now excitedly searching for the next giant whirlpool in the gray starry sky. After about an hour, Wang Baole’s rapid search and his neglect of the countless small and medium sized whirlpools.., he finally found the second whirlpool where the god King had fallen.
The whirlpool, which was about the same size as the previous one, soon appeared before Wang Baole’s eyes. He also saw more than ten cultivators from the ten thousand sect clans sitting cross-legged in the whirlpool.
How dare you steal my good fortune! Wang Baole didn’t pause for even a moment as he charged forward. The cultivation of these cultivators wasn’t ordinary, but to Wang Baole, they were like children, they were on a completely different level from him.
That wasn’t a wrong description. Wang Baole’s current state had long surpassed that of the second echelon in the myriad sect clan. He could even be considered top-notch in the first echelon.
Therefore, the moment he charged forward, along with the explosion of his aura and the roar of his physical strength, Wang Baole suddenly made his move. The entire process took less than the time it takes for half an incense stick to burn, six of the dozen or so people were crushed by him!
The rest fled in shock and terror.
Ignoring the fleeing cultivators, Wang Baole sat cross-legged in the center of the Vortex, high-spirited. He inhaled sharply, and immediately, the broken rules within the vortex charged toward him. They surged into his body in an instant and fused into the intrinsic scabbard.
The intrinsic scabbard’s color instantly turned crimson, as if fresh blood had gathered together. Even the glow spread out and penetrated Wang Baole’s body. From Afar, the glow of his blood surged into the sky.
Following that was the black hair. It came whistling from all directions. Due to the increase in its overall density, the number of strands that appeared this time exceeded ten thousand, charging straight at Wang Baole!
“I suck, I suck, I Suck!”Wang Baole opened his eyes and didn’t Dodge. His entire body was like a black hole, directly absorbing the black hair that was charging at him. The black fish also flew over rapidly, opening its mouth and swallowing continuously, it wasn’t slow either. Overall, it was fifty-fifty with Wang Baole. As it swallowed, it glared at Wang Baole. Due to its unique existence, Wang Baole wasn’t able to detect it accurately.
As it glared at Wang Baole and fought with him for the black strands of hair, Wang Baole’s body shook violently. His physical strength had broken through!
In an instant, he had gone from the mid-stage to the late-stage of the star realm!
As he broke through, his intrinsic scabbard had also undergone some changes. The suction force had increased, causing the black hair around him to be pulled over. The balance between him and the black fish, which had been evenly divided, had been broken in an instant, the balance had gradually shifted to 60-40!
The black fish’s eyeballs bulged. Its eyes revealed a strong sense of grievance and unwillingness, as well as anger.
“Eating my body and snatching my food is one thing, but it actually snatches more than me. Ahhhh!”The black fish was a little crazy. Its eyes were red and filled with ferocity. It had ignored the rules that Chen Qingzi had set for it, with a flash, it appeared directly behind Wang Baole. Without Wang Baole noticing, it opened its mouth wide!
The moment it opened its mouth, it instantly enveloped the surroundings, including Wang Baole’s body. It closed its mouth abruptly, wanting to... Swallow Wang Baole!
However, just as it was about to swallow Wang baole, it vaguely heard a strange sound.
“Son!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1138
chapters.content:
Chapter 1138:, fishing!
Translator:
549690339
The moment the sound rang out, the donkey’s head materialized outside Wang Baole’s storage bag. Its eyes were still closed, as if it was still in a deep sleep. However, its nose twitched frequently, and it moved at an astonishing speed, it lunged at the seemingly empty space behind Wang Baole and took a huge bite!
It was unknown what it had bitten off, but the donkey’s teeth broke. Half of its body exploded. It let out a blood-curdling scream and returned to its storage bag in an instant.
Its blood-curdling scream caused Wang Baole to immediately open his eyes. His body disappeared, and he reappeared in the distance. He looked around, his eyes filled with suspicion. Wang Baole had spread out his divine perception as well, however, he didn’t find any clues in his surroundings.
What’s going on... Wang Baole frowned. He absorbed the black hair as he sent his divine perception into his storage bag. He saw that the donkey was only half a body.
The donkey was still in a deep sleep. Its stomach was about to explode, but it still hadn’t woken up..
However, within its body, Wang Baole saw a mixture of black and green aura. It swam within its body and continued to repair itself. At the same time, it seemed to be transforming it.
As for Xiao Wu... it was also in a deep sleep. There didn’t seem to be anything out of the ordinary.
What did the donkey swallow? It looks like the aura of death and black hair... Wang Baole wondered, he had to absorb the aura of the Unending Heavenly Dao outside. He couldn’t divert his attention, so he didn’t have much time to stay here. He had no choice but to retract his consciousness and focus on absorbing the black hair to strengthen his body.
After retracting his consciousness, Little Five, who was in a deep sleep, suddenly opened his eyes. The donkey opened its eyes as well. The man and the donkey looked at each other.
“The method I taught you, isn’t it very useful? Right, is the fish outside delicious... ?”Little five rubbed his belly and asked softly.
“Son!”The donkey said lazily. It didn’t care that its belly had exploded. It stuck out its tongue and licked its lips.
“This fellow is really bold. He actually dares to eat it... . What the hell is this thing... . It can even eat the Heavenly Dao... .”Little Five was silent. He looked at the donkey’s belly and then at the way it licked its lips, after muttering to himself, he rubbed his stomach again...
He was hungry as well.
......
“Could it be that it’s not the Heavenly Dao? It really can be eaten... .”After a long moment, little five began to wonder. He looked around the outside world, and his gaze seemed to pierce through his bag of holding. He saw a blurry figure fleeing off into the distance, and he licked his lips as well.
At that moment, in the area that little five was looking at with his special technique, the black fish was screaming and running at top speed. If you looked closely, you would see a little less of its tail...
“What the hell? What is that thing? It can see me and bite me. Ah, ah, ah, ah, ah. Isn’t it afraid of dying from overeating?”The black fish was in so much pain that it was about to cry. It quickly returned to the core furnace and howled outside the fog, after not seeing any response, the feeling of grievance reached its peak. After circling around a few times, it could only leave and return to Wang Baole.
However, this time, it did not dare to approach. On one hand, it was because of the bite it had just received. On the other hand, it vaguely felt as if a gaze filled with desire was also there.
Therefore, it only dared to devour the black hair outside, as if it wanted to vent its grievances and anger on the black hair. Very quickly, the black hair was almost completely devoured by Wang Baole and it.
“Next!”Wang Baole’s body swayed delightedly as he charged into the distance. However, his mind was filled with wariness. The scene from before made him feel like there might be something around that had its eyes on him.
It seems like I can’t underestimate the prodigies of the ten thousand sect clan... I should slow down the absorption of the death qi. It Won’t be good if someone sees me. Wang Baole thought to himself as he sped up.
Just like that, in the next few hours, Wang Baole appeared in one large whirlpool after another. Anyone who entered would be immediately killed and chased away. It was extremely violent, causing the cultivators to have no choice but to flee. His name.., it was soon heard from the prodigies from the sects of the left Dao holy region who had seen his portrait.
“Wang Baole? !”
“This pervert, this lunatic. His Dao stars have turned into stars. He even beat up Chong Lizi. Why is he bullying us?”
“He keeps saying that these whirlpools belong to him. Why didn’t he say that the divine emperor and Chen Qingzi are his seniors?”
“Damn it, he’s here again. Everyone, run!”
The entire gray starry sky was thrown into chaos as Wang Baole rampaged through it. Large whirlpools were occupied and absorbed by him, and even more strands of black hair were absorbed into his body. However, Wang Baole appeared to be reckless, he was still very cautious when it came to absorbing black hair.
With his cultivation, he could cover the entire area, and the second-tier elites wouldn’t be able to notice him. However, there would still be cultivators like the old turtle and the beautiful and ugly alike who would notice something amiss.
Wang Baole didn’t pay too much attention to this. It had been difficult to keep this a secret all along, and now that it was such a rare opportunity, Wang Baole didn’t think too much about it when he thought about how his senior brother Chen Qingzi was backing him up.
Compared to worrying and being restrained, it was better to absorb as much as he could here. He wanted to break through the stars and step into the galaxy with his physical body!
Wang Baole’s notoriety spread. Eventually, a large whirlpool would form. As soon as he got close, the people inside would disperse, and this would speed up his absorption.
As a result, his physical body was constantly being absorbed and fed back. It was improving rapidly, from the late-stage of the star to the perfected star. It was getting closer and closer.
If it had been anyone else, they might have broken through long ago. However, Wang Baole’s star dot technique was to transform the stars into his own body. In an invisible manner, every star was like a clone of him. Therefore, the improvement of his physical body was slow, however, every slight improvement was earth-shattering.
As for the absorption of the death qi, Wang Baole couldn’t help but swallow a few more mouthfuls after stopping for a period of time to nourish his spirit soul. At the same time, it drove the black fish even crazier.
However, the biggest gains weren’t from Wang Baole’s physical body and soul. Instead, it was from his intrinsic scabbard. The scabbard was no longer red. It was now extremely red, and a purplish-black luster appeared.
Wang baole only felt the aura emanating from it for a moment, and his heart skipped a beat. It was clear how powerful it was.
The donkey and Xiaowu’s awakening had also been noticed by Wang Baole. In fact, while he was absorbing the vortexes one after another, the two of them kept complaining to each other in his storage bag, their voices were so loud that it was impossible for Wang Baole not to hear them.
“Dumb donkey, can’t You Swallow Less? If you swallow so frequently, how dare that thing come!”
“Son!”
“Son my ass. Restrain yourself. Restrain yourself, or else it won’t dare come!”
Listening to the conversation between the two fellows, Wang Baole sensed that they were also quietly devouring the black hair. He didn’t pay them any heed. After all, he had starved them for so long that he had forgotten about the existence of the two fellows.
As compensation, he could absorb as much as he wanted. There were so many strands of black hair that he wouldn’t be able to absorb them all. However, what he was curious about was what the two fellows were talking about... he couldn’t help but ask.
“What are you two doing? Who are you talking about?”
As Wang Baole spoke, the donkey and Xiaowu froze instantly. It was only after a long while that the donkey spoke carefully.
“Son.”
“A very delicious fish?”Wang baole blinked and scanned Xiaowu with his supernatural awareness. Xiaowu’s body trembled, and a fawning look appeared on his face as he tried to curry favor with him.
“Dad, we’re fishing...”
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes, deep in thought. He thought of the donkey’s appearance and the explosion of its stomach. He wondered if there was a fish that had been by his side and was trying to harm him. Furthermore, it had been following him the entire time..
“Do you need me to cooperate?”Wang Baole suddenly sent a voice transmission.
“Dad, absorb more of the death Qi here. I reckon that useless fish will not be able to take it,”Xiaowu said quickly, pleasantly surprised.
“Son!”The donkey’s eyes lit up as well, and it quickly agreed.
“After you catch it, each of you will get 10% . The remaining 80% will be your tribute!”Wang Baole said immediately, without hesitation.
Xiao Wu and the donkey were silent. After a long while, they nodded, feeling wronged.
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He wanted to see what kind of fish was so bold as to follow him all the way and harm him. At the same time, he realized why there seemed to be a lot of black hair around him when he had absorbed it earlier, however, he hadn’t absorbed that much. He had thought that it had dissipated, but looking at it now... the fish had probably eaten it.
Eating my good fortune? Wang Baole glared, he was very displeased, but he couldn’t be too obvious when he thought about fishing. He pretended not to notice as he swam around in the gray starry sky. He continued to absorb and grow stronger. Gradually, the large whirlpool in the gray starry sky.., one by one, they disappeared. Wang Baole searched for a long time, but he didn’t see them again. Then, he acted as if he was about to choke on his food and drink some water. He opened his mouth and took a deep breath. Immediately, the death qi around him surged rapidly, it surged toward him with a loud bang!

chapters.title: Chapter 1139
chapters.content:
Chapter 1139: was stunned!
Translator:
549690339
At the start of the absorption, Wang Baole controlled his strength and didn’t absorb too much. He only absorbed the death Qi within a certain radius, nourishing his soul and sending out waves of comfort.
As for the black hair that was attracted by the death Qi, Wang Baole’s physical body had become much stronger. Furthermore, he was thinking that the donkey and Xiaowu seemed to be able to swallow the black hair. If the situation really came to a head, he would just throw them out.
With their abilities, they shouldn’t be able to die.
The main reason why he didn’t immediately absorb the black strands of hair was that he couldn’t use too much force when fishing. He had to cook them slowly and for a long period of time. He had to slowly wear down the other party’s rationality and make him act impulsively, that was why he was able to catch them.
I want to see what kind of reckless fish dares to ambush me! Wang Baole snorted in his heart. As he absorbed the death Qi in the surroundings, he slowly increased his strength, increasing the range and absorbing more death qi.
As the boundless death Qi surged into his soul, it trembled even more. Not only did it feel extremely comfortable, it also began to reflect back on his cultivation as his soul continued to grow stronger, it also gradually increased his cultivation.
For cultivators, cultivation, soul, and physical body were separate but also one. Therefore, the increase in the soul and physical body naturally led to an increase in cultivation.
However, as it was not specifically meant to increase cultivation, the speed of improvement was somewhat slow. The advantage was that it was continuous. As Wang Baole continued to increase his strength, the surrounding death Qi gradually arrived, gradually, the death Qi vortex was about to form. Not far from where he was, the black fish was in a dilemma.
It wanted to go over and swallow Wang Baole to end this once and for all. However, the bite that it had received previously made its heart skip a beat. It did not dare approach, but it did not approach... it watched helplessly as the surrounding death Qi was continuously being swallowed by Wang Baole, its heart was in a frenzy.
The Deathly Qi was a part of its body. To It, Wang Baole wasn’t devouring the deathly qi, but eating its own flesh and blood.
As a result, its struggle was naturally intense. It was as if two consciousnesses had appeared in its mind. One told it to charge over, and the other told it to endure.
I Can’t go. This fellow absorbed my Qi previously. It’ll only take a moment at most before it stops. I’ll endure! In the end, the consciousness that allowed it to endure gained the upper hand in the Black Fish’s mind, and it suppressed its impulse.
Therefore, in the gray starry sky, Wang Baole and the fish were in a stalemate. Wang Baole waited for a long while, but the fish still hadn’t appeared. The black strands of hair around him had also gathered together, some of them were even charging at full speed towards him.
......
“Dad, what should we do? Why Don’t you absorb more at once? Otherwise, the fish won’t come!”
“Son!”Little Five and the donkey were getting anxious, especially the donkey. It couldn’t control its saliva as it drooled.
Foolish. I can’t be anxious while fishing! Wang Baole snorted in his heart. He ignored little five and the donkey and sped off into the distance. As he avoided the black strands of hair, he once again increased his absorption of the death qi.
The Death Qi in the surrounding area was immediately increased. Wang Baole also increased his speed and sped off into the distance, causing the large amount of black strands of hair to chase after him. At the same time, he spoke in his heart.
“The two of you, did you notice that the fish is chasing after us?”
“Dad, the fish is still there. I can sense that it’s around us!”Xiaowu said hurriedly. The donkey nodded frantically. Wang baole immediately calmed down. Deep down, he thought that the stinky fish was very cautious.
“I’m not afraid of being cautious, but I’m afraid of running away!”Wang Baole smiled and continued to run. He continued to absorb the death qi, and the range of absorption grew larger and faster. This made the black fish following behind him even more frantic.
“It’s not over?”
“Damn it, it’s really not over!”The Black Fish’s eyes were red, at that moment, the two consciousnesses in its mind awakened once again. They suppressed each other crazily, causing its body to tremble. It couldn’t hold it in any longer. The despicable little thief before its eyes.., he didn’t give up after absorbing it as he had done in the past. Instead, he continued to absorb it..
He had already absorbed quite a lot up until now. From the looks of it, it seemed like it wasn’t over yet. This drove it crazy. It wanted to look for Chen Qingzi, but it had ignored Chen Qingzi no matter how many times it went to look for him, that was why the Black Fish’s crimson eyes revealed a fierce glint.
If you eat any more, I’ll Swallow You! As it roared in its heart, Wang Baole, who was speeding off into the distance, continued to absorb the death Qi along with the tens of thousands of strands of black hair behind him.
However... his forehead was already covered in sweat, and his heart was trembling. Even the donkey and Xiaowu were trembling in fear. There were too many strands of black hair chasing after him, and the fish had yet to appear.., this made Xiaowu and Xiaowu doubt their own judgment.
Wang Baole cursed in his heart. However, he was unwilling to give up now. Furthermore... even though there were more strands of black hair behind him, as the death Qi was absorbed, his soul was also growing stronger.
It could be said that at this moment, he was conflicted, in pain, and in joy.
“Still not coming? Still not coming!”
Wang Baole was anxious, and his eyes were filled with madness. He thought that the black fish had probably reached its limit and didn’t dare appear. Perhaps it was waiting for an opportunity.
However, if he waited like this, he wouldn’t be able to hold on for long. Therefore... he should create an opportunity for the other party.
At the thought of this, Wang Baole was determined. He roared loudly and formed a seal with both hands. The dark fire in his body burned, forming a powerful suction force that sucked in the surrounding death Qi!
This time, he released all of the dark fire in his body and all of his cultivation. He used all of his strength to engulf the death qi. As a result, a loud rumble was created, causing the large area of death Qi in the surroundings to instantly become violent, it rolled towards him with a loud bang and surged rapidly.
From Afar, the amount of death Qi that Wang Baole had swallowed this time was comparable to the amount he had swallowed previously. As a result, the black fish became even more aggrieved and agitated. It let out a roar, as if it was about to lose control of itself, the impulse in its mind was about to overwhelm its rationality.
At that moment, it seemed to feel that the temptation wasn’t enough. As the death Qi was absorbed, the number of strands of black hair in the surroundings instantly increased to seventy to eighty thousand. Wang Baole was like playing with fire, as the donkey and Little Five’s hearts jumped in fear, suddenly, his body shook violently. He let out a scream and spat out a large mouthful of blood.
It was as if... He had choked on something he was eating.
His speed was affected as well. In the blink of an eye, the strands of black hair charged towards him, causing Wang Baole’s expression to change drastically. He was about to flee at top speed..
However, at that moment, a ferocious glint flashed across the Black Fish’s eyes. It disappeared in a flash and reappeared behind Wang Baole, just as it was about to open its mouth!
However, just as it appeared and was about to open its mouth, little five and the donkey in Wang Baole’s mind let out excited roars.
“Daddy is behind you!”
“Son! Son!”
As the words echoed in Wang Baole’s mind, in that instant... in the Black Fish’s eyes, it saw the silhouette of a donkey, as well as a wretched youth.., and... The Little Thief, who seemed to have choked.
The eyes of the three fellows lit up, and with excitement, they opened their mouths and bit at it!
The Little Donkey, who had tasted sweetness before, opened its mouth wide. It seemed to have used all its strength to support itself, and its shape changed. It was like a black hole. Little Five was even more exaggerated. Its body was gone, and it was only left with a mouth.., as it drooled, it also swallowed.
The most exaggerated thing was... that little thief. It was as if he could transform, and instantly, tens of thousands of figures appeared. Each of them opened their mouths wide as they tried to swallow him. In fact, it even saw a zombie, a weapon.., a figure filled with extreme hatred, and a white deer with its mouth wide open.
This scene caused the black fish to be stunned for a moment. It stood there in a daze, as if it had been scared out of its wits, and its body was trembling.
It was true... that these fellows before its eyes were actually even more savage than it!

chapters.title: Chapter 1140
chapters.content:
Chapter 1140:? ? ?
Translator:
549690339
The little donkey was not afraid of death!
It was only afraid that it would starve, so even if it died, as long as it could eat something delicious, it would be satisfied.
Even though its stomach had exploded the last time it bit down, it still used all its strength to open its mouth and bite down crazily. In an instant, its newly recovered stomach exploded again, this time, it wasn’t just its stomach. Even its limbs and even its tail were destroyed.
It was the same with its neck. Half of its head was the same, but it didn’t seem to feel any pain. Instead, one of the eyes on the remaining half of its head narrowed in satisfaction.
As for serendipity... it was just as shocking. The remaining half of its head emitted an aura that was somewhat similar to that of the black fish! !
As for Xiao Wu... He wasn’t afraid of death. Perhaps he had been afraid, but after being starved for an unknown period of time, he wanted to eat whatever he could or couldn’t eat.
If it weren’t for the fact that he didn’t think he could eat the donkey, he would have eaten it.
That was why he used all his strength and took a huge bite. His body didn’t explode due to the strange circumstances, but he spat out a large amount of blood mist. His eyes were glowing, as if he had received a great tonic!
As for Wang Baole... He wasn’t afraid of death.
Therefore, when he sensed that Xiao Wu and the donkey were going fishing, and that they wanted to eat fish, he weighed his options and felt that he could eat fish as well.
After all, his original body was an undying and indestructible black wooden board. How could a fish burst it? Therefore, when he found out where the invisible fish had appeared, Wang Baole didn’t hesitate at all, he used all his strength and swallowed at the spot where the donkey and Little Five had bitten.
It was also because of his star incarnations that he had swallowed much more than the donkey and Little Five..
Therefore, as he swallowed and felt as if he had swallowed something, as if it was greasy, Wang Baole’s eyes widened abruptly. In that instant, an extremely dense ball of death qi appeared on his body, it was an aura of death that could no longer be described. It contained endless rules, the Myriad Dao of Heaven and earth, and countless wills.
......
Just one mouthful was enough to make Wang Baole’s mind buzz. Banging sounds came from within his body. It was as if his meridians were about to explode. Qi and blood spewed out uncontrollably from his body, as if his body was about to explode!
It wasn’t just his actual body that was affected. All the star avatars were affected as well. In fact... a small portion of the avatars couldn’t take it anymore and collapsed immediately. However, they reformed in the next instant, they devoured the matter that had dispersed once again.
His shadow from his previous life was affected as well. They quickly shared and digested the matter in order to resolve Wang Baole’s devouring this time!
“What... What did I swallow!”Wang Baole’s expression was one of shock. He didn’t have time to think about it. As his star clone collapsed and reassembled, the nine quasi-dao stars in his body didn’t collapse, instead, they expanded rapidly. In a few breaths’time, as the Aura continued to supplement them, one of the quasi-dao stars exploded and became... a quasi-dao star!
Then a second, a third, and a fourth!
Within a short period of time, the four quasi-dao stars exploded out, transforming into stars. However, that was not the end. In the next moment, the fifth, the sixth, the seventh, and finally... the ninth quasi-dao star, it transformed into a star!
At the same time, the netherworld flame in his body exploded out, as if it had been replenished like never before. It was as if it had received an incredible stroke of good fortune, which spread out through his entire body, it caused his divine soul to break through the early star realm and reach the mid star realm.
It wasn’t over yet. It continued to rise, all the way until it reached the late star realm! !
Although his cultivation base was in the early star realm, he was in the late fleshly body realm and the late Divine Soul Realm. As of this moment, his cultivation base erupted with power. As soon as the nine quasi-dao stars reached the star realm, it began to rise rapidly, with a loud boom, he broke through the early-stage of the star realm and entered... the mid-stage of the star realm!
At that moment, Wang Baole was stunned. He knew that his cultivation would definitely progress at a slower pace than everyone else. His foundation was too deep, so if he wanted to break through, he would need to convert the stars in his body, most of them would be converted into stars. Only then would he be able to transform into a galaxy, until he was able to transform into a complete galaxy with Dao Heng as the center!
When that happened, he would be able to advance to the level of a mighty figure in the galaxy. Once he advanced, he would become so powerful that he would be able to become a mighty figure in the galaxy-grade with a single leap!
It was precisely because he knew this that Wang Baole was even more shocked.
At the same time, he vaguely heard the sound of crying... and what he had originally seen was an illusory figure fleeing into the distance in the empty void.
It was a little blurry, and he could only see the outline of it. It was like... a fish that had lost a small part of its body..
Even though he wanted to chase after it, the fish had run too fast. Furthermore, after his cultivation had exploded, perhaps it was because the substance he had swallowed made him feel a little greasy, causing Wang Baole to think of the ice spirit water, just as he instinctively wanted to take out a bottle, he saw the black strands of hair that were rushing towards him.
“Huh?”Wang baole blinked. He had a vague feeling that this thing... seemed very refreshing.
In the next instant, Wang Baole grabbed a strand of black hair and placed it in his mouth. His eyes lit up immediately.
“Delicious, very crisp, and a little sweet!”Wang Baole licked his lips. He didn’t run anymore, and he couldn’t catch up to the fish. He charged towards the strands of hair, grabbing them and eating them.
Cracking sounds came from his mouth. The pleasant taste excited Wang Baole, and it also made little five and the donkey anxious. Little Five was fine, but he rushed out to eat as fast as he could. The donkey only had half a head left, it had no mouth to eat. In its anxiety, it couldn’t even make a sound. In the end, it seemed to have been forced into a corner. It used half of its head to hit the strands of black hair, causing them to crawl into it..
All in all, the three of them were in a frenzy. As they continued to devour the black strands of hair around them, the intrinsic scabbard in Wang Baole’s body began to buzz, as if it was filled with dissatisfaction.
“Shut up. You’ve already eaten quite a bit. It’s my turn!”Wang Baole ignored them and suppressed them. Then, his eyes shone as he continued to grab the black strands of hair to devour them.
“This thing is better than ice spirit water!”
At the same time... in the depths of the gray starry sky, inside the core oven, outside the black fog that was used to refine the divine emperor, the black fish that had been running away was like a child that had been bullied and beaten up outside, it ran over while bawling loudly.
When it reached the outside of the fog, it landed on the ground and started rolling around. Its cries grew louder and louder until it shook the core oven. Chen Qingzi, who had his eyes closed in the fog, opened his eyes in surprise. He looked outside and was stunned for a moment, he disappeared in an instant and reappeared outside the Black Fog.
“Divine Emperor Weiyang has come in? Or has the heavenly axiom of Weiyang descended? How dare you! ! How dare you hurt the heavenly axiom of the dark sect! !”Chen Qingzi’s face was gloomy, killing intent filled the air. The fish in front of him, which was rolling around and wailing like a child, was in a terrible state.
Half of its body was gone. The wound was jagged, as if it had been bitten off. It was a shocking sight, and it made Chen Qingzi even angrier.
“Tell me who was the one who injured you. I’ll capture him for you. Hurt him as much as I hurt you!”
When the black fish heard Chen Qingzi’s words, it was instantly moved. There seemed to be tears in its eyes as it let out a series of roars, as if it was describing something. At the same time, it flipped its body and started transforming in midair. First, it turned into a donkey, then, it turned into a youth. It paused for a moment before its body exploded, transforming into countless figures. Each and every one of them looked like Wang Baole..
Finally, they gathered together, turning back into a fish and wailing once again.
However, as it was crying and bawling, it did not notice Chen Qingzi’s expression. From the beginning, it was extremely gloomy. However, as it watched and watched until it saw Wang Baole’s expression, its expression became strange. In the end, it blinked and coughed dryly.
“That’s enough. It’s just a few bites. It Won’t kill me!”
“It’s not a big deal. Why did you call me out? Let’s not talk about it anymore. I’m going back to refine the moon splitter!”As he said that, Chen Qingzi turned around and disappeared into the black fog.
The black fish outside the black fog was stunned once again. It was dazed and at a loss, as if it had yet to react.
”?”
”? ?”
”? ? ?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1141
chapters.content:
Chapter 1141:, the Bad Guy!
Translator:
549690339
At that moment, if anyone could see through the heart of the crippled little black fish, they would definitely be able to feel a few words reverberating in its mind..
“What happened to helping me?”
“What happened to capturing the other party for me to bite?”
“What happened to anger?”
The little black fish was at a loss... it only reacted after a long while. It let out a mournful wail and rolled around outside the fog. After a long while, it realized that no one was paying attention to it. Only then did it stop feeling wronged and leave the place as if it was venting, a series of roars came from outside.
As it vented its anger, Chen Qingzi, who had stepped into the black fog, couldn’t help but feel a headache coming on. He hadn’t expected Wang Baole to swallow a small portion of the little black fish. He hadn’t expected Wang Baole to look so miserable, he found it difficult to pull the little black fish aside.
If this goes on, little junior brother won’t really eat all of the fish, right? Chen Qingzi’s eyelids twitched. He felt that the possibility of that happening was very high. He raised his hand and rubbed the space between his brows, he spread out his divine perception and instantly enveloped the entire gray starry sky. Then, he saw..
His expression was even stranger and filled with helplessness.
He saw that in the gray starry sky, Wang Baole was still absorbing the death qi. The donkey and a youth were hiding beside him. Even though they tried their best to hide it, they had swallowed countless mouthfuls of saliva.
The donkey, in particular, had just recovered its head. There was a flaw in its chin, causing its saliva to spill out into the starry sky..
Wang Baole didn’t drool, but the glow in his eyes and the way he swallowed his saliva made it clear that the three of them were addicted to fishing. They still wanted to fish.
“Isn’t this silly? That fish has been bitten so badly. How can it still go past?”Chen Qingzi muttered, as he said that, his eyes widened in the next instant. He stared blankly at the black fish that had left behind Wang Baole and the other two. It had appeared there.
He gritted his teeth and was about to make a move.
......
Chen Qingzi was silent. He felt that he should retract his previous judgment. This black fish... was indeed a little silly.
However, no matter how silly it was, it was still the Heavenly Dao. As Chen Qingzi had a headache, he coughed in Wang Baole’s direction and sent out his telepathic thoughts.
As Chen Qingzi sent out his telepathic thoughts, Wang Baole was reprimanding the donkey and Xiaowu.
“The two of you, restrain yourselves!”
“Donkey, swallow your saliva. Your saliva is all over the place. If this continues, that fish will become silly. Will it still dare to appear?”
“Xiaowu, go and catch the donkey’s saliva. Hurry up. If you can’t catch any fish, I’ll use the two of you as bait!”
Xiaowu and the donkey looked aggrieved. They didn’t dare to speak out in anger. They looked at each other quickly, as if they were silently wondering if this was human talk. It was too much.
However, Xiaowu didn’t dare resist. He could only run over and place his hands on the donkey’s chin. He sighed as he gulped.
Wang Baole snorted. He was about to continue reprimanding the donkey, but at that moment, his expression changed. The words that Chen Qingzi had sent him rang in his mind.
“Junior brother, stop sucking in the air of death. Stop staring at that fish. That’s the Heavenly Dao of our dark sect... I’ll bring you to the dark sect later so that you can suck in as much as you want.”
“Senior brother?”Wang Baole was initially pleasantly surprised. However, when he heard what Chen Qingzi had said, he immediately felt guilty. He quickly nodded and turned to glare angrily at the donkey and Little Five, who were fishing. He kicked them away, he gritted his teeth and spoke with disappointment.
“What are you doing? That fish is so pitiful, and you still want to fish it?”
“Do you have any compassion? Do you have any compassion? That’s too much!”Wang baole growled angrily. His expression and his words instantly made the donkey and Xiaowu Freeze in shock, feeling a little lost.
“I didn’t have the heart to do this in the first place. You insisted on blackmailing me and forcing me to do it. However, my conscience is hurting, and I feel that I’ve let the baby black fish down!”
“Let me tell you, I’ve come to a realization. I Can’t help the wicked. From now on, Baby Black Fish is my brother. Anyone who dares to lay their hands on it will be making things difficult for me, Wang Baole. They will be my mortal enemy and will not rest until one of them is dead!”Wang Baole’s words were firm and decisive, it spread in all directions, causing little five and the donkey to tremble. The one who was the most shaken was the black fish that was following them not too far away..
The fish had been gnashing its teeth, feeling wronged and angry. However, at that moment, after hearing Wang Baole’s words, its body began to tremble. It wasn’t angry, but touched!
It was like a person who had suffered an intense grievance. No one understood or stood up for him. However, at that moment, someone suddenly came up and patted its head, giving it warmth, understanding, and even loudly telling it.., “In the future, I will help whoever bullies you. Whoever bullies you will be my enemy. I know all of your grievances.”.
Under such circumstances, anyone would be touched, even if the other party was an enemy... especially for the immature black fish, it was even more touched. Therefore, almost instantly, it transferred its hostility and hatred towards Wang Baole, more than half of it was transferred. Not only that, it even felt that Wang Baole was very warm.
If that was all, perhaps the black fish would react on its own after some time. However, Wang Baole would not give it the chance. After saying that, Wang Baole raised his right hand and waved it, instantly taking out half of the black hair that he had accumulated previously, the black hair that was prepared to be a snack was taken out and shouted loudly.
“Baby Fish, don’t be angry, okay? Come out for a moment. These are my compensation. From now on, we are brothers, so I won’t suck your breath anymore. If anyone provokes you, I’ll help you stand up for them.”
As soon as Wang Baole said that, the black fish, which was hiding not far away, hesitated for a moment.
Wang Baole waited for a moment. Seeing that the other party did not appear, he took out some black hair and revealed a warm smile. He tried his best to make himself look friendly and shout loudly.
“Baby fish, I was wrong. Please forgive me. I’ll take you to eat all these black hair in the future!”
Perhaps it was because Wang Baole had moved the little black fish, or perhaps it was because the black hair was very attractive, or perhaps there was something wrong with the little black fish’s mind... not long after, the figure of the little black fish slowly appeared in the distance, it looked at Wang Baole warily.
This scene immediately made little five and the donkey widen their eyes. They looked at each other rapidly, and they saw the shock in each other’s eyes and the worship that rose involuntarily.
“Could it be that the kick just now was a feint, and its real purpose was actually to fish? Impressive, indeed impressive!”
“Son! Son! Son!”
While little five and the donkey were in shock, the little black fish flew over quickly. It swallowed a mouthful and retreated instantly. It was still vigilant, but when it realized that there was no danger, it flashed and disappeared again. After a few more times.., the little black fish seemed to have lowered its guard. After Wang Baole took out more strands of black hair, the little black fish finally got closer. It didn’t leave immediately. Instead, it ate while looking at Wang Baole in confusion.
At that moment, little five and the donkey’s eyes were glowing. They opened their mouths and were about to pounce over when the little black fish reacted. It was about to explode with fear and anger, but Wang Baole seemed to be even angrier than it was, he blocked the little black fish behind him and rushed forward, kicking them one by one. Amidst the loud boom, he sent little five and the donkey flying with a kick.
“Shameless, you’ve gone too far!”
“Do you still have a conscience? Let me tell you two, Baby Little Fish is my brother and your elder. No one is allowed to eat him in the future!”
This scene stunned little five and the donkey. They couldn’t help but feel wronged. The little black fish was stunned as well. When it looked at Wang Baole, it seemed like it was about to cry, it let out a mournful wail as if it had found its family. It pounced towards Wang Baole. All its hatred towards Wang Baole disappeared in an instant, and it was transferred to Xiaowu and the donkey.
So, it was the two of you!
That’s right. The beast that had bitten it first was the one with only its head left!
“Xiaowu, don’t cry.”Wang Baole smiled warmly. He gently stroked the little black fish’s body, then glared at Xiaowu and the donkey.
“Little fish is so cute. You guys... Don’t do it again!”
Little Five was silent.
The donkey was at a loss.
Chen Qingzi continued massaging the space between his brows.
—
He still owed five chapters. He wasn’t in a good state today, and he wanted to rest for half a day. He wanted to continue the chapters next weekend

chapters.title: Chapter 1142
chapters.content:
Chapter 1142:, the Big One!
Translator:
549690339
Wang baole blinked. He looked at the little black fish, who looked comfortable after being caressed by him. However, when he looked at little five and the donkey, he gritted his teeth. After a moment of silence, he suddenly called out in his heart.
“Senior brother...”
Chen Qingzi, who was in the core oven, did not want to speak. However, it was not good for his little junior brother to call out to him. Therefore, he could only reply helplessly.
“What’s the matter?”
Hearing his senior brother’s reply, Wang Baole’s spirits were lifted, and he sent a voice transmission rapidly.
“Senior brother, this isn’t right. Is this the Heavenly Dao of our dark race? Isn’t this too silly? It only knows how to eat... with this kind of mentality, it’ll be easy for others to deceive it in the future.”
Chen Qingzi rubbed the space between his brows and sighed.
“It’s still a child... according to the age of your federation people, it’s only about three to five years old. How Smart Can you expect a child of three to five years old to be? “At its age, of course, it only knows how to eat.”
“Alright, stop bullying it...”Chen Qingzi didn’t want to speak anymore. He gathered his thoughts and shook his head, continuing to refine the moon splitting divine emperor before him.
As for Wang Baole, he coughed. Deep down, he still felt a little guilty. It was as if he was trying to trick a child with candy.
“Little Five and the donkey, these two are too much!”Wang Baole glared at them and kicked them again, causing them to feel even more wronged. They stared at Wang Baole, and deep down.., they had already started cursing, but they didn’t dare show it on the surface.
Wang Baole was well aware of this. He simply waved his hand and put the two fellows back into his storage bag. He wouldn’t be bothered if they were out of sight, out of mind, and out of mind. In reality, he was the one who ate the most after fishing.
As for the little black fish, it was even more touched now. When it looked at Wang baole, its eyes revealed a cordial look. It even flew up and circled around him, looking very happy.
......
“This child...”Wang Baole had a strange look on his face. After coughing once again, a warm smile appeared on his face as he spoke softly.
“Baby Little Fish, let’s go. Big Brother will bring you to eat something delicious.”
Hearing Wang Baole’s words, the little black fish was clearly even more excited. It circled around Wang Baole even faster. Wang baole blinked and spoke again.
“Baby Fish, do you know where there are larger whirlpools?”Wang Baole felt that the little black fish was definitely more familiar with this place than he was. He had been searching this gray area for a long time, he hadn’t seen any other large whirlpools, so he tried to ask.
The black fish paused, and a look of contemplation appeared in its eyes. Then, its eyes lit up. When it looked at Wang baole, its body instantly swelled up. This sudden change stunned Wang Baole. After a long while, he saw that it had become extremely majestic, the black fish, which had surpassed all the whirlpools he had seen before, suddenly had a look of excitement in its eyes.
“Are you telling me that you know how big a vortex is?”
The gigantic black fish nodded quickly. Then, with a flash, it recovered and sped off into the distance, as if to lead the way. In his excitement, Wang Baole immediately followed.
It was clear that his senior brother did not allow him to absorb the death qi. Therefore, if he wanted to attract more black hair, he could only do so in the vortex where the strong had fallen. Furthermore, in the vortex, his intrinsic sword sheath would also be strengthened, this would reflect the nutrients that would strengthen his physical body.
As for swallowing the black hair raw, even though Wang Baole had eaten quite a lot, he felt that it didn’t have much effect. At most, it tasted good. After swallowing it and fusing it into his body, it would also be absorbed by his intrinsic scabbard.
Therefore, in the end, Wang Baole still felt that finding the vortex was the most important thing. At that moment, as they sped along, with the little black fish leading the way, both of them were extremely fast. Perhaps it was because the vortex was too far away.., therefore, the little black fish soon felt that Wang Baole’s speed was too slow.
Therefore, the black fish stopped and shouted at Wang Baole. At the same time, it flipped its body a few times. If it was anyone else, they might not be clear about its thoughts, but Wang Baole had been with the donkey for many years and had some experience, as he learned by analogy, he came to a realization.
“You want to take me flying?”As soon as Wang Baole opened his mouth, the little black fish quickly nodded.
“Good baby!”Wang Baole laughed. He landed on the little black fish’s back. In that instant, the little black fish charged forward. Its speed was dozens of times faster than before, wang Baole’s vision blurred. In the next moment... it was as if the little black fish had brought him through space. He appeared in an area with an even denser aura of death!
In front of him, there was a gigantic whirlpool. This whirlpool was even more astonishing than what the little black fish had described. It was ten times the size of the whirlpool that Wang Baole had absorbed previously.
Wang Baole couldn’t see the end of it at all. This made him excited, especially since there was no one else in the area other than him.
Wang Baole’s eyes lit up. He spread out his spiritual perception and scanned his surroundings. After a long while, a look of understanding appeared in his eyes.
This was the gray starry sky, but it wasn’t the gray starry sky either. It was within the range of the gray starry sky, but it was as if another space had overlapped.
Combined with the shocking whirlpool before his eyes, Wang Baole had a vague guess. The almighty who had died here must have had an earth-shattering cultivation that surpassed that of an ordinary galaxy. That was why his death had suppressed the void, that was why this place had been created on its own.
That was why it had been so difficult to be discovered. That was why no cultivators from the myriad sect clan had entered this place.
In reality, if it hadn’t been for the little black fish leading the way, even Wang Baole wouldn’t have been able to find his way in.
I’m Rich
Excited, Wang Baole immediately rushed forward. He quickly approached the vortex. At the same time, he felt waves of repulsive force formed by the shattering of the laws. It surged forth from within the vortex like a tsunami.
However, the more that happened, the more excited Wang Baole became. The intrinsic scabbard in his body rumbled as he activated it with all his might. Under the frenzied absorption, he slowly walked forward. As he absorbed, he resisted the pressure, he slowly stepped into the vortex and sat down cross-legged. He closed his eyes and focused all his attention on activating the intrinsic scabbard.
His intrinsic scabbard was also excited at that moment. Blood-red light erupted. It seemed to be extremely thirsty as it spread out the absorption force, drawing in the massive amount of shattering of the laws in the surroundings and continuously surging toward him.
Time passed slowly. The shockingly broken rules in the vast whirlpool were being rapidly absorbed by Wang Baole’s natal scabbard. Very quickly, it reached 10% , 20% , 30% ..
The color of the natal scabbard had completely turned purple, and it was even spreading towards black. The aura contained within it also became more and more terrifying.
In the area, as the number of broken rules in the vortex decreased, a certain degree of collapse occurred, causing a large amount of black hair to gather in all directions. The number reached tens of thousands in an instant, and it wasn’t over yet, it was still gathering.
The little black fish was excited as well. It looked at the black hair, as if it was continuously swallowing its saliva. The donkey and little five sneaked out once again. On the other side, they stared at the black hair, and their saliva dripped down once again.
As the three of them were craving for more, Wang Baole’s absorption of the damaged laws within the vortex increased from thirty percent to seventy percent. Then, eighty percent, ninety percent..
In an instant, the surroundings began to rumble. The number of black strands increased to nearly one hundred and sixty thousand. They were still gathering in the distance. The total number had exceeded two hundred thousand.
At that moment, almost half of the intrinsic scabbard had turned completely black. Then... when Wang Baole absorbed the final ten percent of the damaged laws within the vortex, in an instant.., a deafening sound reverberated in all directions, even reaching beyond the gray starry sky.
As the sound reverberated, the vortex where Wang Baole was formed into a gigantic black hole. It sucked violently towards the outside world. In that instant... the number of black strands in the surroundings increased explosively, reaching nearly three hundred thousand, they charged towards Wang Baole with a loud boom. They tunneled into his body frantically from all directions.
As it entered his body too quickly, Wang Baole’s body trembled violently.
At the same time, outside the gray space, in the hidden area above the gray space, the hundreds of thousands of unending clan warships shuddered simultaneously. It was visible to the naked eye that they were showing signs of withering, as if they were being pulled!
This scene stunned the mystic flower divine emperor, who was overseeing the place. He narrowed his eyes and looked carefully at the gray space below. Although he couldn’t see what was happening inside clearly, he could clearly sense that a lot of the death aura had dissipated, therefore, he snorted coldly.
“Is this a dying struggle? Increase the volume! !”

chapters.title: Chapter 1143
chapters.content:
Chapter 1143:, the nine stoves!
Translator:
549690339
With the mystic flower divine emperor’s order, the hundred thousand-plus unending clan warships immediately buzzed. The unending clan cultivators within them increased their strength, drawing in more of the Unending Heavenly Dao Aura, turning them into green clouds, the clouds fell into the gray starry sky.
At the same time, Wang Baole went into a frenzy. Large amounts of black hair surged into his body and were absorbed by his intrinsic sword scabbard. Then, they were fed back to nourish his physical body, forming a cycle, wang Baole was almost oblivious to his surroundings.
Little Five and the donkey were excited as well. Even though they didn’t dare rush into the Sea of black hair, they did their best to devour it from the outside. It was the same for the little black fish.
However, after looking at the donkey and Little Five, it had a look of disdain on its face. It flew into the Sea of black hair and opened its mouth... swallowing hundreds and thousands of black hair!
The little donkey and Little Five were not satisfied with this scene. They also increased their strength and used their own methods. It was unknown what method Little Five used, but his body turned into a small vortex and absorbed the black hair.
The little donkey was even more extraordinary. It could not turn into a vortex, and it did not have such a big mouth. However, after absorbing the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao and Wei Yang’s Heavenly Dao, its form was already very special. At this moment, its body, which had recovered more than half, swayed, it transformed into the shape of a large pancake. It spread out and blocked a portion of the black strands that were charging forward. All the black strands that had fallen into the pancake disappeared rapidly.
At that moment, the four of them could be said to have displayed their respective abilities. They were all absorbing frantically. However, overall, Wang Baole alone was absorbing fifty percent of the black strands, while the little black fish was absorbing thirty percent. As for little five and the donkey.., they had absorbed ten percent of the black hair.
Although they didn’t look as good as the little black fish or Wang Baole, there were too many strands of black hair here. The black hole formed by the majestic whirlpool had an earth-shattering suction force, causing the hundreds of thousands of strands of black hair to become less and less visible to the naked eye!
This made Wang Baole a little anxious. His physical strength was now at the peak of the late-stage star realm. He seemed to be only half a step away from the perfected stage, but in reality, he knew very well that as he had too many stars, his physical body would be affected as well, therefore, the further he advanced, the more terrifying the power he would need to advance.
For example, right now, his natal scabbard had already absorbed almost a hundred thousand strands of black hair, and it was also reflecting the same level of aura to improve his physical body. However, he was still far from breaking through.
Fortunately, in the next instant, under the explosion of the black hole, a large amount of black hair was attracted over. At the same time, with the help and replenishment of the mystic flower divine emperor... even more strands of black hair were approaching from further away. As a result.., wang Baole and the other three were once again excited.
At the same time, the hundred thousand-plus unending clan warships outside the gray space began to tremble once again. The mystic flower deity Emperor stood up as well. Confusion appeared in his eyes. However, after a moment of hesitation, he gritted his teeth.
I don’t believe it. Continue increasing the size! As a loud boom rang out, the hundred thousand-plus unending clan warships were released once again. This time, they released even more. However... these clusters of green fog that had fused into the gray space.., after they turned into a sea of black strands, they were immediately drawn towards Wang Baole.
......
As the explosions rang out, the number of black strands around Wang Baole once again increased to hundreds of thousands. This made little five and the donkey even more excited. The little black fish was so excited that it was about to tremble.
Under this crazy absorption, even though the vortex was vast, the suction force gradually weakened. It was also at this moment that little five couldn’t take it anymore. He needed time to digest it, therefore, he had no choice but to end the absorption. He watched as the black hair left. At the same time that he felt indignant in his heart, when he saw the little donkey and the little black fish, he felt even more indignant.
“These two foodies are too gluttonous!”Little Five was helpless. The black fish was the Heavenly Dao, so it was reasonable for them to be able to eat. However, the little donkey... was actually able to persevere, this caused little five to be gradually shocked.
This was especially true when he saw the huge pancake that the little donkey had transformed into. It was riddled with holes, and seemed as if it would collapse if it continued to eat. However, the little donkey was still persistent..
“It really doesn’t want to live anymore!”In the midst of Little Five’s shock, the little donkey had indeed persevered to the extreme. However, it was not convinced. It still wanted to eat, and when the sound of children’s cries rang out, it still had to persevere. As a result, the huge pancake.., in the next instant, more than half of the pancake collapsed, but it... was still swallowing.
The little black fish was shocked by this scene. When it looked at the donkey, its eyes were filled with wariness and intense wariness.
Fortunately, after the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, the large pancake that the donkey had formed collapsed. It screamed in pain and retreated. Only then did it end its swallowing. Therefore, Xiao Wu and the little black fish heaved a sigh of relief.
The little black fish had also reached its limits. It needed time to digest and absorb the energy endlessly. In the end, it had no choice but to give up. Wang Baole was the only one left who was still absorbing the energy.
As the intrinsic scabbard absorbed the energy, and as the power of feedback continued to pour in, the aura of his physical body began to emit a shocking wave. The wave grew stronger and stronger. It meant that his physical strength was moving from the late-stage of the star realm.., it was charging towards the perfected star realm.
I’m still a little short, just a little short! Wang Baole’s eyes were red, he circulated his cultivation, and the tens of thousands of stars behind him materialized. His soul was being strengthened, causing the intrinsic scabbard in his body to have an even stronger suction force. Countless strands of black hair surged in, and the feedback force became even more astonishing, however... The vortex could no longer hold on. After another hour, the black hole formed by Wang Baole’s cross-legged meditation vortex slowly dissipated.
The suction force also dissipated, and the surrounding strands of black hair, due to the loss of the suction force, scattered in all directions and quickly disappeared into nothingness. Wang Baole roared and rushed out, grabbing at the strands of black hair that had gradually disappeared into nothingness, he kept grabbing at them.
However, his speed wasn’t as fast as before, so even if he tried his best, he still couldn’t catch much.
I was so close! Wang Baole’s eyes were bloodshot, a terrifying glow appeared in his eyes. He was feeling a little frustrated. He could sense that with his powerful and terrifying physical body, he was just a step away from achieving a breakthrough and stepping into the perfected stellar realm.
The final seventy to eighty thousand strands! Wang Baole didn’t know how much he had absorbed previously. However, he could sense that with a few more tens of thousands, he would definitely be able to advance!
If he ignored his senior brother’s advice and swallowed the death Qi, Wang Baole felt that he would be able to swallow the tens of thousands of strands of black hair very quickly. However, he now knew that the death Qi was the power of the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao. The little black fish wasn’t strong to begin with, so if he continued to swallow it.., there might be an impact.
Therefore, after Wang Baole tried his best to restrain himself, he grew more and more agitated. He couldn’t help but look at little five and the donkey. His entire body was emitting terrifying ripples, as well as a gaze that made people shudder, it made little five, the donkey, and the little black fish feel a little afraid.
After a long while, Wang Baole managed to control himself. He raised his head abruptly and looked into the depths of the gray starry sky. He knew very well that there was nowhere else around him that could allow him to absorb a sufficient amount of black hair. As for the small whirlpool.., it was too slow.
A glint flashed in his eyes, and he shouted in a low voice.
“Follow me to the depths!”As he spoke, Wang Baole’s body swayed, and he took a step forward. With a loud boom, his powerful physical body caused the void to distort. With a single step, he stepped out of the space, he appeared in the Gray starry sky and headed deep into it with a loud boom!
Xiaowu, the donkey, and the little black fish hesitated for a moment before following him quickly. Just like that, the four of them moved at high speed, and before long... they had arrived at the center of the Gray Starry Sky!
As soon as they entered, Wang Baole immediately saw... an earth-shattering, boundless, and gigantic bronze oven in front of him!
There were flames burning within the oven, causing the surrounding heat waves to surge. There wasn’t one oven in this area, but... nine!
Eight were circling around the outside, and one was inside!
The eight outside were filled with flames, but the one inside... was filled with black mist!
The moment Wang Baole stepped into the area, the cultivators from the ten thousand sect clans who had entered the area before Wang Baole surrounded the eight stoves outside. There were more than a hundred of them. Some of them were comprehending something, while others were fighting for it, however, no matter what they were doing, they instantly turned to look at Wang Baole.
There were no weaklings who could enter the area. That was why they were very concerned about the newcomers!
Similarly, it was also because there were no weaklings in this place. As they looked at Wang Baole, Wang Baole could sense that there were more than a hundred people in this place. They could all be considered top-notch prodigies from the various sects and clans!

chapters.title: Chapter 1144
chapters.content:
Chapter 1144: was gaining momentum!
Translator:
549690339
The eyes of both parties immediately met!
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He scanned the area and saw the eight ovens outside. Four of them were occupied by cultivators. He couldn’t see who was occupying them. He could only see the area around the four ovens, there were more than ten cultivators who were at the perfected stellar realm each. They seemed to be guarding the ovens.
Two of them were from the Wei Yang clan. The other two weren’t from the Wei Yang clan, but their auras weren’t weak at all.
The dozen or so cultivators on one side formed a grand array formation, forming a giant silver dragon that hovered above the furnace with its eyes closed. Its aura was astonishing.
The other one transformed into five ancient swords. The power of the five elements spread out, enveloping the entire area. It was equally shocking.
Other than the four of them, the other four furnaces were in a state of chaos. It was obvious that they were engaged in a battle before Wang Baole arrived. However, as they were in a state of balance and were not weaklings, there was no result for the time being.
Wang Baole’s arrival caused the cultivators who were engaged in a battle to look over. However, in the next moment, they averted their gazes and ignored Wang Baole. They were engaged in a battle, so they didn’t look closely. Instead, they scanned Wang Baole with their divine senses, they realized that Wang Baole was only at the mid-stage of the star realm, so they didn’t pay too much attention to him.
Even though they realized that Wang Baole’s physical body was at the late-stage of the star realm, which of the elites from the various sects and clans wasn’t talented? Their cultivation wasn’t ordinary, and their physical bodies weren’t ordinary either.
Therefore, a mid-stage cultivator at the late-stage of the physical body realm wasn’t worthy of their attention. However, it was clear that their cultivation and knowledge weren’t enough to let them know that the intruder before them was at the mid-stage of the star realm, the number of stars in his body was already shocking. Although his physical body was in the late stage of the star realm, it was still the power of over 10,000 special stars under the star Dot Technique!
However, there were still some people who could vaguely see the clues. At this moment, two of the four furnaces with master seats sent out divine thoughts to inform their protectors.
“There’s something wrong with this person!”
“Don’t provoke him. I believe that this person isn’t stupid and won’t take the initiative to provoke us!”
Other than the people occupying the host seats in the two furnaces, who could vaguely sense it, the rest didn’t realize how terrifying Wang Baole was. Therefore, they quickly averted their gazes and continued their battle, in an instant, booming sounds spread in all directions once again.
......
Seeing this, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. When he had arrived, he had already learned many details about the ovens from Xie Haiyang. Looking at their positions, especially when he sensed that within the central ovens surrounded by the eight ovens.., he sensed the presence of his senior brother, and he immediately understood.
The eight ovens outside were clearly the best place to gain enlightenment. Once the Moon splitting divine emperor died, the cultivators who occupied the main seat in the eight ovens would definitely gain the most from the connection between the ovens!
Similarly, if they were unable to occupy the main seat of one of the ovens, they would still gain something at the edge of the ovens. However, in comparison, the difference was not small.
There were more than a hundred cultivators in the area, and each of them were chosen from the various sects and clans, second only to the first echelon. In fact, each of them had a very high chance of making it into the first echelon. Therefore, this good fortune was very important to them, if it weren’t for the more important compensation, none of them would have been willing to give up this opportunity.
As for the four ovens that had been completely occupied, it was clear that there were already cultivators in the main position. Furthermore, the four ovens that were protected by the dharma protectors were obviously the former. The people who occupied the main position had to have a status and a cultivation base that allowed them to suppress their fellow clan members, they must have paid a huge price to obtain this opportunity.
As for the other four furnaces, it was obvious that no one could do that. That was why they were in such chaos.
However, in Wang Baole’s eyes, that was not the case. What he wanted now was not to wait for the Moon splitting divine emperor to die so that he could obtain good fortune. What he wanted... was the shattering of the laws!
Only by absorbing enough shattering of the laws could it form a suction force that would attract even more of the aura of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao. At that moment, he could see the shocking shattering of the laws within the eight stoves.
Looks like I came a little too late... Wang Baole’s eyes were bloodshot. He was just a step away from attaining the perfected physical body of a star. He was already anxious. When he saw the chaos, a murderous glint flashed in his eyes, he swept his gaze across the area and locked onto a kiln that was being fought over by more than a dozen cultivators. With a flash of his body, he charged forward.
He was so fast that he was like a shooting star that approached with a loud bang.
However, his appearance had already attracted the attention of everyone in the area. As soon as he charged forward, the cultivators who had been fighting over the kiln immediately noticed him, one of the middle-aged cultivators, who was at the perfected stellar realm, was knocked back by his opponent. He was filled with rage. As he saw Wang Baole charging towards him, his eyes lit up, he raised his right hand and made a grabbing motion.
“You’re courting death. I can use your qi and blood to strengthen my soul!”The middle-aged man waved his hand. The perfected stellar realm’s cultivation exploded, forming a gigantic star that merged with him. With a wave of his hand, he made a grabbing motion, he seemed to possess an infinite amount of suppressive power as he grabbed at Wang Baole.
In the blink of an eye, a giant palm appeared in front of Wang Baole. It was about to grab him, but Wang Baole smiled coldly. He didn’t Dodge at all. Instead, he sped up once more, he slammed his head into the palm.
A loud boom shook the sky. The palm, which looked extremely powerful and powerful, actually grabbed Wang baole the moment it made contact with his body. It was as if it couldn’t take it anymore and exploded instantly.
A blood-curdling scream was heard from the middle-aged cultivator’s mouth at that moment. The palm was torn into pieces. His expression changed instantly, and shock appeared in his eyes. He was about to retreat, but it was too late. Wang Baole was too fast.., after shattering the giant palm, he appeared directly in front of the middle-aged cultivator. He didn’t even look at him as he struck out with his palm.
Boom!
As the palm descended, a star was destroyed!
The previously arrogant middle-aged cultivator couldn’t even let out a scream. His fleshly body collapsed, his soul collapsed, and his body and soul were destroyed!
This scene instantly caused the hearts of the surrounding chosen of the myriad sects and clans to tremble, and huge waves of shock rose up in their hearts!
“What’s going on! ?”
“A single slap... to kill a perfected stellar realm cultivator?”
“What kind of physical body is that!”
Even the four warlords, who had their own seats and were surrounded by dharma protectors, were exuding an aura of shock. It was as if four pairs of eyes had locked onto Wang Baole.
At the same time, some of the cultivators from the left Dao sacred zone recognized Wang Baole’s identity and exclaimed involuntarily.
“You Are... Wang Baole!”
“The owner of the Dao Planet, Wang Baole, the one who suppressed Chong Lizi!”
Wang Baole ignored the uproar. His eyes were bloodshot, and all he could see was the kiln. He charged toward the target, the kiln, without slowing down.
Wang Baole approached with a terrifying and ferocious aura. Around the kiln, the expressions of the dozen cultivators who had been fighting over it changed rapidly. They wanted to retreat, but they were unwilling to do so, soon, one of the youths from the side sect, the Saint Domain, had a vicious look in his eyes as he let out a low growl.
“It will be more difficult to fight over the other baking furnaces. Why don’t we all fight together and suppress this person!”
If it had been a weakling, it might not have been the case. However, everyone was a prodigy at the moment, and their eyes were filled with the desire to fight. This was because this was indeed the case. The competition for the other baking furnaces was already intense. If they were to join in.., it was too difficult to fight for the main seat. After all, there were too many people, and there were too few seats.
Instead of that, it would be better to attack together and suppress them!
In that instant, out of the dozen or so people, apart from three who chose to leave after their expressions changed, the rest rushed out and turned into streaks of light. They attacked Wang Baole, who was approaching him.
In that instant, the aura of the perfected stellar realm rose into the sky, filling the surroundings. There were divine abilities, the glow of Dharmic treasures, and the radiance of laws. They gathered together and formed a huge wave that attacked Wang Baole!
None of these people were weaker than Chong Yizi. There were even a few who were slightly stronger than Chong Yizi. Therefore, when they joined forces, their aura was shocking!
However... it was still not enough!

chapters.title: Chapter 1145
chapters.content:
Chapter 1145:, uncle, help me!
Translator:
549690339
It’s indeed not enough!
Cultivators’cultivation was divided into three paths: The Soul, the realm, and the physical body. They might seem different, but they affected each other. Often, one path would be improved, and the other two paths would be nourished.
However, very few people were able to do so. These three paths improved at the same time, and those who were able to do so could be said to be able to suppress and dominate the world.
This was the path that Wang Baole had chosen. His soul had already reached the late-stage of the star realm, and his physical body was at the peak of the late-stage. He was only a hair’s breadth away from the perfected stage. His cultivation was slightly weaker, but he was still at the mid-stage of the star realm.
As a result, his true combat strength had long surpassed the level he had reached during the battle with Chong Yizi. It had even surpassed the level he had reached not just by a tiny bit, but by more than ten times, or even dozens of times!
That was why he had been able to destroy a cultivator who was at the perfected stellar realm with a single push. That was why... Even though there were more than a dozen elites working together, these people, even in their respective sects and clans.., they could be considered elites, but in front of Wang Baole, they... could not do it!
Amidst the booming sounds, Wang Baole’s body did not stop. In an instant, he collided with the more than a dozen cultivators who were working together. Almost at the moment of collision, the Nightmare Eye incantation behind Wang Baole’s back suddenly materialized, and his gaze froze the souls of the more than a dozen cultivators, it immediately caused the souls of the dozen or so cultivators to tremble.
Then, tens of thousands of stars materialized, and the Divine Bull’s shadow roared. It charged forward abruptly. It was as if the earth had been shattered, as if the mountains had collapsed and the earth had cracked. It was as if the heavens had reversed, and the dozen or so cultivators coughed up blood, their supernatural powers collapsed, their spells shattered, their dharmic treasures flew backward, and their bodies were like kites with their strings cut. As they spat out mouthfuls of blood, they were knocked away by the Divine Bull.
The sound was deafening, and it shook the entire area. It also caused the rest of the cultivators in the area to widen their eyes, and their hearts were in turmoil!
However, before they could react, Wang Baole had already taken a step forward and appeared in front of a cultivator who had retreated in an instant. She was a woman, and her appearance was acceptable. Her eyes were filled with shock, and there was an intense fear in them, she was just about to speak.
“You...”
Before she could finish her sentence, Wang Baole had already thrown a punch coldly, shattering the woman into pieces. Then, with a flash, he appeared beside another cultivator and kicked him!
The physical strength of a cultivator at the peak of the late-stage star realm was not enough to achieve this. However, Wang Baole had too many stars and had a little star magic. This allowed his physical body to surpass cultivators of the same realm by far.
......
As his foot landed, a shrill scream rang out. The body of the person who had been kicked by Wang Baole exploded, and his soul retreated. It was hard for him to escape, and he continued to explode!
It wasn’t over yet. A cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes. His body swayed once again, and he instantly turned into three afterimages. He caught up to the three cultivators from the Wan Zong clan, whose combat strength surpassed Chong Lizi. As soon as they appeared, he threw a punch!
He didn’t need any divine abilities, spells, or dharma treasures. To Wang Baole, his strongest asset was his physical body. Therefore, he threw three punches in a row, and they were earth-shattering!
A loud boom rang out. The three of them spat out blood. Their physical bodies couldn’t take it and exploded instantly. However, as their flesh and blood shattered, their souls rushed out rapidly. There were strange objects outside their souls.
It was a black wooden statue, a blood-colored knife, and a scale.
The aura of the galaxy emanated from the three strange objects. They were the three men’s protective treasures. They weren’t in the top tier of their respective clans and sects, but they were extremely close. That was why they had been given a supreme treasure, it was used to protect their souls.
Their physical bodies had been destroyed, and the appearance of the Strange Treasure had neutralized Wang Baole’s killing power. The souls of the three men retreated rapidly amidst the shock and fear, avoiding the calamity of death.
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and snorted coldly. His focus was on absorbing the shattered rules in the oven, and he was too lazy to chase after them. As for the others, they had retreated far away. Wang Baole didn’t pay them any heed. In a flash, he charged straight for the oven.
This time... none of the cultivators from the myriad sect clan dared to stop him.
From the moment Wang Baole had flown out until now, everything had happened in a few moments... it had happened too quickly!
Wang Baole’s attack had forced everyone to retreat. He had killed two people, forcing the three prodigies, who were infinitely close to the first tier, to use the items in the galaxy to save their lives.
