The rest felt their scalps go numb as they retreated rapidly, they saw Wang Baole flying towards the oven, but they were still terrified and worried that something might happen. Someone spoke up.
“I withdraw from the battle for the oven!”
“Withdraw!”
“Fellow Daoist Wang, don’t misunderstand. I withdraw from the battle for the oven as well!”
As soon as the words were spoken, the others who had retreated spoke up one after another. They were afraid that it would cause a misunderstanding. Wang baole gave them the impression that he was too powerful. He wasn’t any weaker than some of the new starfields, especially when it came to his ferocity, it was even more shocking to them.
To fight with such a ferocious person would definitely be courting death. As the retreating cultivators dispersed, they didn’t want to leave, so they joined in the fight for the other ovens.
The fight for the other ovens became even more intense. Wang Baole didn’t care about any of this. He had already stepped onto the target ovens. There wasn’t a single person inside or outside the ovens other than him, even though a large number of people were observing the situation, no one dared to get close.
There were even more people inside. While they were fearful, they couldn’t help but look envious. It was obvious that Wang Baole’s appearance was extremely domineering, overwhelming, and imposing.
This kind of life was what the elites yearned for. That was why when they couldn’t do it and saw someone else do it with their own eyes, they were naturally envious.
However, whether it was fear or envy, it had nothing to do with Wang Baole at the moment. What he wanted the most now was for his physical body to break through the peak of the late-stage of the star realm and step into... The Perfected Star Realm!
Therefore, very quickly, Wang Baole stepped into the oven. Before he could sit down cross-legged, he could feel the thick, broken rules in the oven. The intrinsic scabbard in his body buzzed once again, revealing his desire.
It’s indeed suitable! Wang Baole’s eyes were filled with joy. He was about to sit down cross-legged and absorb the energy when, all of a sudden, a violent fluctuation was emitted from the oven in the distance, which was controlled by the Weiyang clan.
The fluctuation erupted instantly and spread out of the oven, causing the Weiyang clan dharma protectors around the oven to unleash their cultivation and suppress it together. At the same time, a hurried voice came from within the oven.
“Uncle, help me!”
The voice spread in all directions. When it reached Wang Baole’s ears, he found it familiar. He raised his head and scanned the area. Immediately, he saw a familiar figure of a little girl in the oven occupied by the Weiyang clan, she flashed and appeared, as if she wanted to escape from the oven. However, she was suppressed by an illusory hand that appeared above her head and forced back into the oven.
“Fellow Daoist Wang, you and I won’t interfere.”At the same time, after pressing down the little girl’s figure, an illusory figure converged above the oven.
The figure appeared to be a young man, dressed in a golden robe, with a handsome face and stars in his eyes. Although he was at the stellar perfection stage like the others, the aura emanating from him, it was obvious that he was much stronger than the others.
That was because he was a member of the royal family of the Weiyang clan. That was because his star wasn’t earth-grade. It was... a heaven-grade star that only the Weiyang clan could control!
Even Wang Baole felt a tingling pain in his eyes the moment he saw the figure. However, in the next moment, his eyes lit up and he frowned slightly.
That was because... he recognized the figure that had disappeared in a flash. It was the little girl from the dark sect who had been in the fallen star lands that year!
Senior Brother is here. Why didn’t you make a move? Wang Baole hesitated for a moment. He was also curious that the other party had called him uncle... then, he rose from the oven and looked at the young man from the Wei Yang Royal Family who was standing on the oven in the distance.
“Let her leave.”
The young man from the Wei Yang Royal Family fell silent. The dharma protectors around him all frowned and looked at Wang Baole with hostility. Wang Baole might have been terrifying previously, but deep in their hearts, their prince.., could do all of that.
“Are you really going to make an enemy out of me?”After a few breaths of silence, Prince Wei Yang narrowed his eyes and looked at Wang Baole as he spoke slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1146
chapters.content:
Chapter 1146:, the battle Prince!
Translator:
549690339
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes as he stared at Prince Weiyang. He now had a better understanding of the Weiyang clan. He knew that the so-called royal family was actually the descendant of the deity Emperor within the Weiyang clan.
Wang Baole didn’t know how many deity emperors there were in the current Weiyang clan. However, no matter what, the fact that they were sent here and that they had so many guardians meant that the status of the prince in his bloodline was definitely not low, even if he wasn’t the highest among his descendants, however, he was definitely not low.
It could be a descendant of the moon splitter divine emperor, a descendant of the mystic flower divine emperor, or a descendant of the divine emperor who didn’t come? Wang baole frowned slightly, he felt a threat from Prince Weiyang.
It could even be said that if he hadn’t entered the gray space and obtained the good fortune he had before, he wouldn’t have been a match for this person if he had fought him.
After all, that was a heaven pole star, far beyond the Earth grade. Even though it wasn’t as powerful as his Dao Heng, this person’s cultivation was already at the perfected stellar realm. With his status, he would definitely be able to obtain even more resources, he was probably not far from the celestial domain grade now.
Wang Baole was well aware of such a character. It would be difficult to kill him, and it would be easy for him to get entangled. He would definitely have many life-saving methods.
Perhaps the purpose of coming here is to obtain good fortune here, so that I can leap into the galaxy? All sorts of thoughts flashed through Wang Baole’s mind. He suddenly laughed, and his eyes shone brightly.
A bright light flashed, and in that instant, it turned into a battle intent.
“To be your enemy?”The moment Wang Baole opened his mouth, he charged forward. He was so fast that he was instantly close to the furnace where Prince Weiyang was!
There was no need to think about making an enemy out of him. Wang Baole was the dark child. His senior brother was fighting against the deity Emperor. That meant that he had to fight against the Weiyang clan. His master, the blazing flame ancestor, was an irreconcilable enemy of the Weiyang clan as well, therefore, no matter what, the enemy... was already destined.
Since that was the case, Wang Baole didn’t need to hesitate. Furthermore, his senior brother was in the central furnace. How could he be afraid? As for the little girl from the Dark Sect, Wang Baole didn’t think that he was wrong. She was a member of the dark sect.
As for why his senior brother hadn’t made a move, Wang Baole didn’t want to think about it anymore. So what if he had saved the wrong person.
In the next instant, Wang Baole shattered the void and created a deafening boom. As soon as he appeared, he clenched his right fist and punched down.
......
Amidst the loud boom, it was as if the starry sky was shaking. The dharma protectors around Prince Weiyang’s baking furnace erupted with their auras. They rushed out and attacked together, wanting to suppress Wang Baole together.
In an instant, the two parties collided. The instant they collided... Prince Weiyang, who was standing on the oven, suddenly raised his right hand. A cloud of black gas appeared in his hand, the black gas turned into five black bamboo sticks!
One of the bamboo sticks was broken by Prince Weiyang the moment it appeared!
The moment it was broken, the air around where Wang Baole had appeared distorted. At least ten thousand bamboo sticks materialized in an instant and shot towards him.
Wang Baole’s pupils constricted. His physical strength erupted, and he threw another punch!
At that moment, Prince Weiyang’s eyes were cold as he said calmly, “Destroy!”.
“Destroy!”
As soon as Prince Weiyang spoke, the ten thousand bamboo sticks exploded before they could get close to Wang Baole. They formed a whirlwind-like storm that engulfed Wang Baole in an instant. At the same time, the surrounding dao protectors who had attacked.., all of their cultivation erupted at the same time, and they attacked him together.
A loud boom rose into the sky. The dao protectors who had attacked trembled violently, and their expressions changed. Their bodies were involuntarily struck by a powerful force, and they scattered in all directions. Within the storm of tens of thousands of bamboo sticks.., wang Baole looked slightly disheveled at the moment, but he still charged forward with his powerful physical body. His eyes were filled with killing intent as he locked onto Prince Weiyang in the distance. In a flash, he seemed to ignore the surrounding dao protectors and was about to kill the prince.
Prince Weiyang’s gaze remained the same. Just as Wang Baole was about to charge forward, he broke another black bamboo stick. In that instant... Wang Baole had no choice but to stop. The air around him rippled, and one bamboo stick after another appeared, the number of bamboo sticks... exceeded the previous number, reaching around fifty thousand.
The moment they appeared, the bamboo sticks exploded once again, forming a storm that was even more shocking than before. The dharma protectors around him charged forward again, unleashing their divine abilities, spells, and Dharmic treasures.
The sound shook the surroundings, causing the expressions of the people around them to change. While they were shocked by Prince Weiyang’s strength, Wang Baole’s roar was also heard from within the storm, in the next moment... blood trickled out of the corners of the mouths of the dharma protectors, and they retreated once again. Wang baole, who had been suppressed by them, was like an ancient ferocious beast. Even though he was in an even more pathetic state.., however, his savagery intensified once more, and he continued to charge forward.
“Foolish!”
Prince Weiyang spoke calmly, and he heaved a sigh of relief. In his mind, if he had been too stubborn and fierce, such a powerful person wouldn’t have been terrifying. He could have easily broken him.
The person in front of him, judging from his behavior after entering this place, was very domineering. His domineering attitude was indeed in line with his current judgment. He had killed several such people in his life.
The moment he opened his mouth and Wang Baole charged at him once again as if he had gone mad, Prince Weiyang laughed softly and broke the three black bamboo sticks in front of him in one go!
The moment he broke them, more than a hundred thousand bamboo sticks appeared around Wang Baole. In the blink of an eye, the hundred thousand bamboo sticks exploded!
A loud boom filled the air. A storm that was much stronger than before erupted around Wang Baole in an instant. The dozen or so dharma protectors around him laughed sinisterly as they unleashed their cultivation and revealed Weiyang’s true form, their aura was at least twice as strong as before!
It was clear that they hadn’t gone all out previously. They had been hiding their strength. Now that they had unleashed their power, they were like a dozen ferocious gods that charged at the storm around Wang Baole with all their might!
At that moment, Prince Weiyang’s body swayed. He stepped out of the oven. He raised his right hand, and a giant stone seal formed in front of him. It gathered rapidly and pressed down on Wang baole, who was surrounded by the storm and everyone else!
“Fool!”As he suppressed the storm, a look of contempt appeared in Prince Weiyang’s eyes. However... just as he was about to attack, and when all the dharma protectors around him erupted and the storm roared, a calm voice rang out, suddenly, a faint voice rang out from within the storm.
“You’ve finally come out, Paper Rule!”The moment they made their move, Wang Baole, who everyone thought was in the midst of a frenzy within the storm, had a calm expression on his face. A strange glint appeared in his eyes. He raised his right hand and made a grabbing motion, immediately, the Dao Heng Star behind him appeared.
The paper rule exploded with a loud bang.
It was the law of Dao Stars. It was the augmentation of the nine quasi-dao stars. It was the pull of tens of thousands of unique stars. All of this made the law of paper-based law reach its peak at this moment!
With a loud boom, a ripple that was hard to detect even with one’s divine sense spread out instantly with Wang Baole as the center. Wherever it passed, everything was made of paper!
The storm turned into pieces of paper!
The surrounding guardian cultivators trembled violently. Shock appeared on their faces, and their bodies turned into paper figures!
It was the same for the stone seal. Prince Weiyang, who was walking towards them, trembled violently. His expression changed drastically. It was too late for him to retreat. Ripples swept across his body in an instant!
His body, visible to the naked eye... was rapidly turning into paper!
“Who’s a Fool?”The starry sky seemed to have turned white. Wang Baole walked out from within the countless pieces of paper. There wasn’t a hint of anger, nor was there a hint of violence. Instead, he spoke calmly towards Prince Weiyang, who was half-turned into paper, he spoke softly.
As he spoke, he raised his right hand, and flames... spread towards all the pieces of paper around him!

chapters.title: Chapter 1147 - felt his scalp go numb!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1147: felt his scalp go numb!
Translator:
549690339
“Who’s the Fool...”Prince Weiyang’s eyes narrowed. He didn’t have the time to respond. He didn’t even have the time to show his emotions. Just as the flames erupted from Wang Baole’s body and spread out in all directions.., prince Weiyang let out an intense roar.
As he roared, his star materialized and Weiyang’s true body materialized. However, he was still unable to stop himself from turning into paper. He could only delay the process slightly. Half of his body had been turned into paper. That was a head and three arms!
However, he was also a ruthless person. At the critical moment, the other two heads bit the tip of their tongues and spat out two mouthfuls of fresh blood. The fresh blood quickly gathered on top of his head and formed a blood-colored dagger. It wasn’t aimed at Wang Baole, but at himself!
In the next instant, a blood-colored glow shook the heavens. The blood-colored dagger landed directly on Prince Weiyang’s body. As it slashed past, it cut off all of his body that had been turned into paper!
A head and three arms were instantly separated from his body!
As fresh blood spurted out, Prince Weiyang let out a shrill cry. However, as the paper-like part of his body was cut off, he instantly felt relieved. He fell back abruptly. As he fell back, he quickly took out a large number of pills and swallowed them, his real body withered rapidly. At the cost of one arm and a head, half of his body grew flesh and blood, and he managed to barely recover.
However, his face was extremely pale, and his breathing was much weaker. In the end, he managed to survive. As for the others... They didn’t have Prince Weiyang’s methods and decisiveness. Furthermore, Wang Baole’s flames were released too quickly, as Prince Weiyang and the people around him watched, the flames spread, turning into a storm of shredded paper and burning.
Then, the dozen or so guardians of the Weiyang clan scattered. The moment their bodies turned into paper figures, the flames pounced on them, enveloping their bodies. In an instant... they were completely burned and turned into ashes!
None of the dozen or so guardians managed to escape. They were destroyed in body and soul!
“Wang Baole!”Prince Weiyang was no longer as calm as he had been before. His hair was disheveled, and he looked extremely disheveled. This time, it had been a huge blow to him.
All the Dharma Protectors had died, and he had almost fallen here. At the same time, the trauma in his heart was even greater. He had thought that he was scheming against someone, but he had never expected that he was the one who had been schemed against.
What arrogance? What recklessness? They were all fakes!
From the beginning to the end, the darn fellow before him had been deliberately mystifying and putting on a tough front. His goal was to bait him.
......
That way, the other party wouldn’t have to expend too much energy and would crush him directly. Otherwise, even if they were evenly matched, once they were entangled, there would be other chain reactions.
In the blink of an eye, Prince Weiyang understood everything. The more he understood, the more sullen he felt, and the more he was driven mad.
He had suffered too great a loss. Not only was the Dharma Protector gone, but he was also severely injured. His aura had also weakened significantly. Even his cultivation had dropped due to the severe injuries. He was no longer at the perfected star realm, but at the late-stage star realm.
All of this had been due to a misjudgment!
He wasn’t the only one who was going crazy. All the cultivators who had witnessed the scene felt waves of shock in their hearts. They were shocked. Wang Baole’s attack had been too ruthless!
His attack during the battle for the kiln had been domineering, but it hadn’t been ruthless. Only his battle with Prince Weiyang had been considered ruthless. Such a character had caused everyone to suck in a breath of cold air. At the same time, they had become even more fearful of Wang Baole, they became even more fearful of him.
“His cultivation is strong, and he is scheming...”
“He may seem overbearing, but he is cold and ruthless...”
“Such a monster has appeared in the left Dao Holy Region!”
It was not only the people who were fighting for the kiln who were shocked. At that moment, the three factions in the other three furnaces with host seats were also shocked as if they were facing a great enemy.
The force with the silver dragon’s projection stared at Wang Baole. A tall and slender woman’s figure appeared faintly in the oven beneath her. She looked at Wang Baole.
There was also the ovens that revolved with the power of the five elements and transformed into five ancient swords. It was the same inside. A young man could be seen sitting cross-legged and meditating inside. He opened his eyes at that moment.
Finally, there was another oven occupied by the Wei Yang clan. There was also a young man in it. Judging from his temperament and aura, he seemed to be a prince as well. However, he didn’t seem to be the same divine emperor as the one who had been severely injured by Wang Baole.
Wang Baole didn’t pay too much attention to the attention of everyone around him. His eyes swept across the pale-faced Prince Wei Yang, whose eyes were filled with hatred as he gritted his teeth and called out his name. He spoke calmly.
“My name is not something that you can call out at will!”As he spoke, Wang Baole’s body swayed and disappeared in an instant. Prince Weiyang’s expression changed again. He retreated quickly without hesitation, his target was the other Prince Weiyang.
However, his speed was still not as fast as Wang Baole’s. Before he could get too far, the air around him distorted. Wang Baole took a step forward and punched out with his right hand!
“You Want to kill me?”Wang Baole’s voice was calm. He threw a punch with all his might, and with a loud boom, cracks appeared on Prince Weiyang’s body. Blood splattered everywhere. Before Prince Weiyang could scream in pain.., wang Baole caught up with him in a flash and threw another punch!
“You still dare call me stupid?”This punch, combined with his speed, was even stronger than before. With a loud boom, Prince Weiyang was sent flying. There were even more cracks on his body, and even all the bones in his body were cracked, it was as if his entire body was about to fall apart.
“You still dare to call my name?”Killing intent flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes. He took a step forward and chased after him. He lifted his right foot and was about to land on the Prince of the Weiyang clan.
However, at that moment, a cold voice came from the oven of another Prince Weiyang.
“Fellow Daoist, injuries are fine, but there’s no need to kill me.”
Wang Baole didn’t even look at him, pretending that he hadn’t heard anything. The person who had spoken only spoke and didn’t stop him. Clearly... as a member of the same race, it was his duty to speak, but it wasn’t his duty to act.
This was something that couldn’t be hidden from Wang Baole. Otherwise, the other party would have attacked him earlier. In reality, this was one of the reasons why Wang Baole had acted so brainless and violent in the first place.
That was why he continued to land his foot on the prince. With a loud boom, the heavily injured prince, whose flesh, blood, and bones were all shattered, collapsed with a loud crash. He was torn into pieces, and it was unknown what his soul had done, the moment his physical body collapsed, a violent force was released, causing Wang Baole’s body to be pushed back a thousand feet.
The Prince’s soul let out a shrill cry. It was swept up by a cloud of black gas and fled into the distance. In the next moment, it charged out of the center of the Gray Starry Sky and escaped.
“Wang Baole!”A roar was heard, the Prince’s soul didn’t notice that a black fish, a donkey, and a shifty-eyed youth were approaching him from where he was heading. They all had malicious intentions in their eyes.
He wasn’t the only one who didn’t notice. Other than Wang Baole, none of the other stars had noticed this. They were all stunned by Wang Baole’s attack.
Wang Baole didn’t bother with the one who had escaped. He moved and appeared above the Dark Sect’s little girl’s oven. He lowered his head to take a look. He raised his right hand and waved it, immediately releasing the seal, the little girl who had been trapped inside leaped up. Her face was filled with excitement, and her eyes were filled with adoration as she cheered.
“Uncle is so powerful!”
“I’m not your uncle!”Wang Baole glanced at the little girl. He could sense the dark sect’s aura from her, but he was still on guard. He even started calling out to his senior brother in his heart.
“Senior brother, who is this brat?”
“What child?”Soon, Chen Qingzi’s surprised voice was heard in Wang Baole’s mind.
“AH? This little girl from the dark sect before me.”Wang Baole was stunned.
“Before your eyes? There’s nothing there...”Wang Baole’s pupils constricted when he heard that. When he looked at the little girl again, she was... gone!
Wang Baole’s heart jolted. He looked around and realized that no one around him seemed surprised at all. It was as if... they hadn’t seen the little girl from the beginning to the end, it was as if everything that had happened was an illusion!

chapters.title: Chapter 1148
chapters.content:
Chapter 1148: The Strange Little Girl!
Translator:
549690339
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. Everything was too strange. He felt his scalp tingle at that moment. He stood where he was and looked around. No matter how hard he tried to spread out his divine sense, he couldn’t see the little girl at all, after a moment of silence, Wang Baole didn’t send a voice transmission to his senior brother, Chen Qingzi. Instead, he called out to Little Missy in his heart.
The strange thing was that Little Missy didn’t respond either. If it had been any other time, Wang Baole wouldn’t have felt anything. However, today, he had an indescribable feeling.
It was a good thing that Xiaowu, the donkey, and the little black fish had returned after surrounding Prince Weiyang, who was only left with his soul. Although they weren’t close to the oven, Wang Baole had already sensed them.
“Xiaowu, Donkey, come!”Wang Baole immediately spoke after sensing them. Soon, under the watchful eyes of the surrounding people, Xiaowu and the donkey flew to Wang Baole’s side.
The little black fish did the same. It circled around Wang Baole, but no one could see it. Wang baole ignored the little black fish and immediately sent a voice transmission to Xiaowu and the donkey.
“Tell me everything that happened after I entered the oven area!”
Little Five was surprised, and the donkey glanced at Wang baole curiously.
“Tell me quickly!”Wang baole frowned. He felt an inexplicable sense of frustration. Seeing that, little five hurriedly spoke.
“When you arrived just now, there was an ignorant fellow who tried to stop you. He was killed by you with a single slap, and then he tried to snatch the oven. He was surrounded and attacked by more than a dozen people who didn’t know what was good for him. However, they didn’t know that their father was extraordinary. Many of them were easily killed by their father. When they were shocked, they scattered. When their father took over the oven, no one dared to provoke him. He was invincible!”
“Son!”The donkey nodded quickly, indicating that Xiaowu was right.
“And then?”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and sent a voice transmission.
“And then? That Prince Weiyang who was captured by us. That guy didn’t know what was good for him. He actually provoked daddy. In a fit of rage, Daddy went up and suppressed him again.”Xiaowu looked at Wang baole strangely.
......
“How did he provoke me?”Wang Baole asked again.
“Huh? He just walked out of the oven where he was and scolded Daddy.”Little Five’s expression was even stranger. Wang Baole’s questions had made him feel that something was amiss.
Wang Baole also felt that something was amiss. After a moment of silence, he suddenly spoke.
“Because of that little girl?”
“What little girl?”Little Five was stunned. The donkey was stunned as well. This caused Wang Baole’s mind to be shaken. Little Five might lie, but the donkey wouldn’t. Its mind was connected to Wang Baole’s, wang Baole could clearly sense the other’s thoughts.
Everything was as Xiaowu had said.
Then... Wang Baole already had an answer in his heart as to what the truth was. Perhaps in that instant just now, everyone had been hallucinating, or perhaps... it was just his own hallucination.
No matter what, no one had seen the little girl. Not even his omnipotent senior brother, Chen Qingzi, had seen the little girl in Wang Baole’s heart, then, this matter... was too terrifying when one thought about it.
A strong sense of danger made Wang Baole wary, but at the same time, it also made him more anxious about improving his cultivation. Therefore, after a few seconds of silence, Wang Baole leaped up, the oven that he had occupied the first time exploded together with the oven below.
Instantly, the broken rules within surged toward Wang Baole like a torrent. They fused into his body and were absorbed by his intrinsic sword scabbard like a whale.
Soon, a vortex appeared around Wang Baole. The vortex grew larger and larger. It even affected the other seven ovens, causing the expressions of the cultivators around the seven ovens to change.
At that moment, a laughter that sounded like a silver bell suddenly reverberated in Wang Baole’s ears. It reverberated in the surrounding starry skies. When Wang Baole heard the laughter, he opened his eyes abruptly.
He didn’t see the owner of the laughter, but he saw the cultivators in the area. Regardless of whether it was the cultivators who had fought over the stoves or the three who already had a master, all of them... at that moment, their eyes began to distort, it was as if a strange force had silently affected all the cultivators in the area.
Even little five and the donkey did the same. For a split second, a black glow appeared in their eyes. Only the little black fish continued to swim around without any reaction.
Seeing the changes in the cultivators, Wang Baole was shocked. He immediately waved his hand and put little five and the donkey into his storage bag. Then, he called out to his senior brother.
However... his call seemed to be blocked and didn’t come out.
“Uncle, don’t be so vigilant. I Won’t Harm You...”
“It’s just that... There are too few people who have died here. It Won’t be fun anymore.”The little girl’s voice was faint. As Wang Baole’s thoughts reverberated in his mind, the elites from the myriad sect clan around him.., the blood vessels in their eyes shot up. They all looked at Wang Baole and roared. It was as if they had met an irreconcilable enemy. They charged at Wang Baole from all directions.
The strongest ones were three!
One was the woman from where the silver dragon projection was located, one was the youth who had charged out from the five elements ancient sword, and the last was the remaining Prince Weiyang.
The three cultivators were all at the perfected stage, and Prince Weiyang was at the heaven-grade star level. The other two weren’t, but the stars were special. They didn’t seem to be any lower than the heavens.
The moment they made their move, the sky shook and the earth shook. The starry skies rumbled. The remaining cultivators erupted with their cultivation. They seemed to have gone mad as they roared and charged forward.
“What’s Going On!”Everything had happened too suddenly. It could be said that everything had changed after the little girl had appeared. Even though Wang Baole himself was powerful, he was still shaken, he wasn’t strong enough to suppress the dozens of stars in the area by himself.
After all, most of the stars in the area were at the perfected star realm, and there were three of them. They far surpassed the true elites of the same realm. Therefore, in the next moment, Wang Baole retreated abruptly.
The instant he retreated, the five elements ancient sword had pierced through the spot where he had been. The illusory silver dragon roared and slashed down with its claws. A large number of divine abilities and spells flooded the area.
“Who exactly are you?”After Wang Baole dodged, he moved closer to the core oven and roared loudly. His voice was like thunder, spreading in all directions and covering the core oven.
However... he clearly felt that he was his senior brother inside, but he didn’t react at all.
This scene made Wang Baole’s heart sink once again.
“Uncle, no one can detect you here. Don’t worry and kill as much as you can. Too few people have died, and it’s not fun. Come on, Uncle.”
“As for who I am... Uncle, what do you think?”The little girl’s voice was filled with a strange laughter that reverberated in all directions. The cultivators who were affected by her laughter became even more frenzied. In fact, a few of them.., when they charged at Wang Baole, they actually self-destructed.
With a loud boom, Wang Baole retreated rapidly with an ugly expression on his face. Fortunately, even though he had avoided them, the connection between him and the two furnaces was still there. At that moment, there were still a large number of broken rules that spread out from the two furnaces and surged towards him, therefore, when he saw the surrounding cultivators charging towards him again with bloodshot eyes, Wang Baole’s eyes flashed coldly. The intrinsic scabbard in his body expanded with a loud boom.
In an instant, the suction force increased, and an endless amount of broken rules surged into the intrinsic scabbard, causing the scabbard to turn pitch black and gradually show signs of turning transparent.
The intrinsic scabbard was Wang Baole’s trump card. It was also the only thing in his mind that seemed to be able to break through the situation. He could sense that as the intrinsic scabbard absorbed it... there seemed to be a stream of sword Qi growing within it, it was becoming more and more terrifying!
Of course, other than that, there was also the Dao scripture.
However, the use of the Dao scripture could not be sustained for too long. Furthermore, it was mostly used to suppress and intimidate. It was not sharp enough!
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and ignored the cultivators charging at him. He dodged and dodged time and time again, accelerating the absorption of the shattering rules.
At the same time, in the surrounding starry skies, green threads seemed to be able to ignore the blockade due to their different levels. They flashed and appeared within, and the number of threads increased..
30,000,50,000,100,000,200,000..
—
He was in a very bad state today, and it would be irresponsible for him to force himself to continue writing. He was truly sorry that he had overestimated himself. He owed him a chapter, which was a total of six chapters

chapters.title: Chapter 1149
chapters.content:
Chapter 1149:, physical breakthrough!
Translator:
549690339
However... even though there were more and more green threads in the area, the shattering rules within the oven couldn’t form a whirlpool unless they were completely absorbed. Once the whirlpool didn’t appear, the suction force wouldn’t exist.
Without the suction force, it would take a long time to absorb the green threads. It would have been fine at other times, but now that Wang Baole was trapped in this strange place, all the cultivators from the myriad sect clan around him went crazy.
That made a cold glint flash in Wang Baole’s eyes. He moved his body and once again avoided everyone’s combined divine ability. He accelerated the absorption of the broken rules in the oven, causing the intrinsic scabbard in his body to become more and more translucent.
However, at that moment, the little girl’s faint voice reverberated in Wang Baole’s ears once again.
“Uncle, you only have the time it takes an incense stick to burn... you have to work hard. After the time it takes an incense stick to burn, the fortuitous encounter that I have enveloped will be like a bubble. With a bang... it will be destroyed.”
“At that time, you will also be destroyed.”As the little girl said that, she giggled. That laughter spread in Wang Baole’s mind and turned into a threat. It also affected his intuition, giving Wang Baole a premonition, if he really couldn’t break through this place within the time it takes for an incense stick to burn... then... There was a high chance that he would be in a fatal crisis.
“You’re just playing tricks!”A cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes. He quickly determined the other party’s identity. He didn’t know if this little girl was the same person he had seen in the fallen star.
Regardless, the first person he ruled out was Zi Yue!
No matter how powerful Zi Yue’s background was, Wang Baole didn’t believe that his senior brother, Chen Qingzi, wouldn’t be able to detect her if she came. Therefore, the possibility that she was Zi Yue was extremely low.
As for the blood-colored centipede, Wang Baole didn’t think so either. As he thought and absorbed the blood-colored centipede, the cultivators around him grew even more frenzied. The woman who had morphed into a silver dragon was even more difficult to deal with, she formed long silver lines and began to entangle Wang Baole rapidly.
The youth who had five ancient swords in his hands was extremely ferocious. He would often attack with five ancient swords, tearing through the air from five different directions. There was also the Prince of the never-ending clan. He might not be able to entangle and kill as well as the first two, but he was very comprehensive, his cultivation was strong, comparable to that of a half-step galactic domain.
That was why every time the three of them attacked, Wang Baole had no choice but to retreat rapidly. It wasn’t that he couldn’t fight, but once he did, if he couldn’t finish them off in an instant, the dozens of perfected stars surrounding him would join forces, it would be difficult for Wang Baole to fight back!
There’s another way. Senior brother should be able to sense that something is wrong from what I said earlier... Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. The moment the three of them joined forces to attack, he raised his right hand and formed a seal. The star atlas behind him instantly materialized, the Divine Bull roared and charged forward.
......
A loud boom instantly filled the air, and violent ripples spread out violently in all directions. It was as if mountains and seas had been toppled. The loud boom forced everyone back, and many of them coughed up blood.
However, Wang Baole had also expended quite a lot of energy. His face was slightly pale, and he retreated rapidly. The absorption of the shattering rules hadn’t ended, but he had decisively severed the connection between one of the ovens, all his energy was focused on one of the furnaces. As such, the suction force increased. As he gritted his teeth and activated his intrinsic sword sheath, the influx of the shattering rules increased exponentially.
He could sense that he had already absorbed half of the shattering rules in the furnace. If he wanted to absorb all of them, he would need about thirty breaths!
“Thirty breaths!”Wang Baole’s eyes were bloodshot. He looked at the people around him and saw that they were charging at him once again. A huge nightmare eye appeared behind Wang Baole.
With a roar, the nightmare eye behind Wang Baole suddenly opened, revealing waves of dark light. They turned into waves of terrifying power, causing the people who were charging at him to freeze.
Waves of piercing pain appeared in Wang Baole’s mind. The Nightmare Eye Art had been activated to the maximum, and there were too many people enveloped this time. As he felt the piercing pain, cracks appeared on the nightmare eye behind him, it seemed like it wouldn’t be able to hold on for long.
However, Wang Baole couldn’t care too much at the moment. Almost at the instant that everyone froze, overlapping shadows appeared on Wang Baole’s body. His nine quasi-dao stars, under the activation of the origin avatar art, immediately transformed into nine clones, they flew out from his original body and charged towards the crowd.
The tens of thousands of unique stars on the star map also descended one by one. They transformed into clones and charged towards the crowd. Although they weren’t as powerful as the quasi-dao star clones and weren’t as powerful as Wang Baole’s original body, each of them possessed a certain level of combat power, and there were quite a few of them, even though they couldn’t suppress the crowd, they could form a barrier around Wang Baole to stall for time. That shouldn’t be a problem.
As a loud boom rang out, the cultivators from the myriad sect clan broke free from the freezing effect of the Nightmare Eye Art. A huge battle erupted. The noise was deafening, and Wang Baole was surrounded by layers of his clones, buying him some time, his absorption of the broken rules had also reached seventy percent.
A cold glint flashed in his eyes, and an intense killing intent filled his eyes. Even though everyone present had been affected and attacked him, at that moment, Wang Baole’s killing intent was equally intense.
That was because he saw his nine quasi-dao stars retreating in defeat as they fought with all their might against the three strongest prodigies. One after another, their clones were blasted into pieces. Even though they had reappeared.., however, it was clear that cracks had appeared on the core of the quasi-dao stars.
Once they collapsed and exploded, Wang Baole would definitely suffer great damage.
As for the ten thousand unique stars, many of them had already been destroyed. The cultivators from the myriad sect clan were all in a frenzy. They were constantly charging forward, self-destructing at every turn. Every self-detonation would cause the incarnations of some of the unique stars.., to be destroyed immediately.
The killing intent in Wang Baole’s eyes grew stronger as he watched. The intrinsic scabbard in his body seemed to sense danger as well, and it began to devour and absorb at an even faster rate.
Eighty percent, ninety percent..
Just as Wang Baole absorbed ninety percent of the broken rules in the oven, the defense formed by the tens of thousands of unique stars exploded simultaneously by the seven to eight cultivators from the myriad sect clan, instantly creating a gap.
Wang Baole was silent as he silently chanted the Dao scripture in his heart.
In the next moment, more than ten cultivators from the myriad sect clan charged through the gap with bloodshot eyes. As they neared, the power of the Dao scripture descended with a loud bang, forming a suppressive force that crushed the dozen or so cultivators who were charging at him, their bodies trembled violently. Even the cultivators from the other ten thousand sect clans outside did the same.
Taking advantage of this moment, all of his avatars rose to their feet and fought back rapidly. At the same time, the intrinsic scabbard in Wang Baole’s body finally... completely absorbed the last fragment of the broken rules in the oven!
Almost at the same moment that he absorbed all the broken rules in the oven, a huge whirlpool appeared directly in the oven. It was like a black hole. A suction force erupted, causing the green threads that had gathered into hundreds of thousands to gather in the surroundings, at that moment, they charged towards him with a loud boom.
Ten Thousand, twenty thousand, thirty thousand..
A large number of green threads shot through the air and appeared in the oven. They surged into Wang Baole’s body and were absorbed by the intrinsic scabbard. Then, they fed back a large amount of power that nourished his physical body, causing Wang Baole’s physical body to.., rise again.
With a loud boom, when the power of the Dao scripture dissipated, Wang Baole had absorbed more than eighty thousand green threads. At that moment, his physical body finally... exploded and broke through, stepping into... The perfected stellar realm!
The physical power of the perfected stellar realm was already astonishing. Wang Baole’s physical body was augmented by numerous stars, so his breakthrough was shocking. Even his nine quasi-dao stars shone brightly, the special stars that hadn’t collapsed were all shining brightly.
There were even a large number of light spots formed by the special stars that had been shattered into pieces. They were gathering rapidly, as if they were about to form stars again.
Now, it’s my turn to fight back! Killing intent exploded in Wang Baole’s eyes. As he continued to absorb the black hair, he stood up from his cross-legged position after his physical body had broken through. His body was filled with endless power, he took a step forward!
The starry sky beneath his feet shattered, and the air around him distorted. With a single step, Wang Baole appeared in front of the two cultivators from the myriad sect clan. He clenched his fists at the same time and punched out!

chapters.title: Chapter 1150
chapters.content:
Chapter 1150: — if the Dark Sect wasn’t destroyed, the emperor’s body wouldn’t appear!
Translator:
549690339
Bang, Bang, Bang!
The two prodigies from the myriad sect clan were both at the perfected stellar realm. However, it was clear that their combat abilities were on a completely different level from Wang Baole’s. Wang Baole’s physical body was too strong, and his soul was the same. He was now using his cultivation to strengthen his body, even if he didn’t use any divine abilities or spells, his physical body was still earth-shattering.
With a loud boom, the bodies of the two prodigies exploded instantly. They felt an indescribably powerful force slam into their bodies, and they lost consciousness in the next moment. They didn’t even feel any pain, their physical bodies were torn into pieces. Their souls couldn’t escape either. They were instantly torn apart by Wang Baole’s violent force.
From the beginning to the end, Wang Baole’s body didn’t stop. Instead, in a flash, he crashed into another prodigy from the myriad sect clan. He was a middle-aged man. His eyes were filled with madness, but he instinctively tried to dodge, however, it was too late.
In the next moment, Wang Baole crashed into him. With a loud boom, the man’s entire body collapsed. Wang Baole was about to continue attacking, but at that moment, Prince Weiyang, the Silver Dragon Lady, and the young man from the five elements ancient sword, who were surrounded by his nine avatars.., the three of them suddenly became blurry. A strange force seemed to envelop them, causing the three of them to break away from Wang Baole’s quasi-dao stellar avatar and appear around Wang Baole.
As soon as they appeared, the three of them erupted with killing intent and charged forward!
The lady who had transformed into a giant silver dragon had a blood-red glow in her eyes. She formed a seal with her hands, and the Silver Dragon immediately turned crimson. It roared towards the sky and charged towards Wang Baole.
The young man with the five elements ancient sword did the same. All the blood vessels in his body bulged, and the five ancient swords split. They split from five to ten, then from ten to twenty. They multiplied, and in an instant, they reached thousands. They covered the sky and covered the earth, they charged towards Wang Baole from all directions!
There was also Prince Weiyang. He unleashed his true form without hesitation. His three heads and six arms appeared with a loud boom, and he leaped forward. He used the price of one head and two arms to form a giant hand seal, suppressing Wang baole from top to bottom.
Each of the three of them was extraordinary. If they were in the outside world, each of them would be able to suppress the prodigies from all directions, surpassing the so-called second tier teams. Even the first tier teams from the various sects and clans wouldn’t be able to compare to the three of them.
At this moment, they were going all out in their madness. Even though Wang Baole had perfected his physical body, he could still fight against the three of them at the same time. However... in this strange region.., after all, there was still that mysterious and malicious little girl!
Therefore, in the next instant, Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and retreated instantly. Under the guidance of the Qi dynamic, the three of them immediately charged at him. The Crimson Dragon coiled around him, and the thousand swords howled. Wang Baole’s body, which seemed to be retreating, suddenly reversed, he charged forward at an even faster speed.
As he retreated and advanced, his speed exploded. Under the guidance of the Qi dynamic, he immediately created an opportunity for Wang Baole. If the three of them were rational, it would be difficult for Wang Baole to use the Qi dynamic to seize the opportunity. However, he could still do it now.
......
In the next instant, under the sudden burst of speed, his body avoided the Crimson Dragon and the thousand swords. When he reappeared, he was right in front of the hand seal formed by Prince Weiyang. Without any hesitation, he roared, he threw a punch.
The power of his physical body exploded. Even the quasi-dao stellar clones and the clones of all the special stars in the surroundings surged forward. They all returned to their original positions, causing Wang Baole’s punch to shake the heavens and earth.
The void trembled. The starry sky collapsed. Prince Weiyang’s hand seal shattered into pieces. Blood spurted out of his mouth as well. He was knocked back thousands of feet by Wang Baole’s punch, he crashed into an invisible barrier in the void!
As the sound reverberated, cracks appeared in the void around Prince Weiyang’s body. It was as if there was a barrier there. As the barrier shook, Wang Baole’s pupils constricted!
He was about to charge forward, but at that moment, his vigilance exploded. His body twisted at an unbelievable angle. He leaned back abruptly, stepping on the air and retreating rapidly. At the same time, he took out a leaf without hesitation, he pressed down on the spot where he had been previously.
The leaf was a gift from the blazing flame ancestor, and it contained a shocking curse.
The instant he retreated and the leaf was taken out to suppress him, a strand of black hair appeared where his head had been. It split apart instantly.
The little girl then emerged from the void. However, what welcomed her was the suppressive power emanating from the leaf. Rumbling filled the air, and the little girl’s entire body trembled violently, and her expression twisted, pupils appeared in her eyes, as if they were in a state of chaos. A normal person would only have one pupil, but this little girl had at least seven or eight in each eye, which was why it made people feel dizzy, it was terrifying!
When the pupils appeared, pain appeared on the little girl’s face, and she let out a shrill cry. At the same time, different voices came out of her body as if they were roaring.
“The dark sect deserves to be killed! !”
“The dark sect needs to be destroyed!”
“The dark sect, the dark sect, the stone stele formed from its own laws... can not exist in this world! !”
“Why not? The dark sect has walked the stone stele world for generations. If it were not for us, this world would not exist!”
“If the dark sect is not destroyed, the emperor’s body can not appear. If the emperor’s body does not appear... how can this world return!”
“Return! Return! I feel a call. Weiyang has returned. Weiyang has returned!”
All sorts of voices, ancient and crazy, erupted from the little girl’s body. The little girl’s expression became more and more distorted. Her body expanded and contracted at times. Wang Baole was about to continue attacking, however, at that moment, all the pupils in the little girl’s eyes fused together again, as if she had recovered from her uncontrollable state.
The instant she recovered, the little girl’s body swayed and appeared beside Prince Weiyang, who had been severely injured by Wang Baole. She dove right into his body.
Prince Weiyang immediately let out a shrill scream. The head that he had self-destructed previously was now filled with flesh and blood. In the next instant... Another head grew out.
However... This head didn’t belong to him. It belonged to the little girl!
The little girl’s hands also grew out from the two arms where Prince Weiyang had self-detonated. As the flesh and blood squirmed, she shook her head and controlled Prince Weiyang’s body to walk out. She stared coldly at Wang Baole.
However, a hint of fear flashed in the depths of her eyes.
At the same time, Wang Baole’s heart trembled violently. This was the first time he had heard someone refer to the stone stele world. He couldn’t help but make many guesses, but now wasn’t the time to think, the moment the little girl recovered, Wang Baole recalled the slightly dimmer tree leaves. He retreated abruptly, once again avoiding the blockade of the Crimson Dragon and the thousand swords. Then, he headed straight for the second kiln.
He arrived in an instant. Wang Baole didn’t hesitate and immediately began to absorb. He had already sensed that even though his intrinsic scabbard could indeed come out now, he wasn’t confident that he could kill the little girl directly. As for breaking through this area.., it would be a little difficult.
However, it didn’t matter. The existence of his intrinsic scabbard was more of a trump card. Furthermore, Wang Baole felt that if he continued to absorb it, his intrinsic scabbard would become completely transparent, and its power would be even more astonishing.
As he retreated, the second oven’s shattering rules surged forward. As he absorbed it rapidly, his avatars spread out and enveloped the surroundings, once again turning into a defense.
Within himself, he accelerated the absorption!
Prince Weiyang, who was currently occupied by the little girl, suddenly spoke with hesitation in his eyes.
“All of you, go over and self-destruct to injure him!”
As soon as he said that, the remaining fifty or so people, with the exception of the Silver Dragon Lady and the young man with the ancient sword, rushed out and charged at Wang Baole. As they neared his clones, the seven or eight people in front of him immediately self-destructed, they didn’t hesitate to self-destruct.
Amidst the loud booms, the Silver Dragon Lady and the young man with the thousand swords also made their moves. In an instant, many of Wang Baole’s clones were destroyed once again. Wang baole, who was protected, narrowed his eyes.
“It’s fine if you don’t move. Once you do, my scabbard and the tree leaves will move together!”A cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes. He allowed the explosions around him to continue as he absorbed the rules of the oven’s destruction.
The rules of destruction in the second oven instantly decreased. Soon, there were only forty percent, thirty percent, twenty percent... when it reached ten percent, the eyes of the little girl who had occupied Prince Weiyang’s body shone with a dark light, her body swayed, and she disappeared instantly. When she reappeared, she was beside Wang Baole.
The moment she reappeared, Wang Baole turned his head abruptly. Killing intent erupted in his eyes. He instantly took out the tree leaves, and the intrinsic scabbard in his body emitted an aura!

chapters.title: Chapter 1151
chapters.content:
Chapter 1151: — a fierce battle!
Translator:
549690339
However, just as Wang Baole took out the leaf and released the aura of his intrinsic scabbard, the little girl, who had appeared strangely beside Wang baole, turned blurry in an instant. As if she had been scared off, she reappeared in the distance, her eerie gaze locked onto Wang Baole.
Wang Baole also raised his head to look at the little girl. His eyes narrowed, and a hint of savagery appeared in them.
“Testing me? Then you’ll be disappointed. I can still use this leaf many times,”Wang Baole suddenly said, as he spoke, the defense formed by the large number of clones around him began to tremble under the continuous self-detonation of the cultivators from the ten thousand sects. The explosions continued.
With such a level of self-detonation, even though Wang Baole’s physical body had broken through and reached the perfected star realm, he was still affected. If the little girl hadn’t threatened him, Wang Baole could have let loose, he had the power to suppress everyone in the area.
However, he had to be careful now. As he narrowed his eyes, Wang Baole maintained his defense and continued to absorb the second kiln. More and more strands of black hair gathered around him, and soon.., the last portion of the broken rules in the second kiln was sucked away by Wang Baole. It formed a vortex, and the black hair gathered in the area surged towards him.
The little girl’s eyes flashed with killing intent. Her body disappeared once again, as if she had fused with the black strands, making it impossible for Wang Baole to differentiate between them.
Seeing this, Wang Baole decided to take out the tree leaves completely and let them float above his head. He activated them with all his might, and the tree leaves exploded with a dazzling light that enveloped the surroundings. The pressure increased greatly, the little girl, who seemed to have fused with the black hair, had no choice but to retreat again. She appeared from afar, and a look of madness appeared in her eyes.
At the same time, as a large amount of black hair surged in, the intrinsic scabbard in Wang Baole’s body was also rapidly absorbing it. At that moment, half of the area had become translucent.
When it’s completely transparent, the sword intent within it will definitely be earth-shattering! Wang Baole sensed it for a moment and realized something. He didn’t continue to sit there and absorb the black hair. Instead, with a wave of his hand, he brought along all the avatars that surrounded him, he began to move, rapidly approaching the third kiln.
He might as well absorb the black hair along with the broken rules within the third kiln. Even if his avatars collapsed one after another during this process, with the feedback from the absorption of the intrinsic scabbard and the nourishment of his physical strength.., it caused many of the destroyed avatars to reassemble.
Even though they couldn’t reach a balance, they were able to buy a lot of time. At that point, Wang Baole had already calmed down. He knew that everything was developing in his favor.
The longer he waited, the more he would absorb, and the stronger his physical body would become. At the same time, he didn’t believe that his senior brother, Chen Qingzi, wouldn’t notice anything. Therefore, if he waited, he might not even need to think of a way to escape from his senior brother’s predicament, he would be able to find a way to escape.
That’s why it’s the one who’s in a hurry! Wang Baole’s eyes flashed. He admitted that the little girl was strange and that she had mastered some indescribable abilities. However, that was all. Her greatest weakness was.., that she didn’t have enough combat strength.
......
As long as she doesn’t have the ability to kill me instantly, then this time, no matter what her goal is, she won’t be able to succeed! Wang Baole snorted coldly in his heart as he absorbed the energy even faster.
As a loud boom rang out, he absorbed a large amount of the broken rules in the third kiln. In such a short period of time, he had absorbed half of them. Wang Baole’s body was also nourished by the black strands of hair, and with the feedback from his intrinsic scabbard.., he was being nourished, and he was rising again!
A perfected star realm cultivator wasn’t the limit of one’s physical body. As he rose, Wang Baole’s physical body grew stronger and stronger, and he continued to advance... towards the galaxy!
At that moment, the little girl who was staring at Wang Baole from afar felt that Wang Baole was becoming more and more difficult to deal with. She grew anxious. Multiple pupils appeared in her eyes, and she roared from within her body.
“Kill him! Find the projection of the deepest fear in his heart. Materialize and kill him!”
“This is the dark child of this generation. Kill him and cut off the dark sect’s Hope!”
“No. The dark sect is destined to be a force to be reckoned with!”
“I’ve found him. He was afraid of this!”
“Kill, Kill, Kill!”
As the screams rang out, the other two heads of Prince Weiyang, who was in the little girl’s body, let out painful screams as the little girl’s emotions fluctuated.
Then, the pupils in the little girl’s eyes overlapped rapidly. When they returned to normal, the little girl suddenly opened her mouth, revealing her serrated teeth that were filled with mucus. She let out a roar at Wang Baole.
The Roar seemed to have formed an invisible ripple that rumbled in all directions. Wang Baole’s body trembled, and his soul shook slightly. However, he recovered in an instant. However, the clones that were charging at him.., the cultivators from the ten thousand sect clans, who were attacking continuously, trembled violently and retreated.
They no longer attacked the clones that were protecting Wang Baole. Instead, as they retreated, they charged towards Prince Weiyang, who was in the little girl’s body. In the next moment... a strange scene appeared!
There were more than thirty remaining cultivators from the ten thousand sect clans, including the young man who had transformed into a giant dragon and displayed a thousand swords. They seemed to have completely lost their minds, as they charged towards Prince Weiyang, who had been possessed by the little girl, they seemed to merge into him the moment they made contact!
Their bodies, souls, and even their cultivation levels were merged into him. In the span of a few breaths, the thirty cultivators had merged with Prince Weiyang!
The integration of each cultivator would cause a wart to appear on Prince Weiyang’s body, and his aura would increase as well. In the end... After all the cultivators had integrated into him, Prince Weiyang appeared before Wang Baole, he had turned into a monster!
The monster had dozens of arms and legs. Its body was elongated, and it looked like a giant human centipede!
There were also dozens of warts on its body. These warts evolved rapidly, eventually turning into lifeless heads that screamed in pain. They twisted their bodies and charged toward Wang Baole at an astonishing speed, they roared.
They were too fast!
In the next instant, hundreds of centipedes that were formed by the little girl crashed and exploded in front of Wang Baole, blocking his path. Some of them were even devoured by the centipede. The speed of the centipede didn’t decrease as it tore at Wang Baole. Instead, it was even faster, in the blink of an eye... They appeared in front of Wang Baole, who was shaken to the core!
“Centipede?”Wang Baole raised his right hand. The leaf that the blazing flame ancestor had given him was instantly unfurled, forming a screen of light that blocked his path.
Amidst the rumbling, the screen of light showed signs of cracking, but it was still there. This was the first time that the centipede formed by the little girl had been blocked. Wang Baole was shaken to the core. He wanted to unfurl his intrinsic scabbard, but he gave up and retreated rapidly, he formed a seal with his hands and pointed at the leaf that had transformed into the screen of light!
“Seal!”
As he pointed, he uttered a single word. Immediately, the screen of light curved and enveloped the centipede that the little girl had transformed into. It was like a seal, but it was clearly unable to last for long. The centipede within it roared and attacked continuously.
“It’s not the blood-colored centipede that I remember
It’s something that I’ve sensed through some unknown method, something that I’m afraid of, that’s why it’s manifested..
As Wang Baole retreated, the sense of danger grew stronger again. He didn’t have time to think too much. As he absorbed the black hair, he raised his right hand. Taking advantage of the time that the other party had been trapped, he directly drew the third, fourth, and fifth kiln.., all of them were drawn over, frantically absorbing the broken rules within.
I have to be fast. I have to make the intrinsic scabbard completely translucent as soon as possible
Wang Baole went all out. He circulated his cultivation and pulled the intrinsic scabbard in his body. At the same time, he felt that it wasn’t enough. He raised his right hand and slapped it hard on his chest. With a loud boom, the intrinsic scabbard in his body was forced out from his body, rays of light spread out from Wang Baole’s body. Finally, the intrinsic scabbard... materialized before him!
Almost at the instant the intrinsic scabbard appeared, the shattering rules in the surrounding oven went berserk. Without Wang Baole’s physical body to block them, the intrinsic scabbard absorbed them even faster, causing the shattering rules.., they surged forward at an even faster speed than before!
At the same time, the surrounding strands of black hair, under the unprecedented suction force, converged with an earth-shattering roar!
30,000,80,000,100,000,200,000,300,000... until... it was so dense that it seemed endless!

chapters.title: Chapter 1152
chapters.content:
Chapter 1152: — unending suction!
Translator:
549690339
At that moment, the shattering rules of the three ovens exploded violently and surged toward Wang Baole, who was in the center. To be precise, it surged toward the intrinsic sword sheath that had materialized in front of him!
At that moment, nearly sixty percent of the intrinsic sword sheath had become translucent. A terrifying ripple was constantly growing within it, causing the little girl, who had fused with all the cultivators from the myriad sect clan, to become a monster, the seal on the leaf was growing more and more violent.
Rumbling sounds could be heard as the shattered natural laws were absorbed, and more strands of black hair were drawn over. In a short time, there were more than 400,000 of them.
It was because of the many strands of black hair that the starry sky was dyed green. The little girl, who was sealed inside of the leaf, began to grow even more anxious. She began to scream and struggle, the cracks on the leaf seal appeared rapidly. It was obvious that it wouldn’t be able to hold on for too long.
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He knew very well that if his natal scabbard hadn’t become completely transparent before the leaf seal was broken, making it difficult for him to display his most confident attack, then this battle.., he could only think of other ways to delay it.
He could delay it until his senior brother broke through the strange situation outside and saved him.
Such a good opportunity. How troublesome! Wang baole sighed. However, he also knew that it was not the time to feel emotional. Instead, he quickly formed seals with his hands and continuously struck at the natal scabbard in front of him, one catalytic mark after another was formed.
As the Natal scabbard buzzed, the devouring power increased once again. It reached the maximum that Wang Baole could unleash at the moment, causing loud noises to reverberate in the surroundings. The number of broken rules in the surrounding ovens decreased visibly.
Soon, all the broken rules in the third ovens were absorbed by Wang Baole in the blink of an eye. Amidst the booming sounds, the third ovens released a violent suction force, causing a large amount of black hair to fly towards the scabbard!
As it absorbed, the feedback power took form. It was a ball of purple mist that spread out from the intrinsic scabbard and entered Wang Baole’s seven orifices and all the pores on his body, causing Wang Baole’s body to tremble, the strength of his physical body surged once again at the perfected level of the Star!
The perfected level of the star. Even though the name had the word “Perfected”in it, in reality, there were steps and a hundred steps in this realm. As it was difficult to advance in this realm, as long as one took a step, one could be said to be at the perfected level, regardless of whether one took a step or a hundred steps, one could give up at any time and advance to the celestial domain realm.
However... generally speaking, one would advance to a dozen or so steps. That way, after a breakthrough in cultivation, one’s battle prowess would increase. Theoretically speaking, the more steps one took, the higher one’s battle prowess would be after a breakthrough.
However, due to the difficulty of the process, very few people had reached the pinnacle since ancient times. However, Wang Baole’s physical body, nourished by the Heavenly Dao, was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Within a short period of time.., he had stepped from the first step to the tenth step, and he was still continuing!
......
His physical body exuded a suppressive force that seemed to be able to suppress the surrounding starry skies. A powerful vibration that made one’s heart race also spread throughout his body.
Booming sounds rang out continuously, and a large amount of black hair surged into his body. On one hand, it gave Wang baole the opportunity to nourish his physical body. At the same time, it also helped his intrinsic sword scabbard absorb the shattering rules of the other stoves.
Therefore, after more than ten breaths, the shattering rules of the fourth ovens were also sucked dry. The suction force formed instantly spread in all directions, causing more of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao black hair to surge in rapidly.
Faster and faster!
More and more!
This became a cycle, causing Wang Baole’s physical body to become stronger and stronger. Eventually, the seal formed by the tree leaves shattered even more, and the monster girl inside was extremely anxious.
It could clearly sense that as time passed and Wang Baole’s physical body grew stronger, the gradually transparent scabbard in front of it gave it a sense of danger, and the danger was constantly increasing.
In a short period of time, it had reached a level that made its heart skip a beat. However, Wang Baole still seemed to feel that it was not enough. Therefore, even though the little girl’s heart was trembling, he was still absorbing it frantically, his eyes turned bloodshot as he exerted all his strength!
“It’s still not enough!”Wang Baole roared, in the next instant, the shattering rules in the fifth kiln were emptied. The suction force erupted, causing millions of strands of black hair to gather in the surroundings. As they continued to gather, they continued to pour into the intrinsic scabbard!
Wang Baole’s intrinsic scabbard had gone from sixty percent transparent to more than seventy percent. It was even expanding rapidly to eighty percent. His physical body was also in the state of the perfected star state. Under the continuous feedback.., he had reached the thirty-plus steps!
There weren’t many people who could reach this level in terms of cultivation. It was even rarer to see someone who had reached the physical body level. After all, the cultivation of the physical body was slower and more arduous than cultivation!
However, Wang Baole had no choice but to work hard. His eyes were bloodshot, and he still felt that his intrinsic scabbard was slightly weaker. However... the monster girl inside the leaf seal was now the boss with her eyes wide open, there were even fewer signs of struggle... compared to before.
It seemed to be able to sense that the seal formed by the leaf seal could, to a certain extent... provide its own protection.
However, just as the little girl felt danger for the first time in her heart, four of the five stoves were now empty. They turned into a suction force, causing the green threads in the surroundings to continuously surge in at a rate of tens of thousands per breath, as a result, the suction force of the intrinsic sword sheath naturally increased. It only absorbed the remaining one of the stoves, and instantly, the broken rules within the stoves were sucked dry.
In the next instant, the six stoves turned into black holes. The suction force that spread out caused the green color in the surroundings to visibly decrease rapidly.
A hundred thousand, two hundred thousand, three hundred thousand... All the way to six hundred thousand!
At the same time, Wang Baole’s intrinsic scabbard had expanded from more than 70% transparent to 80% , followed by 90% ..
His physical strength had also increased from the previous thirty plus steps to more than seventy steps. This level of physical strength was already extremely terrifying. It was likely that some ordinary early-stage celestial domain-grade powerhouses.., couldn’t put it out.
Even in a certain way, that his body comparable to the magic weapon, it is no exaggeration!
It is also at this time, the little girl does not want to struggle, but in the obvious shortness of breath, pinch out one mark after another, actually began to defend!
At the same time, the black hair of the Unending Heavenly Dao was sucked away by Wang baole like a bottomless pit. After absorbing nearly a million dao, the Unending Heavenly Dao in the entire gray starry sky was reduced by more than half.
To the Weiyang clan, it was earth-shattering. The battleships of the Weiyang clan, which were floating outside the gray starry sky and maintaining a state of concealment, were soon unable to continue concealing themselves. Waves of ripples reverberated, they had no choice but to appear before the eyes of the cultivators from the myriad sect clans in the outside world.
That wasn’t all... there were even a few battleships that, as everyone looked over, self-detonated and shattered into pieces. This scene immediately stunned everyone who saw it.
In the next moment, not only did the unending battleships explode, but more and more battleships also began to explode at higher frequency.
In the space of a few breaths, the face of the Xuan Hua divine emperor flickered, and rumbling sounds could be heard as more than 30,000 of the 100,000 unending battleships were destroyed! !
At this moment, everyone outside was completely shocked, and a huge commotion broke out.
“What’s going on! ?”
“What’s happening! ?”
“Could it be that moon splitting emperor is dead?”
“Chen Qingzi is coming out! !” Xuan Hua’s expression was also unsightly. He had not noticed Moon splitting emperor’s death, but he could tell that Chen Qingzi must have used some tricks in there. Perhaps he really was about to charge out.
After a moment of hesitation, Xuan Hua was about to speak..
But at that moment... thirty percent of the remaining unending battleships, about seventy to eighty thousand in number, all trembled at the same time, and cracks began to appear!
A massive suction force, far greater than before, suddenly erupted from within the gray starry sky, affecting the outside world. It was actually forcefully absorbing the Heavenly Dao Aura within the unending battleships! !
It was as if the guest was the host.
—
Still writing!

chapters.title: Chapter 1153
chapters.content:
Chapter 1153:, Extreme Dao physical body!
Translator:
549690339
In reality, the host was not the host!
On Wang Baole’s side, after the intrinsic scabbard absorbed enough broken rules and Wisps of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao Aura, the entire area instantly turned translucent!
If one did not look closely, one would not be able to see clearly. At the same time, after the intrinsic scabbard was completely translucent, it sucked violently in all directions once again.
Immediately, all the black hair in the surroundings, numbering in the millions, seemed to have gone crazy. In the next instant, they all surged into the intrinsic scabbard. This scene was also the cause of the disturbance in the outside world.
The suction force was too strong. As it sucked too much at once, it caused the Weiyang warship in the outside world to lose its balance. It was like a tug-of-war. When the other party suddenly increased its strength, the other party was unable to resist and would naturally be sucked in!
That was why the scene of it shattering and collapsing was happening. At the same time, as the intrinsic scabbard absorbed millions of strands of black hair at once, it was also very conscientious and gave Wang baole a wave of astonishing nourishment.
The nourishing power was too strong. In an instant, Wang Baole’s steps from seventy steps to ninety steps at the Perfected Stellar Realm continued!
Ninety-three, ninety-four, ninety-five..
The speed was so fast that Wang Baole didn’t even have time to react. His body rumbled continuously, and he was nourished to a hundred steps!
The moment he reached a hundred steps, ancient runes that seemed to have existed since ancient times appeared on Wang Baole’s body. Their appearance seemed to bring with it a sense of heavenly music, as they reverberated in all directions, the runes spread out and surrounded Wang baole, giving him a perfect contrast.
From Afar, Wang Baole looked as if he had become an immortal!
An ancient-looking aura and a terrifying pressure spread out from his body, causing the air around him to distort and the starry sky to tremble. It was as if even the entire area couldn’t withstand it.
That was because he was at the hundred steps!
......
Theoretically speaking, the great circle of the stellar realm was the limit. It was incredibly difficult to reach that level of cultivation, and it was incredibly difficult to reach the fleshly body level. The hardest part... was the divine soul. Without the assistance of some rare and rare treasures, it would be impossible! Furthermore, it was almost impossible to reach the great circle of the stellar realm with the help of extinct heavenly materials and earthly treasures!
In fact, in the Wei Yang Dao Domain, in addition to the myriad sect clans, there were some ancient sects with long legacies. There weren’t many of them, and any one of them would be taken seriously by the Wei Yang clan. For example, the Xie clan was one of them.
In an ancient sect like this, the criteria by which the top elites in their ranks were measured were their cultivation, soul, and physical body. All of them had to be at least ninety steps away when they were at the perfected star realm.
Wang Baole’s physical body had reached its peak. If word got out... it would shock everyone!
In reality, the little girl who had been trapped by the tree leaves was already shocked. She stared blankly at Wang Baole, at the runic symbols around him, and at the terrifying pressure emanating from him. The little girl’s body.., she couldn’t help but tremble.
“I’ve gone too far...”the little girl muttered. A large number of other pupils appeared in her pupils once again, and many voices spread out from within her body.
“Extreme Dao physical body!”
“That’s impossible. Since ancient times, the Extreme Dao physical body has only been a legend. It’s impossible for a living being to achieve it!”
“That’s right, it’s impossible. If you want to obtain the Extreme Dao physical body, even heavenly treasures can’t strengthen it. Even though the Heavenly Dao Aura is strong, it’s impossible for you to complete the last step of the transition!”
“In theory, only if your physical body is already heaven-defying would it be possible. However, that’s not a breakthrough, but a return!”
As the voices reverberated in all directions, Wang Baole raised his head. He could sense that his physical body had reached an unbelievable level. However, the most important thing for him now was not to observe his physical body, instead, it was to cut open the little girl and the strange space!
Therefore, in the next instant, as the little girl’s pupils contracted rapidly, a cold glint flashed across Wang Baole’s eyes. As he stared at the little girl, he raised his left hand and grabbed the intrinsic scabbard!
At the same time, he placed his right hand on the scabbard. It was as if there was an invisible sword hilt that no one could see. After Wang Baole grabbed it, his divine thought fluctuated and summoned the leaf back!
The leaf, which had reached its limit, began to burn and spread out, but it didn’t disappear. It was formed from the curse left behind by the blazing flame ancestor. It turned into a large amount of fog and headed straight for Wang Baole. When it returned to his side.., it turned back into a leaf and disappeared into his storage bag.
The little girl let out a roar. Her expression was twisted. After sensing a strong sense of danger, she didn’t leave. Instead, she turned into a ferocious afterimage and charged at Wang Baole at an indescribable speed, killing him!
Her speed was astonishing, and her battle prowess was monstrous. At that moment, dozens of figures appeared on her body, and they were even increasing in number. After nearly a hundred, it seemed to have gathered all the power of the figures, they turned into a huge mouth that seemed to be able to devour everything, and it swallowed Wang Baole in one gulp!
Wang Baole’s gaze was cold. He imagined a sword in his mind. Right now, he was holding onto the hilt of the sword, and he was pulling it out bit by bit. His actions were the same!
One Inch!
He was only pulling out one inch!
The sky cracked and the earth cracked. A loud boom reverberated in all directions. An immense pressure, accompanied by an extreme ray of light, erupted instantly, causing the little girl who had just charged forward to let out a shrill scream, her body was like snow that had met boiling water, melting in an instant.
