However, the little girl was also extremely ferocious. Even though her body was melting, she forced herself to gather together. She endured the intense pain and was unwilling to give up. She charged forward. Her mouth was wide open, covering Wang Baole’s surroundings. She looked like she was about to fall!
Wang Baole’s expression remained the same as he pulled out..
Two inches!
A loud boom shook the heavens and earth. It was as if there was a force that could suppress and tear apart everything. It exploded from the scabbard. The light was even brighter, causing the sky and Earth to change color. The starry sky distorted, and the little girl with her gaping mouth.., her body could no longer hold on. With a loud boom, she exploded!
As she exploded, the figures of the cultivators from the myriad sect clan that she had fused with earlier reappeared. They scattered in all directions, unconscious, revealing Prince Weiyang, who was in the little girl’s body.
As the prince’s body trembled, his two heads collapsed. Even the parts of his body that belonged to him fell apart, as if he had used this chance to escape the lock of the Sword Qi, the little girl’s figure materialized. Her face was pale, and she screamed as she retreated rapidly.
“You’re not Wang Baole, you’re not a cultivator, you’re not the life of this era. No... You’re nothing. You’re not the existence of the stone stele world!”
“Who the hell are you!”
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He was about to pull out the third inch of the invisible sword, but his eyes narrowed the next moment. A smile appeared on his lips, but he didn’t continue pulling it out.
That was because... as the little girl retreated, the void behind her was suddenly torn apart by a sword qi. A hole was torn open, and a large hand reached out and grabbed the little girl’s head, it was yanked outward!
“The Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao has awakened. I didn’t expect this ancient will to awaken as well!”
“Junior brother, this is senior brother’s mistake!”
As Chen Qingzi’s voice reverberated in the air, the strange starry sky that had been torn apart by the little girl with a strange force suddenly collapsed with a loud bang. It was as if an invisible barrier had been torn apart, the gray starry sky outside was revealed!
And... Chen Qingzi, who was standing above the central oven and hadn’t been reunited with Wang Baole for a long time!
“Baole greets senior brother!”Wang Baole stared at Chen Qingzi, his eyes filled with emotion. He cupped his fists and bowed deeply!
At that moment, only three of the surrounding ovens were still filled with a suppressive force. The others were no longer of any use and were completely abandoned. The cultivators from the myriad sect clan were floating around, unconscious.
The only ones who were awake were Wang Baole and Chen Qingzi!
“You’ve grown up...”Chen Qingzi’s eyes were filled with regret. He had just said that when his expression suddenly changed. He raised his head to look at the outside world, and a strange light shone in his eyes as he laughed loudly.
“Baole, senior brother has caught a big fish. Are you willing to eat with me?”
“How can I not obey senior brother’s orders!”Wang Baole laughed when he heard that.

chapters.title: Chapter 1154
chapters.content:
Chapter 1154:, the Unending Heavenly Dao!
Translator:
549690339
Wang Baole looked at his senior brother, Chen Qingzi. He had a hunch that the big fish that his senior brother had mentioned wasn’t the divine emperor, but..
“The Unending Heavenly Dao?”Wang Baole asked softly.
As he spoke, half of the unending battleships outside the gray space continued to collapse. The entire outside world was thrown into chaos!
The cultivators from the myriad sect clans were visibly moved. They looked as if they were facing a great enemy, and even began to back up. Clearly, they didn’t want to get involved, and were trying to send voice transmissions to their disciples who had entered the gray starry sky.
However... it was as if a clay ox had entered the sea. There was no response at all. However, there was nothing strange about it. After all, the spell formation only contained isolation. However, the changes that had occurred in the Wei Yang clan caused the cultivators from the myriad sect clans to feel a bit uneasy.
At the same time, the leader of the Weiyang clan, Divine Emperor Xuan Hua, also had an ugly expression on his face. He stared at the gray starry sky below. He could sense a large amount of the aura of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao disappearing, and he also saw the collapse of the Weiyang battleship, this had happened too quickly and disrupted his plan.
His original plan was to use the aura of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao to neutralize the power of the formation and at the same time create a suppressive effect on the revived Heavenly Dao of the dark sect.
In this way, with the current state of the Unending Heavenly Dao, he would definitely be able to create an effect on the suppressive effect. Moreover, even if he could not produce an immediate result, he would be able to weaken the power of the array formation. At the same time, he would be able to help the Unending Heavenly Dao’s aura fuse into the array formation, he would also be able to help the moon splitting divine emperor, who was currently fighting Chen Qingzi and was in danger.
This was the first plan of the unending clan.
At the same time, there was another plan, and that was... fishing!
Trapping this place, trapping the revived Heavenly Dao of the dark sect, and even trapping Chen Qingzi, in order to attract the remaining dark sect members who were hiding in the Weiyang Dao domain and could not be found.
The Weiyang clan believed that the greater the change in this place, the greater the attraction to the remaining dark sect members!
In addition, they had a third goal, which was to increase the hatred for the dark sect once again. The reason why they did not stop the cultivators of the myriad sect clan from entering and informed them of the risk was to let them die in there, and the more they died.., the hatred would grow. If the dark sect wanted to rise again from the ashes, it naturally wouldn’t be able to accomplish it.
......
However... of the three goals, all of them had changed except for the last one. All of these changes had occurred because the aura of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao in the spell formation had disappeared in large numbers.
“Dammit, what the hell is going on in there? !”Xuan Hua frowned. She was just about to say something when... an enraged roar suddenly rang out from the depths of the starry sky.
As the voice rang out, it was as if the minds of all the cultivators from the myriad sects and clans in the area were shaken, regardless of their level of cultivation.
Even Divine Emperor Xuan Hua was affected. He could also sense waves of terrifying aura gathering on the remaining Weiyang battleships. His expression changed, and he immediately let out a low, solemn shout.
“Go Back!”
As mystic flower spoke, her voice reverberated once again. She seemed unwilling, but she eventually left slowly. The terrifying aura that had gathered on the Weiyang clan warships also gradually dissipated.
At the same time, Chen Qingzi, who had raised his head with Wang Baole in the gray space, frowned slightly and suddenly spoke.
“Baole, can you continue sucking?”
“Of course!”Wang Baole smiled. Without any hesitation, he charged toward the seventh kiln. At the same time, he raised his right hand and pointed at the eighth kiln, instantly drawing the two ovens over, the intrinsic scabbard in front of him flashed. Instantly, the broken rules within the two ovens exploded and surged toward Wang Baole’s intrinsic scabbard like a torrent.
In terms of speed, the strength of Wang Baole’s physical body enhanced his speed. The entire process only took about ten breaths of time. Just as the terrifying aura in the outside world was about to completely dissipate.., the seventh and eighth broken rules in the oven were immediately emptied.
They turned into two huge black holes that emitted a monstrous suction force, causing the thin strands of black hair around them to once again rumble under the suction force, as if they were about to be squeezed dry, the remaining Unending Heavenly Dao black hair in the gray starry sky was once again drawn over.
In the blink of an eye, the number once again exceeded a hundred thousand. Soon, two hundred thousand, then three hundred thousand, then four hundred thousand, then five hundred thousand... until it reached a million again!
This was basically completely drained!
The moment these strands of black hair appeared, they charged towards Wang Baole’s intrinsic scabbard and were absorbed crazily.
Even someone as powerful as Chen Qingzi took a few more glances at Wang Baole’s intrinsic sword sheath. A look of admiration appeared in his eyes. He retracted his gaze and narrowed his eyes as he looked up.
It was as if his gaze could pierce through the starry skies and see the outside world.
Just as Wang Baole’s intrinsic sword sheath was absorbing the aura of the Unending Heavenly Dao, the terrifying aura that had left under Xuan Hua’s command began to fluctuate and roar, it roared once more from the depths of the starry skies.
The terrifying aura descended upon the unending battleships outside the gray starry skies once again. This scene caused Xuan Hua’s expression to change again. She was about to speak... but at that moment, within the gray starry skies, Wang Baole waved his hand, he released the little black fish, the donkey, and Little Five.
The moment the three appeared, they saw the sea of black hair around them. They immediately grew excited and split into three directions, as if they had turned into three black holes, absorbing and devouring them all at the same time!
As a result, the black hair in the area began to disappear at an even faster rate!
Originally, there had been a million black hair in the area, but now, it was reduced to 800,000,700,000,500,000... . By the time it reached 300,000, roaring sounds could be heard from beyond the gray starry sky, and no matter how much Xuan Hua berated them.., it didn’t seem to be of any use. The terrifying aura exploded out from the Weiyang clan battleships.
It grew stronger and stronger, and the pressure grew more and more shocking. All of the surrounding cultivators were forced to fall back once again. To their astonishment, they saw... that the Weiyang clan’s battleships seemed to have reached their limit, they could no longer withstand the pressure, and were instantly torn to pieces.
As they collapsed, the terrifying aura that had descended from the sky also gathered together to a certain extent. It instantly gathered together and formed an illusory image on top of the many destroyed Weiyang clan battleships!
It was a gigantic golden beetle!
Its entire body was golden, and it was supposed to be divine. However, its ferocious appearance and cold eyes made it look exceptionally savage. The bloody stench that emanated from its entire body made it seem as if it had just finished eating its blood, it gave people a feeling that they could not get close to it.
As for its appearance, it looked very similar to the Weiyang race’s battleships. It was as if they were of the same origin. In fact, this was indeed the case. All of the Weiyang race’s battleships came from the gigantic golden beetle before them, that was because... it was the Heavenly Dao of the Weiyang race!
It had been born after devouring the Heavenly Dao of the dark sect from back then. Now, it was the Heavenly Dao that had suppressed the entire Weiyang Dao domain and controlled endless natural laws and laws!
At that moment, what appeared here was not its original body. Instead, it was a split-up body that had gathered together. However, it was extremely powerful. It did not even bother to pay attention to Xuan Hua’s berating. The enormous golden beetle let out a roar, its body charged straight into the gray starry sky, instantly disappearing into it.
Xuan Hua’s expression instantly turned ugly. With a sway of its body, it stepped into it as well.
At the same time, Chen Qingzi, who was in the center of the area, had an intense glint in his eyes.
“I’ve caught it. Baole, follow me!”Chen Qingzi laughed loudly. With a flick of his sleeve, he rolled up Wang Baole and retreated rapidly, heading straight for the central oven.
Little Five and the donkey followed quickly. As for the little black fish, it shuddered, its eyes filled with intense fear. At the same time, it was eager to give it a try. Just as it was about to turn its head to look, Chen Qingzi grabbed it in mid-air, he took it away.
In the blink of an eye, Wang Baole and Chen Qingzi entered the central oven. The place where they had been was instantly filled with rolling clouds and rumbling sounds!
The Unending Heavenly Dao had descended!

chapters.title: Chapter 1155
chapters.content:
Chapter 1155:, reversal of the Moon splitting!
Translator:
549690339
The moment Wang Baole entered the oven with Chen Qingzi, his vision blurred, and he saw everything clearly in the oven in the next moment.
In a certain sense, it was like a world.
The Sky was gray, and the ground was gray. There were no mountains, no rivers, and no plants around. There was only... an extremely dense black fog!
Within the fog, the sound of chains could be heard, and heavy breathing could be heard. It was like a storm that reverberated in all directions. At the same time, there was a strong suppressive force that continued to spread out from within the Black Fog, causing Wang Baole to feel.., his heart and mind trembled.
He seemed to have also sensed the return of Wang Baole and Chen Qingzi. The breathing in the fog paused, followed by a shrill scream.
“Kill me!”
“Kill me!”
“Kill me!”
The voice reverberated in the air, shaking Wang Baole’s mind. His cultivation was on the verge of collapse, and his body was trembling. He almost lost his balance. In that instant, Wang Baole was astounded, he had guessed the identity of the person who had screamed from within the fog.
“Moon-splitting divine emperor!”Wang Baole’s eyes shone with a strange light. He knew that there were only five divine emperors left in the never-ending clan. Other than patriarch never-ending, one of the remaining four was moon-splitting, the other was the mystic flower from outside.
These were the elites of the mountain in the Wei Yang Dao Domain. Any one of them would be able to intimidate the myriad sect clans. They were undoubtedly important figures.
But now... Such an important figure was screaming and begging for death. It could be seen from this... how shockingly powerful his senior brother was!
In the past, Wang Baole had heard that his senior brother had killed a divine emperor, but he didn’t have much of an idea. However, now that his cultivation had reached his level, he was able to understand the divine emperor’s realm and how terrifying it was. Therefore, when he recalled the rumors he had heard.., the shock in his heart grew stronger.
......
Senior brother, what cultivation level does he have? is he really only in the galaxy? Wang Baole looked at his senior brother, Chen Qingzi, who was beside him.
The instant he looked over, the fog in the gray starry sky outside the oven churned violently, and a terrifying aura erupted.
As it erupted, it formed a vortex that moved at high speed, heading straight for the center of the Gray Starry Sky.
As the vortex closed in, all of the remaining green threads in the gray starry sky seemed to be incredibly excited as they rapidly closed in and fused into the vortex.
However, as they fused into the vortex, furious roars could be heard coming from within. It was as if the Unending Heavenly Dao within the vortex was becoming more and more aware of the aura he had lost.
As the roars echoed out, a large amount of natural law and power of laws spread out from within the vortex, filling the entire gray starry sky. It was as if a huge net had been formed, and when it collided with the aura of death in the area, a large amount of aura of death seemed to evaporate, it dissipated rapidly.
As it did, the gray starry sky became less blurry, and gradually became clearer. At the same time, the cultivators on the periphery were shocked beyond belief, and wanted to flee, however, it was very difficult for them to escape from the tyranny of the Unending Heavenly Dao. When they came into contact with the power of laws and natural laws, they would immediately be sucked dry.
The Heavenly Dao was merciless!
This was especially true in the face of his rage. All life was his food, and even the remaining cultivators of the myriad sect clans couldn’t escape his wrath.
Even Xuan Hua, who had been following closely behind him, kept berating him, but it was to no avail. After being heavily injured and sensing that his natural enemy was in front of him, the Unending Heavenly Dao went completely mad and erupted with ferocity.
This was also the reason why Xuan Hua had stopped him from descending. After all, this was a third objective. Once Heavenly Dao arrived, there would be too much slaughter. Although the Wei Yang clan could accept it, it would be detrimental to their plan.
However, it was too late now. The gray starry sky was rapidly thinning, and everything within was gradually becoming clearer. The cultivators of the myriad sect clans outside immediately saw Wei Yang Heavenly Dao’s indiscriminate slaughter!
A fierce gleam appeared in the eyes of everyone present, but... There was nothing they could do. They could only remain silent.
In the silence of the outside world, the Unending Heavenly Dao let out a roar and transformed into a vortex that shot toward the central baking furnace. As soon as it arrived, its natural law and natural law began to spread out in all directions, as it surrounded the baking furnace, it also spread out to surround the chosen from the various sects who had been unconscious. They were second only to the first echelon.
Thankfully, Xuan Hua had been fast enough to save them. Otherwise, the casualties would have been even greater.
“Dammit!”Xuan Hua’s face was grim. Although the spell formation in the Gray Starry Sky had been broken quite a bit, it was still too far from what the Wei Yang clan had planned.
“How did this happen? How did the aura of the Wei Yang Heavenly Dao disappear! ? ! ?”Xuan Hua’s heart was filled with hatred. The main reason for the deviation in her plan was because of the massive disappearance of the Wei Yang Heavenly Dao’s aura.
If not for this, the Weiyang Heavenly Dao wouldn’t have sent an avatar down in a fit of rage!
At the same time, in the central oven, Chen Qingzi threw his head back and laughed loudly as the Weiyang Heavenly Dao charged towards him. His eyes shone with an intense light. He raised his right hand and waved it. Immediately, Wang Baole, who was beside him.., he saw the thick black fog shrink instantly and charge towards... the little black fish!
It was as if it had been forcefully poured into the little black fish’s body, causing its body to rapidly expand. As it was poured into the little black fish, the area that was originally filled with black fog also became clear, a figure that was bound by many chains was revealed.
In the next instant, after all the Black Fog was sucked away by the little black fish, an aura that far surpassed the aura from before spread out from the little black fish’s body. At the same time, it became even larger.., on its body... Threads of laws and principles began to appear!
They looked the same as the laws and principles of the Weiyang Heavenly Dao, but their essence was completely different!
The appearance of these threads immediately suppressed Wang Baole’s own laws and principles. The only things that were not suppressed were the time laws and the power of the dao stars contained in his waning moon.
Other than that, his nine quasi-daos and the tens of thousands of special stars dimmed. However, at the same time, the dark fire within Wang Baole’s body seemed to be nourished. It erupted instantly and spread throughout Wang Baole’s entire body, it also spread to the quasi-daos and the tens of thousands of special stars, causing them... to regain their original form as if the laws and laws had been replaced!
Not only that, Wang Baole could clearly sense that all the divine abilities and spells he had learned in the never-ending dao domain were about to melt as they were being replaced, it was as if the never-ending Heavenly Dao and the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao didn’t fuse together, resulting in only one type of Heavenly Dao laws and laws in a person’s body!
The intense repulsion and conflict shook Wang Baole’s mind. He was about to make a choice when... suddenly, the intrinsic scabbard in his body shook violently, as if it was suppressing something, it instantly suppressed the will of the Unending Heavenly Dao and the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao, forcing them to coexist within Wang Baole’s body.
It was a long story, but it all happened in an instant. Chen Qingzi tilted his head and glanced at Wang Baole. There was a strange look in his eyes, but he didn’t say anything. Instead, he raised his right hand and formed a seal, pointing at the bound Moon splitter.
“Reverse the Dao!”
As soon as he said that, moon splitter’s screams grew even more painful. Black appeared on his body, and it spread rapidly throughout his entire body. As it spread, waves of the dark sect’s aura erupted from his body.
“Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao, the ladder has been set up. Why aren’t you returning to your position?”Chen Qingzi shouted again. Immediately, the little black fish, which had grown much larger, let out a joyful cry. It dashed towards Moon splitter and closed in on him in an instant, it drilled directly into the center of his brows.
Almost at the instant it drilled in, Lie Yue’s miserable cry became even more shrill. As his body trembled intensely, the black color spread even faster. At this moment, a roaring sound came from the sky, and the enormous figure of the golden beetle appeared.
It did not really enter. Instead, it spat out a large amount of black hair outside the oven, causing it to drill into the oven and pour into... lie Yue’s divine emperor’s body!
The Unending Heavenly Dao could allow the divine emperor to fall, but it couldn’t allow the divine emperor to be reversed. If it was reversed, it would be a fundamental injury to it.
Chen Qingzi didn’t panic when he saw this. Instead, he laughed loudly.
“Baole, your destiny has arrived!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1156
chapters.content:
Chapter 1156: — Chen Qingzi’s plan!
Translator:
549690339
Chen Qingzi laughed out loud. He swung his sleeve, and a powerful force immediately swept Wang Baole toward the moon-splitting emperor. In an instant, Wang Baole was behind the moon-splitting emperor!
The pressure from the moon-splitting emperor was terrifying, but to a certain extent, it was the safest place to be. This was especially so when the situation was reversed. The broken rules that belonged to the moon-splitting emperor continued to emanate from his body.
These rules were a great supplement to Wang Baole’s natal scabbard!
During the transformation, a large amount of death qi also spread out. Wang Baole held back from inhaling it. Instead, he stared at the divine emperor as he was transformed.
To him, this was the greatest serendipity. If he could comprehend it, his soul and cultivation would increase!
At that moment, Wang Baole had more than half understood his senior brother Chen Qingzi’s plan!
He was fishing for the Weiyang Heavenly Dao, and his goal was to use the Weiyang Heavenly Dao to nourish the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao. He wanted to raise the dark sect’s heavenly dao high up in the sky as if it had been upgraded, allowing it to stand tall in the Weiyang Dao Domain.
That would mean that the two great heavenly dao would coexist in the Weiyang Dao Domain!
Once it was done, it would mean that the dark sect’s techniques would no longer be suppressed like before. The Dark Sect’s hidden descendants would be able to reappear and be protected by the Heavenly Dao!
Naturally, they wouldn’t be a match for the Wei Yang clan. However, as long as the Heavenly Dao wasn’t destroyed, the dark sect’s existence wouldn’t truly disappear. It would be extremely difficult to destroy the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao, which had been upgraded and integrated into the Wei Yang Dao Domain, it wasn’t something that could be done easily.
Wang Baole was extremely shaken by this plan. He hadn’t expected his senior brother to be so crazy. It was obvious that he wanted the revived dark sect’s Heavenly Dao to be upgraded and become one of the Heavenly Dao in the Dao Domain, other than absorbing the power of the Unending Heavenly Dao, he also needed a method to lift the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao into nothingness.
This was equally difficult. That was why... The Moon splitting divine emperor had reversed the situation!
He had raised the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao at the price of sacrificing a divine emperor!
......
If news of this spread, it would definitely be sensational and cause a stir in the entire unending dao domain. That was especially so after Wang Baole analyzed the situation. His senior brother had first wanted to reverse the moon splitting and severely injure the unending heavenly dao so that it would have a chance to reveal itself, then, he would sacrifice the moon-splitting spell to complete the upgrade of the Heavenly Dao.
What a grand plan! Wang Baole’s breathing quickened. He didn’t believe that his senior brother had come up with all of this on the spot. He even tried to recall what had happened. Wang Baole felt that... Perhaps this was his senior brother, Chen Qingzi.., he had started this plan a long time ago!
First, he would weaken the Weiyang clan step by step. Then, he would give them a chance to lure the moon-splitting spell into attacking them. Then, he would suppress it in the opposite direction, but he wouldn’t kill them. Instead, he would slowly draw attention from all directions, until the rescue of the Weiyang clan and the arrival of the Heavenly Dao arrived.
That means... there might be other... dark sect cultivators hiding in the outside world! Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. As he made his judgment, he felt that there was a high chance that his guess was correct.
After all, this matter was too big for the dark sect. Even if his senior brother was confident, this was the never-ending DAO domain, after all. There had to be other preparations.
As Wang Baole thought about this, he heard the shrill cry of the moon splitting being reversed. His mind was shaken, and his thoughts were interrupted. His eyes shone brightly. In the sky, the golden beetle formed by the Weiyang Heavenly Dao.., it let out an extremely angry roar and released a large amount of Heavenly Dao power to prevent the moon splitting from being reversed.
At the same time, behind the golden beetle, the sky distorted, revealing a tall figure. That figure... was the mystic flower deity emperor. He stood there, his gaze landing on Chen Qingzi.
“Chen Qingzi!”
“The Weiyang clan has treated you well,”Xuan Hua said slowly. “Why do you have to do this? !”Her voice was like Heavenly Thunder, rumbling out in all directions. It was as if she could say anything she wanted, and the power of countless natural laws and natural laws were formed, they transformed into threads that wrapped around Chen Qingzi’s body.
It was as if the Weiyang Heavenly Dao had been blessed. As it roared, it increased its aura, causing the seemingly irreversibly transformed moon splitter to tremble. The power of the transformation slowly came to a halt, as if it was about to be reversed!
“I once did something wrong and wanted to repent.”Chen Qingzi sighed. After laughing self-deprecatingly, he took a huge gulp from the wine flask in his right hand. After which, he formed an incantation gesture and pointed out. Instantly, the wooden sword beside him emitted a resplendent light, it formed a sword light that seemed to be able to tear apart the starry skies and intimidate the entire universe. It shot towards Xuan Hua with a thunderous roar.
At the same time, Chen Qingzi’s laughter gradually grew louder. He took one step at a time and stepped into the void.
“When the heavens and earth separate, the cycle of fate stops...”
“If you wish to know the cause of your past life, the one who will receive it in this life is...”
“If you wish to know the fruits of your next life, the one who will do it in this life is...”Chen Qingzi’s ancient dark ballad rang out from Chen Qingzi’s mouth. His laughter made Wang Baole unable to tell whether he was crying or laughing.
He only saw Chen Qingzi walking out of the dark ballad, step by step, towards the oven where the mystic flower was located.
The next moment, the dark ballad was still reverberating. Chen Qingzi had already walked out of the oven. Outside the oven, he swung his sword down. The entire gray starry sky rumbled, as if it had been sliced apart in an instant.
The mystic flower retreated. Her expression was grim. She shouted in a low voice.
“Chen Qingzi, the destruction of the dark sect is inevitable. Weiyang has returned, and you know that it can not be reversed!”Chen Qingzi picked up the wine flagon and took another big gulp of wine. He shook his head, and a look of madness appeared in his eyes.
“So Noisy!”Chen Qingzi laughed heartily, and once again swung his sword at the retreating Xuan Hua!
The starry sky rumbled, and the entire area trembled. The cultivators of the myriad sects and clans all fell back. They saw a sword light, and in front of that sword light, they saw Xuan Hua, who had revealed Weiyang’s true body, and... behind that sword light.., chen Qingzi was walking towards them step by step!
His long robes fluttered in the wind. He was dressed in green robes and held a wine gourd!
At that moment, Chen Qingzi, even if he wasn’t a woman, could be described as a peerless beauty!
Amidst the rumbles, a great battle erupted!
As the battle raged in the outside world, in the oven, Wang Baole’s good fortune was suddenly activated. As his mystic essence was blocked and the support from Wei Yang’s Heavenly Dao disappeared, the transformation on lie Yue’s body began once again.
It was slow, but it continued. During the transformation process, the Dao rhythm that spread out from moon splitter’s body was rapidly absorbed by Wang Baole. The shattered rules also rushed towards Wang Baole’s natal scabbard.
During this process, the power from the Heavenly Dao Weiyang was also used to support moon splitter. However, due to Wang Baole’s position and the absorption, a portion of it was drawn over.
In that instant, Wang Baole’s figure rumbled. His soul, his cultivation, and the power of his physical body were all erupting at the same time. They were all rising!
This kind of opportunity could be said to be beyond ordinary serendipity. That was because there was basically no serendipity that could be compared to the dao charm that could reverse a divine emperor.
There was also no serendipity. It was more important than the power of rules that was released when the two Heavenly Dao were fighting against each other.
Every invisible clash between them was a clash of different laws and laws. Wang Baole was the only one who was close. His absorption and comprehension of the laws had reached an unbelievable level.
Therefore, in a short period of time, his soul had reached the peak of the late-stage star realm. His cultivation had also soared from the mid-stage star realm to the peak of the mid-stage.
As his cultivation and soul had increased, the immortal energy in his body had grown stronger and more powerful. Behind him, Dao Stars had appeared. Nine quasi-dao stars had appeared, and tens of thousands of special stars had appeared.
Behind the star map, Wang Baole’s shadows from his previous life had also appeared. They were all being absorbed. Finally... an illusory black wooden board had appeared!
This time, I will definitely have one soul, cultivation, and physical body step into the star domain. I will strive to have all three step into the star domain... if not, I will have to have at least two step into the star domain! Wang Baole’s eyes were filled with determination, he absorbed crazily in this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
—
I was very touched last night. I felt mixed emotions and warmth at the same time. I thank the fellow Daoists from the Nine Peaks, the Ark, the Gargamel, and the other fellow Daoists who have comforted and supported me. Thank you!
All these years, I have been touched by you every single time I wrote a book. It also made me feel that everything was wonderful on the path of writing a book. I will adjust my state as soon as possible. Thank you!

chapters.title: Chapter 1157
chapters.content:
Chapter 1157: There was something wrong with chapter 1157!
Translator:
549690339
The improvement of his soul, the leap in his cultivation, and the continued strengthening of his physical body made Wang Baole realize that he had to seize this opportunity. He also knew very well that... it wouldn’t be long!
The transformation of the Moon splitter divine emperor was now sixty percent complete. Even though the process was slow, the sky above them was showing signs of cracking. It was the Unending Heavenly Dao outside. It had gone mad and was charging madly.
If not for the fact that the oven had been strengthened countless times by his senior brother, Chen Qingzi, the Unending Heavenly Dao would have blasted it into the oven long ago.
Even if the Unending Heavenly Dao had entered, it wouldn’t have treated me as its first target... Wang Baole thought to himself as he controlled the intrinsic scabbard in his body. He adjusted it slightly, allowing the two Heavenly Dao laws in his body to.., he could suppress one side at any time, allowing the other side to take the lead. He would feel more at ease.
However, as he absorbed and improved, he was also thinking about another matter. That Was... how should he leave this place.
According to Wang Baole’s judgment, just as he had guessed that there were other people from the dark sect, he didn’t believe that only one divine emperor had come from the endless clan. Therefore, the upcoming battle would be even more intense.
He, on the other hand, might have a unique opportunity, but he was at the center. Therefore, he had to consider when and how he should leave. However, just as Wang Baole was distracted and analyzing the matter, suddenly, from his storage bag.., a strand of divine thought emerged from the leaf that had used up a portion of its power and entered his mind.
“My dear disciple, this is a rare opportunity. Go ahead and absorb it. I will think of a way to bring you out of this vortex later!”
“That senior brother of yours doesn’t want to be a son. In order to revive the dark sect, he doesn’t have the strength to bring you out. However, with me around, I’m the person closest to you.”There was a hint of pride in the Moon Splitting Patriarch’s voice, it reverberated in Wang Baole’s mind.
Hearing his master’s voice, a smile appeared on Wang Baole’s face. He didn’t care about his master’s displeasure towards his senior brother, Chen Qingzi. He nodded and calmed down. He took a deep breath, he focused all his energy on absorbing the Dao rhythm law that emanated from the transformation of the split moon.
Wang Baole continued to absorb the law. The battle in the outside world had reached an intense stage. Even though the mystic flower deity Emperor was powerful, he was still lacking when compared to Chen Qingzi!
This was related to Chen Qingzi’s expertise in killing. It was also related to the existence of the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao. The dark art had been enhanced, and the area of impact from the battle between the two in the starry skies grew larger and larger.
The surrounding starry skies continued to shatter, and the moon-splitting reversal reached seventy percent. The moment it reached seventy percent, Wang Baole’s soul rumbled, and he broke through from the late-stage of the Star Realm to the perfected star realm!
......
At the same time, the barrier of the oven could no longer withstand the unending Heavenly Dao’s madness. It was knocked open, and the sound of shattering reverberated. The gigantic golden beetle turned into a sea of light, it was about to charge through the gap.
However, it was at that moment that a cold snort rang out from the void. Ripples spread out in the air, and seven figures appeared out of thin air in the starry sky outside the kiln!
They were all dressed in black robes, and their auras of death towered up into the sky. At the same time, underworld flames erupted from their bodies, and as they burned, they attacked simultaneously in an attempt to stop the Unending Heavenly Dao.
As he roared, his back suddenly split open, and laughter rang out. A middle-aged man walked out from the split back. He was dressed in an imperial robe and wore an imperial crown, his cultivation base fluctuations surged up into the sky. They surpassed the power of the stars, the power of the galaxy, and... a shocking aura that seemed to be even stronger than Xuan Hua’s!
“Divine emperor Di Shan!”
Almost at the same time that the person appeared, the seven black-robed men in the area immediately let out hoarse voices. However, they did not retreat. Instead, they continued to attack with all their might to suppress him.
As they tried to stop him, the shattered kiln wall began to rapidly close up. Just as the gap was about to disappear, Wei Yang Heavenly Dao, who had been stopped, let out a roar, and his body flickered, a smaller clone appeared once again. It didn’t care about anything else. The moment the hole was about to disappear, it dove into the hole!
The seven black-robed men were about to stop them, but they were stopped by the divine emperor Di Shan. The battle raged in the outside world, and inside the oven, Wang Baole was shocked.
Even though he had already made a judgment, he was still shocked when he saw with his own eyes the appearance of a second divine emperor. At the same time, he sensed the strong dark sect aura and the sense of antiquity from the seven black-robed men.
They’ve all appeared? Wang Baole’s breathing quickened. However, he didn’t have time to think about it. The moment the smaller golden beetle formed by the Heavenly Dao Weiyang charged into the gap and descended into the world inside the oven.., wang Baole didn’t hesitate to activate the intrinsic scabbard in his body. He quickly suppressed all the laws and laws of the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao, making the part of his body that belonged to the Heavenly Dao Weiyang become everything.
As a result, the aura on his body changed instantly. At the moment of the change, the golden beetle that had been charging towards him from the unending heavenly dao seemed to hesitate. However, in the next instant, it exploded with speed, it ignored Wang Baole and charged towards the moon-splitting divine emperor.
It was as if the moon-splitting divine emperor was as bright as the sun in its eyes. In the blink of an eye, the golden beetle approached the moon-splitting divine emperor.
It instantly fused into the moon-splitting divine emperor’s body and collided with the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao!
Amidst the rumbling, Wang Baole’s breathing quickened. He didn’t know if what he had done earlier had worked, but the result was still acceptable. After a moment of hesitation, he quickly released the suppression from his natal scabbard and began to absorb it again.
That was because... within the moon-splitting divine emperor’s body, as the two Heavenly Dao clashed, the moon-splitting divine emperor’s roar grew even more shrill. It exuded more dao charm and shattered rules. At the same time, Wang Baole was from the Dark clan, after all. As his eyes flashed.., he began to quickly control his natal scabbard to absorb the aura from the Weiyang Heavenly Dao.
Wang Baole’s improvement grew even faster. His physical strength had reached the hundred steps of the perfected star realm. He had a strong feeling that his physical body was accumulating power.
It was... the power to break through the stars and step into the celestial domain realm!
In his star map, all the stars were shining and evolving. It was the same in his previous life. However, in the next moment, Wang Baole could clearly sense that the dao aura emanating from the moon-splitting divine emperor was decreasing!
That was because, as the Unending Heavenly Dao fused with the moon-splitting divine emperor, and as the two Heavenly Dao within the moon-splitting divine emperor’s soul clashed, if they were evenly matched, it would be difficult to determine who would emerge victorious. That would result in an intense battle. Naturally, Wang Baole would absorb the most, but now... The Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao had just awakened and was no match for it!
It could be seen with the naked eye that it was being suppressed. Due to the death Qi on the moon splitting divine emperor’s body, it was retreating rapidly. It had grown from seventy to eighty percent before, and now, it had grown back to fifty percent. It was even continuing.., it had grown to forty percent, thirty percent, twenty percent..
Eventually, it had grown to ten percent. The Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao seemed to be barely able to defend itself, unable to resist and reverse the situation. The moon splitting divine emperor’s eyelids were trembling as well, as if it was about to awaken!
Wang Baole’s expression changed drastically when he saw this. However, he also felt that this was strange. Based on his previous judgment, his senior brother had planned this for a long time. There shouldn’t have been such a change.
However, what he saw was indeed the case.
Fortunately, in the next moment, the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao erupted once again. It was as if it was going all out to fight back. At that moment, a faint voice suddenly rang out from outside the oven, from the starry skies above all the combatants.
“Chen Qingzi, you’ve lost.”As the voice echoed out, a three-headed, six-armed giant appeared in the starry sky. As soon as it appeared, a towering pressure spread out.
“Divine emperor of light!”
Outside the furnace, Chen Qingzi was still smiling, but his expression was a bit unsightly. “The three of you actually came. interesting. From the looks of it, that primordial ancestor of yours from never ending is also here, right?”.
“There’s no need for the patriarch to come personally. The three of us are more than enough to suppress you and the remnants of the dark sect,”the glowing man said calmly. Then, he lifted his right hand and... pushed it down toward the kiln!
The starry sky trembled, and rumbling sounds filled the air. The seven black-robed men from the dark sect outside the kiln trembled violently, and blood sprayed out of their mouths as they exploded. At the same time, the newly restored barrier on the kiln could no longer withstand the pressure, and collapsed!
“Heavenly Dao, why aren’t you devouring the Dark Dao in Lie Yue’s body and waking lie yue up?”
As the barrier shattered, the golden beetle formed by the Unending Heavenly Dao let out a loud cheer. Without any hesitation, it charged towards lie yue, whose eyelids were trembling violently!
Wang Baole watched the scene unfold before his eyes, and his heart pounded. He didn’t know why, but he had a vague feeling... that something wasn’t right!

chapters.title: Chapter 1158
chapters.content:
Chapter 1158: Who Is The Heavenly Dao!
Translator:
549690339
This matter shouldn’t be so simple!
Senior brother Chen Qingzi shouldn’t have been so careless!
This matter couldn’t have failed just like that!
It would have been fine if it had been a sudden and temporary plan, but it was clearly not the case. This was something Chen Qingzi had planned for a long time. If that was the case, how could senior brother not have thought of the Weiyang clan stopping him?
How could he not know that the person who had appeared was definitely not just a divine emperor?
Therefore, even now, Wang Baole still felt that there was something wrong with this matter!
Just as Wang Baole’s mind was shaken, Chen Qingzi, who was outside the oven, was clearly anxious. His body flashed, and he was about to rush towards the oven, but he was stopped by the mystic essence. At the same time, the light figure of the Weiyang clan in the starry sky.., he sneered and raised his right hand, suppressing Chen Qingzi.
A loud boom rang out. Even Chen Qingzi, who was as powerful as him, was unable to escape in an instant. Under the suppression, he spat out the first mouthful of blood he had ever spat out in battle.
As he spat out the blood, the golden beetle formed by the Wei Yang Heavenly Dao in the oven approached the moon splitter divine emperor with malevolence, greed, and excitement. Nothing unexpected happened as Wang Baole had predicted, in the blink of an eye... it burrowed into the moon-splitting divine emperor’s body!
“No!”Chen Qingzi let out a roar in the distant starry sky. His hair was disheveled, and he was about to charge forward again. However, the Wei Yang clan’s divine emperor light and Divine Emperor Xuan Hua attacked at the same time. They suppressed him once again, causing Chen Qingzi to spit out another mouthful of blood.
In the oven, the moment the Wei Yang Heavenly Dao fused into the moon-splitting divine emperor’s body, the ever vigilant divine emperor Di Shan, who was in the area where the oven’s walls were damaged, seemed to heave a sigh of relief. He hadn’t participated in Chen Qingzi’s battle. His role.., was to prevent any other unforeseen events from happening.
Seeing that everything was going smoothly, the divine emperor Di Shan laughed coldly. He stepped into the oven and walked towards the moon splitter. He had already seen the final ten percent of the death Qi on the moon splitter divine emperor’s body dissipate rapidly as the unending heavenly dao fused into it, it was dissipating rapidly.
There was no way to stop it. The power of the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao was being suppressed endlessly. Just as it was about to disappear completely, Wang Baole suddenly realized something. He looked at the battered Chen Qingzi outside the oven and suppressed his emotions, he didn’t look at the moon-splitting divine emperor.
......
A bold answer appeared in his heart. If the answer was real, it would explain everything that had happened.
As Wang Baole’s bold guess appeared in his heart, the death aura around the moon-splitting divine emperor was suppressed until there was only a little bit left. His eyelids stopped trembling, and he slowly... opened them!
The moment his eyes opened, divine emperor Di Shan, who was walking over step by step, suddenly narrowed his eyes. His expression changed. He was about to retreat, but it was too late.
A sigh came from the moon splitting divine emperor’s mouth.
“What a pity. Why didn’t Weiyang’s primordial Lord Come? What a pity, Di Shan. Why didn’t you come in your true form?”As he spoke, a streak of sword light shot up into the sky. It was so long that it seemed to span across the galaxy, and it shook the heavens and earth, a sword light that shook the entire starry sky erupted from moon-splitting divine emperor’s body and retreated forward. Di Shan, whose expression had already changed drastically, suddenly slashed out!
This slash was extremely resplendent, as if it had replaced all the light in the starry sky. It also contained an indescribable dao rhythm and laws. It was as if... This sword had gathered the power of the entire universe!
Or more accurately, it had gathered... The Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao power!
The sword light swept across, causing the starry sky to shake. Di Shan’s body trembled violently. He stared at the Moon splitter divine emperor and spoke slowly.
“Aren’t you...”before he could finish his words, his body exploded with a loud bang. He disintegrated into pieces and exploded.
Divine Emperor Di Shan had fallen!
However, it wasn’t his actual body that had fallen. It was his dao body. Even so, the impact on divine emperor Di Shan was equally great. As the dao body disintegrated, a large amount of nomological and nomological power spread out in all directions, it was as if mountains and seas were toppling in all directions. Wang Baole was so excited that his breathing quickened, and his eyes shone brightly.
In his eyes, the deathly aura that had been suppressed to the point where there was only a tiny bit of it left exploded in an instant. With a loud boom, it countered the Weiyang Heavenly Dao in his body, and the Weiyang Heavenly Dao seemed to scream as well, it wanted to escape from Lie Yue’s body, but it was clearly impossible!
If it was in the outside world, the Unending Heavenly Dao might still have its advantages. However, in Lie Yue’s body, it didn’t have any chance. It was being absorbed... by Lie Yue with the naked eye!
That’s right. It was being absorbed. More accurately, it was being... devoured!
I understand now! A complicated look appeared in Wang Baole’s eyes. As waves of emotions surged in his heart, the divine emperor of light and the Divine Emperor of mystic flower outside the oven were also shocked by the scene. The two of them retreated rapidly, their eyes filled with bewilderment, however, in the next instant, as they realized what was happening, their expressions turned ugly. However, they couldn’t hide their shock. They looked at Chen Qingzi, who had been suppressed by them, and then looked at Moon Splitter, who was walking out of the oven step by step.
“You are not moon splitter!”
“Of course, I Am Not Moon splitter. I Am Chen Qingzi,”moon splitter, who was walking towards the starry sky, said softly in the oven. As he spoke, his appearance changed, in the next instant, he transformed back into Chen Qingzi’s appearance.
Chen Qingzi, who had been suppressed by the Divine Emperors of light and Xuan Hua, also had a change in his appearance. He turned withered. It was... Moon splitter!
However, his eyes were lifeless, and his body was filled with an aura of death!
“At the same time, I am still... The Heavenly Dao!”The instant Chen Qingzi spoke softly, his aura erupted once again. With a boom, his aura swept across the starry sky, suppressing everything in its path. It was even on his forehead, the mark of the black fish appeared!
At this moment, Xuan Hua and Guang Ming’s expressions once again changed.
“It’s all fake... After lie Yue was defeated by me a few years ago, I transformed him into the dark sect... everything was just a show to lure you all to come and rescue him, to lure the Heavenly Dao of Wei Yang to descend
“The Heavenly Dao that has been revived... is not what you think it is. It was only formed by a wisp of spiritless will that I split. The True Heavenly Dao that has been revived is the Heavenly Dao that has been awakened in my body. I am the Heavenly Dao of the dark sect, the sealed emissary of this generation of the Wei Yang clan and this world
“Luo Tian may have fallen, but the mission of the Dark clan is still there. The stone tablet realm will naturally have to be suppressed.”
“Originally, I wanted to attract the mysterious ancestor of the Wei Yang clan. I wanted to know whether he was an immortal or... the so-called clone of the Celestial Emperor. Unfortunately, he didn’t come,”Chen Qingzi said softly, the light and Xuan Hua’s expressions changed drastically once again.
Wang Baole’s heart was pounding, and his pupils constricted slightly. He retracted his gaze in silence. He no longer paid attention to the battle in the starry skies. Instead, he used all his strength to absorb the divine emperor Di Shan’s dao body after his death, the endless rhymes all around.
His cultivation, the rapid rise, his body, the crazy accumulation of explosive power, his soul, also in the infinite growth!
The first to break through was his cultivation. As his physical body and soul grew stronger, it became easier for him to break through. As the many special stars behind him became stars.., wang Baole’s cultivation rumbled. He went from the mid-stage of a star to the late-stage of a Star!
The next to break through was his soul. As he absorbed the Dao rhythm and continued to comprehend it, he advanced from the late-stage of a star to the perfected stage. Even though it was only two or three steps, he was still at the Perfected Stage!
The final breakthrough... was in his physical body. After he had accumulated enough power, the entire world seemed to rumble in his heart. An indescribable, powerful force erupted from his body!
His physical body... the galaxy!
Amidst the rumble, powerful ripples spread from his body. They swept outwards in an overwhelming manner. As they rolled endlessly, Wang Baole opened his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1159
chapters.content:
Chapter 1159:, receiving!
Translator:
549690339
The moment Wang Baole opened his eyes, lightning seemed to flash across his eyes. The laws and laws belonging to the Unending Heavenly Dao arrived and wrapped around his body, they turned into ancient runic symbols and imprinted themselves into his body.
This was the recognition given by the Heavenly Dao to the celestial domain realm. It was one of the rules governing the operation of the Heavenly Dao. However, Wang Baole didn’t only have the aura of the Unending Heavenly Dao in his body. He also had the will of the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao. Therefore, in the next instant.., the laws and rules contained within the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao descended once again, imprinting themselves on his body.
This double reinforcement caused Wang Baole’s physical body to rumble. Waves of even more powerful power erupted continuously within his body, forming a blood qi that seemed to be able to overturn the heavens. It spread in all directions, cracks appeared in the surrounding void. It was as if his existence had already affected the operation of the starry skies.
This was the terrifying aspect of being a mighty figure in the galaxy!
Normally speaking, cultivators in the galaxy would arrive first with their cultivation, followed by their souls. It was very difficult for their physical bodies to reach perfection. Even though it had some effect on the operation of the starry skies, their cultivation would be able to suppress the effect.
However, Wang Baole was the complete opposite. His cultivation was only at the late-stage of the star realm. Even though his soul had reached perfection, he had only taken a few steps. He was far from reaching the galaxy. His physical body was the only one who had stepped into the galaxy ahead of time, this created some incongruities.
More importantly, Wang Baole was equipped with the rules and laws of the two Heavenly Dao. This would create a conflict. If it had been anyone else, it would have been difficult for them to withstand this conflict. They would have exploded and died.
However, Wang Baole’s natal scabbard had the power of suppression and neutralization. It was activated instantly. With a loud boom, it suppressed the power of the two Heavenly Dao, forcing them to merge and coexist.
That was the only problem that had been solved. However... the effect on the starry skies and the surrounding void was constantly being torn apart. It couldn’t be erased in a short period of time, unless Wang Baole’s cultivation had increased as well, or perhaps there was a powerful figure to cover it up.
That powerful figure... appeared very quickly.
More accurately speaking, the moment Wang Baole’s physical body stepped into the galaxy and the surrounding void was affected, he had already descended. It was... The Blazing Flame ancestor!
Using the leaf that he had given Wang Baole as a positioning device, the blazing flame ancestor didn’t come in person, but his divine thoughts had already descended and enveloped Wang Baole’s surroundings. It shielded Wang Baole, and at the same time.., it also neutralized the abnormality caused by his breakthrough.
There were many cultivators from the myriad sect clans here, but most of them were far away. Chen Qingzi’s radiance was too bright, and the reversal shook the entire area. That was why no one paid attention to Wang Baole. Even the two divine emperors did the same.
......
After all... Chen Qingzi was the one who shone the brightest in the area. With the help of the blazing flame ancestor, Wang Baole’s breakthrough seemed shocking, but no one paid any attention to it.
In the next instant, the air around Wang Baole distorted, and his figure disappeared without a trace... when he reappeared, he was no longer in the oven. Instead, he was beside the blazing flame ancestor. Xie Haiyang was also there, he looked at Wang Baole, then at Chen Qingzi, his eyes still filled with shock.
He had never suspected that Wang Baole would be able to speak to Chen Qingzi, but he had never expected that the relationship between the two of them would be even closer than before.
If he still didn’t know Wang Baole’s identity as a member of the dark sect, he wouldn’t be Xie Haiyang.
As for Wang Baole, after he was teleported out, he was stunned at first. Then, he immediately understood and sat down cross-legged. At the same time, the other cultivators from the myriad sect clans also started using similar techniques, they secretly brought out most of their disciples who hadn’t died after entering the array formation. They all retreated quickly. The changes in this place were too great. It wouldn’t be beneficial for them to continue staying here, instead, they would be affected easily.
“Old Bull, why aren’t you taking us away?”Seeing that his disciple was smart and calm after being led out by him, the blazing flame ancestor smiled and immediately slapped the divine bull with his sleeve. The divine bull immediately retreated, it charged into the distance.
Wang baole blinked. He really wanted to tell his master that he didn’t need to slap the Divine Bull, and he didn’t need to say anything either. Wasn’t the Divine Bull your master..
“Perhaps master has forgotten about it?”Wang baole coughed dryly. As the Divine Bull sped away, he turned to look at his senior brother, Chen Qingzi, who was on the battlefield that had sped off into the distance.
“Stop looking. Your senior brother, who doesn’t deserve to be a human, has gone too far this time. He has turned himself into the Heavenly Dao. From now on... There will be a series of battles between the never-ending clan and the dark sect
“Although you belong to the dark sect, you are still a disciple of the raging flame sect. This karma... it’s inevitable that you will come into contact with it. However, the only thing master can do is to give you a way out.”As the Raging Flame Patriarch spoke, Wang Baole fell silent, he was about to speak after a long while.
“There’s no need to say anything else. I’ve lived for so long. It’s good to see such a lively scene. Besides... I hope that your senior brother, Chen Qingzi, can lead the dark sect to victory. That way, I can vent my anger.”The Raging Flame Patriarch shook his head and smiled, however, the next moment, he frowned.
“However, there’s a slight problem. Even though I feel that no one will notice you, if I think about it carefully, it’s impossible. You... are most likely exposed. However, Chen Qingzi has attracted everyone’s attention, so no one will pay attention to you
“After returning to the blazing flame galaxy, Baole, you will immediately enter seclusion. In the blazing flame galaxy, I would like to see if the never-ending clan will dare to cause trouble for You!”
“Master...”Wang Baole stood up and bowed deeply to the blazing flame ancestor. Guilt rose in his heart. He had no right to interfere with his senior brother’s decision. He had indeed obtained sufficient fortune this time, but he had been exposed because of it, it was not what he had wanted.
However, there was nothing he could do about it. Since he had been exposed, Wang Baole had made preparations. He was also waiting... for Chen Qingzi!
Wang Baole was certain that his senior brother would definitely come and finish what he had exposed. However, his trust, which had always been firm, could not help but waver now.
That was because... his senior brother, who had fused with the Heavenly Dao, or perhaps had transformed into the Heavenly Dao, gave Wang Baole a strange feeling for some reason.
The strange feeling made Wang baole more or less feel complicated.
However, the complicated feeling didn’t last for long. As the Divine Ox charged forward, half a month after leaving the battlefield and on its way back to the raging flame galaxy, the blazing flame ancestor, who had been meditating with his eyes closed, suddenly opened his eyes, a bright light shone in his eyes. The divine ox beneath him suddenly stopped in its tracks. A loud boom rang out from all over its body, and a sea of fire spread out in all directions.
“Chen Qingzi?”
At the same time, Wang Baole sensed something as well. He lifted his head to look at the distant starry sky. He could sense the natural laws and nomological powers that belonged to the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao within his body. They were now vibrating vigorously. Gradually.., a familiar figure appeared out of thin air in the void before his eyes. Step by step, it walked to the edge of the Divine Ox’s Sea of fire.
He had long hair, a green robe, a wine gourd, and a wooden sword.
It was... Chen Qingzi, who had the mark of a black fish on his forehead!
“Thank you, fellow Daoist lie Yan, for taking care of the dark child of our sect.”Chen Qingzi smiled as he cupped his fists and bowed to the blazing flame ancestor.
Lie Yan’s expression was unsightly. He didn’t say a word and merely snorted.
Chen Qingzi didn’t mind. He continued smiling as he looked at Wang Baole. His eyes were filled with gentleness as he spoke softly.
“Baole, are you willing to follow me to the dark sect? Let’s continue on the path we didn’t finish the last time.”
—
The book review section had the title of the Nine Peaks and the monthly ticket starting point. Everyone would pay attention to it when they had the time. I hadn’t participated in it for a long time, so I didn’t really understand it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1160
chapters.content:
Chapter 1160:, the Dark Nether Galaxy!
Translator:
549690339
Wang Baole was silent. The scenes from the battlefield surfaced in his mind. From the beginning to the end, his senior brother Chen Qingzi could have told him the truth.
Even though he hadn’t told him the truth, Wang Baole didn’t hold any grudges. After all, this was related to the dark sect. It wasn’t wrong for his senior brother to be on the safe side.
He had indeed obtained the good fortune himself. Even though there was a risk of being exposed, all of this was inevitable. Unless he didn’t go over, it would be difficult for him to continue hiding.
From start to finish, his senior brother had indeed been extremely protective of him. Even before he left, he had arranged for him to stay behind his true body.
No matter how he looked at it, there was no problem. However, Wang Baole did not know why, but he had a strange feeling that the senior brother in front of him was slightly different from the past him in his memories.
Wang Baole didn’t know the exact reason why he had such a thought. He could only attribute it to... perhaps the integration and revival of the Heavenly Dao had made the senior brother more dignified and less emotional.
Perhaps it’s also a comparison. Wang Baole thought of the blazing flame ancestor. Everything about him, his master, was very real. He could see and feel it clearly. On the other hand, his senior brother... was a little ethereal.
Regardless, Wang Baole didn’t have any distrust towards his senior brother, Chen Qingzi. He still trusted him, because he thought of everything that had happened when he was in the federation. After a long while, Wang Baole made up his mind, he turned around and looked at the blazing flame ancestor.
The Blazing Flame ancestor wanted to say something, but he hesitated.
“Master,”Wang Baole said softly. He didn’t clasp his fists. Instead, he knelt down and kowtowed.
He didn’t say much, but the blazing flame ancestor understood. He sighed softly after a moment of silence.
“Remember what I told you. The Blazing Flame Galaxy is your path of retreat.”
Wang baole nodded. He couldn’t stay in the blazing flame galaxy anymore. If that happened, the dark sect and the Weiyang clan would implicate his master. That wasn’t what he wanted.
......
Furthermore, he had the dark sect’s mark on him. As a dark child, he had a deep connection with the dark sect. He knew that he couldn’t stay out of it.
Furthermore... Wang Baole wanted to become stronger!
If he stayed in the raging flame galaxy, he would lose the opportunity to become stronger. There wasn’t much time left, and the blood-colored centipede would appear again at any moment. Wang Baole had no choice but to take a gamble.
All sorts of reasons made Wang Baole’s conviction settle. He stood up, looked at the cautious Xie Haiyang, and suddenly turned to speak to his senior brother, Chen Qingzi.
“Senior brother, the Moon splitting divine emperor’s array formation oven was refined by the Xie family. Let’s forget about this matter, shall we?”
Chen Qingzi smiled when he heard that. He glanced at Xie Haiyang, who was clearly agitated and nervous after hearing Wang Baole’s words, and nodded.
“The Xie family has nothing to do with this matter.”
As soon as he said that, Xie Haiyang seemed to have lost all his strength. He forced himself to bow deeply to Wang Baole and Chen Qingzi. He was filled with emotion. In reality, when he had been following Wang Baole.., he hadn’t expected Chen Qingzi to set up such a grand scheme in the end, turning himself into the Heavenly Dao.
Even the Xie family had to be careful in the face of such a powerful figure. They might even voluntarily give up on his father’s side. After all, the current situation.., no one was willing to participate in the war between the dark sect’s rise and the Weiyang clan.
“Junior brother, let’s go,”Chen Qingzi said with a smile after settling the matter.
Wang Baole turned around and bowed to the grandmaster, the blazing flame ancestor, once again. He stepped out of the Divine Ox and stepped on the Sea of fire around him. He walked towards his senior brother, Chen Qingzi, step by step. He watched as his disciple slowly left, the Blazing Flame ancestor felt a little downcast. He didn’t know why, but at that moment, he thought of his other disciples who had fallen.
He had a grudge with the Weiyang clan, but he didn’t have the ability to take revenge. He only had a curse on him, and the threat was greater than reality. He wanted to risk everything and explode. Even if he died, he wanted a divine emperor to die with him.
However... he still had many ties to him. He had once been tied to his only surviving second disciple. Now... He had Wang Baole.
That was why he wanted to protect Wang Baole. If this disciple insisted on entering the dark sect, he might as well help. He would risk his life in exchange for a divine emperor.
However, he could tell that Wang Baole wasn’t willing to do that.
In the silence, the blazing flame ancestor stared at Wang Baole, who was beside Chen Qingzi. He suddenly sent a voice transmission to Chen Qingzi.
“He really treats you as an elder brother. Therefore... Chen Qingzi, no matter what plans you have, no matter what your intentions are, if you sacrifice my disciple as the price, I won’t be able to do anything to you. However, I’ll risk my face and Fuse my curse with the Unending Heavenly Dao, strengthening the power of the Unending Heavenly Dao!”
Wang Baole couldn’t hear what Chen Qingzi said, but he saw his senior brother, Chen Qingzi, stop in his tracks.
“I do indeed see little junior brother as my only family member. Chen Qingzi, you’ve done a good job,”Chen Qingzi said softly to the blazing flame ancestor. He smiled at Wang Baole and waved his sleeve, causing a cloud of black fog to disperse, it formed a gigantic black fish and let out a soundless roar toward the starry sky. With a leap, it brought Wang Baole into the void, disappearing without a trace.
After a long while, the blazing flame ancestor finally retracted his gaze. His expression was downcast, and he was unhappy. He seemed to have aged a lot.
Xie Haiyang, who was beside him, saw the blazing flame ancestor in such a state. After some thought, he spoke softly.
“Grandmaster, although Martial Uncle Baole has left, I’m still here...”
“You?”The Blazing Flame ancestor glanced sideways and snorted.
“Shut up!”As he spoke, he waved his right hand, and the Divine Bull beneath him roared and charged forward. They were still heading towards the blazing flame galaxy. Xie Haiyang, who was on the Divine Bull’s back, felt wronged.
As the blazing flame ancestor’s figure gradually disappeared into the starry sky, Wang Baole and Chen Qingzi also disappeared into the void. The cultivators from the myriad sect clan also dispersed and returned to their respective territories, the war at the divine emperor level finally came to an end. At the same time, the details of the war spread.
The Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao had awakened in Chen Qingzi. Chen Qingzi... was the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao.
This news spread like a storm across the entire Weiyang Dao Domain at an extremely fast speed. It caused almost all the clans and sects to feel uneasy. Those who didn’t know about the dark sect also began searching rapidly, as for the clans and sects who knew of the dark sect, endless worry rose up in their hearts.
It was as if a mountain was about to rain. Most of the clans and sects had activated their isolation spell formations and were unwilling to participate. The truth was... the outcome of this battle left everyone shaken.
Moon splitter had fallen, and Di Shan’s dao body had been beheaded. Light and Xuan Hua were unable to do anything to Chen Qingzi. Of the five divine emperors of the Weiyang clan, it seemed that other than the most mysterious primordial ancestor, there was no one else who could pose a threat to Chen Qingzi.
The most mysterious patriarch hadn’t revealed his true form for many years. The only person who had been in charge all year round was his corpse. His Dao name was Jijia, and he represented the patriarch to the outside world.
The entire Weiyang Dao Domain fell into silence as a result. It was like the eve of a storm..
At the same time, in the void, Chen Qingzi’s Heavenly Dao fish, which was half-real and half-illusory, led Wang Baole forward. They weren’t heading towards the three great saint domains in the starry sky. Instead... they were in the void, they continued to sink, Sink, sink..
If the starry skies were to be compared to a piece of paper, with the starry skies and the three great saint domains above it, then under the paper... was the nine serenities abyss.
At that moment, the Heavenly Dao Fish that Chen Qingzi had transformed into brought Wang baole deeper into the nine serenities abyss..
Gradually, they approached... the resting place of the remaining members of the dark sect for many years!
Hades galaxy!

chapters.title: Chapter 1161
chapters.content:
Chapter 1161: — Senior Brother’s silence!
Translator:
549690339
Humans were divided into life and death, and the world was divided into yin and yang.
Even though the Weiyang Dao domain was in reality a stone tablet world formed by Luo Tian’s palm seal, it was still divided in the same way. Otherwise, everything would be incomplete. All living beings would be unable to nourish themselves within it, and the myriad daos wouldn’t be able to exist within it for long, it wouldn’t be able to form a cycle, and it would be difficult for it to be replaced. It wouldn’t be able to operate.
Chen Qingzi and Wang Baole were currently in the ninth Netherworld of the abyss. They had arrived at the death realm of the Weiyang Dao Domain.
There were many names here, such as the death realm, the Netherworld, the ninth Netherworld, and the abyss. Different legends had different names, but to the dark sect, they preferred to call this place... The Netherworld realm!
However, in the end, this place was actually just an anti-starry sky. There were also the laws and rules of the Endless Heavenly Dao in it, but they were just weaker than the living world. In addition, the dark sect had never been wiped out, and over the past tens of thousands of years.., the strict defense of this place had also worn down a lot of the Endless Heavenly Dao in this place.
There was also Chen Qingzi, who had transformed into the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao and entered the endless world together with the Endless Heavenly Dao. This allowed the endless heavenly dao domain to have two heavenly daos. As a result, there was no longer any endless aura in this netherworld realm, instead, it was enveloped by the dense power of the dark sect’s Heavenly Dao.
Although the area of the Netherworld was the same as the living world, there were far fewer galaxies and stars in the Netherworld. There was only... a vast and boundless underworld river with no source to be seen, and no end to it.
This underworld river spanned the entire netherworld. There were countless spots of light in it, densely packed together. It was impossible to count just how many of them there were. There were even more... that were submerged in the underworld river. At a glance, it was enough to make all cultivators.., feel insignificant.
In the middle of the Dark River... There was a single, and only, Star!
The star was huge, but it wasn’t suspended in the air. It was like a small island that stood tall in the Dark River. It continued to exist no matter how the Dark River flowed.
This dark star is the only one left among the 3,000 Great Dao stars of the dark sect. Outside the vast dark river, Chen Qingzi’s figure materialized. Wang Baole stood beside him, unable to hide the shock on his face, his mind was already in a state of shock.
As he walked, he saw the shocking dark river, and he could sense the thick death aura emanating from within it. His own unending Heavenly Dao laws were completely suppressed here, unable to be revealed at all, on the other hand, the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao laws were extremely active. As they spread throughout his body, the dark fire in his body began to burn vigorously. It spread outside his body, forming a dark sea of fire.
“Dark Star?”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. As he spoke softly, he retracted his gaze from the Dark River and looked at the only star. He could sense the ancient aura emanating from it, and he could also sense the presence of the dark sect on this star, there were many ripples of the dark sect’s aura.
......
“Back then, when Wei Yang rebelled and fought against the dark sect, almost all of the 3,000 Great Dao stars of the dark sect were destroyed. The Heavenly Dao perished. As for me... in the years that followed, I used all my methods to repair one of them. I even retrieved its shadow from time and brought it back with the melting star,”Chen Qingzi muttered, they walked towards the Dark River and the Dark Star, one step at a time.
When Wang Baole heard Chen Qingzi’s words, his heart trembled again. He followed silently. The two of them, one at the front and one at the back, were getting closer and closer to the Dark River and the dark star.
Their arrival attracted the attention of the dark sect cultivators on the dark star. Powerful divine senses swept over instantly. A large number of figures rose into the sky from the dark star and rushed towards them.
“Baole, do you know the mission of the Dark Sect?”Chen Qingzi asked softly, ignoring the people who were flying towards them from the Dark Planet.
Wang Baole nodded first, then shook his head. He remained silent.
“The dark sect... is merely an enforcer of the rules.”
“Whose rules?”Wang Baole asked.
“The Weiyang Dao domain is merely a stone tablet. This stone tablet was formed from the palm of a mighty figure from another realm. The Dark Clan Enforcers the rules of this mighty figure.”
“In the past, the underworld sect had always been there. However, they had merged with the laws and secretly controlled them. In this life... because the laws were loosened, the underworld sect appeared and was known to the world
“It was also because of this that the disaster of the destruction of the sect was born. It was also because of this that Weiyang rose again
“However, no matter what, the mission of the Underworld sect is... to maintain the seal so that it can exist forever. No living being... can escape this world!”Chen Qing zi muttered. Reminiscence appeared in his eyes, but soon after, he sighed, he calmed down and spoke slowly.
“You don’t seem surprised by this.”
Wang Baole looked at his senior brother before him. The unfamiliar feeling grew stronger. After a long while, he spoke softly.
“I’ve been to the fated star and learned some secrets of the world. I also learned... that Allheaven has fallen. is the mission of the dark sect important?”
“That is the reason for the existence of the dark sect.”Chen Qingzi spoke calmly. He turned around and gave Wang Baole a deep look. He didn’t continue the topic. He spoke suddenly.
“Baole, do you want to become stronger?”
Wang Baole’s eyes narrowed. He didn’t argue. Instead, he looked at his senior brother, Chen Qingzi.
“The method to become stronger requires the absorption of an endless amount of death qi. At the same time... There is another way. That is to increase the level of civilization in your federation. With the federation’s improvement, your cultivation will reach its peak in the shortest amount of time.”
Chen Qingzi pointed at the Styx River.
“Do you know what’s in the Styx River?”
“The living beings that have settled down over the endless years,”Wang Baole said softly after a moment of silence.
“Not completely. The Styx River not only contains the living beings that have settled down since the start of the stone tablet realm, it also contains the relics of time. To be more precise... it contains all the historical dust that has appeared in the stone tablet realm up until now
“At the same time, it also contains an almost endless amount of death qi. This is what you need. In addition... It also contains the fragments of past civilizations. Every single fragment, when integrated into your federation’s star, will allow your federation’s star to grow stronger and raise the level of the federation’s civilization
“You want to become stronger... This is where your destiny lies,”Chen Qingzi said calmly. The people who had flown out from the distant dark star were approaching. There were thousands of them, and the aura of the galaxy within them.., there were dozens of them.
If it had been any other time, Wang Baole would have paid attention to them. However, he was no longer in the mood to pay attention to them. Instead, he looked at the vast dark river. His eyes slowly narrowed as he spoke suddenly.
“Senior brother, what do you need me to do?”
“I need you to help me go to the Dark River and retrieve an item.”Chen Qingzi didn’t hide his intentions as he looked at Wang Baole.
Wang Baole looked at his senior brother as well. Their eyes met, and Wang Baole spoke.
“Why me?”
“There is a great danger in the Dark River. Only the suppression of the Heavenly Dao can make the danger disappear slightly. Only the dark child can activate the Dark River’s mark and allow people to enter smoothly.”
