“Really, but you can’t let mom and Dad Worry.”
Wang Baole was about to cheer out of instinct, but when he saw Wang Baole, he retracted his head and held it in. He nodded quickly and obediently. Then, he rolled his eyes and saw that the table in front of Wang Baole was empty, therefore, he quickly got up and brought a bottle of ice spirit water for Wang Baole and placed it in front of him.
Looking at the ice spirit water, Wang Baole’s heart warmed even more. After a moment of silence, he suddenly spoke.
“You Like Him?”As Wang Baole spoke, he waved his right hand, and an illusory shadow appeared. It was the youth that his sister had secretly watched.
Wang Baole’s pretty face blushed. He was a little shy, but he still nodded.
Wang Baole thought about it. Different positions would determine different ways of handling the matter. If it was in the past, Wang Baole might have directly stopped it and chosen a person that he acknowledged. However, now that he was in his position.., he wouldn’t interfere with his younger sister’s decision. Furthermore, the youth was unpredictable. What was happening now didn’t mean that it would happen in the future. Therefore, he wouldn’t stop it, but he would make some adjustments.
In the next instant, Wang Baole’s Dao rhythm spread. He immediately found the youth who had just arrived home in ethereal city. He looked at the Karma thread that spread across the starry sky and waved his hand, instantly, the Karma thread collapsed.
As it collapsed, on the other end of the Karma Thread, on the planet where the divine eye civilization was located, a middle-aged cultivator who was sitting cross-legged and meditating changed his expression. He was about to get up, but in the next instant, his body withered like a deflated rubber ball, he fell to the ground and turned into ashes.
He wasn’t the only one. At the same time, more than a dozen cultivators of different cultivation levels within the divine eye civilization turned into ashes in that instant.
There was another person whose cultivation had reached the level of a spirit immortal. He looked familiar, but Wang Baole had forgotten his name. In his memory, he must have been a disciple of the sky-palm Grandmaster. His body trembled. He wanted to explain, but before he could say anything.., his body was reduced to ashes.
At the same time that this person died, the sky-palm Grandmaster, who was outside the Solar System receiving the purple gold civilization with the people from the Federation, shuddered. A shadow of his soul appeared above his head. One of the Shadow’s arms.., had been cut off by a dao rhythm!
As the arm was cut off, a mouthful of blood sprayed out of the mouth of the sky-holding patriarch. His body trembled, and he turned his head with a pale face. Then he bowed deeply in the direction of Earth in the Solar System.
“I didn’t plan this,”he said in a voice that filled him with awe and fear. “But I knew what I was doing, so I let you go. I’ll cut off your soul and arm, and I’ll cut off twenty percent of your cultivation base as a warning to others!”.
Everyone in the area immediately noticed his state of mind, and looked over in shock. Even patriarch violet-gold swept his hand over the sky thoughtfully.
“Fellow Daoists and seniors, please forgive me. My disciple has committed a taboo. As his master, I deserve to be punished, and I am willing to do so.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1196
chapters.content:
Chapter 1196: Zhao Yameng and Zhou Xiaoya
Translator:
549690339
The purple gold grand ancestor narrowed his eyes at the sky-palm Grand Ancestor’s words. He seemed to have a rough idea of what was going on. He thought to himself, to be able to make such a cultivator who was about to step into a star be willing to be punished, and with such a mysterious method of punishment.., it seemed like the person who was able to influence the Great Dao with just a hint of dao charm must be Wang Baole.
It seems like my judgment of him wasn’t good enough. This Wang Baole... is stronger than I thought, and more powerful than what he had shown before
The purple gold grand ancestor’s smile grew wider at the thought. He was more confident in the purple gold civilization’s decision this time. At the same time, the people from the federation across from him, be it Lin you, Dao Friend Gui, or Qing Lingzi, were all shocked, they had confirmed their previous guesses.
Wu mengling, Li Xingwen, and the others from the Federation didn’t go out to welcome Wang Baole. Instead, they went to Jupiter, the place where the purple gold civilization would be welcomed. At that moment, they were even more certain that Wang Baole had returned, from time to time, they would turn their heads to look at Earth.
They knew very well that if Wang Baole had really returned, then he must be... in ethereal city.
They didn’t care about the way he held the sky, nor did they see the figures who were constantly looking at Earth. Wang Baole’s Dao Aura was now lingering around the youth. The instant the youth’s Karma was severed, his body trembled violently, sweat poured out, and his entire body was trembling. His eyes were filled with intense fear.
“I will not interfere in the matter between you and the Baoling Spirit. However, you must not harm her. You must not harm her in any way.”At that moment, an unfamiliar but familiar voice appeared in his mind. It said that it was unfamiliar, it was the first time that this voice had entered his mind. It was called familiar because he had seen Wang Baole’s silhouette and the words he had said on numerous screens throughout his life.
To the federation, Wang Baole... had been completely deified.
After passing on the words, Wang Baole retracted his dao charm. This was a very, very small matter. Since his sister liked him, he could just go ahead and like him. As for what the youth thought, it didn’t matter. Since he had chosen to calculate it.., then, even if Karma was formed, he would be free once his sister was tired of it.
Before he was tired of it, his life had to be based on Wang Baoling’s will.
Perhaps it was a little overbearing, but position determined one’s thinking. Wang Baole did not continue to put in effort on this matter. He stroked his sister’s head and said softly.
“Go Open the door. An old friend has arrived.”
Wang Baoling’s mind was still filled with excitement, and she continued to feel dizzy. When she heard that, she hurriedly got up and ran to the door. The moment she opened the door, she saw a familiar figure outside the door.
......
“Sister Xiaoya!”Wang baoling exclaimed in surprise.
The person who had come was... Zhou Xiaoya!
Her cultivation had reached the level of a spirit immortal, and her entire body was filled with a gentle aura. Her long hair draped over her shoulders, and she wore a long dress. She smiled as she raised her hand to stroke Wang Baoling’s head. Her gaze shifted from her side to where she was sitting, wang Baole also raised his head to look at her.
“When did you come back?”Zhou Xiaoya asked gently. She walked up to Wang Baole, tidied his collar, and sat beside him naturally.
Baoling blinked. She quickly went to fetch another bottle of ice spirit water and placed it in front of Zhou Xiaoya. She sat at the side, her eyes filled with interest as she sized up her brother and Zhou Xiaoya.
Over the years, she naturally knew that sister Xiaoya liked her brother. She would visit him almost every few days, many times more than when she was home..
I just got back. Wang Baole looked at Zhou Xiaoya and revealed a warm smile. However, deep in his eyes, there was a hint of regret. It was the fact that regrets were seldom seen, but it was also the complicated feelings of regret.
Zhou Xiaoya seemed to be able to sense it. She smiled and shook her head, gently talking about some trivial matters of life. She was like a family member, like a big sister and like a sister-in-law, having a heart-to-heart talk with the baoling spirit.
It could be seen that the baoling spirit liked Zhou Xiaoya very much, and they were very familiar with each other. Wang Baole saw this scene, and warmth filled his heart. It was only when he raised his head and looked outside the door that the baoling spirit, who was standing beside him, blinked, although she didn’t sense anything, she could vaguely guess something based on the connection between her bloodlines. She stood up and ran to the door again, opening it.
“Sister Yameng!”
A proud figure stood at the door. She was tall and straight, and at the same time, she had the gentleness and tenacity of a woman. She didn’t lack heroic spirit either. She was like a blazing sun, exuding a sense of holiness. She could make too many people feel inferior in front of her.
It was... Zhao Yameng!
After realizing that Wang Baole had returned and wasn’t on Earth, she had been one step slower than Zhou Xiaoya. When she arrived, she saw Wang Baole and Zhou Xiaoya, who was sitting beside him.
“Senior sister Yameng,”Zhou Xiaoya stood up and said gently.
Zhao Yameng smiled as she patted the head of the Baole Spirit. She smiled as she returned the greeting to Zhou Xiaoya. Then, she walked over to Wang Baole’s side, looked at him, and sat down on the other side of him.
“Baole, did you subdue the Purple Gold Civilization? How did you settle it? When did it merge with the Sun and the Stars?”
Zhao Yameng was different from what Zhou Xiaoya was talking about. She sat down and started talking about the federation. After communicating with Wang Baole, she told him everything she had discovered about the federation over the years.
She also told Wang Baole about the undercurrents within the god’s eye civilization. She also told him about the cultivators from the Dao Palace who had awakened in the vast expanse dao palace. They seemed to be getting restless.
This was a completely different style from Zhou Xiaoya’s. Wang Baole’s eyes were filled with regret as he answered carefully. Zhou Xiaoya, on the other hand, was very quiet as she listened. She didn’t seem to have participated in the conversation, but she didn’t say anything either, however, she raised her hands and pressed them behind Wang Baole’s ears, gently pressing them down for him.
With that, she naturally blended into the conversation. All of this made Wang baoling, who was sitting not too far away from the three of them, exclaim in her heart.
The light in her eyes grew brighter. Although she still respected her brother, deep down, she was curious as to how her brother would deal with the issue of the two sisters-in-law.
However, she did not know that behind her... behind Zhou Xiaoya and Zhao Yameng, another figure appeared. Other than Wang Baole, no one else could see it. It was little Missy Wang Yiyi.
She sized up Zhou Xiaoya with a faint smile, then looked at Zhao Yameng, and finally looked at Wang Baole mockingly.
“Baole, these two girls, I’ve seen with my own eyes the two of you walk step by step to where you are today. Aiya, who are you going to choose? There’s also Li Wan ‘Er. Why Don’t you accept them all? Back then, my father... ahem.”Wang Yiyi didn’t dare continue, however, her eyes were filled with encouragement.
Wang Baole felt a headache coming on. This was the first time since he had returned from the ninth underworld realm that he didn’t know what to do. His originally calm state of mind was inevitably shaken.
This was especially so when his younger sister was beside him. She had just been taught by him, and now, she was sitting there watching with relish. Wang Baole couldn’t help but glance over.
Bao Ling retracted her head, wanting to pretend that she hadn’t seen anything. However, when she realized that her brother’s eyes were a little fierce, she pouted and stood up, deliberately yawning.
“I’m going to sleep.”After saying that, she returned to her room unwillingly.
Time passed slowly, and the night passed without a word.
While Wang Yiyi was moaning and moaning, Zhao Yameng and Zhou Xiaoya left one after another. Wang baole sighed softly. He had too many things on his mind. Even though he knew what the two of them were thinking, he still couldn’t agree to it.
He didn’t know what would happen in the future. There were too many things in the stone tablet realm that he didn’t know how to deal with.
He was still too weak.
“I’ll leave it to time,”Wang Baole murmured softly. He raised his head again, and his eyes regained their calmness. He saw Wu mengling, Li Xingwen, and the others on Jupiter, and the Purple Gold Patriarch, they were discussing the next step in the fusion of the stars.
Next, I hope that during the fusion of the federation, my cultivation and soul will be upgraded, and I will step into... The Galaxy! Wang Baole lowered his head. As he raised his right hand, a missing corner of a compass appeared in his hand.
It was the Realm Ascension Compass!

chapters.title: Chapter 1197 - Seven Stars of the Seven Heavens!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1197: — Seven Stars of the Seven Heavens!
Translator:
549690339
There didn’t seem to be anything out of the ordinary about the compass. The only thing that was obvious was the feeling of time. There were unerasable grime in many places, as if it had been stained with blood from who knows how many years ago.
However, there wasn’t the slightest abnormal aura. It was exuding an oak-like smell. At the same time, there was a finger-wide angle missing from the right corner of the compass.
The missing corner seemed to have been struck by an external force, causing the compass to shatter. Cracks could even be seen on the missing corner. There were deep and shallow cracks that spread across the entire compass, increasing the sense of time on the compass.
“Realm Ascension Compass.”Wang Baole held the compass and muttered to himself. This compass might have many uses, but Wang baole only knew one, and that was... to raise the level of civilization.
He didn’t know how it worked, but he thought that it must be some sort of hidden treasure. It could increase the thickness of a civilization, and then add history to it out of thin air. It was like grafting, allowing a civilization to leap forward.
As for how to use it, it wasn’t complicated. He just needed to fuse it into the star.
Wang Baole thought for a moment, then raised his head. He glanced at the star and sun, but didn’t immediately fuse it into the star. After all, the object came from the Dark River and the nine serenities. Wang Baole didn’t have much confidence in it, so he needed to study it again, only then would he be able to confirm whether or not to use it.
The arrival of the purple gold civilization will also raise the level of the federation’s civilization after merging with it... Wang Baole thought for a moment, then closed his eyes and quietly meditated.
Time passed, and soon, seven days passed.
During these seven days, Wang Baole’s home was filled with visitors. They included the Ethereal Dao ancestor, Li Xingwen; the president, Wu mengling; the vice president and governor of the Martian colony, Lin You; fellow Daoist Gui; and the Jin family ancestor, whom Wang Baole had never met before in the TRILUNARIS Corporation and Wang Baole, then, there were the sky-palm and the others from the God’s eye civilization, as well as the anxious Qing spirit child from the vast Dao Palace..
The higher-ups of the Federation had all come to pay their respects. Wang Baole treated different people differently. For example, Li Xingwen, Wu mengling, and the others. Wang Baole treated them with the courtesy of a junior. As for the others.., wang Baole greeted them with a smile. However, no matter how gentle he was, it was hard to avoid making the other visitors, other than Li Xingwen, Wu mengling, and the others, feel nervous.
The newly joined Patriarch of the Purple Gold civilization also arrived. He was respectful and respectful in front of Wang Baole, not daring to make any rash moves or words. This made the higher-ups of the federation even more fearful of Wang Baole.
Whether it was on the surface or below the surface, Wang Baole’s status and status were unparalleled in the entire federation. Some of the cultivators in the federation had even addressed him as the patriarch when they talked about Wang Baole.
......
The federation’s Patriarch!
This title spread very quickly, and no one disagreed with it. Everything in the federation could be said to have been acquired by Wang Baole. He had been in charge of the integration of the Vast Expanse Dao Palace, and he had participated in the integration of the God’s eye civilization, the purple gold civilization had come because of his fame.
Therefore, in the current federation, although Wang Baole still hadn’t fulfilled his childhood dream of becoming the president, that was no longer important.
After receiving all the visitors, Wang Baole left a clone to accompany him so as not to disturb his parents. His main body left Earth and went to the Sun and the star.
The star, which he had been unable to enter in the past, was now like his own garden to Wang Baole. The reason for this was that his cultivation was no longer the same as before. On the other hand, the divine eye star was already under his control, after merging with the Sun, the sun naturally belonged to Wang Baole.
Within the Sun, Wang Baole sat cross-legged in the solar flare. As he cultivated, the purple gold civilization and the Federation had reached a consensus on the details, and the merger was on the agenda.
It was set for half a month later!
During this half a month, there were still many things that needed to be done beforehand. For example, the division of the areas after the merger, how to deal with the hundreds of civilizations that were attached to the purple gold civilization, and the seating of the purple gold civilization in the federation.
After all, compared to the federation, the Purple Gold civilization was too big. Without Wang Baole, the federation would have been completely passive during the fusion. However, now, the Purple Gold Civilization had taken the initiative to retreat, they proposed that the purple gold star be completely integrated into the federation’s star, giving up the initiative. At the same time, they also handed over the hundreds of small civilizations that were attached to it to the federation.
From then on, these small civilizations would no longer be attached to the Purple Gold Star, but to the federation.
Their galaxy would circle around the edge of the future federation galaxy and become part of the Federation’s star spiral. At the same time, twenty percent of the federation’s territory would be divided and given to the purple gold civilization.
This was a huge disadvantage for the purple gold civilization. After all, their integration could expand the federation by a lot. However, the purple gold civilization wasn’t displeased at all. Instead, they pushed for it with all their might.
Everyone could tell that the federation was nothing to the Purple Gold civilization. They had come here to... rely on Wang Baole.
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye with the full cooperation and push. Everything that had been planned had been completed. Finally, on this day, with the simultaneous broadcast of the entire federation, the integration of the purple gold civilization had officially begun!
At that moment, Wang Baole had split into hundreds of clones and spread out in all directions. He was meditating at the outer edge of the solar system to prevent any accidents or changes. As for his main body, he was still seated within the Sun’s star, leading the fusion this time.
Very quickly, the citizens of the entire federation saw a star that was much larger than the Sun in the sky. It slowly emerged from the blurriness, surrounded by countless meteors that seemed to be pulling and pushing at the same time, the Strange Star slowly approached the Sun.
The entire process lasted for fourteen days. In the first seven days, the temperature in the solar system had risen by a lot, and the spiritual energy had also risen dramatically. Through the broadcast of the Solar System’s array formation, the people were able to see everything that was happening.
Everyone was excited, and so was the divine eye civilization. This was because for them, the fusion of the purple gold would also increase the level of their lives, and their cultivation bases would instantly soar. The vast expanse Daoist palace was the same, and they were even more excited, once the fusion took place, their injuries would be forcefully healed in an instant. Some of the injuries that weren’t very serious could even be healed immediately.
This was the law and law of the starry skies of the stone stele world. Both the Dark Sect’s Heavenly Dao and the Unending Heavenly Dao contained dao.
The fusion of civilizations would increase the level of their lives. It would be like changing the heavens and changing lives. It would affect their natural endowments and increase their cultivation levels!
When the eighth day arrived, the purple-gold star and the Federation’s sun came into complete contact. They emitted a large amount of fog that slowly merged under the suppression of the purple-gold patriarch and Wang Baole.
From Afar, the sun was very small, and the purple-gold star was very large. However, during the fusion, the Federation’s sun was absorbing and the purple-gold star was contributing. This process continued for seven days.
The second seven days seemed to have changed the world for the Federation. The changes were so great that it shook everyone’s minds!
The borders of the Federation expanded instantly, more than ten times!
The Spirit Qi from the divine eye civilization and the original planets in the Solar System in the federation’s starry skies erupted in an instant, exceeding the previous times by a hundred times.
The temperature in the starry skies reached an alarming level. However, under Wang Baole’s protection, the planets were not affected, and no one was harmed. At the same time, as the temperature and spirit Qi became denser, the entire solar system became hazy.
The hazy feeling grew stronger, and some unconscious spirits appeared faintly. These spirits were all born with Spirit Qi, and they were all different in appearance. They danced in the galaxy, causing everyone who saw them to be shaken.
The planet belonging to the Purple Gold civilization appeared in the previously designated area of the Solar System as if it was being pulled. Although it was blurry, their appearance caused a storm to rise in the Solar System. As the storm passed, Spirit Qi erupted once again.
Everyone from the divine eye civilization, all life forms from the federation, and cultivators from the vast expanse dao palace all trembled violently at this moment. Waves of aura erupted from all directions. This was a breakthrough, a rise in power!
On the seventh day... The Purple Gold Star completely merged with the Federation Sun, causing the area of the federation’s star field to expand once again. It was now hundreds of times larger than before. There were hundreds of planets belonging to the federation, with hundreds of small civilizations surrounding them, within each small civilization, there were ten planets of different sizes.
From Afar, in the starry sky... in the original position of the Solar System, the Solar System had disappeared, and in its place was an even larger... multi-colored star whirlpool!
At this moment, in the left path holy region, many sects and families had sensed something. Many gazes from all directions in the left path holy region were all looking... at the location of the Solar System!
—

chapters.title: Chapter 1198 - realm plate domain suppression!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1198:, realm plate domain suppression!
Translator:
549690339
Violet gold fused into it, causing the level of the federation’s civilization to rise!
Heavenly Dao laws and natural laws spread out in all directions, filling the entire galaxy. Violet lightning bolts spread out in all directions, causing everyone to look up to see violet snakes dancing in the starry sky, shocking to the extreme.
All of the cultivators, be it the vast Expanse Dao palace or the divine eye civilization, all experienced an increase in their level of life, along with the feedback of their spiritual energy. Their cultivation bases exploded with power, and the aura of a breakthrough spread out, it was in the new federation that the aura of a breakthrough began to spread out.
Within the divine eye civilization, Patriarch Heavenpalm’s cultivation base exploded with power. He had originally been in the great circle of planets, but now, he had broken through to the star realm. He had been preparing for his cultivation base to advance for many years, he had long since left behind an immortal planet for himself, which was the foundation of the divine eye civilization.
At that moment, with the help of the immortal planet, he was able to make a breakthrough in his cultivation base. With the help of the spiritual energy, he was able to ignite the planet, causing it to rise into the sun, and his cultivation base to smoothly step into the star realm!
!!
A large number of cultivators from the divine eye civilization also rose, and three of them directly stepped into the planet realm!
As for the vast expanse Daoist Palace, rumbling sounds could be heard as figures began to howl from their secluded meditation facilities. There were a total of nine planet cultivators, all of whom had recovered from their injuries, and were now out of secluded meditation!
As for Qing Lingzi, he had completely recovered from his injuries, and was now back in the middle of the star realm!
There was also star Wing Elder. Due to his high cultivation level and his injuries, although he was unable to completely recover, he could clearly feel that his injuries had improved quite a bit.
And the ones who had improved the most… were the federation cultivators from the Solar System. When their cultivation levels erupted, it was comparable to the combination of the divine eyes and the Dao Palace.
Zhao yameng, Li Xingwen, Wu mengling, Lin You, the Jin family Elder, and fellow Daoist Gui. These six former planets had all broken through at this moment due to the explosion of spiritual energy and the increase in their levels of life.
Mid-stage planets, late-stage planets… in the end, Li Xingwen was indeed a genius. He was the first to break through to the star realm, followed by Zhao Yameng, and then Lin You!
As for Wu Mengling, the Patriarch of the Jin family, and fellow Daoist Gui, they had all stopped at the late-stage planets.
There were also other people who had made breakthroughs. There were even thirteen original spirit immortal cultivators who had used this opportunity to break through and step into the planets.
The rise of the three factions, the appearance of planets, and the glow of a few stars made the new federation’s Starry Skies even more dazzling and loud.
The reason for the rise of the federation’s local cultivators was that the federation’s cultivators were in charge, both in the past and the present. They were the true masters of the galaxy. Therefore, the increase in their cultivation was more comprehensive.
However, the person who had benefited the most was still Wang Baole!
If the federation cultivators were the ones in charge, then Wang Baole was the one in charge!
His soul had used the improvement in his level of life and the integration of the purple gold civilization. With the help of the explosion, he had reached the ninety steps of the perfected stellar realm. It wasn’t over yet. He was still advancing.
He took ninety-three steps, ninety-six steps… Ninety-nine steps!
With another leap, he stepped into the hundred steps. His soul shook violently, and it elevated immediately, breaking through to… The Celestial Domain Realm!
At that moment, Wang Baole was in the physical celestial domain and the Divine Soul Celestial Domain. His foundation was too deep and too strong, so the integration of the purple gold was unable to support his advancement. He was still at the perfected stellar realm, but his combat strength had increased greatly due to the advancement of his soul to the celestial domain, it had increased by too much.
He sat cross-legged in the Sun. His eyes opened and closed, and he stood at the center of the new federation like a God!
Booming sounds and the sound of a breakthrough rang out continuously in the starry sky. The expansion of the new federation’s Galaxy caused a reaction in the starry sky. The powerful cultivators from the countless sects and clans in the left Dao holy region were all shocked, their gazes seemed to be able to pierce through the galaxy and see the Federation, which had expanded by hundreds of times!
This was not a real sight, nor was it the arrival of divine will. Instead, it was a natural reaction due to the dao fusing with the galaxy.
However, even though most of the sects and clans were shaken to the core and knew that a new overlord had appeared in the left Dao sacred region from then on, they were still very wary of the sects that were ranked in the top few in the left Dao sacred region, for example, the first sect, the nine paths sect, was only slightly shocked. They didn’t feel too strongly about it. It didn’t matter if there were dozens of planets in the new federation, or if there were a few stars.., the new federation’s power had not only risen to become the overlord of the nineteenth region, it had even surpassed it. However… it was still lacking in high-end combat power!
After all, Wang Baole’s power was still considered a star by the nine dao sects. They couldn’t see it with their own eyes. They could only sense the expansion of the galaxy. That was why they cared the most.., the blazing flame ancestor and the starry wings of the Vast Expanse Dao Palace.
To the nine Dao sect, these two were the true foundation of the new federation. They were powerful, but the former couldn’t easily ignite the curse. The latter was injured. The Nine Dao sect and the other top-ranked sects.., they did not lack star domains, so although they were a threat, they were not a big deal.
Of course, there were two other reasons. They were only slightly shaken. One… was that war was about to break out in the Weiyang Dao Domain, and a great calamity was about to befall them. It was still unknown whether they would be able to survive in the end.
Two… The nine paths sect knew very well that although this kind of advancement by absorbing other civilizations was quick, it was full of drawbacks and could not be unlimited.
Firstly, it was unstable. If it was a small civilization, it would be fine. But if it was a large galaxy like the purple gold civilization, it was like a snake swallowing an elephant. There was a hidden danger of collapse, and it would take a long time to digest, at the same time, it was very easy to reach the limit of saturation and could not continue to rely on this method to advance.
In the end… it was still difficult to reach the position of the top-ranked sects like the nine paths sect.
They had merely raised the starting point a little higher. However, their foundations were unstable, and when a strong wind blew, it was inevitable that they would collapse.
Wang Baole was well aware of what they knew. He was ambitious to begin with, and he was competing with time. It was obvious that he wouldn’t be satisfied with the fact that he wouldn’t be able to support his cultivation increase even after he had integrated with the purple gold civilization, most importantly… regardless of whether the purple gold civilization would come or not, Wang Baole didn’t care too much about it.
That was because the promotion he was going to give to the federation wasn’t the integration of the purple gold, but… The Realm Ascension Plate!
The function of this plate wasn’t just like its name. It could promote a civilization, and it could also be used as a precious treasure to suppress the fate of the newly promoted civilization, so that it wouldn’t be unstable and would be able to achieve a perfect integration, furthermore… there was no limit to it!
In other words, with the Realm Ascension disk, the expansion and fusion of the new federation could, to a certain extent, break through the limits and enter the infinite!
Therefore, in the next instant, the appearance of the new federation shocked most of the sects and clans, but it only caused the sects like the nine paths sect to tremble slightly… Wang Baole, who was sitting cross-legged in the sun, spread out his spiritual perception, after enveloping the solar system, which had expanded hundreds of times, he raised his right hand and waved it abruptly.
“All living beings are the dao, and the ascending disk is the reserve. From now on… It shall be the reserve of our federation, suppressing the starry skies, so that the federation will not collapse, perish, or Fall!”
Immediately, the ordinary ascending disk flew out. After it flew out of the Sun and the star, its size changed abruptly and expanded infinitely. As the loud booms reverberated, the disk grew larger, it became more and more translucent. In a few breaths’time, it became as big as the new solar system. Its form was completely transparent, invisible to the naked eye, and it enveloped the entire Solar System!
It pressed down!
Amidst booming sounds, the new solar system, which had expanded hundreds of times, went from its initial barely holding and unstable state to instantly stabilizing in the midst of the loud bang. The feedback of Spiritual Qi in that instant was even more than before, it erupted once again!
The cultivation of all living beings rose once again!

chapters.title: Chapter 1199 - Clouds in all directions!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1199: Clouds in all directions!
Translator:
549690339
As soon as the ascending plate appeared, the starry sky rumbled, and countless amounts of spiritual energy erupted from within. It filled the entire solar system, and at the same time, it made the stars in the Solar System seem as if they had been baptized, and they gave off brilliant rays of light.
The planets were brilliant, and the flames of the stars spread out in all directions.
The power of suppression enveloped the universe, as if it had frozen everything at the most beautiful moment. In fact, there was even a protective power that spread out from within, making the solar system the center of attention of the universe at this moment!
What was even more shocking was that at this moment, the Solar System seemed to have turned into a black hole, sucking in a large amount of spiritual energy from the starry skies of the entire left Dao holy region.
In an instant, countless amounts of spiritual energy poured in from all directions with a loud rumble that could topple mountains and overturn seas. They poured crazily into the solar system and into the ascending boundary plate, becoming the aura of the Federation and the foundation of the Federation!
!!
This caused the spiritual energy in the Solar System to reach an astonishing level in an instant. It turned into a dense fog that enveloped everything within sight.
Numerous spiritual veins were born on the various planets, and the spiritual rain fell like never before.
Such a change naturally shook the entire left path holy region. Therefore, in an instant, waves of exclamations immediately erupted from all the sects and clans within the left path holy region who were paying attention to the federation, the sounds of an uproar continued to ring out from the mouths of the experts from the various galaxies.
They could not see the current federation, and because their divine senses were too far away, they could not explore the solar system. However, the senses from the Dao allowed them to immediately sense that something was wrong. The spiritual energy from their respective galaxies was being drained, this caused a huge wave to rise in their hearts.
“Something’s not right. This feeling is very abnormal. The spiritual energy is decreasing and flowing towards the federation! !”
“After the federation fused with the Violet Gold, the entire realm was unstable. We could only say that it was barely holding on, but why did it suddenly… stabilize completely? It’s as if it’s completely absorbed!”
“What item is absorbing boundless spiritual energy to suppress the federation’s realm and stabilize it completely! ? ! ?”Cries of alarm rang out from within the various sects and clans, the Nine Provinces Dao and the other four great sects, which were ranked in the top five in the entire left Dao holy region, began to tremble slightly, and their expressions changed dramatically.
The other sects and clans could sense what was happening, and naturally, they could. At the same time… the other sects and clans were limited in their knowledge, so it wasn’t a problem for them to know what was happening, therefore, when they sensed the aura and stability of the federation, the Nine Provinces Dao sect and the other four sects immediately found the answer.
“This is some kind of true treasure that can suppress fate and stabilize a realm. This kind of treasure is very rare. Any one of them can be said to be peerless!”
“According to records, there are only a handful of true treasures that can do this. Other than some items that have owners, there are definitely not more than three that are scattered outside!”
“Lingyi Bell, Dao Soul Banner, and Realm Ascension Plate must be one of these three!”
“It can’t be the realm ascending plate. It’s a legendary supreme treasure that can suppress an entire universe. It’s rumored that the Emperor of the dead and progenitor Weiyang fought and shattered it. That’s why the Emperor of the dead died!”
While the various sects and clans were in shock, the nine regions road and the other top five sects were also in shock. At this moment, in the new solar system, the cultivation levels of all living beings had reached an extreme. Li Xingwen’s cultivation level had directly risen from the initial stage of a star to the middle stage of a star.
It seemed like this was only a small increase in cultivation level, but due to the difference in levels, the difficulty was comparable to tens or even hundreds of planet cultivators breaking through a cultivation level.
Next was Zhao Yameng, who had also stepped into the middle stage of the star. Lin You, who was slightly behind, had also reached the peak of the initial stage of the star. As for Wu Mengling, fellow Daoist Gui, and the Jin family’s patriarch, they all exploded at this moment. Other than the Jin family’s patriarch.., the first two were all at the early stage of the Star Realm!
As a result, of the six people, five were at the star realm. Although the Jin family’s patriarch didn’t immediately step into the Star Realm, with his foundation, he had a high chance of stepping into the star realm after cultivating for a period of time.
As for the thirteen people who had just advanced to the planet realm, they had all advanced to the middle stage of the planet realm by a large margin. There were even more than ten people whose cultivation bases had broken through to the planet realm with the help of the ascending plate.
There were countless low-level cultivators who had made breakthroughs. The divine eye civilization’s sky-palm Patriarch had also benefited greatly. He had reached the peak of the middle stage of the planet, and was only half a step away from the late stage of the planet.
If it had been any other time, his cultivation base would definitely have been unstable, and there would have been many drawbacks. But now… The rise in his level of life had resolved most of that instability, and with the suppression of a precious treasure like the Realm Ascension Plate.., all the cultivators’cultivation bases had been stabilized!
It was the same in the Vast Expanse Dao Palace. One by one, the elders who had been healing came out of secluded meditation. Master Starry Wing’s eyes shone with a strange light, and his injuries… had recovered by more than eighty percent.
This caused his heart to race, and his breathing to quicken.
At the same time… when the violet-gold civilization had merged with the Solar System, they had been the contributors. None of the cultivators, including those from the dependent civilizations, had received any benefits. On the contrary, to a certain extent.., their foundations had been depleted by quite a bit.
In fact, some of the cultivators’cultivation bases had been shaken, and it was as if their lives had withered. This caused many of the violet gold civilization cultivators to be filled with dissatisfaction and frustration, as well as helplessness.
Even the violet gold patriarch felt a bit of regret, as if he had made the wrong decision..
However, as the boundless spiritual energy poured into them and the ascending realm plate fused into them, the spiritual energy began to feed back to them!
Everything happened in an instant, and the losses of the violet gold civilization were immediately replenished. All of the withered beings felt their spirits rise, and their cultivation bases began to rise.
However, it was clear that they had only joined for a very short period of time, and that their sequences were different. Naturally, they couldn’t compare to the Divine Eye and Vast Expanse Dao Palace, but… that was enough to make the violet gold civilization and the hundreds of other small civilizations very excited.
As for Patriarch Violet Gold, he was even more excited than before. Even though he hadn’t given the violet star civilization much of a boost, it was enough to allow his cultivation base to rise by a single step, despite the fact that he had no hope of advancing to a Starfield, he had reached his true limit, and his confidence in breaking through to a starfield had increased from almost nothing to half!
His battle prowess had also increased. With his deep foundation, he was now barely qualified to fight against an early-stage starfield cultivator!
More importantly, this gave him strong confidence and hope. Patriarch Violet Gold was ecstatic as he raised his head to look in the direction of the Sun and star. He could faintly see a figure sitting cross-legged in meditation, he felt extremely determined and fortunate to have made the decision to integrate into the federation.
The figure in his eyes was Wang Baole. As the Lord of the Realm Ascension Plate, his gains this time were naturally the greatest. The amount of spirit Qi absorbed by all the living beings in the solar system was only twenty to thirty percent, the remaining seventy to eighty percent was all poured into him.
In an instant, his cultivation had reached the level of three to five steps to the perfected star realm. He continued to increase his cultivation to the limit!
Soon, he had reached the fourteen to fifteen steps. The Spirit Qi surged into a vortex that surrounded the sun. Wang Baole was completely immersed in it. There was only one thought in his mind at that moment.
He wanted to… attempt a breakthrough in his cultivation. He wanted to step into the star domain. He wanted to use his soul, physical body, and cultivation to become a true powerhouse in the never-ending DAO domain that the divine emperor would fear!
This time, I must step into the Starfield! Determination appeared in Wang Baole’s eyes. He formed a seal with his hands, and his cultivation rose once again under the influx of Spirit Qi!

chapters.title: Chapter 1200 - clarity of Dao Heart!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1200:, clarity of Dao Heart!
Translator:
549690339
What was a starfield.
Wang Baole had many previous understandings. When he hadn’t reached the planet realm at the very beginning, he had thought that it was a realm that was extremely profound, a realm that cultivators dreamed of achieving in their entire lives.
Then, as his dao star rose into the sun and stepped into the star realm, his thoughts changed. In his understanding, there was basically no difference between the Starfield realm and the Starfield realm in the universe. They both contained more than one galaxy, from there, they gathered together to form a vast sea of stars.
Due to the number and scale of the galaxies contained, there were also differences in size between the star domains. If one were to compare these star domains to living beings, then they would be the so-called star domain-grade.
But now, his thoughts changed again. This time, the change came from his previous life’s comprehension on the fated star. It came from the tears and kowtowing in the Styx River in the nine serenities land. In his understanding, the star domain-grade.., it was no longer as simple as seeing a sea of stars in the universe as a living being.
!!
It was… Dao!
Finding one’s own Dao and pushing it to the extreme, to the end, and finally achieving perfection in this dao… that was the essence of a celestial domain-grade cultivator.
Every celestial domain actually contained a dao that was different from others. Some people had one dao, while others had several. It was difficult to tell the strong from the weak, and it depended on one’s understanding of the Dao.
The blazing flame ancestor, for example, was a combination of the Dao of curses and the Dao of fire. The other galaxies that Wang Baole had encountered were all the same. There were rumors that there were three thousand Great Dao in the entire universe, but in reality, the Dao was not fixed, it was far beyond the so-called three thousand.
Wang Baole didn’t know exactly how many there were, but he knew clearly that the dao that he was walking on now was freedom, freedom.
His Dao intent was at peace, and his mind was at peace.
This was… His Dao heart was clear.
“Good.”Wang baole, who was sitting cross-legged in the Sun and star, smiled. He closed his eyes again and took the initiative to absorb the boundless spirit Qi that had been absorbed from the entire left Dao sacred territory after the Realm Ascension Plate had fused with it.
The purpose of the spirit Qi wasn’t to nourish the tens of thousands of stars in Wang Baole’s star domain into stars. All of his stars had already gone through this step and had reached the so-called great perfection of the stars.
The purpose of the Spirit Qi was to… light up the tens of thousands of stars in Wang Baole’s body, allowing the Dao of all the stars to manifest in his heart, allowing the Dao to eventually converge, forming what he sought… freedom.
Because he wanted freedom, Wang Baole had to be stronger than the others!
Because he wanted freedom, the Dao that Wang Baole comprehended had to be more comprehensive!
The process from the first step to the hundred steps of the perfected stellar realm was his pursuit of the Dao of freedom.
At that moment, he had already reached the fifteenth step, and he was still continuing.
With a loud boom, the vortex formed by Spirit Qi had already covered the entire sun and star, and it was still spreading in all directions. In just a few breaths’time, it had covered half of the new solar system. In that instant.., all the powerful cultivators in the left dao sacred region who were paying attention to this place sensed the presence of Wang Baole as well as the presence of the supreme treasure suppressing it!
“The Blazing Flame disciple, Wang Baole!”
“That presence is him. He’s advancing to the star domain!”
“This isn’t a big deal. The supreme treasure that can suppress the solar system is the key!”
“The war between the never-ending clan and the dark sect is about to begin. If we have such a supreme treasure, we’ll definitely have more confidence in being able to survive this calamity!”
Streams of divine thoughts instantly appeared in the various sects and clans of the left Dao sacred territory. However, the power that the federation had revealed to the public could still dispel many people’s greed, however… for the nine Prefectures Dao sect and the top five sects in the left Dao sacred territory, the moment they sensed the supreme treasure, greed rose in their hearts.
Even though they knew that the blazing flame ancestor was behind Wang Baole, they still spared no expense and used the secret techniques of their respective sects and clans. Through different methods, their divine thoughts were strengthened and spread out from all directions, they wanted to see for themselves what the Supreme Treasure was.
If it wasn’t something famous, or if its power was different from their judgment, or if it was already at its peak, then even though they were greedy, they still had to weigh their gains and losses.
Therefore, in the next instant, outside the Solar System, as the starry sky distorted, the divine senses from all directions gathered and looked towards the solar system.
However… as the secret techniques of the various sects were unleashed and they looked over, when they saw the ascending boundary plate and the figures within the Solar System, a short period of silence suddenly appeared, following that, waves of incredulous exclamations and heavy breathing immediately erupted within the sects where the divine thoughts were probing.
“That’s… That’s…”
“Ascending realm plate! ! It’s actually the legendary ascending realm plate that has already been destroyed! This is impossible! !”
“Ascending realm plate! !”
An uproar broke out as more than ten auras of star fields erupted from within the Dao of the nine prefectures. The other four sects that were ranked in the top five did the same, and their auras began to rumble.
The allure of the ascending realm plate was too great!
As the hearts of the experts from the various sects trembled and began to stir, Patriarch Starry Wings from the Vast Expanse Dao Palace in the Solar System suddenly opened his eyes. Without any hesitation, he sent his divine will out and swept out toward the outer reaches of the Solar System, it was a deterrent.
A cold snort rang out from a distance, echoing in the minds of the experts from the various sects who had used secret techniques to examine the area. This voice… contained the power of fire, as well as a curse, it was none other than Patriarch Blazing Flame.
Starry Wings was fine. He was just an ordinary starfield, but patriarch blazing flame was different. His cold snort caused the hearts of many experts from the various sects and clans to tremble.
It was different to guess that the blazing flame ancestor would come. It was different to personally experience his arrival.
At the same time, the voice of the blazing flame ancestor rang out in Wang Baole’s mind.
“Baole, don’t worry about your advancement. I’ll help you block any attacks. I’d like to see who dares to disrupt my disciple’s advancement!”
“Master… There’s no need for that.”Wang Baole opened his eyes. He felt warmth in his heart as he spoke softly.
How could Wang Baole not notice that the powerful cultivators from the various sects and clans in the left Dao sacred region were approaching him with their telepathic thoughts? Even though he was currently in the midst of gaining enlightenment, he could still sense everything.
That was because this was within his expectations.
Of course, Wang Baole understood the significance of the Realm Ascension Plate. He also understood the rise of the federation, especially his own ascension. It was the same as reclassifying the left Dao Sacred Region. As such, he would naturally be targeted, spied on, and even blocked.
However, he couldn’t just stand still and not move forward because he was afraid of being targeted. At the same time, he planned to use this opportunity to mobilize the elites from the various sects and clans of the left Dao Sacred Zone to give him a chance to establish his authority here.
This time, establishing his authority would determine the status of the federation. It would also determine whether Wang Baole would be able to live a carefree life in the future. At the same time… more importantly, it was where he had reserved the nutrients for his advancement to the star domain just in case!
After all, a corner of the Realm Ascension Plate was still missing.
Therefore, after sensing that the Divine Thoughts were hesitating, and hearing his master’s words, Wang Baole spoke.
“Are you confident?”The Blazing Flame ancestor sent his divine thoughts over.
“I don’t dare say all of them, but there are some. If it’s really inappropriate… master, can you help me suppress them for a few months?”
“Yes!”
Hearing his master’s words, Wang Baole smiled slightly. His dao aura spread out abruptly, instantly spreading out to the outer solar system. As the divine thoughts that had arrived outside the solar system hesitated.., they saw Wang Baole’s true form within the Solar System!
In an instant… the divine thoughts began to tremble violently once again!
“A hundred-step starfield for the soul! A hundred-step starfield for the body as well! Cultivation at the perfected stellar realm… the target is also the hundred-step Starfield!”
“This… this… is unprecedented! This is the legendary body of the First Dao!”
“Once it succeeds, it will be the strongest starfield under the deity Emperor. If it advances to the middle stage of the Starfield… it will be able to fight the deity Emperor! !”
“The left Dao holy region is going to have an overlord? ! !”

chapters.title: Chapter 1201 - the crusade against the various star domains
chapters.content:
Chapter 1201:, the crusade against the various star domains
Translator:
549690339
Any star domain could be considered an overlord!
For example, within the nine Regions Dao, there were over a dozen star domains on the surface, but their foundations were extremely deep. There were definitely some hidden in the dark, and even the great circle of Star domains.
If the number of star domains belonging to the top five sects in the left Dao holy region were added together, it would be close to fifty on the surface!
As for the experts from the Starfields after the top five and from all the other regions added together, it would not exceed this number. If one were to calculate in this manner, this faction was already extremely powerful. This was also the terrifying aspect of the left Dao holy region, although it could not compare to the UNYANG Central Region, it was not much different from the other sects.
Only… There was no divine emperor realm expert in the left Dao Holy Region!
!!
The Blazing Flame ancestor was the only person who barely possessed the strength of a divine emperor. However, once the blazing flame ancestor’s curse was fully unleashed, he would perish together with the blazing flame ancestor. Therefore, although he could be considered a divine emperor, he could only use it once.
Using the Sea of people tactic to sacrifice several peak-stage perfected celestial domain cultivators wasn’t impossible to resolve. It was just that there was no need to take the risk. Even so, the blazing flame ancestor was still the strongest cultivator in the left dao holy region.
However, things were different now. The dao aura that Wang Baole revealed caused great waves to rise in the hearts of all the powerful cultivators from the various sects after seeing and feeling it.
That was because the body of the Origin Dao was a legendary existence. It was an extreme state that was almost impossible to achieve. Normally, a galaxy with a perfect hundred-step cultivation realm would be considered a prodigy among prodigies. Two of them would be considered a monster.
If all three were the same, then such a thing was already heaven-defying. One could deduce an answer based on the knowledge and knowledge gained from the ancient records.
An initial-stage starfield cultivator with an initial-dao body could fight against a perfected starfield cultivator. He could be considered invincible in the Starfield. If an initial-dao body advanced to the mid-stage starfield cultivator, he could fight against an immortal deity Emperor. He could even continue deducing, if an initial-dao body advanced to the late-stage starfield cultivator, he could easily defeat an immortal deity emperor, even if it would be difficult to kill him.
If an initial-dao body advanced to the perfected starfield cultivator, he could even kill an immortal deity Emperor and scatter his blood throughout the universe!
This was something that even Wang Baole’s former senior brother, Chen Qingzi, was unable to do while he was in the celestial domain. He could only defeat the divine emperor at most. The two times he had killed the divine emperor were due to his own cultivation, which was already in the nine serenities realm, he had stepped into the divine emperor realm without anyone knowing about it in the outside world.
Therefore, when they saw that the path Wang Baole was taking was in this direction, most of the sects and clans in the left Dao holy region were shaken. Many powerful cultivators, who had used mystic techniques to spread their divine thoughts over, were shaken, after being shaken by the blazing flame ancestor, they were even more shaken. They retreated and left the area.
They were worried that once Wang Baole successfully advanced, there would be no need for Weiyang to start a war with the dark sect. Wang Baole would come to seek revenge.
The price was too high. It wasn’t worth offending such a powerful enemy for the sake of the Realm Ascension Plate. Even though the Realm Ascension Plate was indeed a supreme treasure among supreme treasures, it was hard to say whether it would be a stroke of good fortune or a catastrophe between life and death.
However, even though most of the sects and clans chose to retreat, to the nine Prefectures Dao, as well as the four great sects of the left Dao sacred region who were ranked in the top five, they… couldn’t retreat!
In reality, even if Wang Baole hadn’t revealed his origin dao body, they would still choose to attack after weighing the pros and cons. Even if the blazing flame would stop them, they would still try to snatch the Realm Ascension Plate away.
Now, with Wang Baole’s original dao body, they were filled with killing intent. Once Wang Baole succeeded in his promotion, then… The Federation, with Wang Baole and the blazing flame ancestor.., it would definitely bring about a drastic change in the situation in the left Dao sacred territory.
The Nine Prefectures Dao, the other top five sects, and even the sects behind them would all be threatened. This threat would affect the future of the sect.
Therefore, in the next moment, an old voice spoke from within the mountain gate of the Dao of the nine prefectures.
“There is a violation of civilization in the nineteen prefectures. By the command of the Dao of the nine prefectures, all of the prefectures will immediately launch an attack!”
As the voice spoke, streams of energy erupted out. There were fourteen of them, all of them celestial domains. Shockingly, one of them emanated fluctuations of the great circle of the celestial domain as it shot toward… The Federation!
It wasn’t just the nine Regions Dao. The other four great sects and clans in the top five all responded. Each of them sent their own star fields flying toward the federation.
As for the other ten thousand sects and clans, although they had no choice, they had no choice but to come out. However, their speed was clearly a bit slower.
In the starry sky of the left Dao Holy Region, numerous figures were moving like beams of light. Some were charging forward, some were tearing through the air, and some were using magical items to fly through the air. They were getting closer and closer to the federation from all directions.
If one was able to look down at the entire left Dao holy region from an extremely high position, one would be able to see that the more than ten star regions of the nine Regions Dao were currently gathering together. Vaguely, nine enormous chains had gathered on their bodies.
These nine chains were the nine great daos of the nine Regions Dao. While their might was shocking, the other four directions were similar. One of them was a heaven splitting axe, and the other was a meteorite that was the size of a galaxy, there was a giant blood-red cauldron and an illusory giant that was astonishingly large and was the size of a star.
These were the Great Dao of these sects. Their actions and the ripples that they stirred immediately attracted the attention of the side sect’s saint realm and the Wei Yang Central Region.
The latter stared at them but did not act rashly. This was because the dark sect’s gaze and deterrence were very strong. The moment the Wei Yang clan moved, they would give the dark sect a chance. The war would likely start immediately, and both parties were not completely prepared.
As for the side-sect holy region, they were too far away. If they crossed the border at the same time, it would easily cause misunderstandings and even greater war. That was why they were watching.
As the unending central region and the side-sect holy region watched, the elites from the various sects and clans from the celestial domain were getting closer and closer to the federation.
In the Vast Expanse Dao Palace, the lord of the stellar wings was silent for a few breaths. He stood up and bowed towards the spot where Wang Baole was meditating. Then, he took a step forward and arrived outside the solar system. He sat down cross-legged in the starry sky, a huge figure gathered behind him. It was like a god, standing tall in the starry sky.
A hearty laughter rang out from another direction. It came from a sea of fire. A woman walked out from the Sea of fire. She was dressed in armor, and her eyes were filled with viciousness. There was a cold smile on her lips, she sat cross-legged outside the Solar System as well and spoke.
“Little junior brother, don’t be afraid. Eldest senior sister will protect you!”
The person who had come was Wang Baole’s eldest senior sister. She was also… one of the clones of the blazing flame ancestor. Her cultivation had also reached the celestial domain realm.
Apart from eldest senior sister, the Phantom image of a divine ox appeared in another direction. It raised its head and roared, and the flames around its body surged into the sky.
“Kid, I’ll help you!”
Wang baole smiled, but he sighed inwardly. He felt that his master must have been too deeply immersed in the drama..
Before Wang Baole’s smile faded, the scent of incense wafted out from the fourth direction. A gentle-looking middle-aged man walked out from the void. His body was in a state of illusion and reality. When he appeared.., he smiled at where Wang Baole was sitting cross-legged. He didn’t say a word. He sat down cross-legged. The power of his incense shook the starry sky.
It was… Wang Baole’s second senior brother, the only true second senior brother who had cultivated the dao of incense!
Wang Baole couldn’t get up. His heart warmed even more. He stared at the four figures around him and suddenly sent a voice transmission. Then, he closed his eyes. The cultivation in his body had increased from fifteen steps to more than fifty steps!

chapters.title: Chapter 1202 - waiting to be entrapped
chapters.content:
Chapter 1202:, waiting to be entrapped
Translator:
549690339
Fifty-four steps!
They were halfway through the hundred steps. Wang Baole’s eyes lit up. He spread out his consciousness and enveloped the entire solar system. He sensed the four figures coming from all directions. At the same time, he sensed that they were outside the solar system, at that moment, powerful presences that were previously unattainable and that he had to look up to were rushing towards him.
The major powers of the star field had gathered together, and a great battle was about to begin within the left Dao sacred region. At the same time, the eyes of the side sect gathered. The Weiyang Central Region was also using a special method to look at this place.
At this moment, the divine will of the vast majority of the experts in the entire Weiyang Dao region was gathered in this tiny federation. One of them was from the side sect, the ninth Phoenix sect, which was ranked third in the sacred region. The bell lady was sitting cross-legged next to her master as she looked over, her expression seemed normal, but deep down, her emotions were turbulent.
It was the same for the Seven Spirit Dao, which was ranked second in the side sect’s holy region. It was the same for the mysterious and unfathomable moon star sect… the figures within were all within the sect’s array formation, looking at the federation from afar. Kong Dao and Zhuo Yifan were among them, li Wan ‘er was among them.
!!
There was also a blurry figure sitting cross-legged in front of a waterfall at the back mountain of the Moon Star sect. Although her eyes were closed, her divine thoughts had already crossed the galaxy and landed in the starry sky where the Federation was located.
There were also Xie Haiyang and his son, who had returned to the Xie family. There were also many people who knew Wang Baole. They were all paying attention to him in every region of the Weiyang Dao Domain.
As everyone watched, Wang Baole’s cultivation continued to climb from the fifty-fourth step to the fifty-seventh to the eighth step… outside the federation’s Solar System, in the east, which was marked by the Earth, the galaxy distorted, the sound of the Great Dao reverberated through the void. One could even see the starry sky collapsing and shattering.
Black chains broke out from the collapsed starry sky. There were nine of them, each formed from the Great Dao of the nine Prefectures Dao. There were more than ten mighty figures from the Galaxy on top of the last chain, a figure stood. It was an old man dressed in a white robe. His cultivation was at the perfected Galaxy realm, and he seemed to be able to suppress the laws and regulations. The moment he appeared, ripples appeared in the starry sky inside and outside the Solar System.
Even Wang Baole’s cultivation paused for a moment. He opened his eyes and looked over.
The second senior brother, who was guarding the area and cultivating the dao of incense, sat cross-legged. He opened his eyes slowly and looked calmly at the nine great dao chains and the dozen or so figures from the galactic realms.
“Halt,”the second senior brother said calmly. He raised his right hand and waved it. Instantly, a loud boom rang out behind him. The starry skies distorted as well. Bubbles of all sizes and colors appeared one after another.
Each of these bubbles contained a world, the foundation of second senior brother’s Dao, the incense nation. If you magnified these bubbles countless times, you would be able to clearly see that the world contained countless living beings, these living beings were currently meditating, worshipping, and offering astonishing incense offerings. The source of these incense offerings was none other than second senior brother.
As soon as the words left his mouth, he waved his right hand. As soon as the bubbles appeared, the power of the incense transformed into numerous symbols that contained boundless will power. They blocked the incoming nine chains.
Rumbling sounds could be heard as the symbols and will power collided with the nine chains. The dao resonated, and the hearts of all living beings trembled. As the nine chains shook, the bodies of the more than ten star domains above them rushed out to suppress second senior brother.
The sound was so loud that it filled the sky. Second senior brother’s body was blurry, and his face was a bit pale. However, he performed a double-handed incantation gesture and waved his hand. Immediately, the countless incense sticks from the air bubbles gathered together again, forming an incense stick that was lit!
As soon as the incense stick appeared, Wisps of mist swirled around in all directions, once again blocking the way.
Although they managed to trap the feet of the more than ten star domains above the nine chains, it was clear that they could not hold out for too long. At the same time, the white-robed old man from the nine Regions Dao looked over coldly from a distance. He did not immediately make a move.
At the same time, similar scenes appeared in three other directions. The person who descended in the direction of the eldest senior sister was the tall giant. This giant was only an illusory dao shadow, and several star domains within it formed hand seals at the same time, this caused the giant to explode with great power. A punch was thrown over. Although it was blocked by the eldest senior sister, the eldest senior sister also coughed up blood, but she did not retreat.
As for master Xing Yi, he was in an even more miserable state. His opponent was that shocking cauldron. Its suppressive power was shocking, causing him to cough up blood. His hair was disheveled as he continuously retreated.
The one who should have been the most relaxed was old bull. However, his opponent was not one side. Instead, it was the heaven cleaving axe and the meteorite. These two dao shadows represented a sect that was ranked in the top five of the left Dao holy region, there were more than a dozen people from the star region who had arrived. They attacked at the same time. Even though Old Niu wasn’t ordinary, he was still shaken by the force of the attack.
In that instant, there was a loud boom, the sound of the Great Dao colliding, and the sound of the galaxy being torn apart. It erupted outside the solar system, but there were still people who didn’t move.
The white-robed elder from the nine Prefectures Dao didn’t move. The four elders from the other four great sects, who were at the late-stage of the star region, didn’t move either. The five of them sat cross-legged in five different directions, their faces filled with vigilance.
They couldn’t move unless the flames burned.
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and continued to absorb the massive amount of spirit qi gathered by the ascending realm plate. His cultivation was increasing every second, from fifty steps to sixty steps.
It was as if his cultivation had reached such a stage that he could no longer conceal it, nor could he restrain it. His aura spread out involuntarily, causing the warring galaxies outside the Solar System to sense it.
A dark light flashed in the eyes of the white-robed elder from the nine Prefectures Dao, who was standing guard at the rear. He looked carefully at Wang Baole, who was in the Solar System, and then at the projection of the ascending realm plate. Then, he swept his gaze across the gap in the ascending realm plate, he suddenly spoke.
“Fellow Daoists, if the four sects still want to hold back at this moment and miss the opportunity, don’t regret it!”
“Fellow Daoists, you’re being too paranoid. The Great Powers of our sect have already tried their best. Why don’t the nine paths sect open the gap first? Our sect is willing to be the vanguard after the gap appears.”After hearing the words of the white-clothed old man.., the four late-stage star domain elders from the other four sects who hadn’t made a move spoke slowly.
“That’s the case!”
“That divine bull is a blazing mount. It’s a strange beast from the universe. How can it be easy to resist?”
The white-robed old man from the nine Regions Dao snorted coldly. He could naturally see that the almighty experts from the four sects had many reservations. In fact, the nine Regions Dao was the same. They weren’t going to go easy, but rather, no one wanted to rush into the Solar System first, that would cause the blazing flame ancestor to target them first.
Everyone had cultivated to this level, so they were naturally not stupid. If they were placed outside, they would all be crafty old foxes. Thinking of this, the white-robed old man’s eyes filled with determination as he suddenly spoke.
“Fellow Daoists, if the raging flames come, I will be the main force to hold them back. How about you and the other almighty experts from the four sects go all out?”
After a brief moment of silence, the four late-stage elders from the four sects nodded. Then, they immediately issued a decree. In the next instant… a monstrous boom rang out from old Niu, Guru Xing Yi, and eldest senior sister, the first to be broken through was naturally where Xing Yi was.
Blood sprayed out of his mouth. The instant his body retreated, three figures rushed out of his direction and headed straight for the Solar System. They closed in at the first possible moment and were just about to step in when, amidst the roar, they were all blocked by a force.
The thing that prevented them from entering the solar system was the protection that the ascending realm plate gave off. It was comparable to a spell formation, preventing the three cultivators from forcefully entering the Solar System.
The three of them looked at each other, but didn’t say anything. They immediately attacked the spell formation that prevented them from entering. From the beginning to the end, they didn’t go to the gap, nor did they mention it.
It wasn’t that they didn’t know. On the contrary… at the moment they arrived, the five sects, including the Dao of the nine regions, had already noticed the gap in the ascending plate.
However, that place… was too obvious. Anyone who was a bit vigilant wouldn’t choose it.
Very quickly, outside the Solar System, a loud boom rose again. As the wings of the stars retreated, as the eldest senior sister and second senior brother retreated, more figures rushed past and bombarded the protective barrier of the ascending realm plate.
At that moment, Wang Baole’s eyes flashed imperceptibly.
It’s still not enough. He muttered to himself. His cultivation had also risen to sixty-three or forty steps. He seemed to be in a hurry. He didn’t know what spell he had used, but the absorption and increase in his cultivation had increased slightly.
At the same time, outside of the solar system, the other sects from the other star fields arrived one after another, no matter how slow they were. As soon as they appeared, the eyes of the white-robed old man from the nine regions dao began to shine brightly.
“There’s a gap in the ascending realm plate. Follow my lead and go suppress it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1203 - realm mending plate (part one)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1203: realm mending plate (part one)
Translator:
549690339
The moment the words left the mouth of the white-robed old man from the nine regions road, the experts from the various sects of the left Dao holy region who had just arrived all frowned and hesitated.
“Oh?”The white-robed old man narrowed his eyes and looked over.
As his gaze swept over, the hearts of the seven or eight star regions that had just arrived were all shaken. The gaze of an expert from the great circle of star regions was not something that anyone could endure.
“Senior three-daos,”said a peak mid-stage cultivator from one of the starfields. “May I ask if your sect’s patriarch nine-daos is coming out of secluded meditation?”.
The white-robed old man frowned. Recently, there had been a lot of bad rumors about his nine provinces dao patriarch. The nine provinces dao patriarch was not considered to have the battle prowess of a divine emperor, which made the nine provinces dao very angry, however, they couldn’t find the source of the rumors. At this moment, he flicked his sleeve and lifted his right hand. An ancient jade slip appeared in his hand. He squeezed it slightly, and a vast dao charm suddenly spread out.
!!
This dao charm surpassed that of a star domain. It was at the universe level, which was the divine emperor level. As it spread out, a fierce light appeared in the white-robed old man’s eyes.
“All of you, go break the gap!”
The expression of the mid-stage cultivator from the star field who had asked earlier changed, and cold sweat began to drip down his forehead.
Recently, there had been many rumors regarding the nine Regions Dao’s universe realm nine paths patriarch. Some said that this nine paths patriarch had already passed away, and some said that because he had once avoided reincarnation and returned to the world, he had been suppressed by the dark sect, there were also rumors that he was unable to leave the nine Regions Dao’s mountain gate. This matter had spread throughout the entire left path holy region, causing the hearts of all the sects to tremble intensely.
There were even some almighty figures who had deduced the secrets of the heavens. Although the answers they obtained were vague, they vaguely pointed to the matter of him passing away. Even now, even though the Dao charm revealed by the jade slip was indeed at the universe level, he was not completely sure, however, he did not dare to gamble.
Therefore, he gritted his teeth and the cultivator at the middle stage of the star region immediately bowed.
“Obey the Decree!”As he spoke, his eyes already had a decisive look. When he looked at the solar system, killing intent flashed in his eyes. He was the first to rush out. The other sects and star regions behind him also did not dare to say anything. They rushed out one after another. A group of seven people instantly approached the Solar System, they stepped into the rising boundary plate that enveloped the solar system, where the gap was.
As soon as they entered, these seven people immediately attacked. Under the explosive power of the star fields, they bombarded the defensive barrier.
In an instant, the illusory rising boundary plate shook intensely and slowly became translucent. As for master Xing Yi, eldest senior sister, second senior brother, and Old Niu, even though they were already retreating, they were unable to block all of them, however… the top five sects, including the Nine Prefectures Dao, maintained their suppression. At the same time, they each assigned one or two people to attack the defensive barrier of the Solar System’s realm Ascension Plate.
The rest of them didn’t approach.
Within the Solar System, the ripples of Wang Baole’s cultivation had increased from sixty steps to seventy steps, and his aura was becoming more and more shocking. However, not all of them had arrived.
Wang baole sighed in his heart.
The Realm Ascension Plate was incomplete and missing a corner. If Wang Baole had only been promoted to an ordinary Starfield, the integration of the Realm Ascension Plate into the Federation would have been enough to support his breakthrough. Even a little more would have been enough, much less him alone.
However, his promotion this time required a hundred times more than that of an ordinary starfield. That was why the missing corner was crucial. Wang Baole wasn’t confident that he would succeed.
That was why he had exposed his promotion in front of everyone. He wanted to attract attention. He wanted to create a sense of danger in the sects and clans of the left Dao holy region. He wanted to do it for the Realm Ascension Plate, he wanted to stop himself. As long as they came, as long as they stepped into the realm ascension plate..
Wang Baole was confident that he could use their life force to bring the Realm Ascension Plate closer to completion in a short period of time. He wanted to replenish what he was lacking in his promotion.
This was a plan that Wang Baole had hatched after he returned to the federation and grasped and studied the Realm Ascension disk. He had discovered that the realm ascension disk… contained the ability to shift the universe. At the same time, there was a gap in it, therefore, once it was activated… The Gap would be the most dangerous spot!
However, even though eldest senior sister, second senior brother, Old Bull, and the exalted star wing didn’t deliberately reveal any flaws and were indeed powerless to stop it… The Nine Prefectures Dao College and the other four great sects didn’t take any risks.
