They remained cautious, they allowed the other sects’Starfields to investigate.
As time passed, if any clues were discovered, all their efforts would be for naught. Furthermore, Wang Baole could already predict that the incomplete realm ascension plate would at most support him to seventy steps, after all, the complete and incomplete parts weren’t just missing the missing parts. It was a complete and integrated enhancement.
I was wrong. Even if master hadn’t come, these people wouldn’t have taken the risk. The result would still be the same… Wang Baole sighed. He felt a little regretful. There were only seven Starfields in the gap, there were only six other Starfields in the Realm Ascension Plate.
In total, there were only thirteen Starfields. Other than one peak mid-stage cultivator, the others were all at the early-stage.
If I could have ten more… Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. At that moment, the membrane at the gap trembled. The seven star domains within the gap attacked with all their might. The membrane was about to be blasted open, and the only mid-stage cultivator from the star domain.., surprise appeared in his eyes. Then, he seemed to have sensed something. His expression changed, and he was about to retreat.
However, just as he sensed that he was about to retreat, a cold glint flashed in Wang Baole’s eyes. He didn’t hesitate any longer. He raised his right hand and pointed!
“Spin!”
The moment he said that, the giant ascending realm plate that enveloped the entire solar system began to spin. As it spun, a sense of translocation erupted, the white-robed elder from the nine prefectures dao college and the late-stage elders from the four sects all had a change in expression. They stood up abruptly, and the expressions on the faces of the other star domains changed as well..
The bodies of the six early-stage cultivators from the five sects instantly turned blurry. There was no sign of struggle or resistance. They disappeared in an instant. When they reappeared… They had all been teleported to the gap!
“There really is a trap!”
“Damn it!”
The five great sects, including the Nine Regions Dao sect, let out a low roar. The sixth cultivator, who had been teleported to the gap, had a change in expression. Together with the only mid-stage cultivator from the galaxy, his cultivation erupted and he was about to escape.
However, in the next instant…
“Seal!”
Wang baole, who was sitting cross-legged in the Sun and star, had a vicious look in his eyes. As he spoke calmly, a powerful sealing force appeared at the gap in the ascending realm plate. It sealed off all the positions, causing the cultivators inside to.., they wouldn’t be able to rush out in a short period of time.
“Wang Baole!”Shouts rang out from inside and outside the gap. The white-robed elder from the nine Prefectures Dao, as well as the late-stage elders from the four sects, rushed out at the same time. However, just as they rushed out.., the Sea of flames descended, enveloping everything in its path. The blazing flame ancestor stepped out of thin air.
With a wave of his hand, he blocked all five of them.
“Blazing Flame, how dare you! My Dao of the nine prefectures ancestor will definitely suppress you!”The white-robed elder from the Dao of the nine prefectures shouted in a low voice, a cold glint in his eyes.
“Suppress? With the help of Your Sect’s dao array formation, he will only be able to reach the universe-grade in a short period of time. Does he dare come out? Why is he pretending to be a divine emperor? Your grandfather is the only deity Emperor in the left Dao sacred region. He managed to scare me last time, and now, he wants to scare your grandfather? The Blazing Flame ancestor sneered, he thought to himself that if he were to scare him again, he would spread the rumors even wider.
The recent rumors about the nine Prefectures Dao ancestor in the left dao sacred region were naturally caused by him… …
At the same time, while the blazing flame ancestor was fighting with the elders of the five sects, Wang Baole spoke again with a cold look in his eyes.
“Sacrifice!”
As soon as he spoke, a huge suction force erupted from within the solar system and the ascending realm plate. Everything else was perfect, so as the force erupted, the gap immediately became the target of everyone.
This place was sealed again, as if it was sealed. The faces of the thirteen almighty cultivators from the thirteen galaxies within it changed drastically. They were about to blast it open, but it was clearly impossible!
In the next moment, their bodies began to tremble. From their skulls, their eyes, ears, nose, mouth, every inch of their flesh and blood, every inch of their bones, and even every inch of their divine souls, there was the breath of origin, under the suction force, it spread out on its own, transforming into wisps of white mist that shot toward the edge of the rising realm plate!
The suction force was forced, and it was domineering. As everyone’s essences were sucked out, the unprecedented pain caused the thirteen cultivators to let out miserable shrieks.
Their bodies withered visibly, and their divine souls became transparent. Their life force, cultivation bases, and even all traces of their existence… were sucked away by the suction force of the ascending realm plate!
As the suction force was absorbed, the missing corner of the ascending realm disk, although not physically complete, appeared to be illusory threads. They intertwined with each other, causing the ascending realm disk to expand towards its illusory completion.
At that moment, Wang Baole’s cultivation erupted with a loud bang as the ascending realm disk absorbed and gradually became complete!
Seventy steps, seventy-five steps, eighty steps, eighty-five steps… ninety steps.
His hair danced in the wind, as if he were a river of stars. His divine soul appeared, as if he were a giant, resonating with the Great Dao. His fleshly body rippled, as if it were resonating with the starry sky, until… his cultivation base.., he had reached the ninety-five steps of the Great Circle of stars!

chapters.title: Chapter 1204 - Perfected Hundred Steps!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1204:, Perfected Hundred Steps!
Translator:
549690339
Just as Wang Baole’s cultivation reached the ninety-fifth step of the perfected star realm, the more than ten star domains at the gap in the realm ascension plate let out shrill screams. Their bodies withered instantly, then, as if they had turned into dust, they vanished into the starry skies.
Their bodies, their vitality, their souls, their cultivation, and everything else had been sacrificed to make up for the missing corner of the Realm Ascension Plate.
However… even if they were sacrificed, the ascending realm disk would still be unable to make up for what was missing.
The real way to make up for what was missing was to make the ascending realm disk truly complete. That was too difficult. According to Wang Baole’s estimations, if he wanted to do that, the number of star domains he had to sacrifice would reach an astonishing level, of course, if he had the ability to sacrifice a universe deity emperor, he could do so as well.
Other than that, there was another method. That was to find some extremely precious natural treasures. Or perhaps, for the entire stone stele world, it was to find a soul with a special meaning that carried the weight of time.
!!
There might seem to be many methods, but in reality, none of them were possible.
That was why after Wang Baole had studied the Realm Ascension Plate, he had thought of a method. He wouldn’t try to fill in the gaps with material things. Instead, he would weave an illusory web and use a large amount of spirit qi and the soul to fill in the gaps in the Realm Ascension Plate, he would make it seem complete.
He would then be able to support himself and break through to the celestial domain realm. However… now that his cultivation had risen to the ninety-fifth step of the perfected star realm, Wang Baole could sense that the realm ascension plate was powerless.
Looking around, the dozen or so celestial domains that he had worshiped had only filled in sixty percent of the gaps in the Realm Ascension Plate.
“What a pity!”Wang baole sighed softly. He was filled with regret. However… This scene was extremely shocking to the powerful cultivators from the various sects and clans outside the Solar System.
“This… this…”
“What a ruthless heart!”
“Sacrificing a powerful cultivator from the galaxy to fill the gap. Wang Baole, you are too vicious!”
Roars filled with shock rang out from the powerful cultivators from the various sects outside the Solar System. The white-robed elder from the Dao of the nine prefectures narrowed his eyes. He was shocked by Wang Baole’s sacrifice, and his body swayed as he retreated, he focused his gaze on the Solar System. The other late-stage cultivators from the other four sects also retreated rapidly.
The Blazing Flame ancestor didn’t stop him. He snorted coldly and stood outside the Solar System. His eldest and second disciples, as well as the divine ox, gathered rapidly. The stellar wing master hesitated for a moment before rushing over as well, he cupped his fists and bowed to the blazing flame.
The blazing flame smiled and nodded. Then, he looked at the nine Regions Dao and the others, and a cold glint flashed in his eyes.
“Come on, let’s go in. This time, we won’t Stop You.”
The white-robed elder from the nine prefectures dao frowned. He was in a dilemma. If he attacked, he was worried that the realm ascension plate would still have a suction force. If he didn’t attack, a stalemate wouldn’t be an option.
The elders from the other four great sects also had grim expressions on their faces. They had judged that there was danger at the gap, but they hadn’t expected that the danger was actually a sacrifice.
It was a good thing that they could clearly sense that Wang baole, who was sitting cross-legged within the Sun and star, hadn’t attained a perfect level of cultivation. That way, they had achieved their goal.
“Wang Baole, if you agree to our two conditions, we don’t need the Realm Ascension Plate. The left Dao sacred region also welcomes the promotion of Your Federation and recognizes the status of your federation. Form an alliance with each other and stop fighting!” The white-robed elder from the nine Prefectures Dao suddenly spoke.
Without waiting for Wang Baole’s reply, the white-robed elder spoke again.
“First, you must immediately advance to the star domain. You can not continue to accumulate the power of perfection
“Second, the federation can not expand for another ten thousand years. Maintain this scale
“Third, you must follow the instructions of the left Dao Sacred Region’s parliament and act in coordination with external enemies
“With these three conditions, if you agree, the left Path Holy Region Council will give you a spot in the federation, and you will be protected by the left Path Holy Region. If you do not agree… then today, we will attack in full force and Destroy Your Federation!”The white-robed old man said, the aura of a perfected Starfield exploded out. The other Starfields in the nine prefectures around him did the same, causing the starry sky to tremble. Nine Great Dao chains suddenly appeared once again, enveloping the entire area, it was as if they wanted to trap the solar system within.
The other four sects did the same. The cauldron rumbled, the Giants roared, the heaven cleaving axe and the meteorites emanated boundless dao might, as if they wanted to solidify all of the fate of the Solar System.
More than fifty celestial domains surrounded the area, each of which was filled with shocking energy. The starry sky seemed to be on the verge of collapsing.
Faced with all this, even the blazing flame patriarch’s expression turned grim. The Divine Ox and his eldest disciple were his clones, and they were the same. Only the second disciple remained expressionless, however, there was determination in his eyes.
As for the exalted cultivator from the stellar wing, he narrowed his eyes, as if weighing the pros and cons in his heart. However, he seemed to have thought of something in the end. Determination appeared in his eyes, and his fighting spirit rose.
Seeing that both sides were in a stalemate, the blazing flame ancestor suddenly sent a telepathic thought to Wang Baole from the bottom of his heart.
“Baole, I was rash this time. Use your worst-case scenario. Do you need me to sacrifice a portion of my cultivation to suppress the gap?”
“Master is concerned about me. How could I Be Rash? I am grateful. Thank you for this, master. It is my miscalculation that is not to blame, Master!”Wang Baole stood up from his cross-legged position and raised his head to look outside the solar system, he first bowed deeply towards his master.
As he swept his gaze across the elites from the nine prefectures dao sect and the other sects, a murderous look appeared in Wang Baole’s eyes. Although he had been scheming against the sects, if they hadn’t come, the previous incident wouldn’t have happened.
I’m still a little short… Wang Baole’s eyes were filled with determination. He wasn’t an indecisive person. Even though he needed his master’s help to make a last resort, it wouldn’t affect his master much, he had only limited it to the federation for a period of time.
That period of time was enough for him to find a replacement.
With that thought in mind, Wang Baole suddenly sent out a telepathic thought.
There’s no need for master to personally suppress it. I just need to draw the raging flame galaxy over and suppress it at the gap in the ascending realm plate. This spell will cause a loss of spirit Qi in the raging flame galaxy. However, I will be able to find a replacement within half a year at most. As I release the Raging Flame Galaxy, I will also be able to replenish the missing spirit qi. However, during this half a year, due to the suppression of the Raging Flame Galaxy, I’m afraid that master will be confined to the federation… Disciple..
“That’s it?”The blazing flame ancestor laughed. He didn’t seem to care at all. He didn’t even bother listening to what Wang Baole had to say after that. He raised his right hand suddenly and grabbed at the air.
With that Grab, a ball of flame appeared out of thin air. The Blazing Flame ancestor held it in his hand and tossed it casually towards the gap.
The ball of flame moved at a rapid speed. It reached the gap in an instant and expanded abruptly. Instantly, the void rumbled. The ball of flame grew larger and larger. In the blink of an eye, it was the size of the gap. The Flames within it churned, a vast galaxy could be seen within.
It was… The Raging Flame Galaxy.
This scene stunned the white-robed old man and the others, and their expressions immediately changed. They wanted to stop it, but it was clearly impossible. In the next instant… as the ball of flame appeared, it suddenly pressed down on the gap.
With a loud bang, the Solar System shook violently. From within the ball of flame, a shocking amount of spiritual energy exploded out. This spiritual energy spread rapidly, forming many threads that filled up a corner of the ascending realm plate, the gap that was already sixty percent filled was instantly filled up!
Even though it was still incomplete, from the perspective of filling up the void, it was already complete!
The instant the filling up of the void was completed, the ascending realm plate rumbled. Wang Baole’s cultivation rose once again from the ninety-five steps that had stopped.
Ninety-six steps!
Ninety-seven steps!
Ninety-eight steps!
Ninety-nine steps!
Up To… a hundred steps!
Wang Baole’s hair danced in the wind, and his aura rose infinitely. As everyone outside the Solar System was shaken, the light in their eyes exploded, and they spoke suddenly.
“Why should I be the one to give you the three conditions instead of the three I gave you? Today… I will step into the Galaxy!”
As he spoke, the sound of the starry sky rumbled out from his body, shaking the Great Dao. The entire Solar System became one, fusing with his body. Countless natural laws erupted madly!

chapters.title: Chapter 1205 - Great Dao transmission domain!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1205:, Great Dao transmission domain!
Translator:
549690339
“Wang Baole!”The white-robed elder from the nine prefectures dao college’s expression changed drastically. The other elders from the four great sects did the same. They were filled with killing intent. They might have been on friendly terms with each other previously, but now, under their combined attacks and pressure.., wang Baole had chosen to advance to the perfected star realm. This represented Wang Baole’s attitude.
His words made the white-robed elder and the others even angrier. Seeing that Wang Baole was about to advance, the five of them looked at each other and didn’t hesitate. They attacked at the same time, heading towards the Solar System.
The Blazing Flame ancestor was about to stop them when Wang Baole’s voice reverberated in the starry skies.
“Master, there’s no need to stop us. Please return to the Solar System to rest. Let them do their thing. After the disciples advance, we will go to their sects and pay our respects to them.”
The Blazing Flame Patriarch laughed heartily. With a flick of his sleeve, he swept up his own disciples, master starry wings, and the old bull into the Solar System. As soon as they entered, the five great sects in the area made their move, they had already landed.
!!
Rumbling could be heard as the nine Great Dao chains of the Dao of the nine prefectures spread out without limit, encircling the solar system layer by layer, as if they were completely sealing it. The giant waved his hand and grabbed the heaven cleaving axe, the two sects actually appeared to have fused their dao together, and the axe struck the protective barrier of the ascending boundary plate of the Solar System.
The sound was monstrous, and the ascending boundary plate that protected the solar system trembled a few times. Although it caved in, it did not shatter. Instead, it quickly recovered. At the same time, the meteorite also descended, and with a boom, it smashed down, it caused the edge of the Solar System to be heavily caved in, but it was similarly not damaged.
Then, the attacks from the dozens of galaxies formed a storm of divine abilities and spells, engulfing the Solar System. However, the Realm Ascension Plate was a supreme treasure. Even if the gap was only a false one, the defense it formed still shocked everyone who had attacked, they were shocked beyond words.
They were unable to do anything to the Realm Ascension Plate in a short period of time!
This was the difference between Wang Baole and the past. After experiencing so many things, his thoughts had changed a lot. He was still ruthless and didn’t lack to gamble, but his foundation was… full of confidence!
There had been some errors in his calculations during the battle today, but that was only for his cultivation. If it was a safety issue, Wang Baole was ninety percent certain.
That was why he didn’t even look at the powerful cultivators from the various sects that were attacking the solar system outside. He didn’t care about the waves of ripples that reverberated within the solar system due to the explosions in the outside world.
Naturally, the federation cultivators took action to resolve these ripples. At that moment, Wang Baole was completely focused on his own breakthrough. After his cultivation reached the hundred steps of the perfected stellar realm, he didn’t hesitate at all, as he accumulated his strength to the maximum, he exploded with a loud bang.
It was as if there was an invisible pillar of light that represented Wang Baole’s cultivation. It continued to climb into the void at an extremely fast speed. Even as it climbed, it would still encounter some invisible barriers that blocked its path, however, these barriers only collided with the pillar of light before they shattered with a loud bang. They couldn’t stop it at all.
The entire process lasted for the time it takes for an incense stick to burn. As Wang Baole’s cultivation soared, the Dao Aura on his body grew stronger. His hair danced in the wind, and his body began to emit a refreshing fragrance.
The rules and laws around him were revealed. Above him, countless mesh-like existences appeared in the Solar System. The void below him was also churning, and he was located in the center of the Solar System, the entire Solar System was spinning around him.
The spinning speed increased, and more rules and laws appeared. The starry sky rumbled and shook the heavens and earth. Finally, cracking sounds came from within Wang Baole’s body!
The tens of thousands of stars in his body had all become stars. The core was dao, and nine circles surrounded him. The tens of thousands of stars dotted each other. After they became stars, they continued to expand, causing the starry sky in his body to spin as well!
The size of the starry sky… was shocking. There were tens of thousands of galaxies in it, and each galaxy wasn’t weak. They were formed from the evolution of special galaxies, forming one spiral after another. Eventually… They formed within Wang Baole’s body! The spiral of stars gathered together and formed… a galaxy!
With a loud boom, Wang Baole’s hair fluttered in the wind once again. His soul materialized, and his physical body emitted a strong light. The instant his cultivation advanced to a galaxy, the three of them fused together rapidly.
His soul, physical body, and cultivation all merged into one!
There was no distinction between them. There was no longer the pure power of the soul. There was no longer the simple power of the physical body. There was no longer the usual fluctuation of cultivation. After all of them merged into one, Wang Baole’s every move contained the power of the soul, it contained the power of the physical body, and it contained the fluctuation of cultivation.
All of this caused his dao charm to erupt instantly. Behind him, a shocking divine ox that was larger than the solar system was formed. It was even refracted outside.
Even the old ox’s original body seemed to be inferior to it. It was as if this was the real divine ox. However, that was not all. On the Divine Ox’s back, Wang Baole’s illusory figure suddenly materialized and sat cross-legged in meditation, as he closed his eyes, waves of ripples spread throughout the entire left Dao holy region.
At that moment, the rules and laws of the left Dao holy region were strongly affected. All the galaxies, the starry skies, and all the stars trembled slightly. The hearts of countless cultivators were trembling violently. faintly.., a voice seemed to reverberate in the minds of all the living beings in the left Dao holy region.
“My dao is free and unfettered!”
“The voice of the Great Dao, this is impossible!”As Wang Baole’s voice reverberated in the minds of all the living beings in the left Dao holy region, all the galaxies outside the Solar System, who had stopped their attacks in shock and were retreating rapidly.., all of their expressions changed drastically.
The white-robed elder from the nine prefectures dao seemed to have seen a ghost. He couldn’t control himself even with his composure, and he cried out in shock.
“Only by advancing to the divine emperor realm can the sound of the Great Dao spread throughout all life. You, you, you… you only advanced to the Starfield realm. How is this possible!”
“Even the legendary body of the beginning Dao wouldn’t be able to achieve this. unless… unless your life level is already at the divine emperor realm, or even higher. That’s why the sound of the Great Dao appeared before you advanced to the Starfield Realm!”
“You still have secrets. You… you… You’re not Wang baole, not a federation cultivator. Who Are You? !”
The white-robed elder went crazy. The elders from the four great sects beside him were shocked and lost their voices. Their scalps went numb, and they groaned in their hearts. If they had known that the voice of the Great Dao would appear after Wang Baole’s promotion, they wouldn’t have tried to stop him.
The voice of the Great Dao represented that its dao was written within the laws of the universe. The laws of the universe were part of the Heavenly Dao, but they weren’t something that the Heavenly Dao could influence. They were the foundation of everything!
To possess such a dao, to a certain extent… it was equivalent to possessing the might of a divine emperor who was at the universe-level!
The universe-level contained the universe within themselves. That was why they could be called Divine Emperors. They used the power of gods and the might of emperors to make all living beings in the universe invincible, unreachable, and untouchable!
Now, when they looked at Wang Baole’s Dharmic projection, they felt a piercing pain in their eyes, as if they were about to bleed. Their minds were in turmoil, and they retreated.
The Blazing Flame ancestor was also dumbfounded. He stared blankly at Wang Baole, and his mind buzzed. He subconsciously looked at his first disciple and the old bull.
“I taught a divine emperor?”
“Yes, you’re Old Bull.”Old Bull.
“Bull!”Eldest senior sister.
“Master is mighty…”second senior brother thought for a moment and said softly.
As the blazing flame ancestor stared at each other, and the experts from the five great sects in the outside world retreated rapidly, Wang Baole’s dharmic projection, which was larger than the size of the solar system, slowly opened its eyes and said calmly.
“You are not free.”
“You are not free.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1206 - Step Three!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1206:, Step Three!
Translator:
549690339
In the starry skies, outside the Solar System, the gigantic shadow of the divine ox stood above the galaxy. It seemed to be able to prop up the void, causing the entire left Dao holy region to tremble violently.
However, the source of all this was not the shadow of the Divine Ox. Instead, it was Wang Baole, who was sitting cross-legged on its back and wearing a long green robe with his hair flying in the wind.
His hair was as green as the clouds, representing freedom.
His long hair was like the Dao, and it fluttered in the wind. It represented freedom.
His eyebrows were like sharp blades, and his eyes were filled with stars. His entire body was filled with the dao aura. The vast universe within his body made Wang Baole’s dharma idol seem to have surpassed a god and become a supreme being.
!!
The moment he spoke, his words had reached the level where his words would follow the DAO.
You are not free!
As soon as those words were said… countless laws and principles appeared outside the Solar System. They formed threads that twined in all directions and rearranged themselves.
They rearranged themselves according to Wang Baole’s Great Dao, according to his will. They turned into shackles that appeared on every cultivator’s body. At that moment, the Unending Heavenly Dao dimmed, and the dark sect’s power of the Heavenly Dao dissipated.
Only Wang Baole’s Great Dao became the only one here!
This wasn’t the power of the galaxy that the stone stele world could display.
This was the power of the universe in the stone stele world!
Whether it was the nine Prefectures Dao, the other four great sects, or the cultivators from the various sects and clans who had rushed over, everyone’s bodies trembled violently at that moment.
As the shackle appeared, their bodies immediately became extremely heavy. It was as if something that originally belonged to them had been forcefully taken away from their bodies, causing the bodies of all the cultivators in the area to immediately become extremely awkward, in fact, even their movements slowed down.
This was a form of deprivation of all freedom, of all physical strength!
It wasn’t over.
All of you felt uneasy!
When these words were spoken, it was as if a windstorm had descended from the starry sky. It swept out in all directions, causing the void in the starry sky to distort violently. The dao within the bodies of all the cultivators trembled as they were suppressed, it was as if another shackle had sealed their souls, their will, and their senses!
This was to deprive them of all freedom and the breath of spirit!
At that moment, they couldn’t move their bodies or their minds. All the cultivators’minds went blank. It was as if time had stopped flowing in their bodies. Wang Baole raised his right hand, opened his palm, and faced the void, he slowly clenched his fist.
As he clenched his fist, the starry sky rumbled and the Void shattered. The dozens of sealed Starfields began to show signs of shattering. Cracks spread out, as if they were about to collapse.
It was as if Wang Baole’s palm had transformed into the starry sky. As he clenched his fist, he wanted to suppress all the cultivators in the area.
There were already seven or eight early-stage cultivators in the Starfields who couldn’t take it anymore. Before Wang Baole could fully clench his fist, a loud boom rang out. Their bodies exploded within the two seals. They were torn to shreds, his spirit and soul were also shattered. His body and soul were destroyed.
The cracks in the bodies of the others also increased. However… These were galaxy regions, and there were many of them. There were even perfected Galaxy regions like the white-robed elder among them.
There were also four late-stage cultivators in the galaxy regions. In the next instant, as the eight galaxy regions fell, the white-robed elder’s body trembled violently. A violent force erupted within his body.
As the force erupted, his entire body seemed to burn. It was clear that at this critical moment, he had chosen to burn his own cultivation and soul, allowing his cultivation to increase exponentially. He had managed to break free from Wang Baole’s dao shackles, he let out a shrill roar.
“Everyone, why aren’t you burning the Dao of the various sects? Do you want to die here?”
As soon as he spoke, the nine chains formed by the Great Dao of the nine Prefectures Dao began to burn with a loud bang. They flew towards Wang Baole’s dharma idol and wrapped around it.
At the same time, the four late-stage elders from the other four sects knew that they were in a life-and-death crisis. They saw that the white-robed elder was already on fire, so they gritted their teeth and unleashed their cultivation as if they were on fire, they too chose to burn. They managed to activate the Dao Shadows of their respective sects, causing the giant cauldron, meteorite, heaven-cleaving axe, and the giant to all burn.
As they burned, the elders of the four sects let out a shrill cry that spread in all directions. The cauldron crashed towards Wang Baole, the meteorite crashed, and the heaven-cleaving axe came crashing down beside Wang Baole. The Giant’s roar shook the starry skies, and he crashed into Wang Baole with his body!
That wasn’t all. As the Great Dao of the five great sects burned and suppressed Wang Baole together, loud booms rang out from all five directions in the left Dao sacred region. Those five directions.., they were the five great sects in the left Dao sacred region, including the Nine Prefectures Dao!
The five great sects were all paying attention to this place. They saw Wang Baole making his move, and they saw that their own cultivators were in imminent danger. How could they not be anxious? After all, this was their strongest combat ability on the surface,
therefore, in the next instant, the five great sects’foundations exploded. Each of them formed a dazzling arm that contained boundless dao charm. It pierced through the void from the five directions and appeared directly on the battlefield outside the Solar System, it didn’t touch Wang Baole. Instead, it grabbed the cultivators from its own sects and retreated rapidly.
“The Solar System is not a place where you can come and go as you wish,”Wang Baole’s dharmic projection said calmly. He ignored the various Great Dao that were hurtling towards him. His body instantly turned blurry and disappeared. When he reappeared, he was already far away, he raised his right hand and clenched his fist. The power of his physical body, his soul, and his cultivation were all fused together to form this punch. It was aimed at the five hands formed by the five great sects, which were retreating rapidly in an attempt to save Wang Baole. It was aimed at the five arms that were escaping!
The five arms trembled. In the next moment, they merged together without hesitation, forming an even brighter palm. The moment Wang Baole’s fist was aimed at him, it struck him directly.
Amidst the rumbling, Wang Baole’s fist collided with the palm formed by the five sects’accumulated resources.
The starry sky trembled. The Great Dao rumbled. The palm trembled violently. The cultivators from the various sects within spat out blood. At least thirty percent of them had their physical bodies disintegrated, their souls shattered, and their bodies and souls were destroyed.
However, the hand formed from the accumulation of the five sects’resources was indeed extraordinary. It retreated rapidly as it trembled. Even though all the sects had died, more than half of them were still protected. As it retreated.., it disappeared into the starry sky in an instant, disappearing without a trace.
Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and stared at the starry sky in the distance. At the same time, the items formed from the Burning Great Dao from the various sects, which he had managed to avoid by shifting his dharmic projection in a blurry manner earlier, also flew towards him and pressed down on him once again.
Chains, giant cauldrons, giants, sky-splitting axes, meteorites, and a shocking aura appeared around him. They burned everything. However, just as they were about to come into contact with Wang Baole, Wang Baole spoke calmly.
“Waning moon!”
Immediately, the spell of the waning moon was activated. The dao of the waning moon was time, and it didn’t belong to the stone stele world. With Wang Baole’s current cultivation level in the galaxy, as he activated it, time suddenly reversed around him, instantly reversing by dozens of breaths, the Burning Great Dao of the various sects around him were affected as well. They retreated from their burning state in an instant and retreated back into time.
However, before they could leave, Wang Baole raised his hand and suppressed all the items manifested by the Great Dao of the five sects. He threw them to the gap in the ascending realm plate that had been filled by the raging flame galaxy. He sealed it immediately, causing the gap to rumble, the pressure on the raging flame galaxy was greatly reduced, and it was replaced by the Great Dao of the five sects.
It became a new item to fill the gap!
This scene shocked all the cultivators in the Solar System who were paying attention to the battle. It shocked the myriad sect clans in the left Dao holy region who were looking at the scene from afar. It also shocked the many factions in the side sect holy region who were observing the scene.
“This isn’t the galaxy!”
“The power of a divine emperor! !”
“How… How is this possible! ? ! ?”
They weren’t the only ones. At this moment, all the sects and clans in the Weiyang Central Region, as well as the Weiyang clan, saw what was happening. Waves of shock rose up in their hearts, and the progenitor opened his eyes, his pupils constricted.
“This is… the true third step?”
Even further away, in the netherworld, a gaze seemed to pierce through everything and stare at this place.

chapters.title: Chapter 1207 - -- Mighty Master!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1207: — Mighty Master!
Translator:
549690339
The blazing flame ancestor’s eyes were filled with confusion. He still couldn’t understand why his disciple, after breaking through to the galaxy, had become… capable of becoming a divine emperor.
He had a guess, but it was too unbelievable. It reminded him of some rumors from ancient times.
On the other hand, the federation cultivators in the Solar System were excited and excited. However, they didn’t know much about the galaxy, so they didn’t notice anything. They only knew that Wang Baole was extremely powerful.
However, the Heaven Palm Grandmaster, the exalted star wing, and the Purple Gold Grandmaster were different. The waves of emotions in their hearts were surging. The Heaven Palm Grandmaster sucked in a deep breath. All the thoughts in his heart.., all of them vanished, and he no longer dared to show any signs of unwillingness.
As for Guru Starry Wing, he was trembling, and his eyes shone with intense light. He knew more than most people… because he had once seen a paragon cultivator from the outside world, the Holy Queen Yiyi of the sect, she was his daughter.
!!
Therefore, he knew a secret. All of the cultivators in this universe cultivated incomplete dao. They were all incomplete. In the outside world, although there were different names for the different levels of cultivation.., there was a unified judgment.
This judgment was made from the first step to the fifth step.
According to what he had heard in the past, this universe’s star field should belong to the third step in the universe, and the Divine Emperor was the fourth step. However, in reality, because the Dao was incomplete, it was far inferior to the cultivators in the outside world, the difference was due to the individual comprehending different dao. It was about the same realm.
There were occasional exceptions, but there were still some minor differences. Those who were able to make exceptions were the strongest in the universe.
However… no matter how exceptional they were, it seemed impossible for them to reach Wang Baole’s level. He had just stepped into the galaxy and demonstrated the divine emperor’s control over the Great Dao.
There could only be one explanation..
Could it be that Wang Baole, due to some special fortuitous encounter, has embarked on… a complete great dao, becoming… the third step in the true sense of the word
The cultivator from the stellar wing was greatly shaken. The Purple Gold Patriarch was also extremely excited and thankful for his previous choice. He felt that he had done the right thing in his life, he had resolutely chosen to merge into the Solar System.
As for the seventeen sons of the Seven Spirits Dao, they were all equally excited as they murmured to themselves.
“Daddy is really daddy. Wait for me, Daddy. My cultivation base will break through very soon. When that time comes, I’ll definitely go down to your knees and have some fun…”
There was also the mysterious Starry Moon sect. Sitting cross-legged on the cliff in front of the mountain waterfall, Patriarch Starmoon looked away from the federation, his eyes filled with emotion as a smile appeared on his face.
“The agreed time is almost up…”
At that moment, a thought appeared in the minds of everyone in the entire Weiyang Dao Domain. That was… from now on, there would be one more peak expert in the Weiyang Dao Domain!
That person’s name was… Wang Baole!
At that moment, Wang Baole, who had risen to prominence in the Weiyang Dao Domain, stood outside the Solar System. After suppressing the five Great Dao sects at the gap in the ascending realm plate, he stared at the spot where the palm formed from the Five Great Dao sects’foundations had disappeared. He narrowed his eyes, a sharp glint flashed across his eyes.
“The price I have to pay isn’t enough,”Wang Baole said calmly. He raised his right hand, clenched his fist, and threw four punches into the starry sky!
Each of these four punches was the strongest combat power he could muster after the fusion of his physical body, soul, and cultivation. They transformed into four gigantic fist shadows that rumbled with the power of the Great Dao, they charged towards the four great sects other than the nine Prefectures Dao!
They were so fast that they pierced through the void and arrived in the starry skies where the four great sects were in an instant. They charged straight towards the main star gate of the four great sects. As the cultivators from the four great sects cried out in shock, Wang Baole’s four fist shadows.., they landed in different starry skies.
The four great sects each unleashed a tremendous amount of power and unleashed their full strength. However, amidst a series of rumbles, Wang Baole’s fist shadows smashed into the mountain gate. Countless buildings collapsed, and a large number of cultivators coughed out blood from the tremors, even the stars were shaking. They were knocked off course, causing a storm to sweep across their starry skies.
Wang Baole’s dao charm dissipated with his fist, filling the starry skies where the four great sects were. All the cultivators felt their bodies sink, and their souls were suppressed. The stronger their cultivation, the deeper they felt.
To the four great sects, this punch represented Wang Baole’s attitude and his warning!
Then, Wang Baole looked in the direction of the Nine Prefectures Dao. What he had done previously was not enough to establish his might today. Even if he had thrown out four punches, he still would not have been able to achieve the deterrence that he wanted. Therefore, the source of all this was the nine Prefectures Dao, it was where Wang Baole wanted to establish his might.
As the four fist shadows disappeared into the distance, Wang Baole raised his right hand and made a grabbing motion towards the Solar System.
With that grabbing motion, the ancient green-bronze sword outside the Sun and star, which had been expanding continuously previously, suddenly trembled violently and disappeared in the next instant. When it reappeared, it had shrunk significantly, it was in Wang Baole’s hand!
After being lifted by him, the cultivation in his body exploded. The power of the scabbard rumbled and slashed towards the direction of the Nine Prefectures Dao!
A sword Qi that was the size of a galaxy exploded in front of Wang Baole. It pierced through the air and headed towards the location of the nine regions dao, creating countless explosions and sharp sounds as it whistled through the air.
As the sword landed, Wang Baole released his grip. The ancient green-bronze sword disappeared, and when it reappeared, it returned to its original position. The cultivators of the Vast Expanse Dao Palace were in shock. At that moment, in the left Dao sacred territory, at the main star Mountain Gate in the starry sky where the nine Regions Dao was located.., the void was torn apart. Sword Qi appeared and slashed at the star!
The star trembled as if it was about to be cut in half. Countless cultivators from the nine prefectures dao spewed out blood. A shocked sigh came from the depths of the nine Prefectures Dao. A gigantic figure, exuding the aura of a universe-grade cultivator, materialized, it raised its hand and pointed at the sword Qi that was slashing at Wang Baole.
A loud boom rang out. The figure’s finger collapsed, shattering into pieces. The Sword Qi dissipated as well. However, Wang Baole’s Dao Aura had turned into a suppressive force. Wang Baole’s voice echoed throughout the nine Prefectures Dao.
“This is a warning!”
His voice and Dao Aura spread like a storm, shattering the mountain gates of the Nine Prefectures Dao. The stars trembled violently as well. A portion of the area couldn’t take it anymore and collapsed, turning into countless meteorites that scattered across the starry skies.
“Fellow Daoist, please calm down. It’s the nine Prefectures Dao’s fault. We deserve this calamity.”After a long while, the universe-grade patriarch from the nine Prefectures Dao spoke slowly, his voice filled with fatigue and age.
At that moment, the entire left Dao sacred region was silent. Everyone understood that the situation… had changed.
Wang Baole didn’t continue to pay attention to the nine prefectures dao. Outside the Solar System, Wang Baole’s dharma idol turned around and bowed deeply towards the blazing flame patriarch as a disciple.
“Master.”
The blazing flame ancestor’s eyes lit up instantly. He puffed out his chest and stroked his beard. A smile appeared on his face, and he nodded his head in high spirits.
“Baole, you did well. Very well. I am very pleased. Boss, second brother, and Old Bull, you have to work hard too. You Can’t Play All Day!”
“What master has taught me is that I must work hard in the future and listen to master’s teachings. I must reach the level of little junior brother as soon as possible.”Eldest senior sister’s expression was solemn. She looked at Wang Baole with warmth in her eyes, when she looked at the flames, she was extremely respectful. There was even some exaggerated fanaticism..
Old Niu, who was beside her, also spoke solemnly.
“Your disciple is awesome. You are even more awesome!”
”…”second senior brother was silent for a moment before saying weakly.
“Master is mighty…”
Wang baole blinked. His heart was filled with warmth. He cupped his fists towards the blazing flame ancestor and bowed once again.
“Thank you for your teachings, master. Master, how about visiting my hometown?”
The blazing flame ancestor laughed heartily and nodded happily.
Wang Baole laughed as well. As he walked towards the solar system, his dharma idol shrank until it became as small as an ordinary person’s. He followed behind the blazing flame ancestor, and under the respectful welcome of the elites from the various factions in the federation, he walked towards Earth.
Along the way, the blazing flame ancestor’s laughter was loud and clear. Joy filled the entire starry sky.
The Solar System regained its peace. The Divine Ox Dao Shadow formed by Wang Baole’s divine ability was hovering above the solar system, threatening the entire universe. Within the Solar Star, Wang Baole’s actual body closed his eyes, the corners of his lips curled into a smile.
Accompanying his master was his Dharma Idol Avatar. It wasn’t that he was disrespectful, but that he had just advanced to the Galactic Domain. His actual body still needed some time to comprehend and consolidate his cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1208 - questions!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1208:, questions!
Translator:
549690339
Generally speaking, it was difficult for a person’s height to determine the true level of a civilization. However… there were very few absolutes in this world. Therefore, when a person’s height reached the limit.., the level of a civilization would rise by far too much.
This was the case for the Federation!
This was the case for Wang Baole!
His cultivation might only be in the galaxy, but… the battle he had fought against the five great sects had shown him to be as powerful as a divine emperor. The four punches he had thrown at the four great sects had shocked everyone, what shocked and alarmed the elites of the various sects in the never-ending DAO domain the most was… the sword he had used to slash at the nine Prefectures Dao realm!
That strike had been unleashed by the universe-grade Supreme Treasure, the ancient bronze sword. It contained all of Wang Baole’s cultivation, soul, and physical strength. Combined with the power of the Supreme Treasure, the power unleashed was so strong that it could injure a universe divine emperor realm cultivator!
!!
The Patriarch of the nine regions dao might have some problems of his own, but within the mountain gates of the nine Regions Dao, he had indeed been able to use some special techniques to reach the universe-grade. His finger had crumbled.., the few divine emperors within the Wei Yang clan had instantly placed great importance on Wang Baole.
After all, if the former were to leave the mountain gates of the Dao of the nine prefectures, he would only be a slightly stronger perfected galactic realm cultivator. As for the latter… he would be able to go anywhere he wanted, and he would be able to erupt with power that could threaten divine emperors.
This allowed the federation… to rise up completely. This was because not only did it contain Wang Baole’s combat strength, which was comparable to that of a divine emperor, but it also contained the blazing flame patriarch.
With the combined efforts of the master and disciple, it would have been fine if the dark sect hadn’t been present. The Weiyang clan might have been fearful, but if they had hardened their hearts and risked the death of two divine emperors, it wasn’t as if they couldn’t suppress them.
The price for doing so was high. However, if the time came, the Weiyang clan wouldn’t hesitate. However, with the dark sect’s greatest enemy on their side, the two superpowers could erupt into a war that would spread throughout the entire Weiyang Dao Domain at any moment, therefore, the Wei Yang clan did not dare to move or move at this moment.
Once they moved, the dark sect would definitely not let go of this opportunity. At that time, the Wei Yang clan would be in an extremely passive position, and the possibility of their destruction would increase by 20-30% .
And when a person, or rather, a faction, could increase the probability of the other party losing by 20-30% , that person or faction would already be standing in an undefeatable position.
This was the case with the federation at this moment!
Therefore, the Weiyang clan quickly expressed their goodwill and announced that the entire DAO domain had not only acknowledged the status of the federation, but had also sent out a large amount of resources as gifts. However, this also included scheming.., the status they had acknowledged was shockingly the number one sect in the left Dao holy region.
Their goal was clearly to sow discord, causing the other sects in the left Dao holy region, especially the nine regions dao, to suffer too great a loss of face. They had no choice but to fight the federation.
They would use this as a hindrance, because the Weiyang Dao region could only tolerate the rise of the federation. This was already the limit. They did not want to see a future in the left Dao holy region that… had never existed before, a domain lord who had unified the left Dao Holy Region!
At the very least, they would have to wait until the war between the Weiyang clan and the dark sect was concluded. Or perhaps… They could use this as a bargaining chip, rather than letting things get out of control.
The never-ending clan’s actions were in line with their interests. That was why the never-ending clan visited frequently in the following days. The various sects in the side-door holy region also arranged for powerful individuals of a certain status to come and present their gifts.
Similarly, in the left Dao Holy Region, Wang Baole’s battle had shaken all the sects. As a result, there were many admirers and visitors in the following days. However, there were almost no applications to integrate into the Solar System.
The various sects and clans in the left Dao holy region didn’t want to offend either side. They were all watching.
Wang Baole didn’t pay any attention to these matters. Instead, he handed the matter over to the Federation president, Wu Mengling, and the others. His avatar accompanied his master, the blazing flame patriarch, to relax in the Solar System, while his main body sat cross-legged in the Sun and star, he stabilized his cultivation.
He had already sensed that the combat prowess he had displayed after advancing to the Starfield had exceeded his previous judgment. This made Wang Baole feel puzzled as well.
However, the answer… Wang Baole had his own guesses and judgments as well.
There are three reasons for all of this… one is that my original form is the black wooden board, another is that it has something to do with the immortal inheritance that ancient times gifted me. Another reason is that in my previous life, I had left the stone stele world and comprehended the Dao beyond the stone stele world, especially the waning moon..
Wang Baole mumbled to himself. He naturally knew that the time art of the waning moon wasn’t the Dao of the stone stele world. That was why its power within the stone stele world was heaven-defying.
At the same time, the inheritance of immortals was very elusive. Wang Baole felt that it was more like an opportunity, or perhaps a proof of qualification. He wasn’t able to understand what it was exactly.
As for the black wooden board… Wang Baole narrowed his eyes. He thought back to what he had seen with the help of the statue in the Dark River, the wooden nail that had pierced into the forehead of the true emperor!
I feel like the truth is getting closer and closer..
Since my main body is stuck in the forehead of the real emperor in the Weiyang Dao Domain, why was I summoned into this universe? Is this the emperor’s plan to save himself, or… do I actually have another mission..
Back then… Allheaven had only planned to use a single finger to seal the Weiyang Dao Domain. However, after seeing my main body’s black wooden board, why did it… turn from a single finger to an entire arm
Is what he’s sealing really gu? Wang Baole narrowed his eyes, his eyes shining brightly. He had a bold guess in his heart.
Could it be that Allheaven is sealing Gu, me, and… The Emperor’s avatar! Wang Baole fell silent. He thought of Chen Qingzi.
Could it be that Chen Qingzi really didn’t know that he was the one who was supposed to seal and prevent anyone from going out? Why would he turn a blind eye to it? Previously, Wang Baole had thought that it was because of his emotions, and because of his master, Ming Kunzi.
But now, his thoughts were wavering.
Could it be… Chen Qingzi’s mission on the surface is to seal the ancient remnant soul so that the immortal’s inheritance can not leave, while the one who is secretly sealed is… The Emperor’s avatar
If the emperor’s avatar can not leave, then the real emperor will not be complete… if the emperor really has a large number of avatars scattered, then could it be… that this is where his last avatar is located
If it really is what I think it is, then the Emperor definitely didn’t mean for me to be summoned into this universe… the more Wang Baole thought about it, the more he felt that the seal on the stone tablet realm.., it was clearly preventing the return of the Emperor’s avatar, and he was here… because what he saw with the help of the statue in the Nether River was clearly an enemy of the emperor.
Do I really have a mission that I have forgotten about? Destroy the Emperor’s avatar? Make it incomplete
Then, what is the origin of the centipede… is it a part of the immortals? Or… is it the real Emperor’s avatar? Or is it the person who was sent here by the emperor’s true body to break the situation? Wang Baole had a headache, the more he knew, the more confused he became.
Also, the Black Wooden Nail is me. Then… is it the black wooden nail from back then that had consciousness? or did someone use the unconscious black wooden nail as a supreme treasure to destroy the Emperor and nail it between the Emperor’s brows? If the black wooden nail from back then had consciousness, then what is my consciousness now.
If it’s the latter, then who… controlled me and used it against the emperor? Wang Baole was silent. After a long while, he suddenly laughed.
“It’s useless to think too much. If I keep going, I’ll naturally know everything!”
“Now, what I need to consider is how to get master’s Raging Flames to remove the restrictions in the federation as soon as possible. I need other items that can be used to fill the gaps in the realm ascension plate…”Wang Baole narrowed his eyes and pondered, after a long while, his eyes shone brightly.
“There is one existence that fits perfectly… it is a soul that, to the entire stone stele world, bears the weight of countless years and has experienced the restarting of the universe from almost every era. It also has a special meaning…”
“Purple Moon!”Wang Baole suddenly raised his head. His gaze spread out from the solar system and stared into the depths of the starry sky.
At the same time, in the void within the nine netherworld, a gaze spread out as well. It looked at the spot where Wang Baole was looking. The owner of the gaze was sitting cross-legged in the nine netherworld. His long hair fluttered in the wind, and the ordinary wooden sword in front of his knees was Chen Qingzi.
“Junior brother, this is what I have prepared for you… a great tonic!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1209 - , the Purple Moon Tribulation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1209:, the Purple Moon Tribulation!
Translator:
549690339
As Wang Baole and Chen Qingzi stared at each other, one of them from within the Federation’s sun and the other from the depths of the nine Netherworlds. As they stared at the starry skies, their gazes converged on a certain spot within the Weiyang Dao Domain, a figure, who was sitting cross-legged and meditating in an area that only a mighty figure could find, suddenly shuddered.
It could be seen that this figure was a woman. At first glance, she looked very beautiful. She was none other than ziyue!
However, her body was completely obscured by mist. It was as if there were numerous souls within it, and each soul seemed to be the host soul. As they continuously roamed within her body, the woman’s face and figure changed rapidly, it was also visible to the naked eye.
Sometimes it was a young man, sometimes it was a young woman, sometimes it was an old man, and sometimes it was a middle-aged man. From the beginning to the end, there was not a single soul that repeated itself. It was as if the soul within her body was boundless.
However, without exception, no matter how she changed her appearance, her expression was cautious and filled with intense unease. In the end, when her face turned back into a beautiful woman, her eyes shone brightly, she raised her right hand and quickly formed a hand seal, as if she was deducing.
!!
When she was deducing, if someone looked in all directions, they would be able to see that there were no stars in the place where the Purple Moon was. There were countless specks of dust floating in the starry sky. Most of these specks of dust contained the aura of ancient times, moreover, some of the buildings that were considered complete could be seen to have features that did not match the characteristics of this era.
Looking at it from a distance, the ruins formed by the dust were very large. The area covered was probably the size of a galaxy. However, this was not the complete part of it. There were even layers of rings of light surrounding it.
Within each ring of light, there seemed to be ruins from different eras.
It was as if there were no other life forms in the area. There were only traces of the passage of time. From a distance, it looked like an enormous, immovable vortex.
This place… did not exist within the boundaries of Weiyang Dao Domain. It was the land of sinkholes, a place where history was buried. It was like a junkyard that was constantly being cleaned up.
Whether it was the dao domains of the nine serenities realm or the living, anything that could not be permitted by the laws of this generation would be expelled here. As time passed, the junkyard in the ruins.., was filled with countless chaotic ripples.
When these ripples and chaos reached a certain level, they would form a storm that would destroy everything. It would tear up parts of this place and turn them into the most primitive nutrients that would be sent into the entire Weiyang Dao domain and scattered throughout the starry sky, it would turn into the foundation for the formation of stars and the appearance of Spiritual Qi.
It could be said that the existence of this place was an indispensable part of the universe, as well as a part of the operation of its own mechanism.
Even before the dark annihilation storm descended, this place was still a place that no living beings were allowed to enter. No matter if it was the living or the dead, they were not allowed to get close to it.
If someone accidentally barged in, they would be contaminated as soon as they got close. If they were affected, their minds would become chaotic and they would die. They would become a part of this place.
Even the almighty experts of the star area were no exception. Unless they had special methods and had reached the great circle of the star area, they could only stay in this place for a period of time.
Of course, if one’s cultivation base was at the universe level, they could come and go freely in this place. However, they would still be affected, and the effect would gradually increase as time passed.
Therefore, this place wasn’t suitable for searching, and this characteristic made this place very suitable for hiding. Of course… this was only suitable for some special souls!
Because of the chaos and confusion here, it wasn’t a dangerous place for some souls with special meanings. It was more like a Holy Land. Zi Yue… was one such example.
She basically had no influence here. At the same time, she could make use of the chaos and confusion here to make her star Dao more complete. That was why, after the Earth Federation had left, she had recovered some of her past life’s memories, after arriving at the sinkhole, her cultivation base improved day by day. At the same time, she relied on the scattered seeds outside to indirectly control the surroundings.
At the same time, she was 99% safe. After all, if she were to hide, even if the divine emperor was here, he would have no choice but to give up on capturing her.
This was also the reason why… Zi Yue’s cultivation of the Dao of stars had spread to the various sects in the three major regions in secret over the years. She had even gained the attention and enmity of others, but she was still able to continue to live a carefree life.
Even after she had been intimidated by Chen Qingzi and Zi Yue had escaped, she hadn’t been completely afraid. However, over the years, there had been three times when she had felt a strong sense of fear.
The first time had been when Wang Baole had used the heavenly fate book to search for Zi Yue on the heavenly fated star. The second time had been when Wang Baole had locked onto the Dao essence in the mystic realm of the Federation.
Zi Yue had immediately reacted and changed her position. She had also made a lot of preparations. However, now… the sense of danger had erupted once again, and her body had clearly trembled a few times.
After a long moment passed, she looked up, and a vicious expression appeared on her face as she muttered to herself.
“A catastrophe? !”
As she spoke, her eyes narrowed, and she performed another incantation gesture with her right hand. She slashed out toward herself, and her body began to tremble. Gradually, she split into three, leaving one sitting cross-legged on the spot. At the same time, the other two split into two directions at top speed, one of them turned into a speck of dust even further away. The last body didn’t stop and disappeared into nothingness.
At the same time, within the Solar System’s star, Wang Baole’s real body stood up from his cross-legged position with a deep look in his eyes. He took a step forward with a calm expression.
As he took that step, ripples appeared in the void beneath his feet. As the ripples spread out, it was as if the starry sky had been peeled off. An image slowly appeared. In the image… was the sinkhole.
Wang Baole had locked onto Zi Yue twice, and he had already figured out the approximate location where she was hiding. Now that he had made up his mind to capture her, he didn’t hesitate at all. He walked towards the image within the ripples.
As his feet landed, Wang Baole’s true form disappeared instantly.
At the same time, in a city on Earth, the blazing flame ancestor, who was walking amidst the heavy traffic, was marveling at the splendor of the mortal world in the Federation’s civilization. Beside him were Wang Baole, eldest senior sister, second senior brother, and Old Niu, who had transformed into a burly man, zhao Yameng and Zhou Xiaoya were also accompanying him.
The Blazing Flame ancestor seemed to view the two girls as his daughters-in-law, and the more he looked at them, the more satisfied he became. On the way, his eldest senior sister would occasionally make fun of Wang Baole and the girls. The atmosphere was harmonious, and the blazing flame ancestor was like the ancestor of a family, he brought the younger generation on a journey, occasionally giving Zhou Xiaoya and Zhao yameng pointers on their cultivation levels, and they laughed and laughed along the way.
He had many treasures, and he would give one to each of them every now and then. As a result, Zhao Yameng and Zhou Xiaoya each had dozens of dharmic treasures on them. Wang baole smiled from the side. However, very quickly, almost at the instant his actual body left.., the blazing flame ancestor suddenly stopped in his tracks. He raised his head and looked in the direction of the Sun, then at Wang Baole, who was beside him.
“You went out?”
“I’m handling some small matters,”Wang Baole said with a smile.
“Dharma Idol, you don’t have to accompany me,”the blazing flame ancestor said with concern.
“It’s fine, don’t worry, Master.”Wang Baole bowed warmly and continued to bring his master around the mortal city. Along the way, they blended into the crowd around them, however, even though everyone was familiar with Wang Baole’s appearance, no one could recognize him after seeing him. It was as if Wang Baole’s appearance was different in everyone’s eyes.
As they strolled, ripples appeared in the sinkhole of the Weiyang Dao Domain, in the void beyond the rings. Wang Baole’s true form appeared out of thin air.
As soon as he appeared, his own Great Dao immediately rippled the rules and laws in the area. The sinkhole instantly roared, and countless bolts of lightning exploded in all directions, even the rings began to spin slowly. It was as if Wang Baole’s arrival had a huge impact on the entire sinkhole!

chapters.title: Chapter 1210 - hadn’t come to its senses yet?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1210: hadn’t come to its senses yet?
Translator:
549690339
The entire sinkhole was a celestial body formed by dozens of rings. Looking around, this place was incomparably vast. Each ring was made up of countless dust and ruins. As for the depths, they emitted a purplish-red light, when this light entered one’s eyes, it would cause one’s eyes to hurt and then explode.
The color seemed to be purplish-red, but in reality, it contained an extreme color that was beyond what ordinary life forms could see. At the same time, it contained information that had existed for countless years. Therefore, even if the galactic domain saw it, even if it didn’t die.., it would still have a strong impact on one’s mind.
However, to Wang Baole, this was nothing. He merely narrowed his eyes and swept his gaze across the sinkhole. As the Dao Aura filled the air, he stood outside and searched for anything suspicious.
The moment Wang Baole arrived, Zi Yue’s pupils constricted in the purple-red area at the center of the sinkhole. She couldn’t control the shock on her face.
What shocked her was Wang Baole’s cultivation. She had never expected that Wang Baole’s cultivation would increase so quickly. At that moment, she felt an intense sense of danger.
!!
What shocked her even more was that Wang Baole’s appearance had caused such a shocking reaction in the sinkhole. One had to know that the sinkhole was only so intense when the dark annihilation storm arrived, other times, it was extremely quiet.
However, at that moment… The chaos and confusion within seemed to be going out of control. The reason for all of this was Wang Baole’s arrival.
What is Wang Baole’s cultivation level? could he… could he be recalling his previous life? Zi Yue shuddered. She didn’t recall many memories from her previous life, but there was one scene that she couldn’t forget.
That was… in the first few lives, by the river, when she was about to catch a spirit rain in the river, she was stared at by a gaze that came from the void. That Gaze had frightened her to this day.
After recovering this memory, she had carefully considered it for a long time. She had even used some special methods to judge and analyze it. She had a vague feeling that the person staring at her should be Wang Baole.
Therefore, she had previously arranged for Chong Lizi to test him, but she had never been able to confirm it. It was only when she had been locked onto by Wang Baole’s Dao essence that she had a vague feeling that it might be Wang Baole.
Now that she had witnessed it with her own eyes, Zi Yue already had an answer in her heart. Her face turned even paler. She felt that her three-life spell was still unstable. Her body swayed, and she was about to retreat.
However, at that moment… Wang Baole, who was outside the sinkhole, opened his mouth and spoke calmly.
“Noisy!”
As soon as he spoke, countless echoes reverberated throughout the sinkhole!
These echoes appeared in every ring, and as they reverberated, illusory shadows appeared in every ring. Most of these shadows looked like black wooden planks, and there were even a few shadows, they were Wang Baole’s previous life!
There were the Celestials, the devil blades, the resentful cultivators, the zombies, and the little white deer… these shadows repeated Wang Baole’s words at the same time. Instantly, the entire sinkhole spun in circles, and the violent and chaotic laws and rules within them.., it froze instantly. It was as if the so-called chaos in this place had to be quelled in front of Wang Baole!
That was because Wang Baole’s Dao was to be free and unrestrained!
That was because Wang Baole’s soul had experienced all the lives, from the creation of this universe to the present. It was extremely heavy and incomparable!
That was because Wang Baole had been present in every life since the beginning of this universe!
All of this allowed Wang Baole to use his presence in every life to suppress everything. He could use his years of experience to shake everything, and he could use his dao to destroy the Chaos!
The laws and rules of the Heavenly Dao in the outside world repelled everything here. However, Wang Baole’s Dao and existence could not be repelled by the Heavenly Dao. Therefore, no matter what the reason was, he was supreme here!
No matter how chaotic this place was, it had to be obedient in front of him. This was because of his status, and this was the Suppressive Force of a God!
After the suppression, the sinkhole was peaceful. Wang Baole’s dao aura immediately calmed down in the sinkhole, and he sensed… the only fluctuation within!
This fluctuation did not come from his physical body, but from his mind. Under Wang Baole’s Dao Aura, the fluctuation in his mind could not be hidden. He instantly sensed it, and he sensed the lock on his divine thoughts in the purple-red region at the core.
“I’ve found it,”Wang Baole said calmly. He took a step forward. It was as if he had shrunk the stars into an inch. In an instant, he had crossed all the rings and appeared in the central region, right in front of Zi Yue’s hidden figure.
The moment Wang Baole appeared, Zi Yue let out a sharp sound and retreated abruptly. Her hands formed hand seals, and threads gathered rapidly in front of her, enveloping Wang Baole as if they were tearing through the void.
There were hundreds of thousands of threads. They were densely packed and covered the entire area. It was like a heavenly net!
The Shadows of the stars appeared on each thread. In that instant, the Weiyang Central Region, the left Dao sacred region, and the side sect sacred region all had cultivators from their respective sects and clans. Some were elites, some were seniors, some were men and women, some were old and some were young. There were hundreds of thousands of cultivators. No matter what they were doing in different places, their bodies trembled.
They sat down cross-legged. Their faces were flushed, and they seemed to resonate with Zi Yue. They… were all Zi Yue’s star seeds!
There were also some threads that weren’t connected to the three outer realms. They were connected to the ruins and dust in the different rings of the sinkhole!
Zi Yue was going all out. She was using her trump card. The moment she unleashed the art of the Star Dao, Wang Baole’s opponents seemed to be the hundreds of thousands of people. At the same time, the threads contained a large number of rules and laws, there were both this life and his previous life. They contained more than half of the Dao that had existed in the entire universe since it had been rebooted.
The power of the DAO surpassed that of the Starfield. To a certain extent, Zi Yue’s Dao was considered complete in the incomplete great dao of the stone stele realm. It wasn’t as complete as the divine emperor’s, but it still had some aspects that the divine emperor was wary of.
As the power erupted, Wang Baole’s eyes narrowed slightly, but only briefly… if it had been on a different battlefield, Wang Baole might have needed to fuse his dharmic form and go all out to suppress Zi Yue.
However, he didn’t need to do so here.
Although this place was suitable for Zi Yue, it was more suitable for Wang Baole.
That was because, in the history of the stone stele world, Wang Baole had been earlier than Zi Yue. This place… compared to the weight of time, it was like authority!
“Suppress!”Wang Baole said calmly. He raised his right hand and pressed forward. Immediately, the sinkhole rumbled once again. All of Wang Baole’s figures that appeared within it raised their hands and suppressed him.
Behind Wang Baole, as all the rings in the area rumbled and spun, Wang Baole’s true form, the black wooden board, appeared. It was extremely large and large, and it was an unprecedented sight. As his palm landed, it suppressed it.
In an instant, Zi Yue let out a shrill scream. The hundreds of thousands of threads in front of her began to collapse. Every time one of them collapsed, the stars on it would shatter. In the three outer domains, those who had been planted by her would spit out blood, their bodies would be reduced to ashes.
That was because they had died a long time ago. Zi Yue had used the art of planting stars to keep them alive like puppets.
Those who hadn’t been reduced to ashes had also dried up. All of their auras had been withdrawn by Zi Yue. At that moment, Zi Yue’s expression was ferocious. Her aura erupted, and a purple color spread out from her body. It was as if Wang Baole’s palm.., it became the sky in front of her, as if it wanted to conquer the sky.
However… it still didn’t work!
Wang Baole’s palm continued to fall, and the threads continued to collapse. Zi Yue’s shrill screams grew even more intense. Her body was clearly standing in the void, but the void beneath her seemed to have become an impenetrable place, making it impossible for her to escape, she couldn’t hide, and her body was showing signs of collapsing.
The faces of countless souls appeared on her body in an instant, but they died one after another. Hundreds of thousands of threads suddenly collapsed, and Zi Yue’s aura weakened to the extreme, fear and shock appeared in her eyes. Wang Baole’s palm stopped above Zi Yue’s head.
“Little Fox, haven’t you come to your senses?”
Zi Yue’s body trembled. She raised her head with difficulty and looked through her palm at Wang Baole. At that moment, Wang Baole was a little blurry in her eyes. He seemed to contain boundless great dao, like the ruler of Heaven and earth. He was majestic and mysterious, she couldn’t see his face clearly. All she could see was… a pair of eyes that were exactly the same as the ones in her memories.
Fear surfaced in her previous life, and Zi Yue’s mind felt like it was about to explode. Vaguely, she regained some of her memories. In her memories, she seemed to be in a little girl’s room, placed on a shelf, she watched the little girl draw curiously.
Until one day, she saw a little person fly out of the painting. The little girl brought the little person to the door. She seemed to be a little curious, so she shook hard and fell off the shelf, smashing onto the little girl’s head.
With this smash, she saw the appearance of the little person clearly.
This smash seemed to have entered the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1211 - Enlightenment
chapters.content:
Chapter 1211: Enlightenment
Translator:
549690339
“I… AM enlightened…”Zi Yue’s body trembled. She looked at the palm before her and at the blurry figure behind it that seemed to contain the might of the heavens. Waves of emotions stirred in her heart.
It was as if Wang Baole’s words were like a huge rock that had fallen into her heart, stirring up huge waves that drowned her. At the same time, the images buried deep in her memories were revealed, they filled her mind.
She saw her true form. It was just a doll. A doll that was placed on a shelf in a little girl’s room. It was lifeless, had no breath, and had no thoughts, she didn’t even know when she had gained consciousness.
She only knew that she was looking at a little girl. Other dolls were also looking at her. They were like an old ape or a little tiger.
They were all looking at her, until one day, the little girl put them into the world she had drawn..
!!
And so, they had real life. In the world she had drawn, they became the first gods… but unlike the other gods, she did not know why, but she always felt insecure.
Perhaps it was because she had been alone for too long, or perhaps it was because of that figure back then, that gaze, that sentence, that made her feel terrified, and that was why she lacked a sense of security.
She had always been afraid that one day, she would be erased. That was why, in her fear, she had given her hair to anyone who she felt could protect her life. This habit, even if the world changed time and time again, and the universe restarted again.., it continued to exist in her world.
And unlike the old ape, she and the Little Tiger had inevitably entered reincarnation.
After that, she would wake up in a muddle-headed state. She would forget too many things from the past, and forget many images. The only thing she remembered was that she had no sense of security in this universe. The only thing she remembered was.., her past habits.
That was why she had the seed star Dao.
She remembered that this cultivation technique… was not something she had obtained by killing her lover. Instead, it was something that had been passed down in the mysterious ruins of the Vast Expanse Dao Palace, that Ruin… was her cave abode from an unknown era.
She had created the Dao of stars.
“I remember now…”Zi Yue mumbled. She had woken up many times since she had entered this universe, but she had never been able to recall all her memories like she was now.
“You… are the person from back then, the little white deer, and the soul that had pushed open the door and walked out of master’s bedroom!”Zi Yue lowered her head, giving up all resistance as she spoke bitterly.
Wang baole looked at Zi Yue calmly and retracted his right hand. He stood in front of Zi Yue and looked around before speaking calmly.
“Since you have recalled your past life, are you willing to use half a sixty-year-cycle for me?”
“Only half a sixty-year-cycle?”Zi Yue was taken aback. She raised her head again and looked at Wang Baole. She had thought that she would definitely die this time, and the recovery of her memories made her lose all will to resist. She knew that if it was someone else.., perhaps she could still struggle a little. However, against the person before her, there was nothing she could do.
It didn’t matter if it was in the past or now.
